# ── Server ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Must match the frontend's NEXT_PUBLIC_API_PORT (default 8008).
PORT=8008
NODE_ENV=development
CLIENT_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8007
# fatal | error | warn | info | debug | trace | silent
LOG_LEVEL=info

# ── Authentication ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Required in production (≥ 32 chars). Generate: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(48).toString('hex'))"
JWT_SECRET=
# Session lifetime in seconds (JWT expiry, auth cookie and Redis session TTL). Default 8 hours.
SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=28800
# Failed login attempts allowed per IP per window.
LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10
LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS=900

# ── Database (SQL Server / Azure SQL) ────────────────────────────────────────
# Either set DATABASE_URL …
# DATABASE_URL="sqlserver://your-server.database.windows.net:1433;database=CRM_DB;user=crmadmin;password={your_password};encrypt=true;trustServerCertificate=false"
# … or the individual DB_* values below (DATABASE_URL is built from them when it is not set).
DB_SERVER=your-server.database.windows.net
DB_PORT=1433
DB_DATABASE=CRM_DB
DB_USER=crmadmin
DB_PASSWORD=your_password
DB_ENCRYPT=true
DB_TRUST_SERVER_CERT=false
# Connection timeout in ms (default 30000; recommended >= 30000 for Azure SQL Serverless cold starts)
DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30000

# ── Redis (cache, rate limiting, sessions, BullMQ) ───────────────────────────
# Optional in local dev: the API degrades gracefully when Redis is unreachable
# (imports of ≤ 500 rows then run inside the request; audit events are written directly).
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
# Run the import/audit workers inside the API. Set false when running `npm run worker` as its own process.
RUN_WORKERS=true

# ── Business settings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Timezone of wall-clock values entered in forms (ticket due dates) and of audit timeline times.
BUSINESS_TIMEZONE=Asia/Kolkata

# ── Seeding (`npm run seed`) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Admin account created on first seed. Leave the password empty to have one generated and printed once.
SEED_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD=
# Demo data (users + CRM records from prisma/seed-data/demo/*.json). Defaults to on outside production.
# SEED_DEMO_DATA=true
# Shared password for demo users; when empty they get random passwords and can't sign in.
# SEED_USER_PASSWORD=
# Re-import the ISO address master even if it looks up to date.
# SEED_REFRESH_ADDRESS_MASTER=true

================
File: backend-crm/prisma.config.ts

import 'dotenv/config';
import { defineConfig } from 'prisma/config';
import { resolveDatabaseUrl } from './src/config/databaseUrl.ts';

// `generate` and `validate` don't connect, so a placeholder keeps them working before a database is configured;
// `migrate` / `db push` fail fast against it with a clear connection error.
const PLACEHOLDER_URL = 'sqlserver://localhost:1433;database=CRM_DB;user=sa;password=placeholder;trustServerCertificate=true';

export default defineConfig({
    schema: 'prisma/schema.prisma',
    migrations: {
        path: 'prisma/migrations',
        seed: 'tsx prisma/seed.ts',
    },
    datasource: {
        url: resolveDatabaseUrl() ?? PLACEHOLDER_URL,
    },
});

-- Prisma emits string defaults without the N prefix, so the init migration stored the ₹ in these
-- defaults as '?'. Recreate them as Unicode literals. (The API always sets currency explicitly.)
BEGIN TRY

BEGIN TRAN;

ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Opportunity] DROP CONSTRAINT [Opportunity_currency_df];
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Opportunity] ADD CONSTRAINT [Opportunity_currency_df] DEFAULT N'Indian Rupee: ₹' FOR [currency];

ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Quotation] DROP CONSTRAINT [Quotation_currency_df];
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Quotation] ADD CONSTRAINT [Quotation_currency_df] DEFAULT N'Indian Rupee: ₹' FOR [currency];

COMMIT TRAN;

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH

IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
BEGIN
    ROLLBACK TRAN;
END;
THROW

END CATCH

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Nandini CRM â€” SQL Server schema
//
// Contracts mirror frontend-crm/src/types/*.types.ts; service mappers translate rows to those shapes.
//
// SQL Server rules applied throughout:
// â€¢ No scalar lists: string arrays (productCategory, communicationType, copyActivitiesTo, partnerCompanies)
//   are JSON in NVarChar(Max); repeating objects (emails, line items) are child tables.
// â€¢ No multiple cascade paths (error 1785): every cross-entity FK is NoAction/NoAction. Only owned
//   children (emails, line items) cascade from their single parent.
// â€¢ Core entities are soft-deleted (isDeleted / deletedAt), so FKs never block a "delete".
// â€¢ Column widths â‰¥ the frontend's FIELD_MAX_LENGTH (frontend-crm/src/config/fieldLimits.ts).
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  provider            = "prisma-client"
  output              = "../src/generated/prisma"
  moduleFormat        = "esm"
  runtime             = "nodejs"
  importFileExtension = "js"
}

// Connection URL lives in prisma.config.ts (Prisma 7); runtime connects through @prisma/adapter-mssql.

// â”€â”€ Identity â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

/// Mapped onto the pre-existing `Users` table (Id, Username, Password, Role) so current accounts keep working.
/// Every column added beyond those four has a default, so existing rows migrate without manual backfill.
model User {
  // Int keeps the existing auth contract (frontend `User.id: number`).
  id           Int       @id @default(autoincrement()) @map("Id")
  username     String    @unique @map("Username") @db.NVarChar(50)
  /// bcrypt hash. Legacy plain-text values are re-hashed on the user's next successful login.
  passwordHash String    @map("Password") @db.NVarChar(255)
  role         String    @default("Sales Executive") @map("Role") @db.NVarChar(50)
  /// Not @unique: SQL Server unique constraints allow a single NULL. Uniqueness is enforced in the service.
  email        String?   @db.NVarChar(120)
  fullName     String    @default("") @db.NVarChar(100)
  phone        String?   @db.NVarChar(20)
  department   String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true)
  isGroupUser  Boolean   @default(false)
  onLeave      Boolean   @default(false)
  lastLoginAt  DateTime?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @updatedAt

  @@index([email])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@map("Users")
}

/// Atomic per-prefix counters behind ORG-0001, CON-0001, â€¦ (see src/utils/codeGenerator.ts).
model SequenceCounter {
  prefix       String @id @db.NVarChar(10)
  currentValue Int    @default(0)
}

// â”€â”€ Organizations â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model Organization {
  id          String @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  accountCode String @unique @db.NVarChar(20)

  // Overview
  organizationName     String    @db.NVarChar(200)
  mailingName          String?   @db.NVarChar(200)
  tradeName            String?   @db.NVarChar(200)
  natureOfBusiness     String?   @db.NVarChar(100)
  accountStatus        String    @default("Active") @db.NVarChar(20)
  inactivityReason     String?   @db.NVarChar(500)
  typeOfEntity         String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  customerType         String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  sapCodeTallyId       String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  showroomBranchCode   String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  sourceOfLead         String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  /// Display name of the parent corporation (free text in the form); parentOrganizationId links it when known.
  memberOfParentCorp   String?   @db.NVarChar(200)
  parentOrganizationId String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  numberOfEmployees    String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  annualTurnover       String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  description          String?   @db.NVarChar(1000)
  accountVerified      Boolean   @default(false)
  verifiedAt           DateTime?
  verifiedBy           String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  activeAmc            Boolean   @default(false)
  activeCloud          Boolean   @default(false)
  provideSupport       String    @default("Yes") @db.NVarChar(3)
  assignedUser         String?   @db.NVarChar(50)

  // Billing address (billingStreet mirrors billingAddress for older records)
  billingAddress    String? @db.NVarChar(250)
  billingStreet     String? @db.NVarChar(250)
  billingCity       String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  billingState      String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  billingPostalCode String? @db.NVarChar(12)
  billingCountry    String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  billingLatitude   String? @db.NVarChar(30)

  // Shipping address
  shippingAddress        String? @db.NVarChar(250)
  shippingStreet         String? @db.NVarChar(250)
  shippingCity           String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  shippingState          String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  shippingPostalCode     String? @db.NVarChar(12)
  shippingCountry        String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  shippingLongitude      String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  copyAddressFromBilling Boolean @default(false)

  // Tax & bank
  registrationType String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  panNumber        String? @db.NVarChar(10)
  msmeRegnNumber   String? @db.NVarChar(19)
  accountName      String? @db.NVarChar(200)
  bankName         String? @db.NVarChar(100)
  bankIfscCode     String? @db.NVarChar(11)
  /// Canonical GSTIN; the API also echoes it as the legacy `gstNumber` alias.
  gstNo            String? @db.NVarChar(15)
  cinNo            String? @db.NVarChar(21)
  tanNumber        String? @db.NVarChar(10)
  accountNumber    String? @db.NVarChar(18)
  typeOfAccount    String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  bankAddress      String? @db.NVarChar(250)

  // Partner licensing: string[] as JSON
  partnerCompaniesJson String? @db.NVarChar(Max)

  // Audit & soft delete
  createdBy String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  updatedBy String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  isDeleted Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt DateTime?

  parentOrganization Organization?  @relation("OrganizationHierarchy", fields: [parentOrganizationId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  childOrganizations Organization[] @relation("OrganizationHierarchy")
  corporateEmails    EntityEmail[]
  contacts           Contact[]
  opportunities      Opportunity[]
  quotations         Quotation[]
  tickets            Ticket[]
  convertedLeads     Lead[]         @relation("LeadConvertedOrganization")

  @@index([organizationName])
  @@index([accountStatus])
  @@index([assignedUser])
  @@index([gstNo])
  @@index([isDeleted, createdAt])
}

/// Emails owned by exactly one Organization, Contact or Lead (one FK set per row).
/// Returned by the API as `corporateEmails` (organizations) / `emailAddresses` (contacts, leads).
model EntityEmail {
  id              String  @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  email           String  @db.NVarChar(120)
  isPrimary       Boolean @default(false)
  isOptedOut      Boolean @default(false)
  isInvalidBounce Boolean @default(false)
  sortOrder       Int     @default(0)

  organizationId String? @db.NVarChar(50)
  contactId      String? @db.NVarChar(50)
  leadId         String? @db.NVarChar(50)

  // Each parent is the sole cascade path to this table, so cascading is safe here.
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)
  contact      Contact?      @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)
  lead         Lead?         @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([contactId])
  @@index([leadId])
  @@index([email])
}

// â”€â”€ Contacts â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model Contact {
  id          String @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  contactCode String @unique @db.NVarChar(20)

  name             String  @db.NVarChar(100)
  /// Denormalized display name; organizationId is the link.
  organizationName String  @db.NVarChar(200)
  organizationId   String? @db.NVarChar(50)
  mobile           String  @db.NVarChar(20)
  officePhone      String? @db.NVarChar(20)
  phone3           String? @db.NVarChar(20)
  phone4           String? @db.NVarChar(20)
  phone5           String? @db.NVarChar(20)
  assignedTo       String  @db.NVarChar(50)
  isPrimaryContact Boolean @default(false)
  designation      String? @db.NVarChar(100)
  department       String? @db.NVarChar(100)
  leftJob          String  @default("No") @db.NVarChar(3)
  /// string[] as JSON (e.g. ["Call","Email"]).
  communicationTypeJson String? @db.NVarChar(Max)
  doNotCall        Boolean @default(false)
  description      String? @db.NVarChar(2000)

  createdBy String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  updatedBy String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  isDeleted Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt DateTime?

  organization   Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  emailAddresses EntityEmail[]
  opportunities  Opportunity[]
  quotations     Quotation[]
  tickets        Ticket[]
  convertedLeads Lead[]        @relation("LeadConvertedContact")

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([mobile])
  @@index([name])
  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([isDeleted, createdAt])
}

// â”€â”€ Leads â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model Lead {
  id       String @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  leadCode String @unique @db.NVarChar(20)

  // Overview
  name                String  @db.NVarChar(100)
  mobile              String  @db.NVarChar(20)
  mailingName         String? @db.NVarChar(200)
  designation         String? @db.NVarChar(100)
  leadSource          String  @db.NVarChar(50)
  /// string[] as JSON.
  productCategoryJson String  @db.NVarChar(Max)
  followupType        String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  addDescription      String  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  registrationType    String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  turnover            String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  assignedTo          String  @db.NVarChar(50)
  otherPhone          String? @db.NVarChar(20)
  organizationName    String? @db.NVarChar(200)
  department          String? @db.NVarChar(100)
  leadType            String  @db.NVarChar(30)
  status              String  @default("New") @db.NVarChar(30)
  nextFollowupDate    DateTime @db.Date
  nextFollowupTime    String? @db.NVarChar(20)
  description         String? @db.NVarChar(2000)
  noOfEmployee        String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  referredBy          String? @db.NVarChar(200)

  // Primary address
  primaryAddress    String? @db.NVarChar(250)
  primaryCity       String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  primaryState      String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  primaryPostalCode String? @db.NVarChar(12)
  primaryCountry    String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  primaryLatitude   String? @db.NVarChar(30)

  // Other address
  otherAddress        String? @db.NVarChar(250)
  otherCity           String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  otherState          String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  otherPostalCode     String? @db.NVarChar(12)
  otherCountry        String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  otherLongitude      String? @db.NVarChar(30)
  copyAddressFromLeft Boolean @default(false)

  // Conversion (set atomically by POST /api/leads/:id/convert)
  convertedAt             DateTime?
  convertedBy             String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  convertedOrganizationId String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  convertedContactId      String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  convertedOpportunityId  String?   @db.NVarChar(50)

  createdBy String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  updatedBy String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  isDeleted Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt DateTime?

  emailAddresses        EntityEmail[]
  convertedOrganization Organization? @relation("LeadConvertedOrganization", fields: [convertedOrganizationId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  convertedContact      Contact?      @relation("LeadConvertedContact", fields: [convertedContactId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  convertedOpportunity  Opportunity?  @relation("LeadConvertedOpportunity", fields: [convertedOpportunityId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([status])
  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([mobile])
  @@index([nextFollowupDate])
  @@index([isDeleted, createdAt])
}

// â”€â”€ Products â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model Product {
  id          String @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  productCode String @unique @db.NVarChar(20)

  productName        String   @db.NVarChar(200)
  hsnCode            String?  @db.NVarChar(8)
  category           String?  @db.NVarChar(100)
  type               String?  @db.NVarChar(30)
  manufacturer       String?  @db.NVarChar(100)
  taxType            String?  @default("GST") @db.NVarChar(10)
  taxRate            String?  @db.NVarChar(10)
  // The API returns these as strings (ProductFormData); stored as decimals for reporting.
  discount           Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  cost               Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  mrp                Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  msp                Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  contractCreate     String   @default("No") @db.NVarChar(3)
  description        String?  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  termsAndConditions String?  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  isActive           Boolean  @default(true)

  createdBy String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  updatedBy String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  isDeleted Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt DateTime?

  opportunityLineItems OpportunityLineItem[]
  quotationLineItems   QuotationLineItem[]

  @@index([productName])
  @@index([category])
  @@index([isDeleted, createdAt])
}

// â”€â”€ Opportunities â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model Opportunity {
  id              String @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  opportunityCode String @unique @db.NVarChar(20)

  opportunityName     String?   @db.NVarChar(200)
  /// string[] as JSON.
  productCategoryJson String    @db.NVarChar(Max)
  contactName         String    @db.NVarChar(100)
  contactId           String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  organizationName    String    @db.NVarChar(200)
  organizationId      String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  contactNumber       String    @db.NVarChar(20)
  emailAddress        String?   @db.NVarChar(120)
  referredBy          String?   @db.NVarChar(200)
  type                String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  salesStage          String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  leadSource          String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  leadGivenBy         String    @db.NVarChar(200)
  nextFollowupDate    DateTime  @db.Date
  nextFollowupTime    String?   @db.NVarChar(20)
  followupType        String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  addDescription      String    @db.NVarChar(2000)
  description         String?   @db.NVarChar(2000)
  assignedTo          String    @db.NVarChar(50)

  // Billing
  tallySerialNo String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  invoiceNo     String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  invoiceDate   DateTime? @db.Date

  commission  String  @db.NVarChar(50)
  addDocument String? @default("No") @db.NVarChar(3)

  // Line-item totals (verified server-side)
  /// No DB default: Prisma writes SQL Server string defaults without the N prefix (â‚¹ â†’ ?). The API always sets it.
  currency        String  @db.NVarChar(30)
  groupName       String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  lumpSumDiscount Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  totalAmount     Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  totalDiscount   Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  subtotal        Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  totalTax        Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  grandTotal      Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)

  createdBy String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  updatedBy String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  isDeleted Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt DateTime?

  organization   Organization?         @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  contact        Contact?              @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  lineItems      OpportunityLineItem[]
  quotations     Quotation[]
  convertedLeads Lead[]                @relation("LeadConvertedOpportunity")

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([contactId])
  @@index([salesStage])
  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([nextFollowupDate])
  @@index([isDeleted, createdAt])
}

model OpportunityLineItem {
  id            String  @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  opportunityId String  @db.NVarChar(50)
  productId     String? @db.NVarChar(50)
  productName   String  @db.NVarChar(200)
  quantity      Decimal @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  amount        Decimal @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  discount      Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  discountType  String  @default("percentage") @db.NVarChar(10)
  salePrice     Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  taxRate       String  @db.NVarChar(20)
  taxAmount     Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  total         Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  description   String? @db.NVarChar(2000)
  note          String? @db.NVarChar(2000)
  sortOrder     Int     @default(0)

  opportunity Opportunity @relation(fields: [opportunityId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)
  product     Product?    @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([opportunityId])
  @@index([productId])
}

// â”€â”€ Quotations â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model Quotation {
  id            String @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)

  currency        String  @db.NVarChar(30)
  groupName       String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  lumpSumDiscount Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  totalAmount     Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  totalDiscount   Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  subtotal        Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  totalTax        Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  grandTotal      Decimal @default(0) @db.Decimal(18, 2)

  // Customer & address
  organizationName String?  @db.NVarChar(200)
  organizationId   String?  @db.NVarChar(50)
  contactName      String   @db.NVarChar(100)
  contactId        String?  @db.NVarChar(50)
  contactMobile    String?  @db.NVarChar(20)
  mailingName      String?  @db.NVarChar(200)
  gstNo            String?  @db.NVarChar(15)
  contactEmail     String?  @db.NVarChar(120)

  billingAddress    String  @db.NVarChar(250)
  billingCity       String  @db.NVarChar(80)
  billingState      String  @db.NVarChar(80)
  billingPostalCode String  @db.NVarChar(12)
  billingCountry    String  @db.NVarChar(80)

  shippingAddress        String? @db.NVarChar(250)
  shippingCity           String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  shippingState          String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  shippingPostalCode     String? @db.NVarChar(12)
  shippingCountry        String? @db.NVarChar(80)
  copyAddressFromBilling Boolean @default(true)

  // Linked context & legacy aliases
  opportunityId      String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  status             String?   @db.NVarChar(30)
  quotationSubject   String?   @db.NVarChar(200)
  notes              String?   @db.NVarChar(2000)
  termsAndConditions String?   @db.NVarChar(4000)

  createdBy String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  updatedBy String?   @db.NVarChar(50)

  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  isDeleted Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt DateTime?

  opportunity  Opportunity?        @relation(fields: [opportunityId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  contact      Contact?            @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([opportunityId])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([quoteStage])
  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([isDeleted, createdAt])

// â”€â”€ Tickets â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model Ticket {
  id           String @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  ticketNumber String @unique @db.NVarChar(20)

  amcFlag                 Boolean  @default(false)
  cloudFlag               Boolean  @default(false)
  ticketSubject           String?  @db.NVarChar(200)
  organizationName        String   @db.NVarChar(200)
  organizationId          String?  @db.NVarChar(50)
  contactPersonName       String   @db.NVarChar(100)
  contactId               String?  @db.NVarChar(50)
  contactNumber           String?  @db.NVarChar(20)
  contactEmail            String?  @db.NVarChar(120)
  ticketPriority          String   @db.NVarChar(20)
  source                  String   @default("Call") @db.NVarChar(20)
  supportType             String   @default("Free") @db.NVarChar(20)
  supportMode             String   @db.NVarChar(50)
  natureOfCall            String   @db.NVarChar(100)
  ticketStatus            String   @default("New") @db.NVarChar(30)
  /// Local date-time from the form (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`), stored as datetime for overdue queries.
  dueDate                 DateTime
  problemReported         String   @db.NVarChar(2000)
  problemObserved         String?  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  resolution              String?  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  reasonForEscalatedCalls String?  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  rca                     String?  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  addDescription          String?  @db.NVarChar(2000)
  accountAddress          String?  @db.NVarChar(250)
  leftJob                 String   @default("No") @db.NVarChar(3)
  assignedTo              String   @db.NVarChar(50)
  partnerCompany          String?  @db.NVarChar(200)
  partnerCompanyContact   String?  @db.NVarChar(100)

  createdBy String    @db.NVarChar(50)
  updatedBy String?   @db.NVarChar(50)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  isDeleted Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt DateTime?

  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  contact      Contact?      @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([ticketStatus])
  @@index([ticketPriority])
  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([dueDate])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([isDeleted, createdAt])
}

// â”€â”€ Masters (reference data, seeded) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

/// Nature of Call master: tickets must use one of these names; `priority` suggests the ticket priority.
model NatureOfCall {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  name      String   @unique @db.NVarChar(100)
  /// High | Medium | Low
  priority  String   @db.NVarChar(10)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

/// Channel / referral partner firms involved in support tickets.
model PartnerCompany {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  companyName     String   @unique @db.NVarChar(200)
  natureOfPartner String?  @db.NVarChar(100)
  phone           String?  @db.NVarChar(20)
  email           String?  @db.NVarChar(120)
  city            String?  @db.NVarChar(80)
  billingCountry  String?  @db.NVarChar(80)
  assignedTo      String?  @db.NVarChar(50)
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  contacts PartnerCompanyContact[]
}

model PartnerCompanyContact {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  partnerCompanyId String   @db.NVarChar(50)
  name             String   @db.NVarChar(100)
  designation      String?  @db.NVarChar(100)
  mobile           String?  @db.NVarChar(20)
  officePhone      String?  @db.NVarChar(20)
  email            String?  @db.NVarChar(120)
  location         String?  @db.NVarChar(80)
  isActive         Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt

  partnerCompany PartnerCompany @relation(fields: [partnerCompanyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([partnerCompanyId])
}

/// ISO 3166-1 countries (seeded from CRM_Address_Master.xlsx â†’ Country_Master).
model Country {
  iso2Code    String @id @db.NVarChar(2)
  iso3Code    String @db.NVarChar(3)
  countryName String @db.NVarChar(100)
  numericCode Int

  subdivisions Subdivision[]
}

/// ISO 3166-2 states / provinces / regions (seeded from State_Region_Master).
model Subdivision {
  subdivisionCode String @id @db.NVarChar(10)
  countryIso2     String @db.NVarChar(2)
  subdivisionName String @db.NVarChar(150)
  subdivisionType String @db.NVarChar(60)

  country Country @relation(fields: [countryIso2], references: [iso2Code], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([countryIso2])
}

// â”€â”€ Audit trail â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

model AuditLog {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.NVarChar(50)
  entityType  String   @db.NVarChar(30)
  entityId    String   @db.NVarChar(50)
  /// CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE | CONVERT | IMPORT | STATUS_CHANGE â€¦
  action      String   @db.NVarChar(30)
  changedBy   String   @db.NVarChar(50)
  /// JSON diff `{ field: { from, to } }` or a snapshot, depending on the action.
  changesJson String?  @db.NVarChar(Max)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([entityType, entityId, createdAt])
  @@index([changedBy])
}

/**
 * Reference masters seeded in every environment. Generated from frontend-crm/src/data/mockNatureOfCalls.ts and
 * mockPartners.ts so the backend doesn't depend on the frontend repo at deploy time; edit here (the database is
 * the source of truth once seeded).
 */

export interface NatureOfCallSeed {
    name: string;
    priority: 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
}

export interface PartnerCompanySeed {
    companyName: string;
    natureOfPartner: string;
    phone: string;
    email: string;
    city: string;
    billingCountry: string;
    assignedTo: string;
}

export interface PartnerContactSeed {
    name: string;
    designation: string;
    /** companyName of the partner this contact works for. */
    partnerCompany: string;
    mobile: string;
    officePhone?: string;
    email: string;
    location: string;
}

/**
 * Database seed: `npm run seed` (or `npx prisma db seed`).
 *
 * Reference data (every run, idempotent):
 *   • admin user (SEED_ADMIN_USERNAME / SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD; a random password is generated and printed once
 *     when none is given); an existing admin's password is never changed
 *   • Nature of Call and partner masters (prisma/seed-data/masters.ts)
 *   • ISO 3166 address master (prisma/seed-data/CRM_Address_Master.xlsx), refreshed when the workbook changes
 *
 * Demo data (skipped in production unless SEED_DEMO_DATA=true; only into an empty CRM):
 *   • directory users, products, organizations, contacts, leads, opportunities, quotations and tickets from
 *     prisma/seed-data/demo/*.json, created through the same record functions as the API (codes, validation,
 *     links and audit rows included). Demo users get SEED_USER_PASSWORD, or random passwords when unset.
 */
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import { ENV } from '../src/config/env.js';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/prisma.js';
import { connectRedis, isRedisReady, redis } from '../src/config/redis.js';
import { createContactRecord } from '../src/modules/contacts/contact.service.js';
import { contactInputSchema } from '../src/modules/contacts/contact.validator.js';
import { createLeadRecord } from '../src/modules/leads/lead.service.js';
import { leadImportSchema } from '../src/modules/leads/lead.validator.js';
import { createOpportunityRecord } from '../src/modules/opportunities/opportunity.service.js';
import { opportunityInputSchema } from '../src/modules/opportunities/opportunity.validator.js';
import { createOrganizationRecord } from '../src/modules/organizations/organization.service.js';
import { organizationImportSchema } from '../src/modules/organizations/organization.validator.js';
import { createProductRecord } from '../src/modules/products/product.service.js';
import { productInputSchema } from '../src/modules/products/product.validator.js';
import { createQuotationRecord } from '../src/modules/quotations/quotation.service.js';
import { quotationInputSchema } from '../src/modules/quotations/quotation.validator.js';
import { runInTransaction } from '../src/modules/shared/transactions.js';
import { createTicketRecord } from '../src/modules/tickets/ticket.service.js';
import { ticketInputSchema } from '../src/modules/tickets/ticket.validator.js';
import { hashPassword } from '../src/modules/auth/auth.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../src/services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../src/types/user.types.js';
import { NATURE_OF_CALLS, PARTNER_COMPANIES, PARTNER_CONTACTS } from './seed-data/masters.js';

XLSX.set_fs(fs);

const SEED_DIR = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const ADDRESS_WORKBOOK = resolve(SEED_DIR, 'seed-data', 'CRM_Address_Master.xlsx');
const DEMO_DATA_DIR = resolve(SEED_DIR, 'seed-data', 'demo');
/** SQL Server allows 2,100 parameters per statement; subdivisions have 4 columns. */
const INSERT_CHUNK = 400;

const log = (message: string) => console.log(`[seed] ${message}`);
const randomPassword = () => randomBytes(15).toString('base64url');

// ── Reference data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function seedAdmin(): Promise<AuthUser> {
    const username = process.env.SEED_ADMIN_USERNAME || 'admin';
    const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username } });
    if (existing) {
        log(`admin user "${username}" already exists (password unchanged)`);
        return { id: existing.id, username: existing.username, role: existing.role };
    }

    const provided = process.env.SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD;
    if (provided && provided.length < 12) throw new Error('SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD must be at least 12 characters.');
    const password = provided || randomPassword();
    const admin = await prisma.user.create({
        data: { username, fullName: 'Administrator', role: 'Admin', department: 'Management', passwordHash: await hashPassword(password) },
    });
    log(`created admin user "${username}"`);
    if (!provided) log(`  generated password (shown once, store it now): ${password}`);
    return { id: admin.id, username: admin.username, role: admin.role };
}

async function seedMasters(): Promise<void> {
    for (const [index, entry] of NATURE_OF_CALLS.entries()) {
        await prisma.natureOfCall.upsert({
            where: { name: entry.name },
            create: { name: entry.name, priority: entry.priority, sortOrder: index },
            update: { priority: entry.priority, sortOrder: index },
        });
    }
    for (const company of PARTNER_COMPANIES) {
        await prisma.partnerCompany.upsert({ where: { companyName: company.companyName }, create: company, update: company });
    }
    for (const { partnerCompany, ...contact } of PARTNER_CONTACTS) {
        const company = await prisma.partnerCompany.findUnique({ where: { companyName: partnerCompany }, select: { id: true } });
        if (!company) continue;
        const existing = await prisma.partnerCompanyContact.findFirst({ where: { partnerCompanyId: company.id, name: contact.name }, select: { id: true } });
        if (existing) await prisma.partnerCompanyContact.update({ where: { id: existing.id }, data: contact });
        else await prisma.partnerCompanyContact.create({ data: { ...contact, partnerCompanyId: company.id } });
    }
    log(`masters: ${NATURE_OF_CALLS.length} natures of call, ${PARTNER_COMPANIES.length} partner companies, ${PARTNER_CONTACTS.length} partner contacts`);
}

interface CountryRow { country_name: string; iso2_code: string; iso3_code: string; numeric_code: string | number }
interface SubdivisionRow { country_iso2: string; subdivision_code: string; subdivision_name: string; subdivision_type: string }

/** Loads the ISO address master; reloads only when the database doesn't match the workbook. */
async function seedAddressMaster(): Promise<void> {
    if (!fs.existsSync(ADDRESS_WORKBOOK)) {
        log(`address master skipped: ${ADDRESS_WORKBOOK} not found`);
        return;
    }
    const workbook = XLSX.readFile(ADDRESS_WORKBOOK);
    const countries = XLSX.utils
        .sheet_to_json<CountryRow>(workbook.Sheets.Country_Master, { defval: '' })
        .filter((row) => /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(String(row.iso2_code).trim()))
        .map((row) => ({
            iso2Code: String(row.iso2_code).trim(),
            iso3Code: String(row.iso3_code).trim(),
            countryName: String(row.country_name).trim(),
            numericCode: Number(row.numeric_code) || 0,
        }));
    const countryCodes = new Set(countries.map((c) => c.iso2Code));
    const subdivisionsByCode = new Map<string, { subdivisionCode: string; countryIso2: string; subdivisionName: string; subdivisionType: string }>();
    for (const row of XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<SubdivisionRow>(workbook.Sheets.State_Region_Master, { defval: '' })) {
        const code = String(row.subdivision_code).trim();
        const countryIso2 = String(row.country_iso2).trim();
        if (!code || !countryCodes.has(countryIso2)) continue;
        subdivisionsByCode.set(code, {
            subdivisionCode: code,
            countryIso2,
            subdivisionName: String(row.subdivision_name).trim(),
            subdivisionType: String(row.subdivision_type).trim(),
        });
    }
    const subdivisions = [...subdivisionsByCode.values()];

    const [countryCount, subdivisionCount] = await Promise.all([prisma.country.count(), prisma.subdivision.count()]);
    if (countryCount === countries.length && subdivisionCount === subdivisions.length && process.env.SEED_REFRESH_ADDRESS_MASTER !== 'true') {
        log(`address master up to date (${countryCount} countries, ${subdivisionCount} subdivisions)`);
        return;
    }

    // Nothing references these tables by foreign key (addresses store ISO2 codes), so a full reload is safe.
    await prisma.$transaction(
        async (tx) => {
            await tx.subdivision.deleteMany();
            await tx.country.deleteMany();
            await tx.country.createMany({ data: countries });
            for (let i = 0; i < subdivisions.length; i += INSERT_CHUNK) {
                await tx.subdivision.createMany({ data: subdivisions.slice(i, i + INSERT_CHUNK) });
            }
        },
        { timeout: 120_000 },
    );
    log(`address master loaded: ${countries.length} countries, ${subdivisions.length} subdivisions`);
}

// ── Demo data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type MockRecord = Record<string, any>;

type DemoDataset = 'users' | 'products' | 'organizations' | 'contacts' | 'leads' | 'opportunities' | 'quotations' | 'tickets';

async function loadMock(dataset: DemoDataset): Promise<MockRecord[]> {
    const records: unknown = JSON.parse(await fs.promises.readFile(resolve(DEMO_DATA_DIR, `${dataset}.json`), 'utf8'));
    if (!Array.isArray(records)) throw new Error(`seed-data/demo/${dataset}.json is not an array`);
    return records as MockRecord[];
}

interface Tally {
    created: number;
    skipped: string[];
}

/** Runs one demo record write; a record that fails validation or a uniqueness rule is reported and skipped. */
async function attempt<T>(tally: Tally, label: string, write: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | undefined> {
    try {
        const result = await write();
        tally.created++;
        return result;
    } catch (err) {
        const issues = (err as { issues?: { path: PropertyKey[]; message: string }[] }).issues;
        const reason = issues ? issues.map((i) => `${i.path.join('.')}: ${i.message}`).join('; ') : (err as Error).message;
        tally.skipped.push(`${label} — ${reason}`);
        return undefined;
    }
}

function report(entity: string, tally: Tally): void {
    log(`${entity}: ${tally.created} created${tally.skipped.length ? `, ${tally.skipped.length} skipped` : ''}`);
    for (const reason of tally.skipped) log(`  skipped ${reason}`);
}

const remap = (map: Map<string, string>, id: unknown) => (typeof id === 'string' && map.get(id)) || undefined;

async function seedDemoUsers(): Promise<void> {
    const users = await loadMock('users');
    const sharedPassword = process.env.SEED_USER_PASSWORD;
    let created = 0;
    for (const user of users) {
        if (await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username: user.username } })) continue;
        await prisma.user.create({
            data: {
                username: user.username,
                fullName: user.name,
                email: user.email || null,
                role: user.role,
                department: user.department,
                isActive: user.status !== 'Inactive',
                isGroupUser: Boolean(user.isGroupUser),
                onLeave: Boolean(user.onLeave),
                passwordHash: await hashPassword(sharedPassword || randomPassword()),
            },
        });
        created++;
    }
    log(`demo users: ${created} created${sharedPassword ? ' (password: SEED_USER_PASSWORD)' : ' (random passwords; set SEED_USER_PASSWORD to sign in as them)'}`);
}

async function seedDemoRecords(admin: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
    const actorFor = (record: MockRecord): AuthUser => ({ ...admin, username: record.createdBy || admin.username });
    const productIds = new Map<string, string>();
    const organizationIds = new Map<string, string>();
    const contactIds = new Map<string, string>();
    const opportunityIds = new Map<string, string>();

    const products: Tally = { created: 0, skipped: [] };
    for (const p of await loadMock('products')) {
        const dto = await attempt(products, p.productName, () =>
            runInTransaction((tx) => createProductRecord(tx, productInputSchema.parse(p), actorFor(p))),
        );
        if (dto) productIds.set(p.id, dto.id);
    }
    report('products', products);

    // Parents first, so "Member of" links resolve.
    const organizations: Tally = { created: 0, skipped: [] };
    const orgMocks = (await loadMock('organizations')).sort(
        (a, b) => Number(Boolean(a.memberOfParentCorp)) - Number(Boolean(b.memberOfParentCorp)),
    );
    for (const o of orgMocks) {
        const dto = await attempt(organizations, o.organizationName, () =>
            runInTransaction((tx) => createOrganizationRecord(tx, organizationImportSchema.parse(o), actorFor(o))),
        );
        if (dto) organizationIds.set(o.id, dto.id);
    }
    report('organizations', organizations);

    const contacts: Tally = { created: 0, skipped: [] };
    for (const c of await loadMock('contacts')) {
        const dto = await attempt(contacts, c.name, () =>
            runInTransaction((tx) =>
                createContactRecord(tx, contactInputSchema.parse({ ...c, organizationId: remap(organizationIds, c.organizationId) }), actorFor(c)),
            ),
        );
        if (dto) contactIds.set(c.id, dto.id);
    }
    report('contacts', contacts);

    const leads: Tally = { created: 0, skipped: [] };
    for (const l of await loadMock('leads')) {
        await attempt(leads, l.name, () => runInTransaction((tx) => createLeadRecord(tx, leadImportSchema.parse(l), actorFor(l))));
    }
    report('leads', leads);

    const withProducts = (items: MockRecord[] | undefined) =>
        (items ?? []).map((item) => ({ ...item, productId: remap(productIds, item.productId) }));

    const opportunities: Tally = { created: 0, skipped: [] };
    for (const o of await loadMock('opportunities')) {
        const input = {
            ...o,
            organizationId: remap(organizationIds, o.organizationId),
            contactId: remap(contactIds, o.contactId),
            lineItems: withProducts(o.lineItems),
        };
        const dto = await attempt(opportunities, o.opportunityCode ?? o.opportunityName, () =>
            runInTransaction((tx) => createOpportunityRecord(tx, opportunityInputSchema.parse(input), actorFor(o))),
        );
        if (dto) opportunityIds.set(o.id, dto.id);
    }
    report('opportunities', opportunities);

    const quotations: Tally = { created: 0, skipped: [] };
    for (const q of await loadMock('quotations')) {
        const input = {
            ...q,
            opportunityId: remap(opportunityIds, q.opportunityId),
            organizationId: remap(organizationIds, q.organizationId),
            contactId: remap(contactIds, q.contactId),
            lineItems: withProducts(q.lineItems),
        };
        await attempt(quotations, q.quotationCode ?? q.quotationTitle, () =>
            runInTransaction((tx) => createQuotationRecord(tx, quotationInputSchema.parse(input), actorFor(q))),
        );
    }
    report('quotations', quotations);

    const tickets: Tally = { created: 0, skipped: [] };
    for (const t of await loadMock('tickets')) {
        await attempt(tickets, t.ticketNumber ?? t.ticketSubject, () =>
            runInTransaction((tx) => createTicketRecord(tx, ticketInputSchema.parse(t), actorFor(t))),
        );
    }
    report('tickets', tickets);
}

async function crmIsEmpty(): Promise<boolean> {
    const counts = await Promise.all([
        prisma.organization.count(),
        prisma.contact.count(),
        prisma.lead.count(),
        prisma.opportunity.count(),
        prisma.quotation.count(),
        prisma.product.count(),
        prisma.ticket.count(),
    ]);
    return counts.every((count) => count === 0);
}

async function seedDemoData(admin: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
    const wanted = process.env.SEED_DEMO_DATA ? process.env.SEED_DEMO_DATA === 'true' : !ENV.IS_PRODUCTION;
    if (!wanted) {
        log(`demo data skipped (${process.env.SEED_DEMO_DATA ? 'SEED_DEMO_DATA=false' : 'production'}; set SEED_DEMO_DATA=true to include it)`);
        return;
    }
    await seedDemoUsers();
    if (!(await crmIsEmpty())) {
        log('demo records skipped: the CRM already has records');
        return;
    }
    await seedDemoRecords(admin);
}

/** Best effort: drop cached lookups / search so the API sees the new data immediately. */
async function invalidateCaches(): Promise<void> {
    connectRedis();
    for (let waited = 0; !isRedisReady() && waited < 2_000; waited += 100) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    if (!isRedisReady()) return;
    await Promise.all([cacheService.invalidatePattern('cache:*'), cacheService.invalidatePattern('recent:*')]);
    log('caches cleared');
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
    const admin = await seedAdmin();
    await seedMasters();
    await seedAddressMaster();
    await seedDemoData(admin);
    await invalidateCaches();
    log('done');
}

main()
    .catch((err: Error) => {
        console.error('[seed] failed:', err);
        process.exitCode = 1;
    })
    .finally(async () => {
        // disconnect(), not quit(): with Redis unreachable the client is mid-reconnect, quit() never settles,
        // and its retry timers would keep the process alive.
        redis.disconnect();
        await prisma.$disconnect();
    });

import type { Server } from 'node:http';
import express, { type Express, type Request, type Response } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import { pinoHttp } from 'pino-http';
import { ENV } from './config/env.js';
import { logger } from './config/logger.js';
import { connectDatabase, prisma } from './config/prisma.js';
import { connectRedis, isRedisReady, redis } from './config/redis.js';
import authRouter from './modules/auth/auth.routes.js';
import productRouter from './modules/products/product.routes.js';
import organizationRouter from './modules/organizations/organization.routes.js';
import contactRouter from './modules/contacts/contact.routes.js';
import leadRouter from './modules/leads/lead.routes.js';
import opportunityRouter from './modules/opportunities/opportunity.routes.js';
import quotationRouter from './modules/quotations/quotation.routes.js';
import ticketRouter from './modules/tickets/ticket.routes.js';
import searchRouter from './modules/search/search.routes.js';
import lookupRouter from './modules/lookups/lookup.routes.js';
import auditRouter from './modules/audit/audit.routes.js';
import importRouter from './modules/imports/import.routes.js';
import { closeQueues } from './jobs/queues.js';
import { startWorkers, stopWorkers } from './jobs/workers/index.js';
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from './middlewares/errorHandler.js';

const LAN_ORIGIN = /^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|192\.168\.\d+\.\d+|10\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)(:\d+)?$/;

const app: Express = express();

// Behind Azure App Service / a reverse proxy, trust one hop so req.ip (rate limiting, sessions) is the client's.
if (ENV.IS_PRODUCTION) app.set('trust proxy', 1);

// ── Global Middleware ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.use(helmet());
app.use(
    cors({
        origin: (origin, callback) => {
            if (!origin) return callback(null, true);
            if (!ENV.IS_PRODUCTION || origin === ENV.CLIENT_ORIGIN || LAN_ORIGIN.test(origin)) {
                return callback(null, true);
            }
            return callback(new Error(`CORS blocked for origin: ${origin}`));
        },
        credentials: true,
    }),
);
app.use(
    pinoHttp({
        logger,
        // Health probes would otherwise flood the logs.
        autoLogging: { ignore: (req) => req.url === '/api/health' },
        customLogLevel: (_req, res, err) => (err || res.statusCode >= 500 ? 'error' : res.statusCode >= 400 ? 'warn' : 'info'),
    }),
);
app.use(cookieParser());
// Mounted before the global body parser: imports carry up to 5,000 rows and parse with their own 10 MB limit.
app.use('/api/import', importRouter);
app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' }));

// ── Health check ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.get('/api/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
    res.status(200).json({
        status: 'ok',
        message: 'CRM API is running',
        redis: isRedisReady() ? 'connected' : 'unavailable',
    });
});

// ── Routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.use('/api/auth', authRouter);
app.use('/api/products', productRouter);
app.use('/api/organizations', organizationRouter);
app.use('/api/contacts', contactRouter);
app.use('/api/leads', leadRouter);
app.use('/api/opportunities', opportunityRouter);
app.use('/api/quotations', quotationRouter);
app.use('/api/tickets', ticketRouter);
app.use('/api/search', searchRouter);
app.use('/api/lookups', lookupRouter);
app.use('/api/audit-logs', auditRouter);

// ── 404 + global error handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.use(notFoundHandler);
app.use(errorHandler);

// ── Start: database must be reachable; Redis connects in the background ────────
async function start(): Promise<Server> {
    if (ENV.USING_DEV_JWT_SECRET) {
        logger.warn('JWT_SECRET is not set; using an insecure development secret');
    }
    connectRedis();
    await connectDatabase();
    if (ENV.RUN_WORKERS) startWorkers();
    return app.listen(ENV.PORT, () => logger.info(`API listening on port ${ENV.PORT}`));
}

function registerShutdown(server: Server): void {
    let shuttingDown = false;
    const shutdown = (signal: string) => {
        if (shuttingDown) return;
        shuttingDown = true;
        logger.info({ signal }, 'Shutting down');
        server.close(async () => {
            await stopWorkers();
            await Promise.allSettled([closeQueues(), prisma.$disconnect(), redis.quit()]);
            process.exit(0);
        });
        // Don't hang forever on keep-alive connections.
        setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 10_000).unref();
    };
    process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));
    process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));
}

start()
    .then(registerShutdown)
    .catch((err: Error) => {
        logger.fatal({ err: err.message }, 'Failed to start API (database unreachable?)');
        process.exit(1);
    });

export default app;

/**
 * Resolves the SQL Server connection string shared by the Prisma CLI (prisma.config.ts) and the runtime
 * client (src/config/prisma.ts). `DATABASE_URL` wins; otherwise it is assembled from the legacy
 * DB_* variables so existing .env files keep working.
 *
 * Kept dependency-free (no env validation, no logger) because prisma.config.ts loads it standalone.
 */

/** Wraps values containing URL delimiters in braces, the escaping both Prisma and @prisma/adapter-mssql read. */
function escapeValue(value: string): string {
    return /[;={}:]/.test(value) ? `{${value}}` : value;
}

export function resolveDatabaseUrl(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): string | undefined {
    if (env.DATABASE_URL) return env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (!env.DB_SERVER) return undefined;

    const encrypt = env.DB_ENCRYPT === 'true';
    // Matches the previous mssql config: trust the cert by default only for unencrypted (local) servers.
    const trustServerCertificate = env.DB_TRUST_SERVER_CERT ? env.DB_TRUST_SERVER_CERT === 'true' : !encrypt;

    const params: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
        database: env.DB_DATABASE || 'CRM_DB',
        user: env.DB_USER,
        password: env.DB_PASSWORD,
        encrypt: String(encrypt),
        trustServerCertificate: String(trustServerCertificate),
        connectionTimeout: env.DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT || '30000',
    };
    const query = Object.entries(params)
        .filter((entry): entry is [string, string] => entry[1] !== undefined && entry[1] !== '')
        .map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${escapeValue(value)}`)
        .join(';');

    return `sqlserver://${env.DB_SERVER}:${env.DB_PORT || '1433'};${query}`;
}

import 'dotenv/config';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { resolveDatabaseUrl } from './databaseUrl.js';

/** Used only outside production so local dev starts without a secret; production must set JWT_SECRET. */
const DEV_JWT_SECRET = 'dev-only-insecure-jwt-secret-do-not-use-in-production';

const envSchema = z
    .object({
        NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development'),
        PORT: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(8008),
        CLIENT_ORIGIN: z.url().default('http://localhost:8007'),
        LOG_LEVEL: z.enum(['fatal', 'error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug', 'trace', 'silent']).default('info'),

        JWT_SECRET: z.string().min(1).optional(),
        /** Lifetime of a login session: JWT expiry, auth cookie max-age and Redis session TTL. */
        SESSION_TTL_SECONDS: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(8 * 60 * 60),

        DATABASE_URL: z.string({ error: 'DATABASE_URL (or DB_SERVER + DB_* variables) is required.' }).min(1),
        REDIS_URL: z.string().min(1).default('redis://localhost:6379'),

        LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(10),
        LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(15 * 60),

        /** Timezone of wall-clock values entered in forms (ticket due dates) and of audit display times. */
        BUSINESS_TIMEZONE: z
            .string()
            .default('Asia/Kolkata')
            .refine((tz) => {
                try {
                    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: tz });
                    return true;
                } catch {
                    return false;
                }
            }, 'BUSINESS_TIMEZONE must be a valid IANA timezone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata).'),
        /** Run the BullMQ workers inside the API process (set false when running `npm run worker` separately). */
        RUN_WORKERS: z
            .enum(['true', 'false'])
            .default('true')
            .transform((value) => value === 'true'),
    })
    .superRefine((env, ctx) => {
        if (env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && (!env.JWT_SECRET || env.JWT_SECRET.length < 32)) {
            ctx.addIssue({
                code: 'custom',
                path: ['JWT_SECRET'],
                message: 'JWT_SECRET must be set to at least 32 characters in production.',
            });
        }
    });

const parsed = envSchema.safeParse({ ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: resolveDatabaseUrl() });

if (!parsed.success) {
    const details = parsed.error.issues.map((issue) => `  • ${issue.path.join('.') || 'env'}: ${issue.message}`).join('\n');
    throw new Error(`Invalid environment configuration:\n${details}`);
}

const env = parsed.data;

export const ENV = {
    NODE_ENV: env.NODE_ENV,
    IS_PRODUCTION: env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    PORT: env.PORT,
    CLIENT_ORIGIN: env.CLIENT_ORIGIN,
    LOG_LEVEL: env.LOG_LEVEL,
    JWT_SECRET: env.JWT_SECRET ?? DEV_JWT_SECRET,
    /** True when the insecure development secret is in use (logged as a warning at startup). */
    USING_DEV_JWT_SECRET: !env.JWT_SECRET,
    SESSION_TTL_SECONDS: env.SESSION_TTL_SECONDS,
    DATABASE_URL: env.DATABASE_URL,
    REDIS_URL: env.REDIS_URL,
    BUSINESS_TIMEZONE: env.BUSINESS_TIMEZONE,
    RUN_WORKERS: env.RUN_WORKERS,
    RATE_LIMIT: {
        LOGIN_MAX: env.LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX,
        LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS: env.LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS,
    },
    COOKIE: {
        NAME: 'token',
        MAX_AGE_MS: env.SESSION_TTL_SECONDS * 1000,
    },
} as const;

/**
 * Character limits enforced by the API validators. Mirrors frontend-crm/src/config/fieldLimits.ts (the inputs'
 * `maxLength`) and must stay in sync with it and with the column widths in prisma/schema.prisma.
 */
export const FIELD_MAX_LENGTH = {
    phone: 16,
    pinCode: 6,
    postalCode: 12,
    pan: 10,
    tan: 10,
    ifsc: 11,
    gstin: 15,
    cin: 21,
    msme: 19,
    hsn: 8,
    shortCode: 30,
    bankAccount: 18,
    email: 120,
    url: 255,
    personName: 100,
    organizationName: 200,
    shortText: 80,

import { PrismaMssql } from '@prisma/adapter-mssql';
import { PrismaClient } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { ENV } from './env.js';
import { logger } from './logger.js';

/** Single Prisma client for the process, connected through the SQL Server driver adapter (Prisma 7). */
export const prisma = new PrismaClient({
    adapter: new PrismaMssql(ENV.DATABASE_URL),
    log: [
        { level: 'warn', emit: 'event' },
        { level: 'error', emit: 'event' },
    ],
});

prisma.$on('warn', (event) => logger.warn({ target: event.target }, event.message));
prisma.$on('error', (event) => logger.error({ target: event.target }, event.message));

/** Interactive-transaction client, for helpers that must run inside `prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => …)`. */
export type TransactionClient = Parameters<Parameters<typeof prisma.$transaction>[0]>[0];

const MAX_CONNECT_RETRIES = 3;
const RETRY_DELAY_MS = 5000;

/** Opens the pool (fails fast on bad credentials) before the server starts accepting requests.
 * Retries up to 3 times to allow Azure SQL Serverless auto-pause resumption.
 */
export async function connectDatabase(): Promise<void> {
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_CONNECT_RETRIES; attempt++) {
        try {
            await prisma.$connect();
            await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
            logger.info('Connected to SQL Server');
            return;
        } catch (err) {
            await prisma.$disconnect().catch(() => {});
            if (attempt < MAX_CONNECT_RETRIES) {
                logger.warn(
                    { attempt, maxRetries: MAX_CONNECT_RETRIES, err: (err as Error).message },
                    'Database connection attempt failed, retrying (Azure SQL may be waking up)...'
                );
                await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, RETRY_DELAY_MS));
            } else {
                throw err;
            }
        }
    }
}

File: backend-crm/src/config/redis.ts
================
import { Redis, type RedisOptions } from 'ioredis';
import { ENV } from './env.js';
import { logger } from './logger.js';

const MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS = 30_000;
/** ioredis emits an error per reconnect attempt; log the outage once per this interval instead. */
const ERROR_LOG_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;

/**
 * Builds a Redis connection from REDIS_URL. The app's shared client (below) fails commands immediately while
 * disconnected so callers can fall back to the database; BullMQ (Phase 4) needs its own connection created
 * with `{ maxRetriesPerRequest: null }`.
 */
export function createRedisConnection(overrides: RedisOptions = {}): Redis {
    let lastErrorLoggedAt = 0;
    const client = new Redis(ENV.REDIS_URL, {
        lazyConnect: true,
        enableOfflineQueue: false,
        maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
        retryStrategy: (attempt) => Math.min(attempt * 1_000, MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS),
        ...overrides,
    });

    client.on('ready', () => logger.info('Connected to Redis'));
    client.on('error', (err: Error) => {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastErrorLoggedAt < ERROR_LOG_INTERVAL_MS) return;
        lastErrorLoggedAt = now;
        logger.warn({ err: err.message }, 'Redis unavailable — caching, rate limiting and session revocation degrade gracefully');
    });

    return client;
}

/** Shared client for caching, rate limiting and session tracking. */
export const redis = createRedisConnection();

export function isRedisReady(): boolean {
    return redis.status === 'ready';
}

/** Starts connecting without blocking startup; Redis being down must never stop the API. */
export function connectRedis(): void {
    redis.connect().catch(() => {
        // Logged by the 'error' handler; retryStrategy keeps reconnecting in the background.
    });
}

File: backend-crm/src/jobs/queues.ts
================
import { Queue, type JobsOptions } from 'bullmq';
import type { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { logger } from '../config/logger.js';
import { createRedisConnection, isRedisReady } from '../config/redis.js';

export const QUEUE_NAMES = {
    import: 'crm-import',
    audit: 'crm-audit',
} as const;

/** How long a producer waits for Redis before falling back to synchronous processing. */
const ENQUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS = 3_000;

/** BullMQ needs its own connections with `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`; it shares REDIS_URL with the cache. */
export function createQueueConnection(): Redis {
    return createRedisConnection({ maxRetriesPerRequest: null, enableOfflineQueue: true, lazyConnect: false });
}

let producerConnection: Redis | undefined;
const queues = new Map<string, Queue>();

function getQueue(name: string, defaultJobOptions: JobsOptions): Queue {
    let queue = queues.get(name);
    if (!queue) {
        producerConnection ??= createQueueConnection();
        queue = new Queue(name, { connection: producerConnection, defaultJobOptions });
        queue.on('error', (err) => logger.warn({ err: err.message, queue: name }, 'Queue error'));
        queues.set(name, queue);
    }
    return queue;
}

/** Imports run once: a retry would re-create rows that already succeeded. Results are kept for a day. */
export const importQueue = () =>
    getQueue(QUEUE_NAMES.import, {
        attempts: 1,
        removeOnComplete: { age: 24 * 60 * 60, count: 500 },
        removeOnFail: { age: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 },
    });

/** Audit writes retry with backoff; failures are kept for inspection. */
export const auditQueue = () =>
    getQueue(QUEUE_NAMES.audit, {
        attempts: 5,
        backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 1_000 },
        removeOnComplete: { age: 60 * 60, count: 1_000 },
        removeOnFail: { age: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 },
    });

/** Background jobs are usable only while Redis is reachable (checked on the shared client). */
export const isQueueAvailable = (): boolean => isRedisReady();

/**
 * Adds a job, or returns null when Redis is unavailable / doesn't answer in time, so the caller can process
 * synchronously instead of hanging the request. The queue is created only once Redis is known to be up.
 */
export async function tryEnqueue<T>(getQueueFn: () => Queue, name: string, data: T, options?: JobsOptions): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!isQueueAvailable()) return null;
    const queue = getQueueFn();
    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
    try {
        const job = await Promise.race([
            queue.add(name, data, options),
            new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
                timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Enqueue timed out')), ENQUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS);
            }),
        ]);
        return job.id ?? null;
    } catch (err) {
        logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, queue: queue.name }, 'Could not enqueue job; processing synchronously');
        return null;
    } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
    }
}

export async function closeQueues(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.allSettled([...queues.values()].map((queue) => queue.close()));
    await producerConnection?.quit().catch(() => undefined);
}

/**
 * Standalone worker process: `npm run worker`. Run it alongside the API with RUN_WORKERS=false on the API
 * so imports don't compete with request handling for CPU.
 */
import { logger } from '../config/logger.js';
import { connectDatabase, prisma } from '../config/prisma.js';
import { connectRedis, redis } from '../config/redis.js';
import { closeQueues } from './queues.js';
import { startWorkers, stopWorkers } from './workers/index.js';

async function main(): Promise<void> {
    connectRedis();
    await connectDatabase();
    startWorkers();

    let stopping = false;
    const shutdown = async (signal: string) => {
        if (stopping) return;
        stopping = true;
        logger.info({ signal }, 'Stopping workers');
        await stopWorkers();
        await Promise.allSettled([closeQueues(), prisma.$disconnect(), redis.quit()]);
        process.exit(0);
    };
    process.on('SIGINT', () => void shutdown('SIGINT'));
    process.on('SIGTERM', () => void shutdown('SIGTERM'));
}

main().catch((err: Error) => {
    logger.fatal({ err: err.message }, 'Worker process failed to start');
    process.exit(1);
});

import { Worker } from 'bullmq';
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';
import { auditService, type AuditEntry } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { createQueueConnection, QUEUE_NAMES } from '../queues.js';
import { throttledLogger } from './throttledLogger.js';

/** Persists queued audit events (logins, import summaries); retried with backoff by the queue's job options. */
export function startAuditWorker(): Worker<AuditEntry> {
    const worker = new Worker<AuditEntry>(QUEUE_NAMES.audit, (job) => auditService.write(job.data), {
        connection: createQueueConnection(),
        concurrency: 5,
    });
    const warn = throttledLogger();
    worker.on('failed', (job, err) =>
        logger.error({ jobId: job?.id, attempts: job?.attemptsMade, err: err.message }, 'Audit job failed'),
    );
    worker.on('error', (err) => warn(err.message, 'Audit worker error'));
    return worker;
}

import type { Worker } from 'bullmq';
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';
import { startAuditWorker } from './audit.worker.js';
import { startImportWorker } from './import.worker.js';

let running: Worker[] = [];

/** Starts the import and audit workers (in the API process, or standalone via src/jobs/worker.ts). */
export function startWorkers(): void {
    if (running.length > 0) return;
    running = [startImportWorker(), startAuditWorker()];
    logger.info('Background workers started (import, audit)');
}

/** Lets in-flight jobs finish, then disconnects. */
export async function stopWorkers(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.allSettled(running.map((worker) => worker.close()));
    running = [];
}

File: backend-crm/src/jobs/workers/throttledLogger.ts
================
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';

const INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;

/** Workers emit an error per reconnect attempt while Redis is down; log at most once a minute per worker. */
export function throttledLogger(): (detail: string, message: string) => void {
    let last = 0;
    return (detail, message) => {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - last < INTERVAL_MS) return;
        last = now;
        logger.warn({ err: detail }, message);
    };
}
