File: backend-crm/src/middlewares/authMiddleware.ts
================
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { ENV } from '../config/env.js';
import { sessionService } from '../modules/auth/session.service.js';
import { tokenService, type VerifiedToken } from '../modules/auth/token.service.js';
import { HttpError } from '../utils/httpError.js';

/** Reads the session token from the auth cookie, falling back to an `Authorization: Bearer` header. */
export function readToken(req: Request): string | undefined {
    const fromCookie: unknown = req.cookies?.[ENV.COOKIE.NAME];
    if (typeof fromCookie === 'string' && fromCookie) return fromCookie;
    return req.headers.authorization?.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '') || undefined;
}

/** Verifies a token without throwing; returns undefined if it is missing, invalid or expired. */
export function tryVerifyToken(token: string | undefined): VerifiedToken | undefined {
    if (!token) return undefined;
    try {
        return tokenService.verifyToken(token);
    } catch {
        return undefined;
    }
}

/**
 * Requires a valid session: verifies the JWT, then (for tracked sessions) checks Redis that it hasn't been
 * revoked. If Redis is unreachable the signed, unexpired JWT is trusted so an outage doesn't log everyone out.
 */
export async function authenticate(req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> {
    const token = readToken(req);
    if (!token) return next(HttpError.unauthorized());

    const verified = tryVerifyToken(token);
    if (!verified) return next(HttpError.unauthorized('Invalid or expired session token'));

    if (verified.tracked && (await sessionService.isActive(verified.id, verified.jti)) === false) {
        return next(HttpError.unauthorized('Your session has ended. Please sign in again.'));
    }

    req.user = { id: verified.id, username: verified.username, role: verified.role };
    req.auth = { jti: verified.jti, tracked: verified.tracked };
    next();
}

/** Restricts a route to the given roles (case-insensitive). Use after `authenticate`. */
export function requireRole(...roles: string[]) {
    const allowed = new Set(roles.map((role) => role.toLowerCase()));
    return (req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
        if (!req.user) return next(HttpError.unauthorized());
        if (!allowed.has(req.user.role.toLowerCase())) return next(HttpError.forbidden());
        next();
    };
}

================
File: backend-crm/src/middlewares/errorHandler.ts
================
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';
import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { ENV } from '../config/env.js';
import { logger } from '../config/logger.js';
import { HttpError, type ApiFieldError } from '../utils/httpError.js';
import { isTransactionUnavailableError, isWriteConflictError } from '../utils/prismaErrors.js';

// Re-exported so existing imports from this module keep working.
export { HttpError } from '../utils/httpError.js';

/** Error body matching the frontend's `ApiError` (`{ status: 'error', message, code?, errors? }`). */
interface ErrorBody {
    status: 'error';
    message: string;
    code?: string;
    errors?: ApiFieldError[];
}

/** Best-effort list of the columns behind a unique / FK violation; the meta shape varies with driver adapters. */
function constraintFields(error: Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError): string | undefined {
    const meta = error.meta as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    const target = meta?.target ?? (meta?.driverAdapterError as { cause?: { constraint?: unknown } } | undefined)?.cause?.constraint;
    if (Array.isArray(target)) return target.join(', ');
    if (typeof target === 'string') return target;
    if (target && typeof target === 'object' && 'fields' in target && Array.isArray(target.fields)) return target.fields.join(', ');
    return undefined;
}

function fromPrismaError(error: Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError): [number, ErrorBody] | null {
    // Only reached once runInTransaction / runSerializable retries are exhausted.
    if (isWriteConflictError(error)) {
        return [StatusCodes.CONFLICT, {
            status: 'error',
            code: 'WRITE_CONFLICT',
            message: 'This record was changed by another request at the same time. Please try again.',
        }];
    }
    if (isTransactionUnavailableError(error)) {
        return [StatusCodes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, {
            status: 'error',
            code: 'SERVER_BUSY',
            message: 'The server is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.',
        }];
    }
    switch (error.code) {
        case 'P2002': {
            const fields = constraintFields(error);
            return [StatusCodes.CONFLICT, {
                status: 'error',
                code: 'DUPLICATE_RECORD',
                message: fields ? `A record with the same ${fields} already exists.` : 'A record with these details already exists.',
            }];
        }
        case 'P2025':
            return [StatusCodes.NOT_FOUND, { status: 'error', code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'The requested record was not found.' }];
        case 'P2003':
            return [StatusCodes.CONFLICT, {
                status: 'error',
                code: 'RELATED_RECORD_CONSTRAINT',
                message: 'This record is linked to another record that does not exist or still references it.',
            }];
        case 'P2000':
            return [StatusCodes.BAD_REQUEST, { status: 'error', code: 'VALUE_TOO_LONG', message: 'A value is too long for its field.' }];
        default:
            return null;
    }
}

/** Express-generated client errors (bad JSON, oversized body) carry `status` + `expose`. */
function isClientHttpError(err: unknown): err is Error & { status: number; expose: boolean; type?: string } {
    return err instanceof Error && typeof (err as { status?: unknown }).status === 'number' && (err as { expose?: unknown }).expose === true;
}

export function errorHandler(err: unknown, req: Request, res: Response, _next: NextFunction): void {
    let statusCode: number = StatusCodes.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
    let body: ErrorBody = { status: 'error', message: 'Internal Server Error' };

    if (err instanceof HttpError) {
        statusCode = err.statusCode;
        body = { status: 'error', message: err.message, code: err.code, errors: err.errors };
    } else if (err instanceof ZodError) {
        statusCode = StatusCodes.BAD_REQUEST;
        body = {
            status: 'error',
            code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
            message: err.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Validation failed',
            errors: err.issues.map((issue) => ({ message: issue.message, path: issue.path.map(String) })),
        };
    } else if (err instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError) {
        const mapped = fromPrismaError(err);
        if (mapped) [statusCode, body] = mapped;
        if (statusCode === StatusCodes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) res.setHeader('Retry-After', '2');
    } else if (isClientHttpError(err)) {
        statusCode = err.status;
        body = {
            status: 'error',
            code: err.type === 'entity.parse.failed' ? 'INVALID_JSON' : 'BAD_REQUEST',
            message: err.type === 'entity.parse.failed' ? 'Request body is not valid JSON.' : err.message,
        };
    }

    if (statusCode >= StatusCodes.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR) {
        logger.error({ err, method: req.method, url: req.originalUrl }, 'Unhandled error');
        // Internals stay out of production responses; development keeps the real message for debugging.
        if (!ENV.IS_PRODUCTION && err instanceof Error && !(err instanceof HttpError)) body.message = err.message;
    } else {
        logger.debug({ statusCode, code: body.code, url: req.originalUrl }, body.message);
    }

    res.status(statusCode).json(body);
}

/** 404 for unmatched routes, in the same error shape. */
export function notFoundHandler(req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
    next(HttpError.notFound(`Route not found: ${req.method} ${req.originalUrl}`));
}

================
File: backend-crm/src/middlewares/rateLimiter.ts
================
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';
import { ENV } from '../config/env.js';
import { logger } from '../config/logger.js';
import { isRedisReady, redis } from '../config/redis.js';
import { HttpError } from '../utils/httpError.js';

interface WindowState {
    count: number;
    /** Seconds until the window resets. */
    ttl: number;
}

/**
 * Fixed-window counter: the first hit creates the key with its expiry (SET … NX EX), later hits only INCR,
 * so the window never extends. Returns null when Redis is unavailable (callers fail open).
 */
async function hit(key: string, windowSeconds: number): Promise<WindowState | null> {
    if (!isRedisReady()) return null;
    try {
        const results = await redis.multi().set(key, 0, 'EX', windowSeconds, 'NX').incr(key).ttl(key).exec();
        const count = Number(results?.[1]?.[1]);
        const ttl = Number(results?.[2]?.[1]);
        return Number.isFinite(count) ? { count, ttl: ttl > 0 ? ttl : windowSeconds } : null;
    } catch (err) {
        logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, key }, 'Rate limiter unavailable; allowing request');
        return null;
    }
}

async function peek(key: string): Promise<WindowState | null> {
    if (!isRedisReady()) return null;
    try {
        const [count, ttl] = await Promise.all([redis.get(key), redis.ttl(key)]);
        return count === null ? { count: 0, ttl: 0 } : { count: Number(count), ttl: Math.max(ttl, 0) };
    } catch (err) {
        logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, key }, 'Rate limiter unavailable; allowing request');
        return null;
    }
}

function tooManyRequests(res: Response, retryAfterSeconds: number, message: string): HttpError {
    res.setHeader('Retry-After', String(retryAfterSeconds));
    return new HttpError(message, StatusCodes.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, { code: 'RATE_LIMITED' });
}

export interface RateLimiterOptions {
    /** Redis key namespace, e.g. `ratelimit:api`. */
    keyPrefix: string;
    max: number;
    windowSeconds: number;
    keyGenerator?: (req: Request) => string;
    message?: string;
}

/** Generic Redis-backed limiter counting every request. Fails open (allows traffic) if Redis is down. */
export function createRateLimiter(options: RateLimiterOptions) {
    const { keyPrefix, max, windowSeconds, keyGenerator = (req) => req.ip ?? 'unknown' } = options;
    const message = options.message ?? 'Too many requests. Please try again later.';

    return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
        const state = await hit(`${keyPrefix}:${keyGenerator(req)}`, windowSeconds);
        if (!state) return next();

        res.setHeader('RateLimit-Limit', String(max));
        res.setHeader('RateLimit-Remaining', String(Math.max(max - state.count, 0)));
        res.setHeader('RateLimit-Reset', String(state.ttl));

        if (state.count > max) return next(tooManyRequests(res, state.ttl, message));
        next();
    };
}

// ── Login brute-force protection ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Only failed attempts count (keyed `ratelimit:login:{ip}`), so users behind one office NAT aren't
// locked out by their colleagues' successful logins.

const loginKey = (ip: string | undefined) => `ratelimit:login:${ip ?? 'unknown'}`;
const LOGIN_LIMIT_MESSAGE = 'Too many failed login attempts. Please try again later.';

export const loginRateLimit = {
    /** Middleware: rejects with 429 once the IP has used up its failed attempts for the window. */
    async guard(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> {
        const state = await peek(loginKey(req.ip));
        if (state && state.count >= ENV.RATE_LIMIT.LOGIN_MAX) {
            return next(tooManyRequests(res, state.ttl || ENV.RATE_LIMIT.LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS, LOGIN_LIMIT_MESSAGE));
        }
        next();
    },

    async recordFailure(ip: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
        await hit(loginKey(ip), ENV.RATE_LIMIT.LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS);
    },

    async reset(ip: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return;
        await redis.del(loginKey(ip)).catch((err: Error) => {
            logger.warn({ err: err.message }, 'Failed to reset login rate limit');
        });
    },
};

File: backend-crm/src/middlewares/validateRequest.ts
================
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { z } from 'zod';

export interface RequestSchemas {
    body?: z.ZodType;
    query?: z.ZodType;
    params?: z.ZodType;
}

/**
 * Validates and normalizes `req.body`, `req.query` and `req.params` with Zod. Parsed values replace the
 * originals, so handlers receive trimmed / coerced / defaulted data. A ZodError is forwarded to the error
 * handler, which turns it into a 400 with per-field `errors`.
 */
export function validateRequest(schemas: RequestSchemas) {
    return (req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
        if (schemas.params) req.params = schemas.params.parse(req.params) as Request['params'];
        if (schemas.query) {
            // Express 5 exposes `req.query` as a getter; shadow it with the parsed value.
            Object.defineProperty(req, 'query', {
                value: schemas.query.parse(req.query),
                writable: true,
                configurable: true,
                enumerable: true,
            });
        }
        if (schemas.body) req.body = schemas.body.parse(req.body ?? {});
        next();
    };
}

File: backend-crm/src/modules/audit/audit.service.ts

import { z } from 'zod';
import { ENV } from '../../config/env.js';
import { prisma } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { AuditEntityType } from '../../services/audit.service.js';

/** Route segment (plural or singular, any case) → stored entity type. */
const ENTITY_TYPES: Record<string, AuditEntityType> = {
    organization: 'Organization',
    organizations: 'Organization',
    contact: 'Contact',
    contacts: 'Contact',
    lead: 'Lead',
    leads: 'Lead',
    opportunity: 'Opportunity',
    opportunities: 'Opportunity',
    quotation: 'Quotation',
    quotations: 'Quotation',
    product: 'Product',
    products: 'Product',
    ticket: 'Ticket',
    tickets: 'Ticket',
    user: 'User',
    users: 'User',
};

export const auditParamsSchema = z.object({
    entityType: z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .transform((value) => ENTITY_TYPES[value.toLowerCase()])
        .refine((value): value is AuditEntityType => Boolean(value), { message: `entityType must be one of: ${[...new Set(Object.values(ENTITY_TYPES))].join(', ')}.` }),
    entityId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(50),
});

export const auditQuerySchema = z.object({
    limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(500).catch(100).default(100),
});

export interface AuditEntryDto {
    id: string;
    action: string;
    changedBy: string;
    createdAt: string;
    changes: unknown;
}

/** `AuditRevisionItem` from frontend-crm/src/components/common/Drawer/types.ts. */
export interface AuditRevisionItem {
    title: string;
    author: string;
    time: string;
    from?: string;
    to?: string;
    note?: string;
    tag?: string;
}

const timeFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
    timeZone: ENV.BUSINESS_TIMEZONE,
    day: '2-digit',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: true,
});

/** e.g. `12-Oct-2026, 11:15 AM` in the business timezone (the timeline's existing format). */
function displayTime(date: Date): string {
    const parts = Object.fromEntries(timeFormat.formatToParts(date).map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
    return `${parts.day}-${parts.month}-${parts.year}, ${parts.hour}:${parts.minute} ${String(parts.dayPeriod).toUpperCase()}`;
}

/** `salesStage` → `Sales Stage`. */
const fieldLabel = (field: string) => field.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, '$1 $2').replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase());

function displayValue(value: unknown): string {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '—';
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.every((item) => typeof item !== 'object')) return value.join(', ') || '—';
        return `${value.length} item${value.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value).slice(0, 200);
    return String(value);
}

const isDiff = (value: unknown): value is { from: unknown; to: unknown } =>
    typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && 'from' in value && 'to' in value;

const ACTION_TITLES: Record<string, { title: string; tag: string }> = {
    CREATE: { title: 'Record created', tag: 'Created' },
    DELETE: { title: 'Record deleted', tag: 'Deleted' },
    CONVERT: { title: 'Lead converted', tag: 'Converted' },
    IMPORT: { title: 'Imported', tag: 'Imported' },
    LOGIN: { title: 'Signed in', tag: 'Login' },
    LOGIN_FAILED: { title: 'Failed sign-in attempt', tag: 'Security' },
    LOGOUT: { title: 'Signed out', tag: 'Logout' },
};

/** One timeline item per changed field for updates; one item for every other action. */
function toRevisions(entry: AuditEntryDto, time: string): AuditRevisionItem[] {
    const base = { author: entry.changedBy, time };
    const changes = (entry.changes ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

    if (entry.action === 'UPDATE' || entry.action === 'STATUS_CHANGE') {
        const note = typeof changes.reason === 'string' ? changes.reason : undefined;
        const items = Object.entries(changes)
            .filter(([, value]) => isDiff(value))
            .map(([field, value]) => {
                const diff = value as { from: unknown; to: unknown };
                return { ...base, title: `${fieldLabel(field)} updated`, from: displayValue(diff.from), to: displayValue(diff.to), tag: 'Updated', note };
            });
        return items.length > 0 ? items : [{ ...base, title: 'Record updated', tag: 'Updated', note }];
    }

    const known = ACTION_TITLES[entry.action] ?? { title: entry.action, tag: entry.action };
    if (entry.action === 'CONVERT' && isDiff(changes.status)) {
        return [{ ...base, ...known, from: displayValue(changes.status.from), to: displayValue(changes.status.to) }];
    }
    return [{ ...base, ...known }];
}

export const auditLogService = {
    /** Newest first: raw entries plus timeline items ready for `AuditTrailTimeline`. */
    async forEntity(params: unknown, query: unknown) {
        const { entityType, entityId } = auditParamsSchema.parse(params);
        const { limit } = auditQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});

        const rows = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
            where: { entityType, entityId },
            orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
            take: limit,
        });

        const entries: AuditEntryDto[] = rows.map((row) => {
            let changes: unknown = null;
            try {
                changes = row.changesJson ? JSON.parse(row.changesJson) : null;
            } catch {
                changes = row.changesJson;
            }
            return { id: row.id, action: row.action, changedBy: row.changedBy, createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(), changes };
        });

        return {
            entityType,
            entityId,
            entries,
            revisions: entries.flatMap((entry, index) => toRevisions(entry, displayTime(rows[index].createdAt))),
        };
    },
};

import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';
import { authService } from './auth.service.js';
import { readToken, tryVerifyToken } from '../../middlewares/authMiddleware.js';
import { setAuthCookie, clearAuthCookie } from './cookie.util.js';
import type { LoginInput } from './auth.validator.js';

// Responses keep the existing `AuthResponse` / `LogoutResponse` shapes the frontend's AuthContext reads.

/** POST /api/auth/login — body already validated by `validateRequest({ body: loginSchema })`. */
export async function login(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const { user, token } = await authService.loginUser(req.body as LoginInput, {
        ip: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.get('user-agent'),
    });

    setAuthCookie(res, token);
    res.status(StatusCodes.OK).json({ status: 'ok', message: 'Login successful', user });
}

/** POST /api/auth/logout — always clears the cookie; revokes the session too when the token is still valid. */
export async function logout(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const verified = tryVerifyToken(readToken(req));
    if (verified) await authService.logout(verified, verified);

    clearAuthCookie(res);
    res.status(StatusCodes.OK).json({ status: 'ok', message: 'Logged out successfully' });
}

/** GET /api/auth/me — requires `authenticate`. */
export function getMe(req: Request, res: Response): void {
    res.status(StatusCodes.OK).json({ status: 'ok', user: req.user });
}

File: backend-crm/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts

import { createHash, randomUUID, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';
import { prisma } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';
import { loginRateLimit } from '../../middlewares/rateLimiter.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { auditService } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { sessionService, type SessionMetadata } from './session.service.js';
import { tokenService } from './token.service.js';
import type { LoginInput } from './auth.validator.js';
import type { AuthSession, AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';

const BCRYPT_ROUNDS = 12;
const BCRYPT_HASH_PATTERN = /^\$2[aby]\$\d{2}\$[./A-Za-z0-9]{53}$/;
const INVALID_CREDENTIALS = 'Invalid username or password';

// Compared against when the username doesn't exist, so response time doesn't reveal which usernames are valid.
let dummyHashPromise: Promise<string> | undefined;
const dummyHash = () => (dummyHashPromise ??= bcrypt.hash(randomUUID(), BCRYPT_ROUNDS));

export function hashPassword(plain: string): Promise<string> {
    return bcrypt.hash(plain, BCRYPT_ROUNDS);
}

/** Constant-time comparison for legacy plain-text passwords (hashing first equalizes the lengths). */
function plainTextMatches(candidate: string, stored: string): boolean {
    const a = createHash('sha256').update(candidate).digest();
    const b = createHash('sha256').update(stored).digest();
    return timingSafeEqual(a, b);
}

/** Checks a password against the stored value; `needsRehash` flags legacy plain-text rows to migrate to bcrypt. */
async function verifyPassword(candidate: string, stored: string): Promise<{ valid: boolean; needsRehash: boolean }> {
    if (BCRYPT_HASH_PATTERN.test(stored)) {
        return { valid: await bcrypt.compare(candidate, stored), needsRehash: false };
    }
    const valid = plainTextMatches(candidate, stored);
    return { valid, needsRehash: valid };
}

export interface LoginResult {
    user: AuthUser;
    token: string;
}

export const authService = {
    async loginUser(credentials: LoginInput, context: SessionMetadata = {}): Promise<LoginResult> {
        const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username: credentials.username } });

        if (!user) {
            await bcrypt.compare(credentials.password, await dummyHash());
            await loginRateLimit.recordFailure(context.ip);
            throw new HttpError(INVALID_CREDENTIALS, StatusCodes.UNAUTHORIZED, { code: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS' });
        }

        const { valid, needsRehash } = await verifyPassword(credentials.password, user.passwordHash);
        if (!valid) {
            await loginRateLimit.recordFailure(context.ip);
            // Failures for unknown usernames aren't audited: anyone could flood the log with made-up names.
            void auditService.enqueue({ entityType: 'User', entityId: String(user.id), action: 'LOGIN_FAILED', changedBy: user.username, changes: { ip: context.ip } });
            throw new HttpError(INVALID_CREDENTIALS, StatusCodes.UNAUTHORIZED, { code: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS' });
        }

        // Only revealed after a correct password, so it doesn't help username enumeration.
        if (!user.isActive) {
            throw new HttpError('This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.', StatusCodes.FORBIDDEN, {
                code: 'ACCOUNT_INACTIVE',
            });
        }

        await prisma.user.update({
            where: { id: user.id },
            data: {
                lastLoginAt: new Date(),
                ...(needsRehash ? { passwordHash: await hashPassword(credentials.password) } : {}),
            },
        });
        if (needsRehash) logger.info({ userId: user.id }, 'Migrated legacy plain-text password to bcrypt');

        await loginRateLimit.reset(context.ip);

        const authUser: AuthUser = { id: user.id, username: user.username, role: user.role };
        const jti = randomUUID();
        const tracked = await sessionService.create(user.id, jti, context);
        void auditService.enqueue({ entityType: 'User', entityId: String(user.id), action: 'LOGIN', changedBy: user.username, changes: { ip: context.ip } });

        return { user: authUser, token: tokenService.generateToken(authUser, { jti, tracked }) };
    },

    async logout(user: AuthUser, session: AuthSession): Promise<void> {
        if (session.tracked) await sessionService.revoke(user.id, session.jti);
        void auditService.enqueue({ entityType: 'User', entityId: String(user.id), action: 'LOGOUT', changedBy: user.username });
    },
};

File: backend-crm/src/modules/auth/session.service.ts
================
import { ENV } from '../../config/env.js';
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';
import { isRedisReady, redis } from '../../config/redis.js';

const sessionKey = (userId: number, jti: string) => `session:${userId}:${jti}`;
const SCAN_BATCH_SIZE = 200;

export interface SessionMetadata {
    ip?: string;
    userAgent?: string;
}

/**
 * Redis-tracked login sessions (`session:{userId}:{jti}`), expiring with the JWT. A session that is
 * tracked but missing from Redis has been revoked (logout, deactivation, password change).
 */
export const sessionService = {
    /** Records a new session; returns false (untracked) when Redis is unavailable. */
    async create(userId: number, jti: string, metadata: SessionMetadata): Promise<boolean> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return false;
        try {
            const value = JSON.stringify({ ...metadata, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
            await redis.set(sessionKey(userId, jti), value, 'EX', ENV.SESSION_TTL_SECONDS);
            return true;
        } catch (err) {
            logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, userId }, 'Could not record session; continuing untracked');
            return false;
        }
    },

    /** True if active, false if revoked/expired, null when Redis can't be asked (callers then trust the JWT). */
    async isActive(userId: number, jti: string): Promise<boolean | null> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return null;
        try {
            return (await redis.exists(sessionKey(userId, jti))) === 1;
        } catch (err) {
            logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, userId }, 'Session lookup failed; trusting token');
            return null;
        }
    },

    async revoke(userId: number, jti: string): Promise<void> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return;
        await redis.del(sessionKey(userId, jti)).catch((err: Error) => {
            logger.warn({ err: err.message, userId }, 'Session revoke failed');
        });
    },

    /** Ends every tracked session of a user (e.g. after deactivation or a password change). */
    async revokeAll(userId: number): Promise<void> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return;
        try {
            let cursor = '0';
            do {
                const [next, keys] = await redis.scan(cursor, 'MATCH', `session:${userId}:*`, 'COUNT', SCAN_BATCH_SIZE);
                cursor = next;
                if (keys.length > 0) await redis.unlink(...keys);
            } while (cursor !== '0');
        } catch (err) {
            logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, userId }, 'Revoking all sessions failed');
        }
    },
};

File: backend-crm/src/modules/auth/token.service.ts

import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { ENV } from '../../config/env.js';
import type { AuthSession, AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';

const ALGORITHM = 'HS256';

export interface VerifiedToken extends AuthUser, AuthSession {}

export const tokenService = {
    generateToken(user: AuthUser, session: AuthSession): string {
        return jwt.sign(
            { id: user.id, username: user.username, role: user.role, tracked: session.tracked },
            ENV.JWT_SECRET,
            { algorithm: ALGORITHM, expiresIn: ENV.SESSION_TTL_SECONDS, jwtid: session.jti },
        );
    },

    /** Verifies signature, algorithm and expiry, then checks the claims have the expected shape. Throws on any failure. */
    verifyToken(token: string): VerifiedToken {
        const payload = jwt.verify(token, ENV.JWT_SECRET, { algorithms: [ALGORITHM] });
        if (
            typeof payload !== 'object' ||
            typeof payload.id !== 'number' ||
            typeof payload.username !== 'string' ||
            typeof payload.role !== 'string' ||
            typeof payload.jti !== 'string'
        ) {
            throw new Error('Malformed token payload');
        }
        return {
            id: payload.id,
            username: payload.username,
            role: payload.role,
            jti: payload.jti,
            tracked: payload.tracked === true,
        };
    },
};

import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService, diffRecords } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import type { PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { generateEntityCode } from '../../utils/codeGenerator.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { daysAgo } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { parsePagination } from '../../utils/pagination.js';
import { emailsInclude, normalizeEmails, replaceEmails } from '../shared/entityEmails.js';
import { acquireLocks, lockRecords, runInTransaction, softDeleteData, type BulkDeleteResult } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import { toContactData, toContactDto, type ContactDto } from './contact.mapper.js';
import { CONTACT_SORT_FIELDS, contactInputSchema, contactListQuerySchema, type ContactInput } from './contact.validator.js';

const include = { emailAddresses: emailsInclude } as const;

const notFound = () => HttpError.notFound('Contact not found');

// ── Integrity rules (run inside the write transaction) ───────────────────────

/** A mobile number identifies one live contact (lead conversion relies on this to find existing contacts). */
async function assertUniqueMobile(tx: TransactionClient, mobile: string, excludeId?: string): Promise<void> {
    await acquireLocks(tx, [`contact:mobile:${mobile}`]);
    const duplicate = await tx.contact.findFirst({
        where: { mobile, isDeleted: false, ...(excludeId ? { NOT: { id: excludeId } } : {}) },
        select: { contactCode: true, name: true },
    });
    if (duplicate) {
        throw HttpError.conflict(`A contact with mobile ${mobile} already exists (${duplicate.contactCode} · ${duplicate.name}).`);
    }
}

/**
 * An explicit `organizationId` must point at a live organization, whose name then wins. Otherwise the typed
 * organization name is linked to the live organization with that exact name, if there is one.
 */
async function resolveOrganization(tx: TransactionClient, input: ContactInput): Promise<{ id: string | null; name: string }> {
    if (input.organizationId) {
        const org = await tx.organization.findFirst({
            where: { id: input.organizationId, isDeleted: false },
            select: { id: true, organizationName: true },
        });
        if (!org) {
            throw HttpError.badRequest('The selected organization no longer exists.', [
                { message: 'Select an existing organization.', path: ['organizationName'] },
            ]);
        }
        return { id: org.id, name: org.organizationName };
    }
    const byName = await tx.organization.findFirst({
        where: { organizationName: input.organizationName, isDeleted: false },
        select: { id: true, organizationName: true },
    });
    return byName ? { id: byName.id, name: byName.organizationName } : { id: null, name: input.organizationName };
}

/** Keeps one primary contact per organization: promoting this contact demotes the others (audited). */
async function demoteOtherPrimaries(tx: TransactionClient, contactId: string, organizationId: string | null, actor: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
    if (!organizationId) return;
    await acquireLocks(tx, [`contact:primary:${organizationId}`]);
    const others = await tx.contact.findMany({
        where: { organizationId, isPrimaryContact: true, isDeleted: false, NOT: { id: contactId } },
        select: { id: true },
    });
    if (others.length === 0) return;

    await tx.contact.updateMany({
        where: { id: { in: others.map((row) => row.id) } },
        data: { isPrimaryContact: false, updatedBy: actor.username },
    });
    await auditService.recordMany(
        tx,
        others.map((row) => ({
            entityType: 'Contact' as const,
            entityId: row.id,
            action: 'UPDATE' as const,
            changedBy: actor.username,
            changes: { isPrimaryContact: { from: true, to: false }, reason: `Primary contact changed to ${contactId}` },
        })),
    );
}

/**
 * Inserts a contact (code, mobile uniqueness, organization link, emails, primary rule, audit) inside the
 * caller's transaction. Used by `create` and by lead conversion; cache invalidation is the caller's job.
 */
export async function createContactRecord(tx: TransactionClient, input: ContactInput, user: AuthUser): Promise<ContactDto> {
    // Code first: its counter row lock queues concurrent creates before they take any other lock.
    const contactCode = await generateEntityCode(tx, 'CON');
    await assertUniqueMobile(tx, input.mobile);
    const organization = await resolveOrganization(tx, input);
    const row = await tx.contact.create({
        data: { ...toContactData(input, organization), contactCode, createdBy: user.username },
    });
    await replaceEmails(tx, { contactId: row.id }, normalizeEmails(input.emailAddresses));
    if (input.isPrimaryContact) await demoteOtherPrimaries(tx, row.id, organization.id, user);

    const dto = toContactDto(await tx.contact.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id }, include }));
    await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Contact', entityId: row.id, action: 'CREATE', changedBy: user.username, changes: dto });
    return dto;
}

/** Live contact by id, or else by mobile number, for "find or create" flows. */
export async function findLiveContact(tx: TransactionClient, mobile: string, id?: string) {
    if (id) {
        const byId = await tx.contact.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
        if (byId) return byId;
    }
    return mobile ? tx.contact.findFirst({ where: { mobile, isDeleted: false }, include }) : null;
}

// ── Service ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const contactService = {
    async list(query: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<PaginatedResult<ContactDto>> {
        const page = parsePagination(query, CONTACT_SORT_FIELDS);
        const filters = contactListQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});

        const where: Prisma.ContactWhereInput = { isDeleted: false };
        if (filters.organizationId) where.organizationId = filters.organizationId;
        if (filters.assignedTo) where.assignedTo = filters.assignedTo;
        if (filters.mine) where.assignedTo = user.username;
        if (filters.isPrimaryContact !== undefined) where.isPrimaryContact = filters.isPrimaryContact;
        if (filters.createdWithinDays) where.createdAt = { gte: daysAgo(filters.createdWithinDays) };
        if (page.search) {
            where.OR = [
                { name: { contains: page.search } },
                { contactCode: { contains: page.search } },
                { organizationName: { contains: page.search } },
                { mobile: { contains: page.search } },
                { officePhone: { contains: page.search } },
                { designation: { contains: page.search } },
                { emailAddresses: { some: { email: { contains: page.search } } } },
            ];
        }

        const [total, rows] = await prisma.$transaction([
            prisma.contact.count({ where }),
            prisma.contact.findMany({ where, include, orderBy: [page.orderBy, { id: 'asc' }], skip: page.skip, take: page.take }),
        ]);
        return { data: rows.map(toContactDto), total, page: page.page, limit: page.limit };
    },

    async getById(id: string): Promise<ContactDto> {
        const row = await prisma.contact.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
        if (!row) throw notFound();
        return toContactDto(row);
    },

    async create(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<ContactDto> {
        const input = contactInputSchema.parse(body);

        const created = await runInTransaction((tx) => createContactRecord(tx, input, user));
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('contacts');
        return created;
    },

    async update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, user: AuthUser): Promise<ContactDto> {
        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'contact', [id]);
            const existing = await tx.contact.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
            if (!existing) throw notFound();

            const before = toContactDto(existing);
            const merged: Record<string, unknown> = { ...before, ...patch };
            // Retyping the organization name without picking a record means "re-link by name", not "keep the old id".
            if ('organizationName' in patch && !('organizationId' in patch)) delete merged.organizationId;
            const input = contactInputSchema.parse(merged);

            if (input.mobile !== existing.mobile) await assertUniqueMobile(tx, input.mobile, id);
            const organization = await resolveOrganization(tx, input);

            await tx.contact.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...toContactData(input, organization), updatedBy: user.username } });
            if ('emailAddresses' in patch) {
                await replaceEmails(tx, { contactId: id }, normalizeEmails(input.emailAddresses));
            }
            if (input.isPrimaryContact) await demoteOtherPrimaries(tx, id, organization.id, user);

            const after = toContactDto(await tx.contact.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include }));
            const changes = diffRecords(before, after);
            if (Object.keys(changes).length > 0) {
                await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Contact', entityId: id, action: 'UPDATE', changedBy: user.username, changes });
            }
            return after;
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('contacts');
        return updated;
    },

    async remove(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
        await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'contact', [id]);
            const result = await tx.contact.updateMany({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
            if (result.count === 0) throw notFound();
            await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Contact', entityId: id, action: 'DELETE', changedBy: user.username });
        });
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('contacts');
    },

    async bulkRemove(ids: string[], user: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult> {
        const result = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'contact', ids);
            const live = await tx.contact.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false }, select: { id: true } });
            const liveIds = live.map((row) => row.id);
            if (liveIds.length > 0) {
                await tx.contact.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: liveIds } }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
                await auditService.recordMany(
                    tx,
                    liveIds.map((entityId) => ({ entityType: 'Contact' as const, entityId, action: 'DELETE' as const, changedBy: user.username })),
                );
            }
            return { deleted: liveIds.length, ids: liveIds, notFound: ids.filter((id) => !liveIds.includes(id)) };
        });

        if (result.deleted > 0) await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('contacts');
        return result;
    },
};

import { z } from 'zod';

const MAX_COMMUNICATION_TYPES = 10;

    name: requiredText('Contact Name', L.personName),
    organizationName: requiredText('Organization Name', L.organizationName),
    organizationId: optionalText('Organization', 50),
    mobile: phone('Mobile'),
    officePhone: optionalPhone('Office Phone'),
    phone3: optionalPhone('Phone 3'),
    phone4: optionalPhone('Phone 4'),

    leftJob: enumWithDefault('Left Job', ['No', 'Yes'], 'No'),

        .max(MAX_COMMUNICATION_TYPES, { message: `At most ${MAX_COMMUNICATION_TYPES} communication types are allowed.` })
        .default(['Call', 'Email']),
    doNotCall: z.boolean().default(false),
    description: optionalText('Description', L.longText),
});

import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';
import type { z } from 'zod';
import { sendSuccess } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { requireUser } from '../../utils/requestContext.js';

export const importController = {
    /** POST /api/import/:entity → 202 { status: 'queued', importId } or 200 { status: 'completed', result }. */
    async start(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
        const outcome = await importService.start(
            req.params.entity as ImportEntity,
            req.body as z.infer<typeof importBodySchema>,
            requireUser(req),
        );
        if (outcome.status === 'queued') {
            sendSuccess(res, outcome, `Import of ${outcome.total} rows queued`, StatusCodes.ACCEPTED);
        } else {
            const { created, failed } = outcome.result;
            sendSuccess(res, outcome, `Imported ${created} of ${outcome.result.total} rows${failed.length ? ` (${failed.length} failed)` : ''}`);
        }
    },

    /** GET /api/import/jobs/:importId */
    async status(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
        sendSuccess(res, await importService.status(String(req.params.importId), requireUser(req)));
    },
};

File: backend-crm/src/modules/imports/import.processor.ts
================
import { ZodError } from 'zod';
import { ENV } from '../../config/env.js';
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';
import { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { wallClockNow } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { createContactRecord } from '../contacts/contact.service.js';
import { contactInputSchema } from '../contacts/contact.validator.js';
import { assertStatusTransition, createLeadRecord } from '../leads/lead.service.js';
import { leadImportSchema } from '../leads/lead.validator.js';
import { createOrganizationRecord } from '../organizations/organization.service.js';
import { organizationImportSchema } from '../organizations/organization.validator.js';
import { createProductRecord } from '../products/product.service.js';
import { productInputSchema } from '../products/product.validator.js';
import { runInTransaction } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import type { TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';

/** Entities and field keys of the frontend's import wizard (frontend-crm/src/components/common/import). */
export const IMPORT_ENTITIES = ['organizations', 'contacts', 'products', 'leads'] as const;
export type ImportEntity = (typeof IMPORT_ENTITIES)[number];

export interface ImportRow {
    /** Spreadsheet row number (header = 1), echoed back in failures. */
    rowNumber: number;
    /** Values keyed by the template's field keys (e.g. `organizationName`, `gstNumber`). */
    values: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface ImportJobData {
    importId: string;
    entity: ImportEntity;
    rows: ImportRow[];
    user: AuthUser;
    fileName?: string;
}

export interface ImportRowFailure {
    rowNumber: number;
    errors: string[];
}

export interface ImportResult {
    importId: string;
    entity: ImportEntity;
    total: number;
    created: number;
    failed: ImportRowFailure[];
}

const PROGRESS_EVERY_ROWS = 20;
/** Lead fields the template doesn't offer but the record requires; documented defaults, applied only when blank. */
const LEAD_IMPORT_DEFAULTS = { leadSource: 'Other', leadType: 'Cold', addDescription: 'Imported via bulk import', followupType: 'Call' } as const;

const emailList = (email: string | undefined) =>
    email ? [{ email, isPrimary: true, isOptedOut: false, isInvalidBounce: false }] : [];

const businessToday = () => wallClockNow(ENV.BUSINESS_TIMEZONE).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

/** '18' → '18%' (spreadsheets often drop the percent sign). */
const normalizeTaxRate = (value: string | undefined) => (value && /^\d+$/.test(value) ? `${value}%` : value);

type RowWriter = (tx: TransactionClient) => Promise<unknown>;

/**
 * Maps a row's template values onto the entity's input, validates it, and returns the write to run.
 * Mirrors `importRows` in the frontend, but with values the server would otherwise reject defaulted explicitly.
 */
const rowBuilders: Record<ImportEntity, (v: Record<string, string>, user: AuthUser) => RowWriter> = {
    organizations: (v, user) => {
        const input = organizationImportSchema.parse({
            organizationName: v.organizationName,
            natureOfBusiness: v.natureOfBusiness,
            customerType: v.customerType,
            accountStatus: v.accountStatus || 'Active',
            billingAddress: v.billingStreet,
            billingCity: v.billingCity,
            billingState: v.billingState,
            gstNumber: v.gstNumber,
            registrationType: v.gstNumber ? 'Registered' : 'Unregistered',
            assignedUser: user.username,
        });
        return (tx) => createOrganizationRecord(tx, input, user);
    },
    contacts: (v, user) => {
        const input = contactInputSchema.parse({
            name: v.name,
            organizationName: v.organizationName,
            mobile: v.mobile,
            officePhone: v.officePhone,
            emailAddresses: emailList(v.email),
            assignedTo: user.username,
            designation: v.designation,
            department: v.department,
            description: v.description,
            communicationType: [],
        });
        return (tx) => createContactRecord(tx, input, user);
    },
    products: (v, user) => {
        const taxRate = normalizeTaxRate(v.taxRate);
        const input = productInputSchema.parse({
            productName: v.productName,
            hsnCode: v.hsnCode,
            category: v.category,
            type: v.type,
            manufacturer: v.manufacturer,
            taxType: taxRate ? 'GST' : undefined,
            taxRate,
            cost: v.cost,
            mrp: v.mrp,
            description: v.description,
        });
        return (tx) => createProductRecord(tx, input, user);
    },
    leads: (v, user) => {
        const status = v.status || 'New';
        assertStatusTransition(null, status);
        const input = leadImportSchema.parse({
            name: v.name,
            mobile: v.mobile,
            emailAddresses: emailList(v.email),
            organizationName: v.organizationName,
            leadSource: v.leadSource || LEAD_IMPORT_DEFAULTS.leadSource,
            leadType: v.leadType || LEAD_IMPORT_DEFAULTS.leadType,
            status,
            primaryCity: v.primaryCity,
            primaryState: v.primaryState,
            addDescription: v.addDescription && v.addDescription.length >= 3 ? v.addDescription : LEAD_IMPORT_DEFAULTS.addDescription,
            followupType: LEAD_IMPORT_DEFAULTS.followupType,
            nextFollowupDate: businessToday(),
            assignedTo: user.username,
        });
        return (tx) => createLeadRecord(tx, input, user);
    },
};

/** Human-readable reasons for a failed row. */
function describeError(err: unknown): string[] {
    if (err instanceof ZodError) return [...new Set(err.issues.map((issue) => issue.message))];
    if (err instanceof HttpError) return err.errors?.length ? [...new Set([err.message, ...err.errors.map((e) => e.message)])] : [err.message];
    if (err instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && err.code === 'P2002') return ['A record with these details already exists.'];
    logger.error({ err }, 'Unexpected error importing row');
    return ['Unexpected error while importing this row.'];
}

/**
 * Imports rows one by one, each in its own transaction, so a bad row never undoes the good ones.
 * Shared by the BullMQ import worker and the synchronous fallback used when Redis is unavailable.
 */
export async function processImport(data: ImportJobData, onProgress?: (percent: number) => Promise<void> | void): Promise<ImportResult> {
    const build = rowBuilders[data.entity];
    const failed: ImportRowFailure[] = [];
    let created = 0;

    for (const [index, row] of data.rows.entries()) {
        try {
            const write = build(row.values, data.user);
            await runInTransaction(write);
            created++;
        } catch (err) {
            failed.push({ rowNumber: row.rowNumber, errors: describeError(err) });
        }
        if (onProgress && ((index + 1) % PROGRESS_EVERY_ROWS === 0 || index === data.rows.length - 1)) {
            await onProgress(Math.round(((index + 1) / data.rows.length) * 100));
        }
    }

    if (created > 0) await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches(data.entity);
    const result: ImportResult = { importId: data.importId, entity: data.entity, total: data.rows.length, created, failed };
    await auditService.enqueue({
        entityType: 'Import',
        entityId: data.importId,
        action: 'IMPORT',
        changedBy: data.user.username,
        changes: { entity: data.entity, fileName: data.fileName, total: result.total, created, failed: failed.length },
    });
    logger.info({ importId: data.importId, entity: data.entity, total: result.total, created, failed: failed.length }, 'Import finished');
    return result;
}

import express, { Router } from 'express';
import { authenticate } from '../../middlewares/authMiddleware.js';
import { validateRequest } from '../../middlewares/validateRequest.js';
import { importController } from './import.controller.js';
import { importBodySchema, importEntityParamSchema, importIdParamSchema } from './import.service.js';

/**
 * /api/import
 *   POST /:entity          { rows: [{ rowNumber, values }], fileName? }  entity = organizations|contacts|products|leads
 *                          → 202 queued (poll the job) or 200 completed (no Redis; ≤ 500 rows run inline)
 *   GET  /jobs/:importId   → state, progress and per-row results (owner only)
 */
const router = Router();

router.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
router.use(authenticate);

router.get('/jobs/:importId', validateRequest({ params: importIdParamSchema }), importController.status);
router.post('/:entity', validateRequest({ params: importEntityParamSchema, body: importBodySchema }), importController.start);

export default router;

File: backend-crm/src/modules/imports/import.service.ts
================
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';
import { importQueue, isQueueAvailable, tryEnqueue } from '../../jobs/queues.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { optionalText } from '../../validators/common.js';
import { IMPORT_ENTITIES, processImport, type ImportEntity, type ImportJobData, type ImportResult } from './import.processor.js';

export const MAX_IMPORT_ROWS = 5_000;
/** Without Redis, imports up to this size run inside the request; larger ones need the background queue. */
export const MAX_INLINE_IMPORT_ROWS = 500;
const MAX_CELL_LENGTH = 5_000;

const cell = z
    .union([z.string(), z.number(), z.boolean(), z.null()])
    .transform((value) => (value === null ? '' : String(value).trim()))
    .pipe(z.string().max(MAX_CELL_LENGTH, { message: `Cells cannot exceed ${MAX_CELL_LENGTH} characters.` }));

export const importEntityParamSchema = z.object({
    entity: z.enum(IMPORT_ENTITIES, { error: `Entity must be one of: ${IMPORT_ENTITIES.join(', ')}.` }),
});

/** The wizard's valid `MappedRow`s (`{ rowNumber, values }`), plus an optional file name for the audit log. */
export const importBodySchema = z.object({
    rows: z
        .array(z.object({ rowNumber: z.coerce.number().int().min(1), values: z.record(z.string(), cell) }), { error: 'rows must be an array.' })
        .min(1, { message: 'There are no rows to import.' })
        .max(MAX_IMPORT_ROWS, { message: `At most ${MAX_IMPORT_ROWS} rows can be imported at once.` }),
    fileName: optionalText('File name', 255),
});

export const importIdParamSchema = z.object({ importId: z.uuid({ error: 'Invalid import id.' }) });

export type ImportStartResult =
    | { status: 'queued'; importId: string; total: number }
    | { status: 'completed'; importId: string; result: ImportResult };

export interface ImportJobStatus {
    importId: string;
    entity: ImportEntity;
    total: number;
    /** BullMQ state: waiting | active | completed | failed | delayed … */
    state: string;
    progress: number;
    result?: ImportResult;
    failedReason?: string;
}

export const importService = {
    /** Queues the import (202) or, when Redis is down and the file is small enough, runs it now (200). */
    async start(entity: ImportEntity, body: z.infer<typeof importBodySchema>, user: AuthUser): Promise<ImportStartResult> {
        const importId = randomUUID();
        const data: ImportJobData = { importId, entity, rows: body.rows, user, fileName: body.fileName };

        const jobId = await tryEnqueue(importQueue, entity, data, { jobId: importId });
        if (jobId) return { status: 'queued', importId, total: body.rows.length };

        if (body.rows.length > MAX_INLINE_IMPORT_ROWS) {
            throw new HttpError(
                `Background imports are temporarily unavailable. Import at most ${MAX_INLINE_IMPORT_ROWS} rows at a time, or try again later.`,
                StatusCodes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                { code: 'IMPORT_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE' },
            );
        }
        return { status: 'completed', importId, result: await processImport(data) };
    },

    /** Status of a queued import; only its owner can see it. */
    async status(importId: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<ImportJobStatus> {
        if (!isQueueAvailable()) {
            throw new HttpError('Import status is temporarily unavailable.', StatusCodes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, { code: 'IMPORT_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE' });
        }
        const job = await importQueue().getJob(importId);
        const data = job?.data as ImportJobData | undefined;
        if (!job || !data || data.user.id !== user.id) throw HttpError.notFound('Import not found');

        return {
            importId,
            entity: data.entity,
            total: data.rows.length,
            state: await job.getState(),
            progress: typeof job.progress === 'number' ? job.progress : 0,
            result: (job.returnvalue as ImportResult | null) ?? undefined,
            failedReason: job.failedReason || undefined,
        };
    },
};

File: backend-crm/src/modules/leads/lead.conversion.ts

import { auditService } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { toContactDto, type ContactDto } from '../contacts/contact.mapper.js';
import { createContactRecord, findLiveContact } from '../contacts/contact.service.js';
import { contactInputSchema } from '../contacts/contact.validator.js';
import { createOpportunityRecord } from '../opportunities/opportunity.service.js';
import { opportunityInputSchema } from '../opportunities/opportunity.validator.js';
import type { OpportunityDto } from '../opportunities/opportunity.mapper.js';
import { toOrganizationDto, type OrganizationDto } from '../organizations/organization.mapper.js';
import { createOrganizationRecord, findLiveOrganization } from '../organizations/organization.service.js';
import { organizationConversionSchema } from '../organizations/organization.validator.js';

/** `LeadConversionResult` from frontend-crm/src/services/leadConversion.service.ts. */
export interface LeadConversionResult {
    organization: OrganizationDto;
    contact: ContactDto;
    opportunity: OpportunityDto;
    organizationCreated: boolean;
    contactCreated: boolean;
}

const UNREGISTERED_TYPES = new Set(['unregistered', 'consumer']);
const NEW_OPPORTUNITY_STAGE = 'Qualification';
const NEW_OPPORTUNITY_COMMISSION = 'Nil / Direct (0%)';

/** The lead's GST registration bucket ('Composition Scheme' etc. are registered under GST). */
function registrationTypeFor(lead: LeadRow): 'Registered' | 'Unregistered' | undefined {
    const value = lead.registrationType?.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!value) return undefined;
    return UNREGISTERED_TYPES.has(value) ? 'Unregistered' : 'Registered';
}

/** Port of `toOrganizationPayload`; also keeps the organization owner the form collects. */
function organizationPayload(values: ConvertLeadInput, lead: LeadRow) {
    return {
        organizationName: values.organizationName,
        mailingName: values.mailingName,
        natureOfBusiness: values.natureOfBusiness,
        accountStatus: 'Active',
        typeOfEntity: values.typeOfEntity,
        customerType: values.customerType,
        sourceOfLead: values.sourceOfLead,
        memberOfParentCorp: values.memberOf,
        description: values.organizationDescription,
        accountVerified: false,
        provideSupport: 'No',
        assignedUser: values.organizationAssignedTo,
        billingAddress: lead.primaryAddress,
        billingCity: lead.primaryCity,
        billingState: lead.primaryState,
        billingPostalCode: lead.primaryPostalCode,
        billingCountry: lead.primaryCountry,
        registrationType: registrationTypeFor(lead),
        partnerCompanies: [],
    };
}

/** Port of `toContactPayload`. */
function contactPayload(values: ConvertLeadInput, organization: OrganizationDto) {
    return {
        name: values.contactName,
        organizationName: organization.organizationName,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        mobile: values.contactMobile,
        phone3: values.contactPhone3,
        emailAddresses: values.contactEmails,
        assignedTo: values.contactAssignedTo,
        isPrimaryContact: values.isPrimaryContact,
        designation: values.designation,
        department: values.department,
        leftJob: 'No',
        communicationType: values.communicationType,
        doNotCall: values.doNotCall,
        description: values.contactDescription,
    };
}

/**
 * Port of `toOpportunityPayload`, with fallbacks for two fields the opportunity requires but the convert form
 * may leave empty: Add Description falls back to the lead's (required) description, and Lead Given By to the
 * lead's creator.
 */
function opportunityPayload(values: ConvertLeadInput, lead: LeadRow, organization: OrganizationDto, contact: ContactDto) {
    const primaryEmail = normalizeEmails(values.contactEmails).find((row) => row.isPrimary)?.email;
    const description = values.opportunityDescription;
    return {
        productCategory: values.productCategory,
        contactName: contact.name,
        contactId: contact.id,
        organizationName: organization.organizationName,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        contactNumber: contact.mobile,
        emailAddress: primaryEmail,
        referredBy: values.referredBy,
        type: values.opportunityType,
        salesStage: NEW_OPPORTUNITY_STAGE,
        leadSource: values.opportunityLeadSource,
        leadGivenBy: values.principalCompany || values.referredBy || lead.createdBy,
        nextFollowupDate: values.nextFollowupDate,
        nextFollowupTime: values.nextFollowupTime,
        followupType: values.followupType,
        addDescription: description && description.length >= 3 ? description : lead.addDescription,
        description,
        assignedTo: values.opportunityAssignedTo,
        commission: NEW_OPPORTUNITY_COMMISSION,
        lineItems: [],
        lumpSumDiscount: 0,
    };
}

/**
 * POST /api/leads/:id/convert — the frontend's `convertLead` as one serializable transaction: find or create the
 * Organization (by id, then name) and the Contact (by id, then mobile), create the Opportunity, mark the lead
 * Converted with links to all three, and audit it. Any failure rolls the whole conversion back. The lead's record
 * lock (shared with lead edits) also makes concurrent conversions of one lead queue instead of deadlocking.
 */
export async function convertLead(leadId: string, body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<LeadConversionResult> {
    const values = convertLeadSchema.parse(body);

    const result = await runSerializable(async (tx) => {
        await lockRecords(tx, 'lead', [leadId]);
        const lead = await tx.lead.findFirst({ where: { id: leadId, isDeleted: false }, include: leadInclude });
        if (!lead) throw leadNotFound();
        if (lead.status === CONVERTED_STATUS) throw HttpError.conflict('This lead has already been converted.');

        const existingOrganization = await findLiveOrganization(tx, values.organizationName, values.existingOrganizationId);
        const organization = existingOrganization
            ? toOrganizationDto(existingOrganization, { isMyAccount: existingOrganization.assignedUser === user.username, isRecentlyViewed: false })
            : await createOrganizationRecord(tx, organizationConversionSchema.parse(organizationPayload(values, lead)), user);

        const existingContact = await findLiveContact(tx, values.contactMobile, values.existingContactId);
        const contact = existingContact
            ? toContactDto(existingContact)
            : await createContactRecord(tx, contactInputSchema.parse(contactPayload(values, organization)), user);

        const opportunity = await createOpportunityRecord(
            tx,
            opportunityInputSchema.parse(opportunityPayload(values, lead, organization, contact)),
            user,
        );

        await tx.lead.update({
            where: { id: leadId },
            data: {
                status: CONVERTED_STATUS,
                convertedAt: new Date(),
                convertedBy: user.username,
                convertedOrganizationId: organization.id,
                convertedContactId: contact.id,
                convertedOpportunityId: opportunity.id,
                updatedBy: user.username,
            },
        });
        await auditService.record(tx, {
            entityType: 'Lead',
            entityId: leadId,
            action: 'CONVERT',
            changedBy: user.username,
            changes: {
                status: { from: lead.status, to: CONVERTED_STATUS },
                organizationId: organization.id,
                organizationCreated: !existingOrganization,
                contactId: contact.id,
                contactCreated: !existingContact,
                opportunityId: opportunity.id,
                copyActivitiesTo: values.copyActivitiesTo,
            },
        });

        return { organization, contact, opportunity, organizationCreated: !existingOrganization, contactCreated: !existingContact };
    });

    await Promise.all([
        cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('leads'),
        cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('opportunities'),
        ...(result.organizationCreated ? [cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('organizations')] : []),
        ...(result.contactCreated ? [cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('contacts')] : []),
    ]);
    return result;
}

        designation: text(row.designation),
        leadSource: row.leadSource,
        productCategory: parseStringArray(row.productCategoryJson),
        followupType: text(row.followupType),
        addDescription: row.addDescription,
        registrationType: text(row.registrationType),
        turnover: text(row.turnover),
        assignedTo: row.assignedTo,
        otherPhone: text(row.otherPhone),
        organizationName: text(row.organizationName),
        department: text(row.department),
        leadType: row.leadType,
        status: row.status,
        nextFollowupDate: toDateOnly(row.nextFollowupDate),
        nextFollowupTime: text(row.nextFollowupTime),
        description: text(row.description),
        noOfEmployee: text(row.noOfEmployee),
        referredBy: text(row.referredBy),
        primaryAddress: text(row.primaryAddress),
        primaryCity: text(row.primaryCity),
        primaryState: text(row.primaryState),
        primaryPostalCode: text(row.primaryPostalCode),
        primaryCountry: text(row.primaryCountry),
        primaryLatitude: text(row.primaryLatitude),
        otherAddress: text(row.otherAddress),
        otherCity: text(row.otherCity),
        otherState: text(row.otherState),
        otherPostalCode: text(row.otherPostalCode),
        otherCountry: text(row.otherCountry),
        otherLongitude: text(row.otherLongitude),
        copyAddressFromLeft: row.copyAddressFromLeft,

        convertedBy: row.convertedBy ?? undefined,
        convertedOrganizationId: row.convertedOrganizationId ?? undefined,
        convertedContactId: row.convertedContactId ?? undefined,

        createdAt: toIso(row.createdAt),
        updatedAt: toIso(row.updatedAt),
        createdBy: row.createdBy,
    };
}

const DEFAULT_COUNTRY = 'IN';

export function toLeadData(input: LeadInput): Omit<Prisma.LeadUncheckedCreateInput, 'leadCode' | 'createdBy'> {
    const primary = {
        address: nullable(input.primaryAddress),
        city: nullable(input.primaryCity),
        state: nullable(input.primaryState),
        postalCode: nullable(input.primaryPostalCode),
        country: input.primaryCountry ?? DEFAULT_COUNTRY,
    };
    // "Copy address from left" is enforced here rather than trusted from the client.
    const other = input.copyAddressFromLeft
        ? primary
        : {
              address: nullable(input.otherAddress),
              city: nullable(input.otherCity),
              state: nullable(input.otherState),
              postalCode: nullable(input.otherPostalCode),
              country: input.otherCountry ?? DEFAULT_COUNTRY,
          };

    return {
        name: input.name,
        mobile: input.mobile,
        mailingName: nullable(input.mailingName),
        designation: nullable(input.designation),
        leadSource: input.leadSource,
        productCategoryJson: stringifyStringArray(input.productCategory),
        followupType: input.followupType ?? 'Call',
        addDescription: input.addDescription,
        registrationType: nullable(input.registrationType),
        turnover: nullable(input.turnover),
        assignedTo: input.assignedTo,
        otherPhone: input.otherPhone ?? null,
        organizationName: nullable(input.organizationName),
        department: nullable(input.department),
        leadType: input.leadType,
        status: input.status,
        nextFollowupDate: fromDateOnly(input.nextFollowupDate),
        nextFollowupTime: nullable(input.nextFollowupTime),
        description: nullable(input.description),
        noOfEmployee: nullable(input.noOfEmployee),
        referredBy: nullable(input.referredBy),
        primaryAddress: primary.address,
        primaryCity: primary.city,
        primaryState: primary.state,
        primaryPostalCode: primary.postalCode,
        primaryCountry: primary.country,
        primaryLatitude: nullable(input.primaryLatitude),
        otherAddress: other.address,
        otherCity: other.city,
        otherState: other.state,
        otherPostalCode: other.postalCode,
        otherCountry: other.country,
        otherLongitude: nullable(input.otherLongitude),
        copyAddressFromLeft: input.copyAddressFromLeft,
    };
}

import { Router } from 'express';
import { authenticate } from '../../middlewares/authMiddleware.js';
import { validateRequest } from '../../middlewares/validateRequest.js';
import { idParamSchema } from '../../validators/common.js';
import { registerCrudRoutes } from '../shared/crud.js';
import { leadController } from './lead.controller.js';

/**
 * /api/leads
 *   GET    /             ?page&limit&search&sortBy&sortOrder&status&excludeStatus&leadType&leadSource
 *                         &organizationName&assignedTo&mine&nextFollowupDate&createdWithinDays
 *   GET    /:id
 *   POST   /
 *   PUT    /:id          (partial; PATCH is an alias; status can't be set to/from Converted here)
 *   DELETE /:id          (soft delete)
 *   POST   /bulk-delete  { ids }
 *   POST   /:id/convert  ConvertLeadFormValues → LeadConversionResult (atomic)
 */
const router = Router();
router.use(authenticate);

router.post('/:id/convert', validateRequest({ params: idParamSchema }), leadController.convert);
registerCrudRoutes(router, leadController);

export default router;

import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService, diffRecords } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import type { PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { generateEntityCode } from '../../utils/codeGenerator.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { daysAgo, fromDateOnly } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { parsePagination } from '../../utils/pagination.js';
import { emailsInclude, normalizeEmails, replaceEmails } from '../shared/entityEmails.js';
import { lockRecords, runInTransaction, softDeleteData, type BulkDeleteResult } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import { toLeadData, toLeadDto, type LeadDto } from './lead.mapper.js';
import { CONVERTED_STATUS, LEAD_SORT_FIELDS, leadInputSchema, leadListQuerySchema, type LeadInput } from './lead.validator.js';

export const leadInclude = { emailAddresses: emailsInclude } as const;

export const leadNotFound = () => HttpError.notFound('Lead not found');

/** `Converted` is only ever set by POST /api/leads/:id/convert, and a converted lead stays converted. */
export function assertStatusTransition(fromStatus: string | null, toStatus: string): void {
    if (fromStatus === CONVERTED_STATUS && toStatus !== CONVERTED_STATUS) {
        throw HttpError.badRequest('A converted lead cannot change status.', [
            { message: 'This lead has already been converted.', path: ['status'] },
        ]);
    }
    if (fromStatus !== CONVERTED_STATUS && toStatus === CONVERTED_STATUS) {
        throw HttpError.badRequest('Use the Convert action to convert a lead.', [
            { message: 'Leads are converted with the Convert action.', path: ['status'] },
        ]);
    }
}

async function loadLead(tx: TransactionClient | typeof prisma, id: string) {
    const row = await tx.lead.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include: leadInclude });
    if (!row) throw leadNotFound();
    return row;
}

/** Inserts a lead inside the caller's transaction (used by `create`, import and the seed). */
export async function createLeadRecord(tx: TransactionClient, input: LeadInput, user: AuthUser): Promise<LeadDto> {
    const leadCode = await generateEntityCode(tx, 'LD');
    const row = await tx.lead.create({ data: { ...toLeadData(input), leadCode, createdBy: user.username } });
    await replaceEmails(tx, { leadId: row.id }, normalizeEmails(input.emailAddresses));

    const dto = toLeadDto(await loadLead(tx, row.id));
    await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Lead', entityId: row.id, action: 'CREATE', changedBy: user.username, changes: dto });
    return dto;
}

export const leadService = {
    async list(query: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<PaginatedResult<LeadDto>> {
        const page = parsePagination(query, LEAD_SORT_FIELDS);
        const filters = leadListQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});

        const where: Prisma.LeadWhereInput = { isDeleted: false };
        const statusFilter: Prisma.StringFilter = {};
        if (filters.status?.length) statusFilter.in = filters.status;
        if (filters.excludeStatus?.length) statusFilter.notIn = filters.excludeStatus;
        if (Object.keys(statusFilter).length > 0) where.status = statusFilter;
        if (filters.leadType?.length) where.leadType = { in: filters.leadType };
        if (filters.leadSource?.length) where.leadSource = { in: filters.leadSource };
        if (filters.assignedTo) where.assignedTo = filters.assignedTo;
        if (filters.organizationName) where.organizationName = filters.organizationName;
        if (filters.mine) where.assignedTo = user.username;
        if (filters.nextFollowupDate) where.nextFollowupDate = fromDateOnly(filters.nextFollowupDate);
        if (filters.createdWithinDays) where.createdAt = { gte: daysAgo(filters.createdWithinDays) };
        if (page.search) {
            where.OR = [
                { leadCode: { contains: page.search } },
                { name: { contains: page.search } },
                { mobile: { contains: page.search } },
                { otherPhone: { contains: page.search } },
                { organizationName: { contains: page.search } },
                { emailAddresses: { some: { email: { contains: page.search } } } },
            ];
        }

        const [total, rows] = await prisma.$transaction([
            prisma.lead.count({ where }),
            prisma.lead.findMany({ where, include: leadInclude, orderBy: [page.orderBy, { id: 'asc' }], skip: page.skip, take: page.take }),
        ]);
        return { data: rows.map(toLeadDto), total, page: page.page, limit: page.limit };
    },

    async getById(id: string): Promise<LeadDto> {
        return toLeadDto(await loadLead(prisma, id));
    },

    async create(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<LeadDto> {
        const input = leadInputSchema.parse(body);
        assertStatusTransition(null, input.status);

        const created = await runInTransaction((tx) => createLeadRecord(tx, input, user));
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('leads');
        return created;
    },

    async update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, user: AuthUser): Promise<LeadDto> {
        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'lead', [id]);
            const existing = await loadLead(tx, id);
            const before = toLeadDto(existing);
            const input = leadInputSchema.parse({ ...before, ...patch });
            assertStatusTransition(existing.status, input.status);

            await tx.lead.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...toLeadData(input), updatedBy: user.username } });
            if ('emailAddresses' in patch) {
                await replaceEmails(tx, { leadId: id }, normalizeEmails(input.emailAddresses));
            }

            const after = toLeadDto(await loadLead(tx, id));
            const changes = diffRecords(before, after);
            if (Object.keys(changes).length > 0) {
                await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Lead', entityId: id, action: 'UPDATE', changedBy: user.username, changes });
            }
            return after;
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('leads');
        return updated;
    },

    async remove(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
        await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'lead', [id]);
            const result = await tx.lead.updateMany({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
            if (result.count === 0) throw leadNotFound();
            await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Lead', entityId: id, action: 'DELETE', changedBy: user.username });
        });
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('leads');
    },

    async bulkRemove(ids: string[], user: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult> {
        const result = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'lead', ids);
            const live = await tx.lead.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false }, select: { id: true } });
            const liveIds = live.map((row) => row.id);
            if (liveIds.length > 0) {
                await tx.lead.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: liveIds } }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
                await auditService.recordMany(
                    tx,
                    liveIds.map((entityId) => ({ entityType: 'Lead' as const, entityId, action: 'DELETE' as const, changedBy: user.username })),
                );
            }
            return { deleted: liveIds.length, ids: liveIds, notFound: ids.filter((id) => !liveIds.includes(id)) };
        });

        if (result.deleted > 0) await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('leads');
        return result;
    },
};

import { z } from 'zod';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH as L } from '../../config/fieldLimits.js';

    csvQuery,

/** LEAD_STATUSES from frontend-crm/src/types/lead.types.ts. */
export const LEAD_STATUSES = [
    'New',
    'Contacted',
    'In Discussion',
    'Demo Scheduled',
    'Proposal Sent',

    'Negotiation',
    'Converted',
    'Unqualified / Lost',

export const CONVERTED_STATUS = 'Converted';

/** Field rules shared by the lead form and bulk import. */
const leadFields = z.object({

    registrationType: optionalText('Registration Type', 30),
    turnover: optionalText('Turnover', 30),

    organizationName: optionalText('Organization Name', L.organizationName),
    department: optionalText('Department', L.option),
    leadType: requiredText('Lead Type', L.option),
    status: enumWithDefault('Status', LEAD_STATUSES, 'New'),

    description: optionalText('Description', L.longText),
