    otherCity: optionalText('Other City', L.shortText),
    otherState: optionalText('Other State', L.shortText),
    otherPostalCode: optionalPostalCode,
    otherCountry: optionalText('Other Country', L.shortText),
    otherLongitude: optionalText('Other Longitude', 30),
    copyAddressFromLeft: z.boolean().default(false),
});

function refineLeadPostalCodes(
    lead: { primaryPostalCode?: string; primaryCountry?: string; otherPostalCode?: string; otherCountry?: string; copyAddressFromLeft: boolean },
    ctx: z.RefinementCtx,
): void {
    refinePostalCodeForCountry(ctx, 'primaryPostalCode', lead.primaryPostalCode, lead.primaryCountry);
    if (!lead.copyAddressFromLeft) {
        refinePostalCodeForCountry(ctx, 'otherPostalCode', lead.otherPostalCode, lead.otherCountry);
    }
}

/** `LeadFormData` rules from frontend-crm/src/validations/lead.schema.ts. */

/** Bulk import: the template has no Product Category column, so it may be empty. */

    .extend({ productCategory: stringList('Product Category', 30, L.option).default([]) })
    .superRefine(refineLeadPostalCodes);

import { Router, type Request, type Response } from 'express';
import { authenticate } from '../../middlewares/authMiddleware.js';
import { sendSuccess } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { lookupService } from './lookup.service.js';

/**
 * /api/lookups (all cached in Redis)
 *   GET /users               ?includeInactive         → CrmUser[]
 *   GET /organizations       ?search&limit            → compact organizations
 *   GET /contacts            ?search&limit&organizationId
 *   GET /products            ?search&limit&category   (active products)
 *   GET /nature-of-calls                              → NatureOfCallItem[]
 *   GET /partner-companies                            → PartnerCompany[]
 *   GET /partner-contacts    ?partnerCompany          → PartnerCompanyContact[]
 *   GET /address-master      ?country=IN              → { countries, subdivisions }
 */
const router = Router();
router.use(authenticate);

const handler = (load: (query: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    sendSuccess(res, await load(req.query));
};

router.get('/users', handler((q) => lookupService.users(q)));
router.get('/organizations', handler((q) => lookupService.organizations(q)));
router.get('/contacts', handler((q) => lookupService.contacts(q)));
router.get('/products', handler((q) => lookupService.products(q)));
router.get('/nature-of-calls', handler(() => lookupService.natureOfCalls()));
router.get('/partner-companies', handler(() => lookupService.partnerCompanies()));
router.get('/partner-contacts', handler((q) => lookupService.partnerContacts(q)));
router.get('/address-master', handler((q) => lookupService.addressMaster(q)));

export default router;

================
File: backend-crm/src/modules/lookups/lookup.service.ts
================
import { z } from 'zod';
import { prisma } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { CACHE_KEYS, cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import { booleanQuery } from '../../validators/common.js';

/**
 * Data for the frontend's lookup modals and pickers (`LookupRecordMap`): compact projections of the big
 * entities (search + limit) and full lists of the small masters. Cached in Redis; entity writes invalidate
 * `cache:lookups:<entity>*`, masters expire by TTL.
 */

const ENTITY_TTL_SECONDS = 5 * 60;
const MASTER_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60;
const ADDRESS_MASTER_TTL_SECONDS = 24 * 60 * 60;

export const lookupQuerySchema = z.object({
    search: z.string().trim().max(100).optional().catch(undefined),
    limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(200).catch(50).default(50),
});

const withSearch = <T>(search: string | undefined, or: T[]) => (search ? { OR: or } : {});

// ── Users (CrmUser) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CrmUserDto {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    username: string;
    department: string;
    role: string;
    email: string;
    status: 'Active' | 'Inactive';
    isGroupUser: boolean;
    onLeave: boolean;
}

export const usersQuerySchema = z.object({ includeInactive: booleanQuery });

// ── Compact entity projections ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface OrganizationLookupDto {
    id: string;
    accountCode: string;
    organizationName: string;
    mailingName: string;
    tradeName: string;
    billingCity: string;
    billingState: string;
    customerType: string;
    accountStatus: string;
    gstNo: string;
    assignedUser: string;
}

export interface ContactLookupDto {
    id: string;
    contactCode: string;
    name: string;
    organizationName: string;
    organizationId?: string;
    mobile: string;
    email: string;
    designation: string;
    assignedTo: string;
}

export interface ProductLookupDto {
    id: string;
    productCode: string;
    productName: string;
    category: string;
    type: string;
    hsnCode: string;
    mrp: string;
    taxRate: string;
}

export const contactsLookupQuerySchema = lookupQuerySchema.extend({ organizationId: z.string().trim().max(50).optional() });
export const productsLookupQuerySchema = lookupQuerySchema.extend({ category: z.string().trim().max(100).optional() });
export const partnerContactsQuerySchema = z.object({ partnerCompany: z.string().trim().max(200).optional() });
export const addressMasterQuerySchema = z.object({
    country: z.string().trim().toUpperCase().regex(/^[A-Z]{2}$/, { message: 'country must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.' }).optional(),
});

export const lookupService = {
    async users(query: unknown): Promise<CrmUserDto[]> {
        const { includeInactive } = usersQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
        return cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.lookups(`users:${includeInactive ? 'all' : 'active'}`), ENTITY_TTL_SECONDS, async () => {
            const rows = await prisma.user.findMany({
                where: includeInactive ? {} : { isActive: true },
                orderBy: [{ fullName: 'asc' }, { username: 'asc' }],
            });
            return rows.map((user) => ({
                id: String(user.id),
                name: user.fullName || user.username,
                username: user.username,
                department: user.department ?? '',
                role: user.role,
                email: user.email ?? '',
                status: user.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive',
                isGroupUser: user.isGroupUser,
                onLeave: user.onLeave,
            }));
        });
    },

    async organizations(query: unknown): Promise<OrganizationLookupDto[]> {
        const { search, limit } = lookupQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
        const load = async () => {
            const where: Prisma.OrganizationWhereInput = {
                isDeleted: false,
                ...withSearch(search, [
                    { organizationName: { contains: search } },
                    { accountCode: { contains: search } },
                    { tradeName: { contains: search } },
                    { gstNo: { contains: search } },
                    { billingCity: { contains: search } },
                ]),
            };
            const rows = await prisma.organization.findMany({ where, orderBy: { organizationName: 'asc' }, take: limit });
            return rows.map((o) => ({
                id: o.id,
                accountCode: o.accountCode,
                organizationName: o.organizationName,
                mailingName: o.mailingName ?? '',
                tradeName: o.tradeName ?? '',
                billingCity: o.billingCity ?? '',
                billingState: o.billingState ?? '',
                customerType: o.customerType ?? '',
                accountStatus: o.accountStatus,
                gstNo: o.gstNo ?? '',
                assignedUser: o.assignedUser ?? '',
            }));
        };
        // Only the unfiltered list is cached; searches are cheap and too varied to be worth caching.
        return search ? load() : cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.lookups(`organizations:${limit}`), ENTITY_TTL_SECONDS, load);
    },

    async contacts(query: unknown): Promise<ContactLookupDto[]> {
        const { search, limit, organizationId } = contactsLookupQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
        const load = async () => {
            const where: Prisma.ContactWhereInput = {
                isDeleted: false,
                ...(organizationId ? { organizationId } : {}),
                ...withSearch(search, [
                    { name: { contains: search } },
                    { contactCode: { contains: search } },
                    { mobile: { contains: search } },
                    { organizationName: { contains: search } },
                    { emailAddresses: { some: { email: { contains: search } } } },
                ]),
            };
            const rows = await prisma.contact.findMany({
                where,
                include: { emailAddresses: { orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' } } },
                orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
                take: limit,
            });
            return rows.map((c) => ({
                id: c.id,
                contactCode: c.contactCode,
                name: c.name,
                organizationName: c.organizationName,
                organizationId: c.organizationId ?? undefined,
                mobile: c.mobile,
                email: (c.emailAddresses.find((e) => e.isPrimary) ?? c.emailAddresses[0])?.email ?? '',
                designation: c.designation ?? '',
                assignedTo: c.assignedTo,
            }));
        };
        return search || organizationId ? load() : cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.lookups(`contacts:${limit}`), ENTITY_TTL_SECONDS, load);
    },

    async products(query: unknown): Promise<ProductLookupDto[]> {
        const { search, limit, category } = productsLookupQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
        const load = async () => {
            const where: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = {
                isDeleted: false,
                isActive: true,
                ...(category ? { category } : {}),
                ...withSearch(search, [
                    { productName: { contains: search } },
                    { productCode: { contains: search } },
                    { category: { contains: search } },
                    { hsnCode: { contains: search } },
                ]),
            };
            const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({ where, orderBy: { productName: 'asc' }, take: limit });
            return rows.map((p) => ({
                id: p.id,
                productCode: p.productCode,
                productName: p.productName,
                category: p.category ?? '',
                type: p.type ?? '',
                hsnCode: p.hsnCode ?? '',
                mrp: p.mrp?.toString() ?? '',
                taxRate: p.taxRate ?? '',
            }));
        };
        return search || category ? load() : cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.lookups(`products:${limit}`), ENTITY_TTL_SECONDS, load);
    },

    /** `NatureOfCallItem[]` (active entries). */
    async natureOfCalls() {
        return cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.lookups('nature-of-calls'), MASTER_TTL_SECONDS, () =>
            prisma.natureOfCall.findMany({
                where: { isActive: true },
                select: { id: true, name: true, priority: true },
                orderBy: [{ sortOrder: 'asc' }, { name: 'asc' }],
            }),
        );
    },

    /** `PartnerCompany[]` (active). */
    async partnerCompanies() {
        return cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.lookups('partner-companies'), MASTER_TTL_SECONDS, async () => {
            const rows = await prisma.partnerCompany.findMany({ where: { isActive: true }, orderBy: { companyName: 'asc' } });
            return rows.map((p) => ({
                id: p.id,
                companyName: p.companyName,
                natureOfPartner: p.natureOfPartner ?? '',
                phone: p.phone ?? '',
                email: p.email ?? '',
                city: p.city ?? '',
                billingCountry: p.billingCountry ?? '',
                assignedTo: p.assignedTo ?? '',
            }));
        });
    },

    /** `PartnerCompanyContact[]` (active), optionally for one partner company (by name). */
    async partnerContacts(query: unknown) {
        const { partnerCompany } = partnerContactsQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
        const all = await cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.lookups('partner-contacts'), MASTER_TTL_SECONDS, async () => {
            const rows = await prisma.partnerCompanyContact.findMany({
                where: { isActive: true, partnerCompany: { isActive: true } },
                include: { partnerCompany: { select: { companyName: true } } },
                orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
            });
            return rows.map((c) => ({
                id: c.id,
                name: c.name,
                designation: c.designation ?? '',
                partnerCompany: c.partnerCompany.companyName,
                mobile: c.mobile ?? '',
                officePhone: c.officePhone ?? undefined,
                email: c.email ?? '',
                location: c.location ?? '',
            }));
        });
        if (!partnerCompany) return all;
        const target = partnerCompany.toLowerCase();
        return all.filter((c) => c.partnerCompany.toLowerCase() === target);
    },

    /** ISO 3166 countries and subdivisions (`CountryMasterItem` / `StateRegionMasterItem`); `?country=IN` narrows subdivisions. */
    async addressMaster(query: unknown) {
        const { country } = addressMasterQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
        const key = country ? `${CACHE_KEYS.addressMaster}:${country}` : CACHE_KEYS.addressMaster;
        return cacheService.getOrSet(key, ADDRESS_MASTER_TTL_SECONDS, async () => {
            const [countries, subdivisions] = await Promise.all([
                prisma.country.findMany({ orderBy: { countryName: 'asc' } }),
                prisma.subdivision.findMany({
                    where: country ? { countryIso2: country } : {},
                    include: { country: { select: { countryName: true } } },
                    orderBy: [{ countryIso2: 'asc' }, { subdivisionName: 'asc' }],
                }),
            ]);
            return {
                countries: countries.map((c) => ({ countryName: c.countryName, iso2Code: c.iso2Code, iso3Code: c.iso3Code, numericCode: c.numericCode })),
                subdivisions: subdivisions.map((s) => ({
                    countryName: s.country.countryName,
                    countryIso2: s.countryIso2,
                    subdivisionCode: s.subdivisionCode,
                    subdivisionName: s.subdivisionName,
                    subdivisionType: s.subdivisionType,
                })),
            };
        });
    },
};

export function toOpportunityDto(row: OpportunityRow): OpportunityDto {
    return {
        id: row.id,
        opportunityCode: row.opportunityCode,
        opportunityName: text(row.opportunityName),
        productCategory: parseStringArray(row.productCategoryJson),
        contactName: row.contactName,
        contactId: row.contactId ?? undefined,
        organizationName: row.organizationName,
        organizationId: row.organizationId ?? undefined,
        contactNumber: row.contactNumber,
        emailAddress: text(row.emailAddress),
        referredBy: text(row.referredBy),
        type: row.type,
        salesStage: row.salesStage,
        leadSource: row.leadSource,
        leadGivenBy: row.leadGivenBy,
        nextFollowupDate: toDateOnly(row.nextFollowupDate),
        nextFollowupTime: text(row.nextFollowupTime),
        followupType: text(row.followupType),
        addDescription: row.addDescription,
        description: text(row.description),
        assignedTo: row.assignedTo,
        tallySerialNo: text(row.tallySerialNo),
        invoiceNo: text(row.invoiceNo),
        invoiceDate: toDateOnly(row.invoiceDate),
        commission: row.commission,
        addDocument: text(row.addDocument),
        currency: row.currency,
        groupName: text(row.groupName),
        lineItems: toLineItemDtos(row.lineItems),
        lumpSumDiscount: decimalToNumber(row.lumpSumDiscount),
        totalAmount: decimalToNumber(row.totalAmount),
        totalDiscount: decimalToNumber(row.totalDiscount),
        subtotal: decimalToNumber(row.subtotal),
        totalTax: decimalToNumber(row.totalTax),
        grandTotal: decimalToNumber(row.grandTotal),
        createdAt: toIso(row.createdAt),
        updatedAt: toIso(row.updatedAt),
        createdBy: row.createdBy,
    };
}

/** Writable scalar columns; links and computed totals come from the service. */
export function toOpportunityData(
    input: OpportunityInput,
    links: { organization: { id: string | null; name: string }; contact: { id: string | null; name: string } },
    totals: LineItemTotals,
): Omit<Prisma.OpportunityUncheckedCreateInput, 'opportunityCode' | 'createdBy'> {
    return {
        opportunityName: nullable(input.opportunityName),
        productCategoryJson: stringifyStringArray(input.productCategory),
        contactName: links.contact.name,
        contactId: links.contact.id,
        organizationName: links.organization.name,
        organizationId: links.organization.id,
        contactNumber: input.contactNumber,
        emailAddress: input.emailAddress ?? null,
        referredBy: nullable(input.referredBy),
        type: input.type,
        salesStage: input.salesStage,
        leadSource: input.leadSource,
        leadGivenBy: input.leadGivenBy,
        nextFollowupDate: fromDateOnly(input.nextFollowupDate),
        nextFollowupTime: nullable(input.nextFollowupTime),
        followupType: input.followupType ?? 'Call',
        addDescription: input.addDescription,
        description: nullable(input.description),
        assignedTo: input.assignedTo,
        tallySerialNo: nullable(input.tallySerialNo),
        invoiceNo: nullable(input.invoiceNo),
        invoiceDate: input.invoiceDate ? fromDateOnly(input.invoiceDate) : null,
        commission: input.commission,
        addDocument: input.addDocument,
        currency: input.currency ?? DEFAULT_CURRENCY,
        groupName: nullable(input.groupName),
        lumpSumDiscount: input.lumpSumDiscount,
        ...totals,
    };
}

import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService, diffRecords } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import type { PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { generateEntityCode } from '../../utils/codeGenerator.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { daysAgo, fromDateOnly } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { parsePagination } from '../../utils/pagination.js';
import { calculateLineItems, lineItemsInclude, resolveProductIds, toLineItemData } from '../shared/lineItems.js';
import { assertReference } from '../shared/references.js';
import { lockRecords, runInTransaction, softDeleteData, type BulkDeleteResult } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import { toOpportunityData, toOpportunityDto, type OpportunityDto } from './opportunity.mapper.js';
import {
    OPPORTUNITY_SORT_FIELDS,
    opportunityInputSchema,
    opportunityListQuerySchema,
    type OpportunityInput,
} from './opportunity.validator.js';

const include = { lineItems: lineItemsInclude } as const;

const notFound = () => HttpError.notFound('Opportunity not found');

interface Link {
    id: string | null;
    name: string;
}

/**
 * Resolves the organization and contact links. An explicit id must reference an existing record (whose name
 * then wins); otherwise the typed organization name links to the live organization with that name, and the
 * contact name links to a live contact of that organization.
 */
async function resolveLinks(
    tx: TransactionClient,
    input: OpportunityInput,
    previous?: { organizationId: string | null; contactId: string | null },
): Promise<{ organization: Link; contact: Link }> {
    const orgSelect = { id: true, organizationName: true, isDeleted: true } as const;
    let organization: Link;
    if (input.organizationId) {
        const org = await tx.organization.findUnique({ where: { id: input.organizationId }, select: orgSelect });
        assertReference(org, input.organizationId, previous?.organizationId, 'organization', 'organizationName');
        organization = { id: org.id, name: org.organizationName };
    } else {
        const org = await tx.organization.findFirst({ where: { organizationName: input.organizationName, isDeleted: false }, select: orgSelect });
        organization = org ? { id: org.id, name: org.organizationName } : { id: null, name: input.organizationName };
    }

    const contactSelect = { id: true, name: true, isDeleted: true } as const;
    let contact: Link;
    if (input.contactId) {
        const found = await tx.contact.findUnique({ where: { id: input.contactId }, select: contactSelect });
        assertReference(found, input.contactId, previous?.contactId, 'contact', 'contactName');
        contact = { id: found.id, name: found.name };
    } else if (organization.id) {
        const found = await tx.contact.findFirst({
            where: { name: input.contactName, organizationId: organization.id, isDeleted: false },
            select: contactSelect,
        });
        contact = found ? { id: found.id, name: found.name } : { id: null, name: input.contactName };
    } else {
        // Without an organization a contact name is too ambiguous to link.
        contact = { id: null, name: input.contactName };
    }

    return { organization, contact };
}

async function replaceLineItems(tx: TransactionClient, opportunityId: string, input: OpportunityInput, computed: ReturnType<typeof calculateLineItems>): Promise<void> {
    await tx.opportunityLineItem.deleteMany({ where: { opportunityId } });
    if (computed.items.length === 0) return;
    const knownProducts = await resolveProductIds(tx, input.lineItems);
    await tx.opportunityLineItem.createMany({
        data: computed.items.map((item, index) => ({ ...toLineItemData(item, index, knownProducts), opportunityId })),
    });
}

/**
 * Inserts an opportunity with its line items (totals computed server-side) inside the caller's
 * transaction. Used by `create` and by lead conversion; cache invalidation is the caller's job.
 */
export async function createOpportunityRecord(tx: TransactionClient, input: OpportunityInput, user: AuthUser): Promise<OpportunityDto> {
    // Code first: its counter row lock queues concurrent creates before they take any other lock.
    const opportunityCode = await generateEntityCode(tx, 'OPP');
    const links = await resolveLinks(tx, input);
    const computed = calculateLineItems(input.lineItems, input.lumpSumDiscount);

    const row = await tx.opportunity.create({
        data: { ...toOpportunityData(input, links, computed.totals), opportunityCode, createdBy: user.username },
    });
    await replaceLineItems(tx, row.id, input, computed);

    const dto = toOpportunityDto(await tx.opportunity.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id }, include }));
    await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Opportunity', entityId: row.id, action: 'CREATE', changedBy: user.username, changes: dto });
    return dto;
}

export const opportunityService = {
    async list(query: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<PaginatedResult<OpportunityDto>> {
        const page = parsePagination(query, OPPORTUNITY_SORT_FIELDS);
        const filters = opportunityListQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});

        const where: Prisma.OpportunityWhereInput = { isDeleted: false };
        const stageFilter: Prisma.StringFilter = {};
        if (filters.salesStage?.length) stageFilter.in = filters.salesStage;
        if (filters.excludeSalesStage?.length) stageFilter.notIn = filters.excludeSalesStage;
        if (Object.keys(stageFilter).length > 0) where.salesStage = stageFilter;
        if (filters.organizationId) where.organizationId = filters.organizationId;
        if (filters.contactId) where.contactId = filters.contactId;
        if (filters.productId) where.lineItems = { some: { productId: filters.productId } };
        if (filters.assignedTo) where.assignedTo = filters.assignedTo;
        if (filters.mine) where.assignedTo = user.username;
        if (filters.minGrandTotal !== undefined) where.grandTotal = { gte: filters.minGrandTotal };
        if (filters.nextFollowupDate) where.nextFollowupDate = fromDateOnly(filters.nextFollowupDate);
        if (filters.createdWithinDays) where.createdAt = { gte: daysAgo(filters.createdWithinDays) };
        if (page.search) {
            where.OR = [
                { opportunityCode: { contains: page.search } },
                { opportunityName: { contains: page.search } },
                { organizationName: { contains: page.search } },
                { contactName: { contains: page.search } },
                { contactNumber: { contains: page.search } },
                { salesStage: { contains: page.search } },
                { leadSource: { contains: page.search } },
            ];
        }

        const [total, rows] = await prisma.$transaction([
            prisma.opportunity.count({ where }),
            prisma.opportunity.findMany({ where, include, orderBy: [page.orderBy, { id: 'asc' }], skip: page.skip, take: page.take }),
        ]);
        return { data: rows.map(toOpportunityDto), total, page: page.page, limit: page.limit };
    },

    async getById(id: string): Promise<OpportunityDto> {
        const row = await prisma.opportunity.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
        if (!row) throw notFound();
        return toOpportunityDto(row);
    },

    async create(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<OpportunityDto> {
        const input = opportunityInputSchema.parse(body);
        const created = await runInTransaction((tx) => createOpportunityRecord(tx, input, user));
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('opportunities');
        return created;
    },

    async update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, user: AuthUser): Promise<OpportunityDto> {
        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'opportunity', [id]);
            const existing = await tx.opportunity.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
            if (!existing) throw notFound();

            const before = toOpportunityDto(existing);
            const merged: Record<string, unknown> = { ...before, ...patch };
            // Retyping a name without picking a record means "re-link by name", not "keep the old id".
            if ('organizationName' in patch && !('organizationId' in patch)) delete merged.organizationId;
            if ('contactName' in patch && !('contactId' in patch)) delete merged.contactId;
            const input = opportunityInputSchema.parse(merged);

            const links = await resolveLinks(tx, input, existing);
            const computed = calculateLineItems(input.lineItems, input.lumpSumDiscount);
            await tx.opportunity.update({
                where: { id },
                data: { ...toOpportunityData(input, links, computed.totals), updatedBy: user.username },
            });
            if ('lineItems' in patch) await replaceLineItems(tx, id, input, computed);

            const after = toOpportunityDto(await tx.opportunity.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include }));
            const changes = diffRecords(before, after);
            if (Object.keys(changes).length > 0) {
                await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Opportunity', entityId: id, action: 'UPDATE', changedBy: user.username, changes });
            }
            return after;
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('opportunities');
        return updated;
    },

    async remove(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
        await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'opportunity', [id]);
            const result = await tx.opportunity.updateMany({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
            if (result.count === 0) throw notFound();
            await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Opportunity', entityId: id, action: 'DELETE', changedBy: user.username });
        });
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('opportunities');
    },

    async bulkRemove(ids: string[], user: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult> {
        const result = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'opportunity', ids);
            const live = await tx.opportunity.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false }, select: { id: true } });
            const liveIds = live.map((row) => row.id);
            if (liveIds.length > 0) {
                await tx.opportunity.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: liveIds } }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
                await auditService.recordMany(
                    tx,
                    liveIds.map((entityId) => ({ entityType: 'Opportunity' as const, entityId, action: 'DELETE' as const, changedBy: user.username })),
                );
            }
            return { deleted: liveIds.length, ids: liveIds, notFound: ids.filter((id) => !liveIds.includes(id)) };
        });

        if (result.deleted > 0) await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('opportunities');
        return result;
    },
};

import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService, diffRecords } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import { recentViewsService } from '../../services/recentViews.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import type { PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { generateEntityCode } from '../../utils/codeGenerator.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { daysAgo, nullable, stringifyStringArray } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { parsePagination } from '../../utils/pagination.js';
import { emailsInclude, normalizeEmails, replaceEmails } from '../shared/entityEmails.js';
import { acquireLocks, lockRecords, runInTransaction, softDeleteData, type BulkDeleteResult } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import { toOrganizationDto, type OrganizationDto, type OrganizationRow } from './organization.mapper.js';
import {
    ORGANIZATION_SORT_FIELDS,
    bulkStatusSchema,
    organizationInputSchema,
    organizationListQuerySchema,
    type OrganizationWriteInput,
} from './organization.validator.js';

const RECENT_ENTITY = 'organizations';
const DEFAULT_COUNTRY = 'IN';
const MAX_HIERARCHY_DEPTH = 25;
const include = { corporateEmails: emailsInclude } as const;

const notFound = () => HttpError.notFound('Organization not found');

// ── Viewer flags ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function viewerFlags(user: AuthUser) {
    const recentIds = new Set(await recentViewsService.list(user.id, RECENT_ENTITY));
    return (row: OrganizationRow) => ({
        isMyAccount: (row.assignedUser ?? row.createdBy) === user.username,
        isRecentlyViewed: recentIds.has(row.id),
    });
}

// ── Integrity checks (run inside the write transaction) ──────────────────────

/** Name / GSTIN locks make "check, then write" race-free (names compare case-insensitively in SQL Server). */
async function assertUnique(tx: TransactionClient, input: OrganizationWriteInput, gstNo: string | null, excludeId?: string): Promise<void> {
    await acquireLocks(tx, [`organization:name:${input.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase()}`, gstNo && `organization:gst:${gstNo}`]);
    const notSelf = excludeId ? { NOT: { id: excludeId } } : {};
    const sameName = await tx.organization.findFirst({
        where: { organizationName: input.organizationName, isDeleted: false, ...notSelf },
        select: { accountCode: true },
    });
    if (sameName) {
        throw HttpError.conflict(`An organization named "${input.organizationName}" already exists (${sameName.accountCode}).`);
    }
    if (gstNo) {
        const sameGst = await tx.organization.findFirst({
            where: { gstNo, isDeleted: false, ...notSelf },
            select: { accountCode: true, organizationName: true },
        });
        if (sameGst) {
            throw HttpError.conflict(`GSTIN ${gstNo} is already registered to ${sameGst.organizationName} (${sameGst.accountCode}).`);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Links `memberOfParentCorp` (free text in the form) to the live organization with that exact name, if any.
 * Rejects links that would make an organization its own ancestor.
 */
async function resolveParentId(tx: TransactionClient, parentName: string | undefined, selfId?: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!parentName) return null;
    const parent = await tx.organization.findFirst({
        where: { organizationName: parentName, isDeleted: false, ...(selfId ? { NOT: { id: selfId } } : {}) },
        select: { id: true },
    });
    if (!parent || !selfId) return parent?.id ?? null;

    let cursor: string | null = parent.id;
    for (let depth = 0; cursor && depth < MAX_HIERARCHY_DEPTH; depth++) {
        if (cursor === selfId) {
            throw HttpError.badRequest('An organization cannot be a member of one of its own subsidiaries.', [
                { message: 'This parent would create a circular hierarchy.', path: ['memberOfParentCorp'] },
            ]);
        }
        const node: { parentOrganizationId: string | null } | null = await tx.organization.findUnique({
            where: { id: cursor },
            select: { parentOrganizationId: true },
        });
        cursor = node?.parentOrganizationId ?? null;
    }
    return parent.id;
}

// ── Input → columns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface Verification {
    verifiedAt: Date | null;
    verifiedBy: string | null;
}

/** Server-owned verification audit: stamped when switched on, cleared when switched off, kept otherwise. */
function resolveVerification(input: OrganizationWriteInput, actor: AuthUser, existing?: { accountVerified: boolean } & Verification): Verification {
    if (!input.accountVerified) return { verifiedAt: null, verifiedBy: null };
    if (existing?.accountVerified) return { verifiedAt: existing.verifiedAt, verifiedBy: existing.verifiedBy };
    return { verifiedAt: new Date(), verifiedBy: actor.username };
}

function toOrganizationData(
    input: OrganizationWriteInput,
    extras: { parentOrganizationId: string | null; verification: Verification; assignedUser: string | null },
): Omit<Prisma.OrganizationUncheckedCreateInput, 'accountCode' | 'createdBy'> {
    const billing = {
        address: nullable(input.billingAddress),
        city: nullable(input.billingCity),
        state: nullable(input.billingState),
        postalCode: nullable(input.billingPostalCode),
        country: input.billingCountry ?? DEFAULT_COUNTRY,
    };
    // "Copy address from billing" is enforced here rather than trusted from the client.
    const shipping = input.copyAddressFromBilling
        ? billing
        : {
              address: nullable(input.shippingAddress),
              city: nullable(input.shippingCity),
              state: nullable(input.shippingState),
              postalCode: nullable(input.shippingPostalCode),
              country: input.shippingCountry ?? DEFAULT_COUNTRY,
          };

    return {
        organizationName: input.organizationName,
        // Mailing / trade names follow the organization name until set explicitly (as in the form).
        mailingName: input.mailingName ?? input.organizationName,
        tradeName: input.tradeName ?? input.organizationName,
        natureOfBusiness: nullable(input.natureOfBusiness),
        accountStatus: input.accountStatus,
        inactivityReason: input.accountStatus === 'Active' ? null : nullable(input.inactivityReason),
        typeOfEntity: nullable(input.typeOfEntity),
        customerType: nullable(input.customerType),
        sapCodeTallyId: nullable(input.sapCodeTallyId),
        showroomBranchCode: nullable(input.showroomBranchCode),
        sourceOfLead: nullable(input.sourceOfLead),
        memberOfParentCorp: nullable(input.memberOfParentCorp),
        parentOrganizationId: extras.parentOrganizationId,
        numberOfEmployees: nullable(input.numberOfEmployees),
        annualTurnover: nullable(input.annualTurnover),
        description: nullable(input.description),
        accountVerified: input.accountVerified,
        verifiedAt: extras.verification.verifiedAt,
        verifiedBy: extras.verification.verifiedBy,
        activeAmc: input.activeAmc,
        activeCloud: input.activeCloud,
        provideSupport: input.provideSupport,
        assignedUser: extras.assignedUser,

        billingAddress: billing.address,
        billingStreet: billing.address,
        billingCity: billing.city,
        billingState: billing.state,
        billingPostalCode: billing.postalCode,
        billingCountry: billing.country,
        billingLatitude: nullable(input.billingLatitude),

        shippingAddress: shipping.address,
        shippingStreet: shipping.address,
        shippingCity: shipping.city,
        shippingState: shipping.state,
        shippingPostalCode: shipping.postalCode,
        shippingCountry: shipping.country,
        shippingLongitude: nullable(input.shippingLongitude),
        copyAddressFromBilling: input.copyAddressFromBilling,

        registrationType: input.registrationType,
        panNumber: input.panNumber ?? null,
        msmeRegnNumber: input.msmeRegnNumber ?? null,
        accountName: nullable(input.accountName),
        bankName: nullable(input.bankName),
        bankIfscCode: input.bankIfscCode ?? null,
        gstNo: gstFor(input),
        cinNo: input.cinNo ?? null,
        tanNumber: input.tanNumber ?? null,
        accountNumber: nullable(input.accountNumber),
        typeOfAccount: nullable(input.typeOfAccount),
        bankAddress: nullable(input.bankAddress),

        partnerCompaniesJson: stringifyStringArray(input.partnerCompanies),
    };
}

/** Unregistered organizations carry no GSTIN (the form clears it too). */
const gstFor = (input: OrganizationWriteInput): string | null => (input.registrationType === 'Registered' ? (input.gstNo ?? null) : null);

/**
 * Inserts an organization (code, uniqueness, parent link, emails, audit) inside the caller's transaction.
 * Used by `create` and by lead conversion; cache invalidation is the caller's job.
 */
export async function createOrganizationRecord(tx: TransactionClient, input: OrganizationWriteInput, user: AuthUser): Promise<OrganizationDto> {
    // Code first: its counter row lock queues concurrent creates before they take any other lock.
    const accountCode = await generateEntityCode(tx, 'ORG');
    await assertUnique(tx, input, gstFor(input));
    const row = await tx.organization.create({
        data: {
            ...toOrganizationData(input, {
                parentOrganizationId: await resolveParentId(tx, input.memberOfParentCorp),
                verification: resolveVerification(input, user),
                assignedUser: nullable(input.assignedUser) ?? user.username,
            }),
            accountCode,
            createdBy: user.username,
        },
    });
    await replaceEmails(tx, { organizationId: row.id }, normalizeEmails(input.corporateEmails));

    const saved = await tx.organization.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id }, include });
    const dto = toOrganizationDto(saved, { isMyAccount: saved.assignedUser === user.username, isRecentlyViewed: false });
    await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Organization', entityId: row.id, action: 'CREATE', changedBy: user.username, changes: dto });
    return dto;
}

/** Live organization by id, or else by exact (case-insensitive) name, for "find or create" flows. */
export async function findLiveOrganization(tx: TransactionClient, name: string, id?: string): Promise<OrganizationRow | null> {
    if (id) {
        const byId = await tx.organization.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
        if (byId) return byId;
    }
    return name ? tx.organization.findFirst({ where: { organizationName: name, isDeleted: false }, include }) : null;
}

/**
 * Merges a partial update onto the stored record. Paired legacy aliases follow whichever side the patch
 * changed, so a stale twin from the stored record can't override the new value.
 */
function mergePatch(before: OrganizationDto, patch: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    const merged: Record<string, unknown> = { ...before, ...patch };
    const aliasPairs: [canonical: string, alias: string][] = [
        ['gstNo', 'gstNumber'],
        ['billingAddress', 'billingStreet'],
        ['shippingAddress', 'shippingStreet'],
    ];
    for (const [canonical, alias] of aliasPairs) {
        if (alias in patch && !(canonical in patch)) merged[canonical] = patch[alias];
        if (canonical in patch && !(alias in patch)) merged[alias] = patch[canonical];
    }
    return merged;
}

// ── Service ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const organizationService = {
    async list(query: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<PaginatedResult<OrganizationDto>> {
        const normalizedQuery = { ...(query as Record<string, unknown>) };
        if (normalizedQuery.sortBy === 'gstNumber') normalizedQuery.sortBy = 'gstNo';
        const page = parsePagination(normalizedQuery, ORGANIZATION_SORT_FIELDS);
        const filters = organizationListQuerySchema.parse(normalizedQuery);

        const where: Prisma.OrganizationWhereInput = { isDeleted: false };
        if (filters.accountStatus) where.accountStatus = filters.accountStatus;
        if (filters.customerType?.length) where.customerType = { in: filters.customerType };
        if (filters.natureOfBusiness) where.natureOfBusiness = { contains: filters.natureOfBusiness };
        if (filters.assignedUser) where.assignedUser = filters.assignedUser;
        if (filters.parentOrganizationId) where.parentOrganizationId = filters.parentOrganizationId;
        if (filters.mine) where.assignedUser = user.username;
        if (filters.createdWithinDays) where.createdAt = { gte: daysAgo(filters.createdWithinDays) };
        if (filters.recent) where.id = { in: await recentViewsService.list(user.id, RECENT_ENTITY) };
        if (page.search) {
            where.OR = [
                { organizationName: { contains: page.search } },
                { accountCode: { contains: page.search } },
                { natureOfBusiness: { contains: page.search } },
                { customerType: { contains: page.search } },
                { billingCity: { contains: page.search } },
                { billingState: { contains: page.search } },
                { billingAddress: { contains: page.search } },
                { gstNo: { contains: page.search } },
            ];
        }

        const [total, rows, flagsFor] = await Promise.all([
            prisma.organization.count({ where }),
            prisma.organization.findMany({ where, include, orderBy: [page.orderBy, { id: 'asc' }], skip: page.skip, take: page.take }),
            viewerFlags(user),
        ]);
        return { data: rows.map((row) => toOrganizationDto(row, flagsFor(row))), total, page: page.page, limit: page.limit };
    },

    async getById(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<OrganizationDto> {
        const row = await prisma.organization.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
        if (!row) throw notFound();

        await recentViewsService.record(user.id, RECENT_ENTITY, id);
        const flagsFor = await viewerFlags(user);
        return toOrganizationDto(row, flagsFor(row));
    },

    async create(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<OrganizationDto> {
        const input = organizationInputSchema.parse(body);

        const created = await runInTransaction((tx) => createOrganizationRecord(tx, input, user));
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('organizations');
        return created;
    },

    async update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, user: AuthUser): Promise<OrganizationDto> {
        const flagsFor = await viewerFlags(user);

        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'organization', [id]);
            const existing = await tx.organization.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
            if (!existing) throw notFound();

            const before = toOrganizationDto(existing, flagsFor(existing));
            const input = organizationInputSchema.parse(mergePatch(before, patch));
            const gstNo = gstFor(input);
            if (input.organizationName !== existing.organizationName || gstNo !== existing.gstNo) {
                await assertUnique(tx, input, gstNo, id);
            }

            await tx.organization.update({
                where: { id },
                data: {
                    ...toOrganizationData(input, {
                        parentOrganizationId: await resolveParentId(tx, input.memberOfParentCorp, id),
                        verification: resolveVerification(input, user, existing),
                        assignedUser: nullable(input.assignedUser),
                    }),
                    updatedBy: user.username,
                },
            });
            // Emails are only replaced when the patch sends them.
            if ('corporateEmails' in patch) {
                await replaceEmails(tx, { organizationId: id }, normalizeEmails(input.corporateEmails));
            }

            const saved = await tx.organization.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include });
            const after = toOrganizationDto(saved, flagsFor(saved));
            const changes = diffRecords(before, after);
            if (Object.keys(changes).length > 0) {
                await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Organization', entityId: id, action: 'UPDATE', changedBy: user.username, changes });
            }
            return after;
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('organizations');
        return updated;
    },

    async remove(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
        await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'organization', [id]);
            const result = await tx.organization.updateMany({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
            if (result.count === 0) throw notFound();
            await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Organization', entityId: id, action: 'DELETE', changedBy: user.username });
        });
        await Promise.all([cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('organizations'), recentViewsService.forget(RECENT_ENTITY, user.id, [id])]);
    },

    async bulkRemove(ids: string[], user: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult> {
        const result = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'organization', ids);
            const live = await tx.organization.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false }, select: { id: true } });
            const liveIds = live.map((row) => row.id);
            if (liveIds.length > 0) {
                await tx.organization.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: liveIds } }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
                await auditService.recordMany(
                    tx,
                    liveIds.map((entityId) => ({ entityType: 'Organization' as const, entityId, action: 'DELETE' as const, changedBy: user.username })),
                );
            }
            return { deleted: liveIds.length, ids: liveIds, notFound: ids.filter((id) => !liveIds.includes(id)) };
        });

        if (result.deleted > 0) {
            await Promise.all([cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('organizations'), recentViewsService.forget(RECENT_ENTITY, user.id, result.ids)]);
        }
        return result;
    },

    /** PATCH /api/organizations/bulk-status — backs `organizationService.updateStatusBulk` in the frontend. */
    async updateStatusBulk(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<OrganizationDto[]> {
        const { ids, status, inactivityReason } = bulkStatusSchema.parse(body);
        const flagsFor = await viewerFlags(user);

        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'organization', ids);
            const targets = await tx.organization.findMany({
                where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false },
                select: { id: true, accountStatus: true },
            });
            if (targets.length === 0) throw notFound();

            await tx.organization.updateMany({
                where: { id: { in: targets.map((row) => row.id) } },
                data: {
                    accountStatus: status,
                    inactivityReason: status === 'Active' ? null : nullable(inactivityReason),
                    updatedBy: user.username,
                },
            });
            await auditService.recordMany(
                tx,
                targets
                    .filter((row) => row.accountStatus !== status)
                    .map((row) => ({
                        entityType: 'Organization' as const,
                        entityId: row.id,
                        action: 'STATUS_CHANGE' as const,
                        changedBy: user.username,
                        changes: { accountStatus: { from: row.accountStatus, to: status }, ...(inactivityReason ? { inactivityReason } : {}) },
                    })),
            );

            return tx.organization.findMany({ where: { id: { in: targets.map((row) => row.id) } }, include, orderBy: { organizationName: 'asc' } });
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('organizations');
        return updated.map((row) => toOrganizationDto(row, flagsFor(row)));
    },
};

import { z } from 'zod';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH as L } from '../../config/fieldLimits.js';
import {

    bulkIdsSchema,

    csvQuery,

export const ACCOUNT_STATUSES = ['Active', 'Inactive'] as const;
const MAX_PARTNER_COMPANIES = 100;

/** Older records store partner companies as objects; the form stores names. Both normalize to a name. */
const partnerCompanyEntry = z
    .union([z.string(), z.object({ partnerCompanyName: z.string() }).loose()])
    .transform((entry) => (typeof entry === 'string' ? entry : entry.partnerCompanyName).trim())
    .pipe(z.string().max(L.organizationName, { message: `Partner company names cannot exceed ${L.organizationName} characters.` }));

/** GST registration types outside the form's two options (legacy records, imports) and their bucket. */
const UNREGISTERED_TYPES = new Set(['unregistered', 'consumer']);

function normalizeRegistrationType(value: unknown): unknown {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim() || value === 'Registered' || value === 'Unregistered') return value;
    // e.g. 'Composition Scheme', 'SEZ' are GST-registered; 'Consumer' is not.
    return UNREGISTERED_TYPES.has(value.trim().toLowerCase()) ? 'Unregistered' : 'Registered';
}

/**
 * Accepts legacy aliases before validation: `gstNumber` → `gstNo`, `billingStreet` → `billingAddress`, and
 * legacy registration types → Registered / Unregistered.
 */
function normalizeAliases(value: unknown): unknown {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return value;
    const input = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
        ...input,
        gstNo: input.gstNo || input.gstNumber || undefined,
        billingAddress: input.billingAddress || input.billingStreet || undefined,
        shippingAddress: input.shippingAddress || input.shippingStreet || undefined,
        registrationType: normalizeRegistrationType(input.registrationType),
    };
}

/** Field rules shared by the organization form and lead conversion. */
const organizationFields = z.object({
    // Overview
    organizationName: requiredText('Organization Name', L.organizationName),
    mailingName: optionalText('Mailing Name', L.organizationName),
    tradeName: optionalText('Trade Name', L.organizationName),

    accountStatus: enumWithDefault('Account Status', ACCOUNT_STATUSES, 'Active'),
    inactivityReason: optionalText('Inactivity Reason', 500),
    typeOfEntity: requiredText('Type of Entity', L.option),
    customerType: requiredText('Customer Type', L.option),
    sapCodeTallyId: optionalText('SAP Code / Tally ID', L.shortCode),
    showroomBranchCode: optionalText('Showroom / Branch Code', L.shortCode),
    sourceOfLead: optionalText('Source of Lead', L.option),
    memberOfParentCorp: optionalText('Parent Corporation', L.organizationName),
    numberOfEmployees: optionalText('Number of Employees', 30),
    annualTurnover: optionalText('Annual Turnover', 30),
    description: optionalText('Description', L.organizationDescription),
    accountVerified: z.boolean().default(false),
    activeAmc: z.boolean().default(false),
    activeCloud: z.boolean().default(false),
    provideSupport: enumWithDefault('Provide Support', ['Yes', 'No'], 'Yes'),
    assignedUser: optionalText('Assigned User', L.username),
    corporateEmails: corporateEmailListSchema.optional(),

    // Billing address
    billingAddress: requiredText('Billing Address', L.address),
    billingStreet: optionalText('Billing Street', L.address),
    billingCity: requiredText('Billing City', L.shortText),
    billingState: requiredText('Billing State', L.shortText),
    billingPostalCode: optionalPostalCode,
    billingCountry: optionalText('Billing Country', L.shortText),
    billingLatitude: optionalText('Billing Latitude', 30),

    // Shipping address
    shippingAddress: optionalText('Shipping Address', L.address),
    shippingStreet: optionalText('Shipping Street', L.address),
    shippingCity: optionalText('Shipping City', L.shortText),
    shippingState: optionalText('Shipping State', L.shortText),
    shippingPostalCode: optionalPostalCode,
    shippingCountry: optionalText('Shipping Country', L.shortText),

    registrationType: enumWithDefault('Registration Type', ['Registered', 'Unregistered'], 'Registered'),
    panNumber: optionalPan,
    msmeRegnNumber: optionalUpperText('MSME Regn. Number', L.msme),
    accountName: optionalText('Account Name', L.organizationName),
    bankName: optionalText('Bank Name', L.personName),
    bankIfscCode: optionalIfsc,
    gstNo: optionalGst,
    cinNo: optionalUpperText('CIN No', L.cin),
    tanNumber: optionalUpperText('TAN Number', L.tan),
    accountNumber: optionalText('Account Number', L.bankAccount),
    typeOfAccount: optionalText('Type Of Account', 30),
    bankAddress: optionalText('Bank Address', L.address),

    // Partner licensing
    partnerCompanies: z
        .array(partnerCompanyEntry)
        .max(MAX_PARTNER_COMPANIES, { message: `At most ${MAX_PARTNER_COMPANIES} partner companies are allowed.` })
        .optional(),
});

interface PostalFields {
    billingPostalCode?: string;
    billingCountry?: string;
    shippingPostalCode?: string;
    shippingCountry?: string;
    copyAddressFromBilling: boolean;
}

function refinePostalCodes(org: PostalFields, ctx: z.RefinementCtx, billingRequired: boolean): void {
    refinePostalCodeForCountry(ctx, 'billingPostalCode', org.billingPostalCode, org.billingCountry, billingRequired);
    if (!org.copyAddressFromBilling) {
        refinePostalCodeForCountry(ctx, 'shippingPostalCode', org.shippingPostalCode, org.shippingCountry);
    }
}

/** `OrganizationFormData` rules from frontend-crm/src/validations/organization.schema.ts. */
export const organizationInputSchema = z.preprocess(
    normalizeAliases,
    organizationFields.superRefine((org, ctx) => {
        refinePostalCodes(org, ctx, true);
        if (org.registrationType === 'Registered' && !org.gstNo) {
            ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: ['gstNo'], message: 'GST Number is required for registered organizations.' });
        }
    }),
);

export const organizationConversionSchema = z.preprocess(
    normalizeAliases,
    organizationFields
        .extend({
            billingAddress: optionalText('Billing Address', L.address),
            billingCity: optionalText('Billing City', L.shortText),
            billingState: optionalText('Billing State', L.shortText),

        .superRefine((org, ctx) => refinePostalCodes(org, ctx, false)),
);

/**
 * Bulk import: the import template has no entity-type, address or GSTIN-requirement context, so those are
 * optional; everything that is present is still validated with the form's rules.
 */
export const organizationImportSchema = z.preprocess(
    normalizeAliases,
    organizationFields
        .extend({
            natureOfBusiness: optionalText('Nature of Business', L.option),
            typeOfEntity: optionalText('Type of Entity', L.option),
            customerType: optionalText('Customer Type', L.option),
            billingAddress: optionalText('Billing Address', L.address),
            billingCity: optionalText('Billing City', L.shortText),
            billingState: optionalText('Billing State', L.shortText),
        })
        .superRefine((org, ctx) => refinePostalCodes(org, ctx, false)),
);

export interface ProductDto {
    id: string;
    productCode: string;
    productName: string;
    hsnCode: string;
    category: string;
    type: string;
    manufacturer: string;
    taxType: string;
    taxRate: string;
    discount: string;

export function toProductDto(row: Product): ProductDto {
    return {
        id: row.id,
        productCode: row.productCode,
        productName: row.productName,
        hsnCode: text(row.hsnCode),
        category: text(row.category),
        type: text(row.type),
        manufacturer: text(row.manufacturer),
        taxType: text(row.taxType),
        taxRate: text(row.taxRate),
        discount: decimalToString(row.discount),
        cost: decimalToString(row.cost),
        mrp: decimalToString(row.mrp),
        msp: decimalToString(row.msp),
        contractCreate: row.contractCreate,
        description: text(row.description),
        termsAndConditions: text(row.termsAndConditions),
        isActive: row.isActive,
        createdAt: toIso(row.createdAt),
        updatedAt: toIso(row.updatedAt),
        createdBy: row.createdBy,
    };
}

/** Writable columns from validated input (codes and audit columns are set by the service). */
export function toProductData(input: ProductInput): Omit<Prisma.ProductUncheckedCreateInput, 'productCode' | 'createdBy'> {

        hsnCode: nullable(input.hsnCode),
        category: nullable(input.category),
        type: input.type ?? null,
        manufacturer: nullable(input.manufacturer),
        taxType: input.taxType,
        taxRate: input.taxRate ?? null,
        discount: input.discount ?? null,
        cost: input.cost ?? null,
        mrp: input.mrp ?? null,
        msp: input.msp ?? null,
        contractCreate: input.contractCreate,
        description: nullable(input.description),
        termsAndConditions: nullable(input.termsAndConditions),
        isActive: input.isActive,
    };
}

import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService, diffRecords } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import type { PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { generateEntityCode } from '../../utils/codeGenerator.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { daysAgo } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { parsePagination } from '../../utils/pagination.js';
import { acquireLocks, lockRecords, runInTransaction, softDeleteData, type BulkDeleteResult } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import { toProductData, toProductDto, type ProductDto } from './product.mapper.js';
import { PRODUCT_SORT_FIELDS, productInputSchema, productListQuerySchema, type ProductInput } from './product.validator.js';

const notFound = () => HttpError.notFound('Product not found');

/** Product names are unique among live products; the name lock makes "check, then write" race-free. */
async function assertUniqueName(tx: TransactionClient, productName: string, excludeId?: string): Promise<void> {
    await acquireLocks(tx, [`product:name:${productName.trim().toLowerCase()}`]);
    const duplicate = await tx.product.findFirst({
        where: { productName, isDeleted: false, ...(excludeId ? { NOT: { id: excludeId } } : {}) },
        select: { productCode: true },
    });
    if (duplicate) throw HttpError.conflict(`A product named "${productName}" already exists (${duplicate.productCode}).`);
}

/** Inserts a product inside the caller's transaction (used by `create`, import and the seed). */
export async function createProductRecord(tx: TransactionClient, input: ProductInput, actor: AuthUser): Promise<ProductDto> {
    // Code first: its counter row lock queues concurrent creates before they take any other lock.
    const productCode = await generateEntityCode(tx, 'PRD');
    await assertUniqueName(tx, input.productName);
    const row = await tx.product.create({ data: { ...toProductData(input), productCode, createdBy: actor.username } });
    const dto = toProductDto(row);
    await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Product', entityId: row.id, action: 'CREATE', changedBy: actor.username, changes: dto });
    return dto;
}

export const productService = {
    async list(query: unknown): Promise<PaginatedResult<ProductDto>> {
        const page = parsePagination(query, PRODUCT_SORT_FIELDS);
        const filters = productListQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});

        const where: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = { isDeleted: false };
        if (filters.category?.length) where.category = { in: filters.category };
        if (filters.type?.length) where.type = { in: filters.type };
        if (filters.isActive !== undefined) where.isActive = filters.isActive;
        if (filters.createdWithinDays) where.createdAt = { gte: daysAgo(filters.createdWithinDays) };
        if (page.search) {
            // SQL Server's default collation makes `contains` case-insensitive.
            where.OR = [
                { productName: { contains: page.search } },
                { productCode: { contains: page.search } },
                { category: { contains: page.search } },
                { manufacturer: { contains: page.search } },
                { hsnCode: { contains: page.search } },
            ];
        }

        const [total, rows] = await prisma.$transaction([
            prisma.product.count({ where }),
            prisma.product.findMany({ where, orderBy: [page.orderBy, { id: 'asc' }], skip: page.skip, take: page.take }),
        ]);
        return { data: rows.map(toProductDto), total, page: page.page, limit: page.limit };
    },

    async getById(id: string): Promise<ProductDto> {
        const row = await prisma.product.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false } });
        if (!row) throw notFound();
        return toProductDto(row);
    },

    async create(body: unknown, actor: AuthUser): Promise<ProductDto> {
        const input = productInputSchema.parse(body);

        const created = await runInTransaction((tx) => createProductRecord(tx, input, actor));
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('products');
        return created;
    },

    /** Partial update: the patch is merged onto the stored product and the result validated as a whole. */
    async update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, actor: AuthUser): Promise<ProductDto> {
        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'product', [id]);
            const existing = await tx.product.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false } });
            if (!existing) throw notFound();

            const before = toProductDto(existing);
            const input = productInputSchema.parse({ ...before, ...patch });
            if (input.productName !== existing.productName) await assertUniqueName(tx, input.productName, id);

            const row = await tx.product.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...toProductData(input), updatedBy: actor.username } });
            const after = toProductDto(row);
            const changes = diffRecords(before, after);
            if (Object.keys(changes).length > 0) {
                await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Product', entityId: id, action: 'UPDATE', changedBy: actor.username, changes });
            }
            return after;
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('products');
        return updated;
    },

    async remove(id: string, actor: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
        await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'product', [id]);
            const result = await tx.product.updateMany({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, data: softDeleteData(actor) });
            if (result.count === 0) throw notFound();
            await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Product', entityId: id, action: 'DELETE', changedBy: actor.username });
        });
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('products');
    },

    async bulkRemove(ids: string[], actor: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult> {
        const result = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'product', ids);
            const live = await tx.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false }, select: { id: true } });
            const liveIds = live.map((row) => row.id);
            if (liveIds.length > 0) {
                await tx.product.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: liveIds } }, data: softDeleteData(actor) });
                await auditService.recordMany(
                    tx,
                    liveIds.map((entityId) => ({ entityType: 'Product' as const, entityId, action: 'DELETE' as const, changedBy: actor.username })),
                );
            }
            return { deleted: liveIds.length, ids: liveIds, notFound: ids.filter((id) => !liveIds.includes(id)) };
        });

        if (result.deleted > 0) await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('products');
        return result;
    },
};

import { z } from 'zod';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH as L } from '../../config/fieldLimits.js';
import {
    booleanQuery,
    createdWithinDaysQuery,
    csvQuery,
    enumWithDefault,
    optionalAmountString,
    optionalEnum,
    optionalPercentString,
    optionalText,
    requiredText,
} from '../../validators/common.js';

// Option lists from frontend-crm/src/types/product.types.ts (category is open-ended there).
export const PRODUCT_TYPES = ['Product', 'Service', 'Bundle', 'Subscription', 'License', 'Other'] as const;
export const TAX_TYPES = ['GST', 'IGST', 'None'] as const;
export const TAX_RATES = ['0%', '5%', '12%', '18%', '28%'] as const;

/** `ProductFormData` (frontend-crm/src/validations/product.schema.ts) plus numeric checks on the price strings. */
export const productInputSchema = z
    .object({
        productName: requiredText('Product Name', L.organizationName).min(2, {
            message: 'Product Name must be at least 2 characters.',
        }),
        hsnCode: optionalText('HSN Code', L.hsn),
        category: optionalText('Category', L.option),
        type: optionalEnum('Type', PRODUCT_TYPES),
        manufacturer: optionalText('Manufacturer', L.personName),
        taxType: enumWithDefault('Tax Type', TAX_TYPES, 'GST'),
        taxRate: optionalEnum('Tax Rate', TAX_RATES),
        discount: optionalPercentString('Discount'),
        cost: optionalAmountString('Cost'),
        mrp: optionalAmountString('MRP'),
        msp: optionalAmountString('MSP'),
        contractCreate: enumWithDefault('Contract Create', ['Yes', 'No'], 'No'),
        description: optionalText('Description', L.longText),
        termsAndConditions: optionalText('Terms and Conditions', L.longText),
        isActive: z.boolean().default(true),
    })
    .superRefine((product, ctx) => {
        if (product.msp !== undefined && product.mrp !== undefined && Number(product.msp) > Number(product.mrp)) {
            ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: ['msp'], message: 'MSP (minimum selling price) cannot exceed MRP.' });
        }
    });

export type ProductInput = z.infer<typeof productInputSchema>;

/** List filters on top of page / limit / search / sort. */
export const productListQuerySchema = z.object({
    category: csvQuery,
    type: csvQuery,
    isActive: booleanQuery,
    createdWithinDays: createdWithinDaysQuery,
});

export const PRODUCT_SORT_FIELDS = [
    'createdAt',
    'updatedAt',
    'productName',
    'productCode',
    'category',
    'type',
    'manufacturer',
    'mrp',
    'cost',
] as const;

        grandTotal: decimalToNumber(row.grandTotal),

export interface QuotationLinks {
    opportunityId: string | null;
    organizationId: string | null;
    contactId: string | null;
}

export function toQuotationData(
    input: QuotationInput,
    links: QuotationLinks,
    totals: LineItemTotals,
): Omit<Prisma.QuotationUncheckedCreateInput, 'quotationCode' | 'createdBy'> {
    const billing = {
        address: input.billingAddress,
        city: input.billingCity,
        state: input.billingState,
        postalCode: input.billingPostalCode ?? '',
        country: input.billingCountry ?? DEFAULT_COUNTRY,
    };
    // "Copy address from billing" is enforced here rather than trusted from the client.
    const shipping = input.copyAddressFromBilling
        ? billing
        : {
              address: nullable(input.shippingAddress),
              city: nullable(input.shippingCity),
              state: nullable(input.shippingState),
              postalCode: nullable(input.shippingPostalCode),
              country: input.shippingCountry ?? billing.country,
          };

    return {
        quotationTitle: input.quotationTitle,
        quoteStage: input.quoteStage,
        quotationDate: fromDateOnly(input.quotationDate),
        validUntil: fromDateOnly(input.validUntil),
        remarks: nullable(input.remarks),
        termsAndCondition: input.termsAndCondition,
        termsAndConditionDescription: nullable(input.termsAndConditionDescription),
        assignedTo: input.assignedTo,
        opportunityName: input.opportunityName,
        company: input.company,
        validationPeriod: input.validationPeriod,
        otherRef: nullable(input.otherRef),
        paymentTerms: input.paymentTerms,
        paymentTermsDescription: nullable(input.paymentTermsDescription),
        preparedFor: input.preparedFor,
        currency: input.currency ?? DEFAULT_CURRENCY,
        groupName: nullable(input.groupName),
        lumpSumDiscount: input.lumpSumDiscount,
        ...totals,
        organizationName: nullable(input.organizationName),
        organizationId: links.organizationId,
        contactName: input.contactName,
        contactId: links.contactId,
        contactMobile: input.contactMobile ?? null,
        mailingName: nullable(input.mailingName),
        gstNo: input.gstNo ?? null,
        contactEmail: input.contactEmail ?? null,
        billingAddress: billing.address,
        billingCity: billing.city,
        billingState: billing.state,
        billingPostalCode: billing.postalCode,
        billingCountry: billing.country,
        shippingAddress: shipping.address,
        shippingCity: shipping.city,
        shippingState: shipping.state,
        shippingPostalCode: shipping.postalCode,
        shippingCountry: shipping.country,
        copyAddressFromBilling: input.copyAddressFromBilling,
        opportunityId: links.opportunityId,
        status: input.status ?? 'Draft',
        quotationSubject: nullable(input.quotationSubject),
        notes: nullable(input.notes),
        termsAndConditions: nullable(input.termsAndConditions),
    };
}

File: backend-crm/src/modules/quotations/quotation.service.ts
