import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService, diffRecords } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import type { PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { generateEntityCode } from '../../utils/codeGenerator.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { daysAgo } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { parsePagination } from '../../utils/pagination.js';
import { CLOSED_SALES_STAGES, QUOTE_SALES_STAGE } from '../opportunities/opportunity.validator.js';
import { assertTotalsMatch, calculateLineItems, lineItemsInclude, resolveProductIds, toLineItemData } from '../shared/lineItems.js';
import { assertReference } from '../shared/references.js';
import { lockRecords, runInTransaction, softDeleteData, type BulkDeleteResult } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import { toQuotationData, toQuotationDto, type QuotationDto, type QuotationLinks } from './quotation.mapper.js';
import {
    QUOTATION_ALIAS_PAIRS,
    QUOTATION_SORT_FIELDS,
    quotationInputSchema,
    quotationListQuerySchema,
    type QuotationInput,
} from './quotation.validator.js';

const include = { lineItems: lineItemsInclude, opportunity: { select: { opportunityCode: true } } } as const;

const notFound = () => HttpError.notFound('Quotation not found');

const asRecord = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> =>
    value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? (value as Record<string, unknown>) : {};

/**
 * Validates the opportunity / organization / contact references. A quotation is an issued document, so the
 * names typed on it are kept as a snapshot; only the ids are checked.
 */
async function resolveLinks(tx: TransactionClient, input: QuotationInput, previous?: QuotationLinks): Promise<QuotationLinks> {
    const links: QuotationLinks = { opportunityId: null, organizationId: null, contactId: null };
    if (input.opportunityId) {
        const opportunity = await tx.opportunity.findUnique({ where: { id: input.opportunityId }, select: { id: true, isDeleted: true } });
        assertReference(opportunity, input.opportunityId, previous?.opportunityId, 'opportunity', 'opportunityName');
        links.opportunityId = opportunity.id;
    }
    if (input.organizationId) {
        const organization = await tx.organization.findUnique({ where: { id: input.organizationId }, select: { id: true, isDeleted: true } });
        assertReference(organization, input.organizationId, previous?.organizationId, 'organization', 'organizationName');
        links.organizationId = organization.id;
    }
    if (input.contactId) {
        const contact = await tx.contact.findUnique({ where: { id: input.contactId }, select: { id: true, isDeleted: true } });
        assertReference(contact, input.contactId, previous?.contactId, 'contact', 'contactName');
        links.contactId = contact.id;
    }
    return links;
}

async function replaceLineItems(tx: TransactionClient, quotationId: string, input: QuotationInput, computed: ReturnType<typeof calculateLineItems>): Promise<void> {
    await tx.quotationLineItem.deleteMany({ where: { quotationId } });
    const knownProducts = await resolveProductIds(tx, input.lineItems);
    await tx.quotationLineItem.createMany({
        data: computed.items.map((item, index) => ({ ...toLineItemData(item, index, knownProducts), quotationId })),
    });
}

/** Port of `createQuotationFromOpportunity`: quoting moves an open opportunity to "Proposal/Price Quote". */
async function advanceOpportunityStage(tx: TransactionClient, opportunityId: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<boolean> {
    // Same lock as an opportunity edit, so a concurrent edit can't write back a stale stage.
    await lockRecords(tx, 'opportunity', [opportunityId]);
    const opportunity = await tx.opportunity.findUnique({ where: { id: opportunityId }, select: { salesStage: true, isDeleted: true } });
    if (!opportunity || opportunity.isDeleted) return false;
    const terminal: readonly string[] = [...CLOSED_SALES_STAGES, QUOTE_SALES_STAGE];
    if (terminal.includes(opportunity.salesStage)) return false;

    await tx.opportunity.update({ where: { id: opportunityId }, data: { salesStage: QUOTE_SALES_STAGE, updatedBy: user.username } });
    await auditService.record(tx, {
        entityType: 'Opportunity',
        entityId: opportunityId,
        action: 'UPDATE',
        changedBy: user.username,
        changes: { salesStage: { from: opportunity.salesStage, to: QUOTE_SALES_STAGE }, reason: 'Quotation created' },
    });
    return true;
}

/** Merges a partial update; alias pairs follow whichever side the patch changed. */
function mergePatch(before: QuotationDto, patch: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    const merged: Record<string, unknown> = { ...before, ...patch };
    for (const [canonical, alias] of QUOTATION_ALIAS_PAIRS) {
        if (alias in patch && !(canonical in patch)) merged[canonical] = patch[alias];
        if (canonical in patch && !(alias in patch)) merged[alias] = patch[canonical];
    }
    return merged;
}

/**
 * Inserts a quotation (totals computed server-side) inside the caller's transaction and advances
 * the linked opportunity's stage. `create` verifies client totals first; the seed uses this directly.
 * Returns the DTO and whether the opportunity stage changed (for cache invalidation).
 */
export async function createQuotationRecord(
    tx: TransactionClient,
    input: QuotationInput,
    user: AuthUser,
): Promise<{ quotation: QuotationDto; opportunityAdvanced: boolean }> {
    // Code first: its counter row lock queues concurrent creates before they take any other lock.
    const quotationCode = await generateEntityCode(tx, 'QT');
    const computed = calculateLineItems(input.lineItems, input.lumpSumDiscount);
    const links = await resolveLinks(tx, input);
    const row = await tx.quotation.create({
        data: { ...toQuotationData(input, links, computed.totals), quotationCode, createdBy: user.username },
    });
    await replaceLineItems(tx, row.id, input, computed);
    const opportunityAdvanced = links.opportunityId ? await advanceOpportunityStage(tx, links.opportunityId, user) : false;

    const quotation = toQuotationDto(await tx.quotation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id }, include }));
    await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Quotation', entityId: row.id, action: 'CREATE', changedBy: user.username, changes: quotation });
    return { quotation, opportunityAdvanced };
}

export const quotationService = {
    async list(query: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<PaginatedResult<QuotationDto>> {
        const page = parsePagination(query, QUOTATION_SORT_FIELDS);
        const filters = quotationListQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});

        const where: Prisma.QuotationWhereInput = { isDeleted: false };
        if (filters.status?.length) where.status = { in: filters.status };
        if (filters.quoteStage?.length) where.quoteStage = { in: filters.quoteStage };
        if (filters.opportunityId) where.opportunityId = filters.opportunityId;
        if (filters.organizationId) where.organizationId = filters.organizationId;
        if (filters.contactId) where.contactId = filters.contactId;
        if (filters.productId) where.lineItems = { some: { productId: filters.productId } };
        if (filters.assignedTo) where.assignedTo = filters.assignedTo;
        if (filters.mine) where.assignedTo = user.username;
        if (filters.createdWithinDays) where.createdAt = { gte: daysAgo(filters.createdWithinDays) };
        if (page.search) {
            where.OR = [
                { quotationCode: { contains: page.search } },
                { quotationTitle: { contains: page.search } },
                { organizationName: { contains: page.search } },
                { contactName: { contains: page.search } },
                { opportunityName: { contains: page.search } },
            ];
        }

        const [total, rows] = await prisma.$transaction([
            prisma.quotation.count({ where }),
            prisma.quotation.findMany({ where, include, orderBy: [page.orderBy, { id: 'asc' }], skip: page.skip, take: page.take }),
        ]);
        return { data: rows.map(toQuotationDto), total, page: page.page, limit: page.limit };
    },

    async getById(id: string): Promise<QuotationDto> {
        const row = await prisma.quotation.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
        if (!row) throw notFound();
        return toQuotationDto(row);
    },

    async create(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<QuotationDto> {
        const input = quotationInputSchema.parse(body);
        assertTotalsMatch(asRecord(body), calculateLineItems(input.lineItems, input.lumpSumDiscount).totals);

        const { quotation, opportunityAdvanced } = await runInTransaction((tx) => createQuotationRecord(tx, input, user));
        await Promise.all([
            cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('quotations'),
            ...(opportunityAdvanced ? [cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('opportunities')] : []),
        ]);
        return quotation;
    },

    /** Partial update; totals sent in the patch must match the (possibly new) line items. */
    async update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, user: AuthUser): Promise<QuotationDto> {
        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'quotation', [id]);
            const existing = await tx.quotation.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, include });
            if (!existing) throw notFound();

            const before = toQuotationDto(existing);
            const input = quotationInputSchema.parse(mergePatch(before, patch));
            const computed = calculateLineItems(input.lineItems, input.lumpSumDiscount);
            assertTotalsMatch(patch, computed.totals);

            const links = await resolveLinks(tx, input, existing);
            await tx.quotation.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...toQuotationData(input, links, computed.totals), updatedBy: user.username } });
            if ('lineItems' in patch) await replaceLineItems(tx, id, input, computed);

            const after = toQuotationDto(await tx.quotation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include }));
            const changes = diffRecords(before, after);
            if (Object.keys(changes).length > 0) {
                await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Quotation', entityId: id, action: 'UPDATE', changedBy: user.username, changes });
            }
            return after;
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('quotations');
        return updated;
    },

    async remove(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
        await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'quotation', [id]);
            const result = await tx.quotation.updateMany({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
            if (result.count === 0) throw notFound();
            await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Quotation', entityId: id, action: 'DELETE', changedBy: user.username });
        });
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('quotations');
    },

    async bulkRemove(ids: string[], user: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult> {
        const result = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'quotation', ids);
            const live = await tx.quotation.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false }, select: { id: true } });
            const liveIds = live.map((row) => row.id);
            if (liveIds.length > 0) {
                await tx.quotation.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: liveIds } }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
                await auditService.recordMany(
                    tx,
                    liveIds.map((entityId) => ({ entityType: 'Quotation' as const, entityId, action: 'DELETE' as const, changedBy: user.username })),
                );
            }
            return { deleted: liveIds.length, ids: liveIds, notFound: ids.filter((id) => !liveIds.includes(id)) };
        });

        if (result.deleted > 0) await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('quotations');
        return result;
    },
};

/** QUOTE_STAGES / QUOTATION_STATUSES from frontend-crm/src/types/quotation.types.ts. */
export const QUOTE_STAGES = ['Draft', 'Negotiation', 'Delivered', 'On Hold', 'Confirmed', 'Closed Accepted', 'Closed Lost', 'Closed Dead'] as const;
/** `status` accepts QuotationStatus or a QuoteStage (frontend type `QuotationStatus | QuoteStage`). */
const STATUS_VALUES = ['Draft', 'Sent', 'Accepted', 'Rejected', 'Negotiation', 'Delivered', 'On Hold', 'Confirmed', 'Closed Accepted', 'Closed Lost', 'Closed Dead'] as const;

/** Legacy aliases on `QuotationFormData`; the first key of each pair is stored. */
export const QUOTATION_ALIAS_PAIRS: [canonical: string, alias: string][] = [
    ['quotationDate', 'quoteDate'],
    ['contactMobile', 'contactNumber'],
    ['contactEmail', 'emailAddress'],
];

function normalizeAliases(value: unknown): unknown {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return value;
    const input = { ...(value as Record<string, unknown>) };
    for (const [canonical, alias] of QUOTATION_ALIAS_PAIRS) {
        input[canonical] = input[canonical] || input[alias] || undefined;
    }
    return input;
}

File: backend-crm/src/modules/search/search.service.ts
================
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { prisma } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import { CACHE_KEYS, cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';

/** Shapes from frontend-crm/src/services/globalSearch.service.ts. */
export type GlobalSearchCategory = 'organizations' | 'contacts' | 'leads' | 'opportunities';

export interface GlobalSearchResult {
    id: string;
    category: GlobalSearchCategory;
    title: string;
    subtitle: string;
    meta?: string;
    href: string;
}

export type GlobalSearchResults = Record<GlobalSearchCategory, GlobalSearchResult[]>;

export const searchQuerySchema = z.object({
    q: z.string().trim().max(100, { message: 'Search text cannot exceed 100 characters.' }).default(''),
    limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(20).catch(5).default(5),
});

const SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 30;

const joinParts = (...parts: (string | null | undefined)[]) => parts.filter(Boolean).join(' • ');

const empty = (): GlobalSearchResults => ({ organizations: [], contacts: [], leads: [], opportunities: [] });

async function runSearch(q: string, limit: number): Promise<GlobalSearchResults> {
    // Phone numbers match with or without spaces, as in the frontend's normalize().
    const compact = q.replace(/\s+/g, '');
    const recent = { updatedAt: 'desc' } as const;

    const [organizations, contacts, leads, opportunities] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.organization.findMany({
            where: {
                isDeleted: false,
                OR: [
                    { organizationName: { contains: q } },
                    { tradeName: { contains: q } },
                    { sapCodeTallyId: { contains: q } },
                    { billingCity: { contains: q } },
                    { accountCode: { contains: q } },
                ],
            },
            select: { id: true, organizationName: true, tradeName: true, billingCity: true },
            orderBy: recent,
            take: limit,
        }),
        prisma.contact.findMany({
            where: {
                isDeleted: false,
                OR: [
                    { name: { contains: q } },
                    { mobile: { contains: compact } },
                    { officePhone: { contains: compact } },
                    { emailAddresses: { some: { email: { contains: q } } } },
                ],
            },
            select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
                organizationName: true,
                emailAddresses: { select: { email: true, isPrimary: true }, orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' } },
            },
            orderBy: recent,
            take: limit,
        }),
        prisma.lead.findMany({
            where: {
                isDeleted: false,
                OR: [
                    { name: { contains: q } },
                    { organizationName: { contains: q } },
                    { leadCode: { contains: q } },
                    { mobile: { contains: compact } },
                ],
            },
            select: { id: true, name: true, organizationName: true, leadCode: true },
            orderBy: recent,
            take: limit,
        }),
        prisma.opportunity.findMany({
            where: {
                isDeleted: false,
                OR: [{ opportunityName: { contains: q } }, { opportunityCode: { contains: q } }, { organizationName: { contains: q } }],
            },
            select: { id: true, opportunityCode: true, opportunityName: true, organizationName: true, salesStage: true },
            orderBy: recent,
            take: limit,
        }),
    ]);

    return {
        organizations: organizations.map((o) => ({
            id: o.id,
            category: 'organizations',
            title: o.organizationName,
            subtitle: joinParts(o.tradeName && o.tradeName !== o.organizationName ? o.tradeName : '', o.billingCity),
            href: `/organizations/${o.id}`,
        })),
        contacts: contacts.map((c) => {
            const email = c.emailAddresses.find((e) => e.isPrimary)?.email ?? c.emailAddresses[0]?.email;
            return { id: c.id, category: 'contacts', title: c.name, subtitle: joinParts(email, c.organizationName), href: `/contacts/${c.id}` };
        }),
        leads: leads.map((l) => ({
            id: l.id,
            category: 'leads',
            title: l.name,
            subtitle: joinParts(l.organizationName, l.leadCode),
            href: `/leads/${l.id}`,
        })),
        opportunities: opportunities.map((o) => ({
            id: o.id,
            category: 'opportunities',
            title: o.opportunityCode,
            subtitle: joinParts(o.opportunityName, o.organizationName),
            meta: o.salesStage,
            href: `/opportunities/${o.id}`,
        })),
    };
}

export const searchService = {
    /** Up to `limit` matches per category, cached briefly; a blank query returns nothing. */
    async search(query: unknown): Promise<GlobalSearchResults> {
        const { q, limit } = searchQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
        if (!q) return empty();
        // Hashed so arbitrary user text never becomes part of a Redis key (or a SCAN pattern).
        const digest = createHash('sha256').update(q.toLowerCase()).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);
        return cacheService.getOrSet(CACHE_KEYS.search(`${limit}:${digest}`), SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS, () => runSearch(q, limit));
    },
};

File: backend-crm/src/modules/shared/crud.ts

import type { Request, Response, Router } from 'express';
import { validateRequest } from '../../middlewares/validateRequest.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import { sendCreated, sendPaginated, sendSuccess, type PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { requireUser } from '../../utils/requestContext.js';
import { bulkIdsSchema, idParamSchema, patchBodySchema } from '../../validators/common.js';
import type { BulkDeleteResult } from './transactions.js';

/** What every entity service exposes; the frontend's `createCrudService` relies on exactly these endpoints. */
export interface CrudService<TDto> {
    list(query: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<PaginatedResult<TDto>>;
    getById(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<TDto>;
    create(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<TDto>;
    /** `PUT` carries a partial record (frontend `UpdateDto = Partial<…>`), merged onto the stored one. */
    update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, user: AuthUser): Promise<TDto>;
    remove(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void>;
    bulkRemove(ids: string[], user: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult>;
}

export interface EntityLabels {
    /** e.g. "Product" */
    singular: string;
    /** e.g. "products" */
    plural: string;
}

export function createCrudController<TDto>(service: CrudService<TDto>, labels: EntityLabels) {
    return {
        async list(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
            sendPaginated(res, await service.list(req.query, requireUser(req)));
        },
        async getById(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
            sendSuccess(res, await service.getById(String(req.params.id), requireUser(req)));
        },
        async create(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
            sendCreated(res, await service.create(req.body, requireUser(req)), `${labels.singular} created successfully`);
        },
        async update(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
            const updated = await service.update(String(req.params.id), req.body as Record<string, unknown>, requireUser(req));
            sendSuccess(res, updated, `${labels.singular} updated successfully`);
        },
        async remove(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
            const id = String(req.params.id);
            await service.remove(id, requireUser(req));
            sendSuccess(res, { id }, `${labels.singular} deleted successfully`);
        },
        async bulkRemove(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
            const { ids } = req.body as { ids: string[] };
            const result = await service.bulkRemove(ids, requireUser(req));
            sendSuccess(res, result, `${result.deleted} ${result.deleted === 1 ? labels.singular.toLowerCase() : labels.plural} deleted`);
        },
    };
}

export type CrudController = ReturnType<typeof createCrudController>;

/**
 * Registers the standard CRUD endpoints. Call it after any custom routes (e.g. `PATCH /bulk-status`) so
 * those paths aren't captured by `/:id`.
 */
export function registerCrudRoutes(router: Router, controller: CrudController): Router {
    const withId = validateRequest({ params: idParamSchema });
    const withPatch = validateRequest({ params: idParamSchema, body: patchBodySchema });

    router.get('/', controller.list);
    router.post('/', controller.create);
    router.post('/bulk-delete', validateRequest({ body: bulkIdsSchema }), controller.bulkRemove);
    router.get('/:id', withId, controller.getById);
    router.put('/:id', withPatch, controller.update);
    router.patch('/:id', withPatch, controller.update);
    router.delete('/:id', withId, controller.remove);
    return router;
}

import { z } from 'zod';
import type { TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { EntityEmail } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { optionalEmail } from '../../validators/common.js';

/** `CorporateEmail` from frontend-crm/src/types/organization.types.ts. */
export interface CorporateEmailDto {
    id: string;
    email: string;
    isPrimary: boolean;
    isOptedOut: boolean;
    isInvalidBounce: boolean;
}

const MAX_EMAILS_PER_RECORD = 20;

/** One row of an email list as the forms send it (ids are client-generated and ignored). */
export const corporateEmailInputSchema = z.object({
    id: z.string().optional(),
    email: optionalEmail,
    isPrimary: z.boolean().default(false),
    isOptedOut: z.boolean().default(false),
    isInvalidBounce: z.boolean().default(false),
});

export const corporateEmailListSchema = z
    .array(corporateEmailInputSchema)
    .max(MAX_EMAILS_PER_RECORD, { message: `At most ${MAX_EMAILS_PER_RECORD} email addresses are allowed.` });

export type CorporateEmailInput = z.infer<typeof corporateEmailInputSchema>;

export interface NormalizedEmail {
    email: string;
    isPrimary: boolean;
    isOptedOut: boolean;
    isInvalidBounce: boolean;
}

/**
 * Drops blank rows, de-duplicates addresses (case-insensitively) and guarantees exactly one primary
 * whenever at least one address remains, mirroring the frontend's RhfEmailList behaviour.
 */
export function normalizeEmails(rows: readonly CorporateEmailInput[] | undefined): NormalizedEmail[] {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const result: NormalizedEmail[] = [];
    for (const row of rows ?? []) {
        const email = row.email?.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!email || seen.has(email)) continue;
        seen.add(email);
        result.push({ email, isPrimary: row.isPrimary, isOptedOut: row.isOptedOut, isInvalidBounce: row.isInvalidBounce });
    }
    const primaryIndex = Math.max(result.findIndex((row) => row.isPrimary), 0);
    return result.map((row, index) => ({ ...row, isPrimary: result.length > 0 && index === primaryIndex }));
}

export function toEmailDtos(rows: readonly EntityEmail[] | undefined): CorporateEmailDto[] {
    return [...(rows ?? [])]
        .sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder)
        .map((row) => ({
            id: row.id,
            email: row.email,
            isPrimary: row.isPrimary,
            isOptedOut: row.isOptedOut,
            isInvalidBounce: row.isInvalidBounce,
        }));
}

export type EmailOwner = { organizationId: string } | { contactId: string } | { leadId: string };

/** Replaces an owner's email list (delete + insert) inside the caller's transaction. */
export async function replaceEmails(tx: TransactionClient, owner: EmailOwner, emails: readonly NormalizedEmail[]): Promise<void> {
    await tx.entityEmail.deleteMany({ where: owner });
    if (emails.length === 0) return;
    await tx.entityEmail.createMany({
        data: emails.map((row, index) => ({ ...row, ...owner, sortOrder: index })),
    });
}

/** Prisma `include` / `orderBy` fragment for loading a record's emails in display order. */
export const emailsInclude = { orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' } } as const;

File: backend-crm/src/modules/shared/lineItems.ts

import { z } from 'zod';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH as L } from '../../config/fieldLimits.js';
import type { TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { OpportunityLineItem, QuotationLineItem } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { decimalToNumber } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { optionalText, requiredText } from '../../validators/common.js';

/**
 * Line items shared by opportunities and quotations. Totals are always computed here, with the exact
 * algorithm of the frontend's CrmLineItemsSection (same language, same float operations, same rounding),
 * so client and server agree to the rupee.
 */

const MAX_LINE_ITEMS = 200;
const MAX_AMOUNT = 1e13;

const number = (field: string, max = MAX_AMOUNT) =>
    z.coerce
        .number({ error: `${field} must be a number.` })
        .refine(Number.isFinite, { message: `${field} must be a number.` })
        .refine((value) => value >= 0, { message: `${field} cannot be negative.` })
        .refine((value) => value <= max, { message: `${field} is too large.` });

export const lineItemInputSchema = z
    .object({
        id: z.string().optional(),
        productId: optionalText('Product', 50),
        productName: requiredText('Product Name', L.organizationName),
        quantity: number('Quantity', 1e6).refine((value) => value >= 1, { message: 'Quantity must be at least 1.' }),
        amount: number('Amount'),
        discount: number('Discount').default(0),
        discountType: z.enum(['percentage', 'direct'], { error: 'Discount type must be percentage or direct.' }).default('percentage'),
        taxRate: z.string().trim().max(20).default('GST 18%'),
        description: optionalText('Line item description', L.longText),
        note: optionalText('Line item note', L.longText),
        // salePrice / taxAmount / total are derived; client values are ignored.
    })
    .superRefine((item, ctx) => {
        if (item.discountType === 'percentage' && item.discount > 100) {
            ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: ['discount'], message: 'Percentage discount cannot exceed 100.' });
        }
    });

export const lineItemListSchema = z
    .array(lineItemInputSchema)
    .max(MAX_LINE_ITEMS, { message: `At most ${MAX_LINE_ITEMS} line items are allowed.` });

export type LineItemInput = z.infer<typeof lineItemInputSchema>;

/** Port of `parseTaxRate` (frontend): '18%', 'GST 18%' → 18; '--None--', 'GST 0%', '' → 0. */
export function parseTaxRate(taxRate: string): number {
    if (!taxRate || taxRate === '--None--' || taxRate === 'GST 0%') return 0;
    const match = taxRate.match(/(\d+)%/);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
}

export interface ComputedLineItem extends LineItemInput {
    salePrice: number;
    taxAmount: number;
    total: number;
}

export interface LineItemTotals {
    totalAmount: number;
    totalDiscount: number;
    subtotal: number;
    totalTax: number;
    grandTotal: number;
}

/** Recomputes per-line and document totals exactly as `CrmLineItemsEditor` does. */
export function calculateLineItems(items: readonly LineItemInput[], lumpSumDiscount: number): { items: ComputedLineItem[]; totals: LineItemTotals } {
    let grossAmount = 0;
    let grossDiscount = 0;
    let grossSubtotal = 0;
    let grossTax = 0;

    const computed = items.map((item) => {
        const qty = item.quantity || 1;
        const baseAmount = item.amount * qty;
        grossAmount += baseAmount;

        const discount = item.discountType === 'percentage' ? (baseAmount * (item.discount || 0)) / 100 : (item.discount || 0) * qty;
        grossDiscount += discount;

        const lineSubtotal = Math.max(0, baseAmount - discount);
        grossSubtotal += lineSubtotal;

        const taxPercent = parseTaxRate(item.taxRate);
        grossTax += (lineSubtotal * taxPercent) / 100;

        // Per-line display values (handleUpdateLineItem in the editor).
        const discountPerUnit = item.discountType === 'percentage' ? (item.amount * (item.discount || 0)) / 100 : item.discount || 0;
        const salePrice = Math.max(0, item.amount - discountPerUnit);
        const lineNet = salePrice * qty;
        const lineTax = (lineNet * taxPercent) / 100;
        return { ...item, salePrice: Math.round(salePrice), taxAmount: Math.round(lineTax), total: Math.round(lineNet + lineTax) };
    });

    return {
        items: computed,
        totals: {
            totalAmount: Math.round(grossAmount),
            totalDiscount: Math.round(grossDiscount),
            subtotal: Math.round(grossSubtotal),
            totalTax: Math.round(grossTax),
            grandTotal: Math.round(Math.max(0, grossSubtotal + grossTax - (lumpSumDiscount || 0))),
        },
    };
}

const TOTAL_FIELDS = ['totalAmount', 'totalDiscount', 'subtotal', 'totalTax', 'grandTotal'] as const;

/**
 * Rejects a request whose explicitly sent totals disagree with the line items (a stale or tampered quote).
 * Only fields present in the request are compared; the stored values are always the computed ones.
 */
export function assertTotalsMatch(sent: Record<string, unknown>, computed: LineItemTotals): void {
    const mismatches = TOTAL_FIELDS.filter((field) => field in sent && sent[field] !== null && sent[field] !== undefined)
        .filter((field) => Math.round(Number(sent[field])) !== computed[field])
        .map((field) => ({ message: `${field} should be ${computed[field]} for these line items.`, path: [field] }));
    if (mismatches.length > 0) {
        throw HttpError.badRequest('Totals do not match the line items. Refresh the totals and try again.', mismatches);
    }
}

/** Keeps a line's productId only when that product exists (deleted products stay linked for history). */
export async function resolveProductIds(tx: TransactionClient, items: readonly LineItemInput[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
    const ids = [...new Set(items.map((item) => item.productId).filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)))];
    if (ids.length === 0) return new Set();
    const found = await tx.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids } }, select: { id: true } });
    return new Set(found.map((row) => row.id));
}

/** Column values for a line item row (parent FK added by the caller). */
export function toLineItemData(item: ComputedLineItem, index: number, knownProductIds: Set<string>) {
    return {
        productId: item.productId && knownProductIds.has(item.productId) ? item.productId : null,
        productName: item.productName,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        amount: item.amount,
        discount: item.discount,
        discountType: item.discountType,
        salePrice: item.salePrice,
        taxRate: item.taxRate,
        taxAmount: item.taxAmount,
        total: item.total,
        description: item.description ?? null,
        note: item.note ?? null,
        sortOrder: index,
    };
}

/** `OpportunityLineItem` / `QuotationLineItem` DTO (frontend types). */
export interface LineItemDto {
    id: string;
    productId: string;
    productName: string;
    quantity: number;
    amount: number;
    discount: number;
    discountType: 'percentage' | 'direct';
    salePrice: number;
    taxRate: string;
    taxAmount: number;
    total: number;
    description: string;
    note: string;
}

export function toLineItemDtos(rows: readonly (OpportunityLineItem | QuotationLineItem)[] | undefined): LineItemDto[] {
    return [...(rows ?? [])]
        .sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder)
        .map((row) => ({
            id: row.id,
            productId: row.productId ?? '',
            productName: row.productName,
            quantity: decimalToNumber(row.quantity),
            amount: decimalToNumber(row.amount),
            discount: decimalToNumber(row.discount),
            discountType: row.discountType === 'direct' ? 'direct' : 'percentage',
            salePrice: decimalToNumber(row.salePrice),
            taxRate: row.taxRate,
            taxAmount: decimalToNumber(row.taxAmount),
            total: decimalToNumber(row.total),
            description: row.description ?? '',
            note: row.note ?? '',
        }));
}

import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';

/**
 * Validates an explicit reference (organizationId, contactId, opportunityId, …). The record must exist; a
 * soft-deleted one is accepted only when the reference is unchanged, so editing an old record never fails
 * because something it points to was archived, but nothing new can be linked to a deleted record.
 */
export function assertReference<T extends { isDeleted: boolean }>(
    found: T | null,
    requestedId: string,
    previousId: string | null | undefined,
    label: string,
    path: string,
): asserts found is T {
    if (!found) {
        throw HttpError.badRequest(`The selected ${label} does not exist.`, [{ message: `Select an existing ${label}.`, path: [path] }]);
    }
    if (found.isDeleted && requestedId !== previousId) {
        throw HttpError.badRequest(`The selected ${label} has been deleted.`, [{ message: `Select an active ${label}.`, path: [path] }]);
    }
}

================
File: backend-crm/src/modules/shared/transactions.ts
================
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';
import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';
import { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { isTransactionUnavailableError, isWriteConflictError } from '../../utils/prismaErrors.js';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;
const RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS = 50;
const LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
/** sp_getapplock's @Resource is nvarchar(255). */
const MAX_LOCK_RESOURCE_LENGTH = 255;

/** An application lock was chosen as a deadlock victim; the whole transaction is safe to retry. */
class LockDeadlockError extends HttpError {
    constructor() {
        super('This record was changed by another request at the same time. Please try again.', StatusCodes.CONFLICT, {
            code: 'WRITE_CONFLICT',
        });
    }
}

const isRetryable = (err: unknown) =>
    err instanceof LockDeadlockError || isWriteConflictError(err) || isTransactionUnavailableError(err);

async function runWithRetry<T>(
    fn: (tx: TransactionClient) => Promise<T>,
    isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel,
): Promise<T> {
    for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
        try {
            return await prisma.$transaction(fn, { isolationLevel, maxWait: 5_000, timeout: 15_000 });
        } catch (err) {
            if (!isRetryable(err) || attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) throw err;
            logger.warn({ attempt, isolationLevel }, 'Transaction conflict; retrying');
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS * attempt + Math.random() * RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS));
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Runs `fn` in a READ COMMITTED transaction: the default for writes. Rules that READ COMMITTED alone can't make
 * race-free ("check for a duplicate, then insert", read-modify-write updates) take application locks with
 * `acquireLocks` / `lockRecords`, which serialize only the requests that touch the same value or record.
 * Creates also serialize per entity on their `SequenceCounter` row (`generateEntityCode`), so they call it first.
 * Deadlock victims and transactions that couldn't start in time are retried with jittered backoff.
 */
export function runInTransaction<T>(fn: (tx: TransactionClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return runWithRetry(fn, Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.ReadCommitted);
}

/**
 * Runs `fn` in a SERIALIZABLE transaction, for multi-record workflows (lead conversion) that must see a stable
 * snapshot of everything they read. Retried like `runInTransaction`.
 */
export function runSerializable<T>(fn: (tx: TransactionClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return runWithRetry(fn, Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable);
}

/**
 * Takes exclusive transaction-scoped application locks (`sp_getapplock`), released on commit / rollback, in one
 * round trip. Keys are compared byte-for-byte, so callers normalize values (e.g. lowercase names). Blank keys are
 * skipped; the rest are acquired in sorted order so two callers locking overlapping sets can't deadlock.
 */
export async function acquireLocks(tx: TransactionClient, keys: (string | null | undefined)[]): Promise<void> {
    const resources = [...new Set(keys.filter((key): key is string => Boolean(key)).map((key) => `crm:${key}`.slice(0, MAX_LOCK_RESOURCE_LENGTH)))].sort();
    if (resources.length === 0) return;

    const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<{ result: number }[]>`
        DECLARE @resource NVARCHAR(255), @result INT = 0;
        DECLARE lock_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT [value] FROM OPENJSON(${JSON.stringify(resources)}) ORDER BY CAST([key] AS INT);
        OPEN lock_cursor;
        FETCH NEXT FROM lock_cursor INTO @resource;
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @result >= 0
        BEGIN
            EXEC @result = sp_getapplock @Resource = @resource, @LockMode = 'Exclusive', @LockOwner = 'Transaction', @LockTimeout = ${LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS};
            FETCH NEXT FROM lock_cursor INTO @resource;
        END;
        CLOSE lock_cursor;
        DEALLOCATE lock_cursor;
        SELECT @result AS result;
    `;
    const result = rows[0]?.result ?? -999;
    if (result >= 0) return;
    if (result === -3) throw new LockDeadlockError();
    throw new HttpError('The server is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.', StatusCodes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, {
        code: 'SERVER_BUSY',
    });
}

/**
 * Serializes writes to existing records (updates, deletes, conversion) so a read-modify-write can't overwrite or
 * resurrect a concurrent change.
 */
export function lockRecords(tx: TransactionClient, entity: LockedEntity, ids: string[]): Promise<void> {
    return acquireLocks(tx, ids.map((id) => `${entity}:id:${id}`));
}

export type LockedEntity = 'organization' | 'contact' | 'lead' | 'opportunity' | 'quotation' | 'product' | 'ticket';

/** Columns set when a core entity is soft-deleted. */
export const softDeleteData = (actor: AuthUser) => ({
    isDeleted: true,
    deletedAt: new Date(),
    updatedBy: actor.username,
});

export interface BulkDeleteResult {
    deleted: number;
    ids: string[];
    /** Requested ids that don't exist or were already deleted. */
    notFound: string[];
}

File: backend-crm/src/modules/tickets/ticket.service.ts

import { ENV } from '../../config/env.js';
import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../../config/prisma.js';
import type { Prisma } from '../../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { auditService, diffRecords } from '../../services/audit.service.js';
import { cacheService } from '../../services/cache.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../types/user.types.js';
import type { PaginatedResult } from '../../utils/apiResponse.js';
import { generateEntityCode } from '../../utils/codeGenerator.js';
import { HttpError } from '../../utils/httpError.js';
import { daysAgo, wallClockNow } from '../../utils/mappers.js';
import { parsePagination } from '../../utils/pagination.js';
import { lockRecords, runInTransaction, softDeleteData, type BulkDeleteResult } from '../shared/transactions.js';
import { toTicketData, toTicketDto, type TicketDto } from './ticket.mapper.js';
import { TICKET_CLOSED_STATUSES, TICKET_SORT_FIELDS, ticketInputSchema, ticketListQuerySchema, type TicketInput } from './ticket.validator.js';

const notFound = () => HttpError.notFound('Ticket not found');

/**
 * Nature of Call must be an entry of the master (matched case-insensitively; the master's spelling is stored).
 * A since-deactivated entry is kept only when the ticket already used it.
 */
async function resolveNatureOfCall(tx: TransactionClient, name: string, previous?: string): Promise<string> {
    const entry = await tx.natureOfCall.findFirst({ where: { name }, select: { name: true, isActive: true } });
    if (!entry || (!entry.isActive && entry.name !== previous)) {
        throw HttpError.badRequest('Select a Nature Of Call from the list.', [
            { message: 'Select a Nature Of Call from the list.', path: ['natureOfCall'] },
        ]);
    }
    return entry.name;
}

/** The ticket form has no ids, so the organization and contact are linked by name when a live match exists. */
async function resolveLinks(tx: TransactionClient, input: TicketInput): Promise<{ organizationId: string | null; contactId: string | null }> {
    const organization = await tx.organization.findFirst({
        where: { organizationName: input.organizationName, isDeleted: false },
        select: { id: true },
    });
    const contact = organization
        ? await tx.contact.findFirst({
              where: { name: input.contactPersonName, organizationId: organization.id, isDeleted: false },
              select: { id: true },
          })
        : null;
    return { organizationId: organization?.id ?? null, contactId: contact?.id ?? null };
}

/** Inserts a ticket inside the caller's transaction (used by `create` and the seed). */
export async function createTicketRecord(tx: TransactionClient, input: TicketInput, user: AuthUser): Promise<TicketDto> {
    // Code first: its counter row lock queues concurrent creates before they take any other lock.
    const ticketNumber = await generateEntityCode(tx, 'TKT');
    const natureOfCall = await resolveNatureOfCall(tx, input.natureOfCall);
    const links = await resolveLinks(tx, input);
    const row = await tx.ticket.create({
        data: { ...toTicketData(input, { natureOfCall, ...links }), ticketNumber, createdBy: user.username },
    });
    const dto = toTicketDto(row);
    await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Ticket', entityId: row.id, action: 'CREATE', changedBy: user.username, changes: dto });
    return dto;
}

export const ticketService = {
    async list(query: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<PaginatedResult<TicketDto>> {
        const page = parsePagination(query, TICKET_SORT_FIELDS);
        const filters = ticketListQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});

        const and: Prisma.TicketWhereInput[] = [{ isDeleted: false }];
        if (filters.ticketStatus?.length) and.push({ ticketStatus: { in: filters.ticketStatus } });
        if (filters.excludeStatus?.length) and.push({ ticketStatus: { notIn: filters.excludeStatus } });
        if (filters.ticketPriority?.length) and.push({ ticketPriority: { in: filters.ticketPriority } });
        if (filters.supportType?.length) and.push({ supportType: { in: filters.supportType } });
        if (filters.supportMode?.length) and.push({ supportMode: { in: filters.supportMode } });
        if (filters.organizationId) and.push({ organizationId: filters.organizationId });
        if (filters.contactId) and.push({ contactId: filters.contactId });
        if (filters.assignedTo) and.push({ assignedTo: filters.assignedTo });
        if (filters.mine) and.push({ assignedTo: user.username });
        if (filters.overdue) {
            and.push({ dueDate: { lt: wallClockNow(ENV.BUSINESS_TIMEZONE) }, ticketStatus: { notIn: [...TICKET_CLOSED_STATUSES] } });
        }
        if (filters.createdWithinDays) and.push({ createdAt: { gte: daysAgo(filters.createdWithinDays) } });
        if (page.search) {
            and.push({
                OR: [
                    { ticketNumber: { contains: page.search } },
                    { ticketSubject: { contains: page.search } },
                    { organizationName: { contains: page.search } },
                    { contactPersonName: { contains: page.search } },
                    { contactNumber: { contains: page.search } },
                    { natureOfCall: { contains: page.search } },
                ],
            });
        }
        const where: Prisma.TicketWhereInput = { AND: and };

        const [total, rows] = await prisma.$transaction([
            prisma.ticket.count({ where }),
            prisma.ticket.findMany({ where, orderBy: [page.orderBy, { id: 'asc' }], skip: page.skip, take: page.take }),
        ]);
        return { data: rows.map(toTicketDto), total, page: page.page, limit: page.limit };
    },

    async getById(id: string): Promise<TicketDto> {
        const row = await prisma.ticket.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false } });
        if (!row) throw notFound();
        return toTicketDto(row);
    },

    async create(body: unknown, user: AuthUser): Promise<TicketDto> {
        const input = ticketInputSchema.parse(body);
        const created = await runInTransaction((tx) => createTicketRecord(tx, input, user));
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('tickets');
        return created;
    },

    async update(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>, user: AuthUser): Promise<TicketDto> {
        const updated = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'ticket', [id]);
            const existing = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { id, isDeleted: false } });
            if (!existing) throw notFound();

            const before = toTicketDto(existing);
            const input = ticketInputSchema.parse({ ...before, ...patch });
            const natureOfCall = await resolveNatureOfCall(tx, input.natureOfCall, existing.natureOfCall);
            const links = await resolveLinks(tx, input);

            const row = await tx.ticket.update({
                where: { id },
                data: { ...toTicketData(input, { natureOfCall, ...links }), updatedBy: user.username },
            });
            const after = toTicketDto(row);
            const changes = diffRecords(before, after);
            if (Object.keys(changes).length > 0) {
                await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Ticket', entityId: id, action: 'UPDATE', changedBy: user.username, changes });
            }
            return after;
        });

        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('tickets');
        return updated;
    },

    async remove(id: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
        await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'ticket', [id]);
            const result = await tx.ticket.updateMany({ where: { id, isDeleted: false }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
            if (result.count === 0) throw notFound();
            await auditService.record(tx, { entityType: 'Ticket', entityId: id, action: 'DELETE', changedBy: user.username });
        });
        await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('tickets');
    },

    async bulkRemove(ids: string[], user: AuthUser): Promise<BulkDeleteResult> {
        const result = await runInTransaction(async (tx) => {
            await lockRecords(tx, 'ticket', ids);
            const live = await tx.ticket.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, isDeleted: false }, select: { id: true } });
            const liveIds = live.map((row) => row.id);
            if (liveIds.length > 0) {
                await tx.ticket.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: liveIds } }, data: softDeleteData(user) });
                await auditService.recordMany(
                    tx,
                    liveIds.map((entityId) => ({ entityType: 'Ticket' as const, entityId, action: 'DELETE' as const, changedBy: user.username })),
                );
            }
            return { deleted: liveIds.length, ids: liveIds, notFound: ids.filter((id) => !liveIds.includes(id)) };
        });

        if (result.deleted > 0) await cacheService.invalidateEntityCaches('tickets');
        return result;
    },
};

import { z } from 'zod';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH as L } from '../../config/fieldLimits.js';
import {
    booleanQuery,
    createdWithinDaysQuery,
    csvQuery,
    enumWithDefault,
    optionalEmail,
    optionalPhone,
    optionalText,
    requiredText,
    requiredWallClock,
} from '../../validators/common.js';

// Option lists from frontend-crm/src/types/ticket.types.ts.
export const TICKET_PRIORITIES = ['Low', 'Normal', 'High', 'Urgent'] as const;
export const TICKET_STATUSES = ['New', 'Assigned', 'In Progress', 'Pending Customer', 'Escalated', 'Resolved', 'Closed'] as const;
export const TICKET_CLOSED_STATUSES: readonly string[] = ['Resolved', 'Closed'];
export const TICKET_SOURCES = ['Call', 'Email', 'Web Portal', 'Chat', 'In-Person', 'WhatsApp'] as const;
export const SUPPORT_TYPES = ['Free', 'Paid', 'AMC', 'Warranty'] as const;
export const SUPPORT_MODES = ['Offsite Support', 'Onsite Support', 'Remote Support (AnyDesk/TeamViewer)', 'Phone Consultation'] as const;

const requiredEnum = <const T extends readonly [string, ...string[]]>(field: string, values: T) =>
    z.enum(values, { error: `${field} is required.` });

/** `TicketFormData` rules from frontend-crm/src/validations/ticket.schema.ts (Nature of Call is checked against the master). */
export const ticketInputSchema = z.object({
    amcFlag: z.boolean().default(false),
    ticketSubject: optionalText('Ticket Subject', L.title),
    organizationName: requiredText('Organization Name', L.organizationName),
    contactPersonName: requiredText('Contact Person Name', L.personName),
    contactNumber: optionalPhone('Contact Number'),
    ticketPriority: requiredEnum('Ticket Priority', TICKET_PRIORITIES),
    source: enumWithDefault('Source', TICKET_SOURCES, 'Call'),
    supportType: enumWithDefault('Support Type', SUPPORT_TYPES, 'Free'),
    problemReported: requiredText('Problem Reported', L.longText),
    resolution: optionalText('Resolution', L.longText),
    reasonForEscalatedCalls: optionalText('Reason For Escalated Calls', L.longText),
    assignedTo: requiredText('Assigned to', L.username),

    cloudFlag: z.boolean().default(false),

File: backend-crm/src/services/audit.service.ts
================
import { prisma, type TransactionClient } from '../config/prisma.js';
import { logger } from '../config/logger.js';
import { auditQueue, tryEnqueue } from '../jobs/queues.js';

export type AuditEntityType = 'Organization' | 'Contact' | 'Lead' | 'Opportunity' | 'Quotation' | 'Product' | 'Ticket' | 'User' | 'Import';

export type AuditAction =
    | 'CREATE'
    | 'UPDATE'
    | 'DELETE'
    | 'STATUS_CHANGE'
    | 'CONVERT'
    | 'IMPORT'
    | 'LOGIN'
    | 'LOGIN_FAILED'
    | 'LOGOUT';

export interface AuditEntry {
    entityType: AuditEntityType;
    entityId: string;
    action: AuditAction;
    changedBy: string;
    /** A `{ field: { from, to } }` diff for updates, or a snapshot / summary for other actions. */
    changes?: unknown;
}

/** Fields that change on every write and would only add noise to a diff. */
const IGNORED_FIELDS = new Set(['updatedAt', 'updatedBy', 'isRecentlyViewed', 'isMyAccount']);

/** Shallow field-level diff of two DTOs (nested values such as email lists compare by JSON). */
export function diffRecords(before: object, after: object): Record<string, { from: unknown; to: unknown }> {
    const changes: Record<string, { from: unknown; to: unknown }> = {};
    const a = before as Record<string, unknown>;
    const b = after as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)])) {
        if (IGNORED_FIELDS.has(key)) continue;
        if (JSON.stringify(a[key]) !== JSON.stringify(b[key])) changes[key] = { from: a[key], to: b[key] };
    }
    return changes;
}

const toRow = (entry: AuditEntry) => ({
    entityType: entry.entityType,
    entityId: entry.entityId,
    action: entry.action,
    changedBy: entry.changedBy,
    changesJson: entry.changes === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(entry.changes),
});

/**
 * Two write paths:
 *  • `record` / `recordMany` write inside the caller's transaction. Used for every data change, so a change
 *    and its audit entry commit (or roll back) together; an audit trail that can lose entries isn't one.
 *  • `enqueue` hands events that have no transaction of their own (logins, import summaries) to the BullMQ
 *    audit queue, falling back to a direct write when Redis is unavailable.
 */
export const auditService = {
    async record(tx: TransactionClient, entry: AuditEntry): Promise<void> {
        await tx.auditLog.create({ data: toRow(entry) });
    },

    async recordMany(tx: TransactionClient, entries: AuditEntry[]): Promise<void> {
        if (entries.length === 0) return;
        await tx.auditLog.createMany({ data: entries.map(toRow) });
    },

    /** Direct write outside a transaction (the audit worker and the no-Redis fallback). */
    async write(entry: AuditEntry): Promise<void> {
        await prisma.auditLog.create({ data: toRow(entry) });
    },

    /** Fire-and-forget: never throws, so auditing can't break the action being audited. */
    async enqueue(entry: AuditEntry): Promise<void> {
        try {
            const jobId = await tryEnqueue(auditQueue, entry.action, entry);
            if (!jobId) await auditService.write(entry);
        } catch (err) {
            logger.error({ err: (err as Error).message, entry: { ...entry, changes: undefined } }, 'Failed to record audit event');
        }
    },
};

File: backend-crm/src/services/cache.service.ts
================
import { isRedisReady, redis } from '../config/redis.js';
import { logger } from '../config/logger.js';

/** Key namespaces used across the app; invalidate with a trailing `*`, e.g. `cacheService.invalidatePattern(CACHE_KEYS.lookups('*'))`. */
export const CACHE_KEYS = {
    lookups: (name: string) => `cache:lookups:${name}`,
    addressMaster: 'cache:address-master',
    dashboard: (name: string) => `cache:dashboard:${name}`,
    search: (query: string) => `cache:search:${query}`,
} as const;

const SCAN_BATCH_SIZE = 200;

/**
 * Redis-backed cache that never takes the API down: when Redis is unreachable every call logs at debug level
 * and falls through to the source of truth (the fetcher / database).
 */
export const cacheService = {
    /** Returns the cached JSON value for `key`, or runs `fetcher`, caches its result for `ttlSeconds` and returns it. */
    async getOrSet<T>(key: string, ttlSeconds: number, fetcher: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
        if (isRedisReady()) {
            try {
                const cached = await redis.get(key);
                if (cached !== null) return JSON.parse(cached) as T;
            } catch (err) {
                logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, key }, 'Cache read failed; using database');
            }
        }

        const value = await fetcher();

        if (isRedisReady() && value !== undefined) {
            // Fire-and-forget: a failed cache write must not fail or slow the request.
            redis.set(key, JSON.stringify(value), 'EX', ttlSeconds).catch((err: Error) => {
                logger.warn({ err: err.message, key }, 'Cache write failed');
            });
        }
        return value;
    },

    async invalidate(...keys: string[]): Promise<void> {
        if (!isRedisReady() || keys.length === 0) return;
        try {
            await redis.unlink(...keys);
        } catch (err) {
            logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, keys }, 'Cache invalidation failed');
        }
    },

    /** Deletes every key matching a glob pattern (e.g. `cache:lookups:*`), using SCAN so Redis is never blocked. */
    async invalidatePattern(pattern: string): Promise<void> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return;
        try {
            let cursor = '0';
            do {
                const [nextCursor, keys] = await redis.scan(cursor, 'MATCH', pattern, 'COUNT', SCAN_BATCH_SIZE);
                cursor = nextCursor;
                if (keys.length > 0) await redis.unlink(...keys);
            } while (cursor !== '0');
        } catch (err) {
            logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message, pattern }, 'Cache pattern invalidation failed');
        }
    },

    /**
     * Drops every cache an entity write can make stale: that entity's lookups, global search results and
     * dashboard aggregates. Call after the write's transaction commits.
     */
    async invalidateEntityCaches(entity: CachedEntity): Promise<void> {
        await Promise.all([
            cacheService.invalidatePattern(`${CACHE_KEYS.lookups(entity)}*`),
            cacheService.invalidatePattern(`${CACHE_KEYS.search('')}*`),
            cacheService.invalidatePattern(`${CACHE_KEYS.dashboard('')}*`),
        ]);
    },
};

export type CachedEntity = 'organizations' | 'contacts' | 'leads' | 'opportunities' | 'quotations' | 'products' | 'tickets' | 'users';

File: backend-crm/src/services/recentViews.service.ts
================
import { logger } from '../config/logger.js';
import { isRedisReady, redis } from '../config/redis.js';

const MAX_RECENT = 20;
const RECENT_TTL_SECONDS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;

const recentKey = (userId: number, entity: string) => `recent:${userId}:${entity}`;

/**
 * Per-user "recently viewed" records (a Redis sorted set scored by view time), behind flags such as
 * `ExtendedOrganization.isRecentlyViewed`. Without Redis nothing is recorded and lists report no recent views.
 */
export const recentViewsService = {
    async record(userId: number, entity: string, recordId: string): Promise<void> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return;
        const key = recentKey(userId, entity);
        try {
            await redis
                .multi()
                .zadd(key, Date.now(), recordId)
                .zremrangebyrank(key, 0, -(MAX_RECENT + 1))
                .expire(key, RECENT_TTL_SECONDS)
                .exec();
        } catch (err) {
            logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message }, 'Could not record recent view');
        }
    },

    /** Most recent first. */
    async list(userId: number, entity: string): Promise<string[]> {
        if (!isRedisReady()) return [];
        try {
            return await redis.zrevrange(recentKey(userId, entity), 0, MAX_RECENT - 1);
        } catch (err) {
            logger.warn({ err: (err as Error).message }, 'Could not read recent views');
            return [];
        }
    },

    async forget(entity: string, userId: number, recordIds: string[]): Promise<void> {
        if (!isRedisReady() || recordIds.length === 0) return;
        await redis.zrem(recentKey(userId, entity), ...recordIds).catch(() => undefined);
    },
};

import type { Response } from 'express';
import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';

/**
 * Response envelopes matching frontend-crm/src/types/api.types.ts:
 * `ApiResponse<T>` for single items / mutations and `PaginatedResponse<T>` for lists.
 */

export function sendSuccess<T>(res: Response, data: T, message?: string, statusCode: number = StatusCodes.OK): Response {
    return res.status(statusCode).json({ success: true, data, ...(message ? { message } : {}) });
}

export function sendCreated<T>(res: Response, data: T, message?: string): Response {
    return sendSuccess(res, data, message, StatusCodes.CREATED);
}

export interface PaginatedResult<T> {
    data: T[];
    total: number;
    page: number;
    limit: number;
}

export function sendPaginated<T>(res: Response, result: PaginatedResult<T>): Response {
    return res.status(StatusCodes.OK).json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        total: result.total,
        page: result.page,
        limit: result.limit,
    });
}

File: backend-crm/src/utils/codeGenerator.ts
================
import type { TransactionClient } from '../config/prisma.js';

/** Code prefixes per entity: ORG-0001, CON-0001, LD-0001, … */
export const ENTITY_CODE_PREFIX = {
    organization: 'ORG',
    contact: 'CON',
    lead: 'LD',
    opportunity: 'OPP',
    quotation: 'QT',
    product: 'PRD',
    ticket: 'TKT',
} as const;

export type EntityCodePrefix = (typeof ENTITY_CODE_PREFIX)[keyof typeof ENTITY_CODE_PREFIX];

const CODE_PAD_LENGTH = 4;

/**
 * Atomically increments the counter for `prefix` and returns the next code (e.g. `ORG-0042`).
 *
 * Runs as a single MERGE under HOLDLOCK, so concurrent requests serialize on the counter row and never
 * receive the same number, including the very first call, when the row doesn't exist yet. Call it inside
 * the same transaction that inserts the record so a rolled-back insert also releases its number.
 */
export async function generateEntityCode(tx: TransactionClient, prefix: EntityCodePrefix): Promise<string> {
    const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<{ currentValue: number }[]>`
        MERGE [dbo].[SequenceCounter] WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS target
        USING (SELECT ${prefix} AS prefix) AS source
            ON target.[prefix] = source.[prefix]
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET [currentValue] = target.[currentValue] + 1
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT ([prefix], [currentValue]) VALUES (source.[prefix], 1)
        OUTPUT inserted.[currentValue] AS currentValue;
    `;

    const value = rows[0]?.currentValue;
    if (typeof value !== 'number') {
        throw new Error(`Failed to generate a code for prefix "${prefix}"`);
    }
    return formatEntityCode(prefix, value);
}

/** `ORG` + 7 → `ORG-0007` (numbers past 9999 simply widen: `ORG-12345`). */
export function formatEntityCode(prefix: EntityCodePrefix, value: number): string {
    return `${prefix}-${String(value).padStart(CODE_PAD_LENGTH, '0')}`;
}

import { StatusCodes } from 'http-status-codes';

/** One invalid field, matching the frontend's `ApiFieldError`. */
export interface ApiFieldError {
    message: string;
    path: string[];
}

/** An error with an HTTP status that the error handler returns to the client as-is. */
export class HttpError extends Error {
    statusCode: number;
    code?: string;
    errors?: ApiFieldError[];

    constructor(
        message: string,
        statusCode: number = StatusCodes.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        options: { code?: string; errors?: ApiFieldError[] } = {},
    ) {
        super(message);
        this.statusCode = statusCode;
        this.code = options.code;
        this.errors = options.errors;
        Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
    }

    static badRequest(message: string, errors?: ApiFieldError[]): HttpError {
        return new HttpError(message, StatusCodes.BAD_REQUEST, { code: 'BAD_REQUEST', errors });
    }

    static unauthorized(message = 'Authentication required'): HttpError {
        return new HttpError(message, StatusCodes.UNAUTHORIZED, { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' });
    }

    static forbidden(message = 'You do not have permission to perform this action'): HttpError {
        return new HttpError(message, StatusCodes.FORBIDDEN, { code: 'FORBIDDEN' });
    }

    static notFound(message = 'Resource not found'): HttpError {
        return new HttpError(message, StatusCodes.NOT_FOUND, { code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    }

    static conflict(message: string): HttpError {
        return new HttpError(message, StatusCodes.CONFLICT, { code: 'CONFLICT' });
    }
}

import type { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';

/**
 * Helpers for translating between Prisma rows and the frontend's DTO shapes, where optional text is ''
 * rather than null, dates are ISO strings and arrays are real arrays.
 */

/** null/undefined → '' (frontend form fields are plain strings). */
export const text = (value: string | null | undefined): string => value ?? '';

/** Blank / undefined → null for storage. */
export const nullable = (value: string | null | undefined): string | null => {
    const trimmed = value?.trim();
    return trimmed ? trimmed : null;
};

export const toIso = (value: Date): string => value.toISOString();

export const toIsoOrUndefined = (value: Date | null | undefined): string | undefined => (value ? value.toISOString() : undefined);

/** `@db.Date` column → `YYYY-MM-DD` ('' when null). */
export const toDateOnly = (value: Date | null | undefined): string => (value ? value.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : '');

/** `YYYY-MM-DD` (or full ISO) → Date at UTC midnight for `@db.Date` columns. */
export function fromDateOnly(value: string): Date {
    const date = new Date(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? `${value}T00:00:00.000Z` : value);
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid date: ${value}`);
    return date;
}

export const decimalToString = (value: Prisma.Decimal | null | undefined): string => (value ? value.toString() : '');

export const decimalToNumber = (value: Prisma.Decimal | null | undefined): number => (value ? value.toNumber() : 0);

/** Parses a JSON string[] column; malformed or non-string entries are dropped rather than failing the read. */
export function parseStringArray(json: string | null | undefined): string[] {
    if (!json) return [];
    try {
        const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(json);
        return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : [];
    } catch {
        return [];
    }
}

/** Trims, drops blanks and de-duplicates before storing a string[] as JSON. */
export function stringifyStringArray(values: readonly string[] | undefined): string {
    const unique = [...new Set((values ?? []).map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean))];
    return JSON.stringify(unique);
}

// ── Wall-clock date-times (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`, no timezone) ────────────────────
// Stored as if UTC so the value entered round-trips exactly, independent of the server's timezone.

export const fromWallClock = (value: string): Date => new Date(`${value}:00.000Z`);

export const toWallClock = (value: Date): string => value.toISOString().slice(0, 16);

/** The current wall-clock time in `timeZone`, encoded the same way as `fromWallClock`. */
export function wallClockNow(timeZone: string): Date {
    const parts = Object.fromEntries(
        new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
            timeZone,
            year: 'numeric',
            month: '2-digit',
            day: '2-digit',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            hourCycle: 'h23',
        })
            .formatToParts(new Date())
            .map((part) => [part.type, part.value]),
    );
    return fromWallClock(`${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}T${parts.hour}:${parts.minute}`);
}

/** Start of the window for `createdWithinDays` filters. */
export const daysAgo = (days: number): Date => new Date(Date.now() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

File: backend-crm/src/utils/pagination.ts

import { z } from 'zod';

export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 25;
export const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
export const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

/** List query params sent by the frontend's `createCrudService` (`PaginationParams`). */
export const paginationQuerySchema = z.object({
    page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).catch(1).default(1),
    limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_PAGE_SIZE).catch(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE).default(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE),
    search: z.string().trim().max(MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH).optional().catch(undefined),
    sortBy: z.string().trim().optional().catch(undefined),
    sortOrder: z.enum(['asc', 'desc']).catch('desc').default('desc'),
});

export interface PaginationOptions<TSortField extends string> {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    skip: number;
    take: number;
    /** Trimmed search term, or undefined when blank. */
    search?: string;
    sortBy: TSortField;
    sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc';
    /** Ready to spread into a Prisma `findMany` call. */
    orderBy: Record<TSortField, 'asc' | 'desc'>;
}

/**
 * Parses `page`, `limit`, `search`, `sortBy` and `sortOrder` from a request query. Bad values fall back to
 * defaults instead of failing the request, and `sortBy` is restricted to `allowedSortFields` so arbitrary
 * column names never reach the ORM.
 */
export function parsePagination<TSortField extends string>(
    query: unknown,
    allowedSortFields: readonly [TSortField, ...TSortField[]],
    defaultSortField: TSortField = allowedSortFields[0],
): PaginationOptions<TSortField> {
    const parsed = paginationQuerySchema.parse(query ?? {});
    const sortBy = allowedSortFields.includes(parsed.sortBy as TSortField) ? (parsed.sortBy as TSortField) : defaultSortField;

    return {
        page: parsed.page,
        limit: parsed.limit,
        skip: (parsed.page - 1) * parsed.limit,
        take: parsed.limit,
        search: parsed.search || undefined,
        sortBy,
        sortOrder: parsed.sortOrder,
        orderBy: { [sortBy]: parsed.sortOrder } as Record<TSortField, 'asc' | 'desc'>,
    };
}

File: backend-crm/src/utils/prismaErrors.ts

import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';

/**
 * True when SQL Server aborted the transaction as a deadlock victim / serialization failure, so retrying the
 * whole transaction is safe. Prisma reports it as P2034, or (for raw queries through the MSSQL driver adapter)
 * as P2010 with the adapter's `TransactionWriteConflict` classification.
 */
export function isWriteConflictError(err: unknown): boolean {
    if (!(err instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError)) return false;
    if (err.code === 'P2034') return true;
    const cause = (err.meta as { driverAdapterError?: { cause?: { kind?: unknown } } } | undefined)?.driverAdapterError?.cause;
    return cause?.kind === 'TransactionWriteConflict';
}

/** P2028: the transaction couldn't start in time (pool exhausted) or had already been closed. */
export function isTransactionUnavailableError(err: unknown): boolean {
    return err instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && err.code === 'P2028';
}
