                                {subtitle}
                            </Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>

                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.25, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    <Button
                        component={Link}
                        href={backHref}
                        variant="outlined"

                            borderRadius: '8px',

                            color: '#334155',
                            height: 36,

                        {backLabel}
                    </Button>
                    {editHref && (
                        <Tooltip title={editDisabled ? editDisabledTooltip ?? '' : ''}>
                            <span>
                                <Button
                                    {...(editDisabled ? {} : { component: Link, href: editHref })}
                                    disabled={editDisabled}
                                    variant="contained"
                                    startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                    sx={{
                                        textTransform: 'none',

                                    }}
                                >
                                    {editLabel}
                                </Button>
                            </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                    )}
                </Box>
            </Paper>

            {/* ── Tabs + read-only content ── */}
            <Paper
                elevation={0}
                sx={{
                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    boxShadow: '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)',
                }}
            >
                {tabs && tabs.length > 0 && (
                    <Tabs
                        value={activeTab ?? tabs[0].id}
                        onChange={(_, value: string) => onTabChange?.(value)}
                        variant="scrollable"
                        scrollButtons="auto"
                        sx={{
                            borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            minHeight: 46,
                            px: { xs: 1, md: 2 },
                            '& .MuiTabs-indicator': { height: 3, borderRadius: '3px 3px 0 0', backgroundColor: '#2563eb' },
                        }}
                    >
                        {tabs.map((tab) => (
                            <Tab
                                key={tab.id}
                                value={tab.id}
                                icon={React.isValidElement(tab.icon) ? tab.icon : undefined}
                                iconPosition="start"
                                label={
                                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                                        {tab.label}
                                        {tab.sublabel && (
                                            <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontWeight: 400 }}>
                                                {tab.sublabel}
                                            </Typography>
                                        )}
                                    </Box>
                                }
                                sx={{
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                    fontSize: '0.84rem',
                                    minHeight: 46,
                                    color: '#64748b',
                                    '&.Mui-selected': { color: '#1e3a8a', fontWeight: 700 },
                                }}
                            />
                        ))}
                    </Tabs>
                )}

                <FormModeProvider mode="view">
                    {/* `inert` would also block the copy buttons, so only form controls are made non-interactive. */}
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            p: padContent ? { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } : 0,
                            '& input, & textarea, & select, & .MuiSelect-select, & .MuiSwitch-root, & .MuiCheckbox-root, & .MuiRadio-root, & .MuiAutocomplete-root': {
                                pointerEvents: 'none',
                            },
                        }}
                    >
                        {children}
                    </Box>
                </FormModeProvider>
            </Paper>

            {/* ── Audit footer (only when the record carries audit data) ── */}
            {auditText && (
            <Box
                sx={{
                    position: 'fixed',
                    bottom: 0,
                    left: 0,
                    right: 0,
                    zIndex: 1200,
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    px: { xs: 2, md: 4 },
                    py: 1.5,
                    boxShadow: '0 -2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)',
                }}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                    {auditText}
                </Typography>
            </Box>
            )}

            {toast}
        </Box>
    );
}

export interface CreateSplitButtonProps {

    onImportClick: () => void;
    disabled?: boolean;
}

const gradient = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)';
const gradientHover = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)';

                    sx={{

File: frontend-crm/src/components/common/CrmDataBootstrap.tsx

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
import { MASTER_DATA_QUERY_KEY, MASTER_DATA_STALE_MS } from '@/hooks/queries/useMasterData';
import { loadMasterData } from '@/services/masterData.service';
import { clearMasterData } from '@/services/masterData.store';

/**
 * After sign-in, loads the lightweight masters (users, Nature of Call, partners) that lookups and validation
 * use; entity data is fetched on demand by the views that need it. On sign-out, clears every client-side copy
 * of CRM data so the next user starts clean.
 */
export function CrmDataBootstrap() {
    const { user, loading } = useAuth();
    const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    const userId = user?.id;

    useEffect(() => {
        if (loading) return;
        if (userId === undefined) {
            queryClient.clear();
            clearMasterData();
            return;
        }
        void queryClient.prefetchQuery({ queryKey: MASTER_DATA_QUERY_KEY, queryFn: loadMasterData, staleTime: MASTER_DATA_STALE_MS });
    }, [userId, loading, queryClient]);

    return null;
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Button, Checkbox, Divider, Popover, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import type { DataTableColumn } from './types';

export interface ColumnVisibilityPopoverProps<T> {
    columns: DataTableColumn<T>[];
    visibleColumnIds: Set<string>;
    onToggleColumn: (columnId: string) => void;
    onResetDefaults?: () => void;
    anchorEl: HTMLElement | null;
    onClose: () => void;
    /** Identifies the table (stable element ids); persistence itself lives in useColumnVisibility. */
    tableId?: string;
}

const sectionLabelSx = {
    fontSize: '0.7rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    color: '#64748b',
    letterSpacing: '0.05em',
    px: 1.5,
} as const;

export function ColumnVisibilityPopover<T>({
    columns,
    visibleColumnIds,
    onToggleColumn,
    onResetDefaults,
    anchorEl,
    onClose,
    tableId,
}: ColumnVisibilityPopoverProps<T>) {
    const basicColumns = columns.filter((c) => (c.category ?? 'basic') === 'basic');
    const moreColumns = columns.filter((c) => c.category === 'more');
    const visibleCount = columns.filter((c) => visibleColumnIds.has(c.id)).length;
    const idBase = tableId ? `${tableId}-column-visibility` : 'column-visibility';

    const renderItem = (column: DataTableColumn<T>) => {
        const checked = visibleColumnIds.has(column.id);
        const disabled = Boolean(column.locked) || (checked && visibleCount <= 1);
        return (
            <Box
                key={column.id}
                onClick={() => {
                    if (!disabled) onToggleColumn(column.id);
                }}
                sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 0.5,
                    px: 1.25,
                    cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                    '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                }}
            >
                <Checkbox
                    size="small"
                    checked={checked}
                    disabled={disabled}
                    tabIndex={-1}
                    disableRipple
                    slotProps={{ input: { 'aria-label': column.label } }}
                    sx={{ p: 0.75, color: '#94a3b8', '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563eb' } }}
                />
                <Typography
                    sx={{
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                        color: checked ? '#1e293b' : '#64748b',
                        py: 0.75,
                        userSelect: 'none',
                    }}
                >
                    {column.label}
                </Typography>
            </Box>
        );
    };

    return (
        <Popover
            id={idBase}
            open={Boolean(anchorEl)}
            anchorEl={anchorEl}
            onClose={onClose}
            anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'left' }}
            transformOrigin={{ vertical: 'top', horizontal: 'left' }}
            slotProps={{
                paper: {
                    sx: {
                        mt: 0.75,
                        width: 280,
                        maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 32px)',
                        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        borderRadius: '10px',
                        boxShadow: '0 10px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12)',
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                    },
                },
            }}
        >
            <Box
                sx={{
                    px: 1.75,
                    py: 1.25,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 1,
                    borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                }}
            >
                <Box>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                        Customize Columns
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {visibleCount} of {columns.length} visible
                    </Typography>
                </Box>
                {onResetDefaults && (
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        onClick={onResetDefaults}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            minWidth: 0,
                            px: 1,
                            color: '#2563eb',
                        }}
                    >
                        Reset
                    </Button>
                )}
            </Box>

            <Box
                role="group"
                aria-label="Column visibility"
                sx={{
                    maxHeight: 380,
                    overflowY: 'auto',
                    // Reserve the scrollbar gutter so toggling never shifts the layout.
                    scrollbarGutter: 'stable',
                    pb: 0.5,
                    '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { width: 6 },
                    '&::-webkit-scrollbar-track': { background: 'transparent' },
                    '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': { background: '#cbd5e1', borderRadius: 3 },
                    '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover': { background: '#94a3b8' },
                }}
            >
                {basicColumns.length > 0 && (
                    <>
                        <Typography sx={{ ...sectionLabelSx, pt: 1, pb: 0.5 }}>BASIC COLUMNS</Typography>
                        {basicColumns.map(renderItem)}
                    </>
                )}
                {basicColumns.length > 0 && moreColumns.length > 0 && (
                    <Divider sx={{ my: 1, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />
                )}
                {moreColumns.length > 0 && (
                    <>
                        <Typography sx={{ ...sectionLabelSx, pt: 0.5, pb: 0.5 }}>MORE COLUMNS</Typography>
                        {moreColumns.map(renderItem)}
                    </>
                )}
            </Box>
        </Popover>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/common/DataTable/DataTable.tsx

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Checkbox,
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableContainer,
    TableHead,
    TableRow,
} from '@mui/material';
import ArrowDropUpIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowDropUp';
import ArrowDropDownIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowDropDown';
import UnfoldMoreIcon from '@mui/icons-material/UnfoldMore';
import type { DataTableProps, DataTableColumn } from './types';
import { DataTableEmptyState } from './DataTableEmptyState';
import { TableRowActions } from './TableRowActions';

/**
 * Universal Production-Grade Enterprise Data Table.
 * Reusable across all CRM modules (Organizations, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Invoices, etc.).
 */
export function DataTable<T>({
    data,
    columns,
    keyExtractor = (row: T, idx: number) =>
        String((row as Record<string, unknown>)?.id || `row-${idx}`),
    selectable = true,
    selectedIds,
    onToggleSelectRow,
    onToggleSelectAll,
    isAllSelected,
    isIndeterminate,
    sortField,
    sortOrder = 'asc',
    onSort,
    renderActions,
    onViewRow,
    onEditRow,
    getViewHref,
    getEditHref,
    onDeleteRow,
    viewTooltip,
    editTooltip,
    deleteTooltip,
    actionsPosition = 'left',
    actionsWidth = 70,
    actionsHeaderLabel = 'ACTIONS',
    onRowClick,
    activeRowId,
    emptyState,
    emptyIcon,
    emptyTitle,
    emptyDescription,
    emptyActionLabel,
    onEmptyAction,
    minHeight = 280,
    stickyHeader = true,
}: DataTableProps<T>) {
    // Determine row selection state helper
    const isRowSelected = (rowId: string): boolean => {
        if (!selectedIds) return false;
        if (selectedIds instanceof Set) {
            return selectedIds.has(rowId);
        }
        if (Array.isArray(selectedIds)) {
            return selectedIds.includes(rowId);
        }
        return false;
    };

    // Calculate selection states if not passed explicitly
    const computedAllSelected =
        isAllSelected !== undefined
            ? isAllSelected
            : data.length > 0 &&
              data.every((item, idx) => isRowSelected(keyExtractor(item, idx)));

    const computedSomeSelected =
        isIndeterminate !== undefined
            ? isIndeterminate
            : !computedAllSelected &&
              data.some((item, idx) => isRowSelected(keyExtractor(item, idx)));

    // Empty state fallback
    if (data.length === 0) {
        if (emptyState) {
            return <>{emptyState}</>;
        }
        return (
            <DataTableEmptyState
                icon={emptyIcon}
                title={emptyTitle}
                description={emptyDescription}
                actionLabel={emptyActionLabel}
                onAction={onEmptyAction}
            />
        );
    }

    // Action presence check (view is now triggered by clicking the row)
    const hasActions = Boolean(renderActions || onEditRow || getEditHref || onDeleteRow);

    // Row click handler: row click opens the view
    const handleRowClick = onRowClick || onViewRow;

    const renderActionButtons = (row: T, index: number) => {
        if (renderActions) {
            return renderActions(row, index);
        }
        return (
            <TableRowActions
                onView={onViewRow ? () => onViewRow(row) : undefined}
                onEdit={onEditRow ? () => onEditRow(row) : undefined}
                viewHref={getViewHref?.(row)}
                editHref={getEditHref?.(row)}
                onDelete={onDeleteRow ? () => onDeleteRow(row) : undefined}
                viewTooltip={viewTooltip}
                editTooltip={editTooltip}
                deleteTooltip={deleteTooltip}
            />
        );
    };

    // Actions cell renderer
    const renderActionsHeader = () => (
        <TableCell
            sx={{
                backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                color: '#64748b',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                py: 1.2,
                width: actionsWidth,
                textAlign: actionsPosition === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left',
            }}
        >
            {actionsHeaderLabel}
        </TableCell>
    );

    return (
        <TableContainer
            sx={{
                flex: 1,
                minHeight,
                width: '100%',
                maxWidth: '100%',
                overflowX: 'auto',
                overflowY: 'auto',
                WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch',
                '&::-webkit-scrollbar': {
                    width: '8px',
                    height: '8px',
                },
                '&::-webkit-scrollbar-track': {
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                },
                '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
                    backgroundColor: '#cbd5e1',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    '&:hover': {
                        backgroundColor: '#94a3b8',
                    },
                },
            }}
        >
            <Table
                stickyHeader={stickyHeader}
                size="small"
                sx={{
                    minWidth: 'max-content',
                    width: '100%',
                    tableLayout: 'auto',
                }}
            >
                {/* ── Table Header ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
                <TableHead>
                    <TableRow sx={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' }}>
                        {/* Checkbox Column */}
                        {selectable && (
                            <TableCell
                                padding="checkbox"
                                sx={{
                                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                                    borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                    width: 40,
                                    pl: 1.5,
                                }}
                            >
                                <Checkbox
                                    size="small"
                                    checked={computedAllSelected}
                                    indeterminate={computedSomeSelected}
                                    onChange={(e) => onToggleSelectAll?.(e.target.checked)}
                                    sx={{
                                        p: 0.5,
                                        color: '#94a3b8',
                                        '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563eb' },
                                    }}
                                />
                            </TableCell>
                        )}

                        {/* Actions on Left */}
                        {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'left' && renderActionsHeader()}

                        {/* Configurable Columns */}
                        {columns.map((col: DataTableColumn<T>) => {
                            const isSorted = sortField && (col.sortKey || col.id) === sortField;
                            const isSortable = col.sortable && onSort;

                            return (
                                <TableCell
                                    key={col.id}
                                    align={col.align || 'left'}
                                    onClick={
                                        isSortable
                                            ? () => onSort?.(col.sortKey || col.id)
                                            : undefined
                                    }
                                    sx={{
                                        backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                                        borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                        color: isSorted ? '#1e3a8a' : '#64748b',
                                        fontWeight: 700,
                                        fontSize: '0.74rem',
                                        letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                                        py: 1.2,
                                        width: col.width,
                                        minWidth: col.minWidth,
                                        cursor: isSortable ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                                        userSelect: 'none',
                                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                                        transition: 'color 0.15s ease',
                                        '&:hover': isSortable ? { color: '#1e293b' } : {},
                                    }}
                                >
                                    <Box
                                        sx={{
                                            display: 'flex',
                                            alignItems: 'center',
                                            gap: 0.5,
                                            justifyContent:
                                                col.align === 'right'
                                                    ? 'flex-end'
                                                    : col.align === 'center'
                                                    ? 'center'
                                                    : 'flex-start',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <span>{col.label}</span>
                                        {isSortable && (
                                            <Box
                                                component="span"
                                                sx={{
                                                    display: 'inline-flex',
                                                    color: isSorted ? '#2563eb' : '#94a3b8',
                                                }}
                                            >
                                                {isSorted ? (
                                                    sortOrder === 'asc' ? (
                                                        <ArrowDropUpIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                                                    ) : (
                                                        <ArrowDropDownIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                                                    )
                                                ) : (
                                                    <UnfoldMoreIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                                                )}
                                            </Box>
                                        )}
                                    </Box>
                                </TableCell>
                            );
                        })}

                        {/* Actions on Right */}
                        {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'right' && renderActionsHeader()}
                    </TableRow>
                </TableHead>

                {/* ── Table Body ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
                <TableBody>
                    {data.map((row: T, index: number) => {
                        const rowId = keyExtractor(row, index);
                        const isSelected = isRowSelected(rowId);
                        const isActive = Boolean(activeRowId && activeRowId === rowId);

                        return (
                            <TableRow
                                key={rowId}
                                hover
                                selected={isSelected || isActive}
                                onClick={handleRowClick ? () => handleRowClick(row) : undefined}
                                sx={{
                                    cursor: handleRowClick ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                                    transition: 'background-color 0.12s ease',
                                    '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                    ...(isActive && {
                                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff !important',
                                        boxShadow: 'inset 3px 0 0 #2563eb',
                                    }),
                                    '&.Mui-selected': {
                                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff !important',
                                    },
                                    '&.Mui-selected:hover': {
                                        backgroundColor: '#dbeafe !important',
                                    },
                                }}
                            >
                                {/* Checkbox Cell */}
                                {selectable && (
                                    <TableCell
                                        padding="checkbox"
                                        sx={{ pl: 1.5, py: 1 }}
                                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                    >
                                        <Checkbox
                                            size="small"
                                            checked={isSelected}
                                            onChange={() => onToggleSelectRow?.(rowId)}
                                            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                            sx={{
                                                p: 0.5,
                                                color: '#cbd5e1',
                                                '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563eb' },
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    </TableCell>
                                )}

                                {/* Actions Cell Left */}
                                {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'left' && (
                                    <TableCell
                                        sx={{
                                            py: 1,
                                            borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                                            width: actionsWidth,
                                        }}
                                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                    >
                                        {renderActionButtons(row, index)}
                                    </TableCell>
                                )}

                                {/* Column Data Cells */}
                                {columns.map((col: DataTableColumn<T>) => {
                                    let cellContent: React.ReactNode = null;

                                    if (col.render) {
                                        cellContent = col.render(row, index);
                                    } else if (typeof col.accessor === 'function') {
                                        cellContent = col.accessor(row);
                                    } else if (col.accessor) {
                                        cellContent = (row as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)[
                                            String(col.accessor)
                                        ];
                                    } else {
                                        cellContent = (row as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)[col.id];
                                    }

                                    return (
                                        <TableCell
                                            key={col.id}
                                            align={col.align || 'left'}
                                            sx={{
                                                py: 1.2,
                                                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                                color: '#334155',
                                                borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                                                maxWidth: col.width,
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {cellContent}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    );
                                })}

                                {/* Actions Cell Right */}
                                {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'right' && (
                                    <TableCell
                                        align="right"
                                        sx={{
                                            py: 1,
                                            borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                                            width: actionsWidth,
                                        }}
                                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                    >
                                        {renderActionButtons(row, index)}
                                    </TableCell>
                                )}
                            </TableRow>
                        );
                    })}
                </TableBody>
            </Table>
        </TableContainer>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import type { DataTableFilterPillsProps } from './types';

export function DataTableFilterPills<TFilter extends string = string>({
    filters,
    activeFilter,
    onFilterChange,
    variant = 'chip',
}: DataTableFilterPillsProps<TFilter>) {
    if (variant === 'pill') {
        const pillBaseSx = (isActive: boolean) => ({
            px: 1.8,
            py: 0.6,
            borderRadius: '8px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontSize: '0.8rem',
            fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 500,
            backgroundColor: isActive ? '#eff6ff' : '#fff',
            color: isActive ? '#1d4ed8' : '#475569',
            border: isActive ? '1px solid #93c5fd' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
            boxShadow: isActive ? '0 1px 2px rgba(37,99,235,0.1)' : 'none',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 0.8,
            transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
            '&:hover': { borderColor: '#93c5fd', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
        });

        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {filters.map((tab) => {
                    const isActive = activeFilter === tab.id;
                    return (
                        <Box
                            key={tab.id}
                            onClick={() => onFilterChange(tab.id)}
                            sx={pillBaseSx(isActive)}
                        >
                            {tab.icon}
                            {tab.dotColor && (
                                <Box
                                    sx={{
                                        width: 6,
                                        height: 6,
                                        borderRadius: '50%',
                                        backgroundColor: tab.dotColor,
                                    }}
                                />
                            )}
                            {tab.label}
                            {tab.count !== undefined && (
                                <Typography
                                    component="span"
                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                        fontWeight: tab.id === 'all' ? 700 : 400,
                                        color: isActive && tab.id === 'all' ? '#1d4ed8' : '#64748b',
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {tab.count.toLocaleString()}
                                </Typography>
                            )}
                        </Box>
                    );
                })}
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, overflowX: 'auto', pb: 0.5 }}>
            {filters.map((tab) => {
                const isActive = activeFilter === tab.id;
                const tabColor = tab.activeColor || '#1d4ed8';
                const activeBg = tab.activeBgColor || '#eff6ff';
                const activeBadgeBg = tab.activeBadgeBgColor || '#dbeafe';

                return (
                    <Chip
                        key={tab.id}
                        icon={
                            tab.icon
                                ? React.cloneElement(tab.icon as React.ReactElement<{ sx?: object }>, {
                                      sx: {
                                          fontSize: 15,
                                          color: isActive ? `${tabColor} !important` : '#64748b !important',
                                      },
                                  })
                                : undefined
                        }
                        label={
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                                <span>{tab.label}</span>
                                {tab.count !== undefined && (
                                    <Box
                                        component="span"
                                        sx={{
                                            px: 0.75,
                                            py: 0.1,
                                            borderRadius: '10px',
                                            fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                            fontWeight: 700,
                                            backgroundColor: isActive ? activeBadgeBg : '#e2e8f0',
                                            color: isActive ? (tab.activeColor || '#1e40af') : '#475569',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {tab.count}
                                    </Box>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        }
                        onClick={() => onFilterChange(tab.id)}
                        sx={{
                            backgroundColor: isActive ? activeBg : '#ffffff',
                            color: isActive ? tabColor : '#334155',
                            border: isActive
                                ? `1.5px solid ${tab.activeColor || '#3b82f6'}`
                                : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                            fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 500,
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            height: 32,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                            '&:hover': {
                                backgroundColor: isActive ? activeBadgeBg : '#f8fafc',
                            },
                        }}
                    />
                );
            })}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Button,
    FormControl,
    IconButton,
    MenuItem,
    Select,
    Typography,
} from '@mui/material';
import ChevronLeftIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronLeft';
import ChevronRightIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronRight';
import type { DataTablePaginationProps } from './types';

export function DataTablePagination({
    page,
    rowsPerPage,
    totalCount,
    onPageChange,
    onRowsPerPageChange,
    pageSizeOptions = [10, 25, 50],
    variant = 'compact',
    entityLabel = 'Records',
    displayTotalCount,
    hideWhenEmpty = false,
}: DataTablePaginationProps) {
    if (hideWhenEmpty && totalCount === 0) {
        return null;
    }

    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / rowsPerPage));
    const startItem = totalCount === 0 ? 0 : page * rowsPerPage + 1;
    const endItem = Math.min((page + 1) * rowsPerPage, totalCount);

    if (variant === 'full') {
        const currentPage1Based = page + 1;
        return (
            <Box
                sx={{
                    p: 1.8,
                    borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    gap: 2,
                }}
            >
                {/* Left: Rows per page & showing records */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            Rows per page:
                        </Typography>
                        <FormControl size="small">
                            <Select
                                value={rowsPerPage}
                                onChange={(e) => onRowsPerPageChange(Number(e.target.value))}
                                sx={{
                                    height: 28,
                                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                    '& .MuiSelect-select': { py: 0.4, px: 1 },
                                }}
                            >
                                {pageSizeOptions.map((size) => (
                                    <MenuItem key={size} value={size}>
                                        {size}
                                    </MenuItem>
                                ))}
                            </Select>
                        </FormControl>
                    </Box>

                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        Showing{' '}
                        <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {startItem} - {endItem}
                        </Typography>{' '}
                        of{' '}
                        <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {displayTotalCount ?? totalCount.toLocaleString()}
                        </Typography>{' '}
                        {entityLabel}
                    </Typography>
                </Box>

                {/* Right: Full Pagination Navigation Buttons */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based === 1}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(0)}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        First
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based === 1}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(0, page - 1))}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        Prev
                    </Button>

                    {/* Page number buttons */}
                    {Array.from({ length: Math.min(3, totalPages) }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((pageNum) => (
                        <Button
                            key={pageNum}
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => onPageChange(pageNum - 1)}
                            sx={{
                                minWidth: 28,
                                height: 28,
                                p: 0,
                                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                fontWeight: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? 700 : 500,
                                backgroundColor: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? '#eff6ff' : 'transparent',
                                color: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? '#1d4ed8' : '#64748b',
                                border: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? '1px solid #93c5fd' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                            }}
                        >
                            {pageNum}
                        </Button>
                    ))}

                    {totalPages > 3 && (
                        <>
                            <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>...</Typography>
                            <Button
                                size="small"
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(totalPages - 1)}
                                sx={{
                                    minWidth: 32,
                                    height: 28,
                                    p: 0,
                                    fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                    fontWeight: 500,
                                    color: '#64748b',
                                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                }}
                            >
                                457
                            </Button>
                        </>
                    )}

                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based >= totalPages}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages - 1, page + 1))}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        Next
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based >= totalPages}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(totalPages - 1)}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        Last
                    </Button>
                </Box>
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                px: 2,
                py: 1,
                borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 2,
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            }}
        >
            {/* Rows per page selector */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    Rows per page:
                </Typography>
                <Select
                    size="small"
                    value={rowsPerPage}
                    onChange={(e) => onRowsPerPageChange(Number(e.target.value))}
                    sx={{
                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                        height: 28,
                        '& .MuiSelect-select': { py: 0.5, px: 1 },
                        '& .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1' },
                    }}
                >
                    {pageSizeOptions.map((size) => (
                        <MenuItem key={size} value={size}>
                            {size}
                        </MenuItem>
                    ))}
                </Select>
            </Box>

            {/* Range and page switcher */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    {totalCount > 0 ? `${startItem}-${endItem} of ${totalCount}` : '0 of 0'}
                </Typography>

                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        disabled={page === 0}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}
                        sx={{
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            p: 0.4,
                            '&:disabled': { opacity: 0.4 },
                        }}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeftIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                    </IconButton>

                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#334155', px: 0.5 }}>
                        {page + 1} / {totalPages}
                    </Typography>

                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        disabled={page >= totalPages - 1}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}
                        sx={{
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            p: 0.4,
                            '&:disabled': { opacity: 0.4 },
                        }}
                    >
                        <ChevronRightIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                    </IconButton>
                </Box>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    IconButton,
    InputAdornment,
    InputBase,
    Menu,
    MenuItem,
    TextField,
    Tooltip,
    Typography,
} from '@mui/material';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import RefreshIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Refresh';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import KeyboardArrowDownIcon from '@mui/icons-material/KeyboardArrowDown';
import FilterListIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FilterList';
import ViewColumnIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ViewColumn';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import type { DataTableToolbarProps } from './types';

export function DataTableToolbar({
    searchQuery,
    onSearchChange,
    searchPlaceholder = 'Search records...',
    searchWidth = { xs: '100%', sm: 320 },
    onNewClick,
    newButtonLabel = 'New Record',
    onRefresh,
    refreshTooltip = 'Refresh',
    selectedCount = 0,
    onBulkDelete,
    bulkDeleteLabel = 'Delete Selected',
    extraActions,
    variant = 'standard',
    isAllPageSelected = false,
    isSomePageSelected = false,
    onToggleSelectAll,
    onSelectAllMatching,
    onSelectVisible,
    onDeselectAll,
    totalRecords = 0,
    displayTotalRecords,
    currentPage = 1,
    rowsPerPage = 25,
    totalPages = 1,
    onPageChange,
    bulkActionItems = [],
    onFilterClick,
    onColumnClick,
}: DataTableToolbarProps) {
    const [selectMenuAnchor, setSelectMenuAnchor] = useState<null | HTMLElement>(null);
    const [bulkMenuAnchor, setBulkMenuAnchor] = useState<null | HTMLElement>(null);

    if (variant === 'extended') {
        return (
            <Box
                sx={{
                    p: 1.5,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    gap: 1.5,
                    borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                }}
            >
                {/* Left Controls */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                    {/* Checkbox with dropdown */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                        <Checkbox
                            size="small"
                            checked={isAllPageSelected}
                            indeterminate={isSomePageSelected}
                            onChange={onToggleSelectAll}
                            sx={{ p: 0.5, color: '#94a3b8', '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563eb' } }}
                        />
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={(e) => setSelectMenuAnchor(e.currentTarget)}
                            sx={{ p: 0.2, color: '#94a3b8' }}
                        >
                            <KeyboardArrowDownIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                    </Box>

                    <Menu
                        anchorEl={selectMenuAnchor}
                        open={Boolean(selectMenuAnchor)}
                        onClose={() => setSelectMenuAnchor(null)}
                        slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { borderRadius: '8px', minWidth: 160 } } }}
                    >
                        {onSelectAllMatching && (
                            <MenuItem
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setSelectMenuAnchor(null);
                                    onSelectAllMatching();
                                }}
                                sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                            >
                                Select All ({totalRecords})
                            </MenuItem>
                        )}
                        {onSelectVisible && (
                            <MenuItem
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setSelectMenuAnchor(null);
                                    onSelectVisible();
                                }}
                                sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                            >
                                Select Visible
                            </MenuItem>
                        )}
                        {onDeselectAll && (
                            <MenuItem
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setSelectMenuAnchor(null);
                                    onDeselectAll();
                                }}
                                sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                            >
                                Deselect All
                            </MenuItem>
                        )}
                    </Menu>

                    {/* Bulk Action Dropdown */}
                    {bulkActionItems.length > 0 && (
                        <>
                            <Button
                                variant="outlined"
                                size="small"
                                endIcon={<KeyboardArrowDownIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                onClick={(e) => setBulkMenuAnchor(e.currentTarget)}
                                sx={{
                                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                                    color: '#334155',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                    height: 32,
                                    px: 1.5,
                                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                }}
                            >
                                BULK ACTION
                            </Button>

                            <Menu
                                anchorEl={bulkMenuAnchor}
                                open={Boolean(bulkMenuAnchor)}
                                onClose={() => setBulkMenuAnchor(null)}
                                slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { borderRadius: '8px', minWidth: 190 } } }}
                            >
                                {bulkActionItems.map((item) => (
                                    <MenuItem
                                        key={item.id}
                                        onClick={() => {
                                            setBulkMenuAnchor(null);
                                            item.onClick();
                                        }}
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                            color: item.color === 'error' ? '#ef4444' : undefined,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {item.label}
                                    </MenuItem>
                                ))}
                            </Menu>
                        </>
                    )}

                    {/* Filter & Column Layout Buttons */}
                    {onFilterClick && (
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={onFilterClick}
                            sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '6px', width: 32, height: 32, color: '#64748b' }}
                        >
                            <FilterListIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                    )}

                    {onColumnClick && (
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={(e) => onColumnClick(e.currentTarget)}
                            sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '6px', width: 32, height: 32, color: '#64748b' }}
                        >
                            <ViewColumnIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                    )}

                    {/* Search within table */}
                    <TextField
                        size="small"
                        placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                        value={searchQuery}
                        onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
                        sx={{
                            width: { xs: 180, sm: 260 },
                            '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                                height: 32,
                                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                                backgroundColor: '#fff',
                                '& fieldset': { borderColor: '#e2e8f0' },
                                '&:hover fieldset': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1' },
                                '&.Mui-focused fieldset': { borderColor: '#2563eb' },
                            },
                        }}
                        slotProps={{
                            input: {
                                startAdornment: (
                                    <InputAdornment position="start">
                                        <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ),
                                endAdornment: searchQuery ? (
                                    <InputAdornment position="end">
                                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => onSearchChange('')} sx={{ p: 0.2 }}>
                                            <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                        </IconButton>
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ) : undefined,
                            },
                        }}
                    />
                </Box>

                {/* Right: Showing records & Mini Pager */}
                {onPageChange && (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            Showing{' '}
                            <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                {totalRecords === 0 ? 0 : (currentPage - 1) * rowsPerPage + 1} -{' '}
                                {Math.min(currentPage * rowsPerPage, totalRecords)}
                            </Typography>{' '}
                            of{' '}
                            <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                {displayTotalRecords ?? totalRecords.toLocaleString()}
                            </Typography>{' '}
                            records
                        </Typography>

                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                disabled={currentPage === 1}
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
                                sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '4px', width: 26, height: 26 }}
                            >
                                &lt;
                            </IconButton>
                            <Box
                                sx={{
                                    width: 26,
                                    height: 26,
                                    display: 'flex',
                                    alignItems: 'center',
                                    justifyContent: 'center',
                                    border: '1px solid #93c5fd',
                                    borderRadius: '4px',
                                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                }}
                            >
                                {currentPage}
                            </Box>
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
                                sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '4px', width: 26, height: 26 }}
                            >
                                &gt;
                            </IconButton>
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(totalPages)}
                                sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '4px', width: 26, height: 26 }}
                            >
                                &gt;&gt;
                            </IconButton>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                )}
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                p: 1.5,
                borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 1.5,
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            }}
        >
            {/* Search Input Box */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 1,
                    px: 1.5,
                    py: 0.5,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    width: searchWidth,
                    '&:focus-within': {
                        borderColor: '#2563eb',
                        backgroundColor: '#fff',
                        boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(37,99,235,0.1)',
                    },
                }}
            >
                <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                <InputBase
                    placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
                    sx={{
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                        color: '#1e293b',
                        width: '100%',
                    }}
                />
            </Box>

            {/* Actions: Bulk selection or primary actions */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                {selectedCount > 0 ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1d4ed8' }}>
                            {selectedCount} selected

                                    height: 32,
                                }}
                            >
                                {bulkDeleteLabel}
                            </Button>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ) : null}

                {extraActions}

                {onColumnClick && (
                    <Tooltip title="Manage Columns">
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"

                            sx={{
                                color: '#64748b',

                )}

                {onRefresh && (
                    <Tooltip title={refreshTooltip}>
                        <IconButton

                            sx={{

                )}

                {onNewClick && (

                        variant="contained"

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Box, IconButton, Tooltip } from '@mui/material';
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';

export interface TableRowActionsProps {
    onView?: () => void;
    onEdit?: () => void;
    /** Renders the view icon as a real link (supports middle/Ctrl/Cmd-click and "open in new tab"). */
    viewHref?: string;
    /** Renders the edit icon as a real link; navigation is native. `onEdit` (if any) still fires as a side-effect hook. */
    editHref?: string;
    onDelete?: () => void;
    viewTooltip?: string;
    editTooltip?: string;
    deleteTooltip?: string;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Standardized Enterprise Table Row Actions Component.
 * Ensures 100% visual and behavioral consistency across all table views in the CRM.
 */
export function TableRowActions({
    onEdit,
    onDelete,
    viewHref,
    editHref,
    viewTooltip = 'View',
    editTooltip = 'Edit',
    deleteTooltip = 'Delete',
    children,
}: TableRowActionsProps) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>

            {viewHref && (
                <Tooltip title={viewTooltip}>
                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        component={Link}
                        href={viewHref}
                        onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}
                        sx={{
                            color: '#64748b',
                            p: 0.5,
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            '&:hover': { color: '#2563eb', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
                        }}
                    >
                        <VisibilityOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                    </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
            )}

            {(onEdit || editHref) && (
                <Tooltip title={editTooltip}>
                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        {...(editHref ? { component: Link, href: editHref } : {})}
                        onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onEdit?.();
                        }}
                        sx={{
                            color: '#64748b',
                            p: 0.5,
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            '&:hover': { color: '#2563eb', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
                        }}
                    >
                        <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                    </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
            )}

            {onDelete && (
                <Tooltip title={deleteTooltip}>
                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onDelete();
                        }}
                        sx={{
                            color: '#64748b',
                            p: 0.5,
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            '&:hover': { color: '#dc2626', backgroundColor: '#fef2f2' },
                        }}
                    >
                        <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                    </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
            )}

            {children}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import { useCallback, useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import type { DataTableColumn } from './types';

const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'crm_columns_';
const CHANGE_EVENT = 'crm-column-visibility-change';

const storageKey = (tableId: string) => `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${tableId}`;

function readRaw(tableId: string | undefined): string {
    if (!tableId) return '';
    try {
        return window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey(tableId)) ?? '';
    } catch {
        return '';
    }
}

function writeRaw(tableId: string, hidden: string[]): void {
    try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey(tableId), JSON.stringify(hidden));
    } catch {
        // Storage unavailable (private mode / quota): ignore, preference just won't persist.
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
}

function subscribe(onChange: () => void): () => void {
    window.addEventListener('storage', onChange);
    window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
    return () => {
        window.removeEventListener('storage', onChange);
        window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
    };
}

function parseHidden(raw: string): string[] | null {
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
        const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
        return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((v): v is string => typeof v === 'string') : null;
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

export interface ColumnVisibility<T> {
    visibleColumnIds: Set<string>;
    activeColumns: DataTableColumn<T>[];
    toggleColumn: (columnId: string) => void;
    resetDefaults: () => void;
}

/**
 * Tracks which table columns are hidden. Hidden ids (not visible ids) are stored so that
 * columns added later default to visible. Persists to localStorage (`crm_columns_${tableId}`) when `tableId` is given;
 * hydration-safe because the server snapshot is always "nothing stored".
 */
export function useColumnVisibility<T>(
    columns: DataTableColumn<T>[] | undefined,
    tableId?: string
): ColumnVisibility<T> {
    const [localHidden, setLocalHidden] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
    const storedRaw = useSyncExternalStore(
        subscribe,
        () => readRaw(tableId),
        () => ''
    );

    const allColumns = useMemo(() => columns ?? [], [columns]);

    const defaultHidden = useMemo(
        () => allColumns.filter((c) => c.defaultHidden).map((c) => c.id),
        [allColumns]
    );

    const hiddenIds = useMemo(() => {
        const explicit = tableId ? parseHidden(storedRaw) : localHidden;
        const hidden = new Set(explicit ?? defaultHidden);
        allColumns.forEach((c) => {
            if (c.locked) hidden.delete(c.id);
        });
        const anyVisible = allColumns.some((c) => !hidden.has(c.id));
        // Never allow an empty table: fall back to showing every column.
        return anyVisible ? hidden : new Set<string>();
    }, [tableId, storedRaw, localHidden, defaultHidden, allColumns]);

    const visibleColumnIds = useMemo(
        () => new Set(allColumns.filter((c) => !hiddenIds.has(c.id)).map((c) => c.id)),
        [allColumns, hiddenIds]
    );

    const activeColumns = useMemo(
        () => allColumns.filter((c) => visibleColumnIds.has(c.id)),
        [allColumns, visibleColumnIds]
    );

    const commit = useCallback(
        (hidden: string[]) => {
            if (tableId) writeRaw(tableId, hidden);
            else setLocalHidden(hidden);
        },
        [tableId]
    );

    const toggleColumn = useCallback(
        (columnId: string) => {
            if (allColumns.find((c) => c.id === columnId)?.locked) return;
            const next = new Set(hiddenIds);
            if (next.has(columnId)) {
                next.delete(columnId);
            } else {
                // Guard: keep at least one column visible.
                if (visibleColumnIds.size <= 1) return;
                next.add(columnId);
            }
            commit([...next]);
        },
        [allColumns, hiddenIds, visibleColumnIds, commit]
    );

    const resetDefaults = useCallback(() => commit(defaultHidden), [commit, defaultHidden]);

    return { visibleColumnIds, activeColumns, toggleColumn, resetDefaults };
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Skeleton } from '@mui/material';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import HistoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HistoryOutlined';
import { useEntityAuditLogs, type AuditEntityType } from '@/hooks/queries/useAuditLogs';
import type { AuditRevisionItem } from './types';

export interface AuditTrailTimelineProps {
    /** The record whose revision trail is loaded from GET /api/audit-logs/:entityType/:entityId. */
    entityType: AuditEntityType;
    entityId: string;
}

/** Revision trail of one record, newest first, with loading and empty states. */
export function AuditTrailTimeline({ entityType, entityId }: AuditTrailTimelineProps) {
    const { data: items = [], isLoading, isError } = useEntityAuditLogs(entityType, entityId);

    if (isLoading) {
        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
                {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
                    <Skeleton key={i} variant="rounded" height={86} sx={{ borderRadius: '8px' }} />
                ))}
            </Box>
        );
    }
    if (isError || items.length === 0) {
        return (
            <Box sx={{ py: 5, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                <HistoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b' }}>
                    {isError ? 'The revision trail could not be loaded.' : 'No revisions yet'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                    {isError ? 'Please try again in a moment.' : 'Changes to this record will appear here.'}
                </Typography>
            </Box>
        );
    }
    return <RevisionList items={items} />;
}

function RevisionList({ items }: { items: AuditRevisionItem[] }) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 0.5 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                    Revision Trail & Field Edits
                </Typography>
                <Chip
                    label={`${items.length} ${items.length === 1 ? 'Revision' : 'Revisions'} Tracked`}
                    size="small"
                    sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.66rem', fontWeight: 700, backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569' }}
                />
            </Box>

            {items.map((evt, idx) => (
                <Box
                    key={idx}
                    sx={{
                        p: 1.6,
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                        position: 'relative',
                        pl: 2,
                        '&::before': {
                            content: '""',
                            position: 'absolute',
                            left: 0,
                            top: 10,
                            bottom: 10,
                            width: 3,
                            backgroundColor: idx === 0 ? '#2563eb' : '#94a3b8',
                            borderRadius: '0 2px 2px 0',
                        },
                    }}
                >
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            {evt.title}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                            {evt.time}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    {(evt.from || evt.to) && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8, mt: 0.6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                            {evt.from && (
                                <Chip
                                    label={`From: ${evt.from}`}
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{ height: 18, fontSize: '0.64rem', color: '#64748b', backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' }}
                                />
                            )}
                            {evt.from && evt.to && (
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>→</Typography>
                            )}
                            {evt.to && (
                                <Chip
                                    label={`To: ${evt.to}`}
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{ height: 18, fontSize: '0.64rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1d4ed8', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' }}
                                />
                            )}
                        </Box>
                    )}

                    {evt.note && (
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#475569', mt: 0.8 }}>
                            {evt.note}
                        </Typography>
                    )}

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6, mt: 0.8, pt: 0.6, borderTop: '1px dashed #f1f5f9' }}>
                        <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            Edited by <strong style={{ color: '#334155' }}>{evt.author}</strong>
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                </Box>
            ))}
        </Box>
    );
}
