'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Typography,
    IconButton,
    Chip,
    Tooltip,
    type SxProps,
    type Theme,
} from '@mui/material';
import ContentCopyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContentCopyOutlined';

export function copyToClipboard(text: string) {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    }
}

export interface DrawerCopyButtonProps {
    text: string;
    title?: string;
    iconColor?: string;
}

export function DrawerCopyButton({ text, title = 'Copy', iconColor }: DrawerCopyButtonProps) {
    return (
        <Tooltip title={title}>
            <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(text)}>
                <ContentCopyOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: iconColor }} />
            </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
    );
}

export interface DrawerSectionCardProps {
    title?: React.ReactNode;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    action?: React.ReactNode;
    bg?: string;
    borderColor?: string;
    p?: number;
    titleSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function DrawerSectionCard({
    title,
    icon,
    action,
    bg = '#ffffff',
    borderColor = '#eef2f6',
    p = 2,
    titleSx,
    sx,
    children,
}: DrawerSectionCardProps) {
    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                p,
                borderRadius: '10px',
                backgroundColor: bg,
                border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`,
                boxShadow: '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.03)',
                ...sx,
            }}
        >
            {(title || icon || action) && (
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        mb: icon || action ? 1.2 : 0.5,
                    }}
                >
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        {icon}
                        {typeof title === 'string' ? (
                            <Typography
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#475569',
                                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                                    letterSpacing: '0.05em',
                                    // Subtle left accent when there is no icon
                                    ...(!icon && { borderLeft: '3px solid #2563eb', pl: 1, lineHeight: 1.2 }),
                                    ...titleSx,
                                }}
                            >
                                {title}
                            </Typography>
                        ) : (
                            title
                        )}
                    </Box>
                    {action}
                </Box>
            )}
            {children}
        </Box>
    );
}

export function DrawerFieldGrid({ children, columns = 2, sx }: { children: React.ReactNode; columns?: number; sx?: SxProps<Theme> }) {

            sx={{

                mt: 1,
                ...sx,

        </Box>
    );
}

    gap?: number;

export function DrawerMetricGrid({ items, columns = 2, gap = 1.5 }: DrawerMetricGridProps) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, 1fr)`, gap }}>
            {items.map((item, idx) => (
                <Box
                    key={idx}
                    sx={{
                        p: item.p ?? 1.5,
                        borderRadius: '10px',
                        backgroundColor: item.bg || '#ffffff',
                        border: `1px solid ${item.borderColor || '#e2e8f0'}`,
                    }}
                >
                    <Typography
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.68rem',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            color: item.labelColor || '#64748b',
                            letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                        }}
                    >
                        {item.label}
                    </Typography>
                    {typeof item.value === 'string' || typeof item.value === 'number' ? (
                        <Typography
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: item.valueSize || '0.88rem',
                                fontWeight: item.valueWeight || 700,
                                color: item.valueColor || '#0f172a',
                                fontFamily: item.monospace ? 'monospace' : 'inherit',
                                mt: 0.3,
                            }}
                        >
                            {item.value}
                        </Typography>
                    ) : (
                        <Box sx={{ mt: 0.3 }}>{item.value}</Box>
                    )}
                    {item.sublabel && (
                        typeof item.sublabel === 'string' ? (
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.5 }}>
                                {item.sublabel}
                            </Typography>
                        ) : (
                            item.sublabel
                        )
                    )}
                </Box>
            ))}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import { createContext, useContext } from 'react';

export interface DrawerStackContextValue {
    /** Shared collapsed state of the entire right-hand drawer stack. */
    isCollapsed: boolean;
    /** Toggles collapse/expand for the whole stack. */
    onToggleCollapse: () => void;
    /** Forces the stack back to its expanded state (e.g. when a new record opens). */
    onCollapseReset: () => void;
    /** Only the topmost drawer in the stack renders the single shared bookmark tab. */
    showBookmark: boolean;
}

export const DrawerStackContext = createContext<DrawerStackContextValue | null>(null);

export function useDrawerStack(): DrawerStackContextValue | null {
    return useContext(DrawerStackContext);
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
    Drawer,
    Box,
    Typography,
    IconButton,
    Button,
    Tooltip,
    Tabs,
    Tab,
    Snackbar,
    Alert,
    CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import SyncOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SyncOutlined';
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined';
import VerifiedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Verified';
import HistoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HistoryOutlined';
import ChevronLeftIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronLeft';
import ChevronRightIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronRight';

import { type EntityDetailDrawerProps, type DrawerTabItem, buildDrawerTabs } from './types';
import { AuditTrailTimeline } from './AuditTrailTimeline';
import { useDrawerStack } from './DrawerStackContext';

export function EntityDetailDrawer({
    open,
    onClose,
    title,
    subtitle,
    avatarText,
    avatarIcon,
    avatarBg = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7 0%, #0369a1 100%)',
    verified = true,
    loading = false,
    badges = [],
    headerActions,
    tabs = [],
    formTabs,
    tabContents,
    children,
    auditEntity,
    includeChangesTab = true,
    changesTabLabel = 'Changes',
    defaultTabIndex = 0,
    statusText = 'Ready for Order Processing',
    primaryAction,
    secondaryAction,
    footerActions,
    width = { xs: '100%', sm: 540, md: 580 },
    hideBackdrop = false,
    onCollapseChange,
    isCollapsed: isCollapsedProp,
    onToggleCollapse: onToggleCollapseProp,
    showBookmark: showBookmarkProp,
}: EntityDetailDrawerProps) {
    const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<number>(defaultTabIndex);
    const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const stack = useDrawerStack();

    // Precedence: explicit props > shared stack context > internal standalone state
    const isCollapsed = isCollapsedProp ?? stack?.isCollapsed ?? internalCollapsed;
    const showBookmark = showBookmarkProp ?? stack?.showBookmark ?? true;
    const onCollapseReset = stack?.onCollapseReset;

    // Opening the drawer (or switching records) expands it: local state resets during render, shared state below.
    const openKey = open ? title : null;
    const [lastOpenKey, setLastOpenKey] = useState(openKey);
    if (openKey !== lastOpenKey) {
        setLastOpenKey(openKey);
        if (open) setInternalCollapsed(false);
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        if (open) {
            onCollapseReset?.();
            onCollapseChange?.(false);
        }
    }, [open, title, onCollapseChange, onCollapseReset]);

    const handleToggleCollapse = () => {
        if (onToggleCollapseProp) {
            onToggleCollapseProp();
            return;
        }
        if (stack) {
            stack.onToggleCollapse();
            return;
        }
        setInternalCollapsed((prev) => {
            const next = !prev;
            onCollapseChange?.(next);
            return next;
        });
    };

    const headerIconButtonSx = {
        width: 30,
        height: 30,
        color: '#475569',
        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        p: 0,
        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
    } as const;

    const secondaryButtonSx = {
        fontSize: '0.82rem',
        textTransform: 'none',
        fontWeight: 600,
        color: '#334155',
        borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
        height: 36,
        px: 1.8,
        borderRadius: '8px',
        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
        '&:hover': { borderColor: '#94a3b8', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
        ...secondaryAction?.sx,
    } as const;

    const primaryButtonSx = {
        fontSize: '0.82rem',
        textTransform: 'none',
        fontWeight: 700,
        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
        height: 36,
        px: 2.2,
        borderRadius: '8px',
        boxShadow: 'none',
        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
        '&:hover': {
            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 14px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35)',
        },
        ...primaryAction?.sx,
    } as const;

    // Compute initials fallback if avatarText not given
    const getInitials = (str: string) => {
        if (!str) return 'REC';
        const parts = str.trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (parts.length >= 2) {
            return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
        }
        return str.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    };

    const displayAvatar = avatarText || getInitials(title);

    // Compile active tabs: caller tabs (or formTabs + tabContents) + standard Changes tab
    const resolvedBaseTabs: DrawerTabItem[] =
        formTabs && tabContents ? buildDrawerTabs(formTabs, tabContents) : tabs;

    const allTabs: DrawerTabItem[] = [...resolvedBaseTabs];
    if (includeChangesTab && auditEntity) {
        allTabs.push({
            id: 'changes-tab',
            label: changesTabLabel,
            icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
            content: <AuditTrailTimeline entityType={auditEntity.type} entityId={auditEntity.id} />,
        });
    }

    // Ensure valid currentTab index
    const activeTabIndex = Math.min(currentTab, Math.max(0, allTabs.length - 1));

    const effectiveHideBackdrop = hideBackdrop || isCollapsed;

    // Resolve responsive width objects to a concrete value for the bookmark's `right` offset
    const resolvedDrawerWidth =
        typeof width === 'number' || typeof width === 'string'
            ? width
            : (width?.md ?? width?.sm ?? 580);

    return (
        <>
            {open && showBookmark && (
                <Tooltip title={isCollapsed ? 'Expand Details' : 'Collapse Details'} placement="left" arrow>
                    <Box
                        onClick={handleToggleCollapse}
                        role="button"
                        aria-label={isCollapsed ? 'Expand Details' : 'Collapse Details'}
                        sx={{
                            position: 'fixed',
                            top: '45%',
                            right: isCollapsed ? 0 : resolvedDrawerWidth,
                            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                            zIndex: 1410,
                            width: 24,
                            height: 56,
                            backgroundColor: '#2563eb',
                            color: '#ffffff',
                            borderRadius: '8px 0 0 8px',
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'center',
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            boxShadow: '-3px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
                            transition: 'right 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.15s ease',
                            pointerEvents: 'auto',
                            '&:hover': {
                                backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                            },
                        }}
                    >
                        {isCollapsed ? (
                            <ChevronLeftIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                        ) : (
                            <ChevronRightIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                        )}
                    </Box>
                </Tooltip>
            )}
            <Drawer
                anchor="right"
                open={open}
                onClose={onClose}
                hideBackdrop={effectiveHideBackdrop}
                slotProps={{
                    backdrop: {
                        sx: {
                            backgroundColor: effectiveHideBackdrop ? 'transparent' : 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25)',
                            backdropFilter: effectiveHideBackdrop ? 'none' : 'blur(4px)',
                            WebkitBackdropFilter: effectiveHideBackdrop ? 'none' : 'blur(4px)',
                            ...(effectiveHideBackdrop && { pointerEvents: 'none' }),
                        },
                    },
                    paper: {
                        sx: {
                            width,
                            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                            borderLeft: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            boxShadow: isCollapsed ? 'none' : '-12px 0 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08)',
                            display: 'flex',
                            flexDirection: 'column',
                            overflow: 'hidden',
                            transform: isCollapsed ? 'translateX(100%) !important' : 'translateX(0) !important',
                            transition: 'transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important',
                            visibility: 'visible !important',
                        },
                    },
                }}
            >
            {/* ── Top Header Section ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box sx={{ p: 2.5, pb: 2, borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9', backgroundColor: '#ffffff' }}>
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 1.5 }}>
                    {/* Identity Banner */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <Box
                            sx={{
                                width: 48,
                                height: 48,
                                borderRadius: '10px',
                                background: avatarBg,
                                color: '#ffffff',
                                display: 'flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                justifyContent: 'center',
                                fontWeight: 800,
                                fontSize: '1.05rem',
                                letterSpacing: '0.02em',
                                flexShrink: 0,

                            {avatarIcon || displayAvatar}
                        </Box>
                        <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>

                    </Box>
                ) : (
                    allTabs[activeTabIndex]?.content ?? children
                )}
            </Box>

            {/* ── Sticky Drawer Footer ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    p: 2,
                    px: 2.5,
                    borderTop: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                }}
            >
                {/* Status Indicator */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            width: 8,
                            height: 8,
                            borderRadius: '50%',
                            backgroundColor: '#10b981',
                            boxShadow: '0 0 0 3px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)',
                        }}
                    />
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#334155' }}>
                        {statusText}
                    </Typography>
                </Box>

                {/* Right Action Buttons */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                    {footerActions}

                    {secondaryAction && (
                        secondaryAction.tooltip ? (
                            <Tooltip title={secondaryAction.tooltip}>
                                <span>
                                    <Button
                                        variant={secondaryAction.variant || 'outlined'}
                                        size="small"
                                        startIcon={secondaryAction.icon}
                                        onClick={secondaryAction.onClick}
                                        disabled={secondaryAction.disabled}
                                        sx={secondaryButtonSx}
                                    >
                                        {secondaryAction.label}
                                    </Button>
                                </span>
                            </Tooltip>
                        ) : (
                            <Button
                                variant={secondaryAction.variant || 'outlined'}
                                size="small"
                                startIcon={secondaryAction.icon}
                                onClick={secondaryAction.onClick}
                                disabled={secondaryAction.disabled}
                                sx={secondaryButtonSx}
                            >
                                {secondaryAction.label}
                            </Button>
                        )
                    )}

                    {(primaryAction || headerActions?.onEdit) && (
                        primaryAction?.tooltip ? (
                            <Tooltip title={primaryAction.tooltip}>
                                <span>
                                    <Button
                                        variant={primaryAction?.variant || 'contained'}
                                        size="small"
                                        startIcon={primaryAction?.icon || <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                        onClick={primaryAction?.onClick || headerActions?.onEdit}
                                        disabled={primaryAction?.disabled}
                                        sx={primaryButtonSx}
                                    >
                                        {primaryAction?.label || 'Edit Details'}
                                    </Button>
                                </span>
                            </Tooltip>
                        ) : (
                            <Button
                                variant={primaryAction?.variant || 'contained'}
                                size="small"
                                startIcon={primaryAction?.icon || <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                onClick={primaryAction?.onClick || headerActions?.onEdit}
                                disabled={primaryAction?.disabled}
                                sx={primaryButtonSx}
                            >
                                {primaryAction?.label || 'Edit Details'}
                            </Button>
                        )
                    )}
                </Box>
            </Box>

            {/* Notification Toast */}
            <Snackbar
                open={Boolean(toastMessage)}
                autoHideDuration={2500}
                onClose={() => setToastMessage(null)}
                anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'right' }}
            >
                <Alert severity="info" sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', py: 0.5 }}>
                    {toastMessage}
                </Alert>
            </Snackbar>
        </Drawer>
        </>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import {
    Drawer,
    Box,
    IconButton,
    List,
    ListItem,
    ListItemButton,
    ListItemIcon,
    ListItemText,
    Badge,
    Chip,
    Tooltip,
} from '@mui/material';
import MenuIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Menu';

export interface RelatedModuleItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon: React.ReactNode;
    count: number;
    onClick?: () => void;
}

export interface RelatedModulesSidebarProps {
    open: boolean;
    logoSrc?: string; // Path to the company logo image
    title?: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    modules: RelatedModuleItem[];
    activeModuleId?: string;
    onModuleSelect?: (moduleId: string) => void;
    collapsed?: boolean;
    onToggleCollapse?: (collapsed: boolean) => void;
}

export function RelatedModulesSidebar({
    open,
    logoSrc = '/images/NIPL-Updated-Logo-Large.png',
    modules,
    activeModuleId,
    onModuleSelect,
    collapsed,
    onToggleCollapse,
}: RelatedModulesSidebarProps) {
    const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState(false);
    const isCollapsed = collapsed ?? internalCollapsed;

    const handleToggleCollapse = () => {
        const next = !isCollapsed;
        setInternalCollapsed(next);
        onToggleCollapse?.(next);
    };

    return (
        <Drawer
            anchor="left"
            open={open}
            variant="persistent"
            sx={{
                position: 'fixed',
                top: 0,
                left: 0,
                height: '100vh',
                zIndex: 1300,
                width: isCollapsed ? 72 : 260,
                transition: 'width 0.2s ease',
                flexShrink: 0,
                pointerEvents: open ? 'auto' : 'none',
                '& .MuiDrawer-paper': {
                    position: 'fixed',
                    top: 0,
                    left: 0,
                    height: '100vh',
                    zIndex: 1300,
                    width: isCollapsed ? 72 : 260,
                    transition: 'width 0.2s ease, transform 225ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) 0ms',
                    borderRight: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    overflowX: 'hidden',
                    boxShadow: '8px 0 32px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    boxSizing: 'border-box',
                },
            }}
        >
            {/* ── Header Section (Height ~64px, flexbox) ─────────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    height: 64,
                    minHeight: 64,
                    px: isCollapsed ? 1 : 2,
                    borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: isCollapsed ? 'center' : 'space-between',
                    gap: 1,
                    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    flexShrink: 0,
                }}
            >
                {!isCollapsed && (
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            minWidth: 0,
                            userSelect: 'none',
                        }}
                    >
                        <Image
                            src={logoSrc}
                            alt="Nandini CRM Logo"
                            width={120}
                            height={32}
                            style={{ objectFit: 'contain' }}
                        />
                    </Box>
                )}

                <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={handleToggleCollapse}
                    aria-label={isCollapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'}
                    sx={{
                        color: '#475569',
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        p: 0.75,
                        '&:hover': {
                            backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                            color: '#0f172a',
                        },
                    }}
                >
                    <MenuIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                </IconButton>
            </Box>

            {/* ── List Section ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', overflowX: 'hidden', py: 1.25, px: 1 }}>
                <List disablePadding sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.4 }}>
                    {modules.map((item) => {
                        const isActive = item.id === activeModuleId;
                        const hasCount = item.count > 0;

                        const buttonContent = (
                            <ListItemButton
                                onClick={() => {
                                    item.onClick?.();
                                    onModuleSelect?.(item.id);
                                }}
                                selected={isActive}
                                sx={{
                                    borderRadius: '8px',
                                    minHeight: 40,
                                    px: isCollapsed ? 0 : 1.25,
                                    py: 0.85,
                                    justifyContent: isCollapsed ? 'center' : 'flex-start',
                                    backgroundColor: isActive ? '#eff6ff !important' : 'transparent',
                                    color: isActive ? '#1d4ed8' : '#334155',
                                    transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease',
                                    '&:hover': {
                                        backgroundColor: isActive ? '#eff6ff' : '#f8fafc',
                                        color: isActive ? '#1d4ed8' : '#0f172a',
                                    },
                                }}
                            >
                                <ListItemIcon
                                    sx={{
                                        minWidth: isCollapsed ? 'auto' : 32,
                                        mr: isCollapsed ? 0 : 0.5,
                                        color: isActive ? '#1d4ed8' : '#64748b',
                                        display: 'flex',
                                        alignItems: 'center',
                                        justifyContent: 'center',
                                        '& svg': {
                                            fontSize: 19,
                                        },
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {isCollapsed && hasCount ? (
                                        <Badge
                                            badgeContent={item.count}
                                            color="primary"
                                            max={999}
                                            sx={{
                                                '& .MuiBadge-badge': {
                                                    fontSize: '0.6rem',
                                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                                    height: 16,
                                                    minWidth: 16,
                                                    px: 0.4,
                                                    backgroundColor: '#2563eb',
                                                },
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {item.icon}
                                        </Badge>
                                    ) : (
                                        item.icon
                                    )}
                                </ListItemIcon>

                                {!isCollapsed && (
                                    <>
                                        <ListItemText
                                            primary={item.label}
                                            slotProps={{
                                                primary: {
                                                    noWrap: true,
                                                    sx: {
                                                        fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                                        fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 600,
                                                        color: isActive ? '#1d4ed8' : '#334155',
                                                    },
                                                },
                                            }}
                                        />

                                        <Chip
                                            label={item.count}
                                            size="small"
                                            sx={{
                                                height: 20,
                                                minWidth: 26,
                                                fontSize: '0.68rem',
                                                fontWeight: 700,
                                                borderRadius: '6px',
                                                ml: 1,
                                                backgroundColor: isActive
                                                    ? '#dbeafe'
                                                    : hasCount
                                                      ? '#eff6ff'
                                                      : '#f1f5f9',
                                                color: isActive
                                                    ? '#1d4ed8'
                                                    : hasCount
                                                      ? '#2563eb'
                                                      : '#64748b',
                                                border: isActive
                                                    ? '1px solid #93c5fd'
                                                    : hasCount
                                                      ? '1px solid #bfdbfe'
                                                      : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                                '& .MuiChip-label': {
                                                    px: 0.75,
                                                },
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    </>
                                )}
                            </ListItemButton>
                        );

                        return (
                            <ListItem key={item.id} disablePadding>
                                {isCollapsed ? (
                                    <Tooltip title={`${item.label} (${item.count})`} placement="right" arrow>
                                        {buttonContent}
                                    </Tooltip>
                                ) : (
                                    buttonContent
                                )}
                            </ListItem>
                        );
                    })}
                </List>
            </Box>
        </Drawer>
    );
}

type RelatedRow = Record<string, unknown>;

const formatCurrency = (val: unknown): string => {
    const num = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return String(val ?? '-');
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'INR',
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(num);
};

function normalizeModuleKey(moduleId: string): string {
    const normalized = moduleId.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, '_');
    if (normalized === 'quotes') return 'quotations';
    if (normalized === 'line_items') return 'products';
    return normalized;
}

function getModuleIcon(moduleKey: string): React.ReactNode {
    switch (moduleKey) {
        case 'activities':
            return <AssignmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'tickets':
            return <ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'contacts':
            return <PeopleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'contracts':
            return <DescriptionOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'history':
            return <HistoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'leads':
            return <PersonAddAlt1OutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'organizations':
            return <AccountTreeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'partner_contacts':
            return <GroupsOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'opportunities':
            return <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'member_organizations':
            return <AccountTreeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'documents':
            return <FolderOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'products':
            return <Inventory2OutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'quotations':
            return <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'partner_company':
            return <HandshakeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        case 'security_groups':
            return <AdminPanelSettingsOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
        default:
            return <AssignmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />;
    }
}

function renderPrimaryCell(value: unknown, mono = false): React.ReactNode {
    return (
        <Typography
            noWrap
            sx={{
                fontSize: '0.78rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: '#1d4ed8',
                fontFamily: mono ? 'monospace' : 'inherit',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
            }}
        >
            {String(value || '-')}
        </Typography>
    );
}

function renderStatusPill(status: unknown): React.ReactNode {
    const label = String(status || 'Active');
    const lower = label.toLowerCase();
    let bg = '#f1f5f9';
    let color = '#475569';
    let border = '#cbd5e1';

    if (
        lower.includes('active') ||
        lower.includes('completed') ||
        lower.includes('accepted') ||
        lower.includes('won') ||
        lower.includes('published') ||
        lower.includes('resolved')
    ) {
        bg = '#ecfdf5';
        color = '#047857';
        border = '#a7f3d0';
    } else if (
        lower.includes('open') ||
        lower.includes('sent') ||
        lower.includes('scheduled') ||
        lower.includes('new') ||
        lower.includes('in progress') ||
        lower.includes('proposal')
    ) {
        bg = '#eff6ff';
        color = '#1d4ed8';
        border = '#bfdbfe';
    } else if (lower.includes('pending') || lower.includes('negotiation') || lower.includes('warm')) {
        bg = '#fffbeb';
        color = '#b45309';
        border = '#fde68a';
    } else if (lower.includes('rejected') || lower.includes('lost') || lower.includes('expired')) {
        bg = '#fef2f2';
        color = '#b91c1c';
        border = '#fecaca';
    }

    return (
        <Chip
            label={label}
            size="small"
            sx={{
                height: 20,
                fontSize: '0.68rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                backgroundColor: bg,
                color,
                border: `1px solid ${border}`,
            }}
        />
    );
}

export function RelatedRecordsTableView({
    open,
    moduleId,
    moduleTitle,
    parentEntityTitle,
    leftOffset,
    rightOffset,
    isRightDrawerCollapsed = false,
    onClose,
    onRowClick,
    parentRecordId,
    entityData,
    entityType = 'organization',
}: RelatedRecordsTableViewProps) {
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<string>('');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<SortOrder>('asc');
    const [activeRowId, setActiveRowId] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const moduleKey = useMemo(() => normalizeModuleKey(moduleId), [moduleId]);

    const columns = useMemo(() => getColumnsForModule(moduleKey), [moduleKey]);

    const datasets = useRelatedDatasets(entityType, entityData, open);

    const rawRecords = useMemo(
        () =>
            resolveRelatedRecordsForModule(
                moduleKey,
                parentEntityTitle,
                parentRecordId,
                entityData,
                entityType,
                datasets
            ),
        [moduleKey, parentEntityTitle, parentRecordId, entityData, entityType, datasets]
    );

    const filteredAndSortedRecords = useMemo(() => {
        const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
        let list = rawRecords;

        if (q) {
            list = list.filter((row) =>
                Object.values(row).some((v) =>
                    String(v ?? '')
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(q)
                )
            );
        }

        if (sortField) {
            list = [...list].sort((a, b) => {
                const valA = String(a[sortField] ?? '').toLowerCase();
                const valB = String(b[sortField] ?? '').toLowerCase();
                if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
                if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
                return 0;
            });
        }

        return list;
    }, [rawRecords, searchQuery, sortField, sortOrder]);

    if (!open) {
        return null;
    }

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const effectiveRightOffset = isRightDrawerCollapsed ? 28 : rightOffset;

    return (
        <Box
            component="section"
            sx={{
                position: 'fixed',
                top: 0,
                bottom: 0,
                left: leftOffset,
                right: effectiveRightOffset,
                zIndex: 1290, // Tucks nicely underneath both side panels
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                borderRight: '1px solid #cbd5e1', // Adds a clean edge
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                transition: 'left 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), right 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)',
                boxShadow: 'none', // Remove heavy shadow, let the right drawer cast its shadow over this
                overflow: 'hidden',
            }}
        >
            {/* ── Legacy Dark Slate Header Banner (42px) ───────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    height: 42,
                    minHeight: 42,
                    px: 2,
                    backgroundColor: '#475569',
                    color: '#ffffff',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 1.5,
                    flexShrink: 0,
                    borderBottom: '1px solid #334155',
                }}
            >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
                        {getModuleIcon(moduleKey)}
                    </Box>
                    <Typography
                        noWrap
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.78rem',
                            fontWeight: 800,
                            letterSpacing: '0.06em',
                            textTransform: 'uppercase',
                            color: '#ffffff',
                        }}
                    >
                        {moduleTitle}
                    </Typography>
                    <Chip
                        label={filteredAndSortedRecords.length}
                        size="small"
                        sx={{
                            height: 19,
                            minWidth: 24,
                            fontSize: '0.68rem',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)',
                            color: '#ffffff',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            '& .MuiChip-label': { px: 0.75 },
                        }}
                    />
                    {parentEntityTitle && (
                        <Typography
                            noWrap
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 500,
                                color: '#cbd5e1',
                                ml: 0.5,
                                display: { xs: 'none', lg: 'inline' },
                            }}
                        >
                            • {parentEntityTitle}
                        </Typography>
                    )}
                </Box>

                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28)',
                            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            px: 1,
                            height: 26,
                            width: { xs: 130, md: 190 },
                        }}
                    >
                        <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#cbd5e1', mr: 0.6 }} />
                        <InputBase
                            value={searchQuery}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder={`Filter ${moduleTitle.toLowerCase()}...`}
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.73rem',
                                color: '#ffffff',
                                width: '100%',
                                '& input::placeholder': {
                                    color: '#cbd5e1',
                                    opacity: 0.85,
                                },
                            }}
                        />
                    </Box>

                    {/* Show Close [X] button ONLY when the right drawer is collapsed */}
                    {isRightDrawerCollapsed && onClose && (
                        <Tooltip title="Close Related View & Return to Table">
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                onClick={onClose}
                                aria-label="Close related view"
                                sx={{
                                    color: '#cbd5e1',
                                    p: 0.6,
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                    flexShrink: 0,
                                    '&:hover': {
                                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)',
                                        color: '#ffffff',
                                    },
                                }}
                            >
                                <CloseIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                            </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                    )}
                </Box>
            </Box>

            {/* ── Scrollable Universal DataTable Body ──────────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    flex: 1,
                    overflow: 'auto',
                    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                }}
            >
                <DataTable<RelatedRow>
                    data={filteredAndSortedRecords}
                    columns={columns}
                    selectable={false}
                    sortField={sortField}
                    sortOrder={sortOrder}
                    onSort={handleSort}
                    activeRowId={activeRowId}
                    onRowClick={(row) => {
                        setActiveRowId(String(row.id ?? ''));
                        onRowClick(row, moduleKey);
                    }}
                    emptyTitle={`No ${moduleTitle.toLowerCase()} records found`}
                    emptyDescription={`No linked ${moduleTitle.toLowerCase()} records matched for ${parentEntityTitle || 'this record'}.`}
                    minHeight={240}
                />
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

import React from 'react';
import type { SxProps, Theme } from '@mui/material';
import type { AuditEntityType } from '@/hooks/queries/useAuditLogs';

export interface DrawerTabItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon: React.ReactNode;
    badge?: React.ReactNode | number | string;
    content: React.ReactNode;
}

export interface AuditRevisionItem {
    title: string;
    author: string;
    time: string;
    from?: string;
    to?: string;
    note?: string;
    tag?: string;
}

export interface DrawerBadgeItem {
    label: string;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    color?: string;
    backgroundColor?: string;
    borderColor?: string;
    isMonospace?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Standard form tab definition exported by creation forms.
 * Represents the single source of truth for tab identification, label, and icon.
 */
export interface FormTabDefinition {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon: React.ReactNode;
    sublabel?: string;
    badge?: React.ReactNode | number | string;
    hasDot?: boolean;
}


export interface DrawerActionButtonProps {
    label: string;
    onClick: () => void;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    variant?: 'text' | 'outlined' | 'contained';
    disabled?: boolean;
    tooltip?: string;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

export interface EntityDetailDrawerProps {
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    avatarText?: string;
    avatarIcon?: React.ReactNode;
    avatarBg?: string;
    verified?: boolean;
    loading?: boolean;
    badges?: DrawerBadgeItem[];
    headerActions?: {
        onEdit?: () => void;
        onSync?: () => void;
        onView?: () => void;
        custom?: React.ReactNode;
    };
    tabs?: DrawerTabItem[];
    formTabs?: readonly FormTabDefinition[] | FormTabDefinition[];
    tabContents?: Record<string, React.ReactNode>;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    /** The record whose revision trail the 'Changes' tab loads; the tab is omitted without it. */
    auditEntity?: { type: AuditEntityType; id: string };
    includeChangesTab?: boolean; // Default true: attaches the standardized 'Changes' tab (needs auditEntity)
    changesTabLabel?: string; // Default 'Changes'
    defaultTabIndex?: number;
    statusText?: string;
    primaryAction?: DrawerActionButtonProps;
    secondaryAction?: DrawerActionButtonProps;
    footerActions?: React.ReactNode;
    width?: number | string | { xs?: string | number; sm?: string | number; md?: string | number };
    hideBackdrop?: boolean;
    onCollapseChange?: (collapsed: boolean) => void;
    /** Controlled collapse state. Overrides the shared stack context when provided. */
    isCollapsed?: boolean;
    /** Controlled toggle handler. Overrides the shared stack context when provided. */
    onToggleCollapse?: () => void;
    /** Whether this drawer renders the floating bookmark tab (default true). */
    showBookmark?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Dynamically builds DrawerTabItem[] by mapping directly over the creation form's exported tab definitions.
 * Eliminates duplicate/hardcoded labels across side drawers and guarantees 100% sync with creation forms.
 */
export function buildDrawerTabs<T extends string = string>(
    formTabs: readonly FormTabDefinition[] | FormTabDefinition[],
    contentMap: Partial<Record<T, React.ReactNode>>
): DrawerTabItem[] {
    return formTabs.map((tab) => ({
        id: tab.id,
        label: tab.label,
        icon: tab.icon,
        badge: tab.badge,
        content: contentMap[tab.id as T] || null,
    }));
}

"use client";

import { Alert } from '@mui/material';

interface ErrorAlertProps {
    id?: string;
    error: string | null;
    onClose?: () => void;
}

export function ErrorAlert({ id = 'error-alert', error, onClose }: ErrorAlertProps) {
    if (!error) return null;

    return (
        <Alert
            id={id}
            severity="error"
            sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: '10px', fontSize: '13px' }}
            onClose={onClose}
        >
            {error}
        </Alert>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Alert, Box, MenuItem, Select, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import type { ColumnMapping, ImportEntityConfig, ParsedFile } from './types';

export interface ColumnMappingStepProps {
    config: ImportEntityConfig;
    parsed: ParsedFile;
    mapping: ColumnMapping;
    onChange: (mapping: ColumnMapping) => void;
}

export function ColumnMappingStep({ config, parsed, mapping, onChange }: ColumnMappingStepProps) {
    const anyMapped = Object.values(mapping).some(Boolean);

    return (
        <Box>
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b', mb: 1.5 }}>
                Match the columns found in <strong>{parsed.fileName}</strong> ({parsed.rows.length} rows) to CRM fields.
            </Typography>

            {!anyMapped && (
                <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ mb: 2, fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                    None of the file headers matched automatically. Please map the columns manually.
                </Alert>
            )}

            <Box sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '10px', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', px: 2, py: 1, borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', letterSpacing: 0.4 }}>CRM FIELD</Typography>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', letterSpacing: 0.4 }}>COLUMN IN FILE</Typography>
                </Box>
                {config.fields.map((f, i) => (
                    <Box
                        key={f.key}
                        sx={{
                            display: 'grid',
                            gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 2,
                            px: 2,
                            py: 1,
                            borderBottom: i === config.fields.length - 1 ? 'none' : '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                        }}
                    >
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            {f.label}
                            {f.required && <Box component="span" sx={{ color: '#dc2626', ml: 0.4 }}>*</Box>}
                        </Typography>
                        <Select
                            size="small"
                            displayEmpty
                            value={mapping[f.key] ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...mapping, [f.key]: e.target.value })}
                            error={f.required && !mapping[f.key]}
                            sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', backgroundColor: '#fff' }}
                        >
                            <MenuItem value="" sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                                — Don&apos;t import —
                            </MenuItem>
                            {parsed.headers.map((h) => (
                                <MenuItem key={h} value={h} sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                                    {h}
                                </MenuItem>
                            ))}
                        </Select>
                    </Box>
                ))}
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

    '&.Mui-disabled': { background: '#cbd5e1', color: '#fff' },
} as const;

const textBtnSx = { textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569' } as const;

/** Mounts a fresh wizard each time it opens so no state carries over between imports. */
export function DataImportModal(props: DataImportModalProps) {
    return props.open ? <DataImportWizard {...props} /> : null;
}

function DataImportWizard({ open, entity, onClose, onImported }: DataImportModalProps) {
    const config = IMPORT_CONFIGS[entity];
    const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
    const [parsed, setParsed] = useState<ParsedFile | null>(null);
    const [mapping, setMapping] = useState<ColumnMapping>({});
    const [parsing, setParsing] = useState(false);
    const [starting, setStarting] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    /** Set once the backend accepted the rows: a queued job to poll, or the result it already returned. */
    const [queued, setQueued] = useState<{ importId: string; total: number } | null>(null);
    const [inlineResult, setInlineResult] = useState<ImportResult | null>(null);

    // Polls the BullMQ job until it completes or fails.
    const job = useQuery({
        queryKey: ['importJob', queued?.importId],
        queryFn: () => importService.job(queued!.importId),
        enabled: Boolean(queued),
        refetchInterval: (query) => (TERMINAL_STATES.has(query.state.data?.state ?? '') ? false : JOB_POLL_MS),
        staleTime: 0,
    });
    const result = inlineResult ?? (job.data?.state === 'completed' ? (job.data.result ?? null) : null);
    const jobFailed = job.data?.state === 'failed' ? job.data.failedReason || 'The import job failed.' : null;
    const running = Boolean(queued) && !result && !jobFailed && !job.isError;

    // Refresh lists and tell the caller exactly once, when the result arrives.
    const reported = useRef(false);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!result || reported.current) return;
        reported.current = true;
        if (result.created > 0) notifyCrmUpdate(`/api/${entity}`);
        onImported(result.created);
    }, [result, entity, onImported]);

    const mappedRows = useMemo(
        () => (parsed ? mapAndValidateRows(entity, parsed, mapping) : []),
        [entity, parsed, mapping]
    );
    const validRows = useMemo(() => mappedRows.filter((r) => r.errors.length === 0), [mappedRows]);

    const missingRequired = config.fields.filter((f) => f.required && !mapping[f.key]);

    const handleFile = async (file: File) => {
        setError(null);
        setParsing(true);
        try {
            const result = await parseFile(file);
            setParsed(result);
            setMapping(autoMapColumns(entity, result.headers));
            setStep(1);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not read this file.');
        } finally {
            setParsing(false);
        }
    };

    const handleImport = async () => {
        if (validRows.length === 0) return;
        setStarting(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const rows = validRows.map(({ rowNumber, values }) => ({ rowNumber, values }));
            const started = await importService.start(entity, rows, parsed?.fileName);
            if (started.status === 'completed') setInlineResult(started.result);
            else setQueued({ importId: started.importId, total: started.total });
            setStep(3);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Import failed. Please try again.');
        } finally {
            setStarting(false);
        }
    };

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onClose={starting ? undefined : onClose}
            fullWidth
            maxWidth="md"
            slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { borderRadius: '14px', boxShadow: '0 20px 50px rgba(15,23,42,0.18)' } } }}
        >
            <DialogTitle sx={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a', pb: 1 }}>
                Import {config.plural}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
                <Stepper activeStep={step} sx={{ mb: 3, mt: 1 }}>
                    {STEPS.map((label) => (
                        <Step key={label}>
                            <StepLabel>{label}</StepLabel>
                        </Step>
                    ))}
                </Stepper>

                {step === 0 && (
                    <FileUploadDropzone
                        loading={parsing}
                        error={error}
                        entityPlural={config.plural}
                        onFileSelected={handleFile}
                        onDownloadTemplate={() => downloadSampleTemplate(entity)}
                    />
                )}

                {step === 1 && parsed && (
                    <ColumnMappingStep config={config} parsed={parsed} mapping={mapping} onChange={setMapping} />
                )}

                {step === 2 && parsed && (
                    <Box>
                        <ImportPreviewStep config={config} rows={mappedRows} />
                        {validRows.length === 0 && (
                            <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ mt: 2, fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                                No valid rows to import. Go back and adjust the column mapping.
                            </Alert>
                        )}
                        {error && (
                            <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2, fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                                {error}
                            </Alert>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                )}

                {step === 3 && (
                    <ImportResultsStep
                        plural={config.plural}
                        total={queued?.total ?? result?.total ?? validRows.length}
                        progress={result ? 100 : (job.data?.progress ?? 0)}
                        state={result ? 'completed' : (job.data?.state ?? 'waiting')}
                        result={result}
                        error={jobFailed ?? (job.isError ? 'Lost track of the import. It may still finish; refresh the list in a moment.' : null)}
                    />
                )}
            </DialogContent>
            <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, py: 2, borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
                <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={starting} sx={textBtnSx}>
                    {step === 3 ? (running ? 'Run in background' : 'Close') : 'Cancel'}
                </Button>
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }} />
                {step > 0 && step < 3 && (
                    <Button onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)} disabled={starting} sx={textBtnSx}>
                        Back
                    </Button>
                )}
                {step === 1 && (
                    <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        disabled={missingRequired.length > 0}
                        onClick={() => setStep(2)}
                        sx={primaryBtnSx}
                    >
                        {missingRequired.length > 0 ? `Map ${missingRequired[0].label} to continue` : 'Next'}
                    </Button>
                )}
                {step === 2 && (
                    <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        disabled={starting || validRows.length === 0}
                        onClick={handleImport}
                        startIcon={starting ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : undefined}
                        sx={primaryBtnSx}
                    >
                        {starting ? 'Uploading…' : `Import ${validRows.length} Record${validRows.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
                    </Button>
                )}
            </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

const STATE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
    waiting: 'Queued, waiting for a worker…',
    delayed: 'Queued, waiting for a worker…',
    active: 'Importing…',
};

function ImportResultsStep({ plural, total, progress, state, result, error }: {
    plural: string;
    total: number;
    progress: number;
    state: string;
    result: ImportResult | null;
    error: string | null;
}) {
    if (error) return <Alert severity="error" sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{error}</Alert>;
    if (!result) {
        return (
            <Box sx={{ py: 3 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#0f172a', mb: 1 }}>
                    {STATE_LABELS[state] ?? 'Importing…'} ({total} rows)
                </Typography>
                <LinearProgress variant={progress > 0 ? 'determinate' : 'indeterminate'} value={progress} sx={{ height: 8, borderRadius: 4 }} />
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 1 }}>
                    You can close this window; the import keeps running on the server.
                </Typography>
            </Box>
        );
    }
    const failedCount = result.failed.length;
    return (
        <Box>
            <Alert severity={failedCount === 0 ? 'success' : result.created > 0 ? 'warning' : 'error'} sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', mb: 2 }}>
                Imported {result.created} of {result.total} {plural.toLowerCase()}
                {failedCount > 0 ? `; ${failedCount} row${failedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} could not be imported.` : '.'}
            </Alert>
            {failedCount > 0 && (
                <Box sx={{ maxHeight: 280, overflowY: 'auto', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
                    {result.failed.map((row) => (
                        <Box key={row.rowNumber} sx={{ px: 1.5, py: 1, borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9', display: 'flex', gap: 1.5 }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#334155', minWidth: 56 }}>Row {row.rowNumber}</Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#b91c1c' }}>{row.errors.join(' · ')}</Typography>
                        </Box>
                    ))}
                </Box>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Box, Button, CircularProgress, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import CloudUploadOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CloudUploadOutlined';
import { ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS } from './parseFile';

export interface FileUploadDropzoneProps {
    loading: boolean;
    error: string | null;
    entityPlural: string;
    onFileSelected: (file: File) => void;
    onDownloadTemplate: () => void;
}

export function FileUploadDropzone({ loading, error, entityPlural, onFileSelected, onDownloadTemplate }: FileUploadDropzoneProps) {
    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);

    const handleFiles = (files: FileList | null) => {
        const file = files?.[0];
        if (file) onFileSelected(file);
    };

    return (
        <Box>
            <Box
                role="button"
                tabIndex={0}
                onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        inputRef.current?.click();
                    }
                }}
                onDragOver={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setDragging(true);
                }}
                onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
                onDrop={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setDragging(false);
                    handleFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
                }}
                sx={{
                    border: '2px dashed',
                    borderColor: dragging ? '#2563eb' : '#cbd5e1',
                    backgroundColor: dragging ? '#eff6ff' : '#f8fafc',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    py: 5,
                    px: 2,
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#2563eb', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
                }}
            >
                <input
                    ref={inputRef}
                    type="file"
                    hidden
                    accept={ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS.join(',')}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                        handleFiles(e.target.files);
                        e.target.value = '';
                    }}
                />
                {loading ? (
                    <CircularProgress size={32} />
                ) : (
                    <CloudUploadOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                )}
                <Typography sx={{ mt: 1, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.92rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>
                    {loading ? 'Reading file…' : 'Drag & drop your file here, or click to browse'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.4 }}>
                    Supports .csv, .xlsx and .xls (max 10 MB)
                </Typography>
            </Box>

            {error && (
                <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2, fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                    {error}
                </Alert>
            )}

            <Box
                sx={{
                    mt: 2.5,
                    p: 1.8,
                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    borderRadius: '10px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 2,
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                }}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', maxWidth: 420 }}>
                    Not sure about the format? Use our template: the first row must contain column headers, followed by one {entityPlural.toLowerCase().replace(/s$/, '')} per row.
                </Typography>
                <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    size="small"
                    onClick={onDownloadTemplate}
                    sx={{
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                        borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                        color: '#1d4ed8',
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        '&:hover': { borderColor: '#bfdbfe', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
                    }}
                >
                    📄 Download Sample Template (CSV)
                </Button>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

const normalize = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_\-./]+/g, ' ').trim();

/** Pre-selects a file header for each entity field using exact label/key matches, then aliases. */
export function autoMapColumns(entity: ImportEntityType, headers: string[]): ColumnMapping {
    const mapping: ColumnMapping = {};
    const used = new Set<string>();
    const normHeaders = headers.map((h) => ({ header: h, norm: normalize(h) }));
    const fields = IMPORT_CONFIGS[entity].fields;

    const claim = (fieldKey: string, candidates: string[]) => {
        const hit = normHeaders.find((h) => !used.has(h.header) && candidates.includes(h.norm));
        if (hit) {
            mapping[fieldKey] = hit.header;
            used.add(hit.header);
        }
    };

    fields.forEach((f) => {
        mapping[f.key] = '';
    });
    // Exact label/key matches take priority over aliases so e.g. "Name" never steals "Organization Name".
    fields.forEach((f) => claim(f.key, [normalize(f.label), normalize(f.key)]));
    fields.forEach((f) => {
        if (!mapping[f.key]) claim(f.key, f.aliases.map(normalize));
    });
    return mapping;
}

const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

/** Applies the column mapping and validates required fields / email format. */
export function mapAndValidateRows(entity: ImportEntityType, parsed: ParsedFile, mapping: ColumnMapping): MappedRow[] {
    const fields = IMPORT_CONFIGS[entity].fields;
    return parsed.rows.map((raw, idx) => {
        const values: Record<string, string> = {};
        const errors: string[] = [];
        fields.forEach((f) => {
            const header = mapping[f.key];
            values[f.key] = header ? (raw[header] ?? '').trim() : '';
            if (f.required && !values[f.key]) errors.push(`${f.label} is required`);
        });
        if (values.email && !EMAIL_RE.test(values.email)) errors.push('Invalid email');
        return { rowNumber: idx + 2, values, errors };
    });
}

const csvCell = (s: string) => (/[",\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s);

/** Downloads a CSV with the exact header labels and two illustrative rows. */
export function downloadSampleTemplate(entity: ImportEntityType): void {
    const { fields, plural } = IMPORT_CONFIGS[entity];
    const lines = [
        fields.map((f) => csvCell(f.label)).join(','),
        fields.map((f) => csvCell(f.sample[0])).join(','),
        fields.map((f) => csvCell(f.sample[1])).join(','),
    ];
    const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\r\n')], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${plural.toLowerCase()}_import_template.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableContainer, TableHead, TableRow, Tooltip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import type { ImportEntityConfig, MappedRow } from './types';

export interface ImportPreviewStepProps {
    config: ImportEntityConfig;
    rows: MappedRow[];
    previewLimit?: number;
}

const badgeSx = (bg: string, color: string, border: string) => ({
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    px: 1.2,
    py: 0.4,
    borderRadius: '12px',
    fontSize: '0.75rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    backgroundColor: bg,
    color,
    border: `1px solid ${border}`,
});

const headCellSx = { fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' } as const;

export function ImportPreviewStep({ config, rows, previewLimit = 8 }: ImportPreviewStepProps) {
    const validCount = rows.filter((r) => r.errors.length === 0).length;
    const errorCount = rows.length - validCount;
    const preview = rows.slice(0, previewLimit);

    return (
        <Box>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1.2, mb: 2, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <Box sx={badgeSx('#ecfdf5', '#059669', '#a7f3d0')}>Valid rows: {validCount}</Box>
                <Box sx={badgeSx(errorCount ? '#fef2f2' : '#f8fafc', errorCount ? '#dc2626' : '#64748b', errorCount ? '#fecaca' : '#e2e8f0')}>
                    Errors / Missing required: {errorCount}
                </Box>
            </Box>

            <TableContainer sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '10px', maxHeight: 340 }}>
                <Table size="small" stickyHeader>
                    <TableHead>
                        <TableRow>
                            <TableCell sx={headCellSx}>ROW</TableCell>
                            <TableCell sx={headCellSx}>STATUS</TableCell>
                            {config.fields.map((f) => (
                                <TableCell key={f.key} sx={headCellSx}>
                                    {f.label.toUpperCase()}
                                </TableCell>
                            ))}
                        </TableRow>
                    </TableHead>
                    <TableBody>
                        {preview.map((r) => {
                            const ok = r.errors.length === 0;
                            return (
                                <TableRow key={r.rowNumber} sx={{ backgroundColor: ok ? 'transparent' : '#fffafa' }}>
                                    <TableCell sx={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: '#64748b' }}>{r.rowNumber}</TableCell>
                                    <TableCell>
                                        <Tooltip title={ok ? '' : r.errors.join(', ')}>
                                            <Box component="span" sx={badgeSx(ok ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef2f2', ok ? '#059669' : '#dc2626', ok ? '#a7f3d0' : '#fecaca')}>
                                                {ok ? 'Valid' : 'Error'}
                                            </Box>
                                        </Tooltip>
                                    </TableCell>
                                    {config.fields.map((f) => (
                                        <TableCell key={f.key} sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#334155', maxWidth: 180 }}>
                                            <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: 'inherit' }}>
                                                {r.values[f.key] || '-'}
                                            </Typography>
                                        </TableCell>
                                    ))}
                                </TableRow>
                            );
                        })}
                    </TableBody>
                </Table>
            </TableContainer>

            {rows.length > previewLimit && (
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#94a3b8', mt: 1 }}>
                    Showing first {previewLimit} of {rows.length} rows. Rows with errors are skipped on import.
                </Typography>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/common/import/parseFile.ts
