import Papa from 'papaparse';
import type { ParsedFile, RawRow } from './types';

export const ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS = ['.csv', '.xlsx', '.xls'];
const MAX_FILE_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

const cellToString = (value: unknown): string => {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
    if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return String(value).trim();
};

function buildParsed(fileName: string, matrix: unknown[][]): ParsedFile {
    const nonEmpty = matrix.filter((r) => r.some((c) => cellToString(c) !== ''));
    if (nonEmpty.length === 0) throw new Error('The file is empty.');

    const rawHeaders = nonEmpty[0].map(cellToString);
    const seen = new Map<string, number>();
    const headers = rawHeaders.map((h, i) => {
        const base = h || `Column ${i + 1}`;
        const count = seen.get(base) ?? 0;
        seen.set(base, count + 1);
        return count === 0 ? base : `${base} (${count + 1})`;
    });

    const rows: RawRow[] = nonEmpty.slice(1).map((r) => {
        const row: RawRow = {};
        headers.forEach((h, i) => {
            row[h] = cellToString(r[i]);
        });
        return row;
    });

    if (rows.length === 0) throw new Error('The file has headers but no data rows.');
    return { fileName, headers, rows };
}

function parseCsv(file: File): Promise<unknown[][]> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        Papa.parse<string[]>(file, {
            skipEmptyLines: 'greedy',
            complete: (res) => resolve(res.data),
            error: (err: Error) => reject(new Error(`Could not read CSV: ${err.message}`)),
        });
    });
}

async function parseSpreadsheet(file: File): Promise<unknown[][]> {
    // Loaded lazily so the large xlsx bundle is only fetched when needed.
    const XLSX = await import('xlsx');
    try {
        const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: 'array', cellDates: true });
        const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
        if (!sheetName) throw new Error('No sheets found');
        return XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<unknown[]>(workbook.Sheets[sheetName], {
            header: 1,
            blankrows: false,
            defval: '',
        });
    } catch {
        throw new Error('Could not read this spreadsheet. It may be corrupted or password protected.');
    }
}

/** Parses a .csv / .xlsx / .xls file. Throws an Error with a user-friendly message on failure. */
export async function parseFile(file: File): Promise<ParsedFile> {
    const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
    const ext = ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS.find((e) => name.endsWith(e));
    if (!ext) throw new Error('Unsupported file type. Please upload a .csv, .xlsx or .xls file.');
    if (file.size === 0) throw new Error('The file is empty.');
    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) throw new Error('The file is too large (max 10 MB).');

    const matrix = ext === '.csv' ? await parseCsv(file) : await parseSpreadsheet(file);
    return buildParsed(file.name, matrix);
}

const NO_CONTACTS: Contact[] = [];

export function ContactLookupModal({ open, onClose, onSelect, selectedValue }: EntityLookupModalProps<Contact>) {
    // Shared, cache-invalidated query: contacts created elsewhere show up without reopening.
    const { data: contacts = NO_CONTACTS } = useContacts();
    const selectedId = contacts.find((c) => c.name === selectedValue)?.id;

        <GenericLookupModal<Contact>
            open={open}

            onSelect={onSelect}
            data={open ? contacts : NO_CONTACTS}

    );

'use client';

import React, { useDeferredValue, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogTitle,
    Grid,
    IconButton,
    InputAdornment,
    MenuItem,
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableContainer,
    TableHead,
    TablePagination,
    TableRow,
    TextField,
    Typography,
} from '@mui/material';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import RestartAltIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestartAlt';
import SearchOffIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SearchOff';
import type {
    LookupColumn,
    LookupFilterField,
    LookupFilterValues,
    LookupSearchPredicate,
} from '@/types/lookup.types';

export interface GenericLookupModalProps<T extends { id: string }> {
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onSelect: (item: T) => void;
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    columns: LookupColumn<T>[];
    data: T[];
    filterFields?: LookupFilterField[];
    /** Receives the filter values and the main search text. Defaults to text match + exact filter match. */
    searchPredicate?: LookupSearchPredicate<T>;
    selectedId?: string;
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    rowsPerPage?: number;
}

const inputSx = {
    '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
        fontSize: '0.82rem',
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        '& fieldset': { borderColor: '#e2e8f0' },
        '&:hover fieldset': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1' },
        '&.Mui-focused fieldset': { borderColor: '#2563eb' },
    },
    '& .MuiInputLabel-root': { fontSize: '0.8rem' },
} as const;

const headCellSx = {
    fontSize: '0.68rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    color: '#64748b',
    letterSpacing: 0.4,
    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
    borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
} as const;

const fieldValue = <T,>(item: T, key: string): string => {
    const v = (item as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    return v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v);
};

const cellText = <T,>(row: T, col: LookupColumn<T>): string =>
    col.getValue ? col.getValue(row) : fieldValue(row, col.id);

const initialFilters = (fields: LookupFilterField[]): LookupFilterValues =>
    Object.fromEntries(fields.map((f) => [f.key, f.defaultValue ?? '']));

/**
 * Universal record picker dialog: filter bar, results table and pagination.
 * Clicking a row (or pressing Enter on it) calls `onSelect` and closes the dialog.
 */
export function GenericLookupModal<T extends { id: string }>(props: GenericLookupModalProps<T>) {
    // Mount a fresh instance per open so filters and paging always start from their defaults.
    return props.open ? <LookupDialog {...props} /> : null;
}

function LookupDialog<T extends { id: string }>({
    onClose,
    onSelect,
    title,
    subtitle,
    columns,
    data,
    filterFields = [],
    searchPredicate,
    selectedId,
    searchPlaceholder = 'Search…',
    rowsPerPage = 25,
}: GenericLookupModalProps<T>) {
    const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
    const [filters, setFilters] = useState<LookupFilterValues>(() => initialFilters(filterFields));
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const firstRowRef = useRef<HTMLTableRowElement>(null);
    const deferredQuery = useDeferredValue(query);

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        const q = deferredQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
        return data.filter((item) => {
            if (searchPredicate) return searchPredicate(item, filters, q);
            const filtersMatch = filterFields.every((f) => !filters[f.key] || fieldValue(item, f.key) === filters[f.key]);
            if (!filtersMatch) return false;
            return !q || columns.some((c) => cellText(item, c).toLowerCase().includes(q));
        });
    }, [data, deferredQuery, filters, filterFields, columns, searchPredicate]);

    const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / rowsPerPage));
    const safePage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
    const pageRows = filtered.slice(safePage * rowsPerPage, safePage * rowsPerPage + rowsPerPage);
    const rangeStart = filtered.length === 0 ? 0 : safePage * rowsPerPage + 1;
    const rangeEnd = safePage * rowsPerPage + pageRows.length;

    const updateFilter = (key: string, value: string) => {
        setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
        setPage(0);
    };

    const handleReset = () => {
        setQuery('');
        setFilters(initialFilters(filterFields));
        setPage(0);
    };

    const choose = (row: T) => {
        onSelect(row);
        onClose();
    };

    return (
        <Dialog
            open
            onClose={onClose}
            fullWidth
            maxWidth="lg"
            aria-labelledby="lookup-dialog-title"
            slotProps={{
                paper: { sx: { borderRadius: '14px', boxShadow: '0 20px 50px rgba(15,23,42,0.18)', maxHeight: '88vh' } },
            }}
        >
            <DialogTitle id="lookup-dialog-title" sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, pb: 1.5, borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            {title}
                        </Typography>
                        <Box
                            component="span"
                            sx={{
                                px: 1,
                                py: 0.2,
                                borderRadius: '10px',
                                fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                color: '#1d4ed8',
                                backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                            }}
                        >
                            {data.length} records
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                    {subtitle && <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.3 }}>{subtitle}</Typography>}
                </Box>
                <IconButton aria-label="Close" onClick={onClose} size="small" sx={{ color: '#64748b' }}>
                    <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
            </DialogTitle>

            <DialogContent sx={{ p: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                {/* Filter bar */}
                <Box
                    component="form"
                    onSubmit={(e: React.FormEvent) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        firstRowRef.current?.focus();
                    }}
                    sx={{ px: 3, py: 2, backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}
                >
                    <Grid container spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: 'center' }}>
                        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 3 }}>
                            <TextField
                                autoFocus
                                fullWidth
                                size="small"
                                label="Search"
                                placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                                value={query}
                                onChange={(e) => {
                                    setQuery(e.target.value);
                                    setPage(0);
                                }}
                                sx={inputSx}
                                slotProps={{
                                    input: {
                                        startAdornment: (
                                            <InputAdornment position="start">
                                                <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                            </InputAdornment>
                                        ),
                                    },
                                }}
                            />
                        </Grid>
                        {filterFields.map((f) => (
                            <Grid key={f.key} size={{ xs: 6, md: f.width ?? 2 }}>
                                {f.type === 'select' ? (
                                    <TextField
                                        select
                                        fullWidth
                                        size="small"
                                        label={f.label}
                                        value={filters[f.key] ?? ''}
                                        onChange={(e) => updateFilter(f.key, e.target.value)}
                                        sx={inputSx}
                                    >
                                        {(f.options ?? []).map((o) => (
                                            <MenuItem key={o.value} value={o.value} sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                                                {o.label}
                                            </MenuItem>
                                        ))}
                                    </TextField>
                                ) : (
                                    <TextField
                                        fullWidth
                                        size="small"
                                        label={f.label}
                                        placeholder={f.placeholder}
                                        value={filters[f.key] ?? ''}
                                        onChange={(e) => updateFilter(f.key, e.target.value)}
                                        sx={inputSx}
                                    />
                                )}
                            </Grid>
                        ))}
                        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 'grow' }} sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                            <Button
                                type="submit"
                                variant="contained"
                                size="small"
                                startIcon={<SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                sx={{
                                    background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    borderRadius: '8px',
                                    height: 36,
                                    px: 2,
                                    boxShadow: 'none',
                                    '&:hover': { background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)', boxShadow: 'none' },
                                }}
                            >
                                Search
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                                variant="outlined"
                                size="small"
                                onClick={handleReset}
                                startIcon={<RestartAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                sx={{
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                    borderRadius: '8px',
                                    height: 36,
                                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                                    color: '#475569',
                                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                }}
                            >
                                Clear
                            </Button>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </Box>

                {/* Results */}
                <TableContainer sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 240 }}>
                    <Table size="small" stickyHeader>
                        <TableHead>
                            <TableRow>
                                {columns.map((c) => (
                                    <TableCell key={c.id} align={c.align} sx={{ ...headCellSx, minWidth: c.minWidth, width: c.width }}>
                                        {c.label.toUpperCase()}
                                    </TableCell>
                                ))}
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHead>
                        <TableBody>
                            {pageRows.map((row, idx) => {
                                const isSelected = row.id === selectedId;
                                return (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={row.id}
                                        ref={idx === 0 ? firstRowRef : undefined}
                                        hover
                                        tabIndex={0}
                                        selected={isSelected}
                                        onClick={() => choose(row)}
                                        onKeyDown={(e) => {
                                            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                                                e.preventDefault();
                                                choose(row);
                                            }
                                        }}
                                        sx={{
                                            cursor: 'pointer',
                                            '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc !important' },
                                            '&.Mui-selected': { backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
                                            '&:focus-visible': { outline: '2px solid #2563eb', outlineOffset: -2 },
                                            '& td': { borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9' },
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {columns.map((c) => (
                                            <TableCell key={c.id} align={c.align} sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569', py: 1.1, width: c.width }}>
                                                {c.render ? c.render(row) : cellText(row, c) || '-'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        ))}
                                    </TableRow>
                                );
                            })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>

                    {filtered.length === 0 && (
                        <Box sx={{ py: 6, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                            <SearchOffIcon sx={{ fontSize: 36, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />
                            <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.9rem', color: '#334155', mt: 1 }}>
                                No matching records
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8', mt: 0.3 }}>
                                Try a different search term or clear the filters.
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </TableContainer>

                {/* Footer */}
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        px: 3,
                        borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    }}
                >
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        ({rangeStart} - {rangeEnd} of {filtered.length})
                    </Typography>
                    <TablePagination
                        component="div"
                        count={filtered.length}
                        page={safePage}
                        rowsPerPage={rowsPerPage}
                        rowsPerPageOptions={[]}
                        onPageChange={(_, p) => setPage(p)}
                        labelDisplayedRows={() => `Page ${safePage + 1} of ${pageCount}`}
                        sx={{ '& .MuiTablePagination-displayedRows': { fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' } }}
                    />
                </Box>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

const includesQuery = (query: string, ...values: (string | undefined)[]) =>
    !query || values.some((v) => (v || '').toLowerCase().includes(query));

    !filter || (value || '').toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase());

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { useOrganizations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';
import type { EntityLookupModalProps } from '@/types/lookup.types';
import { GenericLookupModal } from './GenericLookupModal';
import { ORGANIZATION_LOOKUP_PRESET } from './lookupConfigs';

const NO_ORGANIZATIONS: ExtendedOrganization[] = [];

export function OrganizationLookupModal({ open, onClose, onSelect, selectedValue }: EntityLookupModalProps<ExtendedOrganization>) {
    // Shared, cache-invalidated query: organizations created elsewhere show up without reopening.
    const { data: organizations = NO_ORGANIZATIONS } = useOrganizations();
    const selectedId = organizations.find((o) => o.organizationName === selectedValue)?.id;
    return (
        <GenericLookupModal<ExtendedOrganization>
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            onSelect={onSelect}
            data={open ? organizations : NO_ORGANIZATIONS}
            selectedId={selectedId}
            {...ORGANIZATION_LOOKUP_PRESET}
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { getNatureOfCalls } from '@/services/masterData.store';
import { getPartnerCompanies, getPartnerContacts } from '@/services/masterData.store';
import { useMasterData } from '@/hooks/queries/useMasterData';
import type { NatureOfCallItem } from '@/types/ticket.types';
import type { PartnerCompany, PartnerCompanyContact } from '@/types/partner.types';
import type { EntityLookupModalProps } from '@/types/lookup.types';
import { GenericLookupModal } from './GenericLookupModal';
import {
    NATURE_OF_CALL_LOOKUP_PRESET,
    PARTNER_COMPANY_LOOKUP_PRESET,
    PARTNER_COMPANY_CONTACT_LOOKUP_PRESET,
    type LookupPreset,
} from './lookupConfigs';

/**
 * Builds an entity lookup modal from a preset and a data source. `getLabel` is the value the field
 * stores, used to highlight the currently selected row.
 */
function createPresetLookupModal<T extends { id: string }>(
    preset: LookupPreset<T>,
    getData: () => T[],
    getLabel: (record: T) => string,
    displayName: string
) {
    function PresetLookupModal({ open, onClose, onSelect, selectedValue }: EntityLookupModalProps<T>) {
        // Subscribes to the masters so the list fills in once they load (API mode); getData reads the same store.
        useMasterData();
        const data = getData();
        const selected = selectedValue?.trim().toLowerCase();
        const selectedId = selected ? data.find((r) => getLabel(r).toLowerCase() === selected)?.id : undefined;
        return (
            <GenericLookupModal<T> open={open} onClose={onClose} onSelect={onSelect} data={data} selectedId={selectedId} {...preset} />
        );
    }
    PresetLookupModal.displayName = displayName;
    return PresetLookupModal;
}

export const NatureOfCallLookupModal = createPresetLookupModal<NatureOfCallItem>(
    NATURE_OF_CALL_LOOKUP_PRESET,
    getNatureOfCalls,
    (n) => n.name,
    'NatureOfCallLookupModal'
);

export const PartnerCompanyLookupModal = createPresetLookupModal<PartnerCompany>(
    PARTNER_COMPANY_LOOKUP_PRESET,
    getPartnerCompanies,
    (p) => p.companyName,
    'PartnerCompanyLookupModal'
);

export const PartnerCompanyContactLookupModal = createPresetLookupModal<PartnerCompanyContact>(
    PARTNER_COMPANY_CONTACT_LOOKUP_PRESET,
    getPartnerContacts,
    (c) => c.name,
    'PartnerCompanyContactLookupModal'
);

File: frontend-crm/src/components/common/lookup/RecordLookupModal.tsx

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    findCrmUser,
    getNatureOfCalls,
    getPartnerCompanies,
    getPartnerContacts,
} from '@/services/masterData.store';
import type { Contact } from '@/types/contact.types';
import type { EntityLookupModalProps, LookupKind, LookupRecordMap } from '@/types/lookup.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';
import { UserLookupModal } from './UserLookupModal';
import { OrganizationLookupModal } from './OrganizationLookupModal';
import { ContactLookupModal } from './ContactLookupModal';
import { NatureOfCallLookupModal, PartnerCompanyLookupModal, PartnerCompanyContactLookupModal } from './PresetLookupModals';

const LOOKUP_MODALS: { [K in LookupKind]: React.ComponentType<EntityLookupModalProps<LookupRecordMap[K]>> } = {
    user: UserLookupModal,
    organization: OrganizationLookupModal,
    contact: ContactLookupModal,
    natureOfCall: NatureOfCallLookupModal,
    partnerCompany: PartnerCompanyLookupModal,
    partnerCompanyContact: PartnerCompanyContactLookupModal,
};

/** Display value written into a lookup field for each kind of record. */
export const LOOKUP_DISPLAY_VALUE: { [K in LookupKind]: (record: LookupRecordMap[K]) => string } = {
    user: (u) => u.username,
    organization: (o) => o.organizationName,
    contact: (c) => c.name,
    natureOfCall: (n) => n.name,
    partnerCompany: (p) => p.companyName,
    partnerCompanyContact: (c) => c.name,
};

const sameText = (a: string, b: string) => a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();

/** Finds the first record whose label matches `value` exactly (case-insensitive); empty input matches nothing. */
const findByLabel = <T,>(records: T[], label: (r: T) => string, value: string) =>
    value.trim() ? records.find((r) => sameText(label(r), value)) : undefined;

export interface LookupRecordPools {
    organizations?: ExtendedOrganization[];
    contacts?: Contact[];
}

/** Resolves a typed / autocompleted field value back to its record (exact, case-insensitive match). */
export function findLookupRecord<K extends LookupKind>(
    kind: K,
    value: string,
    pools: LookupRecordPools = {}
): LookupRecordMap[K] | undefined {
    switch (kind) {
        case 'user':
            return findCrmUser(value) as LookupRecordMap[K] | undefined;
        case 'organization':
            return findByLabel(pools.organizations ?? [], (o) => o.organizationName, value) as LookupRecordMap[K] | undefined;
        case 'contact':
            return findByLabel(pools.contacts ?? [], (c) => c.name, value) as LookupRecordMap[K] | undefined;
        case 'natureOfCall':
            return findByLabel(getNatureOfCalls(), (n) => n.name, value) as LookupRecordMap[K] | undefined;
        case 'partnerCompany':
            return findByLabel(getPartnerCompanies(), (p) => p.companyName, value) as LookupRecordMap[K] | undefined;
        case 'partnerCompanyContact':
            return findByLabel(getPartnerContacts(), (c) => c.name, value) as LookupRecordMap[K] | undefined;
    }
}

export interface RecordLookupModalProps<K extends LookupKind> extends EntityLookupModalProps<LookupRecordMap[K]> {
    kind: K;
}

/** Renders the built-in lookup modal for `kind`. */
export function RecordLookupModal<K extends LookupKind>({ kind, ...props }: RecordLookupModalProps<K>) {
    const Modal: React.ComponentType<EntityLookupModalProps<LookupRecordMap[K]>> = LOOKUP_MODALS[kind];
    return <Modal {...props} />;
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Button } from '@mui/material';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import RefreshIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Refresh';
import { CreateSplitButton } from './CreateSplitButton';

export interface MasterHeaderActionsProps {
    onRefresh?: () => void;
    onNewClick?: () => void;
    newButtonLabel?: string;
    /** When provided, the New button becomes a split button with import options. */
    onImportClick?: () => void;
    /** Extra buttons rendered between Refresh and the New button (e.g. Export). */
    children?: React.ReactNode;
}

export const outlinedHeaderButtonSx = {
    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
    color: '#334155',
    backgroundColor: '#fff',
    textTransform: 'none',
    fontWeight: 600,
    fontSize: '0.8rem',
    borderRadius: '8px',
    height: 36,
    px: 1.8,
    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
} as const;

/** Standard right-aligned header action row shared by the entity master views. */
export function MasterHeaderActions({
    onRefresh,
    onNewClick,
    newButtonLabel = 'New Record',
    onImportClick,
    children,
}: MasterHeaderActionsProps) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.2, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {onRefresh && (
                <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    size="small"
                    startIcon={<RefreshIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                    onClick={onRefresh}
                    sx={outlinedHeaderButtonSx}
                >
                    Refresh
                </Button>
            )}

            {children}

            {onNewClick && onImportClick && (
                <CreateSplitButton
                    newButtonLabel={newButtonLabel}
                    onNewClick={onNewClick}
                    onImportClick={onImportClick}
                />
            )}

            {onNewClick && !onImportClick && (
                <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    size="small"
                    startIcon={<AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                    onClick={onNewClick}
                    sx={{
                        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
                        color: '#fff',
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        height: 36,
                        px: 2,
                        boxShadow: 'none',
                        '&:hover': { background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)' },
                    }}
                >
                    {newButtonLabel}
                </Button>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/common/RecordLink.tsx

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Typography, type SxProps, type Theme } from '@mui/material';

export interface RecordLinkProps {
    /** Full-page URL of the record; used for right-click / middle-click / Ctrl or Cmd + click. */
    href: string;
    /** Called on a plain left click instead of navigating (e.g. opens the side drawer). */
    onOpen: () => void;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

/**
 * A real anchor for a record's title/code. Plain left-click opens the side drawer; modifier
 * clicks, middle-click and the context menu fall through to the browser so the full page can
 * open in a new tab. Always stops propagation so the row's own click handler doesn't also fire.
 */
export function RecordLink({ href, onOpen, children, sx }: RecordLinkProps) {
    const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const isModified = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey;
        if (e.button === 0 && !isModified) {
            e.preventDefault();
            onOpen();
        }
    };

    return (
        <Typography
            component={Link}
            href={href}
            onClick={handleClick}
            sx={[{ textDecoration: 'none' }, ...(Array.isArray(sx) ? sx : [sx])]}
        >
            {children}
        </Typography>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/common/RelatedSecondaryDrawer.tsx

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';

import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Contact } from '@/types/contact.types';
import type { Lead } from '@/types/lead.types';
import type { Opportunity } from '@/types/opportunity.types';
import type { Quotation } from '@/types/quotation.types';
import type { Product } from '@/types/product.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';
import { ContactDetailDrawer } from '@/components/contacts/ContactDetailDrawer';
import { LeadDetailDrawer } from '@/components/leads/LeadDetailDrawer';
import { OpportunityDetailDrawer } from '@/components/opportunities/OpportunityDetailDrawer';
import { QuotationDetailDrawer } from '@/components/quotations/QuotationDetailDrawer';
import { ProductDetailDrawer } from '@/components/products/ProductDetailDrawer';
import { OrganizationDetailDrawer } from '@/components/organizations/OrganizationDetailDrawer';
import { TicketDetailDrawer } from '@/components/tickets/TicketDetailDrawer';
import type { Ticket } from '@/types/ticket.types';
import {
    EntityDetailDrawer,
    DrawerSectionCard,
    DrawerMetricGrid,
} from '@/components/common/Drawer';

export interface SecondaryDrawerEntity {
    type: string;
    data: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface RelatedSecondaryDrawerProps {
    entity: SecondaryDrawerEntity | null;
    /** Display label of the module the row was clicked in (used by the generic fallback drawer). */
    moduleLabel?: string;
    /** Title of the parent record that owns the related module (used as subtitle). */
    parentTitle?: string;
    onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Resolves and renders the stacked secondary detail drawer for a row clicked
 * inside the middle `RelatedRecordsTableView`. Shared by every master view so the
 * three-panel flow behaves identically across the CRM.
 */
export function RelatedSecondaryDrawer({
    entity,
    moduleLabel = 'Related Record',
    parentTitle = '',
    onClose,
}: RelatedSecondaryDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    if (!entity) return null;
    const { type, data } = entity;

    switch (type) {
        case 'contacts':
            return <ContactDetailDrawer contact={data as unknown as Contact} open onClose={onClose} />;

        case 'tickets':
            return <TicketDetailDrawer ticket={data as unknown as Ticket} open onClose={onClose} />;

        case 'leads':
            return (
                <LeadDetailDrawer
                    lead={data as unknown as Lead}
                    open
                    onClose={onClose}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(id))}
                />
            );

        case 'opportunities':
            return (
                <OpportunityDetailDrawer
                    opportunity={data as unknown as Opportunity}
                    open
                    onClose={onClose}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(id))}
                />
            );

        case 'quotations':
            return (
                <QuotationDetailDrawer
                    quotation={data as unknown as Quotation}
                    open
                    onClose={onClose}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(id))}
                />
            );

        case 'products':
            return <ProductDetailDrawer product={data as unknown as Product} open onClose={onClose} />;

        case 'organizations':
            return (
                <OrganizationDetailDrawer
                    organization={data as unknown as ExtendedOrganization}
                    open
                    onClose={onClose}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(id))}
                />
            );

        default: {
            const recordTitle = String(
                data.subject ||
                    data.name ||
                    data.contractTitle ||
                    data.partnerName ||
                    data.ticketNumber ||
                    moduleLabel
            );

            const detailFields = Object.entries(data)
                .filter(([key]) => key !== 'id')
                .map(([key, val]) => ({
                    label: key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').replace(/^./, (s) => s.toUpperCase()),
                    value: String(val ?? '-'),
                }));

            return (
                <EntityDetailDrawer
                    open
                    onClose={onClose}
                    title={recordTitle}
                    subtitle={`${moduleLabel}${parentTitle ? ` • ${parentTitle}` : ''}`}
                    statusText="Linked Record Verified"
                    tabs={[
                        {
                            id: 'overview',
                            label: 'Overview',
                            icon: <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                            content: (
                                <DrawerSectionCard title={`${moduleLabel} Details`}>
                                    <DrawerMetricGrid items={detailFields} />
                                </DrawerSectionCard>
                            ),
                        },
                    ]}
                />
            );
        }
    }
}

const getInitials = (name: string) => {
    const parts = name.replace(/[._-]+/g, ' ').trim().split(/\s+/);
    return ((parts[0]?.[0] ?? '') + (parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1][0] : '')).toUpperCase();
};

interface ChannelAction {
    label: string;
    href: string;
    icon: React.ReactElement;
    /** Hover accent colour. */
    color: string;
    external?: boolean;
}

/** Icon button rendered as a real link (tel:, sms:, mailto:, wa.me). */
function ChannelActionButton({ label, href, icon, color, external }: ChannelAction) {
    return (
        <Tooltip title={label}>
            <IconButton
                component="a"
                href={href}
                aria-label={label}
                size="small"
                {...(external && { target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener noreferrer' })}
                sx={{
                    width: 28,
                    height: 28,
                    color: '#64748b',
                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                    '&:hover': { color, borderColor: color, backgroundColor: `${color}0f` },
                }}
            >
                {icon}
            </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
    );
}

interface ChannelRowProps {
    icon: React.ReactElement;
    value: string;
    caption: string;
    tag?: string;
    actions: ChannelAction[];
    copyTitle: string;
}

function ChannelRow({ icon, value, caption, tag, actions, copyTitle }: ChannelRowProps) {
    return (

                                    px: 0.75,
                                    lineHeight: 1.6,

                            >
                                {tag}
                            </Box>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>{caption}</Typography>

'use client';

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Divider } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import ContactPhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContactPhoneOutlined';
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import TuneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TuneOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { ContactFormData } from '@/types/contact.types';
import { contactService } from '@/services';
import { contactFormSchema } from '../../validations';

import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';

// Reusable Production-grade Form Primitives
import { SectionLabel, useRhfForm } from '@/components/forms';

// Modular Contact Form Sections
import {
    ContactBasicInfoSection,
    ContactPhonesEmailsSection,
    ContactAssignmentSection,
    ContactPreferencesSection,
} from './sections';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Contact Form Tabs ──────────────────────────────
export const CONTACT_FORM_TABS: FormTabDefinition[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />,
    },
];

export interface ContactFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';
    initialData?: Partial<ContactFormData>;
    contactId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const DEFAULT_FORM: ContactFormData = {
    name: '',
    organizationName: '',
    mobile: '',
    officePhone: '',
    phone3: '',
    phone4: '',
    phone5: '',
    emailAddresses: [
        {
            id: 'email-1',
            email: '',
            isPrimary: true,
            isOptedOut: false,
            isInvalidBounce: false,
        },
    ],
    assignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',
    isPrimaryContact: false,
    designation: '',
    department: '',
    leftJob: 'No',
    communicationType: ['Call', 'Email'],
    doNotCall: false,
    description: '',
};

const sectionDividerSx = { my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' } as const;

export default function ContactForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    contactId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: ContactFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } = useRhfForm<ContactFormData>({
        schema: contactFormSchema,
        defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
    });
    const { reset, watch, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const contactName = watch('name');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Contacts', href: ROUTES.CONTACTS },
        { label: mode !== 'create' ? (contactName ? `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'}: ${contactName}` : `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'} Contact`) : 'Create Contact' },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!contactId) return;
        let active = true;
        contactService
            .getById(contactId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) reset({ ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...found });
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [contactId, reset]);

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            // With an id this is an edit: update (API mode reports a missing record as an error instead of
            // silently creating a duplicate). Only the mock store returns null for an unknown id.
            const updated = contactId ? await contactService.update(contactId, values) : null;
            if (!updated) await contactService.create(values);
            showToast(`Contact "${values.name}" saved successfully!`, 'success');
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACTS), 700);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save contact.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (mode === 'view') {
            router.push(ROUTES.CONTACTS);
            return;
        }
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved contact changes?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.CONTACTS);
    };

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={CONTACT_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab="overview"
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={mode === 'view' ? () => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_EDIT(contactId!)) : handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Edit Contact' : mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Contact' : 'Save Contact'}
                cancelLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Back' : 'Cancel'}
                recordView={{
                    title: contactName || '',
                    editHref: contactId ? ROUTES.CONTACT_EDIT(contactId) : undefined,
                    editLabel: 'Edit Contact',
                    backHref: ROUTES.CONTACTS,
                }}
                mode={mode}
                toast={<AppToast open={toast.open} message={toast.message} severity={toast.severity} onClose={closeToast} />}
            >
                <SectionLabel icon={<ContactPhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Contact Details & Association" />
                <ContactBasicInfoSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel icon={<ContactPhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Alternate Communication Channels" />
                <ContactPhonesEmailsSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel icon={<BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Internal Assignment & Department Role" />
                <ContactAssignmentSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel icon={<TuneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Notes" />
                <ContactPreferencesSection />
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import StarBorderIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StarBorder';
import ScheduleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Schedule';
import AccountCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircleOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import { RecordLink } from '../../common/RecordLink';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../../common/CommonMasterView';
import { MasterHeaderActions } from '../../common/MasterHeaderActions';
import { buildExtendedSearchConfig } from '../../common/buildExtendedSearchConfig';
import { AppToast } from '../../common/AppToast';
import { DataImportModal } from '../../common/import';
import { RelatedModulesSidebar, RelatedRecordsTableView } from '../../common/Drawer';
import { RelatedSecondaryDrawer, type SecondaryDrawerEntity } from '../../common/RelatedSecondaryDrawer';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
import { useRelatedModulesForEntity } from '@/config/relatedModules.config';
import { useContacts, useBulkDeleteContacts } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { Contact } from '@/types/contact.types';
import type { ContactFilterTab } from './types';
import { ContactDetailDrawer } from '../ContactDetailDrawer';


/** Stable empty list while the first page loads (keeps memoized filters from recomputing). */
const NO_RECORDS: Contact[] = [];
export function ContactsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const currentUsername = user?.username || '';

    const { data: contacts = NO_RECORDS, refetch } = useContacts();
    const bulkDeleteMutation = useBulkDeleteContacts();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ContactFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<string>('name');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
    // Tracked by id so the drawer always shows the cached copy and closes if the contact is deleted.
    const [drawerContactId, setDrawerContactId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const selectedDrawerContact = useMemo(
        () => (drawerContactId ? contacts.find((c) => c.id === drawerContactId) ?? null : null),
        [contacts, drawerContactId]
    );
    const [activeRelatedModule, setActiveRelatedModule] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [secondaryDrawerEntity, setSecondaryDrawerEntity] = useState<SecondaryDrawerEntity | null>(null);
    const [isLeftSidebarCollapsed, setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const [importOpen, setImportOpen] = useState(false);

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<ContactFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        const primary = contacts.filter((c) => c.isPrimaryContact).length;
        const myContacts = currentUsername ? contacts.filter((c) => c.assignedTo === currentUsername).length : 0;
        const oneWeekAgo = new Date().getTime() - 7 * 86400000;
        const recentlyAdded = contacts.filter((c) => new Date(c.createdAt).getTime() >= oneWeekAgo).length;

        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Contacts',
                icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: contacts.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'primary',
                label: 'Primary Contacts',
                icon: <StarBorderIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: primary,
            },
            {
                id: 'my_contacts',
                label: 'My Contacts',
                icon: <AccountCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: myContacts,
            },
            {
                id: 'recently_added',
                label: 'Recently Added',
                icon: <ScheduleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: recentlyAdded,
            },
        ];
    }, [contacts, currentUsername]);

    // ── Filter & Search Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredContacts = useMemo(() => {
        let result = contacts;

        if (activeTab === 'primary') {
            result = result.filter((c) => c.isPrimaryContact);
        } else if (activeTab === 'my_contacts') {
            result = currentUsername ? result.filter((c) => c.assignedTo === currentUsername) : [];
        } else if (activeTab === 'recently_added') {
            const oneWeekAgo = new Date().getTime() - 7 * 86400000;
            result = result.filter((c) => new Date(c.createdAt).getTime() >= oneWeekAgo);
        }

        if (searchQuery.trim()) {
            const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
            result = result.filter((c) => {
                const name = c.name?.toLowerCase() || '';
                const org = c.organizationName?.toLowerCase() || '';
                const mobile = c.mobile || '';
                const email = c.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email?.toLowerCase() || '';
                const designation = c.designation?.toLowerCase() || '';
                return (
                    name.includes(q) ||
                    org.includes(q) ||
                    mobile.includes(q) ||
                    email.includes(q) ||
                    designation.includes(q)
                );
            });
        }

        if (sortField) {
            result = [...result].sort((a, b) => {
                let valA: string | number = String((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] ?? '');
                let valB: string | number = String((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] ?? '');
                if (sortField === 'email') {
                    valA = a.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email ?? '';
                    valB = b.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email ?? '';
                }
                valA = valA.toLowerCase();
                valB = valB.toLowerCase();
                if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
                if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
                return 0;
            });
        }

        return result;
    }, [contacts, activeTab, searchQuery, sortField, sortOrder, currentUsername]);

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const paginatedContacts = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return filteredContacts.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [filteredContacts, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleToggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) =>
            prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...prev, id]
        );
    };

    const handleToggleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedContacts.map((c) => c.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${selectedIds.length} selected contact(s)?`)) return;
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        try {
            await bulkDeleteMutation.mutateAsync(selectedIds);
            setSelectedIds([]);
            setToast({
                open: true,
                message: `${count} contact(s) deleted successfully.`,
                severity: 'success',
            });
        } catch {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Failed to delete contacts.', severity: 'error' });
        }
    };

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ──────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Contact>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'name',
                label: 'NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                        <RecordLink
                            href={ROUTES.CONTACT_DETAIL(c.id)}
                            onOpen={() => setDrawerContactId(c.id)}
                            sx={{
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                color: '#1d4ed8',
                                fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                            }}
                        >
                            {c.name}
                        </RecordLink>
                        {c.isPrimaryContact && (
                            <Chip
                                label="Primary"
                                size="small"
                                sx={{
                                    height: 18,
                                    fontSize: '0.64rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                                }}
                            />
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 180,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#64748b' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                            {c.organizationName || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'mobile',
                label: 'MOBILE / PHONE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6 }}>
                        <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                            {c.mobile || c.officePhone || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'email',
                label: 'EMAIL',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 180,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6 }}>
                        <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                            {c.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'designation',
                label: 'DESIGNATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {c.designation || c.department || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedTo',
                label: 'ASSIGNED TO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {c.assignedTo || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    const relatedModules = useRelatedModulesForEntity('contact', selectedDrawerContact, setActiveRelatedModule);

    // Falls back to the first module until the user explicitly picks one.
    const effectiveRelatedModule = activeRelatedModule ?? relatedModules[0]?.id ?? null;
    const activeModuleMeta = relatedModules.find((m) => m.id === effectiveRelatedModule);

    // Dismisses the three-panel view and returns to the clean master table.
    const closeThreePanelView = useCallback(() => {
        setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);
        setDrawerContactId(null);
        setActiveRelatedModule(null);
    }, []);

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Contact, ContactFilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            tableId="contacts"
            headerActions={() => (
                <MasterHeaderActions
                    onRefresh={async () => {
                        const { isError } = await refetch();
                        setToast(
                            isError
                                ? { open: true, message: 'Failed to refresh contacts.', severity: 'error' }
                                : { open: true, message: 'Contacts refreshed.', severity: 'info' }
                        );
                    }}
                    onNewClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_NEW)}
                    newButtonLabel="New Contact"
                    onImportClick={() => setImportOpen(true)}
                />
            )}
            searchConfig={buildExtendedSearchConfig({
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by name, organization, phone, email...',
                pageIds: paginatedContacts.map((r) => r.id),
                allIds: filteredContacts.map((r) => r.id),
                selectedIds,
                onSelectedIdsChange: setSelectedIds,
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalRecords: filteredContacts.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            })}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedContacts}
            keyExtractor={(c) => c.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleToggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(c) => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_DETAIL(c.id))}
            getEditHref={(c) => ROUTES.CONTACT_EDIT(c.id)}
            onRowClick={(c) => setDrawerContactId(c.id)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerContact?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Contact"
            editTooltip="Edit Contact"
            emptyTitle="No contacts recorded yet"
            emptyDescription="Create your first contact person and link them to an active organization account."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Contact"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: filteredContacts.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onRowsPerPageChange: (size) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(size);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                hideWhenEmpty: true,
            }}
            relatedSidebar={
                <RelatedModulesSidebar
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerContact)}
                    modules={relatedModules}
                    activeModuleId={effectiveRelatedModule ?? undefined}
                    onModuleSelect={(moduleId) => setActiveRelatedModule(moduleId)}
                    collapsed={isLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                    onToggleCollapse={setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                />
            }
            relatedRecordsTable={
                <RelatedRecordsTableView
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerContact && effectiveRelatedModule)}
                    moduleId={effectiveRelatedModule || ''}
                    moduleTitle={activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Related Records'}
                    parentRecordId={selectedDrawerContact?.id}
                    parentEntityTitle={selectedDrawerContact?.name || ''}
                    entityData={selectedDrawerContact}
                    entityType="contact"
                    leftOffset={isLeftSidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 260}
                    rightOffset={580}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onRowClick={(row, modId) => setSecondaryDrawerEntity({ type: modId, data: row })}
                />
            }
            drawer={
                <ContactDetailDrawer
                    contact={selectedDrawerContact}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerContact)}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                />
            }
            secondaryDrawer={
                secondaryDrawerEntity ? (
                    <RelatedSecondaryDrawer
                        entity={secondaryDrawerEntity}
                        moduleLabel={activeModuleMeta?.label}
                        parentTitle={selectedDrawerContact?.name}
                        onClose={() => setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null)}
                    />
                ) : null
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerContact)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        >
            <DataImportModal
                open={importOpen}
                entity="contacts"
                onClose={() => setImportOpen(false)}
                onImported={(count) => {
                    setToast({ open: true, message: `Successfully imported ${count} contact${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}!`, severity: 'success' });
                }}
            />
        </CommonMasterView>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFormContext } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormGrid, FormGridItem, RhfTextField, RhfPhoneField, RhfLookup, RhfCheckbox, RhfSelect } from '@/components/forms';
import { useOrganizations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { ContactFormData } from '@/types/contact.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';

const NO_ORGANIZATIONS: ExtendedOrganization[] = [];

/**
 * Basic contact identity & organization association, plus primary-contact and left-job status.
 * Must be rendered inside a `FormProvider<ContactFormData>`.
 */
export function ContactBasicInfoSection() {
    const { setValue } = useFormContext<ContactFormData>();
    const { data: organizations = NO_ORGANIZATIONS } = useOrganizations();
    const organizationNames = useMemo(() => organizations.map((o) => o.organizationName), [organizations]);

    return (
        <FormGrid columns={3}>
            <RhfTextField<ContactFormData> name="name" label="Name" required placeholder="e.g. Rajesh Kumar" />
            <RhfPhoneField<ContactFormData> name="mobile" label="Mobile" required hint="Primary mobile" placeholder="e.g. 9876543210" />
            <RhfPhoneField<ContactFormData> name="officePhone" label="Office Phone" placeholder="e.g. 0112345678" />

            <FormGridItem span={2}>
                <RhfLookup<ContactFormData>
                    name="organizationName"
                    label="Organization Name"
                    required
                    hint="Parent company / account"
                    options={organizationNames}
                    placeholder="Search or select organization..."
                    lookupType="organization"
                    onSelectRecord={(org) => setValue('organizationId', org.id, { shouldDirty: true })}
                    onClearRecord={() => setValue('organizationId', '', { shouldDirty: true })}
                />
            </FormGridItem>
            <RhfSelect<ContactFormData> name="leftJob" label="Left Job" options={['No', 'Yes']} placeholder="Select" />

            <FormGridItem span="full">
                <RhfCheckbox<ContactFormData> name="isPrimaryContact" label="Is Primary Contact" />
            </FormGridItem>
        </FormGrid>
    );
}

"use client";

import { Card, CardContent, Typography, Box } from '@mui/material';

interface AccountDetailsCardProps {

export function AccountDetailsCard({ user }: AccountDetailsCardProps) {
    return (
        <Card

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Autocomplete,
    Box,
    FormHelperText,
    TextField,
    Typography,
    type AutocompleteRenderInputParams,
} from '@mui/material';
import { FormField, fieldSx } from './FormField';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH, type FieldSize } from './fieldSizing';
import { ReadOnlyField } from './ReadOnlyField';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import {
    COUNTRY_OPTIONS,
    DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE,
    STATE_NOT_LISTED,
    findSubdivision,
    getCountryByCode,
    getCountryNameByCode,
    getStateOptionLabelsForCountry,
    getSubdivisionsByCountry,
    matchesSearch,
    resolveCountryIso2,
    type CountryMasterItem,
} from '@/data/addressMaster';

// ── Shared helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** ISO2 for a stored country value; empty means India (the CRM default), unknown values stay unknown (''). */
export function countryIso2OrDefault(country?: string | null): string {
    return country?.trim() ? resolveCountryIso2(country) : DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE;
}

/** True when `state` is filled in but isn't a subdivision of `country` (used to clear it after a country change). */
export function shouldResetStateForCountry(state?: string | null, country?: string | null): boolean {
    const value = (state ?? '').trim();
    if (!value) return false;
    if (getSubdivisionsByCountry(countryIso2OrDefault(country)).length === 0) return true;
    return !findSubdivision(value, countryIso2OrDefault(country));
}

export interface PostalCodeConfig {
    isIndia: boolean;
    label: string;
    placeholder: string;
    maxLength: number;
    inputMode: 'numeric' | 'text';
    /** Strips characters that can't appear in this country's postal codes. */
    sanitize: (value: string) => string;
}

/** Input rules for the postal code field: 6-digit PIN for India, 2–12 alphanumeric for everywhere else. */
export function getPostalCodeConfig(country?: string | null): PostalCodeConfig {
    const isIndia = countryIso2OrDefault(country) === DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE;
    return isIndia
        ? {
              isIndia,
              label: 'Postal Code / PIN Code',
              placeholder: 'e.g. 110001',
              maxLength: 6,
              inputMode: 'numeric',
              sanitize: (v) => v.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6),
          }
        : {
              isIndia,
              label: 'Postal Code / ZIP Code',
              placeholder: 'e.g. 94105 / SW1A 1AA',
              maxLength: 12,
              inputMode: 'text',
              sanitize: (v) => v.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9\s-]/g, '').toUpperCase().slice(0, 12),
          };
}

interface BaseFieldProps {
    /** Form field key; used for scroll-to-error (`data-field`). */
    name?: string;
    label?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    error?: string;
    /** Width token; each field has a compact default (postal code `xs`, the rest `md`). */
    size?: FieldSize;
}

/** Adds the shared place-name limit to an Autocomplete's input while keeping its own props (ref, handlers, aria). */
const withMaxLength = (slotProps: AutocompleteRenderInputParams['slotProps']) => ({
    ...slotProps,
    htmlInput: { ...slotProps.htmlInput, maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortText },
});

const ErrorText = ({ error }: { error?: string }) =>
    error ? (
        <FormHelperText error sx={{ mx: 1.75 }}>
            {error}
        </FormHelperText>
    ) : null;

// ── Country ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CountrySelectFieldProps extends BaseFieldProps {
    /** Stored value: ISO2 code (legacy country names are also understood). */
    value: string;
    /** Always called with the ISO2 code ('' when cleared). */
    onChange: (iso2: string) => void;
}

const filterCountries = (options: CountryMasterItem[], { inputValue }: { inputValue: string }) =>
    inputValue
        ? options.filter(
              (c) =>
                  matchesSearch(c.countryName, inputValue) ||
                  c.iso2Code.toLowerCase() === inputValue.trim().toLowerCase() ||
                  c.iso3Code.toLowerCase() === inputValue.trim().toLowerCase()
          )
        : options;

/** Searchable country dropdown. Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, displays the country name. */
export function CountrySelectField({
    name,
    label = 'Country',
    value,
    onChange,
    required,
    disabled,
    placeholder = 'Select Country',
    hint,
    error,
    size = 'md',
}: CountrySelectFieldProps) {
    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    if (mode === 'view') {
        return <ReadOnlyField label={label} value={getCountryNameByCode(value)} hideWhenEmpty sx={{ mb: 2 }} />;
    }

    const selected = getCountryByCode(value) ?? null;

    return (
        <FormField name={name} label={label} required={required} hint={hint} size={size}>
            <Autocomplete<CountryMasterItem, false, false, false>
                options={COUNTRY_OPTIONS as CountryMasterItem[]}
                value={selected}
                onChange={(_, option) => onChange(option?.iso2Code ?? '')}
                getOptionLabel={(option) => option.countryName}
                isOptionEqualToValue={(option, v) => option.iso2Code === v.iso2Code}
                filterOptions={filterCountries}
                disabled={disabled}
                autoHighlight
                size="small"
                renderOption={(props, option) => {
                    const { key, ...rest } = props as React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> & { key: string };
                    return (
                        <Box component="li" key={key} {...rest} sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 1 }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>{option.countryName}</Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                                {option.iso2Code}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    );
                }}
                renderInput={(params) => (
                    <TextField
                        {...params}
                        placeholder={placeholder}
                        error={Boolean(error)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={withMaxLength(params.slotProps)}
                    />
                )}
            />
            <ErrorText error={error} />
        </FormField>
    );
}

// ── State / Province / Region ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface StateRegionFieldProps extends BaseFieldProps {
    value: string;
    onChange: (value: string) => void;
    /** Country (ISO2 or name) whose subdivisions are offered. */
    countryValue?: string;
}

/**
 * Country-filtered, searchable state/region field. Accepts free text for regions missing from ISO 3166-2;
 * picking 'Not listed' clears the field so the user can type the region manually.
 */
export function StateRegionField({
    name,
    label = 'State / Province / Region',
    value,
    onChange,
    countryValue,
    required,
    disabled,
    placeholder,
    hint,
    error,
    size = 'md',
}: StateRegionFieldProps) {
    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    const [manualEntry, setManualEntry] = React.useState(false);
    if (mode === 'view') {
        return <ReadOnlyField label={label} value={value} hideWhenEmpty sx={{ mb: 2 }} />;
    }

    const options = getStateOptionLabelsForCountry(countryIso2OrDefault(countryValue));
    const hasSubdivisions = options.length > 1;
    const resolvedPlaceholder =
        placeholder ??
        (manualEntry || !hasSubdivisions ? 'Type state / province / region' : 'Search or select state / region');

    return (
        <FormField name={name} label={label} required={required} hint={hint} size={size}>
            <Autocomplete<string, false, false, true>
                freeSolo
                options={options}
                value={value || null}
                inputValue={value ?? ''}
                onChange={(_, next) => {
                    if (next === STATE_NOT_LISTED) {
                        setManualEntry(true);
                        onChange('');
                        return;
                    }
                    onChange(next ?? '');
                }}
                onInputChange={(_, next, reason) => {
                    if (reason === 'input' || reason === 'clear') onChange(next);
                }}
                // Diacritic-insensitive search ('haryana' finds 'Haryāna'); 'Not listed' always stays available.
                filterOptions={(opts, state) =>
                    state.inputValue
                        ? [...opts.filter((o) => o !== STATE_NOT_LISTED && matchesSearch(o, state.inputValue)), STATE_NOT_LISTED]
                        : opts
                }
                disabled={disabled}
                size="small"
                renderInput={(params) => (
                    <TextField
                        {...params}
                        placeholder={resolvedPlaceholder}
                        error={Boolean(error)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={withMaxLength(params.slotProps)}
                    />
                )}
            />
            <ErrorText error={error} />
        </FormField>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/forms/fieldSizing.ts
