import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH } from '@/config/fieldLimits';

/**
 * Field sizing design tokens — the single source of truth for how wide a form control is drawn and how many
 * characters it accepts. Widths are caps (`maxWidth`), never minimums, so a field never grows past what its data
 * needs but still shrinks inside narrow grid cells. On phones every field stays full width for touch usability.
 */

export type FieldSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'full';

/**
 * Kind of control being sized. Structural kinds (`multiline`, `lookup`, `composite`) always win over name-based
 * inference; the rest fall back to their default only when the field name doesn't match a known rule.
 */
export type FieldType =
    | 'text'
    | 'multiline'
    | 'number'
    | 'amount'
    | 'percentage'
    | 'phone'
    | 'email'
    | 'url'
    | 'postalCode'
    | 'identifier'
    | 'date'
    | 'time'
    | 'dateTime'
    | 'select'
    | 'lookup'
    | 'composite';

export const FIELD_SIZES: readonly FieldSize[] = ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'full'];

export const FIELD_SIZE_WIDTH: Readonly<Record<FieldSize, string>> = {
    /** PIN code, percentage, Yes/No, counts, units, currency code. */
    xs: '140px',
    /** Phone, date, time, PAN, IFSC, GSTIN, TAN, status, priority, short codes. */
    sm: '220px',
    /** Person name, designation, department, email, selects, amounts, URL, bank account no. */
    md: '340px',
    /** Organization / trade name, subject, lookups, street address lines. */
    lg: '520px',
    /** Textareas, chip groups, line-item tables. */
    full: '100%',
};

// Limits live in config so Zod schemas share them without importing UI code; re-exported for form callers.
export { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH };

/** Responsive cap: full width on phones, token width from the `sm` breakpoint up. */
export function fieldSizeMaxWidth(size: FieldSize): { xs: string; sm: string } {
    return { xs: '100%', sm: FIELD_SIZE_WIDTH[size] };
}

/** `sx` fragment that applies a size token to a control or its wrapper. */
export function fieldSizeSx(size: FieldSize) {
    return { width: '100%', maxWidth: fieldSizeMaxWidth(size) };
}

interface FieldRule {
    pattern: RegExp;
    size: FieldSize;
    maxLength?: number;
}

/** Exact-name tax identifiers; anchored so words like "company" (…pan…) or "distance" (…tan…) never match. */
const TAX_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN = /^(gst(in)?|pan|tan|cin)(no|number)?$|ifsc/;

/**
 * Ordered name rules, first match wins. Patterns run against the normalized leaf key: last path segment,
 * lowercased, non-alphanumerics stripped (`lineItems.0.unitPrice` → `unitprice`, `PIN Code` → `pincode`).
 */
const FIELD_RULES: readonly FieldRule[] = [
    // Long-form text
    {
        pattern: /(description|remarks?|notes?|comments?|termsandconditions?|resolution|problem(observed|reported)|^rca$|reason)/,
        size: 'full',
        maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.longText,
    },
    // Formatted identifiers
    { pattern: /^gst(in)?(no|number)?$/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.gstin },
    { pattern: /^pan(no|number)?$/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.pan },
    { pattern: /^tan(no|number)?$/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.tan },
    { pattern: /ifsc/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.ifsc },
    { pattern: /^cin(no|number)?$/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.cin },
    { pattern: /^msme/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.msme },
    { pattern: /^(hsn|sac)(code)?$/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.hsn },
    { pattern: /(pincode|postalcode|zipcode|^zip$)/, size: 'xs', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.postalCode },
    { pattern: /(sapcode|branchcode|tallyid)/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortCode },
    // Contact channels
    { pattern: /(mobile|phone|landline|fax)\d*$|contactnumber/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.phone },
    { pattern: /email(address)?\d*$/, size: 'md', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.email },
    { pattern: /(website|url|linkedin)$/, size: 'md', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.url },
    // Dates & times
    { pattern: /(date|time|^dob|validuntil|deadline|expiry)$/, size: 'sm' },
    // Small numerics & flags
    { pattern: /(percent(age)?|probability|^discount$|taxrate|^tax$)/, size: 'xs' },
    { pattern: /(quantity|^qty|(?<!ac|dis)count$|^age$|^noof|^numberof|^(unit|uom)$|^currency(code)?$)/, size: 'xs' },
    { pattern: /^(donotcall|leftjob|optedout|optout)$/, size: 'xs' },
    { pattern: /(status|priority)$/, size: 'sm' },
    // Money
    { pattern: /(amount|price|cost|mrp|msp|turnover|revenue|budget|value|total|rate)$/, size: 'md' },
    // Organizations & long titles
    {
        pattern: /^(organi[sz]ation|account|legal|trade|mailing|company)name$|company$|^memberof/,
        size: 'lg',
        maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.organizationName,
    },
    { pattern: /^(opportunity|deal|product|project)name$/, size: 'lg', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.organizationName },
    { pattern: /(designation|department|jobtitle|role)$/, size: 'md', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortText },
    { pattern: /(subject|title)$/, size: 'lg', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.title },
    { pattern: /(address|street)\d*$/, size: 'lg', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.address },
    { pattern: /(city|state|country|district|region|province)$/, size: 'md', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortText },
    // People & bank account
    { pattern: /(name|preparedfor)$/, size: 'md', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.personName },
    { pattern: /^(bank)?account(number|no)$/, size: 'md', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.bankAccount },
    // Remaining short codes and categorical values
    { pattern: /code$/, size: 'sm', maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortCode },
    { pattern: /(type|category|source|stage|industry|segment|mode|terms|period)$|^(typeof|natureof|sourceof)/, size: 'md' },
];

const TYPE_DEFAULT_SIZE: Readonly<Record<FieldType, FieldSize>> = {
    text: 'lg',
    multiline: 'full',
    number: 'sm',
    amount: 'md',
    percentage: 'xs',
    phone: 'sm',
    email: 'md',
    url: 'md',
    postalCode: 'xs',
    identifier: 'sm',
    date: 'sm',
    time: 'sm',
    dateTime: 'md',
    select: 'md',
    lookup: 'lg',
    composite: 'full',
};

const STRUCTURAL_TYPES: ReadonlySet<FieldType> = new Set<FieldType>(['multiline', 'lookup', 'composite']);

/** Last segment of an RHF path (`lineItems.0.unitPrice` → `unitPrice`); labels like `GST No.` stay whole. */
function fieldLeaf(fieldName: string): string {
    return fieldName.split('.').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '';
}

function normalizeFieldKey(fieldName: string): string {
    return fieldLeaf(fieldName).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
}

function matchRule(fieldName?: string): FieldRule | undefined {
    if (!fieldName) return undefined;
    const key = normalizeFieldKey(fieldName);
    if (!key) return undefined;
    return FIELD_RULES.find((rule) => rule.pattern.test(key));
}

/** True for `is…`/`has…` boolean flags stored as Yes/No values. */
function isBooleanFlag(fieldName?: string): boolean {
    return Boolean(fieldName && /^(is|has|can)[A-Z]/.test(fieldLeaf(fieldName)));
}

/**
 * Picks the visual width for a field. Precedence: explicit size → structural type (multiline / lookup /
 * composite) → field-name rule → type default → `full` (unknown fields keep today's full-width behaviour).
 */
export function resolveFieldSize(fieldName?: string, fieldType?: FieldType, explicitSize?: FieldSize): FieldSize {
    if (explicitSize) return explicitSize;
    if (fieldType && STRUCTURAL_TYPES.has(fieldType)) return TYPE_DEFAULT_SIZE[fieldType];
    if (isBooleanFlag(fieldName)) return 'xs';
    const rule = matchRule(fieldName);
    if (rule) return rule.size;
    return fieldType ? TYPE_DEFAULT_SIZE[fieldType] : 'full';
}

/** Picks the character limit for a field: explicit value first, then the field-name rule (undefined = no limit). */
export function resolveFieldMaxLength(fieldName?: string, explicitMaxLength?: number): number | undefined {
    if (explicitMaxLength !== undefined) return explicitMaxLength;
    return matchRule(fieldName)?.maxLength;
}

/**
 * Width that fits a dropdown's longest option (closed select shows the value plus a ~32px arrow).
 * Capped at `md`: longer options are ellipsized in the closed control and shown in full in the menu.
 * Returns undefined while there are no options so name / type inference can decide.
 */
export function resolveOptionsFieldSize(options: readonly string[]): FieldSize | undefined {
    if (options.length === 0) return undefined;
    const longest = Math.max(...options.map((o) => o.length));
    if (longest <= 10) return 'xs';
    if (longest <= 20) return 'sm';
    return 'md';
}

/** Maps an HTML input `type` (plus the multiline flag) to the {@link FieldType} used for sizing. */
export function fieldTypeFromInput(inputType?: string, multiline?: boolean): FieldType {
    if (multiline) return 'multiline';
    switch (inputType) {
        case 'email':
            return 'email';
        case 'tel':
            return 'phone';
        case 'number':
            return 'number';
        case 'url':
            return 'url';
        case 'date':
            return 'date';
        case 'time':
            return 'time';
        case 'datetime-local':
            return 'dateTime';
        default:
            return 'text';
    }
}

/** True for GSTIN / PAN / TAN / CIN / IFSC fields (by name or label), which are stored uppercase. */
export function isTaxIdentifierField(nameOrLabel?: string): boolean {
    return Boolean(nameOrLabel && TAX_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.test(normalizeFieldKey(nameOrLabel)));
}

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Typography, type SxProps, type Theme } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import { ReadOnlyField } from './ReadOnlyField';
import { getCountryNameByCode } from '@/data/addressMaster';
import { fieldSizeSx, resolveFieldSize, type FieldSize } from './fieldSizing';

export const fieldSx = {
    '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
        borderRadius: '8px',
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
        fontSize: '0.85rem',
        '&:hover .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': { borderColor: '#2563EB' },
        '&.Mui-focused .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': {
            borderColor: '#2563EB',
            borderWidth: '1.5px',
        },
    },
    '& .MuiInputLabel-root.Mui-focused': { color: '#2563EB' },
};

export interface FormFieldProps {
    /** Explicit read-only content for view mode (use when the control's value can't be inferred, e.g. chip groups). */
    viewValue?: React.ReactNode;
    /** Form field key; exposed as `data-field` so validation can scroll to and focus the control. */
    name?: string;
    label: string;
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Width token for the whole field (label, control, error). Inferred from `name` when omitted;
     * unrecognised names stay full width. Exposed as `data-field-size` for {@link FormRow} / {@link FormGrid}.
     */
    size?: FieldSize;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

const COPYABLE_FIELDS = new Set([
    'gstNo',
    'gstNumber',
    'panNumber',
    'bankIfscCode',
    'accountNumber',
    'cinNo',
    'tanNumber',
    'msmeRegnNumber',
    'sapCodeTallyId',
    'showroomBranchCode',
]);
const COPYABLE_PATTERN = /(phone|mobile|email|code)$/i;

const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function formatViewString(text: string): string {
    if (!ISO_DATE.test(text)) return text;
    return new Date(`${text}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
}

/** Collects displayable values from every value-bearing control nested inside a FormField (date + time, etc.). */
function collectViewValues(children: React.ReactNode, out: string[]): void {
    React.Children.forEach(children, (child) => {
        if (!React.isValidElement<{ value?: unknown; checked?: unknown; children?: React.ReactNode }>(child)) return;
        const { value, checked, children: nested } = child.props;
        if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') {
            if (String(value) !== '') out.push(formatViewString(String(value)));
        } else if (typeof checked === 'boolean') {
            out.push(checked ? 'Yes' : 'No');
        } else if (nested) {
            collectViewValues(nested, out);
        }
    });
}

function extractViewValue(children: React.ReactNode): { found: boolean; value?: string } {
    const values: string[] = [];
    collectViewValues(children, values);
    // found=true even when empty so FormField hides unfilled fields instead of rendering editable children.
    return { found: true, value: values.length > 0 ? values.join(' • ') : undefined };
}

function viewPresentation(name: string | undefined, value: string | undefined) {
    const copyable = Boolean(name && (COPYABLE_FIELDS.has(name) || COPYABLE_PATTERN.test(name)));
    if (name === 'accountStatus' && value) {
        return { copyable, badge: true, badgeColor: value === 'Active' ? '#16a34a' : '#64748b' };
    }
    if (name === 'customerType' && value) {
        return { copyable, badge: true, badgeColor: '#1d4ed8' };
    }
    return { copyable, badge: false, badgeColor: undefined };
}

export function FormField({ name, viewValue, label, required, hint, size, children, sx }: FormFieldProps) {
    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    if (mode === 'view') {
        if (viewValue !== undefined) {
            return <ReadOnlyField label={label} value={viewValue} hideWhenEmpty sx={{ mb: 2, ...sx }} />;
        }
        const extracted = extractViewValue(children);
        const found = extracted.found;
        // Country fields store ISO2 codes; show the country name.
        const value = name && /country$/i.test(name) && extracted.value ? getCountryNameByCode(extracted.value) : extracted.value;
        if (found) {
            return <ReadOnlyField label={label} value={value} hideWhenEmpty {...viewPresentation(name, value)} sx={{ mb: 2, ...sx }} />;
        }
    }
    const resolvedSize = resolveFieldSize(name, undefined, size);
    return (
        <Box
            data-field={name}
            data-field-size={resolvedSize}
            sx={[{ mb: 2, ...fieldSizeSx(resolvedSize) }, ...(Array.isArray(sx) ? sx : [sx])]}
        >
            {/* Wraps so a hint (e.g. a status chip) drops below the label on compact fields instead of squeezing it. */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    columnGap: 1,
                    mb: 0.6,
                }}
            >
                <Typography
                    variant="body2"
                    sx={{
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: '#374151',
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    }}
                >
                    {label}
                    {required && (
                        <Box component="span" sx={{ color: '#ef4444', ml: 0.4 }}>
                            *
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </Typography>
                {hint && (
                    typeof hint === 'string' ? (
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                            {hint}
                        </Typography>
                    ) : (
                        hint
                    )
                )}
            </Box>
            {children}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import { Box, type SxProps, type Theme } from '@mui/material';
import type { Breakpoint } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { FIELD_SIZES, FIELD_SIZE_WIDTH } from './fieldSizing';

type ResponsiveCount = Partial<Record<Breakpoint, number>>;

/** A number N means: 1 column on phones, up to 2 on tablets, N from `md` up. */
export type FormGridColumns = number | ResponsiveCount;

const toColumnMap = (columns: FormGridColumns): ResponsiveCount =>
    typeof columns === 'number' ? { xs: 1, sm: Math.min(2, columns), md: columns } : { xs: 1, ...columns };

const mapBreakpoints = <V,>(counts: ResponsiveCount, toValue: (count: number) => V) =>
    Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(counts).map(([bp, count]) => [bp, toValue(count)]));

const sxList = (sx?: SxProps<Theme>) => (Array.isArray(sx) ? sx : [sx]);

/** Gap replaces the fields' own bottom margin; `&&` outranks the child's single-class `mb`. */
const resetChildMarginSx = { '&& > *': { mb: 0 } };

const FormGridColumnsContext = createContext<ResponsiveCount>({ xs: 1 });

export interface FormGridProps {
    /** Column count, a number or per breakpoint (default 3 → 1 / 2 / 3). */
    columns?: FormGridColumns;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

/**
 * Compact multi-column grid for related short fields (`PAN + GST + TAN`, `Date + Priority + Status`).
 * Each field keeps its own size cap inside its cell; `full`-size fields (textareas, chip groups) span the row.
 */
export function FormGrid({ columns = 3, children, sx }: FormGridProps) {
    const columnMap = toColumnMap(columns);
    return (
        <FormGridColumnsContext.Provider value={columnMap}>
            <Box
                sx={[
                    {
                        display: 'grid',
                        gridTemplateColumns: mapBreakpoints(columnMap, (n) => `repeat(${n}, minmax(0, 1fr))`),
                        columnGap: 3,
                        rowGap: 2.5,
                        alignItems: 'start',
                        '& > [data-field-size="full"]': { gridColumn: '1 / -1' },
                    },
                    resetChildMarginSx,
                    ...sxList(sx),
                ]}
            >
                {children}
            </Box>
        </FormGridColumnsContext.Provider>
    );
}

export interface FormGridItemProps {
    /** Columns to span; clamped to the grid's column count at each breakpoint. `full` spans the whole row. */
    span?: number | 'full';
    children: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

/** Grid cell for content that needs more than one {@link FormGrid} column. */
export function FormGridItem({ span = 1, children, sx }: FormGridItemProps) {
    const columnMap = useContext(FormGridColumnsContext);
    const gridColumn = span === 'full' ? '1 / -1' : mapBreakpoints(columnMap, (n) => `span ${Math.min(span, n)}`);
    return <Box sx={[{ gridColumn, minWidth: 0 }, resetChildMarginSx, ...sxList(sx)]}>{children}</Box>;
}

/** Each sized field starts at its token width and grows no further than its cap; rows wrap as space runs out. */
const rowItemSizeSx = Object.fromEntries(
    FIELD_SIZES.map((size) => [
        `&& > [data-field-size="${size}"]`,
        { flex: { xs: '1 1 100%', sm: size === 'full' ? '1 1 100%' : `1 1 ${FIELD_SIZE_WIDTH[size]}` } },
    ])
);

export interface FormRowProps {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

/**
 * Flowing row of fields, each at its natural token width (`Country md + State md + City md + PIN xs`).
 * Unlike {@link FormGrid}, columns aren't aligned across rows; use it for one logical group.
 */
export function FormRow({ children, sx }: FormRowProps) {
    return (
        <Box
            sx={[
                {
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    alignItems: 'flex-start',
                    columnGap: 3,
                    rowGap: 2.5,
                    '&& > *': { mb: 0, minWidth: 0, flex: { xs: '1 1 100%', sm: '1 1 220px' } },
                    ...rowItemSizeSx,
                },
                ...sxList(sx),
            ]}
        >
            {children}
        </Box>
    );
}

export interface LookupFieldProps {
    value: string;
    onChange: (value: string) => void;
    placeholder?: string;
    options?: string[];
    /** Opens the record picker (the `[ > ]` directory button). */
    onLookupClick?: () => void;
    /** @deprecated Use `onLookupClick`. */
    onSelectClick?: () => void;
    /** Called after the clear button resets the value. */
    onClear?: () => void;
    /** Shows a spinner in the directory button and disables it. */
    loading?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    lookupTooltip?: string;
    /** Width cap (input + action buttons) for standalone use; omit inside a FormField, which sizes its children. */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;

const actionButtonSx = {
    width: 34,
    height: 34,
    borderRadius: '6px',
    backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
    color: '#fff',
    flexShrink: 0,
    '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#1d4ed8' },
    '&.Mui-disabled': { backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', color: '#94a3b8' },
} as const;

export function LookupField({
    value,
    onChange,
    placeholder = 'Type or select...',
    options = [],
    onLookupClick,
    onSelectClick,
    onClear,
    loading = false,
    disabled = false,
    required = false,
    lookupTooltip = 'Select from Directory',
    fieldSize,
}: LookupFieldProps) {

        onChange('');

                            required={required}

                    size="small"

import React from 'react';

export interface ReadOnlyFieldProps {
    label: string;
    value?: React.ReactNode;
    /** Shows a copy button next to the value (uses `copyText`, or `value` when it is a string/number). */
    copyable?: boolean;
    copyText?: string;
    /** Renders the value as a non-interactive pill. */
    badge?: boolean;
    /** Main colour of the badge (text); the background is a light tint of it. */

    /** Render nothing at all when there is no value (record views only show filled-in data). */
    hideWhenEmpty?: boolean;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;

const isEmpty = (value: React.ReactNode) =>
    value === undefined || value === null || value === false || value === '';

/** Borderless label/value pair for record detail views — no input box, no disabled look. */
export function ReadOnlyField({
    label,
    value,
    copyable,
    copyText,
    badge,
    badgeColor = '#475569',
    hint,
    hideWhenEmpty,
    sx,
}: ReadOnlyFieldProps) {
    const empty = isEmpty(value);
    if (empty && hideWhenEmpty) return null;
    const textToCopy = copyText ?? (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' ? String(value) : undefined);

    return (
        <Box sx={sx}>
            <Typography
                sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.68rem',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: '#64748b',
                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                    letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                    mb: 0.4,
                }}
            >
                {label}
            </Typography>

            {empty ? (
                <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.86rem' }} aria-label="Not provided">
                    —
                </Typography>
            ) : (
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    {badge ? (
                        <Chip
                            label={value}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 24,
                                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                color: badgeColor,
                                backgroundColor: `${badgeColor}1a`,
                                cursor: 'default',
                            }}
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <Typography
                            component="div"
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.86rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                color: '#0f172a',
                                lineHeight: 1.35,
                                wordBreak: 'break-word',
                                whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
                            }}
                        >
                            {value}
                        </Typography>
                    )}
                    {copyable && textToCopy && <DrawerCopyButton text={textToCopy} title={`Copy ${label}`} />}
                </Box>
            )}

            {hint && (
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8', mt: 0.3 }}>{hint}</Typography>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Divider, Paper, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableRow, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { ReadOnlyField } from '../ReadOnlyField';
import type { CrmLineItemsValues } from './CrmLineItemsSection';

const money = (n: number | undefined) => `₹${(n ?? 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;

const headCellSx = {
    fontSize: '0.7rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    color: '#64748b',
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: '0.04em',
    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
} as const;

const SummaryRow = ({ label, value, color, bold }: { label: string; value: string; color?: string; bold?: boolean }) => (
    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b' }}>{label}</Typography>
        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.86rem', fontWeight: bold ? 800 : 600, color: color ?? '#0f172a' }}>{value}</Typography>
    </Box>
);

/** Plain-text presentation of an opportunity's line items and totals: no inputs, buttons or selects. */
export function CrmLineItemsReadOnly({ value }: { value: CrmLineItemsValues }) {
    const items = Array.isArray(value.lineItems) ? value.lineItems : [];
    const hasDiscount = (value.totalDiscount ?? 0) > 0;
    const hasTax = (value.totalTax ?? 0) > 0;

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2, md: 3 }, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 3 }}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <ReadOnlyField label="Currency" value={value.currency} hideWhenEmpty />
                <ReadOnlyField label="Group Name" value={value.groupName} hideWhenEmpty />
            </Box>

            {items.length === 0 ? (
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.86rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>No line items on this record.</Typography>
            ) : (
                <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: '10px', borderColor: '#e2e8f0', overflowX: 'auto' }}>
                    <Table size="small">
                        <TableHead>
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableCell sx={headCellSx}>Product</TableCell>
                                <TableCell sx={headCellSx} align="right">Qty</TableCell>
                                <TableCell sx={headCellSx} align="right">Amount</TableCell>
                                {items.some((i) => i.discount > 0) && (
                                    <TableCell sx={headCellSx} align="right">Discount</TableCell>
                                )}
                                <TableCell sx={headCellSx} align="right">Sale Price</TableCell>
                                <TableCell sx={headCellSx} align="right">Tax</TableCell>
                                <TableCell sx={headCellSx} align="right">Total</TableCell>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHead>
                        <TableBody>
                            {items.map((item) => (
                                <TableRow key={item.id}>
                                    <TableCell sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#0f172a', minWidth: 220 }}>
                                        {item.productName || '—'}
                                        {(item.description || item.note) && (
                                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 400, mt: 0.3 }}>
                                                {[item.description, item.note].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
                                            </Typography>
                                        )}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>{item.quantity}</TableCell>
                                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>{money(item.amount)}</TableCell>
                                    {items.some((i) => i.discount > 0) && (
                                        <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>
                                            {item.discount > 0
                                                ? item.discountType === 'percentage'
                                                    ? `${item.discount}%`
                                                    : money(item.discount)
                                                : '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    )}
                                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>{money(item.salePrice)}</TableCell>
                                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>
                                        {item.taxAmount > 0 ? `${money(item.taxAmount)} (${item.taxRate})` : '—'}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 700 }}>{money(item.total)}</TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                            ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </Paper>
            )}

            {items.length > 0 && (
                <Paper
                    variant="outlined"
                    sx={{ p: 2.5, borderRadius: '10px', borderColor: '#bfdbfe', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', maxWidth: 420, ml: { md: 'auto' }, width: '100%' }}
                >
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.2 }}>
                        <SummaryRow label="Total" value={money(value.totalAmount)} />
                        {hasDiscount && <SummaryRow label="Discount" value={`- ${money(value.totalDiscount)}`} color="#dc2626" />}
                        {(value.lumpSumDiscount ?? 0) > 0 && (
                            <SummaryRow label="Lump Sum Discount" value={`- ${money(value.lumpSumDiscount)}`} color="#dc2626" />
                        )}
                        <SummaryRow label="Subtotal" value={money(value.subtotal)} bold />
                        {hasTax && <SummaryRow label="Tax" value={`+ ${money(value.totalTax)}`} color="#2563eb" />}
                        <Divider />
                        <SummaryRow label="Grand Total" value={money(value.grandTotal)} color="#15803d" bold />
                    </Box>
                </Paper>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useCallback } from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Typography,
    TextField,
    Button,
    IconButton,
    Select,
    MenuItem,
    FormControl,
    Tooltip,
    Divider,
    Paper,
    Alert,
} from '@mui/material';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import { useFormContext, useWatch, type Path, type PathValue } from 'react-hook-form';

import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH, FIELD_SIZE_WIDTH } from '../fieldSizing';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import { CrmLineItemsReadOnly } from './CrmLineItemsReadOnly';
import {
    OPPORTUNITY_CURRENCIES,
    OPPORTUNITY_TAX_RATES,
    type OpportunityLineItem,
} from '@/types/opportunity.types';

export type CrmLineItem = OpportunityLineItem;

export interface CrmLineItemsValues {
    currency: string;
    groupName: string;
    lineItems: OpportunityLineItem[];
    lumpSumDiscount: number;
    totalAmount?: number;
    totalDiscount?: number;
    subtotal?: number;
    totalTax?: number;
    grandTotal?: number;
}

// Backward compatibility alias
export type CrmLineItemsData = CrmLineItemsValues;

export interface CrmLineItemsEditorProps {
    value: CrmLineItemsValues;
    onChange: <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(field: K, val: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => void;
    error?: string;
}

export interface CrmLineItemsSectionProps {
    value?: CrmLineItemsValues;
    onChange?: <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(field: K, val: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => void;
    form?: Partial<CrmLineItemsValues>;
    setField?: <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(key: K, value: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => void;
    error?: string;
}

// Product catalog for quick autocomplete / selection in the line items
export const PRODUCT_CATALOG: { name: string; defaultPrice: number; category: string }[] = [
    { name: 'TallyPrime Silver (Single User)', defaultPrice: 22500, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'TallyPrime Gold (Multi User)', defaultPrice: 67500, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'Tally Software Services (TSS) Renewal - Gold', defaultPrice: 15750, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'Tally Software Services (TSS) Renewal - Silver', defaultPrice: 5250, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'Biz Analyst Mobile App (Annual - 5 Users)', defaultPrice: 12000, category: 'Biz Analyst' },
    { name: 'CredFlow Credit Management Cloud Platform', defaultPrice: 36000, category: 'CredFlow' },
    { name: 'Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud Standard (500GB)', defaultPrice: 42000, category: 'Acronis' },
    { name: 'Connect 21 Multi-Branch Sync Engine', defaultPrice: 18500, category: 'Connect 21' },
    { name: 'WhatsApp Automation for Tally Invoicing', defaultPrice: 14500, category: 'Automation' },
    { name: 'Implementation & Custom Workflow Engineering', defaultPrice: 35000, category: 'Services' },
];

export function parseTaxRate(taxRateStr: string): number {
    if (!taxRateStr || taxRateStr === '--None--' || taxRateStr === 'GST 0%') return 0;
    const match = taxRateStr.match(/(\d+)%/);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
}

export const DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_VALUES: CrmLineItemsValues = {
    currency: 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
    groupName: 'Products & Services',
    lineItems: [],
    lumpSumDiscount: 0,
    totalAmount: 0,
    totalDiscount: 0,
    subtotal: 0,
    totalTax: 0,
    grandTotal: 0,
};

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COMPONENT A: CrmLineItemsEditor (Pure Controlled UI — Zero RHF Hooks)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function CrmLineItemsEditor({ value, onChange, error }: CrmLineItemsEditorProps) {
    const isView = useFormMode().mode === 'view';
    const currency = value.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹';
    const groupName = value.groupName || '';
    const lineItems = Array.isArray(value.lineItems) ? value.lineItems : [];
    const lumpSumDiscount = value.lumpSumDiscount || 0;
    const totalAmount = value.totalAmount ?? 0;
    const totalDiscount = value.totalDiscount ?? 0;
    const subtotal = value.subtotal ?? 0;
    const totalTax = value.totalTax ?? 0;
    const grandTotal = value.grandTotal ?? 0;

    // ── Helper to recalculate all totals from line items ──────────────────────────
    const recalculateTotals = useCallback(
        (items: OpportunityLineItem[], lumpSum: number) => {
            let grossAmount = 0;
            let grossDiscount = 0;
            let grossSubtotal = 0;
            let grossTax = 0;

            items.forEach((item) => {
                const qty = item.quantity || 1;
                const baseAmount = item.amount * qty;
                grossAmount += baseAmount;

                let discVal = 0;
                if (item.discountType === 'percentage') {
                    discVal = (baseAmount * (item.discount || 0)) / 100;
                } else {
                    discVal = (item.discount || 0) * qty;
                }
                grossDiscount += discVal;

                const lineSubtotal = Math.max(0, baseAmount - discVal);
                grossSubtotal += lineSubtotal;

                const taxPercent = parseTaxRate(item.taxRate);
                const lineTax = (lineSubtotal * taxPercent) / 100;
                grossTax += lineTax;
            });

            const computedGrandTotal = Math.max(0, grossSubtotal + grossTax - (lumpSum || 0));

            onChange('lineItems', items);
            onChange('totalAmount', Math.round(grossAmount));
            onChange('totalDiscount', Math.round(grossDiscount));
            onChange('subtotal', Math.round(grossSubtotal));
            onChange('totalTax', Math.round(grossTax));
            onChange('grandTotal', Math.round(computedGrandTotal));
        },
        [onChange]
    );

    // ── Add new product line item ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleAddLineItem = () => {
        const newItem: OpportunityLineItem = {
            id: `line-${Date.now()}`,
            productId: 'prod-tally',
            productName: '',
            quantity: 1,
            amount: 0,
            discount: 0,
            discountType: 'percentage',
            salePrice: 0,
            taxRate: 'GST 18%',
            taxAmount: 0,
            total: 0,
            description: '',
            note: '',
        };
        const updated = [...lineItems, newItem];
        recalculateTotals(updated, lumpSumDiscount);
    };

    // ── Remove product line item ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleRemoveLineItem = (index: number) => {
        const updated = lineItems.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
        recalculateTotals(updated, lumpSumDiscount);
    };

    // ── Update specific line item ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleUpdateLineItem = (index: number, updates: Partial<OpportunityLineItem>) => {
        const updated = lineItems.map((item, i) => {
            if (i !== index) return item;
            const merged: OpportunityLineItem = { ...item, ...updates };

            const qty = merged.quantity || 1;
            const baseAmount = merged.amount;
            let discPerUnit = 0;
            if (merged.discountType === 'percentage') {
                discPerUnit = (baseAmount * (merged.discount || 0)) / 100;
            } else {
                discPerUnit = merged.discount || 0;
            }
            const salePrice = Math.max(0, baseAmount - discPerUnit);
            const lineSubtotal = salePrice * qty;
            const taxPercent = parseTaxRate(merged.taxRate);
            const lineTax = (lineSubtotal * taxPercent) / 100;
            const lineTotal = lineSubtotal + lineTax;

            return {
                ...merged,
                salePrice: Math.round(salePrice),
                taxAmount: Math.round(lineTax),
                total: Math.round(lineTotal),
            };
        });

        recalculateTotals(updated, lumpSumDiscount);
    };

    // ── Select product from catalog ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSelectProduct = (index: number, productName: string) => {
        const found = PRODUCT_CATALOG.find((p) => p.name === productName);
        const amount = found ? found.defaultPrice : 0;
        handleUpdateLineItem(index, {
            productName,
            amount,
            salePrice: amount,
            taxRate: 'GST 18%',
        });
    };

    // ── Handle lump sum discount update ─────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleLumpSumChange = (val: number) => {
        onChange('lumpSumDiscount', val);
        recalculateTotals(lineItems, val);
    };

    if (isView) return <CrmLineItemsReadOnly value={value} />;

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2, md: 3 } }}>
            {error && (
                <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    {error}
                </Alert>
            )}

            {/* ════════════ TOP SETTINGS (Currency) ════════════ */}
            <FormField name="currency" label="Currency" size="sm" hint="Base billing currency" sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <FormControl size="small" fullWidth sx={fieldSx}>
                    <Select
                        value={currency}
                        onChange={(e) => onChange('currency', e.target.value)}
                    >
                        {OPPORTUNITY_CURRENCIES.map((cur) => (
                            <MenuItem key={cur} value={cur}>
                                {cur}
                            </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                    </Select>
                </FormControl>
            </FormField>

            {/* ════════════ LINE ITEMS SECTION ════════════ */}
            <Paper
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                    p: 2.5,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    mb: 4,
                }}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.92rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b', mb: 2 }}>
                    Line Items
                </Typography>

                {/* Group Name input */}
                <FormField
                    name="groupName"
                    label="Group Name"
                    size="lg"
                    hint="Logical bundle name (e.g. Products / Software / AMC)"
                    sx={{ mb: 3 }}
                >
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        value={groupName}
                        onChange={(e) => onChange('groupName', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Software Licenses & Add-ons"
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortText } }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                {/* Dynamic Line items table container */}
                <Box sx={{ overflowX: 'auto', mb: 2 }}>
                    {lineItems.length === 0 ? (
                        <Box
                            sx={{
                                p: 4,
                                textAlign: 'center',
                                backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                                border: '1px dashed #cbd5e1',
                                borderRadius: '8px',
                            }}
                        >
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.86rem', color: '#64748b', mb: 1.5 }}>
                                No product line items added yet. Click below to add products or services.
                            </Typography>
                            <Button
                                variant="contained"
                                startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                                onClick={handleAddLineItem}
                                sx={{
                                    backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                                    color: '#ffffff',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    px: 2.5,
                                    '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#1d4ed8' },
                                }}
                            >
                                Add Product Line
                            </Button>
                        </Box>
                    ) : (
                        <Box sx={{ minWidth: 960 }}>
                            {/* Table Header Row */}
                            <Box
                                sx={{
                                    display: 'grid',
                                    gridTemplateColumns: '70px 2.2fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 40px',
                                    gap: 1.5,
                                    px: 1.5,
                                    py: 1,
                                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                    borderRadius: '6px 6px 0 0',
                                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                    borderBottom: 'none',
                                    fontSize: '0.74rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#475569',
                                }}
                            >
                                <Box>Quantity</Box>
                                <Box>Product</Box>
                                <Box>Amount (₹)</Box>
                                <Box>Discount</Box>
                                <Box>Sale Price (₹)</Box>
                                <Box>Tax Amount (₹)</Box>
                                <Box>Total (₹)</Box>
                                <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>Action</Box>
                            </Box>

                            {/* Table Line Items */}
                            {lineItems.map((item, idx) => (
                                <Box
                                    key={item.id || idx}
                                    sx={{
                                        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                        borderTop: idx > 0 ? 'none' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                        p: 1.5,
                                        backgroundColor: idx % 2 === 0 ? '#ffffff' : '#fafafa',
                                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {/* Main numbers row */}
                                    <Box
                                        sx={{
                                            display: 'grid',
                                            gridTemplateColumns: '70px 2.2fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 40px',
                                            gap: 1.5,
                                            alignItems: 'center',
                                            mb: 1.5,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {/* Quantity */}
                                        <TextField
                                            size="small"
                                            type="number"
                                            value={item.quantity}
                                            onChange={(e) =>
                                                handleUpdateLineItem(idx, {
                                                    quantity: Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 1),
                                                })
                                            }
                                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 1 } }}
                                            sx={fieldSx}
                                        />

                                        {/* Product Lookup / Select */}
                                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                                            <FormControl size="small" fullWidth sx={fieldSx}>
                                                <Select
                                                    value={item.productName || ''}
                                                    displayEmpty
                                                    onChange={(e) => handleSelectProduct(idx, e.target.value)}
                                                >
                                                    <MenuItem value="" disabled>
                                                        -- Select Product --
                                                    </MenuItem>
                                                    {PRODUCT_CATALOG.map((p) => (
                                                        <MenuItem key={p.name} value={p.name}>
                                                            {p.name}
                                                        </MenuItem>
                                                    ))}
                                                </Select>
                                            </FormControl>
                                        </Box>

                                        {/* Amount (Unit price) */}
                                        <TextField
                                            size="small"
                                            type="number"
                                            value={item.amount}
                                            onChange={(e) =>
                                                handleUpdateLineItem(idx, {
                                                    amount: Math.max(0, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0),
                                                })
                                            }
                                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 0 } }}
                                            sx={fieldSx}
                                        />

                                        {/* Discount + Pct/Price selector */}
                                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0.5 }}>
                                            <TextField
                                                size="small"
                                                type="number"
                                                value={item.discount}
                                                onChange={(e) => {
                                                    const raw = Math.max(0, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0);
                                                    const val = item.discountType === 'percentage' ? Math.min(100, raw) : raw;
                                                    handleUpdateLineItem(idx, { discount: val });
                                                }}
                                                slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 0, max: item.discountType === 'percentage' ? 100 : undefined } }}
                                                sx={{ flex: 1, ...fieldSx }}
                                            />
                                            <FormControl size="small" sx={{ width: 75, ...fieldSx }}>
                                                <Select
                                                    value={item.discountType}
                                                    onChange={(e) => {
                                                        const newType = e.target.value as 'percentage' | 'direct';
                                                        const adjustedDiscount = newType === 'percentage' && item.discount > 100 ? 100 : item.discount;
                                                        handleUpdateLineItem(idx, {
                                                            discountType: newType,
                                                            discount: adjustedDiscount,
                                                        });
                                                    }}
                                                >
                                                    <MenuItem value="percentage">Pct</MenuItem>
                                                    <MenuItem value="direct">Price</MenuItem>
                                                </Select>
                                            </FormControl>
                                        </Box>

                                        {/* Sale Price (Readonly/calculated) */}
                                        <TextField
                                            size="small"
                                            value={item.salePrice.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                                            disabled
                                            sx={{
                                                ...fieldSx,
                                                '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
                                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                                    color: '#1e293b',
                                                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                                },
                                            }}
                                        />

                                        {/* Tax Amount + Tax Rate selector */}
                                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0.5 }}>
                                            <TextField
                                                size="small"
                                                value={item.taxAmount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                                                disabled
                                                sx={{
                                                    flex: 1,
                                                    ...fieldSx,
                                                    '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
                                                        fontWeight: 600,
                                                        backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                                    },
                                                }}
                                            />
                                            <FormControl size="small" sx={{ width: 95, ...fieldSx }}>
                                                <Select
                                                    value={item.taxRate}
                                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                                        handleUpdateLineItem(idx, { taxRate: e.target.value })
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    {OPPORTUNITY_TAX_RATES.map((rate) => (
                                                        <MenuItem key={rate} value={rate}>
                                                            {rate}
                                                        </MenuItem>
                                                    ))}
                                                </Select>
                                            </FormControl>
                                        </Box>

                                        {/* Total */}
                                        <TextField
                                            size="small"
                                            value={item.total.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                                            disabled
                                            sx={{
                                                ...fieldSx,
                                                '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
                                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                                    color: '#1e3a8a',
                                                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                                },
                                            }}
                                        />

                                        {/* Delete button (X) */}
                                        <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                                            <Tooltip title="Remove item">
                                                <IconButton
                                                    size="small"
                                                    onClick={() => handleRemoveLineItem(idx)}
                                                    sx={{
                                                        width: 32,
                                                        height: 32,
                                                        backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                                                        color: '#ffffff',
                                                        borderRadius: '4px',
                                                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#b91c1c' },
                                                    }}
                                                >
                                                    <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                                                </IconButton>
                                            </Tooltip>
                                        </Box>
                                    </Box>

                                    {/* Description and Note textareas below each row */}
                                    <Box
                                        sx={{
                                            display: 'grid',
                                            gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
                                            gap: 2,
                                            pt: 1,
                                            borderTop: '1px dashed #e2e8f0',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <Box>
                                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', mb: 0.5 }}>
                                                Description:
                                            </Typography>

                                                fullWidth

                                                    handleUpdateLineItem(idx, { description: e.target.value })
                                                }
                                                slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.longText } }}
                                                sx={fieldSx}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                        <Box>

                                                Note:
                                            </Typography>
                                            <TextField
                                                fullWidth

                                </Box>
                            ))}

                    )}

        </Box>
    );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COMPONENT B: RhfLineItemsConnected (Safe RHF Hook Caller)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function RhfLineItemsConnected() {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<CrmLineItemsValues>();

    const currency = useWatch({ control, name: 'currency' });
    const groupName = useWatch({ control, name: 'groupName' });
    const lineItems = useWatch({ control, name: 'lineItems' });
    const lumpSumDiscount = useWatch({ control, name: 'lumpSumDiscount' });
    const totalAmount = useWatch({ control, name: 'totalAmount' });
    const totalDiscount = useWatch({ control, name: 'totalDiscount' });
    const subtotal = useWatch({ control, name: 'subtotal' });
    const totalTax = useWatch({ control, name: 'totalTax' });
    const grandTotal = useWatch({ control, name: 'grandTotal' });

    const currentValue: CrmLineItemsValues = {
        currency: currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
        groupName: groupName || '',
        lineItems: Array.isArray(lineItems) ? lineItems : [],
        lumpSumDiscount: typeof lumpSumDiscount === 'number' ? lumpSumDiscount : 0,
        totalAmount: typeof totalAmount === 'number' ? totalAmount : 0,
        totalDiscount: typeof totalDiscount === 'number' ? totalDiscount : 0,
        subtotal: typeof subtotal === 'number' ? subtotal : 0,
        totalTax: typeof totalTax === 'number' ? totalTax : 0,
        grandTotal: typeof grandTotal === 'number' ? grandTotal : 0,
    };

    const handleChange = useCallback(
        <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(field: K, val: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => {
            setValue(
                field as unknown as Path<CrmLineItemsValues>,
                val as unknown as PathValue<CrmLineItemsValues, Path<CrmLineItemsValues>>,
                {
                    shouldDirty: true,
                    shouldValidate: true,
                }
            );
        },
        [setValue]
    );

    return <CrmLineItemsEditor value={currentValue} onChange={handleChange} />;
}

export function RhfLineItemsSection() {
    const rhfContext = useFormContext<CrmLineItemsValues>();
    if (!rhfContext) {
        return null;
    }
    return <RhfLineItemsConnected />;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SAFE HYBRID WRAPPER: CrmLineItemsSection
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function CrmLineItemsSection(props: CrmLineItemsSectionProps = {}) {
    const rhfContext = useFormContext<CrmLineItemsValues>();

    // 1. If explicit value and onChange are provided, render pure controlled component
    if (props.value && props.onChange) {
        return <CrmLineItemsEditor value={props.value} onChange={props.onChange} error={props.error} />;
    }

    // 2. If legacy form & setField are provided, adapt without RHF
    if (props.form && props.setField) {
        const legacyValue: CrmLineItemsValues = {
            currency: props.form.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
            groupName: props.form.groupName || '',
            lineItems: Array.isArray(props.form.lineItems) ? props.form.lineItems : [],
            lumpSumDiscount: props.form.lumpSumDiscount || 0,
            totalAmount: props.form.totalAmount || 0,
            totalDiscount: props.form.totalDiscount || 0,
            subtotal: props.form.subtotal || 0,
            totalTax: props.form.totalTax || 0,
            grandTotal: props.form.grandTotal || 0,
        };
        return <CrmLineItemsEditor value={legacyValue} onChange={props.setField} error={props.error} />;
    }

    // 3. If within a FormProvider, delegate to the RHF connected wrapper
    if (rhfContext) {
        return <RhfLineItemsConnected />;
    }

    // 4. Fallback safe editor if neither context nor props are supplied
    return (
        <CrmLineItemsEditor
            value={DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_VALUES}
            onChange={() => {}}
            error={props.error}
        />
    );
}

export default CrmLineItemsSection;

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useController, useFormContext, useWatch, type FieldPath, type FieldValues, type Path } from 'react-hook-form';
import {
    CityAutocompleteField,
    CountrySelectField,
    StateRegionField,
    countryIso2OrDefault,
    shouldResetStateForCountry,
} from '../AddressPrimitives';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import { resolveCountryIso2 } from '@/data/addressMaster';
import type { FieldSize } from '../fieldSizing';

interface RhfAddressFieldBaseProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    /** Width token (default `md`). */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;
}

/** Watches an optional country field; returns undefined when no field name is given. */
function useWatchedCountry<T extends FieldValues>(countryFieldName?: Path<T>, fallbackName?: Path<T>): string | undefined {
    const { control } = useFormContext<T>();
    // useWatch must always be called; watch the fallback (own) field when no country field is configured.
    const watched = useWatch({ control, name: (countryFieldName ?? fallbackName) as Path<T> });
    return countryFieldName ? ((watched as string | undefined) ?? '') : undefined;
}

// ── Country ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type RhfCountrySelectProps<T extends FieldValues> = RhfAddressFieldBaseProps<T>;

/** RHF country dropdown storing ISO2 codes; legacy names already in the form ('India') are converted to 'IN'. */
export function RhfCountrySelect<T extends FieldValues>({ name, fieldSize, ...props }: RhfCountrySelectProps<T>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    const { setValue } = useFormContext<T>();
    const raw = typeof field.value === 'string' ? field.value : '';

    useEffect(() => {
        const iso2 = resolveCountryIso2(raw);
        if (iso2 && iso2 !== raw) setValue(name, iso2 as never, { shouldDirty: false });
    }, [raw, name, setValue]);

    return (
        <CountrySelectField
            {...props}
            name={name}
            size={fieldSize}
            value={raw}
            onChange={(iso2) => field.onChange(iso2)}
            error={fieldState.error?.message}
        />
    );
}

// ── State / Region ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RhfStateRegionFieldProps<T extends FieldValues> extends RhfAddressFieldBaseProps<T> {
    /** Country field this state belongs to; options are filtered by it. */
    countryFieldName?: Path<T>;
    /** Fixed country when there is no country field. */
    countryCode?: string;
}

/** RHF state/region field filtered by the watched country; cleared when the country changes to one it doesn't belong to. */
export function RhfStateRegionField<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    countryFieldName,
    countryCode,
    fieldSize,
    ...props
}: RhfStateRegionFieldProps<T>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    const { setValue, getValues } = useFormContext<T>();
    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    const watchedCountry = useWatchedCountry<T>(countryFieldName, name);
    const country = watchedCountry ?? countryCode ?? '';
    const countryIso2 = countryIso2OrDefault(country);

    // Reset only on an actual country change (not on mount / record load, where state and country arrive together).
    const previousCountry = useRef(countryIso2);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (previousCountry.current === countryIso2) return;
        previousCountry.current = countryIso2;
        if (mode === 'view') return;
        const state = getValues(name) as string | undefined;
        if (shouldResetStateForCountry(state, countryIso2)) {
            setValue(name, '' as never, { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: false });
        }
    }, [countryIso2, mode, name, getValues, setValue]);

    return (
        <StateRegionField
            {...props}
            name={name}
            size={fieldSize}
            value={typeof field.value === 'string' ? field.value : ''}
            onChange={(v) => field.onChange(v)}
            countryValue={country}
            error={fieldState.error?.message}
        />
    );
}

// ── City ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RhfCityFieldProps<T extends FieldValues> extends RhfAddressFieldBaseProps<T> {
    /** Country field used to offer city suggestions (manual entry is always allowed). */
    countryFieldName?: Path<T>;
}

export function RhfCityField<T extends FieldValues>({ name, countryFieldName, fieldSize, ...props }: RhfCityFieldProps<T>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    const country = useWatchedCountry<T>(countryFieldName, name);

    return (
        <CityAutocompleteField
            {...props}
            name={name}
            size={fieldSize}
            value={typeof field.value === 'string' ? field.value : ''}
            onChange={(v) => field.onChange(v)}
            countryValue={country}
            error={fieldState.error?.message}
        />
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/forms/rhf/RhfAddressSection.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import LocalShippingOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalShippingOutlined';
import { useFormContext, useWatch, type FieldValues, type Path } from 'react-hook-form';

import { SectionLabel } from '../SectionLabel';
import { ReadOnlyField } from '../ReadOnlyField';
import { FormGrid, FormGridItem } from '../FormGrid';
import { formatAddressLine } from '@/utils/address';
import { countryIso2OrDefault } from '../AddressPrimitives';
import { RhfTextField } from './RhfTextField';
import { RhfPinCodeField } from './RhfPinCodeField';
import { RhfCheckbox } from './RhfCheckbox';
import { RhfCityField, RhfCountrySelect, RhfStateRegionField } from './RhfAddressFields';
import { DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE, getSubdivisionsByCountry } from '@/data/addressMaster';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';

export interface AddressFieldNames<T extends FieldValues> {
    address: Path<T>;
    city: Path<T>;
    state: Path<T>;
    postalCode: Path<T>;
    country: Path<T>;
}

export interface RhfAddressSectionProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    billingTitle?: string;
    shippingTitle?: string;
    streetLabel?: string;
    shippingStreetLabel?: string;
    billingFields?: AddressFieldNames<T>;
    shippingFields?: AddressFieldNames<T>;
    copyFieldName?: Path<T>;
    copyLabel?: string;
    /** Makes the left (billing / primary) column's fields required. */
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
}

const columnSx = { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 } as const;

/** Country + State, City + PIN side by side within each address column; one column on phones. */
const ADDRESS_GRID_COLUMNS = { sm: 2 };

/** Copy-able field keys mirrored from billing to shipping. */
const MIRRORED_KEYS = ['address', 'country', 'state', 'city', 'postalCode'] as const;

/**
 * Universal two-column address section (billing/primary on the left, shipping/other on the right) built on the
 * ISO 3166 address master: country dropdown storing ISO2, country-filtered state/region, free-text city and a
 * country-aware postal code. The optional copy checkbox mirrors the left column into the right one.
 */
export function RhfAddressSection<T extends FieldValues>({
    billingTitle = 'BILLING ADDRESS',
    shippingTitle = 'SHIPPING ADDRESS',
    streetLabel = 'Street',
    shippingStreetLabel = 'Street',
    billingFields = {
        address: 'billingAddress' as Path<T>,
        city: 'billingCity' as Path<T>,
        state: 'billingState' as Path<T>,
        postalCode: 'billingPostalCode' as Path<T>,
        country: 'billingCountry' as Path<T>,
    },
    shippingFields = {
        address: 'shippingAddress' as Path<T>,
        city: 'shippingCity' as Path<T>,
        state: 'shippingState' as Path<T>,
        postalCode: 'shippingPostalCode' as Path<T>,
        country: 'shippingCountry' as Path<T>,
    },
    copyFieldName = 'copyAddressFromBilling' as Path<T>,
    copyLabel = 'Copy address from left',
    required = true,
    disabled = false,
}: RhfAddressSectionProps<T>) {
    const { control, getValues, setValue } = useFormContext<T>();
    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    const copy = Boolean(useWatch({ control, name: copyFieldName }));

    const billingAddressVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.address });
    const billingCityVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.city });
    const billingStateVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.state });
    const billingPostalCodeVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.postalCode });
    const billingCountryVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.country });

    // Mirror the left column into the right one while "copy" is checked (exact values; country defaults to India).
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!copy || mode === 'view') return;
        const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
        const source: Record<(typeof MIRRORED_KEYS)[number], unknown> = {
            address: billingAddressVal ?? '',
            country: billingCountryVal || DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE,
            state: billingStateVal ?? '',
            city: billingCityVal ?? '',
            postalCode: billingPostalCodeVal ?? '',
        };
        for (const key of MIRRORED_KEYS) {
            if (getValues(shippingFields[key]) !== source[key]) {
                setValue(shippingFields[key], source[key] as never, opts);
            }
        }
    }, [
        copy,
        mode,
        billingAddressVal,
        billingCityVal,
        billingStateVal,
        billingPostalCodeVal,
        billingCountryVal,
        getValues,
        setValue,
        shippingFields,
    ]);

    const [sStreet, sCity, sState, sPostal, sCountry] = useWatch({
        control,
        name: [shippingFields.address, shippingFields.city, shippingFields.state, shippingFields.postalCode, shippingFields.country],
    });

    const billingHasStates = getSubdivisionsByCountry(countryIso2OrDefault(billingCountryVal as string)).length > 0;
    const shippingLocked = copy || disabled;

    if (mode === 'view') {
        const billingLine = formatAddressLine({
            street: billingAddressVal as string,
            city: billingCityVal as string,
            state: billingStateVal as string,
            postalCode: billingPostalCodeVal as string,
            country: billingCountryVal as string,
        });
        const shippingLine = formatAddressLine({
            street: sStreet as string,
            city: sCity as string,
            state: sState as string,
            postalCode: sPostal as string,
            country: sCountry as string,
        });
        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' }, gap: { xs: 3, md: 4 } }}>
                {billingLine && (
                    <Box sx={columnSx}>
                        <SectionLabel icon={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />} label={billingTitle} sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
                        <ReadOnlyField label="Address" value={billingLine} copyable />
                    </Box>
                )}
                {shippingLine && (
                    <Box sx={columnSx}>
                        <SectionLabel icon={<LocalShippingOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#64748b' }} />} label={shippingTitle} sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
                        <ReadOnlyField label="Address" value={shippingLine} copyable />
                    </Box>
                )}
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                gap: { xs: 3, md: 4 },
            }}
        >
            {/* ── Left Column: Billing / Primary Address ── */}
            <Box sx={columnSx}>
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                    label={billingTitle}
                    sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                />
                <FormGrid columns={ADDRESS_GRID_COLUMNS}>
                    <RhfCountrySelect<T> name={billingFields.country} required={required} disabled={disabled} />
                    <RhfStateRegionField<T>
                        name={billingFields.state}
                        countryFieldName={billingFields.country}
                        required={required && billingHasStates}
                        disabled={disabled}
                    />
                    <RhfCityField<T>
                        name={billingFields.city}
                        countryFieldName={billingFields.country}
                        required={required}
                        disabled={disabled}
                    />
                    <RhfPinCodeField<T>
                        name={billingFields.postalCode}
                        countryFieldName={billingFields.country}
                        required={required}
                        disabled={disabled}
                    />
                    <FormGridItem span="full">
                        <RhfTextField<T>
                            name={billingFields.address}
                            label={streetLabel}
                            required={required}
                            hint="Street address, building, premises"
                            multiline
                            minRows={3}
                            maxRows={4}
                            placeholder="Enter street and building address..."
                            disabled={disabled}
                            fieldSize="lg"
                        />
                    </FormGridItem>
                </FormGrid>
            </Box>

            {/* ── Right Column: Shipping / Other Address ── */}
            <Box sx={columnSx}>
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        flexWrap: 'wrap',
                        gap: 1,
                        mb: 1,
                    }}
                >
                    <SectionLabel
                        icon={<LocalShippingOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#64748b' }} />}
                        label={shippingTitle}
                    />
                    <RhfCheckbox<T> name={copyFieldName} label={copyLabel} />
                </Box>

                <FormGrid columns={ADDRESS_GRID_COLUMNS}>
                    <RhfCountrySelect<T> name={shippingFields.country} disabled={shippingLocked} />
                    <RhfStateRegionField<T>
                        name={shippingFields.state}
                        countryFieldName={shippingFields.country}
                        disabled={shippingLocked}
                    />
                    <RhfCityField<T>
                        name={shippingFields.city}
                        countryFieldName={shippingFields.country}
                        disabled={shippingLocked}
                    />
                    <RhfPinCodeField<T>
                        name={shippingFields.postalCode}
                        countryFieldName={shippingFields.country}
