'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar, Box, Chip, IconButton, Tooltip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import { useFormContext, useWatch, type FieldPath, type FieldValues, type PathValue } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField } from '../FormField';
import type { FieldSize } from '../fieldSizing';
import { UserLookupModal } from '@/components/common/lookup';
import { findCrmUser } from '@/services/masterData.store';
import { useMasterData } from '@/hooks/queries/useMasterData';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';

export interface RhfAssignedUserCardProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    /** Outlined pill beside the change button (e.g. "Primary Rep"). Pass an empty string to hide it. */
    roleBadge?: string;
    hint?: string;
    /** Called with the picked username in addition to updating the form, for forms that mirror values elsewhere. */
    onValueChange?: (username: string) => void;
    /** Width token (default `md`): the card only holds an avatar, a truncating name, a badge and a button. */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;
}

const getInitials = (name: string) => {
    const parts = name.replace(/[._-]+/g, ' ').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length === 0) return '?';
    if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase();
};

/**
 * React Hook Form bound "assigned user" card: avatar, full name, role • department and a button that
 * opens the user directory. Stores the picked user's username. Must be rendered inside a `FormProvider`.
 */
export function RhfAssignedUserCard<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    label = 'Assigned to (Account Executive)',
    required = true,
    roleBadge = 'Primary Rep',
    hint,
    onValueChange,
    fieldSize = 'md',
}: RhfAssignedUserCardProps<T>) {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<T>();
    const assignedUsername = (useWatch({ control, name }) as string | undefined) || '';
    const [lookupOpen, setLookupOpen] = useState(false);
    const isView = useFormMode().mode === 'view';
    // Re-renders once the user directory loads (API mode), so the card shows the person, not just the username.
    useMasterData();

    const user = findCrmUser(assignedUsername);
    const displayName = user?.name || assignedUsername || 'Unassigned';
    const subtitle = user
        ? `${user.role} • ${user.department}`
        : assignedUsername
          ? 'Not in user directory'
          : 'No user assigned';

    const handleSelect = (username: string) => {
        setValue(name, username as PathValue<T, FieldPath<T>>, { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true });
        onValueChange?.(username);
    };

    return (
        <FormField
            name={name}
            label={label}
            required={required}
            hint={hint}
            viewValue={assignedUsername ? `${displayName} • ${subtitle}` : ''}
            size={fieldSize}
            sx={{ mb: 0 }}
        >
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 1,
                    p: 1.5,
                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    transition: 'border-color 0.15s ease',
                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1' },
                }}
            >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Avatar sx={{ width: 32, height: 32, fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, backgroundColor: '#1d4ed8', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        {getInitials(displayName)}
                    </Avatar>
                    <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b', lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                            {displayName}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.2 }}>
                            {subtitle}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                </Box>
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    {roleBadge && (
                        <Chip
                            label={roleBadge}
                            size="small"
                            variant="outlined"
                            sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: 22, borderColor: '#cbd5e1', color: '#475569', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 500 }}
                        />
                    )}
                    {!isView && (
                        <Tooltip title="Change assigned user">
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                aria-label="Change assigned user"
                                onClick={() => setLookupOpen(true)}
                                sx={{ color: '#64748b', width: 28, height: 28, '&:hover': { color: '#1d4ed8', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' } }}
                            >
                                <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                            </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                    )}
                </Box>
            </Box>
            <UserLookupModal
                open={lookupOpen}
                onClose={() => setLookupOpen(false)}
                onSelect={(selected) => handleSelect(selected.username)}
                selectedValue={assignedUsername}
            />
        </FormField>
    );
}

import React from 'react';

/** React Hook Form bound boolean checkbox. */
export function RhfCheckbox<T extends FieldValues>({ name, label }: RhfCheckboxProps<T>) {

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Chip, FormHelperText } from '@mui/material';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import { useController, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField } from '../FormField';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import { ReadOnlyField } from '../ReadOnlyField';

export interface RhfChipGroupProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    options: readonly string[];
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
}

/** React Hook Form bound multi-select chip group (string[] field). */
export function RhfChipGroup<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    label,
    options,
    required,
    hint,
}: RhfChipGroupProps<T>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    const selected: string[] = Array.isArray(field.value) ? field.value : [];

    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    if (mode === 'view') {
        return (
            <ReadOnlyField
                label={label}
                hideWhenEmpty
                value={
                    selected.length > 0 ? (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.75 }}>
                            {selected.map((option) => (
                                <Chip
                                    key={option}
                                    label={option}
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'default', color: '#1d4ed8', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' }}
                                />
                            ))}
                        </Box>
                    ) : undefined
                }
                sx={{ mb: 2 }}
            />
        );
    }

    const toggle = (option: string) =>
        field.onChange(
            selected.includes(option) ? selected.filter((o) => o !== option) : [...selected, option]
        );

    return (
        <FormField name={name} label={label} required={required} hint={hint} size="full">
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.8 }}>
                {options.map((option) => {
                    const active = selected.includes(option);
                    return (
                        <Chip
                            key={option}
                            label={option}
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => toggle(option)}
                            icon={active ? <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: '14px !important' }} /> : undefined}
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                backgroundColor: active ? '#dcfce7' : '#f1f5f9',
                                color: active ? '#166534' : '#475569',
                                border: `1px solid ${active ? '#86efac' : '#e2e8f0'}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                })}
            </Box>
            {fieldState.error && <FormHelperText error>{fieldState.error.message}</FormHelperText>}
        </FormField>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/forms/rhf/RhfDateTimeField.tsx

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, FormHelperText, InputAdornment, TextField } from '@mui/material';
import CalendarTodayOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarTodayOutlined';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';
import { useController, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import { ReadOnlyField } from '../ReadOnlyField';
import type { FieldSize } from '../fieldSizing';

export interface RhfDateTimeFieldProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    dateName: FieldPath<T>;
    timeName?: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Single `datetime-local` input bound to `dateName` (value `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`) instead of a
     * separate date + free-text time pair. `timeName` is ignored.
     */
    combined?: boolean;
    /** Width token; defaults to `sm` for a date alone and `md` for date + time. */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;
}

const adornment = (icon: React.ReactNode) => ({
    input: { startAdornment: <InputAdornment position="start">{icon}</InputAdornment> },
});

/** Paired date + optional time input bound to two RHF fields. */
export function RhfDateTimeField<T extends FieldValues>({
    dateName,
    timeName,
    label,
    required,
    hint,
    combined = false,
    fieldSize,
}: RhfDateTimeFieldProps<T>) {
    const size = fieldSize ?? (combined || timeName ? 'md' : 'sm');
    const date = useController<T>({ name: dateName });
    // useController requires a name; fall back to the date name when no time field is configured.
    const time = useController<T>({ name: (timeName ?? dateName) as FieldPath<T> });
    const error = date.fieldState.error?.message ?? (timeName && !combined ? time.fieldState.error?.message : undefined);

    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    if (combined) {
        const raw = typeof date.field.value === 'string' ? date.field.value : '';
        if (mode === 'view') {
            const parsed = raw ? new Date(raw) : null;
            const text =
                parsed && !Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())
                    ? parsed.toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })
                    : raw;
            return <ReadOnlyField label={label} value={text} hideWhenEmpty sx={{ mb: 2 }} />;
        }
        return (
            <FormField name={dateName} label={label} required={required} hint={hint} size={size}>
                <TextField
                    {...date.field}
                    value={raw}
                    type="datetime-local"
                    fullWidth
                    size="small"
                    error={Boolean(date.fieldState.error)}
                    slotProps={adornment(<CalendarTodayOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />)}
                    sx={fieldSx}
                />
                {error && <FormHelperText error>{error}</FormHelperText>}
            </FormField>
        );
    }

    if (mode === 'view') {
        const rawDate = typeof date.field.value === 'string' ? date.field.value : '';
        const parsed = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(rawDate) ? new Date(`${rawDate}T00:00:00`) : null;
        const dateText = parsed
            ? parsed.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
            : rawDate;
        const timeText = timeName && typeof time.field.value === 'string' ? time.field.value : '';
        return <ReadOnlyField label={label} value={[dateText, timeText].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')} hideWhenEmpty sx={{ mb: 2 }} />;
    }

    return (
        <FormField name={dateName} label={label} required={required} hint={hint} size={size}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: timeName ? '1.4fr 1fr' : '1fr', gap: 1.5 }}>
                <TextField
                    {...date.field}
                    value={date.field.value ?? ''}
                    type="date"
                    fullWidth
                    size="small"
                    error={Boolean(date.fieldState.error)}
                    slotProps={adornment(<CalendarTodayOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />)}
                    sx={fieldSx}
                />
                {timeName && (
                    <TextField
                        {...time.field}
                        value={time.field.value ?? ''}
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. 11:30 AM"
                        error={Boolean(time.fieldState.error)}
                        slotProps={adornment(<AccessTimeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                    />
                )}
            </Box>
            {error && <FormHelperText error>{error}</FormHelperText>}
        </FormField>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/forms/rhf/RhfEmailList.tsx

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Button, FormHelperText, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import { useController, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { EmailRow } from '../EmailRow';
import { fieldSizeSx } from '../fieldSizing';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import type { CorporateEmail } from '@/types/organization.types';

export interface RhfEmailListProps {
    /** Name of the `CorporateEmail[]` field. Defaults to `emailAddresses`. */
    name?: string;
    label?: string;
    required?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Repeatable email list bound to a `CorporateEmail[]` field.
 * Guarantees exactly one primary address whenever at least one row exists.
 */
export function RhfEmailList({
    name = 'emailAddresses',
    label = 'Email Address',
    required,
}: RhfEmailListProps) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<FieldValues>({ name });
    const rows: CorporateEmail[] = Array.isArray(field.value) ? field.value : [];

    const errorMessage =
        (fieldState.error as { root?: { message?: string } } | undefined)?.root?.message ??
        fieldState.error?.message;

    const isView = useFormMode().mode === 'view';

    const commit = (next: CorporateEmail[]) => field.onChange(next);

    const handleAdd = () =>
        commit([
            ...rows,
            {
                id: `eml-${Date.now()}`,
                email: '',
                isPrimary: rows.length === 0,
                isOptedOut: false,
                isInvalidBounce: false,
            },
        ]);

    const handleChange = (index: number, updated: CorporateEmail) =>
        commit(
            rows.map((row, i) => {
                if (i === index) return updated;
                return updated.isPrimary ? { ...row, isPrimary: false } : row;
            })
        );

    const handleRemove = (index: number) => {
        const next = rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
        if (next.length > 0 && !next.some((e) => e.isPrimary)) {
            next[0] = { ...next[0], isPrimary: true };
        }
        commit(next);
    };

    if (isView && rows.length === 0) return null;

    return (
        // Capped so the email cards (address + flags) don't stretch across wide layouts.
        <Box sx={{ mb: 1, ...fieldSizeSx('lg') }}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 1 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                    {label}
                    {required && (
                        <Box component="span" sx={{ color: '#ef4444', ml: 0.4 }}>
                            *
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </Typography>
                {!isView && (
                <Button
                    size="small"
                    startIcon={<AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                    onClick={handleAdd}
                    sx={{
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: '#2563eb',
                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                        px: 1.2,
                        py: 0.3,
                        borderRadius: '6px',
                        border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#dbeafe' },
                    }}
                >
                    Add Email
                </Button>
                )}
            </Box>

            {rows.map((row, index) => (
                <EmailRow
                    key={row.id}
                    email={row}
                    onChange={(updated) => handleChange(index, updated)}
                    onRemove={() => handleRemove(index)}
                />
            ))}

            {errorMessage && <FormHelperText error>{errorMessage}</FormHelperText>}
        </Box>
    );
}

================
File: frontend-crm/src/components/forms/rhf/RhfLookup.tsx
================
'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FormHelperText } from '@mui/material';
import { useController, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField } from '../FormField';
import { LookupField } from '../LookupField';
import { resolveFieldSize, type FieldSize } from '../fieldSizing';
import { RecordLookupModal, LOOKUP_DISPLAY_VALUE, findLookupRecord } from '@/components/common/lookup';
import { getAssignableUsernames } from '@/services/masterData.store';
import { useContacts, useOrganizations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import { useMasterData } from '@/hooks/queries/useMasterData';
import type { LookupKind, LookupRecordMap } from '@/types/lookup.types';

export interface RhfLookupProps<T extends FieldValues, K extends LookupKind = LookupKind> {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    options?: string[];
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    placeholder?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    /**
     * Wires the `[ > ]` button to a built-in picker. `custom` (default) defers to `onLookupClick`.
     * For `user`, autocomplete suggestions default to the active user directory when `options` is omitted.
     */
    lookupType?: K | 'custom';
    /** Handler for the `[ > ]` button when `lookupType` is `custom`. */
    onLookupClick?: () => void;
    /** Which user property is written into the field for `lookupType="user"` (default `username`). */
    userValueField?: 'username' | 'name';
    /**
     * Fired with the full record when one is picked from the modal, or when the typed /
     * autocompleted value exactly matches a record — e.g. to auto-populate sibling fields.
     */
    onSelectRecord?: (record: LookupRecordMap[K]) => void;
    /** Fired once when a non-empty value is cleared, via the [X] button or by deleting the text. */
    onClearRecord?: () => void;
    /** Width token for input + action buttons (default `md` for user lookups, `lg` otherwise). */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;
}

/** React Hook Form bound lookup/autocomplete built on the shared {@link LookupField}. */
export function RhfLookup<T extends FieldValues, K extends LookupKind = LookupKind>({
    name,
    label,
    options,
    required,
    hint,
    placeholder,
    disabled,
    lookupType = 'custom',
    onLookupClick,
    userValueField = 'username',
    onSelectRecord,
    onClearRecord,
    fieldSize,
}: RhfLookupProps<T, K>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const value = (field.value as string) ?? '';

    const kind: K | null = lookupType === 'custom' ? null : lookupType;
    // Usernames are short; record lookups (organizations, contacts…) keep the wider `lg` default.
    const size = resolveFieldSize(name, 'lookup', fieldSize ?? (kind === 'user' ? 'md' : undefined));
    // Subscribes to the user directory so suggestions fill in once it loads (API mode).
    const { users } = useMasterData();
    const { data: organizations } = useOrganizations(undefined, {
        enabled: kind === 'organization' && Boolean(onSelectRecord),
    });
    const { data: contacts } = useContacts(undefined, {
        enabled: kind === 'contact' && Boolean(onSelectRecord),
    });
    const suggestions = useMemo(
        () => options ?? (kind === 'user' ? getAssignableUsernames() : undefined),
        // `users` is the re-render trigger; getAssignableUsernames reads the same directory.
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
        [options, kind, users]
    );

    const handleSelect = (record: LookupRecordMap[K]) => {
        if (!kind) return;
        const display =
            kind === 'user' && userValueField === 'name'
                ? (record as LookupRecordMap['user']).name
                : LOOKUP_DISPLAY_VALUE[kind](record);
        field.onChange(display);
        onSelectRecord?.(record);
    };

    // Covers the [X] button (LookupField calls onChange('') first) and backspacing the text away.
    // Only fires when there was something to clear, so empty-to-empty updates stay silent.
    const handleChange = (next: string) => {
        field.onChange(next);
        if (!next.trim()) {
            if (value.trim()) onClearRecord?.();
            return;
        }
        if (!kind || !onSelectRecord || next === value) return;
        const match = findLookupRecord(kind, next, { organizations, contacts });
        if (match) onSelectRecord(match);
    };

    return (
        <FormField name={name} label={label} required={required} hint={hint} size={size}>
            <LookupField
                value={value}
                onChange={handleChange}
                options={suggestions}
                placeholder={placeholder}
                required={required}
                disabled={disabled}
                onLookupClick={kind ? () => setModalOpen(true) : onLookupClick}
            />
            {fieldState.error && (
                <FormHelperText error sx={{ mx: 1.75 }}>
                    {fieldState.error.message}
                </FormHelperText>
            )}
            {kind && (
                <RecordLookupModal<K>
                    kind={kind}
                    open={modalOpen}
                    onClose={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                    onSelect={handleSelect}
                    selectedValue={value}
                />
            )}
        </FormField>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/forms/rhf/RhfPhoneField.tsx
================
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Autocomplete, Box, InputAdornment, TextField } from '@mui/material';
import { useController, useFormContext, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';
import { resolveFieldSize } from '../fieldSizing';
import type { RhfTextFieldProps } from './RhfTextField';
import {
    DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY_ISO2,
    getPhoneCountry,
    PHONE_COUNTRIES,
    matchesPhoneCountry,
    type PhoneCountry,
} from '@/data/countryPhoneCodes';
import { getPreferredCountry, setPreferredCountry, subscribePreferredCountry } from '@/utils/phoneCountryStore';
import { formatPhoneDisplay, joinPhone, maxNationalDigits, splitPhone } from '@/utils/phone';

export type RhfPhoneFieldProps<T extends FieldValues = FieldValues> = Omit<RhfTextFieldProps<T>, 'numericOnly'> & {
    /** ISO-2 country preselected for empty values and legacy numbers without a country code. Defaults to India. */
    defaultCountry?: string;
    /**
     * When true, picking a country here sets the default country of the form's other phone fields.
     * Defaults to true only for the primary "mobile" field.
     */
    setsFormDefault?: boolean;
};

function CountryFlag({ country }: { country: PhoneCountry }) {
    return (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- tiny CDN flag; next/image adds nothing here
        <img
            src={country.flagUrl}
            srcSet={`${country.flagUrl2x} 2x`}
            width={20}
            height={15}
            alt=""
            loading="lazy"
            style={{ objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 2, flexShrink: 0 }}
        />
    );
}

/**
 * International phone input: a searchable country picker (name, ISO-2, ISO-3 or dial code) embedded in the
 * start of an MUI TextField, plus a digits-only national number input. The form value is the full E.164
 * string (`+919811234567`, '' when empty). Legacy 10-digit values are shown as India (+91).
 * Selecting a country closes the list and moves focus to the number input.
 */
export function RhfPhoneField<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    label,
    required,
    hint,
    fieldSize,
    fieldType = 'phone',
    placeholder = 'e.g. 9811234567',
    disabled,
    sx,
    slotProps,
    defaultCountry = DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY_ISO2,
    setsFormDefault = /(^|\.)mobile$/.test(name),
    onChange: onChangeProp,
    // Accepted for compatibility with RhfTextField call sites; the national length is derived from the country.
    maxLength: _maxLength,
    ...rest
}: RhfPhoneFieldProps<T>) {
    void _maxLength;
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
    const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
    const { control } = useFormContext<T>();
    // Country chosen in any other phone field of this form; empty untouched fields default to it.
    const sharedIso2 = React.useSyncExternalStore(
        (notify) => subscribePreferredCountry(control, notify),
        () => getPreferredCountry(control),
        () => undefined,
    );
    const [pickedByUser, setPickedByUser] = React.useState(false);
    const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = React.useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
    const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<PhoneCountry>(
        () => splitPhone(field.value, getPreferredCountry(control) ?? defaultCountry).country,
    );

    const value: string = typeof field.value === 'string' ? field.value : '';
    // Keep the user's chosen country while it still prefixes the value (+1 vs +1242 are ambiguous to parse).
    const ownsValue = !value || value.startsWith(selected.dialCode);
    const external = ownsValue ? null : splitPhone(value, defaultCountry);
    const country = external?.country ?? selected;
    const national = external
        ? external.national
        : value.slice(selected.dialCode.length).replace(/\D/g, '');

    // Adopt the country of an externally set value (form reset / async load); adjusting state during render is the React-sanctioned pattern.
    if (external && external.country.iso2 !== selected.iso2) setSelected(external.country);

    // Follow the form's preferred country while this field is empty and the user hasn't chosen its own.
    const shared = !value && !pickedByUser && sharedIso2 ? getPhoneCountry(sharedIso2) : undefined;
    if (shared && shared.iso2 !== selected.iso2) setSelected(shared);

    const emit = (next: string) => {
        field.onChange(next);
        onChangeProp?.({ target: { name, value: next } } as unknown as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>);
    };

    const handleCountryChange = (_: unknown, next: PhoneCountry | null) => {
        if (!next) return;
        setSelected(next);
        setPickedByUser(true);
        if (setsFormDefault) setPreferredCountry(control, next.iso2);
        setOpen(false);
        emit(joinPhone(next, national.slice(0, maxNationalDigits(next))));
        // Wait for the popup to unmount and Autocomplete to settle before moving focus.
        setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 0);
    };

    const handleNumberChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        const raw = e.target.value;
        if (raw.trim().startsWith('+')) {
            // Pasted a full international number: pick the country from it.
            const parsed = splitPhone(raw, country.iso2);
            setSelected(parsed.country);
            emit(joinPhone(parsed.country, parsed.national.slice(0, maxNationalDigits(parsed.country))));
            return;
        }
        emit(joinPhone(country, raw.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, maxNationalDigits(country))));
    };

    const resolvedSize = resolveFieldSize(name, fieldType, fieldSize);
    const htmlInput = (slotProps?.htmlInput as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};

    return (
        <FormField
            name={name}
            label={label}
            required={required}
            hint={hint}
            size={resolvedSize}
            viewValue={formatPhoneDisplay(value) || undefined}
        >
            <TextField
                {...rest}
                ref={setAnchorEl}
                inputRef={(el: HTMLInputElement | null) => {
                    inputRef.current = el;
                    field.ref(el);
                }}
                name={name}
                value={national}
                onChange={handleNumberChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                disabled={disabled}
                placeholder={placeholder}
                fullWidth
                size="small"
                error={Boolean(fieldState.error)}
                helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
                sx={{ ...fieldSx, ...sx }}
                slotProps={{
                    ...slotProps,
                    htmlInput: {
                        ...htmlInput,
                        type: 'tel',
                        inputMode: 'tel',
                        autoComplete: 'tel-national',
                        'data-phone-national': '',
                        maxLength: maxNationalDigits(country),
                    },
                    input: {
                        ...(slotProps?.input as object | undefined),
                        sx: { pl: 1 },
                        startAdornment: (
                            <InputAdornment position="start" sx={{ mr: 0.5, ml: 0 }}>
                                <Autocomplete<PhoneCountry, false, true, false>
                                    options={PHONE_COUNTRIES as PhoneCountry[]}
                                    value={country}
                                    disableClearable
                                    autoHighlight
                                    selectOnFocus
                                    openOnFocus
                                    disabled={disabled}
                                    open={open}
                                    onOpen={() => setOpen(true)}
                                    onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
                                    onChange={handleCountryChange}
                                    isOptionEqualToValue={(a, b) => a.iso2 === b.iso2}
                                    getOptionLabel={(c) => `${c.iso3} ${c.dialCode}`}
                                    getOptionKey={(c) => c.iso2}
                                    filterOptions={(options, state) =>
                                        // Selected value's label ("IND") is not a query: show everything until the user types.
                                        state.inputValue === `${country.iso3} ${country.dialCode}`
                                            ? options
                                            : options.filter((c) => matchesPhoneCountry(c, state.inputValue))
                                    }
                                    sx={{ width: 82, flexShrink: 0 }}
                                    slotProps={{
                                        popper: {
                                            anchorEl,
                                            placement: 'bottom-start',
                                            modifiers: [{ name: 'offset', options: { offset: [0, 6] } }],
                                            sx: { width: '340px !important', zIndex: 1500 },
                                        },
                                        paper: { sx: { fontSize: '0.85rem' } },
                                    }}
                                    renderOption={(props, c) => {
                                        const { key, ...optionProps } = props as React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> & {
                                            key: string;
                                        };
                                        return (
                                            <Box
                                                component="li"
                                                key={key}
                                                {...optionProps}
                                                sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}
                                            >
                                                <CountryFlag country={c} />
                                                <Box component="span" sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                                                    {c.name}
                                                </Box>
                                                <Box component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, width: 34, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                                                    {c.iso3}
                                                </Box>
                                                <Box component="span" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', minWidth: 42, textAlign: 'right', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                                                    {c.dialCode}
                                                </Box>
                                            </Box>
                                        );
                                    }}
                                    renderInput={(params) => (
                                        <TextField
                                            {...params}
                                            variant="standard"
                                            size="small"
                                            placeholder="Code"
                                            aria-label={`${label} country code`}
                                            slotProps={{
                                                ...params.slotProps,
                                                input: {
                                                    ...params.slotProps.input,
                                                    disableUnderline: true,
                                                    sx: { fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 500, pl: '0 !important', pr: '16px !important', '& input': { p: '0 !important', minWidth: 0 }, '& .MuiAutocomplete-endAdornment': { right: 0 } },
                                                },
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    )}
                                />
                                <Box
                                    aria-hidden
                                    sx={{ width: '1px', height: 20, bgcolor: 'divider', ml: 0, flexShrink: 0 }}
                                />
                            </InputAdornment>
                        ),
                    },
                }}
            />
        </FormField>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { TextField } from '@mui/material';
import {
    useController,
    useFormContext,
    useWatch,
    type FieldPath,
    type FieldValues,
    type Path,
} from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';
import { getPostalCodeConfig } from '../AddressPrimitives';
import type { FieldSize } from '../fieldSizing';

export interface RhfPinCodeFieldProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    /** Overrides the country-specific default label. */
    label?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    placeholder?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    /** Country field to follow (ISO2 or legacy name). */
    countryFieldName?: Path<T>;
    /** Fixed country when there is no country field. Defaults to India. */
    countryCode?: string;
    /** Width token (default `xs`). */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;
}

/**
 * Country-aware postal code input.
 * India: 6-digit numeric PIN. Elsewhere: up to 12 uppercase letters, digits, spaces and hyphens.
 */
export function RhfPinCodeField<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    label,
    required,
    hint,
    placeholder,
    disabled,
    countryFieldName,
    countryCode,
    fieldSize = 'xs',
}: RhfPinCodeFieldProps<T>) {
    const { control } = useFormContext<T>();
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    // useWatch must always run; it watches this field itself when no country field is configured (value ignored).
    const watchedCountry = useWatch({ control, name: (countryFieldName ?? name) as Path<T> });
    const country = countryFieldName ? (watchedCountry as string | undefined) : countryCode;
    const config = getPostalCodeConfig(country);

    return (
        <FormField name={name} label={label ?? config.label} required={required} hint={hint} size={fieldSize}>
            <TextField
                {...field}
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => field.onChange(config.sanitize(e.target.value))}
                fullWidth
                size="small"
                placeholder={placeholder ?? config.placeholder}
                disabled={disabled}
                error={Boolean(fieldState.error)}
                helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
                slotProps={{
                    htmlInput: {
                        maxLength: config.maxLength,
                        inputMode: config.inputMode,
                        ...(config.isIndia ? { pattern: '[0-9]*' } : {}),
                    },
                }}
                sx={fieldSx}
            />
        </FormField>
    );
}

import React from 'react';

================
File: frontend-crm/src/components/forms/rhf/RhfTextField.tsx
================
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { TextField, type TextFieldProps } from '@mui/material';
import { useController, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';
import {
    fieldTypeFromInput,
    isTaxIdentifierField,
    resolveFieldMaxLength,
    resolveFieldSize,
    type FieldSize,
    type FieldType,
} from '../fieldSizing';

export interface RhfTextFieldProps<T extends FieldValues>
    extends Pick<
        TextFieldProps,
        'type' | 'multiline' | 'minRows' | 'maxRows' | 'placeholder' | 'disabled' | 'slotProps' | 'sx'
    > {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    numericOnly?: boolean;
    uppercase?: boolean;
    lowercase?: boolean;
    maxLength?: number;
    min?: number | string;
    max?: number | string;
    step?: number | string;
    /** Width token; inferred from `name` / `fieldType` when omitted. */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;
    /** Data shape used for size inference; derived from `type` / `multiline` when omitted. */
    fieldType?: FieldType;
    onChange?: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
}

/**
 * React Hook Form bound text input rendered inside the shared {@link FormField} shell.
 * Must be rendered inside a `FormProvider`.
 * Enforces production-grade enterprise input constraints (numeric-only, uppercase, lowercase, max/min limits).
 */
export function RhfTextField<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    label,
    required,
    hint,
    numericOnly,
    uppercase,
    lowercase,
    maxLength,
    min,
    max,
    step,
    fieldSize,
    fieldType,
    sx,
    slotProps,
    ...inputProps
}: RhfTextFieldProps<T>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });

    const resolvedType = fieldType ?? fieldTypeFromInput(inputProps.type, inputProps.multiline);
    const resolvedSize = resolveFieldSize(name, resolvedType, fieldSize);

    const isNumeric =
        numericOnly ??
        (resolvedType === 'phone' ||
            /(mobile|phone)/i.test(name) ||
            /(mobile|phone)/i.test(label));

    // Exact-name match: a substring test would uppercase fields like "Principal Company" (com-pan-y).
    const isUppercase = uppercase ?? (isTaxIdentifierField(name) || isTaxIdentifierField(label));

    const isEmail =
        lowercase ??
        (inputProps.type === 'email' ||
            /(email)/i.test(name) ||
            /(email)/i.test(label));

    const existingHtmlInput =
        (slotProps?.htmlInput as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) || {};

    // Postal codes resolve to the international 12-char cap; country-specific masking lives in RhfPinCodeField.
    const resolvedMaxLength =
        resolveFieldMaxLength(name, maxLength ?? (existingHtmlInput.maxLength as number | undefined)) ??
        resolveFieldMaxLength(label);

    const handleChange = (
        e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>
    ) => {
        let val = e.target.value;
        if (isNumeric) {
            val = val.replace(/\D/g, '');
            if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
            }
            e.target.value = val;
        } else if (isUppercase) {
            val = val.toUpperCase();
            if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
            }
            e.target.value = val;
        } else if (isEmail) {
            val = val.toLowerCase().trim();
            e.target.value = val;
        } else if (inputProps.type === 'number') {
            const num = parseFloat(val);
            if (!isNaN(num)) {
                if (max !== undefined && num > Number(max)) {
                    val = String(max);
                    e.target.value = val;
                } else if (min !== undefined && num < Number(min)) {
                    val = String(min);
                    e.target.value = val;
                }
            }
        }
        field.onChange(val);
        inputProps.onChange?.(e);
    };

    const mergedSlotProps = {
        ...slotProps,
        htmlInput: {
            ...existingHtmlInput,
            ...(min !== undefined ? { min } : {}),
            ...(max !== undefined ? { max } : {}),
            ...(step !== undefined ? { step } : {}),
            ...(isNumeric
                ? {
                      inputMode: 'numeric',
                      pattern: '[0-9]*',
                  }
                : {}),
            ...(resolvedMaxLength ? { maxLength: resolvedMaxLength } : {}),
            onInput: (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
                const target = e.currentTarget;
                if (isNumeric && target.value) {
                    let val = target.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                    if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                        val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
                    }
                    target.value = val;
                } else if (isUppercase && target.value) {
                    let val = target.value.toUpperCase();
                    if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                        val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
                    }
                    target.value = val;
                } else if (isEmail && target.value) {
                    target.value = target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                } else if (inputProps.type === 'number' && target.value) {
                    const num = parseFloat(target.value);
                    if (!isNaN(num)) {
                        if (max !== undefined && num > Number(max)) {
                            target.value = String(max);
                        } else if (min !== undefined && num < Number(min)) {
                            target.value = String(min);
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
        },
    };

    return (
        <FormField name={name} label={label} required={required} hint={hint} size={resolvedSize}>
            <TextField
                {...inputProps}
                {...field}
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChange={handleChange}
                fullWidth
                size="small"
                slotProps={mergedSlotProps}
                error={Boolean(fieldState.error)}
                helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
                sx={{ ...fieldSx, ...sx }}
            />
        </FormField>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Chip, Switch, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch, type FieldPath, type FieldValues, type PathValue } from 'react-hook-form';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';

export interface ToggleItem<T extends FieldValues> {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    caption?: string;
}

export interface RhfToggleGroupCardProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    items: ToggleItem<T>[];
    /** Called after a switch changes, for forms that mirror values outside React Hook Form. */
    onValueChange?: (name: FieldPath<T>, checked: boolean) => void;
}

/**
 * Card of labelled on/off switches (AMC, Cloud, …) bound to boolean RHF fields; shows Yes/No pills in view mode.
 * Must be rendered inside a `FormProvider`.
 */
export function RhfToggleGroupCard<T extends FieldValues>({ items, onValueChange }: RhfToggleGroupCardProps<T>) {
    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', sm: `repeat(${Math.min(items.length, 2)}, 1fr)` },
                gap: 2,
                p: 1.75,
                mb: 2,
                border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                borderRadius: '10px',
                backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
            }}
        >
            {items.map((item) => (
                <ToggleCell<T> key={item.name} item={item} onValueChange={onValueChange} />
            ))}
        </Box>
    );
}

function ToggleCell<T extends FieldValues>({
    item,
    onValueChange,
}: {
    item: ToggleItem<T>;
    onValueChange?: (name: FieldPath<T>, checked: boolean) => void;
}) {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<T>();
    const isView = useFormMode().mode === 'view';
    const checked = Boolean(useWatch({ control, name: item.name }));

    const handleChange = (next: boolean) => {
        setValue(item.name, next as PathValue<T, FieldPath<T>>, { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true });
        onValueChange?.(item.name, next);
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 1 }}>
            <Box>
                <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b', fontSize: '0.82rem', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{item.label}</Typography>
                {item.caption && <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>{item.caption}</Typography>}
            </Box>
            {isView ? (
                <Chip
                    label={checked ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
                    size="small"
                    sx={{
                        height: 24,
                        fontSize: '0.76rem',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        cursor: 'default',
                        color: checked ? '#16a34a' : '#64748b',
                        backgroundColor: checked ? '#16a34a1a' : '#64748b1a',
                    }}
                />
            ) : (
                <Switch checked={checked} onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.checked)} slotProps={{ input: { 'aria-label': item.label } }} />
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import type { FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { RhfTextField, type RhfTextFieldProps } from './RhfTextField';

export type RhfUppercaseFieldProps<T extends FieldValues> = Omit<
    RhfTextFieldProps<T>,
    'uppercase'
>;

/**
 * Specialized Uppercase input component that automatically transforms
 * text input to uppercase as the user types (PAN, GST, IFSC, codes). Sized `sm` by default; known identifiers
 * (GSTIN 15, PAN 10, TAN 10, IFSC 11, CIN 21) get their exact `maxLength` from the field name.
 */
export function RhfUppercaseField<T extends FieldValues>({
    maxLength,
    fieldType = 'identifier',
    ...props
}: RhfUppercaseFieldProps<T>) {
    return (
        <RhfTextField<T>
            {...props}
            uppercase
            maxLength={maxLength}
            fieldType={fieldType}
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import {
    useForm,
    type DefaultValues,
    type FieldErrors,
    type FieldValues,
    type Path,
    type Resolver,
    type UseFormReturn,
} from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import type { ZodType } from 'zod';
import { getFirstErrorMessage } from '@/validations';
import { focusFormField } from '@/utils/formFocus';

export type FormToastState = {
    open: boolean;
    message: string;
    severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
};

const CLOSED_TOAST: FormToastState = { open: false, message: '', severity: 'success' };

export interface UseRhfFormOptions<T extends FieldValues> {
    schema: ZodType<unknown>;
    defaultValues: DefaultValues<T>;
}

export interface UseRhfFormReturn<T extends FieldValues> {
    methods: UseFormReturn<T>;
    toast: FormToastState;
    showToast: (message: string, severity?: FormToastState['severity']) => void;
    closeToast: () => void;
    /** Builds a submit handler that toasts the first zod issue on validation failure. */
    createSubmitHandler: (onValid: (values: T) => Promise<void> | void) => () => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Standard form hook for the CRM: React Hook Form + zod resolver + the shared toast convention
 * (first validation error is surfaced in the top-right AppToast, field errors render inline).
 */
export function useRhfForm<T extends FieldValues>({
    schema,
    defaultValues,
}: UseRhfFormOptions<T>): UseRhfFormReturn<T> {
    const methods = useForm<T>({
        // zod schemas with defaults have differing input/output types; the form works on the output shape.
        resolver: zodResolver(schema as never) as unknown as Resolver<T>,
        defaultValues,
        mode: 'onTouched',
    });

    const [toast, setToast] = useState<FormToastState>(CLOSED_TOAST);

    const showToast = useCallback<UseRhfFormReturn<T>['showToast']>(
        (message, severity = 'error') => setToast({ open: true, message, severity }),
        []
    );
    const closeToast = useCallback(() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false })), []);

    const createSubmitHandler = useCallback<UseRhfFormReturn<T>['createSubmitHandler']>(
        (onValid) =>
            methods.handleSubmit(onValid, (errors: FieldErrors<T>) => {
                showToast(getFirstErrorMessage(errors) ?? 'Please correct the highlighted fields.', 'error');
                const firstField = Object.keys(errors)[0];
                if (firstField && !focusFormField(firstField)) {
                    // Not found in the DOM by name: fall back to RHF's registered ref.
                    methods.setFocus(firstField as Path<T>);
                }
            }),
        [methods, showToast]
    );

    return { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler };
}

import React from 'react';
import { FormControl, Select, MenuItem, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { fieldSx } from './FormField';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';
import { ReadOnlyField } from './ReadOnlyField';
import { fieldSizeSx, type FieldSize } from './fieldSizing';

export interface StyledSelectProps {
    label?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    value: string;
    onChange: (v: string) => void;
    options: string[];
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    /** Width cap for standalone use; omit inside a {@link FormField}, which sizes its children. */
    fieldSize?: FieldSize;
}

export function StyledSelect({
    label,
    placeholder,
    value,
    onChange,
    options,
    required,
    disabled,
    fieldSize,
}: StyledSelectProps) {
    const { mode } = useFormMode();
    if (mode === 'view') {
        return <ReadOnlyField label={label ?? ''} value={value} hideWhenEmpty />;
    }

    const placeholderText =
        placeholder || (label ? `Select ${label.replace(/\s*\*$/, '')}` : 'Select an option');

    return (
        <FormControl
            fullWidth
            size="small"
            sx={fieldSize ? { ...fieldSx, ...fieldSizeSx(fieldSize) } : fieldSx}
            required={required}
            disabled={disabled}
        >
            <Select
                displayEmpty
                disabled={disabled}
                value={value}
                onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
                renderValue={(selected) => {
                    if (!selected) {
                        return (
                            <Typography component="span" sx={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                                {placeholderText}
                            </Typography>
                        );
                    }
                    return (
                        <Typography component="span" sx={{ color: '#1e293b', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                            {selected}
                        </Typography>
                    );
                }}
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
            >
                <MenuItem value="" disabled sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#9ca3af', display: 'none' }}>
                    <em>{placeholderText}</em>
                </MenuItem>
                {options.map((o) => (
                    <MenuItem key={o} value={o} sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                        {o}
                    </MenuItem>
                ))}
            </Select>
        </FormControl>
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/layout/GlobalSearch.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, ClickAwayListener, InputBase, Paper, Popper, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import TrendingUpIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TrendingUp';
import WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WorkspacePremiumOutlined';
import {
    GLOBAL_SEARCH_CATEGORIES,
    type GlobalSearchCategory,
    type GlobalSearchResult,
} from '@/services/globalSearch.service';
import { useGlobalSearch } from '@/hooks/queries/useGlobalSearch';

const DEBOUNCE_MS = 150;

const CATEGORY_META: Record<GlobalSearchCategory, { label: string; icon: React.ReactElement }> = {
    organizations: { label: 'Organizations', icon: <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} /> },
    contacts: { label: 'Contacts', icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} /> },
    leads: { label: 'Leads', icon: <TrendingUpIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} /> },
    opportunities: { label: 'Opportunities', icon: <WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} /> },
};

/** True when the keyboard event comes from a place where '/' should be typed, not trigger search. */
const isTypingTarget = (target: EventTarget | null) =>
    target instanceof HTMLElement &&
    (target.isContentEditable || ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(target.tagName));

/**
 * Navbar search across organizations, contacts, leads and opportunities.
 * Press '/' (or Ctrl/⌘+K) to focus; ↑/↓ + Enter to open a result; Esc to close.
 */
export function GlobalSearch() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    // Callback ref (stored in state) so the popper can anchor without reading a ref during render.
    const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
    const [debouncedQuery, setDebouncedQuery] = useState('');
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);

    // Debounce the query so results update after typing pauses.
    useEffect(() => {
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            setDebouncedQuery(query);
            setActiveIndex(0);
        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
        return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [query]);

    // '/' (when not already typing somewhere) or Ctrl/⌘+K focuses the search box.
    useEffect(() => {
        const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
            const slash = e.key === '/' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey && !isTypingTarget(e.target);
            const cmdK = e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey);
            if (slash || cmdK) {
                e.preventDefault();
                inputRef.current?.focus();
                setOpen(true);
            }
        };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    }, []);

    const { results } = useGlobalSearch(debouncedQuery);
    const flat = useMemo<GlobalSearchResult[]>(
        () => GLOBAL_SEARCH_CATEGORIES.flatMap((c) => results[c]),
        [results]
    );
    const trimmed = debouncedQuery.trim();
    const showPopper = open && trimmed.length > 0;

    const close = () => {
        setOpen(false);
        setActiveIndex(0);
    };

    const go = (result: GlobalSearchResult) => {
        close();
        setQuery('');
        inputRef.current?.blur();
        router.push(result.href);
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            close();
            inputRef.current?.blur();
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && flat.length > 0) {
            e.preventDefault();
            setOpen(true);
            setActiveIndex((i) => (i + 1) % flat.length);
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && flat.length > 0) {
            e.preventDefault();
            setActiveIndex((i) => (i - 1 + flat.length) % flat.length);
        } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && flat[activeIndex]) {
            e.preventDefault();
            go(flat[activeIndex]);
        }
    };

    return (
        <ClickAwayListener onClickAway={close}>
            <Box>
                <Box
                    ref={setAnchorEl}
                    sx={{
                        display: { xs: 'none', md: 'flex' },
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 1,
                        backgroundColor: '#F3F4F6',
                        border: '1px solid #E5E7EB',
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        px: 1.5,
                        py: 0.5,
                        width: 220,
                        transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
                        '&:focus-within': {
                            backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
                            borderColor: '#93C5FD',
                            boxShadow: '0 0 0 3px rgba(147,197,253,0.3)',
                            width: 300,
                        },
                    }}
                >
                    <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#9CA3AF', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                    <InputBase
                        inputRef={inputRef}
                        value={query}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                            setQuery(e.target.value);
                            setOpen(true);
                        }}
                        onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
                        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                        placeholder="Search CRM..."
                        slotProps={{
                            input: {
                                'aria-label': 'Search CRM',
                                role: 'combobox',
                                'aria-expanded': showPopper,
                                'aria-controls': 'global-search-results',
                                'aria-autocomplete': 'list',
                            },
                        }}
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            color: '#374151',
                            width: '100%',
                            '& input::placeholder': { color: '#9CA3AF', opacity: 1 },
                        }}
                    />
                    <Typography
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.65rem',
                            color: '#9CA3AF',
                            backgroundColor: '#E5E7EB',
                            borderRadius: '4px',
                            px: 0.6,
                            py: 0.2,
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            flexShrink: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        /
                    </Typography>
                </Box>

                <Popper
                    open={showPopper}
                    anchorEl={anchorEl}
                    placement="bottom-end"
                    sx={{ zIndex: 1400 }}
                    modifiers={[{ name: 'offset', options: { offset: [0, 6] } }]}
                >
                    <Paper
                        id="global-search-results"
                        role="listbox"
                        elevation={0}
                        sx={{
                            width: 380,
                            maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 32px)',
                            maxHeight: 420,
                            overflowY: 'auto',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '10px',
                            boxShadow: '0 12px 32px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14)',
                            py: 0.5,
                        }}
                    >
                        {flat.length === 0 ? (
                            <Typography sx={{ px: 2, py: 2.5, fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#64748b', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                                No matching records found for &lsquo;{trimmed}&rsquo;
                            </Typography>
                        ) : (
                            GLOBAL_SEARCH_CATEGORIES.filter((c) => results[c].length > 0).map((category) => (
                                <Box key={category} sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>
                                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, px: 1.75, py: 0.5, color: '#64748b' }}>
                                        {CATEGORY_META[category].icon}
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '0.05em', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                                            {CATEGORY_META[category].label}
                                        </Typography>
                                        <Box
                                            component="span"
                                            sx={{
                                                fontSize: '0.66rem',
                                                fontWeight: 700,
                                                color: '#1d4ed8',
                                                backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                                borderRadius: '999px',
                                                px: 0.75,
                                                lineHeight: 1.6,
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {results[category].length}
                                        </Box>
                                    </Box>
                                    {results[category].map((result) => {
                                        const index = flat.indexOf(result);
                                        const active = index === activeIndex;
                                        return (
                                            <Box
                                                key={`${category}-${result.id}`}
                                                component={Link}
                                                href={result.href}
                                                role="option"
                                                aria-selected={active}
                                                onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                                                onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => {
                                                    // Modifier clicks open a new tab natively; a plain click navigates and closes.
                                                    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey) return;
                                                    e.preventDefault();
                                                    go(result);
                                                }}
                                                sx={{
                                                    display: 'flex',
                                                    alignItems: 'center',
                                                    gap: 1.25,
                                                    px: 1.75,
                                                    py: 0.9,
                                                    textDecoration: 'none',
                                                    backgroundColor: active ? '#eff6ff' : 'transparent',
                                                }}
                                            >
                                                <Box sx={{ color: active ? '#2563eb' : '#94a3b8', display: 'flex' }}>
                                                    {CATEGORY_META[category].icon}
                                                </Box>
                                                <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                                                    <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                                                        {result.title}
                                                    </Typography>
                                                    {result.subtitle && (
                                                        <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                                            {result.subtitle}
                                                        </Typography>
                                                    )}
                                                </Box>
                                                {result.meta && (
                                                    <Typography
                                                        noWrap
                                                        sx={{
                                                            fontSize: '0.68rem',
                                                            fontWeight: 700,
                                                            color: '#475569',
                                                            backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                                            borderRadius: '6px',
                                                            px: 0.75,
                                                            py: 0.2,
                                                            flexShrink: 0,
                                                        }}
                                                    >
                                                        {result.meta}
                                                    </Typography>
                                                )}
                                            </Box>
                                        );
                                    })}
                                </Box>
                            ))
                        )}
                    </Paper>
                </Popper>
            </Box>
        </ClickAwayListener>
    );
}

/* ─── Hover-dropdown pill ───────────────────────────────── */
function NavPill({ item }: { item: { label: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; items: readonly { label: string; href: string }[] } }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
    const closeTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

    const handleMouseEnter = () => {
        if (closeTimer.current) clearTimeout(closeTimer.current);
        setOpen(true);
    };
    const handleMouseLeave = () => {
        closeTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 120);
    };

    return (
        <Box onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter} onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave} sx={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <Button
                ref={setAnchorEl}
                size="small"
                startIcon={item.icon}
                endIcon={
                    <KeyboardArrowDownIcon
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '16px !important',
                            transition: 'transform 0.2s',

            <Popper

/* ─── User avatar dropdown ──────────────────────────────── */
function UserMenu({ user, onLogout }: { user: { username: string; role: string }; onLogout: () => void }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    const closeTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

    const initials = user.username.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();

    const handleMouseEnter = () => {
        if (closeTimer.current) clearTimeout(closeTimer.current);
        setOpen(true);
    };
    const handleMouseLeave = () => {
        closeTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 150);
    };

    return (
        <Box ref={setAnchorEl} onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter} onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave} sx={{ position: 'relative', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 1,
                    px: 1.2,
                    py: 0.5,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    border: open ? '1px solid #BFDBFE' : '1px solid transparent',
                    backgroundColor: open ? '#EFF6FF' : 'transparent',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                    '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#F3F4F6' },
                }}
            >
                <Avatar
                    sx={{
                        width: 32,
                        height: 32,
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6, #2563EB)',
                    }}
                >
                    {initials}

                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#111827', lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                        {user.username}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#6B7280', lineHeight: 1.2 }}>

                            elevation={8}

function NotificationBell() {

export function Navbar() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user, logout } = useAuth();

    const handleLogout = async () => {
        try {
            await logout();

            router.push(ROUTES.LOGIN);
        }
    };

    return (
        <AppBar
            position="static"
            elevation={0}

                zIndex: 1200,

            <Toolbar sx={{ justifyContent: 'space-between', minHeight: '56px !important', px: { xs: 2, md: 3 } }}>

                {/* ── LEFT: Logo + Nav pills ── */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: { xs: 1, md: 2 } }}>
                    {/* Logo — clicks → dashboard */}
                    <Box
                        component={Link}

'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Box } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    FormField,
    FormGrid,
    FormGridItem,
    LookupField,
    RhfCheckbox,
    RhfChipGroup,
    RhfEmailList,
    RhfLookup,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfPhoneField,
} from '@/components/forms';
import { matchExistingContact } from '@/services';
import { useContacts } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { Contact } from '@/types/contact.types';
import {
    COMMUNICATION_TYPES,
    CONTACT_DEPARTMENTS,
    CONTACT_DESIGNATIONS,
} from '@/types/contact.types';
import { LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS } from '@/types/lead.types';
import type { ConvertLeadFormValues } from '@/validations';

type F = ConvertLeadFormValues;

const NO_CONTACTS: Contact[] = [];

/** "Create Contact OR Select Contact" section of the Convert Lead form. */
export function ConvertContactSection() {
    const { setValue, control } = useFormContext<F>();
    const mobile = useWatch({ control, name: 'contactMobile' });
    const existingContactId = useWatch({ control, name: 'existingContactId' });
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState('');

    // Label → contact lookup for the "select existing" picker.
    const { data: contacts = NO_CONTACTS } = useContacts();
    const contactsByLabel = useMemo(() => {
        const map = new Map<string, Contact>();
        contacts.forEach((c) => map.set(`${c.name} (${c.mobile})`, c));
        return map;
    }, [contacts]);

    const handleSelect = (label: string) => {
        setSelected(label);
        const contact = contactsByLabel.get(label);
        if (!contact) {
            setValue('existingContactId', '');
            return;
        }
        const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
        setValue('existingContactId', contact.id, opts);
        setValue('contactName', contact.name, opts);
        setValue('contactMobile', contact.mobile, opts);
        setValue('contactPhone3', contact.phone3 ?? '', opts);
        setValue('contactEmails', contact.emailAddresses, opts);
        setValue('designation', contact.designation ?? '', opts);
        setValue('department', contact.department ?? '', opts);
        setValue('communicationType', contact.communicationType ?? [], opts);
        setValue('isPrimaryContact', contact.isPrimaryContact, opts);
        setValue('doNotCall', contact.doNotCall, opts);
        setValue('contactDescription', contact.description ?? '', opts);
        setValue('contactAssignedTo', contact.assignedTo, opts);
    };

    const duplicate = useMemo(
        () => (mobile ? matchExistingContact(contacts, mobile, existingContactId || undefined) : undefined),
        [contacts, mobile, existingContactId]
    );

    return (
        <>
            <FormField label="Select Existing Contact" size="lg" hint="Optional — leave blank to create new">
                <LookupField
                    value={selected}
                    onChange={handleSelect}
                    options={[...contactsByLabel.keys()]}
                    placeholder="Search existing contacts by name or mobile..."
                />
            </FormField>

            <FormGrid columns={3}>
                <RhfTextField<F> name="contactName" label="Name" required placeholder="Contact person name" />
                <RhfPhoneField<F> name="contactMobile" label="Mobile" required />
                <RhfPhoneField<F> name="contactPhone3" label="Phone 3" placeholder="Alternate phone number" />

                <RhfSelect<F> name="designation" label="Designation" options={CONTACT_DESIGNATIONS} placeholder="Select Designation" />
                <RhfSelect<F> name="department" label="Department" options={CONTACT_DEPARTMENTS} placeholder="Select Department" />
                <RhfLookup<F> name="contactAssignedTo" label="Assigned to" lookupType="user" required options={LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS} placeholder="Select representative" />

                <FormGridItem span={2}>
                    <RhfTextField<F> name="organizationName" label="Organization Name" required disabled hint="Taken from the organization section below" />
                </FormGridItem>

                <FormGridItem span="full">
                    <RhfEmailList name="contactEmails" required />
                </FormGridItem>
                <RhfChipGroup<F> name="communicationType" label="Communication Type" options={COMMUNICATION_TYPES} />
                <FormGridItem span="full">
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', columnGap: 3 }}>
                        <RhfCheckbox<F> name="isPrimaryContact" label="Is Primary Contact" />
                        <RhfCheckbox<F> name="doNotCall" label="Do Not Call (DND)" />
                    </Box>
                </FormGridItem>
                <RhfTextField<F> name="contactDescription" label="Description" multiline minRows={3} placeholder="Notes about this contact..." />
            </FormGrid>

            {duplicate && (
                <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    This Number Already Exists! Existing contact “{duplicate.name}” will be linked instead of creating a duplicate.
                </Alert>
            )}
        </>
    );
}
