'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Alert } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { FormGrid, RhfLookup, RhfSelect, RhfTextField } from '@/components/forms';
import {
    NATURE_OF_BUSINESS,
    ENTITY_TYPES,
    CUSTOMER_TYPES,
    LEAD_SOURCES as ORG_LEAD_SOURCES,
} from '@/components/organizations/constants';
import { matchExistingOrganization } from '@/services';
import { useOrganizations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import { LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS } from '@/types/lead.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';
import type { ConvertLeadFormValues } from '@/validations';

const NO_ORGANIZATIONS: ExtendedOrganization[] = [];

type F = ConvertLeadFormValues;

/** "Create Organization OR Select Organization" section of the Convert Lead form. */
export function ConvertOrganizationSection() {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<F>();
    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' });

    const { data: organizations = NO_ORGANIZATIONS } = useOrganizations();
    const organizationNames = useMemo(() => organizations.map((o) => o.organizationName), [organizations]);
    const existing = useMemo(
        () => matchExistingOrganization(organizations, organizationName),
        [organizationName, organizations]
    );

    // Link to (and prefill from) an existing organization when the typed name matches one.
    useEffect(() => {
        const opts = { shouldValidate: true } as const;
        if (!existing) {
            setValue('existingOrganizationId', '');
            return;
        }
        setValue('existingOrganizationId', existing.id);
        setValue('mailingName', existing.mailingName ?? '', opts);
        setValue('natureOfBusiness', existing.natureOfBusiness || '', opts);
        setValue('typeOfEntity', existing.typeOfEntity || '', opts);
        setValue('customerType', existing.customerType || '', opts);
        setValue('sourceOfLead', existing.sourceOfLead || '', opts);
        setValue('memberOf', existing.memberOfParentCorp ?? '', opts);
        setValue('organizationDescription', existing.description ?? '', opts);
    }, [existing, setValue]);

    return (
        <>
            {existing && (
                <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                    Organization “{existing.organizationName}” already exists and will be linked — no duplicate will be created.
                </Alert>
            )}
            <FormGrid columns={3}>
                <RhfLookup<F>
                    name="organizationName"
                    label="Organization Name"
                    required
                    hint="New name or pick existing"
                    options={organizationNames}
                    placeholder="Search or enter organization..."
                    lookupType="organization"
                />
                <RhfTextField<F> name="mailingName" label="Mailing Name" placeholder="Official mailing name" />
                <RhfTextField<F> name="memberOf" label="Member of" placeholder="Parent corporation" />

                <RhfSelect<F> name="natureOfBusiness" label="Nature of Business" required options={NATURE_OF_BUSINESS} placeholder="Select Nature of Business" />
                <RhfSelect<F> name="typeOfEntity" label="Type of Entity" required options={ENTITY_TYPES} placeholder="Select Type of Entity" />
                <RhfSelect<F> name="customerType" label="Customer Type" required options={CUSTOMER_TYPES} placeholder="Select Customer Type" />

                <RhfSelect<F> name="sourceOfLead" label="Source of Lead" options={ORG_LEAD_SOURCES} placeholder="Select Source of Lead" />
                <RhfLookup<F> name="organizationAssignedTo" label="Assigned to" lookupType="user" required options={LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS} placeholder="Select representative" />

                <RhfTextField<F> name="organizationDescription" label="Description" multiline minRows={3} placeholder="Notes about this organization..." />
            </FormGrid>
        </>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Box, CircularProgress, Divider, Typography } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlineOutlined';
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MonetizationOnOutlined';
import TransformOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TransformOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { SectionLabel, useRhfForm } from '@/components/forms';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Lead } from '@/types/lead.types';
import {
    buildConvertLeadDefaults,
    convertLead,
    leadService,
} from '@/services';
import {
    convertLeadFormSchema,
    type ConvertLeadFormValues,
} from '@/validations';
import {
    ConvertContactSection,
    ConvertOpportunitySection,
    ConvertOrganizationSection,
} from './convert';

export interface ConvertLeadFormProps {
    leadId: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const CONVERT_TABS = [
    {
        id: 'convert',
        label: 'Convert Lead',
        icon: <TransformOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />,
    },
];

const sectionDividerSx = { my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' } as const;

const EMPTY_DEFAULTS: ConvertLeadFormValues = {
    existingOrganizationId: '',
    organizationName: '',
    mailingName: '',
    natureOfBusiness: '',
    typeOfEntity: '',
    customerType: '',
    sourceOfLead: '',
    memberOf: '',
    organizationDescription: '',
    organizationAssignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    existingContactId: '',
    contactName: '',
    contactMobile: '',
    contactPhone3: '',
    contactEmails: [{ id: 'eml-1', email: '', isPrimary: true, isOptedOut: false, isInvalidBounce: false }],
    isPrimaryContact: true,
    designation: '',
    department: '',
    communicationType: ['Call', 'Email'],
    doNotCall: false,
    contactDescription: '',
    contactAssignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    productCategory: ['Biz Analyst'],
    principalCompany: '',
    referredBy: '',
    opportunityType: 'New Business',
    nextFollowupDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    nextFollowupTime: '11:00 AM',
    followupType: 'Call',
    opportunityDescription: '',
    opportunityLeadSource: 'Website Enquiry',
    opportunityAssignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',
    copyActivitiesTo: [],
};

export function ConvertLeadForm({ leadId, breadcrumbItems }: ConvertLeadFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [lead, setLead] = useState<Lead | null>(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } =
        useRhfForm<ConvertLeadFormValues>({
            schema: convertLeadFormSchema,
            defaultValues: EMPTY_DEFAULTS,
        });

    const { reset, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        leadService
            .getById(leadId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (!active) return;
                if (!found) {
                    showToast('Lead record not found.', 'error');
                } else {
                    setLead(found);
                    reset(buildConvertLeadDefaults(found));
                }
            })
            .catch((err) => {
                if (active) {
                    showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load lead details.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .finally(() => {
                if (active) setLoading(false);
            });

        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [leadId, reset, showToast]);

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Leads', href: ROUTES.LEADS },
        { label: lead?.name ? `Convert: ${lead.name}` : 'Convert Lead' },
    ];

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            const result = await convertLead(leadId, values);
            const orgNote = result.organizationCreated
                ? `Created organization "${result.organization.organizationName}".`
                : `Linked existing organization "${result.organization.organizationName}".`;
            const contactNote = result.contactCreated
                ? `Created contact "${result.contact.name}".`
                : `Linked existing contact "${result.contact.name}".`;

            showToast(`Lead converted successfully! ${orgNote} ${contactNote}`, 'success');
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.LEADS), 1000);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to convert lead.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved lead conversion data?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.LEADS);
    };

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', py: 12 }}>
                <CircularProgress size={36} sx={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
                <Typography sx={{ ml: 2, color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                    Loading lead data...
                </Typography>
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={CONVERT_TABS}
                activeTab="convert"
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel="Convert Lead"
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="1. Create Contact OR Select Contact"
                />
                <ConvertContactSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="2. Create Organization OR Select Organization"
                />
                <ConvertOrganizationSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="3. Create Opportunity"
                />
                <ConvertOpportunitySection />
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

export default ConvertLeadForm;

    lead: Lead | null;
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onEdit?: (id: string) => void;
    onLeadUpdated?: (updatedLead: Lead) => void;
    onShowToast?: (message: string, severity?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning') => void;
}

export function LeadDetailDrawer({
    lead,
    open,
    onClose,
    onEdit,
    onLeadUpdated,
    onShowToast,
}: LeadDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { data: freshLead } = useLead(open && lead?.id ? lead.id : undefined);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (freshLead) {
            onLeadUpdated?.(freshLead);
        }
    }, [freshLead, onLeadUpdated]);

    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'error',
    });

    const l = freshLead ?? lead;
    if (!l) return null;

    const triggerToast = (message: string, severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning' = 'error') => {
        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
        onShowToast?.(message, severity);
    };

    const handleConvertLead = () => {
        const orgName = (l.organizationName || '').trim();
        if (!orgName) {
            triggerToast('Organisation Name is required.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        if (l.status === 'Converted') {
            triggerToast('This lead has already been converted.', 'info');
            return;
        }

        router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_CONVERT(l.id));
    };

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(l.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(l.id));
        }
    };

    const isHot = l.leadType === 'Hot';
    const isWarm = l.leadType === 'Warm';
    const hasOrg = Boolean(l.organizationName && l.organizationName.trim().length > 0);
    const isConverted = l.status === 'Converted';

    return (
        <>
            <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}

            subtitle={`${l.leadCode} • ${l.organizationName || 'Prospect'}`}
            avatarIcon={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24, color: '#ffffff' }} />}

            }
            verified={true}

                {
                    label: l.leadType || 'Normal',

                    backgroundColor: isHot ? '#fee2e2' : isWarm ? '#fef3c7' : '#eff6ff',

                                        {l.referredBy}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                            )}
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Long Description */}
                        {l.description && (
                            <DrawerSectionCard title="BACKGROUND CONTEXT & NOTES">
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#334155', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                                    {l.description}
                                </Typography>
                            </DrawerSectionCard>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
                address: (

                        {/* Primary Address Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard
                            title="PRIMARY REGISTERED ADDRESS"
                            icon={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                        >
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#1e293b', fontWeight: 500, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                                {l.primaryAddress || 'No primary address specified'}

                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 700 }}>CITY / STATE</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                        {l.primaryCity || '-'}, {l.primaryState || '-'}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 700 }}>POSTAL PIN</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                        {l.primaryPostalCode || '-'}

                                </Box>
                                <Box>

                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                        {getCountryNameByCode(l.primaryCountry || 'IN')}

                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Other Address Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard
                            title="OTHER / DISPATCH ADDRESS"
                            icon={<BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#64748b' }} />}
                        >

                                {l.otherAddress || 'Same as primary address or not provided'}
                            </Typography>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 2, mt: 1.2, pt: 1, borderTop: '1px solid #f1f5f9' }}>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 700 }}>CITY / STATE</Typography>

                                        {l.otherCity || '-'}, {l.otherState || '-'}

                                        {getCountryNameByCode(l.otherCountry || 'IN')}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>
                    </Box>
                ),
            }}
            auditEntity={{ type: 'leads', id: l.id }}
            includeChangesTab={true}
            statusText={isConverted ? 'Lead Converted' : `Next Followup: ${l.nextFollowupDate}`}
            primaryAction={{
                label: 'Edit Lead',
                onClick: handleEdit,
                icon: <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
            }}
            secondaryAction={{
                label: isConverted ? 'Lead Converted' : 'Convert Lead',
                icon: isConverted ? (
                    <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#059669' }} />
                ) : (
                    <PublishedWithChangesIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                ),
                onClick: handleConvertLead,
                variant: 'outlined',
                tooltip: !hasOrg
                    ? 'Organisation Name is required to convert lead'
                    : isConverted
                    ? 'Lead has already been converted'
                    : 'Convert Lead to Organization & Contact',
                sx: {
                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    height: 36,
                    px: 1.8,
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    color: isConverted ? '#047857' : hasOrg ? '#047857' : '#dc2626',
                    borderColor: isConverted ? '#a7f3d0' : hasOrg ? '#a7f3d0' : '#fca5a5',
                    backgroundColor: isConverted ? '#ecfdf5' : hasOrg ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef2f2',
                    '&:hover': {
                        borderColor: isConverted ? '#047857' : hasOrg ? '#059669' : '#ef4444',
                        backgroundColor: isConverted ? '#d1fae5' : hasOrg ? '#d1fae5' : '#fee2e2',
                    },
                },
            }}
        />
        <AppToast
            open={toast.open}
            message={toast.message}
            severity={toast.severity}
            onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
        />
    </>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import ArticleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArticleOutlined';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { useRhfForm } from '../forms/rhf';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { leadFormSchema } from '../../validations';
import type { LeadFormData } from '@/types/lead.types';
import { leadService } from '@/services';
import { normalizeAddressFields } from '@/utils/address';

// Modular Lead Form Sections
import {
    LeadOverviewSection,
    LeadAddressSection,
} from './sections';

export type LeadTabKey = 'overview' | 'address';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Lead Form Tabs ────────────────────────────────
export const LEAD_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: LeadTabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'address',
        label: 'Address Information',
        icon: <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

export interface LeadFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';
    initialData?: Partial<LeadFormData>;
    leadId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const DEFAULT_FORM: LeadFormData = {
    name: '',
    mobile: '',
    emailAddresses: [
        {
            id: 'eml-1',
            email: '',
            isPrimary: true,
            isOptedOut: false,
            isInvalidBounce: false,
        },
    ],
    mailingName: '',
    designation: '',
    leadSource: 'Website Enquiry',
    productCategory: ['Biz Analyst'],
    followupType: 'Call',
    addDescription: '',
    registrationType: 'Registered',
    turnover: '₹5 Cr – ₹25 Cr',
    assignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    otherPhone: '',
    organizationName: '',
    department: 'Executive Management',
    leadType: 'Hot',
    status: 'New',
    nextFollowupDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0], // Tomorrow
    nextFollowupTime: '11:00 AM',
    description: '',
    noOfEmployee: '11 – 50 Staff Members',
    referredBy: '',

    primaryAddress: '',
    primaryCity: '',
    primaryState: 'Delhi',
    primaryPostalCode: '',
    primaryCountry: 'IN',

    otherAddress: '',
    otherCity: '',
    otherState: 'Delhi',
    otherPostalCode: '',
    otherCountry: 'IN',
    copyAddressFromLeft: false,
};

/** Country/state pairs normalised to the ISO address master when a saved lead is loaded. */
const LEAD_ADDRESS_PAIRS = [
    ['primaryCountry', 'primaryState'],
    ['otherCountry', 'otherState'],
] as const;

export default function LeadForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    leadId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: LeadFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<LeadTabKey>('overview');

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } = useRhfForm<LeadFormData>({
        schema: leadFormSchema,
        defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
    });
    const { reset, watch, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const leadName = watch('name');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Leads', href: ROUTES.LEADS },
        { label: mode !== 'create' ? (leadName ? `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'}: ${leadName}` : `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'} Lead`) : 'Create Lead' },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!leadId) return;
        let active = true;
        leadService
            .getById(leadId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) reset(normalizeAddressFields(found, LEAD_ADDRESS_PAIRS));
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [leadId, reset]);

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (mode === 'edit' && leadId) {
                await leadService.update(leadId, values);
                showToast('Lead details updated successfully!', 'success');
            } else {
                await leadService.create(values);
                showToast('Lead created successfully! Added to your sales pipeline.', 'success');
            }
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.LEADS), 800);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An error occurred while saving the lead.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (mode === 'view') {
            router.push(ROUTES.LEADS);
            return;
        }
        if (isDirty && !confirm('You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?')) {
            return;
        }
        router.push(ROUTES.LEADS);
    };

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={LEAD_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as LeadTabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={mode === 'view' ? () => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(leadId!)) : handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Edit Lead' : mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Lead' : 'Save Lead'}
                cancelLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Back' : 'Cancel'}
                recordView={{
                    title: leadName || '',
                    editHref: leadId ? ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(leadId) : undefined,
                    editLabel: 'Edit Lead',
                    backHref: ROUTES.LEADS,
                }}
                mode={mode}
                disableContentPadding
                toast={<AppToast open={toast.open} message={toast.message} severity={toast.severity} onClose={closeToast} />}
            >
                {/* Keep both panels mounted so validation state of hidden tab is preserved */}
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'overview'}>
                    <LeadOverviewSection />
                </div>
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'address'}>
                    <LeadAddressSection />
                </div>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import GroupOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GroupOutlined';
import LocalFireDepartmentOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalFireDepartmentOutlined';
import LocalFireDepartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalFireDepartment';
import FiberNewOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FiberNewOutlined';
import TodayOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TodayOutlined';
import AccountCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircleOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import { RecordLink } from '../common/RecordLink';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../common/CommonMasterView';
import { MasterHeaderActions } from '../common/MasterHeaderActions';
import { buildExtendedSearchConfig } from '../common/buildExtendedSearchConfig';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { DataImportModal } from '../common/import';
import { RelatedModulesSidebar, RelatedRecordsTableView } from '../common/Drawer';
import { RelatedSecondaryDrawer, type SecondaryDrawerEntity } from '../common/RelatedSecondaryDrawer';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
import { useRelatedModulesForEntity } from '@/config/relatedModules.config';
import type { Lead } from '@/types/lead.types';
import { useLeads, useBulkDeleteLeads } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { LeadFilterTab } from './master';
import { LeadDetailDrawer } from './LeadDetailDrawer';


/** Stable empty list while the first page loads (keeps memoized filters from recomputing). */
const NO_RECORDS: Lead[] = [];
export function LeadsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const currentUsername = user?.username || '';

    const { data: leads = NO_RECORDS, refetch } = useLeads();
    const bulkDeleteMutation = useBulkDeleteLeads();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<LeadFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<string>('name');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
    // Tracked by id so the drawer always shows the cached copy and closes if the lead is deleted.
    const [drawerLeadId, setDrawerLeadId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const selectedDrawerLead = useMemo(
        () => (drawerLeadId ? leads.find((l) => l.id === drawerLeadId) ?? null : null),
        [leads, drawerLeadId]
    );
    const [activeRelatedModule, setActiveRelatedModule] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [secondaryDrawerEntity, setSecondaryDrawerEntity] = useState<SecondaryDrawerEntity | null>(null);
    const [isLeftSidebarCollapsed, setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const todayStr = useMemo(() => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], []);

    const [importOpen, setImportOpen] = useState(false);

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<LeadFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Leads',
                icon: <GroupOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'hot',
                label: 'Hot Leads',
                icon: <LocalFireDepartmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.filter((l) => l.leadType === 'Hot').length,
                activeColor: '#dc2626',
                activeBgColor: '#fef2f2',
                activeBadgeBgColor: '#fee2e2',
            },
            {
                id: 'new',
                label: 'New Enquiries',
                icon: <FiberNewOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.filter((l) => l.status === 'New').length,
            },
            {
                id: 'followup_today',
                label: 'Followup Today',
                icon: <TodayOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.filter((l) => l.nextFollowupDate === todayStr).length,
                activeColor: '#d97706',
            },
            {
                id: 'my_leads',
                label: 'My Leads',
                icon: <AccountCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: currentUsername ? leads.filter((l) => (l.assignedTo || '').includes(currentUsername)).length : 0,
            },
        ];
    }, [leads, todayStr, currentUsername]);

    // ── Filter Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredLeads = useMemo(() => {
        return leads.filter((lead) => {
            if (activeTab === 'hot' && lead.leadType !== 'Hot') return false;
            if (activeTab === 'new' && lead.status !== 'New') return false;
            if (activeTab === 'followup_today' && lead.nextFollowupDate !== todayStr) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'my_leads' && (!currentUsername || !(lead.assignedTo || '').includes(currentUsername))) return false;

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                const inName = lead.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inCode = lead.leadCode.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inOrg = (lead.organizationName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inPhone = (lead.mobile || '').includes(q) || (lead.otherPhone || '').includes(q);
                const inEmail = (lead.emailAddresses || []).some((e) => e.email.toLowerCase().includes(q));
                const inProduct = (lead.productCategory || []).some((p) => p.toLowerCase().includes(q));
                const inStatus = lead.status.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inSource = lead.leadSource.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inAssigned = lead.assignedTo.toLowerCase().includes(q);

                return (
                    inName ||
                    inCode ||
                    inOrg ||
                    inPhone ||
                    inEmail ||
                    inProduct ||
                    inStatus ||
                    inSource ||
                    inAssigned
                );
            }

            return true;
        });
    }, [leads, activeTab, searchQuery, todayStr, currentUsername]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedLeads = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredLeads].sort((a, b) => {
            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredLeads, sortField, sortOrder]);

    const paginatedLeads = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedLeads.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedLeads, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleToggleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedLeads.map((l) => l.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleToggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]));
    };

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        if (count === 0) return;
        if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${count} selected lead(s)?`)) return;

        try {
            await bulkDeleteMutation.mutateAsync(selectedIds);
            setSelectedIds([]);
            setToast({
                open: true,
                message: `${count} lead(s) deleted successfully.`,
                severity: 'success',
            });
        } catch {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Failed to delete leads.', severity: 'error' });
        }
    };

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Lead>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'name',
                label: 'LEAD NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (l) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.3 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                            <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                            <RecordLink
                                href={ROUTES.LEAD_DETAIL(l.id)}
                                onOpen={() => setDrawerLeadId(l.id)}
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {l.name}
                            </RecordLink>
                        </Box>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8, pl: 3 }}>
                            <Chip
                                label={l.leadCode}
                                size="small"
                                sx={{
                                    height: 18,
                                    fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                    color: '#475569',
                                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                }}
                            />
                            {l.designation && (
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }} noWrap>
                                    {l.designation}
                                </Typography>
                            )}
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 180,
                render: (l) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#64748b', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                        <Box>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#1e293b', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                                {l.organizationName || 'Individual Prospect'}
                            </Typography>
                            {l.primaryCity && (
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                    {l.primaryCity}{l.primaryState ? `, ${l.primaryState}` : ''}
                                </Typography>
                            )}
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'mobile',
                label: 'CONTACT INFO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (l) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.4 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6 }}>
                            <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#64748b' }} />
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                                {l.mobile || l.otherPhone || '-'}

                        {l.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email && (

                                    key={idx}
                                    label={prod}
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{
                                        height: 20,
                                        fontSize: '0.68rem',
                                        fontWeight: 600,
                                        backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                                        color: '#166534',
                                        border: '1px solid #bbf7d0',
                                    }}
                                />
                            ))
                        ) : (
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>-</Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'leadType',
                label: 'LEAD TYPE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 110,
                render: (l) => {
                    const isHot = l.leadType === 'Hot';
                    const isWarm = l.leadType === 'Warm';

                    return (
                        <Chip
                            icon={isHot ? <LocalFireDepartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: '13px !important', color: '#dc2626 !important' }} /> : undefined}
                            label={l.leadType || 'Normal'}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 22,
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                backgroundColor: isHot ? '#fee2e2' : isWarm ? '#fef3c7' : '#f1f5f9',
                                color: isHot ? '#991b1b' : isWarm ? '#92400e' : '#475569',
                                border: isHot ? '1px solid #fecaca' : isWarm ? '1px solid #fde68a' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'status',
                label: 'STATUS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (l) => {
                    let bg = '#eff6ff';
                    let color = '#1d4ed8';
                    let border = '#bfdbfe';

                    if (l.status === 'New') {
                        bg = '#eff6ff';
                        color = '#1e40af';
                        border = '#bfdbfe';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Contacted' || l.status === 'In Discussion') {
                        bg = '#f5f3ff';
                        color = '#6d28d9';
                        border = '#ddd6fe';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Demo Scheduled') {
                        bg = '#fdf4ff';
                        color = '#a21caf';
                        border = '#f5d0fe';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Proposal Sent' || l.status === 'Negotiation') {
                        bg = '#fffbeb';
                        color = '#b45309';
                        border = '#fde68a';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Converted') {
                        bg = '#ecfdf5';
                        color = '#047857';
                        border = '#a7f3d0';
                    } else if (l.status.includes('Lost') || l.status.includes('Unqualified')) {
                        bg = '#fef2f2';
                        color = '#b91c1c';
                        border = '#fecaca';
                    }

                    return (
                        <Chip
                            label={l.status || 'New'}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 22,
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                backgroundColor: bg,
                                color: color,
                                border: `1px solid ${border}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'nextFollowupDate',
                label: 'NEXT FOLLOWUP',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (l) => {
                    const isToday = l.nextFollowupDate === todayStr;

                    return (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                            <CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: 16,
                                    color: isToday ? '#d97706' : '#64748b',
                                }}
                            />
                            <Box>
                                <Typography
                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                        fontWeight: isToday ? 700 : 500,
                                        color: isToday ? '#b45309' : '#334155',
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {l.nextFollowupDate || '-'}
                                    {isToday && (
                                        <Box
                                            component="span"
                                            sx={{
                                                ml: 0.6,
                                                px: 0.6,
                                                py: 0.1,
                                                borderRadius: '4px',
                                                fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                                fontWeight: 800,
                                                backgroundColor: '#fef3c7',
                                                color: '#b45309',
                                                border: '1px solid #fde68a',
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            TODAY
                                        </Box>
                                    )}
                                </Typography>
                                {(l.nextFollowupTime || l.followupType) && (
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                        {l.followupType ? `${l.followupType} • ` : ''}
                                        {l.nextFollowupTime || ''}
                                    </Typography>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedTo',
                label: 'ASSIGNED TO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (l) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {l.assignedTo || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        [todayStr]
    );

    const relatedModules = useRelatedModulesForEntity('lead', selectedDrawerLead, setActiveRelatedModule);

    // Falls back to the first module until the user explicitly picks one.
    const effectiveRelatedModule = activeRelatedModule ?? relatedModules[0]?.id ?? null;
    const activeModuleMeta = relatedModules.find((m) => m.id === effectiveRelatedModule);

    // Dismisses the three-panel view and returns to the clean master table.
    const closeThreePanelView = useCallback(() => {
        setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);
        setDrawerLeadId(null);
        setActiveRelatedModule(null);
    }, []);

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Lead, LeadFilterTab>
            breadcrumbItems={[
                { label: 'Sales' },
                { label: 'Leads' },
            ]}
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            tableId="leads"
            headerActions={() => (
                <MasterHeaderActions
                    onRefresh={async () => {
                        const { isError } = await refetch();
                        setToast(
                            isError
                                ? { open: true, message: 'Failed to refresh leads.', severity: 'error' }
                                : { open: true, message: 'Leads refreshed.', severity: 'info' }
                        );
                    }}
                    onNewClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_NEW)}
                    newButtonLabel="New Lead"
                    onImportClick={() => setImportOpen(true)}
                />
            )}
            searchConfig={buildExtendedSearchConfig({
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by name, company, phone, product, status...',
                pageIds: paginatedLeads.map((r) => r.id),
                allIds: sortedLeads.map((r) => r.id),
                selectedIds,
                onSelectedIdsChange: setSelectedIds,
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalRecords: sortedLeads.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            })}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedLeads}
            keyExtractor={(l) => l.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleToggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(l) => setDrawerLeadId(l.id)}
            getEditHref={(l) => ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(l.id)}
            onRowClick={(lead) => setDrawerLeadId(lead.id)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerLead?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Lead Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Lead"
            emptyTitle="No leads in pipeline"
            emptyDescription="Record new prospective clients, followups, and product interests to begin converting sales."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Lead"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            minHeight={300}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: sortedLeads.length,
                onPageChange: (newPage) => setPage(newPage),
                onRowsPerPageChange: (newRows) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(newRows);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            relatedSidebar={
                <RelatedModulesSidebar
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerLead)}
                    modules={relatedModules}
                    activeModuleId={effectiveRelatedModule ?? undefined}
                    onModuleSelect={(moduleId) => setActiveRelatedModule(moduleId)}
                    collapsed={isLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                    onToggleCollapse={setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                />
            }
            relatedRecordsTable={
                <RelatedRecordsTableView
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerLead && effectiveRelatedModule)}
                    moduleId={effectiveRelatedModule || ''}
                    moduleTitle={activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Related Records'}
                    parentRecordId={selectedDrawerLead?.id}
                    parentEntityTitle={selectedDrawerLead?.name || ''}
                    entityData={selectedDrawerLead}
                    entityType="lead"
                    leftOffset={isLeftSidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 260}
                    rightOffset={580}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onRowClick={(row, modId) => setSecondaryDrawerEntity({ type: modId, data: row })}
                />
            }
            drawer={
                <LeadDetailDrawer
                    lead={selectedDrawerLead}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerLead)}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(id))}
                    onShowToast={(message, severity = 'success') => {
                        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
                    }}
                />
            }
            secondaryDrawer={
                secondaryDrawerEntity ? (
                    <RelatedSecondaryDrawer
                        entity={secondaryDrawerEntity}
                        moduleLabel={activeModuleMeta?.label}
                        parentTitle={selectedDrawerLead?.name}
                        onClose={() => setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null)}
                    />
                ) : null
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerLead)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        >
            <DataImportModal
                open={importOpen}
                entity="leads"
                onClose={() => setImportOpen(false)}
                onImported={(count) => {
                    setToast({ open: true, message: `Successfully imported ${count} lead${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}!`, severity: 'success' });
                }}
            />
        </CommonMasterView>
    );
}
