'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import TrendingUpOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TrendingUpOutlined';
import MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MonetizationOnOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import ScheduleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Schedule';
import AccountCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircleOutlined';
import WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WorkspacePremiumOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import { RecordLink } from '../common/RecordLink';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../common/CommonMasterView';
import { MasterHeaderActions } from '../common/MasterHeaderActions';
import { buildExtendedSearchConfig } from '../common/buildExtendedSearchConfig';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { RelatedModulesSidebar, RelatedRecordsTableView } from '../common/Drawer';
import { RelatedSecondaryDrawer, type SecondaryDrawerEntity } from '../common/RelatedSecondaryDrawer';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
import { useRelatedModulesForEntity } from '@/config/relatedModules.config';
import type { Opportunity } from '@/types/opportunity.types';
import { useOpportunities, useBulkDeleteOpportunities } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { OpportunityFilterTab, OpportunitySortField } from './master';
import { OpportunityDetailDrawer } from './OpportunityDetailDrawer';

const formatCurrency = (val: number) =>
    new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'INR',
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(val);


/** Stable empty list while the first page loads (keeps memoized filters from recomputing). */
const NO_RECORDS: Opportunity[] = [];
export function OpportunitiesMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const currentUsername = user?.username || '';

    const { data: opportunities = NO_RECORDS, refetch } = useOpportunities();
    const bulkDeleteMutation = useBulkDeleteOpportunities();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<OpportunityFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<OpportunitySortField>('createdAt');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
    // Tracked by id so the drawer always shows the cached copy and closes if the deal is deleted.
    const [drawerOppId, setDrawerOppId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const selectedDrawerOpp = useMemo(
        () => (drawerOppId ? opportunities.find((o) => o.id === drawerOppId) ?? null : null),
        [opportunities, drawerOppId]
    );
    const [activeRelatedModule, setActiveRelatedModule] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [secondaryDrawerEntity, setSecondaryDrawerEntity] = useState<SecondaryDrawerEntity | null>(null);
    const [isLeftSidebarCollapsed, setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const todayStr = useMemo(() => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], []);

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<OpportunityFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Opportunities',
                icon: <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'open',
                label: 'Active Pipeline',
                icon: <MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter(
                    (o) => !['Closed Won', 'Closed Lost'].includes(o.salesStage)
                ).length,
                activeColor: '#2563eb',
            },
            {
                id: 'closing_soon',
                label: 'Followup Today',
                icon: <ScheduleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter((o) =>
                    ['Proposal/Price Quote', 'Negotiation'].includes(o.salesStage)
                ).length,
                activeColor: '#d97706',
            },
            {
                id: 'won',
                label: 'Closed Won',
                icon: <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter((o) => o.salesStage === 'Closed Won').length,
                activeColor: '#16a34a',
            },
            {
                id: 'high_value',
                label: 'High Value (₹1L+)',
                icon: <WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter((o) => (o.grandTotal || 0) >= 100000).length,
                activeColor: '#7c3aed',
            },
            {
                id: 'my_deals',
                label: 'My Deals',
                icon: <AccountCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: currentUsername ? opportunities.filter((o) => (o.assignedTo || '').includes(currentUsername)).length : 0,
            },
        ];
    }, [opportunities, currentUsername]);

    // ── Filter Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredOpportunities = useMemo(() => {
        return opportunities.filter((opp) => {
            if (activeTab === 'open' && ['Closed Won', 'Closed Lost'].includes(opp.salesStage)) {
                return false;
            }
            if (
                activeTab === 'closing_soon' &&
                !['Proposal/Price Quote', 'Negotiation'].includes(opp.salesStage)
            ) {
                return false;
            }
            if (activeTab === 'won' && opp.salesStage !== 'Closed Won') {
                return false;
            }
            if (activeTab === 'high_value' && (opp.grandTotal || 0) < 100000) {
                return false;
            }
            if (activeTab === 'my_deals' && (!currentUsername || !(opp.assignedTo || '').includes(currentUsername))) {
                return false;
            }

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                const inOrg = opp.organizationName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inCode = opp.opportunityCode.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inContact = opp.contactName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inPhone = opp.contactNumber.includes(q);
                const inEmail = (opp.emailAddress || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inStage = opp.salesStage.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inType = opp.type.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inSource = opp.leadSource.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inAssigned = opp.assignedTo.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inProduct = (opp.productCategory || []).some((p) =>
                    p.toLowerCase().includes(q)
                );

                return (
                    inOrg ||
                    inCode ||
                    inContact ||
                    inPhone ||
                    inEmail ||
                    inStage ||
                    inType ||
                    inSource ||
                    inAssigned ||
                    inProduct
                );
            }

            return true;
        });
    }, [opportunities, activeTab, searchQuery, currentUsername]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedOpportunities = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredOpportunities].sort((a, b) => {
            if (sortField === 'grandTotal') {
                const valA = a.grandTotal || 0;
                const valB = b.grandTotal || 0;
                return sortOrder === 'asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
            }

            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredOpportunities, sortField, sortOrder]);

    const paginatedOpportunities = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedOpportunities.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedOpportunities, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleSort = (field: OpportunitySortField) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const handleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) =>
            prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
        );
    };

    const handleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedOpportunities.map((o) => o.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleEdit = useCallback(
        (id: string) => {
            router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(id));
        },
        [router]
    );

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        if (count === 0) return;
        if (
            confirm(
                `Are you sure you want to delete ${count} selected opportunities?`
            )
        ) {
            try {
                await bulkDeleteMutation.mutateAsync(selectedIds);
                if (drawerOppId && selectedIds.includes(drawerOppId)) {
                    closeThreePanelView();
                }
                setSelectedIds([]);
                setToast({
                    open: true,
                    message: `${count} opportunities deleted successfully.`,
                    severity: 'success',
                });
            } catch {
                setToast({
                    open: true,
                    message: 'Failed to bulk delete opportunities.',
                    severity: 'error',
                });
            }
        }
    };

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Opportunity>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'opportunityCode',
                label: 'DEAL / CODE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 190,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.3 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                            <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                            <RecordLink
                                href={ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_DETAIL(o.id)}
                                onOpen={() => setDrawerOppId(o.id)}
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {o.opportunityCode}
                            </RecordLink>
                        </Box>
                        <Box sx={{ pl: 3 }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }} noWrap>
                                {o.groupName || 'Primary Solution'}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION & CONTACT',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.3 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                            <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#64748b', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#1e293b', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                                {o.organizationName}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {o.contactName && (
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6, pl: 2.8 }}>
                                <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }} noWrap>
                                    {o.contactName} ({o.contactNumber})
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'salesStage',
                label: 'SALES STAGE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (o) => {
                    let bg = '#eff6ff';
                    let color = '#1d4ed8';
                    let border = '#bfdbfe';

                    if (o.salesStage === 'Closed Won') {
                        bg = '#ecfdf5';
                        color = '#047857';
                        border = '#a7f3d0';
                    } else if (o.salesStage === 'Closed Lost') {
                        bg = '#fef2f2';
                        color = '#b91c1c';
                        border = '#fecaca';
                    } else if (o.salesStage.includes('Proposal') || o.salesStage.includes('Negotiation')) {
                        bg = '#fffbeb';
                        color = '#b45309';
                        border = '#fde68a';
                    } else if (o.salesStage.includes('Value') || o.salesStage.includes('Needs')) {
                        bg = '#f5f3ff';
                        color = '#6d28d9';
                        border = '#ddd6fe';
                    }

                    return (
                        <Chip
                            label={o.salesStage}
                            size="small"
                            icon={
                                o.salesStage === 'Closed Won' ? (
                                    <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon
                                        sx={{ fontSize: '13px !important', color: '#047857 !important' }}
                                    />
                                ) : undefined
                            }
                            sx={{
                                height: 22,
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                backgroundColor: bg,
                                color: color,
                                border: `1px solid ${border}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'grandTotal',
                label: 'DEAL VALUE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(o.grandTotal || 0)}
                        </Typography>
                        {o.lineItems && o.lineItems.length > 0 && (
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                {o.lineItems.length} line item(s)
                            </Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'productCategory',
                label: 'PRODUCT CATEGORY',
                sortable: false,
                minWidth: 170,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
                        {o.productCategory && o.productCategory.length > 0 ? (
                            o.productCategory.map((cat, idx) => (
                                <Chip
                                    key={idx}
                                    label={cat}
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{
                                        height: 20,
                                        fontSize: '0.66rem',
                                        fontWeight: 600,
                                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                        color: '#1d4ed8',
                                        border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                                    }}
                                />
                            ))
                        ) : (
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>-</Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'type',
                label: 'TYPE & SOURCE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            {o.type || 'New Business'}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            via {o.leadSource}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'nextFollowupDate',
                label: 'NEXT FOLLOWUP',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (o) => {
                    const isToday = o.nextFollowupDate === todayStr;

                    return (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                            <CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: 16,
                                    color: isToday ? '#d97706' : '#64748b',
                                }}
                            />
                            <Box>
                                <Typography
                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                        fontWeight: isToday ? 700 : 500,
                                        color: isToday ? '#b45309' : '#334155',
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {o.nextFollowupDate || '-'}
                                    {isToday && (
                                        <Box
                                            component="span"
                                            sx={{
                                                ml: 0.6,
                                                px: 0.6,
                                                py: 0.1,
                                                borderRadius: '4px',
                                                fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                                fontWeight: 800,
                                                backgroundColor: '#fef3c7',
                                                color: '#b45309',
                                                border: '1px solid #fde68a',
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            TODAY
                                        </Box>
                                    )}
                                </Typography>
                                {o.followupType && (
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                        {o.followupType} {o.nextFollowupTime ? `• ${o.nextFollowupTime}` : ''}
                                    </Typography>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedTo',
                label: 'ASSIGNED TO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {o.assignedTo || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        [todayStr]
    );

    const relatedModules = useRelatedModulesForEntity('opportunity', selectedDrawerOpp, setActiveRelatedModule);

    // Falls back to the first module until the user explicitly picks one.
    const effectiveRelatedModule = activeRelatedModule ?? relatedModules[0]?.id ?? null;
    const activeModuleMeta = relatedModules.find((m) => m.id === effectiveRelatedModule);

    // Dismisses the three-panel view and returns to the clean master table.
    const closeThreePanelView = useCallback(() => {
        setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);
        setDrawerOppId(null);
        setActiveRelatedModule(null);
    }, []);

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Opportunity, OpportunityFilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            tableId="opportunities"
            headerActions={() => (
                <MasterHeaderActions
                    onRefresh={async () => {
                        const { isError } = await refetch();
                        setToast(
                            isError
                                ? { open: true, message: 'Failed to refresh opportunities.', severity: 'error' }
                                : { open: true, message: 'Opportunities refreshed.', severity: 'info' }
                        );
                    }}
                    onNewClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_NEW)}
                    newButtonLabel="New Opportunity"
                />
            )}
            searchConfig={buildExtendedSearchConfig({
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by deal, company, contact, stage, amount...',
                pageIds: paginatedOpportunities.map((r) => r.id),
                allIds: sortedOpportunities.map((r) => r.id),
                selectedIds,
                onSelectedIdsChange: setSelectedIds,
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalRecords: sortedOpportunities.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            })}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedOpportunities}
            keyExtractor={(o) => o.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={(f) => handleSort(f as OpportunitySortField)}
            onView={(o) => setDrawerOppId(o.id)}
            getEditHref={(o) => ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(o.id)}
            onRowClick={(opp) => setDrawerOppId(opp.id)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerOpp?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Deal Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Opportunity"
            emptyTitle="No opportunities in pipeline"
            emptyDescription="Create your first deal opportunity and track it from qualification to closed won."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Opportunity"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<TrendingUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            minHeight={300}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: sortedOpportunities.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onRowsPerPageChange: (r) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(r);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                hideWhenEmpty: true,
            }}
            relatedSidebar={
                <RelatedModulesSidebar
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOpp)}
                    modules={relatedModules}
                    activeModuleId={effectiveRelatedModule ?? undefined}
                    onModuleSelect={(moduleId) => setActiveRelatedModule(moduleId)}
                    collapsed={isLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                    onToggleCollapse={setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                />
            }
            relatedRecordsTable={
                <RelatedRecordsTableView
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOpp && effectiveRelatedModule)}
                    moduleId={effectiveRelatedModule || ''}
                    moduleTitle={activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Related Records'}
                    parentRecordId={selectedDrawerOpp?.id}
                    parentEntityTitle={selectedDrawerOpp?.opportunityCode || selectedDrawerOpp?.organizationName || ''}
                    entityData={selectedDrawerOpp}
                    entityType="opportunity"
                    leftOffset={isLeftSidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 260}
                    rightOffset={580}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onRowClick={(row, modId) => setSecondaryDrawerEntity({ type: modId, data: row })}
                />
            }
            drawer={
                <OpportunityDetailDrawer
                    opportunity={selectedDrawerOpp}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOpp)}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onEdit={handleEdit}
                />
            }
            secondaryDrawer={
                secondaryDrawerEntity ? (
                    <RelatedSecondaryDrawer
                        entity={secondaryDrawerEntity}
                        moduleLabel={activeModuleMeta?.label}
                        parentTitle={selectedDrawerOpp?.opportunityCode || selectedDrawerOpp?.organizationName}
                        onClose={() => setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null)}
                    />
                ) : null
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerOpp)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Divider } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RequestQuoteOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';

import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Opportunity } from '@/types/opportunity.types';
import {
    EntityDetailDrawer,
    DrawerSectionCard,
    DrawerCopyButton,
} from '@/components/common/Drawer';
import { AppToast } from '@/components/common/AppToast';
import { useOpportunity, useOrganization, useOrganizations, useQuotations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import { OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS } from './OpportunityForm';

export interface OpportunityDetailDrawerProps {
    opportunity: Opportunity | null;
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onEdit?: (id: string) => void;
    onShowToast?: (message: string, severity?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning') => void;
}

export function OpportunityDetailDrawer({
    opportunity,
    open,
    onClose,
    onEdit,
    onShowToast,
}: OpportunityDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { data: freshOpp } = useOpportunity(open && opportunity?.id ? opportunity.id : undefined);
    const opp = freshOpp ?? opportunity;

    const { data: linkedOrgById } = useOrganization(
        open && opp?.organizationId ? opp.organizationId : undefined
    );
    const { data: organizations } = useOrganizations(undefined, {
        enabled: Boolean(open && opp && !opp.organizationId && opp.organizationName),
    });
    const { data: linkedQuotes } = useQuotations(
        opp?.id ? { opportunityId: opp.id } : undefined,
        { enabled: Boolean(open && opp?.id) }
    );

    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'error',
    });

    if (!opp) return null;

    const triggerToast = (
        message: string,
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning' = 'error'
    ) => {
        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
        onShowToast?.(message, severity);
    };

    // Check whether the linked Organization has a complete address
    const linkedOrg =
        linkedOrgById ??
        organizations?.find(
            (o) =>
                o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                opp.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase()
        );

    const billingStreet = (linkedOrg?.billingStreet || linkedOrg?.billingAddress || '').trim();
    const billingCity = (linkedOrg?.billingCity || '').trim();
    const billingState = (linkedOrg?.billingState || '').trim();
    const billingPostalCode = (linkedOrg?.billingPostalCode || '').trim();

    const hasAddress = Boolean(
        billingStreet && billingCity && billingState && billingPostalCode
    );

    const existingQuote = linkedQuotes?.[0];
    const isQuoteCreated = Boolean(existingQuote);

    const handleCreateQuote = () => {
        if (!hasAddress) {
            triggerToast(
                'Address is required before creating a quotation. Please update the address details first.',
                'error'
            );
            return;
        }

        router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_CREATE_QUOTE(opp.id));
    };

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(opp.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(opp.id));
        }
    };

    const getStageColor = (stage: string) => {
        switch (stage) {
            case 'Closed Won':
                return { bg: '#dcfce7', text: '#15803d', border: '#86efac' };
            case 'Closed Lost':
                return { bg: '#fee2e2', text: '#b91c1c', border: '#fca5a5' };
            case 'Negotiation':
            case 'Proposal/Price Quote':
                return { bg: '#fef3c7', text: '#b45309', border: '#fde68a' };
            default:
                return { bg: '#eff6ff', text: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe' };
        }
    };

    const stageColors = getStageColor(opp.salesStage);

    return (
        <>
            <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={opp.organizationName}
            subtitle={`${opp.opportunityCode} • ${opp.contactName}`}
            avatarText={opp.organizationName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
            avatarBg="#1e3a8a"
            badges={[
                {
                    label: opp.salesStage,
                    backgroundColor: stageColors.bg,
                    color: stageColors.text,
                    borderColor: stageColors.border,
                },
                {
                    label: `₹${opp.grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
                    backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                    color: '#15803d',
                    borderColor: '#bbf7d0',
                },
                {
                    label: opp.type,
                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                    color: '#475569',
                    borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
                onView: () => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_DETAIL(opp.id)),
            }}
            formTabs={OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                basic: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                        {/* Organization & Deal Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="CLIENT ORGANIZATION" bg="#f8fafc">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.98rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                    {opp.organizationName}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.3 }}>
                                Deal Ref: {opp.opportunityCode} • Type: {opp.type}
                            </Typography>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Primary Contact Person Details */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="CONTACT PERSON DETAILS">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.2, mt: 1 }}>
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                    <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                        {opp.contactName}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>

                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                        <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                            {opp.contactNumber}
                                        </Typography>
                                    </Box>
                                    <DrawerCopyButton text={opp.contactNumber} title="Copy Phone Number" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                                </Box>

                                {opp.emailAddress && (
                                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                            <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                                {opp.emailAddress}
                                            </Typography>
                                        </Box>
                                        <DrawerCopyButton text={opp.emailAddress} title="Copy Email" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                                    </Box>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Product Categories */}
                        <Box>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', mb: 1, letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>
                                PRODUCT INTEREST
                            </Typography>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.8 }}>
                                {(opp.productCategory || []).map((cat) => (
                                    <Chip
                                        key={cat}
                                        label={cat}
                                        size="small"
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                            fontWeight: 600,
                                            backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                            color: '#1d4ed8',
                                            border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                                        }}
                                    />
                                ))}
                            </Box>
                        </Box>

                        {/* Next Followup Info */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard bg="#fffbeb" borderColor="#fde68a">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                                <CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: '#b45309' }} />
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#92400e' }}>
                                        Next Followup: {opp.nextFollowupDate} {opp.nextFollowupTime ? `at ${opp.nextFollowupTime}` : ''}
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#b45309' }}>
                                        Method: {opp.followupType || 'Call'} • Lead Given By: {opp.leadGivenBy}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Scope & Descriptions */}
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
                            <DrawerSectionCard title="ACTION BRIEF / ADD DESCRIPTION">
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#334155', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                                    {opp.addDescription}
                                </Typography>
                            </DrawerSectionCard>

                            {opp.description && (
                                <DrawerSectionCard title="DETAILED SCOPE / NOTES">
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#334155', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                                        {opp.description}
                                    </Typography>
                                </DrawerSectionCard>
                            )}
                        </Box>

                        {/* Billing Details & Commission */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="BILLING & COMMISSION" bg="#f8fafc">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 1.5, mt: 1 }}>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Tally Serial No:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                        {opp.tallySerialNo || '—'}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Invoice No:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                        {opp.invoiceNo || '—'}
                                    </Typography>

                                        {opp.addDocument || 'No'}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>
                    </Box>
                ),
                line_items: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                {opp.groupName || 'Products & Services'}
                            </Typography>

                            <Box sx={{ p: 3, textAlign: 'center', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: '8px' }}>

                                                <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Tax ({item.taxRate}):</Typography>

                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Total Discount:</Typography>

                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>₹{opp.subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Tax Total:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#2563eb' }}>+ ₹{opp.totalTax.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                                {opp.lumpSumDiscount > 0 && (
                                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                                        <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b' }}>Lump Sum Discount:</Typography>
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>- ₹{opp.lumpSumDiscount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</Typography>
                                    </Box>
                                )}
                                <Divider sx={{ my: 0.5 }} />
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '0.94rem' }}>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>Grand Total:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: '#15803d', fontSize: '1.05rem' }}>
                                        ₹{opp.grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>
                    </Box>
                ),
            }}
            auditEntity={{ type: 'opportunities', id: opp.id }}
            includeChangesTab={true}
            primaryAction={{
                label: 'Edit Opportunity',
                onClick: handleEdit,
                icon: <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
            }}
            secondaryAction={{
                label: isQuoteCreated ? 'Quote Created' : 'Create Quote',
                icon: isQuoteCreated ? (
                    <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#059669' }} />
                ) : (
                    <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                ),
                onClick: handleCreateQuote,
                variant: 'outlined',
                tooltip: !hasAddress
                    ? 'Complete Address is required to create a quotation'
                    : isQuoteCreated
                    ? 'Quotation already created for this opportunity'
                    : 'Create Quotation from Opportunity details',
                sx: {
                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    height: 36,
                    px: 1.8,
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    color: isQuoteCreated ? '#047857' : hasAddress ? '#047857' : '#dc2626',
                    borderColor: isQuoteCreated ? '#a7f3d0' : hasAddress ? '#a7f3d0' : '#fca5a5',
                    backgroundColor: isQuoteCreated ? '#ecfdf5' : hasAddress ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef2f2',
                    '&:hover': {

                        backgroundColor: isQuoteCreated ? '#d1fae5' : hasAddress ? '#d1fae5' : '#fee2e2',
                    },
                },
            }}
        />
        <AppToast
            open={toast.open}
            message={toast.message}
            severity={toast.severity}
            onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
        />
    </>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';

// Icons
import ArticleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArticleOutlined';
import ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLongOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { useRhfForm } from '../forms/rhf';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { opportunityFormSchema } from '../../validations';
import type { OpportunityFormData } from '@/types/opportunity.types';
import { opportunityService } from '../../services/opportunity.service';

// Modular Opportunity Form Sections
import {
    OpportunityBasicSection,
    OpportunityLineItemsSection,
} from './sections';

export type OpportunityTabKey = 'basic' | 'line_items';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Opportunity Form Tabs ─────────────────────────
export const OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: OpportunityTabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'basic',
        label: 'BASIC',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'line_items',
        label: 'Line Items',
        icon: <ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

export interface OpportunityFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';
    initialData?: Partial<OpportunityFormData>;
    opportunityId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITY_FORM: OpportunityFormData = {
    productCategory: ['Biz Analyst'],
    contactName: '',
    organizationName: '',
    contactNumber: '',
    emailAddress: '',
    referredBy: '',
    type: 'New Business',
    salesStage: 'Qualification',
    leadSource: 'Website Enquiry',
    leadGivenBy: 'Direct Inbound Marketing',
    nextFollowupDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    nextFollowupTime: '11:00 AM',
    followupType: 'Call',
    addDescription: '',
    description: '',
    assignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    // Billing Details
    tallySerialNo: '',
    invoiceNo: '',
    invoiceDate: '',

    // Commission Details
    commission: 'Standard (10%)',

    // Document
    addDocument: 'No',

    // Line Items
    currency: 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
    groupName: 'Products & Services',
    lineItems: [
        {
            id: 'line-1',
            productId: 'prod-tally',
            productName: 'TallyPrime Silver (Single User)',
            quantity: 1,
            amount: 22500,
            discount: 0,
            discountType: 'percentage',
            salePrice: 22500,
            taxRate: 'GST 18%',
            taxAmount: 4050,
            total: 26550,
            description: 'Standard single-user perpetual license for accounting & compliance',
            note: '',
        },
    ],
    lumpSumDiscount: 0,
    totalAmount: 22500,
    totalDiscount: 0,
    subtotal: 22500,
    totalTax: 4050,
    grandTotal: 26550,
};

export default function OpportunityForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    opportunityId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: OpportunityFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<OpportunityTabKey>('basic');

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } =
        useRhfForm<OpportunityFormData>({
            schema: opportunityFormSchema,
            defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITY_FORM, ...initialData },
        });

    const { reset, watch, setValue, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const orgName = watch('organizationName');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Opportunities', href: ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES },
        {
            label:
                mode !== 'create'
                    ? orgName
                        ? `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'}: ${orgName}`
                        : `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'} Opportunity`
                    : 'Create Opportunity',
        },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!opportunityId) return;
        let active = true;
        opportunityService
            .getById(opportunityId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) {
                    reset(found);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [opportunityId, reset]);

    const setField = useCallback(
        <K extends keyof OpportunityFormData>(key: K, value: OpportunityFormData[K]) => {
            setValue(key, value as never, {
                shouldDirty: true,
                shouldValidate: true,
            });
        },
        [setValue]
    );

    // ── Submit Logic with Validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (mode === 'create') {
                await opportunityService.create(values);
                showToast('Opportunity created successfully! Added to your sales pipeline.', 'success');
            } else if (mode === 'edit' && opportunityId) {
                await opportunityService.update(opportunityId, values);
                showToast('Opportunity details updated successfully!', 'success');
            }

            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => {
                router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES);
            }, 800);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(
                err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An error occurred while saving the opportunity.',
                'error'
            );
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (mode === 'view') {
            router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES);
            return;
        }
        if (
            isDirty &&
            !confirm('You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?')
        ) {
            return;
        }
        router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES);
    };

    const formValues = watch();

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as OpportunityTabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={mode === 'view' ? () => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(opportunityId!)) : handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Edit Opportunity' : mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Opportunity' : 'Save Opportunity'}
                cancelLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Back' : 'Cancel'}
                recordView={{
                    title: orgName || '',
                    editHref: opportunityId ? ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(opportunityId) : undefined,
                    editLabel: 'Edit Opportunity',
                    backHref: ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES,
                }}
                mode={mode}
                disableContentPadding
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'basic'}>
                    <OpportunityBasicSection form={formValues} setField={setField} />
                </div>

                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'line_items'}>
                    <OpportunityLineItemsSection />
                </div>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            type="date"
                            value={form.nextFollowupDate}
                            onChange={(e) => setField('nextFollowupDate', e.target.value)}
                            slotProps={calendarAdornment}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                        <FormControl size="small" fullWidth sx={fieldSx}>
                            <Select
                                value={form.nextFollowupTime || '11:00 AM'}
                                onChange={(e) => setField('nextFollowupTime', e.target.value)}
                                startAdornment={
                                    <InputAdornment position="start">
                                        <AccessTimeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                }
                            >
                                <MenuItem value="09:30 AM">09:30 AM</MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="10:00 AM">10:00 AM</MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="11:00 AM">11:00 AM</MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="12:00 PM">12:00 PM</MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="02:30 PM">02:30 PM</MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="03:30 PM">03:30 PM</MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="04:30 PM">04:30 PM</MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="05:30 PM">05:30 PM</MenuItem>
                            </Select>
                        </FormControl>
                    </Box>
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="assignedTo" label="Assigned to" required size="md" hint="Account executive">
                    <LookupField
                        value={form.assignedTo}
                        onChange={(val) => setField('assignedTo', val)}
                        placeholder="Assign to user..."
                        options={[
                            'mittal.sharma',
                            'rajesh.kumar',
                            'anil.verma',
                            'deepak.joshi',
                            'amit.tandon',
                        ]}
                        onLookupClick={() => setUserLookupOpen(true)}
                        required
                    />
                    <UserLookupModal
                        open={userLookupOpen}
                        onClose={() => setUserLookupOpen(false)}
                        onSelect={(user) => setField('assignedTo', user.username)}
                        selectedValue={form.assignedTo}
                    />
                </FormField>

                {/* Product Category:* (Multi-select chips, full row) */}
                <FormField
                    name="productCategory"
                    label="Product Category"
                    required
                    size="full"
                    viewValue={
                        (form.productCategory || []).length > 0 ? (
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.75 }}>
                                {(form.productCategory || []).map((prod) => (
                                    <Chip
                                        key={prod}
                                        label={prod}
                                        size="small"
                                        sx={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'default', color: '#1d4ed8', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' }}
                                    />
                                ))}
                            </Box>
                        ) : null
                    }
                    hint={`${(form.productCategory || []).length} category selected`}
                >
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                            borderRadius: '8px',
                            p: 1.5,
                            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                            display: 'flex',
                            flexWrap: 'wrap',
                            gap: 0.8,
                            transition: 'border-color 0.15s ease',
                            '&:hover': { borderColor: '#2563eb' },
                        }}
                    >
                        {PRODUCT_CATEGORIES.map((prod) => {
                            const selected = (form.productCategory || []).includes(prod);
                            return (
                                <Chip
                                    key={prod}
                                    label={prod}
                                    onClick={() => handleToggleProduct(prod)}
                                    icon={
                                        selected ? (
                                            <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: '14px !important', color: '#166534 !important' }} />
                                        ) : undefined
                                    }
                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                        fontWeight: selected ? 700 : 500,
                                        height: 28,
                                        cursor: 'pointer',
                                        backgroundColor: selected ? '#dcfce7' : '#f8fafc',
                                        color: selected ? '#15803d' : '#475569',
                                        border: selected ? '1.5px solid #86efac' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                                        '&:hover': {
                                            backgroundColor: selected ? '#bbf7d0' : '#e2e8f0',
                                        },
                                    }}
                                />
                            );
                        })}
                    </Box>
                </FormField>
            </FormGrid>

            {/* ── Notes: two textareas side by side ── */}
            <FormGrid columns={2} sx={{ mt: 2.5 }}>
                <FormGridItem>
                    <FormField name="addDescription" label="Add Description" required size="full" hint="Stage summary & action items">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            multiline
                            minRows={4}
                            maxRows={8}
                            placeholder="Provide current milestone details or immediate actions..."
                            value={form.addDescription}
                            onChange={(e) => setField('addDescription', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.longText } }}
                        />
                    </FormField>
                </FormGridItem>
                <FormGridItem>
                    <FormField name="description" label="Description" size="full" hint="Background & scope">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            multiline
                            minRows={4}
                            maxRows={8}
                            placeholder="Enter background scope, requirements, current challenges, and business justification..."
                            value={form.description || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setField('description', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.longText } }}
                        />
                    </FormField>
                </FormGridItem>
            </FormGrid>

            {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            {/* BILLING DETAILS                                                       */}
            {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />
            <SectionLabel
                icon={<ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                label="Billing Details"
                sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}
            />
            <FormGrid columns={3}>
                <FormField name="tallySerialNo" label="Tally Serial No" size="sm" hint="Optional serial number">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. 765432109"
                        value={form.tallySerialNo || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setField('tallySerialNo', e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortCode } }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="invoiceNo" label="Invoice No" size="sm" hint="Reference number">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. INV-2026-0982"
                        value={form.invoiceNo || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setField('invoiceNo', e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortCode } }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="invoiceDate" label="Invoice Date" size="sm" hint="Billing issue date">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        type="date"
                        value={form.invoiceDate || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setField('invoiceDate', e.target.value)}
                        slotProps={calendarAdornment}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                    />
                </FormField>
            </FormGrid>

            {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            {/* COMMISSION & DOCUMENTATION                                            */}
            {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />
            <SectionLabel
                icon={<MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                label="Commission & Documentation"
                sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}
            />
            <FormGrid columns={3}>
                <FormField name="commission" label="Commission" required size={resolveOptionsFieldSize(OPPORTUNITY_COMMISSIONS)} hint="Sales / partner commission">
                    <StyledSelect
                        value={form.commission}
                        onChange={(v) => setField('commission', v)}
                        options={OPPORTUNITY_COMMISSIONS}
                        placeholder="Select Commission"
                        required
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="addDocument" label="Add Document" size="sm" hint="Documents / PO attached">
                    <StyledSelect
                        value={form.addDocument || 'No'}
                        onChange={(v) => setField('addDocument', v)}
                        options={OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT_OPTIONS}
                        placeholder="Select"
                    />
                </FormField>
            </FormGrid>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

// Icons

import HighlightOffOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HighlightOffOutlined';
import VerifiedUserOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VerifiedUserOutlined';
import CloudDoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CloudDoneOutlined';
import BusinessCenterOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessCenterOutlined';
import TagOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TagOutlined';

    organization: ExtendedOrganization | null;

const sectionIcon = (icon: React.ReactElement) => (
    <Box
        sx={{
            width: 24,
            height: 24,
            borderRadius: '7px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            color: '#2563eb',
            backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
        }}
    >
        {icon}
    </Box>
);

const getInitials = (name: string) => {
    const parts = name.replace(/[._-]+/g, ' ').trim().split(/\s+/);
    return ((parts[0]?.[0] ?? '') + (parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1][0] : '')).toUpperCase();
};

/** A code (SAP / showroom) shown as a monospace pill with an inline copy button. */
function IdentifierRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value?: string }) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 1.5, py: 0.9 }}>
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>
                {label}
            </Typography>
            {value ? (
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.25, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Box
                        component="span"
                        sx={{
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: '0.82rem',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            color: '#0f172a',
                            backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            px: 1,
                            py: 0.2,
                            overflow: 'hidden',
                            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        }}
                    >
                        {value}
                    </Box>
                    <DrawerCopyButton text={value} title={`Copy ${label}`} iconColor="#64748b" />
                </Box>
            ) : (
                <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>—</Typography>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

/** Masks all but the last 4 digits of an account number. */
const maskAccountNumber = (value: string) => (value.length > 4 ? `•••• ${value.slice(-4)}` : value);

interface AddressCardProps {
    title: string;
    street?: string;
    city?: string;
    state?: string;
    postalCode?: string;
    country?: string;
}

/** Multi-line address with a copy button (copies the one-line form). Renders nothing when empty. */
function AddressCard({ title, street, city, state, postalCode, country }: AddressCardProps) {
    const oneLine = formatAddressLine({ street, city, state, postalCode, country });
    if (!oneLine) return null;
    const locality = [city, [state, postalCode].filter(Boolean).join(' – ')].filter(Boolean).join(', ');

    return (
        <DrawerSectionCard
            bg="#f8fafc"
            title={title}
            action={<DrawerCopyButton text={oneLine} title={`Copy ${title.toLowerCase()}`} iconColor="#64748b" />}
        >
            {street && (
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a', whiteSpace: 'pre-line' }}>
                    {street}
                </Typography>
            )}
            {locality && <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', mt: 0.3 }}>{locality}</Typography>}
            {country && (
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.3 }}>{getCountryNameByCode(country)}</Typography>
            )}
        </DrawerSectionCard>
    );
}

export function OrganizationDetailDrawer({
    organization,
    open,
    onClose,
    onEdit,
    hideBackdrop,
}: OrganizationDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [showBankAccount, setShowBankAccount] = useState(false);

    const { data: freshOrg } = useOrganization(open && organization?.id ? organization.id : undefined);
    const org = freshOrg ?? organization;

    if (!org) return null;
    const assignedUser = findCrmUser(org.assignedUser);
    const assignedDisplayName = assignedUser?.name || org.assignedUser || '';

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(org.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(org.id));
        }
    };

    const isActive = org.accountStatus !== 'Inactive';
    const location = [org.billingCity, org.billingState].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'Location Unspecified';
    const partnerCompany = org.partnerCompanies?.join(', ');
    const gstin = org.gstNo || org.gstNumber || '';

    const badges: DrawerBadgeItem[] = [
        isActive
            ? { label: 'Active', backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5', color: '#059669', borderColor: '#a7f3d0' }
            : { label: 'Inactive', backgroundColor: '#fef3c7', color: '#b45309', borderColor: '#fde68a' },
        org.accountVerified
            ? {
                  label: org.verifiedAt
                      ? `Verified: ${formatDateTime(org.verifiedAt)} by ${org.verifiedBy || 'Admin'}`
                      : 'Verified',
                  icon: <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />,
                  backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5',
                  color: '#059669',
                  borderColor: '#a7f3d0',
              }
            : {
                  label: 'Not Verified',
                  icon: <HighlightOffOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />,
                  backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                  color: '#64748b',
                  borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
              },
        ...(org.activeAmc
            ? [
                  {
                      label: 'Active AMC',
                      icon: <VerifiedUserOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />,
                      backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                      color: '#1d4ed8',
                      borderColor: '#bfdbfe',
                  },
              ]
            : []),
        ...(org.activeCloud
            ? [
                  {
                      label: 'Active Cloud',
                      icon: <CloudDoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />,
                      backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                      color: '#15803d',
                      borderColor: '#bbf7d0',
                  },
              ]
            : []),
    ];

    return (
        <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            hideBackdrop={hideBackdrop}
            title={org.organizationName}
            subtitle={`${org.tradeName || org.organizationName} • ${location}`}
            avatarBg="linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7 0%, #0369a1 100%)"
            verified={Boolean(org.accountVerified)}
            badges={badges}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
                onView: () => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_DETAIL(org.id)),
            }}
            formTabs={ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS.filter((t) => t.id !== 'partner_licensing')}
            tabContents={{
                overview: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                        <DrawerMetricGrid
                            items={[
                                {
                                    label: 'ANNUAL TURNOVER',
                                    value: org.annualTurnover || '—',
                                    bg: '#eff6ff',
                                    borderColor: '#dbeafe',
                                    labelColor: '#1d4ed8',
                                    valueSize: '1rem',
                                    valueWeight: 800,
                                    p: 1.75,
                                },
                                {
                                    label: 'EMPLOYEES',
                                    value: org.numberOfEmployees || '—',
                                    bg: '#f0fdf4',
                                    borderColor: '#dcfce7',
                                    labelColor: '#15803d',
                                    valueSize: '1rem',
                                    valueWeight: 800,
                                    p: 1.75,

                        />

                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} icon={sectionIcon(<BusinessCenterOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="Business Profile">
                            <DrawerFieldGrid sx={{ mt: 0 }}>
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Nature of Business" value={org.natureOfBusiness} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Type of Entity" value={org.typeOfEntity} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Customer Type" value={org.customerType} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Member Of" value={org.memberOfParentCorp} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Partner Company" value={partnerCompany} sx={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1' }} />

                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} bg="#f8fafc" icon={sectionIcon(<TagOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="Account Identifiers">
                            <Box sx={{ '& > * + *': { borderTop: '1px dashed #e2e8f0' } }}>
                                <IdentifierRow label="SAP Code / Tally ID" value={org.sapCodeTallyId} />

                            <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} icon={sectionIcon(<NotesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="About">
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#334155', lineHeight: 1.55, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>
                                    {org.description}
                                </Typography>
                            </DrawerSectionCard>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
                address: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                        <AddressCard
                            title="Billing Address"
                            street={org.billingStreet || org.billingAddress}
                            city={org.billingCity}
                            state={org.billingState}
