                            state={org.shippingState}
                            postalCode={org.shippingPostalCode}
                            country={org.shippingCountry}
                        />
                    </Box>
                ),
                tax_bank: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} title="Statutory Tax & Compliance">
                            <DrawerFieldGrid>
                                <ReadOnlyField label="GSTIN" value={gstin} copyable />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="PAN" value={org.panNumber} copyable />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="MSME Registration No." value={org.msmeRegnNumber} copyable />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="CIN" value={org.cinNo} copyable />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="TAN" value={org.tanNumber} copyable />
                            </DrawerFieldGrid>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} bg="#f8fafc" title="Operating Bank Account">
                            <DrawerFieldGrid>
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Bank Name" value={org.bankName} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Account Name" value={org.accountName} />
                                <ReadOnlyField
                                    label="Account Number"
                                    value={
                                        org.accountNumber ? (
                                            <Box component="span" sx={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                                                <Box component="span" sx={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                                                    {showBankAccount ? org.accountNumber : maskAccountNumber(org.accountNumber)}
                                                </Box>
                                                <Tooltip title={showBankAccount ? 'Hide account number' : 'Show account number'}>
                                                    <IconButton
                                                        size="small"
                                                        onClick={() => setShowBankAccount((v) => !v)}
                                                        aria-label={showBankAccount ? 'Hide account number' : 'Show account number'}
                                                        sx={{ p: 0.2 }}
                                                    >
                                                        {showBankAccount ? (
                                                            <VisibilityOffOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                                                        ) : (
                                                            <VisibilityOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                                                        )}
                                                    </IconButton>
                                                </Tooltip>
                                            </Box>
                                        ) : undefined
                                    }
                                    copyable
                                    copyText={org.accountNumber}
                                />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="IFSC Code" value={org.bankIfscCode} copyable />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Branch Address" value={org.bankAddress} sx={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1' }} />
                            </DrawerFieldGrid>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>
                    </Box>
                ),
            }}
            auditEntity={{ type: 'organizations', id: org.id }}
            includeChangesTab={true}
            statusText={isActive ? 'Ready for Order Processing' : 'Inactive account'}
            primaryAction={{
                label: 'Edit Details',
                onClick: handleEdit,
            }}
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

// Icons
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';

// Tab components

    OverviewTab,
    AddressTab,
    TaxBankTab,
    PartnerLicensingTab,
} from './tabs';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Organization Form Tabs ──────────────────────────
export const ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: TabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,

/** Country/state pairs normalised to the ISO address master when a saved organization is loaded. */
const ORGANIZATION_ADDRESS_PAIRS = [
    ['billingCountry', 'billingState'],
    ['shippingCountry', 'shippingState'],
] as const;

// ─── Default Form State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DEFAULT_FORM: OrganizationFormData = {
    organizationName: '',
    mailingName: '',
    natureOfBusiness: '',

type TabKey = 'overview' | 'address' | 'tax_bank' | 'partner_licensing';

// Maps a validation field key to the tab that renders it (unmapped keys stay on the current tab).
const FIELD_TAB_MAP: Record<string, TabKey> = {
    organizationName: 'overview',
    mailingName: 'overview',
    natureOfBusiness: 'overview',
    accountStatus: 'overview',
    inactivityReason: 'overview',
    typeOfEntity: 'overview',
    customerType: 'overview',
    sapCodeTallyId: 'overview',
    showroomBranchCode: 'overview',

    cinNo: 'tax_bank',
    tanNumber: 'tax_bank',
    accountNumber: 'tax_bank',
    typeOfAccount: 'tax_bank',
    bankAddress: 'tax_bank',
    partnerCompanies: 'partner_licensing',
};

// ─── Component Props ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface OrganizationFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';
    initialData?: Partial<OrganizationFormData>;
    organizationId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

export default function OrganizationForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    organizationId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: OrganizationFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const isAdmin = user?.role?.toLowerCase() === 'admin';

    const [form, setForm] = useState<OrganizationFormData>({ ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData });
    // Lock is based on the status as last saved, so deactivating mid-edit doesn't lock the user out of their own unsaved change.
    const [persistedStatus, setPersistedStatus] = useState(initialData?.accountStatus ?? 'Active');
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabKey>('overview');
    const [audit, setAudit] = useState<{ createdAt?: string; createdBy?: string; updatedAt?: string }>({});
    const pendingFocusField = useRef<string | null>(null);
    // Values "Discard" resets to: blank for create, the last loaded record for edit.
    const baselineRef = useRef<OrganizationFormData>({ ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData });
    // In edit mode drafts are restored only after the saved record has loaded, so they aren't overwritten by it.
    const [recordLoaded, setRecordLoaded] = useState(!organizationId);
    const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
    const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const methods = useForm<OrganizationFormData>({
        defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
        mode: 'onTouched',
    });

    const isInactive = mode !== 'create' && persistedStatus === 'Inactive';
    const isLocked = isInactive && !isAdmin;
    const effectiveMode = isLocked ? 'view' : mode;

    const draftKey = mode === 'create' ? 'crm_draft_organization_new' : `crm_draft_organization_${organizationId}`;
    const draftValues = useMemo<OrganizationFormData>(
        () => ({ ...form, ...methods.getValues() }),
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- RHF values change together with `form` (see set())
        [form]
    );
    const { clearDraft, confirmDiscard, discardModalOpen, handleKeepEditing, handleDiscardAndLeave } =
        useFormDraftGuard<OrganizationFormData>({
            draftKey,
            isDirty,
            currentValues: draftValues,
            defaultValues: DEFAULT_FORM,
            onRestoreDraft: (draft) => {
                const restored = { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...draft };
                setForm(restored);
                methods.reset(restored);
                setIsDirty(true);
                setToast({ open: true, message: 'Unsaved draft restored from your previous session.', severity: 'info' });
            },
            enabled: effectiveMode !== 'view' && recordLoaded,
            navigate: (href) => router.push(href),
            onDiscard: () => {
                const baseline = baselineRef.current;
                setForm(baseline);
                methods.reset(baseline);
                setIsDirty(false);
                setActiveTab('overview');
            },
        });

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Organizations', href: ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS },
        { label: mode !== 'create' ? (form.organizationName ? `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'}: ${form.organizationName}` : `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'} Organization`) : 'Create & Edit View' },
    ];

    // After a validation-driven tab switch, focus the field once the new tab has rendered.
    useEffect(() => {
        const field = pendingFocusField.current;
        if (!field) return;
        pendingFocusField.current = null;
        const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => focusFormField(field));
        return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    }, [activeTab]);

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!organizationId) return;
        let active = true;
        organizationService
            .getById(organizationId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) {
                    const normalized: OrganizationFormData = normalizeAddressFields<OrganizationFormData>({
                        ...found,
                        accountStatus: found.accountStatus === 'Inactive' ? 'Inactive' : 'Active',
                        billingAddress: found.billingAddress || found.billingStreet || '',
                        shippingAddress: found.shippingAddress || found.shippingStreet || '',
                        gstNo: found.gstNo || found.gstNumber || '',
                        // Mailing name always mirrors the organization name; older records may lack a trade name.
                        mailingName: found.organizationName,
                        tradeName: found.tradeName || found.organizationName,
                    }, ORGANIZATION_ADDRESS_PAIRS);
                    setAudit({
                        createdAt: found.createdAt,
                        createdBy: found.createdBy,
                        updatedAt: found.updatedAt,
                    });
                    baselineRef.current = { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...normalized };
                    setPersistedStatus(normalized.accountStatus);
                    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...normalized }));
                    methods.reset(normalized);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {})
            .finally(() => {
                if (active) setRecordLoaded(true);
            });
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [organizationId, methods]);

    // ── Field updaters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const set = useCallback(
        <K extends keyof OrganizationFormData>(key: K, value: OrganizationFormData[K]) => {
            setForm((prev) => {
                const next = { ...prev, [key]: value };
                if (next.copyAddressFromBilling) {
                    if (key === 'billingStreet' || key === 'billingAddress') {
                        next.shippingStreet = value as string;
                        next.shippingAddress = value as string;
                    }
                    if (key === 'billingCity') next.shippingCity = value as string;
                    if (key === 'billingState') next.shippingState = value as string;
                    if (key === 'billingPostalCode') next.shippingPostalCode = value as string;
                    if (key === 'billingCountry') next.shippingCountry = value as string;
                }
                return next;
            });
            methods.setValue(key as Path<OrganizationFormData>, value as never, {
                shouldDirty: true,
                shouldValidate: true,
            });
            setIsDirty(true);
        },
        [methods]
    );

    const handleCopyAddressToggle = (checked: boolean) => {
        const billingAddr = form.billingAddress || form.billingStreet || '';
        setForm((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            copyAddressFromBilling: checked,
            ...(checked
                ? {
                      shippingStreet: billingAddr,
                      shippingAddress: billingAddr,
                      shippingCity: prev.billingCity || '',
                      shippingState: prev.billingState || '',
                      shippingPostalCode: prev.billingPostalCode || '',
                      shippingCountry: prev.billingCountry || 'IN',
                  }
                : {}),
        }));
        methods.setValue('copyAddressFromBilling', checked, { shouldDirty: true });
        if (checked) {
            methods.setValue('shippingAddress', billingAddr, { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingStreet', billingAddr, { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingCity', form.billingCity || '', { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingState', form.billingState || '', { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingPostalCode', form.billingPostalCode || '', { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingCountry', form.billingCountry || 'IN', { shouldDirty: true });
        }
        setIsDirty(true);
    };

    // ── Calculation of completion progress ────────────────────────────────────
    const progressCount = useMemo(() => {
        let count = 0;
        if (form.organizationName.trim()) count++;
        if (form.natureOfBusiness) count++;
        if (form.accountStatus) count++;
        if (form.typeOfEntity) count++;
        if (form.customerType) count++;
        if (form.sapCodeTallyId.trim()) count++;
        if (form.sourceOfLead) count++;
        if (form.tradeName?.trim()) count++;
        if (form.annualTurnover) count++;
        if (form.description.trim()) count++;
        return Math.min(count, 10);
    }, [form]);

    // ── Submit logic with Zod Validation ──────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSubmit = async (redirectAfter: boolean) => {
        if (isLocked) return;
        const currentData = { ...form, ...methods.getValues() };
        // Mailing name is not editable: it is always the organization name.
        currentData.mailingName = currentData.organizationName;
        if (!currentData.billingAddress && currentData.billingStreet) {
            currentData.billingAddress = currentData.billingStreet;
        }
        if (!currentData.billingStreet && currentData.billingAddress) {
            currentData.billingStreet = currentData.billingAddress;
        }
        if (!currentData.shippingAddress && currentData.shippingStreet) {
            currentData.shippingAddress = currentData.shippingStreet;
        }
        if (!currentData.shippingStreet && currentData.shippingAddress) {
            currentData.shippingStreet = currentData.shippingAddress;
        }
        if (!currentData.gstNo && currentData.gstNumber) {
            currentData.gstNo = currentData.gstNumber;
        }
        if (!currentData.gstNumber && currentData.gstNo) {
            currentData.gstNumber = currentData.gstNo;
        }

        const validation = validateWithToast(organizationFormSchema, currentData);
        if (!validation.success) {
            setToast({ open: true, message: validation.error, severity: 'error' });
            const { fieldName } = validation;
            if (fieldName) {
                const targetTab = FIELD_TAB_MAP[fieldName];
                if (targetTab && targetTab !== activeTab) {
                    pendingFocusField.current = fieldName;
                    setActiveTab(targetTab);
                } else {
                    focusFormField(fieldName);
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        setSubmitting(true);
        try {
            if (mode === 'create') {
                await organizationService.create(currentData as OrganizationFormData);
                clearDraft();
                setIsDirty(false);
                setToast({ open: true, message: 'Organization created successfully!', severity: 'success' });
                if (redirectAfter) {
                    setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS), 800);
                } else {
                    setForm(DEFAULT_FORM);
                    methods.reset(DEFAULT_FORM);
                    setIsDirty(false);
                }
            } else if (mode === 'edit' && organizationId) {
                await organizationService.update(organizationId, currentData as OrganizationFormData);
                clearDraft();
                setIsDirty(false);
                setToast({ open: true, message: 'Organization updated successfully!', severity: 'success' });
                setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS), 800);
            }
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
            setToast({ open: true, message, severity: 'error' });
        } finally {
            setSubmitting(false);
        }
    };

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        confirmDiscard(() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS));
    };

    // ─── Tabs Configuration (derived from ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS) ───────────────
    const tabs = useMemo(() => [
        {
            ...ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[0],
            badge: `${progressCount}/10 done`,
        },
        {
            ...ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[1],
            sublabel: form.billingCity || form.shippingCity ? '(Configured)' : '(3 Locs)',
        },
        ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[2],
        ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[3],
    ], [progressCount, form.billingCity, form.shippingCity]);

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={tabs}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as TabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={effectiveMode === 'view' ? () => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(organizationId!)) : () => handleSubmit(true)}
                recordView={{
                    title: form.organizationName,
                    subtitle: [form.tradeName, [form.billingCity, form.billingState].filter(Boolean).join(', ')]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(' • '),
                    avatarIcon: <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 28 }} />,
                    verified: form.accountVerified,
                    statusLabel: form.accountStatus || undefined,
                    statusColor: form.accountStatus === 'Inactive' ? '#64748b' : '#16a34a',
                    editHref: organizationId ? ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(organizationId) : undefined,
                    editLabel: 'Edit Organization',
                    editDisabled: isLocked,
                    editDisabledTooltip: 'Only Admins can edit inactive organizations',
                    backHref: ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS,
                    audit,
                }}
                saveDisabled={isLocked}
                saveDisabledTooltip="Only Admins can edit inactive organizations"
                banner={
                    isLocked ? (
                        <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: '8px' }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>This organization is Inactive</Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <strong>Reason:</strong> {form.inactivityReason || 'No reason specified'}
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.5 }}>
                                This record is locked. Only users with the <strong>Admin</strong> role can edit or reactivate this account.
                            </Typography>
                        </Alert>
                    ) : isInactive ? (
                        <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: '8px' }}>
                            <strong>Inactive Organization (Admin Override):</strong> Reason: {form.inactivityReason || 'N/A'}. You have administrative privileges to edit or reactivate this organization.
                        </Alert>
                    ) : undefined
                }
                submitting={submitting}
                saveLabel={effectiveMode === 'view' ? 'Edit Organization' : mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Organization' : 'Save Organization'}
                cancelLabel={effectiveMode === 'view' ? 'Back' : 'Cancel'}
                mode={effectiveMode}
                disableContentPadding
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
                    />
                }
            >
                <UnsavedChangesModal
                    open={discardModalOpen}
                    onKeepEditing={handleKeepEditing}
                    onDiscardAndLeave={handleDiscardAndLeave}
                    description="You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they will be discarded."
                />

                {/* ── Tab Content Panels ────────────────────────────────────── */}
                {activeTab === 'overview' && (
                    <OverviewTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                    />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'address' && (
                    <AddressTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                        handleCopyAddressToggle={handleCopyAddressToggle}
                    />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'tax_bank' && (
                    <TaxBankTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                    />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'partner_licensing' && (
                    <PartnerLicensingTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                    />
                )}

            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

    Button,

const getNatureBadgeStyle = (nature: string = '') => {
    const n = nature.toLowerCase();
    if (n.includes('education')) return { backgroundColor: '#f3e8ff', color: '#7e22ce', border: '1px solid #d8b4fe' };
    if (n.includes('construction')) return { backgroundColor: '#fff7ed', color: '#c2410c', border: '1px solid #fed7aa' };
    if (n.includes('distributor') || n.includes('trading') || n.includes('wholesale')) return { backgroundColor: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '1px solid #bfdbfe' };
    if (n.includes('transportation') || n.includes('logistics')) return { backgroundColor: '#ecfeff', color: '#0e7490', border: '1px solid #a5f3fc' };
    if (n.includes('consulting')) return { backgroundColor: '#eef2ff', color: '#4338ca', border: '1px solid #c7d2fe' };
    if (n.includes('it') || n.includes('software')) return { backgroundColor: '#f0f9ff', color: '#0284c7', border: '1px solid #bae6fd' };
    if (n.includes('manufacturing')) return { backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', border: '1px solid #a7f3d0' };
    if (n.includes('healthcare')) return { backgroundColor: '#fff1f2', color: '#be123c', border: '1px solid #fecdd3' };
    if (n.includes('retail')) return { backgroundColor: '#fefce8', color: '#a16207', border: '1px solid #fef08a' };
    return { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', color: '#475569', border: '1px solid #cbd5e1' };
};

const formatNatureLabel = (nature: string = '') => {
    if (nature.includes('Distributor / Trading / Wholesale')) return 'Distributor/Trading';
    return nature;
};


/** Stable empty list while the first page loads (keeps memoized filters from recomputing). */
const NO_RECORDS: ExtendedOrganization[] = [];
export function OrganizationsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const isAdmin = user?.role?.toLowerCase() === 'admin';

    // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const { data: organizations = NO_RECORDS, refetch } = useOrganizations();
    const bulkDeleteMutation = useBulkDeleteOrganizations();
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<FilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState<number>(25);
    const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<SortField>('organizationName');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');

    // Detail View Side Drawer & Three-Panel LIFO Stack State
    // Tracked by id so the drawer always shows the cached copy and closes if the organization is deleted.
    const [drawerOrgId, setDrawerOrgId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const selectedDrawerOrg = useMemo(
        () => (drawerOrgId ? organizations.find((o) => o.id === drawerOrgId) ?? null : null),
        [organizations, drawerOrgId]
    );
    const [activeRelatedModule, setActiveRelatedModule] = useState<string>('contacts');
    const [secondaryDrawerEntity, setSecondaryDrawerEntity] = useState<{
        type: string;
        data: Record<string, unknown>;
    } | null>(null);
    const [isLeftSidebarCollapsed, setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: 'success' | 'info' | 'error' }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const closeThreePanelView = useCallback(() => {
        // Dismiss the three-panel view and return to the normal master table.
        // CommonMasterView resets its shared drawer-collapse state when isDrawerOpen becomes false.
        setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);
        setDrawerOrgId(null);
        setActiveRelatedModule('contacts');
    }, []);

    const relatedModules = useRelatedModulesForEntity('organization', selectedDrawerOrg, setActiveRelatedModule);

    const activeModuleMeta = useMemo(
        () => relatedModules.find((m) => m.id === activeRelatedModule) || relatedModules[0],
        [relatedModules, activeRelatedModule]
    );

    const renderSecondaryDrawer = () => {
        if (!secondaryDrawerEntity) return null;
        const { type, data } = secondaryDrawerEntity;
        const closeSecondary = () => setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);

        if (type === 'contacts') {
            return (
                <ContactDetailDrawer
                    contact={data as unknown as Contact}
                    open
                    onClose={closeSecondary}
                />
            );
        }
        if (type === 'leads') {
            return (
                <LeadDetailDrawer
                    lead={data as unknown as Lead}
                    open
                    onClose={closeSecondary}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(id))}
                />
            );
        }
        if (type === 'opportunities') {
            return (
                <OpportunityDetailDrawer
                    opportunity={data as unknown as Opportunity}
                    open
                    onClose={closeSecondary}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(id))}
                />
            );
        }
        if (type === 'quotations') {
            return (
                <QuotationDetailDrawer
                    quotation={data as unknown as Quotation}
                    open
                    onClose={closeSecondary}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(id))}
                />
            );
        }
        if (type === 'tickets') {
            return (
                <TicketDetailDrawer
                    ticket={data as unknown as Ticket}
                    open
                    onClose={closeSecondary}
                />
            );
        }
        if (type === 'products') {
            return (
                <ProductDetailDrawer
                    product={data as unknown as Product}
                    open
                    onClose={closeSecondary}
                />
            );
        }

        const recordTitle = String(
            data.subject ||
                data.name ||
                data.contractTitle ||
                data.partnerName ||
                data.ticketNumber ||
                activeModuleMeta?.label ||
                'Related Record'
        );

        const detailFields = Object.entries(data)
            .filter(([key]) => key !== 'id')
            .map(([key, val]) => ({
                label: key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').replace(/^./, (s) => s.toUpperCase()),
                value: String(val ?? '-'),
            }));

        return (
            <EntityDetailDrawer
                open
                onClose={closeSecondary}
                title={recordTitle}
                subtitle={`${activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Module'} • ${selectedDrawerOrg?.organizationName || ''}`}
                statusText="Linked Record Verified"
                tabs={[
                    {
                        id: 'overview',
                        label: 'Overview',
                        icon: <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                        content: (
                            <DrawerSectionCard title={`${activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Record'} Details`}>
                                <DrawerMetricGrid items={detailFields} />
                            </DrawerSectionCard>
                        ),
                    },
                ]}
            />
        );
    };

    const [importOpen, setImportOpen] = useState(false);

    // ── Filter & Search Logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredOrganizations = useMemo(() => {
        return organizations.filter((org) => {
            if (activeTab === 'recent' && !org.isRecentlyViewed) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'my' && !org.isMyAccount) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'distributor' && !org.natureOfBusiness?.toLowerCase().includes('distributor')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'enduser' && org.customerType !== 'End User') return false;

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                return (
                    org.organizationName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.natureOfBusiness?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.customerType?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.billingCity?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.billingState?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.billingStreet?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.gstNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
                );
            }
            return true;
        });
    }, [organizations, activeTab, searchQuery]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedOrganizations = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredOrganizations].sort((a, b) => {
            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredOrganizations, sortField, sortOrder]);

    // ── Pagination Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const totalRecords = sortedOrganizations.length;
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalRecords / rowsPerPage));
    const paginatedOrganizations = useMemo(() => {
        const start = (currentPage - 1) * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedOrganizations.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedOrganizations, currentPage, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleSort = (field: SortField) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    // ── Selection Logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const isAllPageSelected = paginatedOrganizations.length > 0 && paginatedOrganizations.every((o) => selectedIds.has(o.id));
    const isSomePageSelected = paginatedOrganizations.some((o) => selectedIds.has(o.id)) && !isAllPageSelected;

    const toggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        const next = new Set(selectedIds);
        if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
        else next.add(id);
        setSelectedIds(next);
    };

    const toggleSelectAll = () => {
        const next = new Set(selectedIds);
        if (isAllPageSelected) {
            paginatedOrganizations.forEach((o) => next.delete(o.id));
        } else {
            paginatedOrganizations.forEach((o) => next.add(o.id));
        }
        setSelectedIds(next);
    };

    // ── Export CSV ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleExport = (onlySelected = false) => {
        const recordsToExport = onlySelected
            ? organizations.filter((o) => selectedIds.has(o.id))
            : filteredOrganizations;

        if (recordsToExport.length === 0) {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'No organizations to export.', severity: 'info' });
            return;
        }

        const headers = ['Account Code', 'Organization Name', 'Nature of Business', 'Customer Type', 'Status', 'Billing Street', 'City', 'State', 'GST Number'];
        const rows = recordsToExport.map((o) => [
            o.accountCode,
            `"${o.organizationName.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
            `"${o.natureOfBusiness || ''}"`,
            `"${o.customerType || ''}"`,
            `"${o.accountStatus || ''}"`,
            `"${(o.billingStreet || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
            `"${o.billingCity || ''}"`,
            `"${o.billingState || ''}"`,
            `"${o.gstNumber || ''}"`,
        ]);

        const csvContent = 'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(','))].join('\n');
        const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
        link.setAttribute('download', `organizations_export_${Date.now()}.csv`);
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);

        setToast({ open: true, message: `Exported ${recordsToExport.length} organizations to CSV.`, severity: 'success' });
    };

    // ── Bulk Actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleBulkAction = async (action: 'active' | 'inactive' | 'delete' | 'export') => {
        if (selectedIds.size === 0) {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Please select records to perform bulk action.', severity: 'info' });
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'delete') {
            const count = selectedIds.size;
            if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${count} selected organization(s)?`)) return;
            try {
                await bulkDeleteMutation.mutateAsync(Array.from(selectedIds));
                if (drawerOrgId && selectedIds.has(drawerOrgId)) {
                    closeThreePanelView();
                }
                setSelectedIds(new Set());
                setToast({ open: true, message: `${count} organizations deleted.`, severity: 'success' });
            } catch {
                setToast({ open: true, message: 'Failed to delete organizations.', severity: 'error' });
            }
        } else if (action === 'active' || action === 'inactive') {
            const status = action === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Inactive';
            try {
                // Saves through the service, whose sync notification refreshes the organizations cache.
                const updated = await organizationService.updateStatusBulk(selectedIds, status);
                setToast({ open: true, message: `${updated.length} organizations updated to ${status}.`, severity: 'success' });
            } catch (err) {
                setToast({
                    open: true,
                    message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to update organization status.',
                    severity: 'error',
                });
            }
        } else if (action === 'export') {
            handleExport(true);
        }
    };

    // ── Filter Pills Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<FilterTab>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Organizations',
                count: organizations.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'recent',
                label: 'Recently Viewed',
                icon: <HistoryIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#94a3b8' }} />,
                count: organizations.filter((o) => o.isRecentlyViewed).length,
            },
            {
                id: 'my',
                label: 'My Accounts',
                icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#94a3b8' }} />,
            },
            {
                id: 'distributor',
                label: 'Distributor/Trading',
                dotColor: '#2563eb',
            },
            {
                id: 'enduser',
                label: 'End User',
                dotColor: '#10b981',
            },
        ],
        [organizations]
    );

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<ExtendedOrganization>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                category: 'basic',
                locked: true,
                label: 'ORGANIZATION NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 240,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.2 }}>
                        <Box
                            sx={{
                                width: 28,
                                height: 28,
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                                backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                display: 'flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                justifyContent: 'center',
                                color: '#2563eb',
                                flexShrink: 0,
                            }}
                        >
                            <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </Box>
                        <Box>
                            <RecordLink
                                href={ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_DETAIL(org.id)}
                                onOpen={() => setDrawerOrgId(org.id)}
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    lineHeight: 1.3,
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {org.organizationName}
                            </RecordLink>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mt: 0.2 }}>
                                {org.tradeName && org.tradeName !== org.organizationName && (
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{org.tradeName}</Typography>
                                )}
                                {org.accountVerified && (
                                    <Box
                                        component="span"
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                            fontWeight: 700,
                                            color: '#059669',
                                            backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5',
                                            px: 0.6,
                                            py: 0.1,
                                            borderRadius: '4px',
                                            border: '1px solid #a7f3d0',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        Verified
                                    </Box>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'natureOfBusiness',
                category: 'basic',
                label: 'NATURE OF BUSINESS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (org) => {
                    const badge = getNatureBadgeStyle(org.natureOfBusiness);
                    return (
                        <Box
                            component="span"
                            sx={{
                                display: 'inline-block',
                                px: 1,
                                py: 0.3,
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                ...badge,
                            }}
                        >
                            {formatNatureLabel(org.natureOfBusiness)}
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'customerType',
                category: 'basic',
                label: 'CUSTOMER TYPE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Box
                        component="span"
                        sx={{
                            display: 'inline-block',
                            px: 1,
                            py: 0.25,
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                            color: '#334155',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        }}
                    >
                        {org.customerType}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'accountStatus',
                category: 'basic',
                label: 'STATUS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 110,
                render: (org) => {
                    const isActive = org.accountStatus === 'Active';
                    return (
                        <Box
                            component="span"
                            sx={{
                                display: 'inline-flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                gap: 0.6,
                                px: 0.9,
                                py: 0.25,
                                borderRadius: '12px',
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                backgroundColor: isActive ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef3c7',
                                color: isActive ? '#059669' : '#d97706',
                                border: isActive ? '1px solid #a7f3d0' : '1px solid #fde68a',
                            }}
                        >
                            <Box
                                component="span"
                                sx={{
                                    width: 6,
                                    height: 6,
                                    borderRadius: '50%',
                                    backgroundColor: isActive ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b',
                                }}
                            />
                            {org.accountStatus}
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'billingStreet',
                category: 'more',
                label: 'BILLING STREET',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', maxWidth: 200 }}>
                        {org.billingStreet || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'billingCity',
                category: 'more',
                label: 'BILLING CITY',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                        {org.billingCity || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'billingState',
                category: 'more',
                label: 'BILLING STATE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                        {org.billingState || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'annualTurnover',
                category: 'more',
                label: 'ANNUAL TURNOVER',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#334155' }}>
                        {org.annualTurnover || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedUser',
                category: 'more',
                label: 'ASSIGNED USER',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {org.assignedUser || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    const headerActions = (
        <MasterHeaderActions
            onRefresh={async () => {
                const { isError } = await refetch();
                setToast(
                    isError
                        ? { open: true, message: 'Failed to refresh organizations.', severity: 'error' }
                        : { open: true, message: 'Organizations refreshed.', severity: 'info' }
                );
            }}
            onNewClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_NEW)}
            newButtonLabel="New Organization"
            onImportClick={() => setImportOpen(true)}
        >
            <Button
                variant="outlined"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<FileDownloadOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                onClick={() => handleExport(false)}
                sx={outlinedHeaderButtonSx}
            >
                Export
            </Button>
        </MasterHeaderActions>
    );

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<ExtendedOrganization, FilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                },
                variant: 'pill',
            }}
            tableId="organizations"
            headerActions={headerActions}
            searchConfig={{
                variant: 'extended',
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search within table...',
                isAllPageSelected,
                isSomePageSelected,
                onToggleSelectAll: toggleSelectAll,
                onSelectAllMatching: () => setSelectedIds(new Set(organizations.map((o) => o.id))),
                onSelectVisible: () => {
                    const next = new Set(selectedIds);
                    paginatedOrganizations.forEach((o) => next.add(o.id));
                    setSelectedIds(next);
                },
                onDeselectAll: () => setSelectedIds(new Set()),
                totalRecords,
                displayTotalRecords: totalRecords.toLocaleString('en-IN'),
                currentPage,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalPages,
                onPageChange: setCurrentPage,
                bulkActionItems: [
                    { id: 'active', label: 'Mark as Active', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('active') },
                    { id: 'inactive', label: 'Mark as Inactive', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('inactive') },
                    { id: 'export', label: 'Export Selected to CSV', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('export') },
                    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete Selected', color: 'error', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('delete') },
                ],
            }}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedOrganizations}
            keyExtractor={(org) => org.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={toggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={toggleSelectAll}
            isAllSelected={isAllPageSelected}
            isIndeterminate={isSomePageSelected}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={(field) => handleSort(field as SortField)}
            onView={(org) => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_DETAIL(org.id))}
            getEditHref={(org) =>
                org.accountStatus === 'Inactive' && !isAdmin
                    ? ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_DETAIL(org.id)
                    : ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(org.id)
            }
            onEdit={(org) => {
                if (org.accountStatus === 'Inactive' && !isAdmin) {
                    setToast({ open: true, message: 'This organization is inactive. Only an Admin can edit it.', severity: 'info' });
                }
            }}
            onRowClick={(org) => setDrawerOrgId(org.id)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerOrg?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Organization"
            emptyTitle="No organizations found"
            emptyDescription="No organizations match your current search and filter criteria."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Organization"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_NEW)}
            pagination={{
                variant: 'full',
                page: currentPage - 1,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: totalRecords,
                displayTotalCount: totalRecords.toLocaleString('en-IN'),
                entityLabel: 'Organizations',
                pageSizeOptions: [10, 25, 50, 100],
                onPageChange: (pageZeroBased) => setCurrentPage(pageZeroBased + 1),
                onRowsPerPageChange: (rows) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(rows);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                },
            }}
            relatedSidebar={
                <RelatedModulesSidebar
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOrg)}
                    logoSrc="/images/NIPL-Updated-Logo-Large.png"
                    modules={relatedModules}
                    activeModuleId={activeRelatedModule}
                    onModuleSelect={(moduleId) => setActiveRelatedModule(moduleId)}
                    collapsed={isLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                    onToggleCollapse={setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                />
            }
            relatedRecordsTable={
                <RelatedRecordsTableView
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOrg)}
                    moduleId={activeRelatedModule}
                    moduleTitle={activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Related Records'}
                    parentEntityTitle={selectedDrawerOrg?.organizationName || ''}
                    parentRecordId={selectedDrawerOrg?.id}
                    entityData={selectedDrawerOrg}
                    entityType="organization"
                    leftOffset={isLeftSidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 260}
                    rightOffset={580}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onRowClick={(clickedRow, modId) =>
                        setSecondaryDrawerEntity({ type: modId, data: clickedRow })
                    }
                />
            }
            drawer={
                <OrganizationDetailDrawer
                    organization={selectedDrawerOrg}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOrg)}
                    hideBackdrop={true}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(id))}
                />
            }
            secondaryDrawer={renderSecondaryDrawer()}
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerOrg)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        >
            <DataImportModal
                open={importOpen}
                entity="organizations"
                onClose={() => setImportOpen(false)}
                onImported={(count) => {
                    setToast({ open: true, message: `Successfully imported ${count} organization${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}!`, severity: 'success' });
                }}
            />
        </CommonMasterView>
    );
}

const DEFAULT_QUICK_FORM = {

    natureOfBusiness: 'Distributor / Trading / Wholesale',
    customerType: 'End User',
    gstNumber: '',
    billingStreet: '',
    billingCity: '',
    billingState: 'Delhi',
    assignedUser: 'mittal.sharma (You)',
    accountStatus: 'Active',

export function QuickCreateDrawer({ open, onClose, onSave }: QuickCreateDrawerProps) {
    const [formData, setFormData] = useState(DEFAULT_QUICK_FORM);
    const [verifyingGst, setVerifyingGst] = useState(false);
    const [gstVerified, setGstVerified] = useState(false);
    const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');

    const handleChange = (field: string, value: string) => {
        setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
        if (field === 'gstNumber') {
            setGstVerified(false);
        }
        if (errorMsg) setErrorMsg('');
    };

    const handleVerifyGst = () => {
        if (!formData.gstNumber) {
            setErrorMsg('Please enter a GST number to verify.');
            return;
        }
        setVerifyingGst(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
            setVerifyingGst(false);
            setGstVerified(true);
        }, 600);
    };

    const handleSave = (addAnother = false) => {
        if (!formData.organizationName.trim()) {
            setErrorMsg('Organization Name is required.');
            return;
        }

        const newOrg: ExtendedOrganization = {
            id: `org-${Date.now()}`,
            accountCode: `ORG-${Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000)}`,
            organizationName: formData.organizationName.trim(),
            mailingName: formData.organizationName.trim(),
            natureOfBusiness: formData.natureOfBusiness as ExtendedOrganization['natureOfBusiness'],
            customerType: formData.customerType as ExtendedOrganization['customerType'],
            accountStatus: formData.accountStatus as ExtendedOrganization['accountStatus'],
            typeOfEntity: 'Private Limited',
            sapCodeTallyId: `TALLY-${formData.organizationName.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()}-${Math.floor(10 + Math.random() * 90)}`,
            showroomBranchCode: 'DEL-HQ',
            sourceOfLead: 'Direct Customer',
            memberOfParentCorp: '',
            numberOfEmployees: '21 To 50',
            annualTurnover: '5 crore to 10 crore',
            description: 'Quick created enterprise account.',
            accountVerified: true,
            provideSupport: 'Yes',
            billingStreet: formData.billingStreet,
            billingCity: formData.billingCity,
            billingState: formData.billingState,
            billingPostalCode: '110001',
            billingCountry: DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE,
            registrationType: 'Registered',
            gstNumber: formData.gstNumber.toUpperCase(),
            panNumber: formData.gstNumber ? formData.gstNumber.substring(2, 12).toUpperCase() : '',
            assignedUser: formData.assignedUser,
            isRecentlyViewed: true,
            isMyAccount: true,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            createdBy: 'mittal.sharma',
        };

        onSave(newOrg, addAnother);

        if (addAnother) {
            setFormData(DEFAULT_QUICK_FORM);
            setGstVerified(false);
        } else {
            onClose();
        }
    };

    return (
        <Drawer
            anchor="right"
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            slotProps={{
                paper: {
                    sx: {
                        width: { xs: '100vw', sm: 540, md: 580 },

                    backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                    color: '#fff',
                    px: 3,
                    py: 2.2,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                }}
            >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            width: 32,
                            height: 32,
                            borderRadius: '8px',
                            backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'center',
                            color: '#60a5fa',
                        }}
                    >
                        <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </Box>
                    <Box>
                        <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.98rem', color: '#fff' }}>
                            Quick Create Organization
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.74rem' }}>
                            Add an account directly to the master directory
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                </Box>
                <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={onClose}
                    sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', '&:hover': { color: '#fff' } }}
                >
                    <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
            </Box>

            {/* ── Drawer Body ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box sx={{ p: 3, flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                {errorMsg && (
                    <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: '8px', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                        {errorMsg}
                    </Alert>
                )}

                {/* Quick create is always a fresh record, even if opened from a page rendered in view mode. */}
                <FormModeProvider mode="create">
                    <FormGrid columns={{ sm: 2 }} sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                        <FormGridItem span="full">

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Typography, TextField, FormControlLabel, Checkbox } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import LocalShippingOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalShippingOutlined';

import {
    FIELD_MAX_LENGTH,
    FormField,
    FormGrid,
    FormGridItem,
    ReadOnlyField,
    SectionLabel,
    fieldSx,
    CountrySelectField,
    StateRegionField,
    CityAutocompleteField,
    PostalCodeField,
    shouldResetStateForCountry,
    countryIso2OrDefault,
} from '@/components/forms';
import { getSubdivisionsByCountry } from '@/data/addressMaster';
import { formatAddressLine } from '@/utils/address';
import type { OrganizationFormData } from '@/types/organization.types';
import { useFormMode } from '@/context/FormModeContext';

export interface AddressTabProps {
    form: OrganizationFormData;
    set: <K extends keyof OrganizationFormData>(key: K, value: OrganizationFormData[K]) => void;
    handleCopyAddressToggle: (checked: boolean) => void;
}

type Side = 'billing' | 'shipping';

/** Country + State, City + PIN side by side within each address column; one column on phones. */
const ADDRESS_GRID_COLUMNS = { sm: 2 };

/** Field keys per column; street is stored in both `*Street` and `*Address`, which the form keeps in sync. */
const KEYS = {
    billing: {
        street: 'billingStreet',
        address: 'billingAddress',
        country: 'billingCountry',
        state: 'billingState',
        city: 'billingCity',
        postalCode: 'billingPostalCode',
    },
    shipping: {
        street: 'shippingStreet',
        address: 'shippingAddress',
        country: 'shippingCountry',
        state: 'shippingState',
        city: 'shippingCity',
        postalCode: 'shippingPostalCode',
    },
} as const satisfies Record<Side, Record<string, keyof OrganizationFormData>>;

export function AddressTab({ form, set, handleCopyAddressToggle }: AddressTabProps) {
    const isView = useFormMode().mode === 'view';
    const copying = Boolean(form.copyAddressFromBilling);

    const setStreet = (side: Side, value: string) => {
        set(KEYS[side].street, value);
        set(KEYS[side].address, value);
    };

    // Changing country clears a state that doesn't belong to the new country.
    const setCountry = (side: Side, iso2: string) => {
        set(KEYS[side].country, iso2);
        if (shouldResetStateForCountry(form[KEYS[side].state], iso2)) set(KEYS[side].state, '');
    };

    const renderColumn = (side: Side) => {
        const k = KEYS[side];
        const isBilling = side === 'billing';
        const locked = !isBilling && copying;
        const country = form[k.country] || '';
        const hasStates = getSubdivisionsByCountry(countryIso2OrDefault(country)).length > 0;

        return (
            <FormGrid columns={ADDRESS_GRID_COLUMNS}>
                <CountrySelectField
                    name={k.country}
                    value={country}
                    onChange={(iso2) => setCountry(side, iso2)}
                    required={isBilling}
                    disabled={locked}
                />

                <StateRegionField
                    name={k.state}
                    value={form[k.state] || ''}
                    onChange={(v) => set(k.state, v)}
                    countryValue={country}
                    required={isBilling && hasStates}
                    disabled={locked}
                />

                <CityAutocompleteField
                    name={k.city}
                    value={form[k.city] || ''}
                    onChange={(v) => set(k.city, v)}
                    countryValue={country}
                    required={isBilling}
                    disabled={locked}
                />

                <PostalCodeField
                    name={k.postalCode}
                    value={form[k.postalCode] || ''}
                    onChange={(v) => set(k.postalCode, v)}
                    countryValue={country}
                    required={isBilling}
                    disabled={locked}
                />

                <FormGridItem span="full">
                    <FormField
                        name={k.address}
                        label="Street"
                        size="lg"
                        required={isBilling}
                        hint={isBilling ? 'Registered office location' : 'Dispatch & delivery location'}
                    >
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            multiline
                            minRows={3}
                            maxRows={5}
                            size="small"
                            placeholder={isBilling ? 'Enter a location' : 'Enter delivery location'}
                            value={form[k.street] || form[k.address] || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setStreet(side, e.target.value)}
                            disabled={locked}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.address } }}
                        />
                    </FormField>
                </FormGridItem>
            </FormGrid>
        );
    };

    if (isView) {
        const line = (side: Side) => {
            const k = KEYS[side];
            return formatAddressLine({
                street: form[k.street] || form[k.address],
                city: form[k.city],
                state: form[k.state],
                postalCode: form[k.postalCode],
                country: form[k.country],
            });
        };
        const billing = line('billing');
        const shipping = line('shipping');
        return (
            <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 }, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' }, gap: 3.5 }}>
                {billing && (
                    <Box>
                        <SectionLabel icon={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Billing Address" />
                        <ReadOnlyField label="Address" value={billing} copyable />
                    </Box>
                )}
                {shipping && (
                    <Box>
                        <SectionLabel icon={<LocalShippingOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Shipping Address" />
                        <ReadOnlyField label="Address" value={shipping} copyable />
                    </Box>
                )}
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: 3.5,
                }}
            >
                {/* ── LEFT COLUMN: Billing Address ─────────────────── */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                    <SectionLabel icon={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Billing Address" />
                    {renderColumn('billing')}
                </Box>

                {/* ── RIGHT COLUMN: Shipping Address ────────────────── */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            flexWrap: 'wrap',
                            gap: 1,
                        }}
                    >
                        <SectionLabel icon={<LocalShippingOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Shipping Address" />
                        {!isView && (
                            <FormControlLabel
                                control={
                                    <Checkbox
                                        size="small"
                                        checked={copying}
                                        onChange={(e) => handleCopyAddressToggle(e.target.checked)}
                                        sx={{ color: '#2563EB', '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563EB' }, p: 0.5 }}
                                    />
                                }
                                label={
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#374151', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                                        Copy address from left
                                    </Typography>
                                }
                                sx={{ m: 0 }}
                            />
                        )}
                    </Box>
                    {renderColumn('shipping')}
                </Box>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

import { OrganizationLookupModal } from '@/components/common/lookup';

const INACTIVITY_REASONS = [

const DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH = FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.organizationDescription;

export interface OverviewTabProps {

function OverviewTabInner({
    form,
