}: OverviewTabProps) {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();

    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' }) ?? form?.organizationName ?? '';
    const tradeName = useWatch({ control, name: 'tradeName' }) ?? form?.tradeName ?? '';
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const currentAccountStatus = (useWatch({ control, name: 'accountStatus' }) ?? form?.accountStatus ?? 'Active') as AccountStatus;
    const isView = useFormMode().mode === 'view';
    const [pendingInactive, setPendingInactive] = React.useState(false);
    const [orgLookupOpen, setOrgLookupOpen] = React.useState(false);
    const watchedNatureOfBusiness = useWatch({ control, name: 'natureOfBusiness' });
    const watchedTypeOfEntity = useWatch({ control, name: 'typeOfEntity' });
    const watchedCustomerType = useWatch({ control, name: 'customerType' });

    // Sync RHF values with external set callback if provided
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && watchedNatureOfBusiness !== undefined && watchedNatureOfBusiness !== form?.natureOfBusiness) {
            set('natureOfBusiness', watchedNatureOfBusiness as NatureOfBusiness);
        }
    }, [watchedNatureOfBusiness, set, form?.natureOfBusiness]);

    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && watchedTypeOfEntity !== undefined && watchedTypeOfEntity !== form?.typeOfEntity) {
            set('typeOfEntity', watchedTypeOfEntity as TypeOfEntity);
        }
    }, [watchedTypeOfEntity, set, form?.typeOfEntity]);

    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && watchedCustomerType !== undefined && watchedCustomerType !== form?.customerType) {
            set('customerType', watchedCustomerType as CustomerType);
        }
    }, [watchedCustomerType, set, form?.customerType]);

    const handleOrgNameChange = (val: string) => {
        // Trade name keeps following the organization name until the user gives it a value of its own.
        const tradeNameFollows = !tradeName || tradeName === organizationName;
        const opts = { shouldValidate: true, shouldDirty: true } as const;
        setValue('organizationName', val, opts);
        setValue('mailingName', val, opts);
        if (set) {
            set('organizationName', val);
            set('mailingName', val);
        }
        if (tradeNameFollows) {
            setValue('tradeName', val, opts);
            if (set) set('tradeName', val);
        }
    };

    const handleTradeNameChange = (val: string) => {
        setValue('tradeName', val, { shouldValidate: true, shouldDirty: true });
        if (set) set('tradeName', val);
    };

    // Verification is audited: switching on records when and by whom; switching off clears both.
    const handleVerifiedToggle = (checked: boolean) => {
        set('accountVerified', checked);
        set('verifiedAt', checked ? new Date().toISOString() : undefined);
        set('verifiedBy', checked ? user?.username || 'Current User' : undefined);
    };
    const verifiedCaption = form.accountVerified
        ? form.verifiedAt
            ? `${formatDateTime(form.verifiedAt)} by ${form.verifiedBy || 'Admin'}`
            : 'Verified'
        : 'Not verified';

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 }, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 3 }}>
            {/* ── Status strip: verification / support + AMC & Cloud entitlements ── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', lg: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: 2,
                    '&& > *': { mb: 0 },
                }}
            >
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        p: 1.75,
                        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        borderRadius: '10px',
                        backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                        gap: 2,
                    }}
                >
                    {/* Left: Account Verified */}
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            flex: 1,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            pr: 2,
                            borderRight: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        }}
                    >
                        <Box>
                            <Typography
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1e293b',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    lineHeight: 1.3,
                                }}
                            >
                                Account Verified
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                                {verifiedCaption}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {isView ? (
                            <Chip
                                label={form.accountVerified ? 'Verified' : 'Not verified'}
                                size="small"
                                sx={{
                                    height: 24,
                                    fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    cursor: 'default',
                                    color: form.accountVerified ? '#16a34a' : '#64748b',
                                    backgroundColor: form.accountVerified ? '#16a34a1a' : '#64748b1a',
                                }}
                            />
                        ) : (
                        <Switch
                            checked={form.accountVerified}
                            onChange={(e) => handleVerifiedToggle(e.target.checked)}
                            sx={{
                                width: 44,
                                height: 24,
                                p: 0,
                                '& .MuiSwitch-switchBase': {
                                    p: '2px',
                                    '&.Mui-checked': {
                                        transform: 'translateX(20px)',
                                        color: '#fff',
                                        '& + .MuiSwitch-track': {
                                            backgroundColor: '#16a34a',
                                            opacity: 1,
                                            border: 0,
                                        },
                                    },
                                },
                                '& .MuiSwitch-thumb': {
                                    width: 20,
                                    height: 20,
                                    boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                                },
                                '& .MuiSwitch-track': {
                                    borderRadius: 12,
                                    backgroundColor: '#cbd5e1',
                                    opacity: 1,
                                },
                            }}
                        />
                        )}
                    </Box>

                    {/* Right: Provide Support */}
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            flex: 1,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            pl: 1,
                        }}
                    >
                        <Box>
                            <Typography
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1e293b',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    lineHeight: 1.3,
                                }}
                            >
                                Provide Support
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                                Active AMC entitlement
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {isView ? (
                            <Chip
                                label={form.provideSupport}
                                size="small"
                                sx={{
                                    height: 24,
                                    fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    cursor: 'default',
                                    color: form.provideSupport === 'Yes' ? '#16a34a' : '#64748b',
                                    backgroundColor: form.provideSupport === 'Yes' ? '#16a34a1a' : '#64748b1a',
                                }}
                            />
                        ) : (
                        <FormControl size="small" sx={{ minWidth: 84 }}>
                            <Select
                                value={form.provideSupport}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    set('provideSupport', e.target.value as 'Yes' | 'No')
                                }
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    borderRadius: '8px',
                                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                                    height: 34,
                                    '& .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': {
                                        borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                                    },
                                    '&:hover .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': {
                                        borderColor: '#94a3b8',
                                    },
                                }}
                            >
                                <MenuItem value="Yes" sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                                    Yes
                                </MenuItem>
                                <MenuItem value="No" sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                                    No
                                </MenuItem>
                            </Select>
                        </FormControl>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                </Box>

                {/* Active AMC & Cloud entitlements */}
                <RhfToggleGroupCard<OrganizationFormData>
                    items={[
                        { name: 'activeAmc', label: 'Active AMC', caption: 'Annual maintenance contract' },
                        { name: 'activeCloud', label: 'Active Cloud', caption: 'Cloud hosting subscription' },
                    ]}
                    onValueChange={(name, checked) => set(name as 'activeAmc' | 'activeCloud', checked)}
                />
            </Box>

            <FormGrid columns={3}>
                {/* ── Identity ── */}
                <FormField
                    name="organizationName"
                    label="Organization Name"
                    required
                    hint="As per official registration"
                >
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. Mohit Traders Pvt Ltd"
                        value={organizationName}
                        onChange={(e) => handleOrgNameChange(e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{
                            input: {
                                endAdornment: organizationName ? (
                                    <InputAdornment position="end">
                                        <VerifiedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#16a34a' }} />
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ) : undefined,
                            },
                            htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.organizationName },
                        }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="tradeName" label="Trade Name" hint="Defaults to the organization name">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. Mohit Traders"
                        value={tradeName}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTradeNameChange(e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.organizationName } }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                {/* Mailing Name (always equals Organization Name) */}
                <FormField name="mailingName" label="Mailing Name" hint="Printed on tax invoices • follows Organization Name">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        value={organizationName}
                        sx={{ ...fieldSx, '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', color: '#475569' } }}
                        slotProps={{
                            htmlInput: { readOnly: true, tabIndex: -1, 'aria-readonly': true },
                            input: {
                                endAdornment: (
                                    <InputAdornment position="end">
                                        <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ),
                            },
                        }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                {/* ── Classification ── */}
                <RhfSelect<OrganizationFormData>
                    name="natureOfBusiness"
                    label="Nature of Business"
                    placeholder="Select Nature of Business"
                    options={NATURE_OF_BUSINESS}
                    required
                />

                <RhfSelect<OrganizationFormData>
                    name="typeOfEntity"
                    label="Type of Entity"
                    placeholder="Select Type of Entity"
                    options={ENTITY_TYPES}
                    required
                />

                <RhfSelect<OrganizationFormData>
                    name="customerType"
                    label="Customer Type"
                    placeholder="Select Customer Type"
                    options={CUSTOMER_TYPES}
                    required
                />

                {/* ── Status & ERP codes ── */}
                <FormField
                    name="accountStatus"
                    label="Account Status"
                    size="sm"
                    hint={
                        (currentAccountStatus || 'Active') === 'Active' ? (
                            <Chip
                                label="● Active Commercial"
                                size="small"
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                    height: 20,
                                    backgroundColor: '#dcfce7',
                                    color: '#16a34a',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                }}
                            />
                        ) : undefined
                    }
                >
                    <StyledSelect
                        label="Account Status"
                        placeholder="Select Account Status"
                        value={currentAccountStatus || 'Active'}
                        onChange={(v) => {
                            const val = v as AccountStatus;
                            if (val === 'Inactive' && currentAccountStatus !== 'Inactive') {
                                // Defer the change until a reason is collected.
                                setPendingInactive(true);
                                return;
                            }
                            setValue('accountStatus', val, { shouldValidate: true, shouldDirty: true });
                            if (set) set('accountStatus', val);
                            if (val === 'Active') {
                                setValue('inactivityReason', '', { shouldDirty: true });
                                if (set) set('inactivityReason', '');
                            }
                        }}
                        options={ACCOUNT_STATUSES}
                    />
                    <CommonActionModal
                        open={pendingInactive}
                        title="Reason for Inactivity"
                        description="Setting this organization to Inactive will lock the record for non-admin users."
                        reasonLabel="Reason"
                        reasonPlaceholder="Why is this organization being deactivated?"
                        presetReasons={INACTIVITY_REASONS}
                        confirmLabel="Deactivate Organization"
                        confirmColor="warning"
                        onConfirm={(reason) => {
                            setValue('accountStatus', 'Inactive', { shouldValidate: true, shouldDirty: true });
                            setValue('inactivityReason', reason, { shouldDirty: true });
                            if (set) {
                                set('accountStatus', 'Inactive');
                                set('inactivityReason', reason);
                            }
                            setPendingInactive(false);
                        }}
                        onClose={() => setPendingInactive(false)}
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="sapCodeTallyId" label="SAP Code / Tally ID" size="sm" hint="ERP Master Ledger Code">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. SAP-ND-4891"
                        value={form.sapCodeTallyId}
                        onChange={(e) => set('sapCodeTallyId', e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{

                                endAdornment: (
                                    <InputAdornment position="end">
                                        <SwapHorizIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ),
                            },
                            htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortCode },
                        }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="showroomBranchCode" label="Showroom / Branch Code" size="sm" hint="Store Location ID">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. DEL-NORTH-04"
                        value={form.showroomBranchCode}
                        onChange={(e) => set('showroomBranchCode', e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.shortCode } }}
                    />
                </FormField>

                {/* ── Business profile ── */}
                <FormField name="sourceOfLead" label="Source of Lead" size="md">
                    <StyledSelect
                        label="Source of Lead"
                        placeholder="Select Source of Lead"
                        value={form.sourceOfLead}
                        onChange={(v) => set('sourceOfLead', v as SourceOfLead)}
                        options={LEAD_SOURCES}
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="annualTurnover" label="Annual Turnover" size="md">
                    <StyledSelect
                        label="Annual Turnover"
                        placeholder="Select Annual Turnover"
                        value={form.annualTurnover}
                        onChange={(v) => set('annualTurnover', v as AnnualTurnover)}
                        options={ANNUAL_TURNOVERS}
                    />
                </FormField>

                <FormField name="numberOfEmployees" label="Number of Employees" size="sm">
                    <StyledSelect
                        label="Number of Employees"
                        placeholder="Select Employees"
                        value={form.numberOfEmployees}
                        onChange={(v) => set('numberOfEmployees', v as NumberOfEmployees)}
                        options={EMPLOYEE_COUNTS}
                    />
                </FormField>

                {/* ── Hierarchy & ownership ── */}
                <FormField name="memberOfParentCorp" label="Member of (Parent Corporation)" size="lg">
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. Apex Holdings Conglomerate Ltd."
                        value={form.memberOfParentCorp}
                        onChange={(e) => set('memberOfParentCorp', e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{
                            input: {
                                endAdornment: (
                                    <InputAdornment position="end" sx={{ gap: 0.5 }}>
                                        <IconButton size="small" sx={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                                            <MenuBookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                                        </IconButton>
                                        <Tooltip title="Search organizations">
                                            <IconButton
                                                size="small"
                                                aria-label="Search organizations"
                                                onClick={() => setOrgLookupOpen(true)}
                                                sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', '&:hover': { color: '#1d4ed8' } }}
                                            >
                                                <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                                            </IconButton>
                                        </Tooltip>
                                        <Tooltip title="Unlink parent">
                                            <span>
                                                <IconButton
                                                    size="small"
                                                    aria-label="Unlink parent"
                                                    disabled={!form.memberOfParentCorp}
                                                    onClick={() => set('memberOfParentCorp', '')}
                                                    sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', '&:hover': { color: '#dc2626' } }}
                                                >
                                                    <LinkOffIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                                                </IconButton>
                                            </span>
                                        </Tooltip>
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ),
                            },
                            htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.organizationName },
                        }}
                    />
                    <OrganizationLookupModal
                        open={orgLookupOpen}
                        onClose={() => setOrgLookupOpen(false)}
                        onSelect={(org) => set('memberOfParentCorp', org.organizationName)}
                        selectedValue={form.memberOfParentCorp}
                    />
                </FormField>

                {/* Assigned to (Account Executive) */}
                <RhfAssignedUserCard<OrganizationFormData>
                    name="assignedUser"
                    label="Assigned to (Account Executive)"
                    required
                    roleBadge="Primary Rep"
                    onValueChange={(username) => set('assignedUser', username)}
                />

                {/* Description (full row) */}
                <FormField
                    name="description"
                    label="Add Description & Scope"
                    size="full"
                    hint={`${form.description.length} / ${DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH}`}
                >
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        multiline
                        minRows={4}
                        maxRows={8}
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="Describe the organization's scope, activities, and key details..."
                        value={form.description}
                        onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value.slice(0, DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH))}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH } }}
                    />
                </FormField>
            </FormGrid>
        </Box>
    );
}

function FallbackOverviewProvider({
    children,
    defaultValues,
}: {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    defaultValues?: OrganizationFormData;
}) {
    const methods = useForm<OrganizationFormData>({
        defaultValues: {
            organizationName: defaultValues?.organizationName || '',
            mailingName: defaultValues?.mailingName || '',
            natureOfBusiness: defaultValues?.natureOfBusiness || '',
            accountStatus: defaultValues?.accountStatus || 'Active',
            typeOfEntity: defaultValues?.typeOfEntity || '',
            customerType: defaultValues?.customerType || '',
            sapCodeTallyId: defaultValues?.sapCodeTallyId || '',
            showroomBranchCode: defaultValues?.showroomBranchCode || '',
            sourceOfLead: defaultValues?.sourceOfLead || '',
            memberOfParentCorp: defaultValues?.memberOfParentCorp || '',
            numberOfEmployees: defaultValues?.numberOfEmployees || '',
            annualTurnover: defaultValues?.annualTurnover || '',
            description: defaultValues?.description || '',
            accountVerified: defaultValues?.accountVerified || false,
            provideSupport: defaultValues?.provideSupport || 'Yes',
            registrationType: (defaultValues?.registrationType as 'Registered' | 'Unregistered') || 'Registered',
            gstNo: defaultValues?.gstNo || defaultValues?.gstNumber || '',
            ...defaultValues,
        },
    });
    return <FormProvider {...methods}>{children}</FormProvider>;
}

export function OverviewTab(props: OverviewTabProps) {
    const existing = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();
    if (existing) {
        return <OverviewTabInner {...props} />;
    }
    return (
        <FallbackOverviewProvider defaultValues={props.form}>
            <OverviewTabInner {...props} />
        </FallbackOverviewProvider>
    );
}

    const isView = useFormMode().mode === 'view';
    const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');

    const partnerCompanies = form.partnerCompanies || [];

    const handleAddPartner = () => {
        const trimmed = inputValue.trim();
        if (!trimmed) return;
        if (partnerCompanies.includes(trimmed)) return;
        set('partnerCompanies', [...partnerCompanies, trimmed]);
        setInputValue('');
    };

    const handleRemovePartner = (index: number) => {
        set(
            'partnerCompanies',
            partnerCompanies.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
        );
    };

    const handleClearInput = () => {
        setInputValue('');
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>

                        onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}

                                        sx={{
                                            display: 'flex',
                                            flexDirection: 'column',
                                            alignItems: 'center',
                                            gap: 1,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <BusinessIcon sx={{ fontSize: 28, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                            No partner companies linked yet.
                                        </Typography>
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#9ca3af' }}>
                                            Type a company name above and click &quot;Add Company&quot;.
                                        </Typography>
                                    </Box>
                                </TableCell>
                            </TableRow>
                        ) : (
                            partnerCompanies.map((name, index) => (
                                <TableRow
                                    key={`${name}-${index}`}
                                    sx={{
                                        '&:nth-of-type(even)': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' },
                                    }}
                                >
                                    <TableCell
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                            fontWeight: 600,
                                            color: '#64748b',
                                            py: 1.2,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {index + 1}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.84rem',
                                            fontWeight: 600,
                                            color: '#1e293b',
                                            py: 1.2,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                            <Chip
                                                label="Partner"
                                                size="small"
                                                sx={{
                                                    height: 20,
                                                    fontSize: '0.68rem',
                                                    backgroundColor: '#e0e7ff',
                                                    color: '#4338ca',
                                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                                }}
                                            />
                                            {name}
                                        </Box>
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ py: 1.2 }}>
                                        {!isView && (
                                        <IconButton
                                            size="small"
                                            onClick={() => handleRemovePartner(index)}
                                            sx={{
                                                color: '#9ca3af',
                                                '&:hover': { color: '#ef4444' },
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                                        </IconButton>
                                        )}
                                    </TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                            ))
                        )}
                    </TableBody>
                </Table>
            </TableContainer>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    TextField,
} from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import AccountBalanceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountBalanceOutlined';
import ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLongOutlined';

import { useFormContext, useWatch, FormProvider, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    FIELD_MAX_LENGTH,
    FormField,
    FormGrid,
    SectionLabel,
    StyledSelect,
    fieldSx,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfUppercaseField,
} from '@/components/forms';
import { ACCOUNT_TYPES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { OrganizationFormData } from '@/types/organization.types';

export interface TaxBankTabProps {
    form: OrganizationFormData;
    set: <K extends keyof OrganizationFormData>(key: K, value: OrganizationFormData[K]) => void;
}

function TaxBankTabInner({ form, set }: TaxBankTabProps) {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();
    const registrationType = (useWatch({ control, name: 'registrationType' }) ?? form?.registrationType ?? 'Registered') as 'Registered' | 'Unregistered';
    const gstNo = useWatch({ control, name: 'gstNo' }) ?? form?.gstNo ?? form?.gstNumber ?? '';

    // Synchronize registrationType changes
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && registrationType) {
            set('registrationType', registrationType);
        }
        if (registrationType === 'Unregistered') {
            setValue('gstNo', '', { shouldValidate: true });
            if (set) {
                set('gstNo', '');
                set('gstNumber', '');
            }
        }
    }, [registrationType, setValue, set]);

    // Synchronize gstNo changes with external set callback if provided
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && gstNo !== undefined) {
            set('gstNo', gstNo);
            set('gstNumber', gstNo);
        }
    }, [gstNo, set]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 }, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 3.5 }}>
            {/* ── Tax identifiers: short, fixed-length codes sit three to a row ── */}
            <Box>
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Tax Identification & Compliance"
                    sx={{ mb: 2 }}
                />
                <FormGrid columns={3}>
                    <RhfSelect<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="registrationType"
                        label="Registration Type"
                        options={['Registered', 'Unregistered']}
                        required
                        placeholder="Select Registration Type"
                    />

                    {registrationType === 'Registered' && (
                        <RhfUppercaseField<OrganizationFormData>
                            name="gstNo"
                            label="GST Number"
                            required={registrationType === 'Registered'}
                            hint="15-character GSTIN"
                            placeholder="e.g. 06AFZFS3757G1Z9"
                            maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.gstin}
                        />
                    )}

                    <RhfUppercaseField<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="panNumber"
                        label="PAN Number"
                        hint="10-character PAN"
                        placeholder="e.g. ABCDE1234F"
                        maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.pan}
                        onChange={(e) => set('panNumber', e.target.value)}
                    />

                    <RhfUppercaseField<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="tanNumber"
                        label="TAN Number"
                        hint="Tax Deduction Account"
                        placeholder="e.g. DELM12345E"
                        maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.tan}
                        onChange={(e) => set('tanNumber', e.target.value)}
                    />

                    <RhfUppercaseField<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="cinNo"
                        label="CIN No"
                        hint="Corporate Identification No."
                        placeholder="e.g. U74999DL2020PTC123456"
                        maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.cin}
                        onChange={(e) => set('cinNo', e.target.value)}
                    />

                    <RhfUppercaseField<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="msmeRegnNumber"
                        label="MSME Regn. Number"
                        hint="Udyam Registration"
                        placeholder="e.g. UDYAM-DL-01-0012345"
                        maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.msme}
                        onChange={(e) => set('msmeRegnNumber', e.target.value)}
                    />
                </FormGrid>
            </Box>

            {/* ── Bank account ── */}
            <Box>
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<AccountBalanceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Bank Account Details"
                    sx={{ mb: 2 }}
                />
                <FormGrid columns={3}>
                    <FormField name="accountName" label="Account Name" size="lg">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. Mohit Traders Pvt Ltd"
                            value={form.accountName || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('accountName', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.organizationName } }}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    <FormField name="bankName" label="Bank Name" size="md">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, SBI"
                            value={form.bankName || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('bankName', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.personName } }}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    <FormField name="typeOfAccount" label="Type Of Account" size="sm">
                        <StyledSelect
                            label="Type Of Account"
                            placeholder="Select Type"
                            value={form.typeOfAccount || ''}
                            onChange={(v) => set('typeOfAccount', v)}
                            options={ACCOUNT_TYPES}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    <FormField name="accountNumber" label="Account Number" size="md">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. 50200012345678"
                            value={form.accountNumber || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('accountNumber', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.bankAccount, inputMode: 'numeric' } }}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    <RhfUppercaseField<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="bankIfscCode"
                        label="Bank IFSC Code"
                        hint="11-character code"
                        placeholder="e.g. HDFC0001234"
                        maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.ifsc}
                        onChange={(e) => set('bankIfscCode', e.target.value)}
                    />

                    <FormField name="bankAddress" label="Bank Address" size="lg">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. Connaught Place Branch, New Delhi - 110001"
                            value={form.bankAddress || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('bankAddress', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.address } }}
                        />
                    </FormField>
                </FormGrid>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

function FallbackTaxBankProvider({
    children,
    defaultValues,
}: {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    defaultValues?: OrganizationFormData;
}) {
    const methods = useForm<OrganizationFormData>({
        defaultValues: {
            registrationType: (defaultValues?.registrationType as 'Registered' | 'Unregistered') || 'Registered',
            gstNo: defaultValues?.gstNo || defaultValues?.gstNumber || '',
            ...defaultValues,
        },
    });
    return <FormProvider {...methods}>{children}</FormProvider>;
}

export function TaxBankTab(props: TaxBankTabProps) {
    const existing = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();
    if (existing) {
        return <TaxBankTabInner {...props} />;
    }
    return (
        <FallbackTaxBankProvider defaultValues={props.form}>
            <TaxBankTabInner {...props} />
        </FallbackTaxBankProvider>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import InventoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/InventoryOutlined';
import CategoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CategoryOutlined';
import NewReleasesOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NewReleasesOutlined';
import StarBorderIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StarBorder';
import { RecordLink } from '../../common/RecordLink';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../../common/CommonMasterView';
import { MasterHeaderActions } from '../../common/MasterHeaderActions';
import { buildExtendedSearchConfig } from '../../common/buildExtendedSearchConfig';
import { AppToast } from '../../common/AppToast';
import { DataImportModal } from '../../common/import';
import { RelatedModulesSidebar, RelatedRecordsTableView } from '../../common/Drawer';
import { RelatedSecondaryDrawer, type SecondaryDrawerEntity } from '../../common/RelatedSecondaryDrawer';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { useRelatedModulesForEntity } from '@/config/relatedModules.config';
import type { Product } from '@/types/product.types';
import { useProducts, useBulkDeleteProducts } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { ProductFilterTab } from './types';
import { ProductDetailDrawer } from '../ProductDetailDrawer';

const RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS = 7;

const TAX_RATE_COLORS: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string; border: string }> = {
    '0%': { bg: '#f0fdf4', color: '#15803d', border: '#bbf7d0' },
    '5%': { bg: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe' },
    '12%': { bg: '#fefce8', color: '#854d0e', border: '#fde68a' },
    '18%': { bg: '#fff7ed', color: '#c2410c', border: '#fed7aa' },
    '28%': { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#b91c1c', border: '#fecaca' },
};


/** Stable empty list while the first page loads (keeps memoized filters from recomputing). */
const NO_RECORDS: Product[] = [];
export function ProductsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { data: products = NO_RECORDS, refetch } = useProducts();
    const bulkDeleteMutation = useBulkDeleteProducts();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ProductFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<string>('productName');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
    // Tracked by id so the drawer always shows the cached copy and closes if the product is deleted.
    const [drawerProductId, setDrawerProductId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const selectedDrawerProduct = useMemo(
        () => (drawerProductId ? products.find((p) => p.id === drawerProductId) ?? null : null),
        [products, drawerProductId]
    );
    const [activeRelatedModule, setActiveRelatedModule] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [secondaryDrawerEntity, setSecondaryDrawerEntity] = useState<SecondaryDrawerEntity | null>(null);
    const [isLeftSidebarCollapsed, setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: 'success' | 'info' | 'error' }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const [importOpen, setImportOpen] = useState(false);

    // ── Filter Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
        const now = new Date().getTime();
        return products.filter((p) => {
            if (activeTab === 'hardware' && !['Hardware', 'Networking', 'Storage', 'Security', 'Peripherals'].includes(p.category || '')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'software' && !['Software', 'License', 'Subscription'].includes(p.type || '')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'services' && !['AMC / Service', 'Cloud Services'].includes(p.category || '')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'recently_added') {
                const created = new Date(p.createdAt).getTime();
                if (now - created > RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS * 86400000) return false;
            }

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                return (
                    p.productName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (p.category || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (p.manufacturer || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (p.hsnCode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    p.productCode.toLowerCase().includes(q)
                );
            }
            return true;
        });
    }, [products, activeTab, searchQuery]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedProducts = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredProducts].sort((a, b) => {
            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredProducts, sortField, sortOrder]);

    // ── Pagination ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const paginatedProducts = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedProducts.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedProducts, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const handleToggleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedProducts.map((p) => p.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleToggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) =>
            prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((sid) => sid !== id) : [...prev, id]
        );
    };

    const closeThreePanelView = useCallback(() => {
        setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);
        setDrawerProductId(null);
        setActiveRelatedModule(null);
    }, []);

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        if (count === 0) return;
        if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${count} selected product(s)?`)) return;
        try {
            await bulkDeleteMutation.mutateAsync(selectedIds);
            if (drawerProductId && selectedIds.includes(drawerProductId)) {
                closeThreePanelView();
            }
            setSelectedIds([]);
            setToast({ open: true, message: `${count} product(s) deleted.`, severity: 'success' });
        } catch {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Failed to delete products.', severity: 'error' });
        }
    };

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<ProductFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        const now = new Date().getTime();
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Products',
                icon: <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'hardware',
                label: 'Hardware',
                icon: <CategoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => ['Hardware', 'Networking', 'Storage', 'Security', 'Peripherals'].includes(p.category || '')).length,
            },
            {
                id: 'software',
                label: 'Software & Licenses',
                icon: <StarBorderIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => ['Software', 'License', 'Subscription'].includes(p.type || '')).length,
            },
            {
                id: 'services',
                label: 'Services & AMC',
                icon: <NewReleasesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => ['AMC / Service', 'Cloud Services'].includes(p.category || '')).length,
            },
            {
                id: 'recently_added',
                label: 'Recently Added',
                icon: <NewReleasesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => now - new Date(p.createdAt).getTime() <= RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS * 86400000).length,
            },
        ];
    }, [products]);

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Product>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'productName',
                label: 'PRODUCT NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 220,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                        <Box>
                            <RecordLink
                                href={ROUTES.PRODUCT_DETAIL(p.id)}
                                onOpen={() => setDrawerProductId(p.id)}
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    lineHeight: 1.2,
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {p.productName}
                            </RecordLink>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                                {p.productCode}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'category',
                label: 'CATEGORY',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {p.category || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'manufacturer',
                label: 'MANUFACTURER',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                        {p.manufacturer || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'hsnCode',
                label: 'HSN CODE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 110,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                        {p.hsnCode || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'mrp',
                label: 'MRP (₹)',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 100,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                        {p.mrp ? `₹${Number(p.mrp).toLocaleString('en-IN')}` : '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'taxRate',
                label: 'TAX',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 80,
                render: (p) => {
                    const style = TAX_RATE_COLORS[p.taxRate || ''] || { bg: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569', border: '#cbd5e1' };
                    return p.taxRate ? (
                        <Chip
                            label={p.taxRate}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 20,
                                fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                backgroundColor: style.bg,
                                color: style.color,
                                border: `1px solid ${style.border}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>-</Typography>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'type',
                label: 'TYPE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 100,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {p.type || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    const relatedModules = useRelatedModulesForEntity('product', selectedDrawerProduct, setActiveRelatedModule);

    // Falls back to the first module until the user explicitly picks one.
    const effectiveRelatedModule = activeRelatedModule ?? relatedModules[0]?.id ?? null;
    const activeModuleMeta = relatedModules.find((m) => m.id === effectiveRelatedModule);

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Product, ProductFilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            tableId="products"
            headerActions={() => (
                <MasterHeaderActions
                    onRefresh={async () => {
                        const { isError } = await refetch();
                        setToast(
                            isError
                                ? { open: true, message: 'Failed to refresh products.', severity: 'error' }
                                : { open: true, message: 'Products refreshed.', severity: 'info' }
                        );
                    }}
                    onNewClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_NEW)}
                    newButtonLabel="New Product"
                    onImportClick={() => setImportOpen(true)}
                />
            )}
            searchConfig={buildExtendedSearchConfig({
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by name, category, HSN, manufacturer...',
                pageIds: paginatedProducts.map((r) => r.id),
                allIds: sortedProducts.map((r) => r.id),
                selectedIds,
                onSelectedIdsChange: setSelectedIds,
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalRecords: sortedProducts.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            })}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedProducts}
            keyExtractor={(p) => p.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleToggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(p) => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_DETAIL(p.id))}
            getEditHref={(p) => ROUTES.PRODUCT_EDIT(p.id)}
            onRowClick={(product) => setDrawerProductId(product.id)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerProduct?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Product"
            editTooltip="Edit Product"
            emptyTitle="No products in catalog yet"
            emptyDescription="Add your first product to start building the catalog. You can define pricing, HSN codes, and tax rates."
            emptyActionLabel="Add Product"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: sortedProducts.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onRowsPerPageChange: (n) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(n);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            relatedSidebar={
                <RelatedModulesSidebar
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerProduct)}
                    modules={relatedModules}
                    activeModuleId={effectiveRelatedModule ?? undefined}
                    onModuleSelect={(moduleId) => setActiveRelatedModule(moduleId)}
                    collapsed={isLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                    onToggleCollapse={setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                />
            }
            relatedRecordsTable={
                <RelatedRecordsTableView
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerProduct && effectiveRelatedModule)}
                    moduleId={effectiveRelatedModule || ''}
                    moduleTitle={activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Related Records'}
                    parentRecordId={selectedDrawerProduct?.id}
                    parentEntityTitle={selectedDrawerProduct?.productName || ''}
                    entityData={selectedDrawerProduct}
                    entityType="product"
                    leftOffset={isLeftSidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 260}
                    rightOffset={580}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onRowClick={(row, modId) => setSecondaryDrawerEntity({ type: modId, data: row })}
                />
            }
            drawer={
                <ProductDetailDrawer
                    product={selectedDrawerProduct}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerProduct)}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                />
            }
            secondaryDrawer={
                secondaryDrawerEntity ? (
                    <RelatedSecondaryDrawer
                        entity={secondaryDrawerEntity}
                        moduleLabel={activeModuleMeta?.label}
                        parentTitle={selectedDrawerProduct?.productName}
                        onClose={() => setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null)}
                    />
                ) : null
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerProduct)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        >
            <DataImportModal
                open={importOpen}
                entity="products"
                onClose={() => setImportOpen(false)}
                onImported={(count) => {
                    setToast({ open: true, message: `Successfully imported ${count} product${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}!`, severity: 'success' });
                }}
            />
        </CommonMasterView>
    );
}

    const router = useRouter();

    const { data: freshProduct } = useProduct(open && product?.id ? product.id : undefined);
    const p = freshProduct ?? product;

    if (!p) return null;

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(p.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_EDIT(p.id));
        }
    };

    const formatCurrency = (val?: string | number) => {
        if (!val) return '—';
        const num = typeof val === 'string' ? parseFloat(val) : val;
        if (isNaN(num)) return String(val);
        return `₹${num.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
    };

    // Calculate margin if MRP & Cost exist
    const costNum = parseFloat(p.cost || '0');
    const mrpNum = parseFloat(p.mrp || '0');
    const mspNum = parseFloat(p.msp || '0');
    const profitMargin = costNum > 0 && mrpNum > 0 ? (((mrpNum - costNum) / costNum) * 100).toFixed(1) : null;

    return (
        <EntityDetailDrawer

                    color: '#475569',
                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
                onView: () => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_DETAIL(p.id)),
            }}
            formTabs={PRODUCT_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                overview: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                        {/* Primary Product Header Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="PRODUCT IDENTITY & CODE" bg="#f8fafc">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                    <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '1.02rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                                        {p.productName}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                                    <Chip
                                        label={p.productCode}

                                        }}
                                    />
                                    <DrawerCopyButton text={p.productCode} title="Copy SKU Code" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Section 1: Sale Information */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard
                            title="Sale Information & Classification"

File: frontend-crm/src/components/products/ProductForm.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Divider } from '@mui/material';
import InventoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/InventoryOutlined';
import LocalOfferOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalOfferOutlined';
import DescriptionOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { productFormSchema } from '@/validations';
import type { ProductFormData } from '@/types/product.types';
import { productService } from '@/services';

// Reusable Form Primitives
import {
    CommonFormLayout,
    AppToast,
    FIELD_MAX_LENGTH,
    FormGrid,
    FormGridItem,
    SectionLabel,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfPercentageField,
    RhfAmountField,
    useRhfForm,
} from '@/components/forms';

// ─── Option Lists ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PRODUCT_CATEGORIES = [
    'Acronis',
    'Biz Analyst',
    'Connect 21',
    'CredFlow',
    'CRM',
    'Data Warehouse',
    'Tally AMC',
    'Tally Customization',
    'Tally On Cloud',
    'Tally Service',
    'Tally Software Service (TSS)',
    'Tally Training',
    'Tally Upgrade',
    'TallyPrime',
    'TallyPrime Server',
    'Teramind',
    'TVU',
];

const PRODUCT_TYPES = [
    'Product',
    'Service',
    'Bundle',
    'Subscription',
    'License',
    'Other',
];

const TAX_TYPES = ['GST', 'IGST', 'None'];
const TAX_RATES = ['0%', '5%', '12%', '18%', '28%'];
const CONTRACT_CREATE_OPTIONS = ['Yes', 'No'];

// ─── Default Form State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DEFAULT_FORM: ProductFormData = {
    productName: '',
    hsnCode: '',
    category: '',
    type: '',
    manufacturer: '',
    taxType: 'GST',
    taxRate: '',
    discount: '',
    cost: '',
    mrp: '',
    msp: '',
    contractCreate: 'No',
    description: '',
    termsAndConditions: '',
};

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Product Form Tabs ─────────────────────────────
export const PRODUCT_FORM_TABS: FormTabDefinition[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />,
    },
];

// ─── Props ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface ProductFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';
    initialData?: Partial<ProductFormData>;
    productId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

export default function ProductForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    productId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: ProductFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } =
        useRhfForm<ProductFormData>({
            schema: productFormSchema,
            defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
        });

    const { reset, watch, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const productName = watch('productName');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Inventory' },
        { label: 'Products', href: ROUTES.PRODUCTS },
        {
            label:
                mode !== 'create'
                    ? productName
                        ? `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'}: ${productName}`
                        : `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'} Product`
                    : 'Create Product',
        },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!productId) return;
        let active = true;
        productService
            .getById(productId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) {
                    reset({ ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...found });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [productId, reset]);

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (mode === 'create') {
                await productService.create(values);
                showToast('Product created successfully!', 'success');
            } else if (productId) {
                await productService.update(productId, values);
                showToast('Product updated successfully!', 'success');
            }
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => {
                router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCTS);
            }, 800);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save product.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (mode === 'view') {
            router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCTS);
            return;
        }
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved product changes?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCTS);
    };

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={PRODUCT_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab="overview"
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={mode === 'view' ? () => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_EDIT(productId!)) : handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Edit Product' : mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Product' : 'Save Product'}
                cancelLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Back' : 'Cancel'}
                recordView={{
                    title: productName || '',
                    editHref: productId ? ROUTES.PRODUCT_EDIT(productId) : undefined,
                    editLabel: 'Edit Product',
                    backHref: ROUTES.PRODUCTS,
                }}
                mode={mode}
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    Section 1: Basic Product Info
                   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<LocalOfferOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Sale Information"
                />

                <FormGrid columns={3} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                    <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                        name="productName"
                        label="Product Name"
                        required
                        placeholder="Enter product name"
                    />
                    <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                        name="category"
                        label="Category"
                        placeholder="Select Category"
                        options={PRODUCT_CATEGORIES}
                    />
                    <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                        name="type"
                        label="Type"
                        placeholder="Select Type"
                        options={PRODUCT_TYPES}
                    />
                    <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                        name="manufacturer"
                        label="Manufacturer"
                        placeholder="e.g. Dell Technologies"
                        fieldSize="md"
                        maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.personName}
                    />
                    <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                        name="hsnCode"
                        label="HSN Code"
                        placeholder="e.g. 84715000"
                    />
                </FormGrid>

                <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />

                {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    Section 2: Pricing & Tax
                   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<LocalOfferOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Pricing & Tax"
                />

                <FormGrid columns={3} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                    {/* ── Prices ── */}
                    <RhfAmountField<ProductFormData>
                        name="cost"
                        label="Cost (₹)"
                        hint="Purchase / landed cost"
                        placeholder="0.00"
                        fieldSize="sm"
                    />
                    <RhfAmountField<ProductFormData>
                        name="mrp"
                        label="MRP (₹)"
                        hint="Maximum Retail Price"
                        placeholder="0.00"
                        fieldSize="sm"
                    />
                    <RhfAmountField<ProductFormData>
                        name="msp"
                        label="MSP (₹)"
                        hint="Minimum Selling Price"
                        placeholder="0.00"
                        fieldSize="sm"
                    />

                    {/* ── Tax ── */}
                    <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                        name="taxType"
                        label="Tax Type"
                        placeholder="Select Tax Type"
                        options={TAX_TYPES}
                    />
                    <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                        name="taxRate"
                        label="Tax Rate"
                        placeholder="Select Tax Rate"
                        options={TAX_RATES}
                    />
                    <RhfPercentageField<ProductFormData>
                        name="discount"
                        label="Discount (%)"
                        hint="e.g. 10 for 10%"
                        placeholder="0"
                    />

                    <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                        name="contractCreate"
                        label="Contract Create"
                        options={CONTRACT_CREATE_OPTIONS}
                    />
                </FormGrid>

                <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />

                {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    Section 3: Description & Terms
                   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<DescriptionOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Description & Terms"
                />

                <FormGrid columns={2} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                    <FormGridItem>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="description"
                            label="Description"
                            multiline
                            minRows={4}
                            placeholder="Enter product description..."
                        />
                    </FormGridItem>
                    <FormGridItem>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="termsAndConditions"
                            label="Terms and Conditions"
                            multiline
                            minRows={4}
                            placeholder="Enter terms and conditions..."
                        />
                    </FormGridItem>
                </FormGrid>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider, type FieldErrors } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Box, CircularProgress, Typography, Alert } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import ArticleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArticleOutlined';
import ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLongOutlined';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { useRhfForm } from '@/components/forms';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Opportunity } from '@/types/opportunity.types';
import type { Quotation, QuotationFormData } from '@/types/quotation.types';
import {
    opportunityService,
    organizationService,
    contactService,
    quotationService,
} from '@/services';
import { quotationFormSchema } from '@/validations';
import {
    QuotationOverviewSection,
    QuotationLineItemsSection,
    QuotationAddressSection,
} from './sections';
import { normalizeAddressFields } from '@/utils/address';

export interface CreateQuoteFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';
    quotationId?: string;
    opportunityId?: string;
    initialData?: Partial<QuotationFormData>;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

export type QuotationTabKey = 'overview' | 'line_items' | 'address';

export const QUOTATION_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: QuotationTabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'line_items',
        label: 'Line Items',
        icon: <ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'address',
        label: 'Address Information',
        icon: <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

const OVERVIEW_FIELD_KEYS = [
    'quotationTitle',
    'quoteStage',
    'quotationDate',
    'validUntil',
    'remarks',
    'termsAndCondition',
    'termsAndConditionDescription',
    'assignedTo',
    'opportunityName',
    'company',
    'validationPeriod',
    'otherRef',
    'paymentTerms',
    'paymentTermsDescription',
    'preparedFor',
];

const LINE_ITEMS_FIELD_KEYS = [

    'groupName',
    'lumpSumDiscount',

    'totalDiscount',
    'subtotal',
    'totalTax',
