const ADDRESS_FIELD_KEYS = [
    'organizationName',
    'organizationId',
    'contactName',
    'contactId',
    'contactMobile',
    'mailingName',
    'gstNo',
    'contactEmail',
    'billingAddress',
    'billingCity',
    'billingState',
    'billingPostalCode',
    'billingCountry',
    'shippingAddress',
    'shippingCity',
    'shippingState',
    'shippingPostalCode',
    'shippingCountry',
    'copyAddressFromBilling',
];

/** Country/state pairs normalised to the ISO address master when address data is loaded. */
const QUOTATION_ADDRESS_PAIRS = [
    ['billingCountry', 'billingState'],
    ['shippingCountry', 'shippingState'],
] as const;

const EMPTY_DEFAULTS: QuotationFormData = {
    // Tab 1: Overview

    quoteStage: 'Draft',
    quotationDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],

    remarks: '',

    // Tab 2: Line Items
    currency: 'Indian Rupee: ₹',

    opportunityId: '',

    quotationSubject: '',

    emailAddress: '',
    notes: '',
    termsAndConditions: '',
};

export function CreateQuoteForm({
    mode = 'create',
    quotationId,
    opportunityId,
    initialData,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: CreateQuoteFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const isEdit = mode !== 'create';
    const [quotation, setQuotation] = useState<Quotation | null>(null);
    const [opportunity, setOpportunity] = useState<Opportunity | null>(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() =>
        mode !== 'create' ? Boolean(quotationId) : Boolean(opportunityId)
    );
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<QuotationTabKey>('overview');
    const [addressPrepopulated, setAddressPrepopulated] = useState(true);

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast } =
        useRhfForm<QuotationFormData>({
            schema: quotationFormSchema,
            defaultValues: { ...EMPTY_DEFAULTS, ...initialData },
        });

    const { reset, handleSubmit, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;

        if (isEdit) {
            if (!quotationId) return;

            quotationService
                .getById(quotationId)
                .then((found) => {
                    if (!active) return;
                    if (!found) {
                        showToast('Quotation record not found.', 'error');
                        setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS), 1200);
                        return;
                    }
                    setQuotation(found);
                    reset(
                        normalizeAddressFields<QuotationFormData>(
                            { ...EMPTY_DEFAULTS, ...found, ...initialData },
                            QUOTATION_ADDRESS_PAIRS
                        )
                    );
                })
                .catch((err) => {
                    if (active) {
                        showToast(
                            err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load quotation details.',
                            'error'
                        );
                    }
                })
                .finally(() => {
                    if (active) setLoading(false);
                });

            return () => {
                active = false;
            };
        }

        // Create mode: load from opportunity
        if (!opportunityId) return;

        opportunityService
            .getById(opportunityId)
            .then(async (found) => {
                if (!active) return;
                if (!found) {
                    showToast('Opportunity record not found.', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                setOpportunity(found);

                // Look up linked organization & contact to prefill address: by id when linked, otherwise
                // a name search (server-side in API mode) narrowed to an exact, case-insensitive match.
                const sameText = (a: string, b: string) => a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();
                const [org, contact] = await Promise.all([
                    found.organizationId
                        ? organizationService.getById(found.organizationId)
                        : organizationService
                              .getAll({ search: found.organizationName })
                              .then((orgs) => orgs.find((o) => sameText(o.organizationName, found.organizationName))),
                    found.contactId
                        ? contactService.getById(found.contactId)
                        : contactService
                              .getAll({ search: found.contactName })
                              .then((contacts) => contacts.find((c) => sameText(c.name, found.contactName))),
                ]);
                if (!active) return;

                const defaults = quotationService.buildQuotationDefaultsFromOpportunity(
                    found,
                    org,
                    contact
                );

                if (!defaults.billingAddress || !defaults.billingCity || !defaults.billingPostalCode) {
                    setAddressPrepopulated(false);
                }

                reset({
                    ...defaults,
                    ...initialData,
                });
            })
            .catch((err) => {
                if (active) {
                    showToast(
                        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load opportunity details.',
                        'error'
                    );
                }
            })
            .finally(() => {
                if (active) setLoading(false);
            });

        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [isEdit, quotationId, opportunityId, initialData, reset, router, showToast]);

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = isEdit
        ? [
              { label: 'Sales' },
              { label: 'Quotations', href: ROUTES.QUOTATIONS },
              {
                  label: quotation?.quotationCode
                      ? `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'}: ${quotation.quotationCode}`
                      : `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'} Quotation`,
              },
          ]
        : [
              { label: 'Sales' },
              { label: 'Opportunities', href: ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES },
              {
                  label: opportunity?.opportunityCode
                      ? `Quote: ${opportunity.opportunityCode}`
                      : 'Create Quote',
              },
          ];

    // Helper to find first error message from FieldErrors
    const getFirstErrorText = (errors: FieldErrors<QuotationFormData>): string | null => {
        for (const key of Object.keys(errors)) {
            const err = (errors as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
            if (err && typeof err === 'object' && 'message' in err && typeof err.message === 'string') {
                return err.message;
            }
            if (Array.isArray(err) && err[0]?.message) {
                return String(err[0].message);
            }
        }
        return null;
    };

    // On invalid submit: auto-switch activeTab to the first tab containing an error & surface in toast
    const onInvalidSubmit = useCallback(
        (errors: FieldErrors<QuotationFormData>) => {
            const errorKeys = Object.keys(errors);

            const hasOverviewError = errorKeys.some((k) => OVERVIEW_FIELD_KEYS.includes(k));
            const hasLineItemsError = errorKeys.some((k) => LINE_ITEMS_FIELD_KEYS.includes(k));
            const hasAddressError = errorKeys.some((k) => ADDRESS_FIELD_KEYS.includes(k));

            if (hasOverviewError) {
                setActiveTab('overview');
            } else if (hasLineItemsError) {
                setActiveTab('line_items');
            } else if (hasAddressError) {
                setActiveTab('address');
            }

            const firstMsg = getFirstErrorText(errors) || 'Please correct the highlighted validation errors.';
            showToast(firstMsg, 'error');
        },
        [showToast]
    );

    const onValidSubmit = async (values: QuotationFormData) => {
        try {
            if (isEdit && quotationId) {
                const updated = await quotationService.update(quotationId, values);
                showToast(
                    `Quotation "${updated?.quotationCode || quotation?.quotationCode || quotationId}" updated successfully!`,
                    'success'
                );
                reset(values);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS);
                }, 800);
            } else if (opportunityId) {
                const result = await quotationService.createQuotationFromOpportunity(
                    opportunityId,
                    values
                );
                showToast(
                    `Quotation "${result.quotationCode}" created successfully for ${result.organizationName}!`,
                    'success'
                );
                reset(values);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS);
                }, 900);
            } else {
                const created = await quotationService.create(values);
                showToast(`Quotation "${created.quotationCode}" created successfully!`, 'success');
                reset(values);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS);
                }, 900);
            }
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(
                err instanceof Error
                    ? err.message
                    : isEdit
                    ? 'Failed to update quotation.'
                    : 'Failed to create quotation.',
                'error'
            );
        }
    };

    const handleSave = handleSubmit(onValidSubmit, onInvalidSubmit);

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (mode === 'view') {
            router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS);
            return;
        }
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved quotation data?')) return;
        router.push(isEdit ? ROUTES.QUOTATIONS : ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES);
    };

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', py: 12 }}>
                <CircularProgress size={36} sx={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
                <Typography sx={{ ml: 2, color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                    {isEdit ? 'Loading quotation details...' : 'Loading opportunity and commercial details...'}
                </Typography>
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={QUOTATION_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as QuotationTabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={mode === 'view' ? () => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(quotationId!)) : handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Edit Quotation' : isEdit ? 'Update Quotation' : 'Save Quotation'}
                cancelLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Back' : 'Cancel'}
                mode={mode}
                disableContentPadding
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                {!addressPrepopulated && (
                    <Box sx={{ p: 2.5, pb: 0 }}>
                        <Alert severity="info">
                            <strong>Address Requirement:</strong> Please ensure the complete billing address
                            (Street, City, State, and PIN code) is provided in the &quot;Address Information&quot; tab.
                            Quotation generation requires a valid invoice address.
                        </Alert>
                    </Box>
                )}

                {/* ── Keep all 3 panels mounted to preserve React Hook Form state across tabs ── */}
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'overview'}>
                    <QuotationOverviewSection />
                </div>

                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'line_items'}>
                    <QuotationLineItemsSection />
                </div>

                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'address'}>
                    <QuotationAddressSection />
                </div>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

export default CreateQuoteForm;

                        </Typography>

                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: '#475569', mt: 0.5, lineHeight: 1.5, whiteSpace: 'pre-line' }}>
                                {quotation.termsAndConditionDescription}
                            </Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                </Box>
            </DrawerSectionCard>

            {/* Remarks / Notes if present */}
            {(quotation.remarks || quotation.notes) && (
                <DrawerSectionCard
                    title="REMARKS & INTERNAL NOTES"
                    icon={<NotesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />}
                    bg="#fafafa"
                >
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155', fontStyle: 'italic', mt: 0.5, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                        {quotation.remarks || quotation.notes}
                    </Typography>
                </DrawerSectionCard>
            )}
        </Box>
    );

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // TAB 2: LINE ITEMS
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const renderLineItems = () => (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
            {/* Group Header */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                <Box>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                        {quotation.groupName || 'Software Licenses & Add-ons'}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        Currency: {quotation.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹'}
                    </Typography>
                </Box>
                <Chip
                    label={`${quotation.lineItems?.length || 0} Items`}
                    size="small"
                    sx={{
                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                        color: '#1d4ed8',
                        border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        fontSize: '0.72rem',
                    }}
                />
            </Box>

            {/* Line Items Cards */}
            {!quotation.lineItems || quotation.lineItems.length === 0 ? (
                <Box sx={{ p: 4, textAlign: 'center', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px dashed #cbd5e1' }}>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        No product line items attached to this quotation.
                    </Typography>
                </Box>
            ) : (
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
                    {quotation.lineItems.map((item, idx) => (
                        <DrawerSectionCard key={item.id || idx} p={1.8}>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 1 }}>
                                <Box sx={{ pr: 2 }}>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.86rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                                        {item.productName}
                                    </Typography>
                                    {item.description && (
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.3, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                                            {item.description}
                                        </Typography>
                                    )}
                                </Box>
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.94rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#15803d', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                                    ₹{(item.total || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>

                            <Box
                                sx={{
                                    display: 'grid',
                                    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
                                    gap: 1,
                                    pt: 1,
                                    borderTop: '1px dashed #e2e8f0',
                                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                }}
                            >
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Quantity:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{item.quantity}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Unit Price:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>₹{(item.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Discount:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>
                                        {item.discount > 0 ? `${item.discount}${item.discountType === 'percentage' ? '%' : '₹'}` : '₹0'}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Tax ({item.taxRate}):</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#2563eb' }}>₹{(item.taxAmount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>
                    ))}
                </Box>
            )}

            {/* Financial Summary Breakdown Card */}
            <Paper
                elevation={0}
                sx={{
                    p: 2.2,
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    border: '1.5px solid #bfdbfe',
                }}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e3a8a', mb: 1.5, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                    Commercial Breakdown
                </Typography>

                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Total Gross Amount:</Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(quotation.totalAmount)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    {quotation.totalDiscount > 0 && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#dc2626' }}>Item Discounts:</Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>
                                - {formatCurrency(quotation.totalDiscount)}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    )}

                    {quotation.lumpSumDiscount > 0 && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#dc2626' }}>Lump Sum Discount:</Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>
                                - {formatCurrency(quotation.lumpSumDiscount)}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    )}

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#475569' }}>Subtotal:</Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(quotation.subtotal)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Tax (GST):</Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#2563eb' }}>
                            + {formatCurrency(quotation.totalTax)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    <Divider sx={{ my: 0.5, borderColor: '#cbd5e1' }} />

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.94rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            Grand Total:
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '1.18rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#15803d' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(quotation.grandTotal)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                </Box>
            </Paper>
        </Box>
    );

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // TAB 3: ADDRESS INFORMATION
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const renderAddress = () => (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
            {/* Customer & Organization Header Card */}
            <DrawerSectionCard
                title="ORGANIZATION & CONTACT"
                icon={<ApartmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                bg="#f8fafc"
            >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.2, mt: 1 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                            <BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e3a8a' }}>
                                {quotation.organizationName || 'Unspecified Organization'}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {quotation.gstNo && (
                            <DrawerCopyButton text={quotation.gstNo} title="Copy GSTIN" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                        )}
                    </Box>

                    {quotation.mailingName && quotation.mailingName !== quotation.organizationName && (
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            Mailing Name: {quotation.mailingName}
                        </Typography>
                    )}

                    {quotation.gstNo && (
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#475569', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            GSTIN: {quotation.gstNo}
                        </Typography>
                    )}

                    <Divider sx={{ my: 0.5 }} />

                    {/* Contact Person Details */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {quotation.contactName}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    {(quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber) && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                    {quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <DrawerCopyButton
                                text={quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber || ''}
                                title="Copy Phone Number"
                                iconColor="#94a3b8"
                            />
                        </Box>
                    )}

                    {(quotation.contactEmail || quotation.emailAddress) && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                    {quotation.contactEmail || quotation.emailAddress}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <DrawerCopyButton
                                text={quotation.contactEmail || quotation.emailAddress || ''}
                                title="Copy Email Address"
                                iconColor="#94a3b8"
                            />
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </Box>
            </DrawerSectionCard>

            {/* Billing Address Card */}
            <DrawerSectionCard
                title="BILLING ADDRESS"
                icon={<LocationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#1e293b', lineHeight: 1.6, mt: 0.5 }}>
                    {quotation.billingAddress || '-'}<br />
                    {quotation.billingCity ? `${quotation.billingCity}, ` : ''}
                    {quotation.billingState || ''}
                    {quotation.billingPostalCode ? ` - ${quotation.billingPostalCode}` : ''}<br />
                    {getCountryNameByCode(quotation.billingCountry || 'IN')}
                </Typography>
            </DrawerSectionCard>

            {/* Shipping Address Card */}
            <DrawerSectionCard
                title="SHIPPING ADDRESS"
                icon={<LocationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                action={
                    quotation.copyAddressFromBilling ? (
                        <Chip
                            label="Same as Billing"
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 20,
                                fontSize: '0.68rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                                color: '#166534',
                                border: '1px solid #bbf7d0',
                            }}
                        />
                    ) : undefined
                }
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#1e293b', lineHeight: 1.6, mt: 0.5 }}>
                    {(quotation.shippingAddress || quotation.billingAddress) || '-'}<br />
                    {(quotation.shippingCity || quotation.billingCity) ? `${quotation.shippingCity || quotation.billingCity}, ` : ''}
                    {quotation.shippingState || quotation.billingState || ''}
                    {(quotation.shippingPostalCode || quotation.billingPostalCode) ? ` - ${quotation.shippingPostalCode || quotation.billingPostalCode}` : ''}<br />
                    {getCountryNameByCode(quotation.shippingCountry || quotation.billingCountry || 'IN')}
                </Typography>
            </DrawerSectionCard>
        </Box>
    );

    return (
        <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={quotation.quotationCode}
            subtitle={`${quotation.quotationTitle || quotation.quotationSubject || 'Quotation'} • ${quotation.organizationName}`}
            avatarText={quotation.quotationCode.replace(/^QT-0*/i, 'QT-')}
            avatarIcon={<RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24, color: '#ffffff' }} />}
            avatarBg="linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)"
            statusText={`Valid Until: ${quotation.validUntil || quotation.quoteDate || '-'}`}
            badges={[
                {
                    label: currentStatus,
                    backgroundColor: statusStyle.bg,
                    color: statusStyle.color,
                    borderColor: statusStyle.border,
                },
                {
                    label: `₹${(quotation.grandTotal || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
                    backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                    color: '#15803d',
                    borderColor: '#bbf7d0',
                },
                {
                    label: quotation.assignedTo || 'Unassigned',
                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                    color: '#475569',
                    borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
                onView: () => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_DETAIL(quotation.id)),
            }}
            primaryAction={{
                label: 'Edit Quotation',
                onClick: handleEdit,
                icon: <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
            }}
            formTabs={QUOTATION_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                overview: renderOverview(),
                line_items: renderLineItems(),
                address: renderAddress(),
            }}
            auditEntity={{ type: 'quotations', id: quotation.id }}
            includeChangesTab={true}
        />
    );
}

export default QuotationDetailDrawer;

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RequestQuoteOutlined';
import DraftsOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DraftsOutlined';
import SendOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SendOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import CancelOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CancelOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';

import { RecordLink } from '../common/RecordLink';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../common/CommonMasterView';
import { MasterHeaderActions } from '../common/MasterHeaderActions';
import { buildExtendedSearchConfig } from '../common/buildExtendedSearchConfig';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { RelatedModulesSidebar, RelatedRecordsTableView } from '../common/Drawer';
import { RelatedSecondaryDrawer, type SecondaryDrawerEntity } from '../common/RelatedSecondaryDrawer';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { useRelatedModulesForEntity } from '@/config/relatedModules.config';
import type { Quotation } from '@/types/quotation.types';
import { useQuotations, useDeleteQuotation, useBulkDeleteQuotations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import { QuotationDetailDrawer } from './QuotationDetailDrawer';

export type QuotationFilterTab = 'all' | 'draft' | 'sent' | 'accepted' | 'rejected';
export type QuotationSortField = 'quotationCode' | 'organizationName' | 'grandTotal' | 'quoteDate' | 'validUntil' | 'status';

const formatCurrency = (val: number = 0) =>
    new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'INR',
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(val);


/** Stable empty list while the first page loads (keeps memoized filters from recomputing). */
const NO_RECORDS: Quotation[] = [];
export function QuotationsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { data: quotations = NO_RECORDS, refetch } = useQuotations();
    const deleteMutation = useDeleteQuotation();
    const bulkDeleteMutation = useBulkDeleteQuotations();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<QuotationFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<QuotationSortField>('quotationCode');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
    // Tracked by id so the drawer always shows the cached copy and closes if the quotation is deleted.
    const [drawerQuotationId, setDrawerQuotationId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const selectedDrawerQuotation = useMemo(
        () => (drawerQuotationId ? quotations.find((q) => q.id === drawerQuotationId) ?? null : null),
        [quotations, drawerQuotationId]
    );
    const [activeRelatedModule, setActiveRelatedModule] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [secondaryDrawerEntity, setSecondaryDrawerEntity] = useState<SecondaryDrawerEntity | null>(null);
    const [isLeftSidebarCollapsed, setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const closeThreePanelView = useCallback(() => {
        setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);
        setDrawerQuotationId(null);
        setActiveRelatedModule(null);
    }, []);

    const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
        const quote = quotations.find((q) => q.id === id);
        const label = quote?.quotationCode ? `"${quote.quotationCode}"` : 'this quotation';
        if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${label}?`)) return;

        try {
            await deleteMutation.mutateAsync(id);
            if (drawerQuotationId === id) {
                closeThreePanelView();
            }
            setToast({
                open: true,
                message: 'Quotation deleted successfully.',
                severity: 'success',
            });
        } catch {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Failed to delete quotation.', severity: 'error' });
        }
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        if (count === 0) return;
        if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${count} selected quotation(s)?`)) return;

        try {
            await bulkDeleteMutation.mutateAsync(selectedIds);
            if (drawerQuotationId && selectedIds.includes(drawerQuotationId)) {
                closeThreePanelView();
            }
            setSelectedIds([]);
            setToast({
                open: true,
                message: `${count} quotation(s) deleted successfully.`,
                severity: 'success',
            });
        } catch {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Failed to delete quotations.', severity: 'error' });
        }
    };

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<QuotationFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Quotations',
                icon: <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'draft',
                label: 'Draft',
                icon: <DraftsOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Draft').length,
                activeColor: '#64748b',
            },
            {
                id: 'sent',
                label: 'Sent',
                icon: <SendOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Sent').length,
                activeColor: '#2563eb',
            },
            {
                id: 'accepted',
                label: 'Accepted',
                icon: <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Accepted').length,
                activeColor: '#059669',
            },
            {
                id: 'rejected',
                label: 'Rejected',
                icon: <CancelOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Rejected').length,
                activeColor: '#dc2626',
            },
        ];
    }, [quotations]);

    // ── Filtering Logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredQuotations = useMemo(() => {
        let result = [...quotations];

        if (activeTab === 'draft') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Draft');
        } else if (activeTab === 'sent') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Sent');
        } else if (activeTab === 'accepted') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Accepted');
        } else if (activeTab === 'rejected') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Rejected');
        }

        if (searchQuery.trim()) {
            const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
            result = result.filter(
                (item) =>
                    (item.quotationCode && item.quotationCode.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.organizationName && item.organizationName.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.contactName && item.contactName.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.quotationTitle && item.quotationTitle.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.quotationSubject && item.quotationSubject.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.opportunityCode && item.opportunityCode.toLowerCase().includes(q))
            );
        }

        // Sorting
        result.sort((a, b) => {
            let valA: string | number = '';
            let valB: string | number = '';

            switch (sortField) {
                case 'quotationCode':
                    valA = a.quotationCode || '';
                    valB = b.quotationCode || '';
                    break;
                case 'organizationName':
                    valA = a.organizationName || '';
                    valB = b.organizationName || '';
                    break;
                case 'grandTotal':
                    valA = a.grandTotal || 0;
                    valB = b.grandTotal || 0;
                    break;
                case 'quoteDate':
                    valA = a.quoteDate || '';
                    valB = b.quoteDate || '';
                    break;
                case 'validUntil':
                    valA = a.validUntil || '';
                    valB = b.validUntil || '';
                    break;
                case 'status':
                    valA = a.status || '';
                    valB = b.status || '';
                    break;
                default:
                    valA = a.quotationCode || '';
                    valB = b.quotationCode || '';
            }

            if (typeof valA === 'number' && typeof valB === 'number') {
                return sortOrder === 'asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
            }
            return sortOrder === 'asc'
                ? String(valA).localeCompare(String(valB))
                : String(valB).localeCompare(String(valA));
        });

        return result;
    }, [quotations, activeTab, searchQuery, sortField, sortOrder]);

    const paginatedQuotations = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return filteredQuotations.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [filteredQuotations, page, rowsPerPage]);

    // ── Columns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Quotation>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'quotationCode',
                label: 'QUOTE CODE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (row) => (
                    <RecordLink
                        href={ROUTES.QUOTATION_DETAIL(row.id)}

                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                        }}
                    >
                        {row.quotationCode}
                    </RecordLink>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'quotationSubject',
                label: 'SUBJECT',
                sortable: false,
                minWidth: 220,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography
                        noWrap
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            color: '#1e293b',
                            maxWidth: 240,
                        }}
                        title={row.quotationSubject}
                    >
                        {row.quotationSubject || 'Quotation'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (row) => (

                        >
                            {row.organizationName}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'contactName',
                label: 'CONTACT PERSON',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                            {row.contactName}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'opportunityCode',
                label: 'OPPORTUNITY',
                sortable: false,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            color: '#2563eb',
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        }}
                    >
                        {row.opportunityCode || row.opportunityId || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'grandTotal',
                label: 'TOTAL AMOUNT',
                sortable: true,
                align: 'right',
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                        {formatCurrency(row.grandTotal)}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'quoteDate',
                label: 'DATE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {row.quoteDate}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'validUntil',
                label: 'VALID UNTIL',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {row.validUntil}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'status',
                label: 'STATUS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 110,
                render: (row) => {
                    const statusMap: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string; border: string }> = {
                        Draft: { bg: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569', border: '#cbd5e1' },
                        Sent: { bg: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe' },
                        Accepted: { bg: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', border: '#a7f3d0' },
                        Rejected: { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#b91c1c', border: '#fecaca' },
                    };
                    const currentStatus = String(row.quoteStage || row.status || 'Draft');
                    const st = statusMap[currentStatus] || statusMap.Draft;

                    return (
                        <Chip
                            label={currentStatus}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                backgroundColor: st.bg,
                                color: st.color,
                                border: `1px solid ${st.border}`,
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                height: 22,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        const isAsc = sortField === field && sortOrder === 'asc';
        setSortOrder(isAsc ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        setSortField(field as QuotationSortField);
    };

    const relatedModules = useRelatedModulesForEntity('quotation', selectedDrawerQuotation, setActiveRelatedModule);

    // Falls back to the first module until the user explicitly picks one.
    const effectiveRelatedModule = activeRelatedModule ?? relatedModules[0]?.id ?? null;
    const activeModuleMeta = relatedModules.find((m) => m.id === effectiveRelatedModule);

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Quotation, QuotationFilterTab>
            breadcrumbItems={[
                { label: 'Sales' },
                { label: 'Quotations' },
            ]}
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                variant: 'pill',
            }}
            tableId="quotations"
            headerActions={() => (
                <MasterHeaderActions
                    onRefresh={async () => {
                        const { isError } = await refetch();
                        setToast(
                            isError
                                ? { open: true, message: 'Failed to refresh quotations.', severity: 'error' }
                                : { open: true, message: 'Quotations refreshed.', severity: 'info' }
                        );
                    }}
                />
            )}
            searchConfig={buildExtendedSearchConfig({
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by quote code, customer, subject...',
                pageIds: paginatedQuotations.map((r) => r.id),
                allIds: filteredQuotations.map((r) => r.id),
                selectedIds,
                onSelectedIdsChange: setSelectedIds,
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalRecords: filteredQuotations.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            })}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedQuotations}
            keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={(id) => {
                setSelectedIds((prev) =>
                    prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
                );
            }}
            onToggleSelectAll={(checked) => {
                if (checked) {
                    setSelectedIds(paginatedQuotations.map((q) => q.id));
                } else {
                    setSelectedIds([]);
                }
            }}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(quote) => setDrawerQuotationId(quote.id)}
            getEditHref={(quote) => ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(quote.id)}
            onDelete={(quote) => handleDelete(quote.id)}
            onRowClick={(quote) => setDrawerQuotationId(quote.id)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerQuotation?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Quotation Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Quotation"
            deleteTooltip="Delete Quotation"
            // Strictly omit onEmptyAction and emptyActionLabel so no "+ New Quotation" button appears
            emptyTitle="No quotations found"
            emptyDescription="Quotations can be created directly from an Opportunity via the 'Create Quote' action."
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: filteredQuotations.length,
                entityLabel: 'Quotations',
                pageSizeOptions: [10, 25, 50],
                onPageChange: (newPage) => setPage(newPage),
                onRowsPerPageChange: (newRows) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(newRows);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            relatedSidebar={
                <RelatedModulesSidebar
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerQuotation)}
                    modules={relatedModules}
                    activeModuleId={effectiveRelatedModule ?? undefined}
                    onModuleSelect={(moduleId) => setActiveRelatedModule(moduleId)}
                    collapsed={isLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                    onToggleCollapse={setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                />
            }
            relatedRecordsTable={
                <RelatedRecordsTableView
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerQuotation && effectiveRelatedModule)}
                    moduleId={effectiveRelatedModule || ''}
                    moduleTitle={activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Related Records'}
                    parentRecordId={selectedDrawerQuotation?.id}
                    parentEntityTitle={selectedDrawerQuotation?.quotationCode || selectedDrawerQuotation?.quotationSubject || ''}
                    entityData={selectedDrawerQuotation}
                    entityType="quotation"
                    leftOffset={isLeftSidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 260}
                    rightOffset={580}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onRowClick={(row, modId) => setSecondaryDrawerEntity({ type: modId, data: row })}
                />
            }
            drawer={
                <QuotationDetailDrawer
                    quotation={selectedDrawerQuotation}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerQuotation)}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(id))}
                    onShowToast={(message, severity = 'success') => {
                        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
                    }}
                />
            }
            secondaryDrawer={
                secondaryDrawerEntity ? (
                    <RelatedSecondaryDrawer
                        entity={secondaryDrawerEntity}
                        moduleLabel={activeModuleMeta?.label}
                        parentTitle={selectedDrawerQuotation?.quotationCode || selectedDrawerQuotation?.quotationSubject}
                        onClose={() => setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null)}
                    />
                ) : null
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerQuotation)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Box, Divider } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    FIELD_MAX_LENGTH,
    FormGrid,
    SectionLabel,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfLookup,
    RhfAddressSection,
    RhfPhoneField,
    RhfUppercaseField,
    RhfEmailField,
} from '@/components/forms';
import type { QuotationFormData } from '@/types/quotation.types';
import { normalizeLegacyStateName } from '@/data/addressMaster';
import { normalizeCountryValue } from '@/utils/address';
import { useContacts, useOrganizations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';
import type { Contact } from '@/types/contact.types';

const NO_ORGANIZATIONS: ExtendedOrganization[] = [];
const NO_CONTACTS: Contact[] = [];

export function QuotationAddressSection() {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<QuotationFormData>();

    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' });
    const contactName = useWatch({ control, name: 'contactName' });

    const prevOrgRef = useRef(organizationName);
    const prevContactRef = useRef(contactName);

    // Organization and Contact options
    const { data: organizations = NO_ORGANIZATIONS } = useOrganizations();
    const { data: contacts = NO_CONTACTS } = useContacts();
    const orgOptions = useMemo(() => organizations.map((o) => o.organizationName), [organizations]);
    const contactOptions = useMemo(() => contacts.map((c) => c.name), [contacts]);

    // ── When Organization changes, auto-fill mailingName, gstNo & addresses ─────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!organizationName || organizationName === prevOrgRef.current) return;
        prevOrgRef.current = organizationName;

        const org = organizations.find(
            (o) =>
                o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                organizationName.trim().toLowerCase()
        );

        if (org) {
            const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
            if (org.mailingName) setValue('mailingName', org.mailingName, opts);
            if (org.gstNumber || org.gstNo) setValue('gstNo', org.gstNumber || org.gstNo || '', opts);

            // Country is set before state so the state field validates against the right country.
            const billingCountry = normalizeCountryValue(org.billingCountry);
            const shippingCountry = normalizeCountryValue(org.shippingCountry || org.billingCountry);

            const billingStreet = org.billingStreet || org.billingAddress;
            if (billingStreet) setValue('billingAddress', billingStreet, opts);
            setValue('billingCountry', billingCountry, opts);
            if (org.billingState) setValue('billingState', normalizeLegacyStateName(org.billingState, billingCountry), opts);
            if (org.billingCity) setValue('billingCity', org.billingCity, opts);
            if (org.billingPostalCode) setValue('billingPostalCode', org.billingPostalCode, opts);

            const shippingStreet = org.shippingStreet || org.shippingAddress;
            if (shippingStreet) setValue('shippingAddress', shippingStreet, opts);
            setValue('shippingCountry', shippingCountry, opts);
            if (org.shippingState) setValue('shippingState', normalizeLegacyStateName(org.shippingState, shippingCountry), opts);
            if (org.shippingCity) setValue('shippingCity', org.shippingCity, opts);
            if (org.shippingPostalCode) setValue('shippingPostalCode', org.shippingPostalCode, opts);
        }
    }, [organizationName, organizations, setValue]);

    // ── When Contact changes, auto-fill mobile & email ──────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!contactName || contactName === prevContactRef.current) return;
        prevContactRef.current = contactName;

        const contact = contacts.find(
            (c) =>
                c.name.trim().toLowerCase() === contactName.trim().toLowerCase()
        );

        if (contact) {
            const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
            if (contact.mobile) setValue('contactMobile', contact.mobile, opts);
            const email = contact.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email;
            if (email) setValue('contactEmail', email, opts);
        }
    }, [contactName, contacts, setValue]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            {/* ── Top Section: Organization & Contact Header Grid ── */}
            <SectionLabel label="ACCOUNT & CONTACT CONTEXT" sx={{ mb: 3 }} />

            <FormGrid columns={3} sx={{ mb: 4 }}>
                {/* ── Account ── */}
                <RhfLookup<QuotationFormData>
                    name="organizationName"
                    label="Organization"
                    options={orgOptions}
                    placeholder="Search or enter Organization..."
                    hint="Linked client organization"
                />
                <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="mailingName"
                    label="Mailing Name"
                    placeholder="Official organization legal name"
                    hint="As on billing documents"
                />
                <RhfUppercaseField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="gstNo"
                    label="GST NO"
                    placeholder="e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5"
                    maxLength={FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.gstin}
                    hint="Client GSTIN"
                />

                {/* ── Recipient ── */}
                <RhfLookup<QuotationFormData>
                    name="contactName"
                    label="Contact"
                    required
                    options={contactOptions}
                    placeholder="Search or enter Contact..."
                    hint="Signatory / quote recipient"
                    fieldSize="md"
                />
                <RhfPhoneField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="contactMobile"
                    label="Contact Mobile No"
                    placeholder="e.g. 9800000000"
                    hint="Direct phone / WhatsApp"
                />
                <RhfEmailField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="contactEmail"
                    label="Contact Email Address"
                    placeholder="contact@company.com"
                    hint="Receives the quotation PDF"
                />
            </FormGrid>

            <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />

            {/* ── Bottom Section: Reusable Billing & Shipping Address Grid ── */}
            <RhfAddressSection<QuotationFormData>
                required
                billingTitle="BILLING ADDRESS"
                shippingTitle="SHIPPING ADDRESS"
                streetLabel="Street"
                shippingStreetLabel="Street"
                copyLabel="Copy address from left"
            />
        </Box>
    );
}

export default QuotationAddressSection;

'use client';

export * from '@/components/forms/rhf/CrmLineItemsSection';

File: frontend-crm/src/components/quotations/sections/QuotationOverviewSection.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    FIELD_MAX_LENGTH,
    FormGrid,
    FormGridItem,
    SectionLabel,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfLookup,
} from '@/components/forms';
import {
    QUOTE_STAGES,
    QUOTE_COMPANIES,
    QUOTE_VALIDATION_PERIODS,
    QUOTE_TERMS_TEMPLATES,
    QUOTE_PAYMENT_TERMS,
    QUOTE_PREPARED_FOR_OPTIONS,
    TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS,
    PAYMENT_TERMS_DESCRIPTIONS,
    type QuotationFormData,
} from '@/types/quotation.types';
import { LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS } from '@/types/lead.types';

/** Select + its description stacked in one grid cell. */
const termsColumnSx = { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 } as const;

export function QuotationOverviewSection() {
    const { control, setValue, getValues } = useFormContext<QuotationFormData>();

    const quotationDate = useWatch({ control, name: 'quotationDate' });
    const validationPeriod = useWatch({ control, name: 'validationPeriod' });
    const termsAndCondition = useWatch({ control, name: 'termsAndCondition' });
    const paymentTerms = useWatch({ control, name: 'paymentTerms' });
    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' });
    const contactName = useWatch({ control, name: 'contactName' });

    // Track previous values so we only overwrite descriptions when user changes the dropdown selection
    const prevTermsRef = useRef(termsAndCondition);
    const prevPaymentTermsRef = useRef(paymentTerms);

    // ── Auto-calculate validUntil from quotationDate + validationPeriod ──────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!quotationDate) return;
        const days = parseInt(validationPeriod || '30', 10) || 30;
        const baseDate = new Date(quotationDate);
        if (isNaN(baseDate.getTime())) return;

        baseDate.setDate(baseDate.getDate() + days);
        const yyyy = baseDate.getFullYear();
        const mm = String(baseDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const dd = String(baseDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        const computedDate = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;

        if (getValues('validUntil') !== computedDate) {
            setValue('validUntil', computedDate, {
                shouldDirty: true,
                shouldValidate: true,
            });
        }
    }, [quotationDate, validationPeriod, getValues, setValue]);

    // ── Auto-populate Terms & Conditions Description template ────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (termsAndCondition && termsAndCondition !== prevTermsRef.current) {
            const template = TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS[termsAndCondition];
            if (template) {
                setValue('termsAndConditionDescription', template, {
                    shouldDirty: true,
                    shouldValidate: true,
                });
            }
            prevTermsRef.current = termsAndCondition;
        }
    }, [termsAndCondition, setValue]);

    // ── Auto-populate Payment Terms Description template ─────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (paymentTerms && paymentTerms !== prevPaymentTermsRef.current) {
            const template = PAYMENT_TERMS_DESCRIPTIONS[paymentTerms];
            if (template) {
                setValue('paymentTermsDescription', template, {
                    shouldDirty: true,
                    shouldValidate: true,
                });
            }
            prevPaymentTermsRef.current = paymentTerms;
        }
    }, [paymentTerms, setValue]);

    // ── Dynamic Prepared For Options ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const preparedForOptions = useMemo(() => {
        const set = new Set<string>(QUOTE_PREPARED_FOR_OPTIONS);
        if (contactName) set.add(contactName);
        if (organizationName) set.add(organizationName);
        return Array.from(set);
    }, [contactName, organizationName]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            <SectionLabel label="OVERVIEW" sx={{ mb: 3 }} />

            <FormGrid columns={3}>
                {/* ── Identity ── */}
                <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="quotationTitle"
                    label="Quotation Title"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. B-Softwares Enterprise Deal"
                    hint="Primary quote identifier"
                />
                <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="opportunityName"
                    label="Opportunity"
                    required
                    disabled
                    hint="Parent Opportunity"
                />
                <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                    name="company"
                    label="Company"
                    required
                    options={QUOTE_COMPANIES}
                    placeholder="Select Issuing Company"
                    hint="Default: Nandini Infosystems"
                />

                {/* ── Validity: date + period → valid until ── */}
                <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="quotationDate"
                    label="Quotation Date"
                    type="date"
                    required
                    slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                />
                <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                    name="validationPeriod"
                    label="Validation Period"
                    required
                    options={QUOTE_VALIDATION_PERIODS}
                    placeholder="Select Period"
                    hint="Default: 30 Days"
                />
                <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                    name="validUntil"
                    label="Valid Until"
                    type="date"
                    required
                    slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                    hint="Date + validation period"
                />

                {/* ── Workflow ── */}
                <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                    name="quoteStage"
                    label="Quote Stage"
                    required
                    options={QUOTE_STAGES}
                    placeholder="Select Quote Stage"
                    hint="Default: Draft"
                />
                <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                    name="preparedFor"
                    label="Prepared For"
                    required
                    options={preparedForOptions}
                    placeholder="Select Target Entity"
                    hint="Recipient role or linked entity"
                />
                <RhfLookup<QuotationFormData>

                        minRows={3}
