'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ConfirmationNumberOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PendingActionsOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PendingActionsOutlined';
import PriorityHighIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PriorityHigh';
import NewReleasesOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NewReleasesOutlined';
import { RecordLink } from '../../common/RecordLink';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../../common/CommonMasterView';
import { MasterHeaderActions } from '../../common/MasterHeaderActions';
import { buildExtendedSearchConfig } from '../../common/buildExtendedSearchConfig';
import { AppToast } from '../../common/AppToast';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
import { findCrmUser } from '@/services/masterData.store';
import {
    TICKET_PRIORITIES,
    TICKET_STATUSES,
    isTicketOpen,
    isTicketOverdue,
    type Ticket,
} from '@/types/ticket.types';
import { useTickets, useBulkDeleteTickets } from '@/hooks/queries';
import type { TicketFilterTab, TicketSortField } from './types';
import { RelatedModulesSidebar, RelatedRecordsTableView } from '../../common/Drawer';
import { RelatedSecondaryDrawer, type SecondaryDrawerEntity } from '../../common/RelatedSecondaryDrawer';
import { useRelatedModulesForEntity } from '@/config/relatedModules.config';
import { TicketDetailDrawer } from '../TicketDetailDrawer';
import { TicketPriorityPill, TicketStatusPill, formatTicketDue } from '../TicketBadges';

const RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS = 7;
const DAY_MS = 86400000;

const isHighPriority = (t: Ticket) => t.ticketPriority === 'High' || t.ticketPriority === 'Urgent';
const isRecent = (t: Ticket, now: number) => now - new Date(t.createdAt).getTime() <= RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS * DAY_MS;
const assigneeName = (username: string) => findCrmUser(username)?.name || username;

/** Sort keys that aren't plain alphabetical: priority/status by workflow order, due date chronologically. */
const sortValue = (t: Ticket, field: TicketSortField): string | number => {
    switch (field) {
        case 'ticketPriority':
            return TICKET_PRIORITIES.indexOf(t.ticketPriority);
        case 'ticketStatus':
            return TICKET_STATUSES.indexOf(t.ticketStatus);
        case 'dueDate':
            return t.dueDate ? new Date(t.dueDate).getTime() : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
        case 'ticketNumber':
            return parseInt(t.ticketNumber.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 0;
        case 'assignedTo':
            return assigneeName(t.assignedTo).toLowerCase();
        default:
            return (t[field] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
    }
};


/** Stable empty list while the first page loads (keeps memoized filters from recomputing). */
const NO_RECORDS: Ticket[] = [];
export function TicketsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const currentUsername = user?.username || '';

    const { data: tickets = NO_RECORDS, dataUpdatedAt: now, refetch } = useTickets();
    const bulkDeleteMutation = useBulkDeleteTickets();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TicketFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(25);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<TicketSortField>('ticketNumber');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
    // Tracked by id so the drawer always shows the cached copy and closes if the ticket is deleted.
    const [drawerTicketId, setDrawerTicketId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const selectedDrawerTicket = useMemo(
        () => (drawerTicketId ? tickets.find((t) => t.id === drawerTicketId) ?? null : null),
        [tickets, drawerTicketId]
    );
    const [activeRelatedModule, setActiveRelatedModule] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [secondaryDrawerEntity, setSecondaryDrawerEntity] = useState<SecondaryDrawerEntity | null>(null);
    const [isLeftSidebarCollapsed, setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: 'success' | 'info' | 'error' }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const matchesTab = useCallback(
        (t: Ticket, tab: TicketFilterTab) => {
            switch (tab) {
                case 'my':
                    return t.assignedTo === currentUsername;
                case 'open':
                    return isTicketOpen(t);
                case 'high_priority':
                    return isHighPriority(t);
                case 'recently_added':
                    return isRecent(t, now);
                default:
                    return true;
            }
        },
        [currentUsername, now]
    );

    // ── Filter Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredTickets = useMemo(() => {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
        return tickets.filter((t) => {
            if (!matchesTab(t, activeTab)) return false;
            if (!q) return true;
            return [
                t.ticketNumber,
                t.ticketSubject,
                t.organizationName,
                t.contactPersonName,
                t.contactNumber,
                t.natureOfCall,
                t.ticketStatus,
                t.assignedTo,
                assigneeName(t.assignedTo),
            ].some((v) => (v || '').toLowerCase().includes(q));
        });
    }, [tickets, activeTab, searchQuery, matchesTab]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedTickets = useMemo(() => {
        const dir = sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        return [...filteredTickets].sort((a, b) => {
            const va = sortValue(a, sortField);
            const vb = sortValue(b, sortField);
            if (va < vb) return -dir;
            if (va > vb) return dir;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredTickets, sortField, sortOrder]);

    // ── Pagination ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const paginatedTickets = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedTickets.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedTickets, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        const next = field as TicketSortField;
        if (sortField === next) {
            setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortField(next);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const handleToggleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        setSelectedIds(checked ? paginatedTickets.map((t) => t.id) : []);
    };

    const handleToggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((sid) => sid !== id) : [...prev, id]));
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        if (count === 0) return;
        if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${count} ticket(s)?`)) return;
        try {
            await bulkDeleteMutation.mutateAsync(selectedIds);
            setSelectedIds([]);
            setToast({ open: true, message: `${count} ticket(s) deleted.`, severity: 'success' });
        } catch {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Failed to delete tickets.', severity: 'error' });
        }
    };

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<TicketFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        const count = (tab: TicketFilterTab) => tickets.filter((t) => matchesTab(t, tab)).length;
        return [
            { id: 'all', label: 'All Tickets', icon: <ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, count: tickets.length },
            { id: 'my', label: 'My Tickets', icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, count: count('my') },
            { id: 'open', label: 'Open Tickets', icon: <PendingActionsOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, count: count('open') },
            { id: 'high_priority', label: 'High Priority', icon: <PriorityHighIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, count: count('high_priority') },
            { id: 'recently_added', label: 'Recently Added', icon: <NewReleasesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, count: count('recently_added') },
        ];
    }, [tickets, matchesTab]);

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Ticket>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'ticketNumber',
                label: 'TICKET',
                sortable: true,
                locked: true,
                minWidth: 260,
                render: (t) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#7c3aed', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                        <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                            <RecordLink
                                href={ROUTES.TICKET_DETAIL(t.id)}
                                onOpen={() => setDrawerTicketId(t.id)}
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    lineHeight: 1.2,
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {t.ticketNumber}
                            </RecordLink>
                            <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b', maxWidth: 260 }}>
                                {t.ticketSubject || t.problemReported}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (t) => (
                    <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#334155', maxWidth: 240 }}>
                        {t.organizationName || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'contactPersonName',
                label: 'CONTACT',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (t) => (
                    <Box>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{t.contactPersonName || '-'}</Typography>
                        {t.contactNumber && <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{t.contactNumber}</Typography>}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'ticketPriority',
                label: 'PRIORITY',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 100,
                render: (t) => <TicketPriorityPill priority={t.ticketPriority} />,
            },
            {
                id: 'ticketStatus',
                label: 'STATUS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (t) => <TicketStatusPill status={t.ticketStatus} />,
            },
            {
                id: 'natureOfCall',
                label: 'NATURE OF CALL',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (t) => <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569' }}>{t.natureOfCall || '-'}</Typography>,
            },
            {
                id: 'dueDate',
                label: 'DUE DATE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 170,
                render: (t) => {
                    const overdue = isTicketOverdue(t, now);
                    return (
                        <Box>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: overdue ? 700 : 500, color: overdue ? '#dc2626' : '#475569' }}>
                                {formatTicketDue(t.dueDate)}
                            </Typography>
                            {overdue && <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#dc2626' }}>Overdue</Typography>}
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedTo',
                label: 'ASSIGNED TO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (t) => <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569' }}>{assigneeName(t.assignedTo) || '-'}</Typography>,
            },
        ],
        [now]
    );

    const relatedModules = useRelatedModulesForEntity('ticket', selectedDrawerTicket, setActiveRelatedModule);

    // Falls back to the first module until the user explicitly picks one.
    const effectiveRelatedModule = activeRelatedModule ?? relatedModules[0]?.id ?? null;
    const activeModuleMeta = relatedModules.find((m) => m.id === effectiveRelatedModule);

    // Dismisses the three-panel view and returns to the clean master table.
    const closeThreePanelView = useCallback(() => {
        setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null);
        setDrawerTicketId(null);
        setActiveRelatedModule(null);
    }, []);

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Ticket, TicketFilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            tableId="tickets"
            headerActions={() => (
                <MasterHeaderActions
                    onRefresh={async () => {
                        const { isError } = await refetch();
                        setToast(
                            isError
                                ? { open: true, message: 'Failed to refresh tickets.', severity: 'error' }
                                : { open: true, message: 'Tickets refreshed.', severity: 'info' }
                        );
                    }}
                    onNewClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.TICKET_NEW)}
                    newButtonLabel="New Ticket"
                />
            )}
            searchConfig={buildExtendedSearchConfig({
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by ticket #, subject, organization, contact...',
                pageIds: paginatedTickets.map((r) => r.id),
                allIds: sortedTickets.map((r) => r.id),
                selectedIds,
                onSelectedIdsChange: setSelectedIds,
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalRecords: sortedTickets.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            })}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedTickets}
            keyExtractor={(t) => t.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleToggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(t) => router.push(ROUTES.TICKET_DETAIL(t.id))}
            getEditHref={(t) => ROUTES.TICKET_EDIT(t.id)}
            onRowClick={(t) => setDrawerTicketId(t.id)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerTicket?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Ticket"
            editTooltip="Edit Ticket"
            emptyTitle="No tickets found"
            emptyDescription="No support tickets match your current search and filter criteria."
            emptyActionLabel="Log Ticket"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.TICKET_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: sortedTickets.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onRowsPerPageChange: (n) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(n);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            relatedSidebar={
                <RelatedModulesSidebar
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerTicket)}
                    modules={relatedModules}
                    activeModuleId={effectiveRelatedModule ?? undefined}
                    onModuleSelect={(moduleId) => setActiveRelatedModule(moduleId)}
                    collapsed={isLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                    onToggleCollapse={setIsLeftSidebarCollapsed}
                />
            }
            relatedRecordsTable={
                <RelatedRecordsTableView
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerTicket && effectiveRelatedModule)}
                    moduleId={effectiveRelatedModule || ''}
                    moduleTitle={activeModuleMeta?.label || 'Related Records'}
                    parentRecordId={selectedDrawerTicket?.id}
                    parentEntityTitle={selectedDrawerTicket?.ticketSubject || ''}
                    entityData={selectedDrawerTicket}
                    entityType="ticket"
                    leftOffset={isLeftSidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 260}
                    rightOffset={580}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                    onRowClick={(row, modId) => setSecondaryDrawerEntity({ type: modId, data: row })}
                />
            }
            drawer={
                <TicketDetailDrawer
                    ticket={selectedDrawerTicket}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerTicket)}
                    onClose={closeThreePanelView}
                />
            }
            secondaryDrawer={
                secondaryDrawerEntity ? (
                    <RelatedSecondaryDrawer
                        entity={secondaryDrawerEntity}
                        moduleLabel={activeModuleMeta?.label}
                        parentTitle={selectedDrawerTicket?.ticketSubject}
                        onClose={() => setSecondaryDrawerEntity(null)}
                    />
                ) : null
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerTicket)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import type { TicketPriority, TicketStatus } from '@/types/ticket.types';

interface PillColors {
    bg: string;
    color: string;
    border: string;
    dot: string;
}

export const TICKET_PRIORITY_COLORS: Record<TicketPriority, PillColors> = {
    Urgent: { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#b91c1c', border: '#fecaca', dot: '#dc2626' },
    High: { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#dc2626', border: '#fecaca', dot: '#ef4444' },
    Normal: { bg: '#fffbeb', color: '#b45309', border: '#fde68a', dot: '#f59e0b' },
    Low: { bg: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569', border: '#e2e8f0', dot: '#94a3b8' },
};

export const TICKET_STATUS_COLORS: Record<TicketStatus, PillColors> = {
    New: { bg: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe', dot: '#3b82f6' },
    Assigned: { bg: '#eef2ff', color: '#4338ca', border: '#c7d2fe', dot: '#6366f1' },
    'In Progress': { bg: '#f5f3ff', color: '#6d28d9', border: '#ddd6fe', dot: '#8b5cf6' },
    'Pending Customer': { bg: '#fffbeb', color: '#b45309', border: '#fde68a', dot: '#f59e0b' },
    Escalated: { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#dc2626', border: '#fecaca', dot: '#ef4444' },
    Resolved: { bg: '#ecfdf5', color: '#059669', border: '#a7f3d0', dot: '#10b981' },
    Closed: { bg: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', border: '#a7f3d0', dot: '#059669' },
};

const FALLBACK: PillColors = { bg: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569', border: '#e2e8f0', dot: '#94a3b8' };

function Pill({ label, colors, rounded }: { label: string; colors: PillColors; rounded: string }) {
    return (
        <Box
            component="span"
            sx={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 0.6,
                px: 0.9,
                py: 0.25,
                borderRadius: rounded,
                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                backgroundColor: colors.bg,
                color: colors.color,
                border: `1px solid ${colors.border}`,
            }}
        >
            <Box component="span" sx={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: colors.dot }} />
            {label}
        </Box>
    );
}

export function TicketPriorityPill({ priority }: { priority: TicketPriority }) {
    return <Pill label={priority} colors={TICKET_PRIORITY_COLORS[priority] ?? FALLBACK} rounded="6px" />;
}

export function TicketStatusPill({ status }: { status: TicketStatus }) {
    return <Pill label={status} colors={TICKET_STATUS_COLORS[status] ?? FALLBACK} rounded="12px" />;
}

/** "27 Oct 2026, 6:00 pm" from a `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` / ISO value; '-' when empty or invalid. */
export function formatTicketDue(value: string | undefined): string {
    if (!value) return '-';
    const d = new Date(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return value;
    return d.toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' });
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ConfirmationNumberOutlined';
import ReportProblemOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReportProblemOutlined';
import BuildCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BuildCircleOutlined';
import ApartmentOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ApartmentOutlined';
import PersonOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import HandshakeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HandshakeOutlined';

import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { isTicketOverdue, type Ticket } from '@/types/ticket.types';

import { findCrmUser } from '@/services/masterData.store';
import { ReadOnlyField } from '@/components/forms/ReadOnlyField';
import {
    EntityDetailDrawer,
    DrawerSectionCard,
    DrawerMetricGrid,
    copyToClipboard,
} from '@/components/common/Drawer';
import { TICKET_FORM_TABS } from './TicketForm';
import { TicketPriorityPill, TicketStatusPill, formatTicketDue } from './TicketBadges';

export interface TicketDetailDrawerProps {
    ticket: Ticket | null;
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onEdit?: (id: string) => void;
    hideBackdrop?: boolean;
}

const sectionIcon = (icon: React.ReactNode) => (
    <Box sx={{ color: '#2563eb', display: 'inline-flex' }}>{icon}</Box>
);

const getInitials = (name: string) => {
    const parts = name.replace(/[._-]+/g, ' ').trim().split(/\s+/);
    return ((parts[0]?.[0] ?? '') + (parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1][0] : '')).toUpperCase();
};

/** Labelled multi-line text; renders nothing when empty. */
function TextBlock({ label, value }: { label: string; value?: string }) {
    if (!value?.trim()) return null;
    return (
        <Box sx={{ '& + &': { mt: 1.5 } }}>
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', letterSpacing: 0.3, mb: 0.4 }}>
                {label.toUpperCase()}
            </Typography>
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#334155', lineHeight: 1.55, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>{value}</Typography>
        </Box>
    );
}

const flagChip = (label: string) => (
    <Chip
        key={label}
        label={label}
        size="small"
        sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 700, backgroundColor: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '1px solid #bfdbfe' }}
    />
);

export function TicketDetailDrawer({ ticket, open, onClose, onEdit, hideBackdrop }: TicketDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { data: freshTicket } = useTicket(open && ticket?.id ? ticket.id : undefined);
    const t = freshTicket ?? ticket;

    if (!t) return null;

    const handleEdit = () => (onEdit ? onEdit(t.id) : router.push(ROUTES.TICKET_EDIT(t.id)));
    const overdue = isTicketOverdue(t);
    const assignedUser = findCrmUser(t.assignedTo);
    const assignedDisplayName = assignedUser?.name || t.assignedTo;
    const flags = [t.amcFlag && 'AMC', t.cloudFlag && 'Cloud'].filter((f): f is string => Boolean(f));

    return (
        <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            hideBackdrop={hideBackdrop}
            title={t.ticketSubject || t.ticketNumber}
            subtitle={`${t.ticketNumber} • ${t.organizationName}`}
            avatarIcon={<ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon />}
            avatarBg="linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed 0%, #6d28d9 100%)"
            badges={[
                {
                    label: t.ticketNumber,
                    isMonospace: true,
                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                    borderColor: '#bfdbfe',
                },
                {
                    label: t.natureOfCall || 'General',
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    color: '#475569',
                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
                onView: () => router.push(ROUTES.TICKET_DETAIL(t.id)),
            }}
            formTabs={TICKET_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                overview: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                        <DrawerMetricGrid
                            items={[
                                { label: 'PRIORITY', value: <TicketPriorityPill priority={t.ticketPriority} />, bg: '#f8fafc', borderColor: '#f1f5f9', p: 1.2 },
                                { label: 'STATUS', value: <TicketStatusPill status={t.ticketStatus} />, bg: '#f8fafc', borderColor: '#f1f5f9', p: 1.2 },
                                {
                                    label: 'SUPPORT TYPE',
                                    value: t.supportType,
                                    valueSize: '0.92rem',
                                    valueWeight: 800,
                                    bg: '#f8fafc',
                                    borderColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                    p: 1.2,
                                    sublabel: flags.length ? <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0.5, mt: 0.6 }}>{flags.map(flagChip)}</Box> : undefined,
                                },
                                {
                                    label: 'DUE DATE',
                                    value: formatTicketDue(t.dueDate),
                                    valueSize: '0.86rem',
                                    valueWeight: 800,
                                    labelColor: overdue ? '#b91c1c' : undefined,
                                    valueColor: overdue ? '#b91c1c' : '#0f172a',
                                    bg: overdue ? '#fef2f2' : '#f8fafc',
                                    borderColor: overdue ? '#fecaca' : '#f1f5f9',
                                    p: 1.2,
                                    sublabel: overdue ? (
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#dc2626', mt: 0.4 }}>Overdue</Typography>
                                    ) : undefined,
                                },
                            ]}
                        />

                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} icon={sectionIcon(<ReportProblemOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="Problem Details">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 1.5, mb: 1.5 }}>
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Nature Of Call" value={t.natureOfCall} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Support Mode" value={t.supportMode} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Source" value={t.source} />
                            </Box>
                            <TextBlock label="Problem Reported" value={t.problemReported} />
                            <TextBlock label="Problem Observed" value={t.problemObserved} />
                            <TextBlock label="Reason For Escalated Calls" value={t.reasonForEscalatedCalls} />
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} icon={sectionIcon(<BuildCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="Resolution & RCA">
                            {t.resolution || t.rca || t.addDescription ? (
                                <>
                                    <TextBlock label="Resolution" value={t.resolution} />
                                    <TextBlock label="RCA (Root Cause Analysis)" value={t.rca} />
                                    <TextBlock label="Additional Description" value={t.addDescription} />
                                </>
                            ) : (
                                <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>No resolution recorded yet.</Typography>
                            )}
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} icon={sectionIcon(<ApartmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="Client & Contact Information">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)', gap: 1.5 }}>
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Organization" value={t.organizationName} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Contact Person" value={t.contactPersonName} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Contact Number" value={t.contactNumber} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Contact Email" value={t.contactEmail} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Left Job" value={t.leftJob} />
                            </Box>
                            <Box sx={{ mt: 1.5 }}>
                                <TextBlock label="Account Address" value={t.accountAddress} />
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} icon={sectionIcon(<PersonOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="Assigned Representative">
                            {t.assignedTo ? (
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.25 }}>
                                    <Box
                                        sx={{
                                            width: 34,
                                            height: 34,
                                            borderRadius: '50%',
                                            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #4f46e5 100%)',
                                            color: '#ffffff',
                                            display: 'flex',
                                            alignItems: 'center',
                                            justifyContent: 'center',
                                            fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                            fontWeight: 700,
                                            boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.25)',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {getInitials(assignedDisplayName)}
                                    </Box>
                                    <Box>
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>
                                            {assignedDisplayName}
                                        </Typography>
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                            {assignedUser ? `${assignedUser.role} • ${assignedUser.department}` : 'Support Representative'}
                                        </Typography>
                                    </Box>
                                </Box>
                            ) : (
                                <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>Unassigned</Typography>
                            )}
                        </DrawerSectionCard>
                    </Box>
                ),
                partner_company: (
                    <DrawerSectionCard p={1.8} icon={sectionIcon(<HandshakeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />)} title="Partner Company">
                        {t.partnerCompany || t.partnerCompanyContact ? (
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)', gap: 1.5 }}>
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Partner Company" value={t.partnerCompany} />
                                <ReadOnlyField label="Partner Company Contact" value={t.partnerCompanyContact} />
                            </Box>
                        ) : (
                            <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>No partner company involved.</Typography>
                        )}
                    </DrawerSectionCard>
                ),
            }}
            auditEntity={{ type: 'tickets', id: t.id }}
            includeChangesTab
            statusText={overdue ? `${t.ticketStatus} • Overdue` : t.ticketStatus}
            primaryAction={{ label: 'Edit Ticket', onClick: handleEdit }}
            secondaryAction={{
                label: 'Copy Ticket Number',
                icon: <ContentCopyOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                onClick: () => copyToClipboard(t.ticketNumber),
            }}
        />
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/components/tickets/TicketForm.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ConfirmationNumberOutlined';
import HandshakeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HandshakeOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import { ticketFormSchema } from '@/validations';
import {
    NATURE_PRIORITY_TO_TICKET_PRIORITY,
    SUPPORT_MODES,
    SUPPORT_TYPES,
    TICKET_PRIORITIES,
    TICKET_SOURCES,
    TICKET_STATUSES,
    type NatureOfCallItem,
    type TicketFormData,
    type TicketPriority,
} from '@/types/ticket.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';
import type { Contact } from '@/types/contact.types';
import type { PartnerCompany, PartnerCompanyContact } from '@/types/partner.types';
import { ticketService } from '@/services';
import { useContacts, useMasterData, useOrganizations } from '@/hooks/queries';
import { formatAddressLine } from '@/utils/address';

import {
    CommonFormLayout,
    AppToast,
    FormGrid,
    FormGridItem,
    fieldSizeSx,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfLookup,
    RhfAssignedUserCard,
    RhfToggleGroupCard,
    RhfDateTimeField,
    RhfPhoneField,
    RhfEmailField,
    useRhfForm,
} from '@/components/forms';

type TicketTabKey = 'overview' | 'partner_company';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Ticket Form Tabs ──────────────────────────────
export const TICKET_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: TicketTabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'OVERVIEW',
        icon: <ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'partner_company',
        label: 'Partner Company',
        icon: <HandshakeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

export const DEFAULT_TICKET_FORM: TicketFormData = {
    amcFlag: false,
    ticketSubject: '',
    organizationName: '',
    contactPersonName: '',
    contactNumber: '',
    ticketPriority: 'Normal',
    source: 'Call',
    supportType: 'Free',
    problemReported: '',
    resolution: '',
    reasonForEscalatedCalls: '',
    assignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',
    cloudFlag: false,
    natureOfCall: '',
    accountAddress: '',
    contactEmail: '',
    leftJob: 'No',
    ticketStatus: 'New',
    dueDate: '',
    supportMode: 'Offsite Support',
    problemObserved: '',
    rca: '',
    addDescription: '',
    partnerCompany: '',
    partnerCompanyContact: '',
};


const organizationAddress = (o: ExtendedOrganization) =>
    o.billingAddress ||
    formatAddressLine({
        street: o.billingStreet,
        city: o.billingCity,
        state: o.billingState,
        postalCode: o.billingPostalCode,
        country: o.billingCountry,
    });

const primaryEmail = (c: Contact) => (c.emailAddresses.find((e) => e.isPrimary) ?? c.emailAddresses[0])?.email ?? '';

export interface TicketFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';
    initialData?: Partial<TicketFormData>;
    ticketId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

// Stable fallbacks while the lists load, so memoized suggestions don't recompute every render.
const EMPTY_ORGANIZATIONS: ExtendedOrganization[] = [];
const EMPTY_CONTACTS: Contact[] = [];

export default function TicketForm({ mode = 'create', initialData, ticketId, breadcrumbItems }: TicketFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TicketTabKey>('overview');
    const [ticketNumber, setTicketNumber] = useState('');

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } = useRhfForm<TicketFormData>({
        schema: ticketFormSchema,
        defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_TICKET_FORM, ...initialData },
    });

    const { reset, getValues, setValue, control, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const ticketSubject = useWatch({ control, name: 'ticketSubject' });
    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' });

    const { data: organizations = EMPTY_ORGANIZATIONS } = useOrganizations();
    const { data: contacts = EMPTY_CONTACTS } = useContacts();
    const { natureOfCalls, partnerCompanies, partnerContacts } = useMasterData();
    const organizationNames = useMemo(() => organizations.map((o) => o.organizationName), [organizations]);

    // Narrow contact suggestions to the chosen organization when it has any contacts on file.
    const contactNames = useMemo(() => {
        const org = organizationName?.trim().toLowerCase();
        const inOrg = org ? contacts.filter((c) => c.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() === org) : [];
        return (inOrg.length > 0 ? inOrg : contacts).map((c) => c.name);
    }, [contacts, organizationName]);

    const natureOfCallNames = useMemo(() => natureOfCalls.map((n) => n.name), [natureOfCalls]);
    const partnerCompanyNames = useMemo(() => partnerCompanies.map((p) => p.companyName), [partnerCompanies]);
    const partnerCompany = useWatch({ control, name: 'partnerCompany' });

    // Same narrowing for partner contacts: only the chosen partner's people, when it has any.
    const partnerContactNames = useMemo(() => {
        const company = partnerCompany?.trim().toLowerCase();
        const inCompany = company ? partnerContacts.filter((c) => c.partnerCompany.toLowerCase() === company) : [];
        return (inCompany.length > 0 ? inCompany : partnerContacts).map((c) => c.name);
    }, [partnerContacts, partnerCompany]);

    const recordLabel = ticketNumber || ticketSubject || 'Ticket';
    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Support' },
        { label: 'Tickets', href: ROUTES.TICKETS },
        {
            label:
                mode === 'create'
                    ? 'Create Ticket'
                    : `${mode === 'view' ? 'View' : 'Edit'}: ${recordLabel}`,
        },
    ];

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!ticketId) return;
        let active = true;
        ticketService
            .getById(ticketId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) {
                    setTicketNumber(found.ticketNumber);
                    reset({ ...DEFAULT_TICKET_FORM, ...found });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [ticketId, reset]);

    const touch = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
    const sameName = (a: string, b: string) => a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();

    const clearContactFields = () => {
        setValue('contactPersonName', '', { shouldDirty: true });
        setValue('contactNumber', '', touch);
        setValue('contactEmail', '', touch);
    };

    // ── Organization selection & clear ───────────────────────────────────────
    const handleOrganizationPicked = (org: ExtendedOrganization) => {
        // Always overwrite: switching organizations must replace the previous one's address.
        setValue('accountAddress', organizationAddress(org), touch);
        // A contact who belongs to a different organization no longer applies.
        const currentContact = getValues('contactPersonName')?.trim();
        if (currentContact) {
            const match = contacts.find((c) => sameName(c.name, currentContact));
            if (match && match.organizationName && !sameName(match.organizationName, org.organizationName)) {
                clearContactFields();
            }
        }
    };

    const handleOrganizationCleared = () => {
        setValue('accountAddress', '', touch);
        clearContactFields();
    };

    // ── Contact selection & clear ────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleContactPicked = (contact: Contact) => {
        setValue('contactNumber', contact.mobile || '', touch);
        setValue('contactEmail', primaryEmail(contact), touch);
        if (contact.organizationName) {
            setValue('organizationName', contact.organizationName, touch);
            const org = organizations.find((o) => sameName(o.organizationName, contact.organizationName));
            // No directory record for the contact's organization: don't leave a previous one's address behind.
            setValue('accountAddress', org ? organizationAddress(org) : '', touch);
        }
    };

    const handleContactCleared = () => {
        setValue('contactNumber', '', touch);
        setValue('contactEmail', '', touch);
    };

    // ── Nature of call → suggested priority ──────────────────────────────────
    // Priority set by the last nature-of-call pick. If the current priority differs from it (or from the
    // default before any pick), the user chose it explicitly and it is left alone.
    const autoPriorityRef = useRef<TicketPriority | null>(null);
    const handleNatureOfCallPicked = (item: NatureOfCallItem) => {
        const current = getValues('ticketPriority');
        const untouched = current === (autoPriorityRef.current ?? DEFAULT_TICKET_FORM.ticketPriority);
        if (!untouched) return;
        const suggested = NATURE_PRIORITY_TO_TICKET_PRIORITY[item.priority];
        autoPriorityRef.current = suggested;
        setValue('ticketPriority', suggested, touch);
    };

    // ── Partner company & contact ────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handlePartnerCompanyPicked = (partner: PartnerCompany) => {
        const contactName = getValues('partnerCompanyContact')?.trim();
        const contact = contactName ? partnerContacts.find((c) => sameName(c.name, contactName)) : undefined;
        if (contact && !sameName(contact.partnerCompany, partner.companyName)) {
            setValue('partnerCompanyContact', '', { shouldDirty: true });
        }
    };

    const handlePartnerContactPicked = (contact: PartnerCompanyContact) => {
        setValue('partnerCompany', contact.partnerCompany, touch);
    };

    const submit = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (mode === 'create') {
                const created = await ticketService.create(values);
                showToast(`Ticket ${created.ticketNumber} created successfully!`, 'success');
            } else if (ticketId) {
                await ticketService.update(ticketId, values);
                showToast('Ticket updated successfully!', 'success');
            }
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.TICKETS), 800);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save ticket.', 'error');
        }
    });

    // Every required field lives on OVERVIEW, so show it before validating to let the error focus land.
    const handleSave = () => {
        setActiveTab('overview');
        submit();
    };

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (mode !== 'view' && isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved ticket changes?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.TICKETS);
    };

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={TICKET_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as TicketTabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={mode === 'view' ? () => router.push(ROUTES.TICKET_EDIT(ticketId!)) : handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Edit Ticket' : mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Ticket' : 'Save Ticket'}
                cancelLabel={mode === 'view' ? 'Back' : 'Cancel'}
                recordView={{
                    title: ticketSubject || ticketNumber || '',
                    editHref: ticketId ? ROUTES.TICKET_EDIT(ticketId) : undefined,
                    editLabel: 'Edit Ticket',
                    backHref: ROUTES.TICKETS,
                }}
                mode={mode}
                toast={<AppToast open={toast.open} message={toast.message} severity={toast.severity} onClose={closeToast} />}
            >
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'overview'}>
                    {/* Entitlements */}
                    <Box sx={fieldSizeSx('lg')}>
                        <RhfToggleGroupCard<TicketFormData>
                            items={[
                                { name: 'amcFlag', label: 'Active AMC', caption: 'Annual maintenance contract' },
                                { name: 'cloudFlag', label: 'Active Cloud', caption: 'Cloud hosting subscription' },
                            ]}
                        />
                    </Box>

                    <FormGrid columns={3} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                        {/* ── Customer ── */}
                        <RhfTextField<TicketFormData> name="ticketSubject" label="Ticket Subject" placeholder="Short summary of the issue" />
                        <RhfLookup<TicketFormData, 'organization'>
                            name="organizationName"
                            label="Organization Name"
                            required
                            options={organizationNames}
                            lookupType="organization"
                            onSelectRecord={handleOrganizationPicked}
                            onClearRecord={handleOrganizationCleared}
                            placeholder="Search or select organization..."
                        />
                        <RhfLookup<TicketFormData, 'contact'>
                            name="contactPersonName"
                            label="Contact Person Name"
                            required
                            options={contactNames}
                            lookupType="contact"
                            onSelectRecord={handleContactPicked}
                            onClearRecord={handleContactCleared}
                            placeholder="Search or select contact..."
                            fieldSize="md"
                        />

                        {/* ── Contact channels ── */}
                        <RhfPhoneField<TicketFormData> name="contactNumber" label="Contact Number" placeholder="e.g. 9876543210" />
                        <RhfEmailField<TicketFormData> name="contactEmail" label="Contact Email" placeholder="e.g. name@company.com" />
                        <RhfSelect<TicketFormData> name="leftJob" label="Left Job" options={['No', 'Yes']} />

                        {/* ── Classification ── */}
                        <RhfLookup<TicketFormData, 'natureOfCall'>
                            name="natureOfCall"
                            label="Nature Of Call"
                            required
                            options={natureOfCallNames}
                            lookupType="natureOfCall"
                            onSelectRecord={handleNatureOfCallPicked}
                            hint="Sets a suggested priority"
                            placeholder="Search or select nature of call..."
                        />
                        <RhfSelect<TicketFormData> name="ticketPriority" label="Ticket Priority" required options={TICKET_PRIORITIES} />
                        <RhfSelect<TicketFormData> name="ticketStatus" label="Ticket Status" options={TICKET_STATUSES} />

                        {/* ── Channel ── */}
                        <RhfSelect<TicketFormData> name="source" label="Source" options={TICKET_SOURCES} />
                        <RhfSelect<TicketFormData> name="supportType" label="Support Type" options={SUPPORT_TYPES} />
                        <RhfSelect<TicketFormData> name="supportMode" label="Support Mode" required options={SUPPORT_MODES} />

                        {/* ── Scheduling & ownership ── */}
                        <RhfDateTimeField<TicketFormData> dateName="dueDate" label="Due Date" required combined />
                        <RhfAssignedUserCard<TicketFormData> name="assignedTo" label="Assigned to" required roleBadge="Primary Rep" />
                        <FormGridItem>
                            <RhfTextField<TicketFormData>
                                name="accountAddress"
                                label="Account Address"
                                multiline
                                minRows={2}
                                hint="From the selected organization"
                                placeholder="Customer site address"
                                fieldSize="lg"
                            />
                        </FormGridItem>
                    </FormGrid>

                    {/* ── Case notes: textareas three to a row ── */}
                    <FormGrid columns={3} sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
                        <FormGridItem>
                            <RhfTextField<TicketFormData>
                                name="problemReported"
                                label="Problem Reported"
                                required
                                multiline
                                minRows={3}
                                placeholder="What the customer reported..."
                            />
                        </FormGridItem>
                        <FormGridItem>
                            <RhfTextField<TicketFormData> name="problemObserved" label="Problem Observed" multiline minRows={3} placeholder="What the engineer found..." />
                        </FormGridItem>
                        <FormGridItem>
                            <RhfTextField<TicketFormData> name="rca" label="RCA (Root Cause Analysis)" multiline minRows={3} placeholder="Underlying cause..." />
                        </FormGridItem>
                        <FormGridItem>
                            <RhfTextField<TicketFormData> name="resolution" label="Resolution" multiline minRows={3} placeholder="Steps taken to resolve..." />
                        </FormGridItem>
                        <FormGridItem>
                            <RhfTextField<TicketFormData>
                                name="reasonForEscalatedCalls"
                                label="Reason For Escalated Calls"
                                multiline
                                minRows={3}
                                placeholder="Why this call was escalated..."
                            />
                        </FormGridItem>
                        <FormGridItem>
                            <RhfTextField<TicketFormData> name="addDescription" label="Add Description" multiline minRows={3} placeholder="Additional notes..." />
                        </FormGridItem>
                    </FormGrid>
                </div>

                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'partner_company'}>
                    <FormGrid columns={2}>
                        <RhfLookup<TicketFormData, 'partnerCompany'>
                            name="partnerCompany"
                            label="Partner Company"
                            options={partnerCompanyNames}
                            lookupType="partnerCompany"
                            onSelectRecord={handlePartnerCompanyPicked}
                            onClearRecord={() => setValue('partnerCompanyContact', '', { shouldDirty: true })}
                            placeholder="Search or select partner company..."
                        />
                        <RhfLookup<TicketFormData, 'partnerCompanyContact'>
                            name="partnerCompanyContact"
                            label="Partner Company Contact"
                            options={partnerContactNames}
                            lookupType="partnerCompanyContact"
                            onSelectRecord={handlePartnerContactPicked}
                            placeholder="Search or select partner contact..."
                        />
                    </FormGrid>
                </div>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

const API_PORT = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_PORT || '8008';

// Resolve the API host from the page's own hostname so the same build works on
// localhost, LAN IPs and the public server IP. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL overrides it.
function resolveApiUrl(): string {
    if (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) return process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL;
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        return `${window.location.protocol}//${window.location.hostname}:${API_PORT}`;
    }
    return `http://localhost:${API_PORT}`;
}

export const ENV = {
    get API_URL() {
        return resolveApiUrl();
    },
} as const;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import GroupsOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GroupsOutlined';
import TrendingUpOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TrendingUpOutlined';
import AccountTreeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountTreeOutlined';
import FolderOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FolderOutlined';
import Inventory2OutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Inventory2Outlined';
import RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RequestQuoteOutlined';

import type { RelatedModuleItem } from '@/components/common/Drawer/RelatedModulesSidebar';
import type { AuditRevisionItem } from '@/components/common/Drawer/types';

    useContacts,
    useEntityAuditLogs,

    type AuditEntityType,
