export type CrmEntityType =
    | 'organization'
    | 'contact'
    | 'lead'
    | 'opportunity'
    | 'product'
    | 'quotation'
    | 'ticket';

export type RelatedRecordRow = Record<string, unknown>;

export interface RelatedRecordDatasets {
    contacts?: Contact[];
    opportunities?: Opportunity[];
    quotations?: Quotation[];
    leads?: Lead[];
    organizations?: ExtendedOrganization[];
    products?: Product[];
    tickets?: Ticket[];
    auditRevisions?: AuditRevisionItem[];
}

export function normalizeRelatedModuleKey(moduleId: string): string {
    const normalized = moduleId.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, '_');
    if (normalized === 'quotes') return 'quotations';
    if (normalized === 'line_items') return 'products';
    return normalized;
}

const AUDIT_ENTITY_MAP: Record<CrmEntityType, AuditEntityType> = {
    organization: 'organizations',
    contact: 'contacts',
    lead: 'leads',
    opportunity: 'opportunities',
    product: 'products',
    quotation: 'quotations',
    ticket: 'tickets',
};

interface ExtractedEntityContext {
    entityType?: CrmEntityType;
    recordId: string;
    title: string;
    orgId: string;
    orgName: string;
    contactId: string;
    contactName: string;
    oppId: string;
    oppCode: string;
    productId: string;
    productName: string;
    lineItems: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

function extractEntityContext(
    entityType?: CrmEntityType,
    entityData?: unknown,
    parentEntityTitle = '',
    parentRecordId = ''
): ExtractedEntityContext {
    const obj =
        entityData && typeof entityData === 'object'
            ? (entityData as Record<string, unknown>)
            : {};

    const recordId = String(parentRecordId || obj.id || '').trim();
    const rawTitle = String(
        parentEntityTitle ||
            obj.organizationName ||
            obj.name ||
            obj.productName ||
            obj.quotationCode ||
            obj.opportunityCode ||
            ''
    ).trim();

    const isOrg = entityType === 'organization' || ('accountCode' in obj && !('leadCode' in obj));
    const isContact = entityType === 'contact' || ('isPrimaryContact' in obj && 'organizationId' in obj);
    const isOpp = entityType === 'opportunity' || 'opportunityCode' in obj;
    const isProduct = entityType === 'product' || ('productCode' in obj && 'mrp' in obj);

    const orgId = String(obj.organizationId || (isOrg ? recordId : '')).trim();
    const orgName = String(obj.organizationName || (isOrg ? rawTitle : ''))
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

    const contactId = String(obj.contactId || (isContact ? recordId : '')).trim();
    const contactName = String(
        obj.contactName || obj.contactPersonName || (isContact ? obj.name || rawTitle : '')
    )
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

    const oppId = String(obj.opportunityId || (isOpp ? recordId : '')).trim();
    const oppCode = String(obj.opportunityCode || '')
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

    const productId = String(isProduct ? recordId : '').trim();
    const productName = String(obj.productName || (isProduct ? rawTitle : ''))
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

    const lineItems = Array.isArray(obj.lineItems)
        ? (obj.lineItems as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
        : [];

    return {
        entityType,
        recordId,
        title: rawTitle,
        orgId,
        orgName: orgName || rawTitle.toLowerCase(),
        contactId,
        contactName,
        oppId,
        oppCode,
        productId,
        productName,
        lineItems,
    };
}

/**
 * Resolves linked records for both `RelatedModulesSidebar` badge counts and `RelatedRecordsTableView`
 * table rows from live React Query datasets (no sync cache or fabricated mock entries).
 */
export function resolveRelatedRecordsForModule(
    moduleId: string,
    parentEntityTitle: string,
    parentRecordId?: string,
    entityData?: unknown,
    entityType?: CrmEntityType,
    datasets: RelatedRecordDatasets = {}
): RelatedRecordRow[] {
    const moduleKey = normalizeRelatedModuleKey(moduleId);
    const ctx = extractEntityContext(entityType, entityData, parentEntityTitle, parentRecordId);

    switch (moduleKey) {
        case 'contacts': {
            const contacts = datasets.contacts ?? [];
            return contacts
                .filter((c) => {
                    if (
                        ctx.entityType === 'opportunity' ||
                        ctx.entityType === 'quotation' ||
                        ctx.entityType === 'ticket'
                    ) {
                        if (ctx.contactId && c.id === ctx.contactId) return true;
                        if (ctx.contactName && c.name.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.contactName) return true;
                    }
                    if (ctx.orgId && c.organizationId === ctx.orgId) return true;
                    if (
                        ctx.orgName &&
                        c.organizationName &&
                        c.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.orgName
                    ) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                })
                .map((c) => ({ ...c }));
        }

        case 'opportunities': {
            const opps = datasets.opportunities ?? [];
            return opps
                .filter((o) => {
                    if (ctx.entityType === 'quotation' && ctx.oppId && o.id === ctx.oppId) return true;
                    if (
                        ctx.entityType === 'quotation' &&
                        ctx.oppCode &&
                        o.opportunityCode.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.oppCode
                    ) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (ctx.entityType === 'contact') {
                        if (ctx.contactId && o.contactId === ctx.contactId) return true;
                        if (
                            ctx.contactName &&
                            o.contactName &&
                            o.contactName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.contactName
                        ) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ctx.entityType === 'product' && (ctx.productId || ctx.productName)) {
                        return Boolean(
                            o.lineItems?.some(
                                (li) =>
                                    (ctx.productId && li.productId === ctx.productId) ||
                                    li.productName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.productName
                            )
                        );
                    }
                    if (ctx.orgId && o.organizationId === ctx.orgId) return true;
                    if (
                        ctx.orgName &&
                        o.organizationName &&
                        o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.orgName
                    ) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                })
                .map((o) => ({ ...o }));
        }

        case 'quotations': {
            const quotes = datasets.quotations ?? [];
            return quotes
                .filter((q) => {
                    if (ctx.entityType === 'opportunity') {
                        if (ctx.recordId && q.opportunityId === ctx.recordId) return true;
                        if (
                            ctx.oppCode &&
                            q.opportunityCode &&
                            q.opportunityCode.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.oppCode
                        ) {
                            return true;
                        }
                        return false;
                    }
                    if (ctx.entityType === 'contact') {
                        if (ctx.recordId && q.contactId === ctx.recordId) return true;
                        if (
                            ctx.contactName &&
                            q.contactName &&
                            q.contactName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.contactName
                        ) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ctx.entityType === 'product' && (ctx.productId || ctx.productName)) {
                        return Boolean(
                            q.lineItems?.some(
                                (li) =>
                                    (ctx.productId && li.productId === ctx.productId) ||
                                    li.productName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.productName
                            )
                        );
                    }
                    if (ctx.orgId && q.organizationId === ctx.orgId) return true;
                    if (
                        ctx.orgName &&
                        q.organizationName &&
                        q.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.orgName
                    ) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                })
                .map((q) => ({ ...q }));
        }

        case 'leads': {
            const leads = datasets.leads ?? [];
            return leads
                .filter(
                    (l) =>
                        ctx.orgName &&
                        l.organizationName &&
                        l.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.orgName
                )
                .map((l) => ({ ...l }));
        }

        case 'organizations': {
            const orgs = datasets.organizations ?? [];
            if (ctx.entityType === 'product' && (ctx.productId || ctx.productName)) {
                const quotes = datasets.quotations ?? [];
                const opps = datasets.opportunities ?? [];
                const matchedOrgIds = new Set<string>();
                const matchedOrgNames = new Set<string>();
                quotes.forEach((q) => {
                    if (
                        q.lineItems?.some(
                            (li) =>
                                (ctx.productId && li.productId === ctx.productId) ||
                                li.productName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.productName
                        )
                    ) {
                        if (q.organizationId) matchedOrgIds.add(q.organizationId);
                        if (q.organizationName) matchedOrgNames.add(q.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase());
                    }
                });
                opps.forEach((o) => {
                    if (
                        o.lineItems?.some(
                            (li) =>
                                (ctx.productId && li.productId === ctx.productId) ||
                                li.productName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.productName
                        )
                    ) {
                        if (o.organizationId) matchedOrgIds.add(o.organizationId);
                        if (o.organizationName) matchedOrgNames.add(o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase());
                    }
                });
                return orgs
                    .filter(
                        (org) =>
                            matchedOrgIds.has(org.id) ||
                            matchedOrgNames.has(org.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase())
                    )
                    .map((org) => ({ ...org }));
            }

            return orgs
                .filter(
                    (org) =>
                        (ctx.orgId && org.id === ctx.orgId) ||
                        (ctx.orgName && org.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.orgName)
                )
                .map((org) => ({ ...org }));
        }

        case 'products': {
            const catalog = datasets.products ?? [];
            if (ctx.lineItems.length > 0) {
                return ctx.lineItems.map((li, idx) => {
                    const matchedProduct = catalog.find(
                        (p) =>
                            p.id === li.productId ||
                            p.productName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                                String(li.productName || '')
                                    .trim()
                                    .toLowerCase()
                    );
                    return {
                        ...(matchedProduct || {}),
                        ...li,
                        id: String(li.id || matchedProduct?.id || `li-${idx}`),
                        productName: String(li.productName || matchedProduct?.productName || '-'),
                        serialNumber: String(matchedProduct?.productCode || '-'),
                        status: matchedProduct?.isActive === false ? 'Inactive' : 'Active',
                    };
                });
            }

            if (ctx.orgId || ctx.orgName) {
                const linkedQuotes = (datasets.quotations ?? []).filter(
                    (q) =>
                        (ctx.orgId && q.organizationId === ctx.orgId) ||
                        (ctx.orgName &&
                            q.organizationName &&
                            q.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() === ctx.orgName)
                );
                const seenProducts = new Map<string, RelatedRecordRow>();
                linkedQuotes.forEach((q) => {
                    (q.lineItems || []).forEach((li, idx) => {
                        const key = String(li.productId || li.productName || idx);
                        if (!seenProducts.has(key)) {
                            const matchedProduct = catalog.find(
                                (p) =>
                                    p.id === li.productId ||
                                    p.productName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                                        String(li.productName || '')
                                            .trim()
                                            .toLowerCase()
                            );
                            seenProducts.set(key, {
                                ...(matchedProduct || {}),
                                ...li,
                                id: String(matchedProduct?.id || li.id || key),
                                productName: String(li.productName || matchedProduct?.productName || '-'),
                                serialNumber: String(matchedProduct?.productCode || '-'),
                                status: matchedProduct?.isActive === false ? 'Inactive' : 'Active',
                            });
                        }
                    });
                });
                return Array.from(seenProducts.values());
            }

            return [];
        }

        case 'tickets': {
            const sameText = (a: string | undefined, b: string) =>
                Boolean(b) && (a || '').trim().toLowerCase() === b;
            return (datasets.tickets ?? [])
                .filter((t) => {
                    if (ctx.entityType === 'contact') {
                        return (
                            (ctx.contactId && t.contactId === ctx.contactId) ||
                            sameText(t.contactPersonName, ctx.contactName)
                        );
                    }
                    return (
                        (ctx.orgId && t.organizationId === ctx.orgId) ||
                        sameText(t.organizationName, ctx.orgName)
                    );
                })
                .map((t) => ({
                    ...t,
                    subject: t.ticketSubject || t.problemReported,
                    status: t.ticketStatus,
                    priority: t.ticketPriority,
                    dateCreated: new Date(t.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN'),
                    assignedUser: t.assignedTo,
                }));
        }

        case 'history':
        case 'conversion_audit': {
            const revisions = datasets.auditRevisions ?? [];
            return revisions.map((rev, idx) => ({
                id: `rev-${ctx.recordId || 'rec'}-${idx}`,
                subject: rev.note ? `${rev.title} — ${rev.note}` : rev.title,
                status: rev.to || 'Recorded',
                contact: ctx.contactName || ctx.title || '-',
                dateModified: rev.time,
                dateCreated: rev.time,
                dueDate: '-',
                assignedUser: rev.author,
            }));
        }

        case 'activities':
        case 'contracts':
        case 'partner_contacts':
        case 'member_organizations':
        case 'documents':
        case 'partner_company':
        case 'security_groups':
        case 'notes':
        default:
            return [];
    }
}

/**
 * Fetches the live datasets needed to compute related records and badge counts for an active drawer entity.
 * Queries are disabled when `enabled` is false or `entityData` is null.
 */
export function useRelatedDatasets(
    entityType: CrmEntityType,
    entityData?: unknown,
    enabled = true
): RelatedRecordDatasets {
    const active = Boolean(enabled && entityData);
    const ctx = useMemo(() => extractEntityContext(entityType, entityData), [entityType, entityData]);

    const contactFilter = useMemo(
        () => (ctx.orgId ? { organizationId: ctx.orgId } : undefined),
        [ctx.orgId]
    );
    const oppFilter = useMemo(() => {
        if (entityType === 'contact' && ctx.contactId) return { contactId: ctx.contactId };
        if (entityType === 'product' && ctx.productId) return { productId: ctx.productId };
        if (ctx.orgId) return { organizationId: ctx.orgId };
        return undefined;
    }, [entityType, ctx.contactId, ctx.productId, ctx.orgId]);

    const quoteFilter = useMemo(() => {
        if (entityType === 'opportunity' && ctx.recordId) return { opportunityId: ctx.recordId };
        if (entityType === 'contact' && ctx.contactId) return { contactId: ctx.contactId };
        if (entityType === 'product' && ctx.productId) return { productId: ctx.productId };
        if (ctx.orgId) return { organizationId: ctx.orgId };
        return undefined;
    }, [entityType, ctx.recordId, ctx.contactId, ctx.productId, ctx.orgId]);

    const ticketFilter = useMemo(() => {
        if (entityType === 'contact' && ctx.contactId) return { contactId: ctx.contactId };
        if (ctx.orgId) return { organizationId: ctx.orgId };
        return undefined;
    }, [entityType, ctx.contactId, ctx.orgId]);

    const leadFilter = useMemo(
        () => (ctx.title && entityType === 'organization' ? { organizationName: ctx.title } : undefined),
        [entityType, ctx.title]
    );

    const needsContacts = active && ['organization', 'opportunity', 'quotation', 'ticket'].includes(entityType);
    const needsOpps = active && ['organization', 'contact', 'quotation', 'product'].includes(entityType);
    const needsQuotes = active && ['organization', 'contact', 'opportunity', 'product'].includes(entityType);
    const needsLeads = active && entityType === 'organization';
    const needsOrgs = active && ['contact', 'opportunity', 'quotation', 'ticket', 'product'].includes(entityType);
    const needsProducts = active && ['organization', 'opportunity', 'quotation'].includes(entityType);
    const needsTickets = active && ['organization', 'contact'].includes(entityType);

    const { data: contacts } = useContacts(contactFilter, { enabled: needsContacts });
    const { data: opportunities } = useOpportunities(oppFilter, { enabled: needsOpps });
    const { data: quotations } = useQuotations(quoteFilter, { enabled: needsQuotes });
    const { data: leads } = useLeads(leadFilter, { enabled: needsLeads });
    const { data: organizations } = useOrganizations(undefined, { enabled: needsOrgs });
    const { data: products } = useProducts(undefined, { enabled: needsProducts });
    const { data: tickets } = useTickets(ticketFilter, { enabled: needsTickets });
    const { data: auditRevisions } = useEntityAuditLogs(
        AUDIT_ENTITY_MAP[entityType],
        active && ctx.recordId ? ctx.recordId : undefined
    );

    return useMemo(
        () => ({
            contacts,
            opportunities,
            quotations,
            leads,
            organizations,
            products,
            tickets,
            auditRevisions,
        }),
        [contacts, opportunities, quotations, leads, organizations, products, tickets, auditRevisions]
    );
}

export function getRelatedModulesForEntity(
    entityType: CrmEntityType,
    entityData?: unknown,
    onSelectModule?: (moduleId: string) => void,
    datasets: RelatedRecordDatasets = {}
): RelatedModuleItem[] {
    const ctx = extractEntityContext(entityType, entityData);

    const countFor = (moduleId: string): number => {
        if (!entityData) return 0;
        return resolveRelatedRecordsForModule(
            moduleId,
            ctx.title,
            ctx.recordId,
            entityData,
            entityType,
            datasets
        ).length;
    };

    const withClick = (
        items: Array<{ id: string; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }>
    ): RelatedModuleItem[] =>
        items.map((item) => ({
            ...item,
            count: countFor(item.id),
            onClick: onSelectModule ? () => onSelectModule(item.id) : undefined,
        }));

    switch (entityType) {
        case 'organization':
            return withClick([
                { id: 'activities', label: 'Activities', icon: <AssignmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'tickets', label: 'Tickets', icon: <ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'contacts', label: 'Contacts', icon: <PeopleOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'contracts', label: 'Contracts', icon: <DescriptionOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'leads', label: 'Leads', icon: <PersonAddAlt1OutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'partner-contacts', label: 'Partner Contacts', icon: <GroupsOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'opportunities', label: 'Opportunities', icon: <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'member-organizations', label: 'Member Organizations', icon: <AccountTreeOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'documents', label: 'Documents', icon: <FolderOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'products', label: 'Products', icon: <Inventory2OutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'quotations', label: 'Quotations', icon: <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'partner-company', label: 'Partner Company', icon: <HandshakeOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'security-groups', label: 'Security Groups', icon: <AdminPanelSettingsOutlinedIcon /> },
            ]);

        case 'contact':
            return withClick([
                { id: 'activities', label: 'Activities', icon: <AssignmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'tickets', label: 'Tickets', icon: <ConfirmationNumberOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'organizations', label: 'Organizations', icon: <ApartmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'opportunities', label: 'Opportunities', icon: <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'quotations', label: 'Quotations', icon: <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon /> },
            ]);

        case 'lead':
            return withClick([
                { id: 'activities', label: 'Activities', icon: <AssignmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'notes', label: 'Notes', icon: <StickyNote2OutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'conversion-audit', label: 'Conversion Audit', icon: <SwapHorizOutlinedIcon /> },
            ]);

        case 'opportunity':
            return withClick([
                { id: 'activities', label: 'Activities', icon: <AssignmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'quotes', label: 'Quotes', icon: <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'contacts', label: 'Contacts', icon: <PeopleOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'organizations', label: 'Organizations', icon: <ApartmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'products', label: 'Products/Line Items', icon: <Inventory2OutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon /> },
            ]);

        case 'quotation':
            return withClick([
                { id: 'line-items', label: 'Line Items', icon: <Inventory2OutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'opportunities', label: 'Opportunities', icon: <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'organizations', label: 'Organizations', icon: <ApartmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'contacts', label: 'Contacts', icon: <PeopleOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon /> },
            ]);

        case 'ticket':
            return withClick([
                { id: 'activities', label: 'Activities', icon: <AssignmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'organizations', label: 'Organizations', icon: <ApartmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'contacts', label: 'Contacts', icon: <PeopleOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon /> },
            ]);

        case 'product':
            return withClick([
                { id: 'quotations', label: 'Quotations', icon: <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'opportunities', label: 'Opportunities', icon: <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'organizations', label: 'Organizations', icon: <ApartmentOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'documents', label: 'Documents', icon: <FolderOutlinedIcon /> },
                { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon /> },
            ]);
    }
}

/**
 * React hook wrapper around `getRelatedModulesForEntity` that automatically subscribes to live React Query
 * datasets when `entityData` is non-null.
 */
export function useRelatedModulesForEntity(
    entityType: CrmEntityType,
    entityData?: unknown,
    onSelectModule?: (moduleId: string) => void
): RelatedModuleItem[] {
    const datasets = useRelatedDatasets(entityType, entityData, Boolean(entityData));
    return useMemo(
        () => (entityData ? getRelatedModulesForEntity(entityType, entityData, onSelectModule, datasets) : []),
        [entityType, entityData, onSelectModule, datasets]
    );
}

"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { authService } from '../services/auth.service';
import type { User, LoginPayload } from '../types/auth.types';

interface AuthContextType {
    user: User | null;
    loading: boolean;
    error: string | null;
    isAuthenticated: boolean;
    login: (credentials: LoginPayload) => Promise<void>;
    logout: () => Promise<void>;
    refreshUser: () => Promise<void>;
    clearError: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const clearError = useCallback(() => {
        setError(null);
    }, []);

    const refreshUser = useCallback(async () => {
        try {
            const res = await authService.getMe();
            setUser(res.user);
            setError(null);
        } catch {
            setUser(null);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        authService
            .getMe()
            .then((res) => {
                if (active) {
                    setUser(res.user);
                    setError(null);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                if (active) {
                    setUser(null);
                }
            })
            .finally(() => {
                setLoading(false);
            });
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, []);

    const login = async (credentials: LoginPayload) => {
        const res = await authService.login(credentials);
        setUser(res.user);
        setError(null);
    };

    const logout = async () => {
        try {
            await authService.logout();
        } finally {
            setUser(null);
            setError(null);
        }
    };

    return (
        <AuthContext.Provider
            value={{
                user,
                loading,
                error,
                isAuthenticated: !!user,
                login,
                logout,
                refreshUser,
                clearError,
            }}
        >
            {children}
        </AuthContext.Provider>
    );
}

export function useAuth(): AuthContextType {
    const context = useContext(AuthContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
    }
    return context;
}

'use client';

import React, { createContext, useContext, useMemo } from 'react';

export type FormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'view';

interface FormModeContextValue {
    mode: FormMode;
}

const FormModeContext = createContext<FormModeContextValue>({ mode: 'create' });

/** Tells shared form primitives (FormField, StyledSelect, EmailRow…) whether to render inputs or read-only values. */
export function FormModeProvider({ mode, children }: { mode: FormMode; children: React.ReactNode }) {
    const value = useMemo(() => ({ mode }), [mode]);
    return <FormModeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</FormModeContext.Provider>;
}

export function useFormMode(): FormModeContextValue {
    return useContext(FormModeContext);
}

File: frontend-crm/src/context/QueryProvider.tsx
================
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { subscribeCrmUpdates } from '@/services/crmSync';
import { queryKeys, queryEntityFromSync } from '@/hooks/queries/queryKeys';
import { auditLogKeys } from '@/hooks/queries/useAuditLogs';

export function QueryProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    const [queryClient] = useState(
        () =>
            new QueryClient({
                defaultOptions: {
                    queries: {
                        staleTime: 60 * 1000,
                        gcTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
                        refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
                        retry: 1,
                    },
                },
            })
    );

    // Bridge: every notifyCrmUpdate (this tab or another) invalidates the matching cache. Updates from an
    // entity without its own keys (e.g. lead conversion, which writes several entities) invalidate everything.
    // Any write also adds audit entries, so revision trails refetch too.
    useEffect(
        () =>
            subscribeCrmUpdates(({ entity }) => {
                const key = queryEntityFromSync(entity);
                queryClient.invalidateQueries(key ? { queryKey: queryKeys[key].all } : undefined);
                if (key) queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: auditLogKeys.all });
            }),
        [queryClient]
    );

    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
}

// ── Master tables ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** All countries in ISO list order (alphabetical by name). */
export const COUNTRY_MASTER: readonly CountryMasterItem[] = COUNTRY_ROWS.map(
    ([countryName, iso2Code, iso3Code, numericCode]) => ({ countryName, iso2Code, iso3Code, numericCode })
);

const COUNTRY_BY_ISO2 = new Map(COUNTRY_MASTER.map((c) => [c.iso2Code, c]));

/** Countries for dropdowns: India first, then the rest alphabetically. */
export const COUNTRY_OPTIONS: readonly CountryMasterItem[] = [
    ...COUNTRY_MASTER.filter((c) => c.iso2Code === DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE),
    ...COUNTRY_MASTER.filter((c) => c.iso2Code !== DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE),
];

export const STATE_REGION_MASTER: readonly StateRegionMasterItem[] = SUBDIVISION_ROWS.map(
    ([countryIso2, subdivisionCode, subdivisionName, typeIdx]) => ({
        countryName: COUNTRY_BY_ISO2.get(countryIso2)?.countryName ?? '',
        countryIso2,
        subdivisionCode,
        subdivisionName,
        subdivisionType: SUBDIVISION_TYPES[typeIdx] ?? '',
    })
);

// ── Normalisation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Diacritic/case/punctuation-insensitive key: 'Haryāna' → 'haryana', 'Jammu & Kashmir' → 'jammu and kashmir'.
 * Use it for search matching so ASCII input finds ISO names with diacritics.
 */
export function normalizeSearchText(text?: string | null): string {
    return (text ?? '')
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/&/g, ' and ')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
}

/** Strips diacritics but keeps case and punctuation: 'Haryāna' → 'Haryana', 'Jammu and Kashmīr' → 'Jammu and Kashmir'. */
export function toPlainName(text: string): string {
    return text.normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '');
}

/** True when `option` contains `query`, ignoring case and diacritics. */
export function matchesSearch(option: string, query: string): boolean {
    return normalizeSearchText(option).includes(normalizeSearchText(query));
}

// Common names/abbreviations that differ from the ISO short names in the master.
const COUNTRY_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = {
    usa: 'US',
    'united states of america': 'US',
    america: 'US',
    uk: 'GB',
    'great britain': 'GB',
    britain: 'GB',
    england: 'GB',
    uae: 'AE',
    russia: 'RU',
    'south korea': 'KR',
    korea: 'KR',
    'north korea': 'KP',
    vietnam: 'VN',
    iran: 'IR',
    syria: 'SY',
    laos: 'LA',
    bolivia: 'BO',
    venezuela: 'VE',
    tanzania: 'TZ',
    moldova: 'MD',
    taiwan: 'TW',
    'czech republic': 'CZ',
    turkey: 'TR',
    'ivory coast': 'CI',
    burma: 'MM',
    'hong kong': 'HK',
};

const COUNTRY_BY_KEY = new Map<string, string>();
for (const c of COUNTRY_MASTER) {
    COUNTRY_BY_KEY.set(normalizeSearchText(c.countryName), c.iso2Code);
    COUNTRY_BY_KEY.set(c.iso3Code.toLowerCase(), c.iso2Code);
}
for (const [alias, iso2] of Object.entries(COUNTRY_ALIASES)) {
    if (COUNTRY_BY_ISO2.has(iso2) && !COUNTRY_BY_KEY.has(alias)) COUNTRY_BY_KEY.set(alias, iso2);
}

// ── Country helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Canonical ISO2 code for an ISO2/ISO3 code or a (legacy) country name, e.g. 'India' → 'IN', 'usa' → 'US'.
 * Returns `fallback` for empty or unrecognised input (pass DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE to default to India).
 */
export function resolveCountryIso2(input?: string | null, fallback = ''): string {
    const raw = (input ?? '').trim();
    if (!raw) return fallback;
    const upper = raw.toUpperCase();
    if (upper.length === 2 && COUNTRY_BY_ISO2.has(upper)) return upper;
    return COUNTRY_BY_KEY.get(normalizeSearchText(raw)) ?? fallback;
}

/** Display name for a code or name ('IN' → 'India'). Unrecognised input is returned trimmed (manual entry). */
export function getCountryNameByCode(codeOrName?: string | null): string {
    const iso2 = resolveCountryIso2(codeOrName);
    return iso2 ? (COUNTRY_BY_ISO2.get(iso2)?.countryName ?? '') : (codeOrName ?? '').trim();
}

export function getCountryByCode(codeOrName?: string | null): CountryMasterItem | undefined {
    return COUNTRY_BY_ISO2.get(resolveCountryIso2(codeOrName));
}

// ── Subdivision helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const subdivisionCache = new Map<string, readonly StateRegionMasterItem[]>();

/** Subdivisions of a country (by code or name), sorted by name. Empty when the country is unknown. */
export function getSubdivisionsByCountry(countryCodeOrName?: string | null): readonly StateRegionMasterItem[] {
    const iso2 = resolveCountryIso2(countryCodeOrName);
    if (!iso2) return [];
    let list = subdivisionCache.get(iso2);
    if (!list) {
        list = STATE_REGION_MASTER.filter((s) => s.countryIso2 === iso2).sort((a, b) =>
            a.subdivisionName.localeCompare(b.subdivisionName, 'en', { sensitivity: 'base' })
        );
        subdivisionCache.set(iso2, list);
    }
    return list;
}

/**
 * Dropdown labels for the state/region field of the given country, with STATE_NOT_LISTED last.
 * Empty when no country is selected.
 */
export function getStateOptionLabelsForCountry(countryCodeOrName?: string | null): string[] {
    if (!resolveCountryIso2(countryCodeOrName)) return [];
    const names = [...new Set(getSubdivisionsByCountry(countryCodeOrName).map((s) => s.subdivisionName))];
    return [...names, STATE_NOT_LISTED];
}

// Pre-ISO / colloquial Indian names still found in older records.
const LEGACY_SUBDIVISION_ALIASES: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {
    IN: {
        orissa: 'IN-OD',
        pondicherry: 'IN-PY',
        uttaranchal: 'IN-UK',
        'new delhi': 'IN-DL',
        'nct of delhi': 'IN-DL',
        'national capital territory of delhi': 'IN-DL',
        'dadra and nagar haveli': 'IN-DH',
        'daman and diu': 'IN-DH',
        'andaman and nicobar': 'IN-AN',
        'j and k': 'IN-JK',
    },
};

/** Finds the master subdivision for a state name or ISO 3166-2 code (full 'IN-DL' or suffix 'DL'). */
export function findSubdivision(
    stateInput?: string | null,
    countryCodeOrName?: string | null
): StateRegionMasterItem | undefined {
    const raw = (stateInput ?? '').trim();
    if (!raw) return undefined;
    const iso2 = resolveCountryIso2(countryCodeOrName, DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE);
    const list = getSubdivisionsByCountry(iso2);
    const key = normalizeSearchText(raw);
    const upper = raw.toUpperCase();
    const aliasCode = LEGACY_SUBDIVISION_ALIASES[iso2]?.[key];
    return list.find(
        (s) =>
            normalizeSearchText(s.subdivisionName) === key ||
            s.subdivisionCode === upper ||
            s.subdivisionCode === `${iso2}-${upper}` ||
            s.subdivisionCode === aliasCode
    );
}

/**
 * Maps a stored state value onto the canonical master name ('Haryana' → 'Haryāna', 'Orissa' → 'Odisha').
 * Values that don't match (manual entries) are returned trimmed, unchanged. Country defaults to India.
 */
export function normalizeLegacyStateName(stateInput?: string | null, countryCodeOrName?: string | null): string {
    const raw = (stateInput ?? '').trim();
    if (!raw || raw === STATE_NOT_LISTED) return raw;
    return findSubdivision(raw, countryCodeOrName)?.subdivisionName ?? raw;
}

File: frontend-crm/src/data/countryPhoneCodes.ts

import { getCountries, getCountryCallingCode, type CountryCode } from 'libphonenumber-js';
import { COUNTRY_MASTER, DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE } from './addressMaster';

/**
 * Country dial-code dataset for the international phone input. Names and ISO-3 codes come from the CRM address
 * master (so they match every other country picker); dial codes come from libphonenumber-js metadata, which
 * stays correct for shared codes (+1, +44, +7...). Flags are CDN images - emoji flags don't render on Windows.
 */
export interface PhoneCountry {
    name: string;
    iso2: string;
    iso3: string;
    /** With plus sign, e.g. '+91'. */
    dialCode: string;
    /** 20px-wide PNG and its 2x variant for retina screens. */
    flagUrl: string;
    flagUrl2x: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY_ISO2 = DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE;

export const flagUrl = (iso2: string, width: 20 | 40 = 20): string =>
    `https://flagcdn.com/w${width}/${iso2.toLowerCase()}.png`;

const supported = new Set<string>(getCountries());

export const PHONE_COUNTRIES: readonly PhoneCountry[] = COUNTRY_MASTER.filter((c) => supported.has(c.iso2Code))
    .map((c) => ({
        name: c.countryName,
        iso2: c.iso2Code,
        iso3: c.iso3Code,
        dialCode: `+${getCountryCallingCode(c.iso2Code as CountryCode)}`,
        flagUrl: flagUrl(c.iso2Code, 20),
        flagUrl2x: flagUrl(c.iso2Code, 40),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

const BY_ISO2 = new Map(PHONE_COUNTRIES.map((c) => [c.iso2, c]));

export const getPhoneCountry = (iso2?: string | null): PhoneCountry | undefined =>
    iso2 ? BY_ISO2.get(iso2.toUpperCase()) : undefined;

/** Matches by country name, ISO-2, ISO-3 or dial code ("+91" / "91"). */
export function matchesPhoneCountry(country: PhoneCountry, query: string): boolean {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return true;
    const dial = country.dialCode.slice(1);
    const qDigits = q.replace(/^\+/, '');
    return (
        country.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        country.iso2.toLowerCase() === q ||
        country.iso3.toLowerCase().startsWith(q) ||
        (/^\d+$/.test(qDigits) && dial.startsWith(qDigits))
    );
}

File: frontend-crm/src/hooks/queries/createEntityHooks.ts

import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { CrudService } from '@/services/base.service';
import type { PaginatedResponse, PaginationParams } from '@/types/api.types';
import type { EntityQueryKeys } from './queryKeys';

/**
 * Builds list/detail queries and create/update/delete mutations for a CRUD service. Mutations invalidate the
 * entity's cache (services also broadcast `notifyCrmUpdate`, which reaches other tabs).
 */
export function createEntityHooks<T, CreateDto, UpdateDto>(
    keys: EntityQueryKeys,
    service: CrudService<T, CreateDto, UpdateDto>
) {
    /** Every record matching `params` (filters such as `organizationId`), e.g. for lookups and related lists. */
    function useList(params?: PaginationParams, options: { enabled?: boolean } = {}) {
        return useQuery<T[]>({
            queryKey: keys.list(params),
            queryFn: () => service.getAll(params),
            enabled: options.enabled ?? true,
        });
    }

    /** Server-paginated page (`{ data, total, page, limit }`) with smooth page-to-page transitions. */
    function usePaginatedList(params?: PaginationParams, options: { enabled?: boolean } = {}) {
        return useQuery<PaginatedResponse<T>>({
            queryKey: [...keys.list(params), 'paginated'] as const,
            queryFn: () => service.list(params),
            placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
            enabled: options.enabled ?? true,
        });
    }

    /** Resolves to `null` when the record doesn't exist (TanStack Query doesn't allow `undefined` data). */
    function useDetail(id?: string) {
        return useQuery<T | null>({
            queryKey: keys.detail(id ?? ''),
            queryFn: async () => (await service.getById(id!)) ?? null,
            enabled: Boolean(id),
        });
    }

    function useCreate() {
        const queryClient = useQueryClient();
        return useMutation({
            mutationFn: (data: CreateDto) => service.create(data),
            onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.all }),
        });
    }

    function useUpdate() {
        const queryClient = useQueryClient();
        return useMutation({
            mutationFn: ({ id, data }: { id: string; data: UpdateDto }) => service.update(id, data),
            // `all` covers the record's detail key too.
            onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.all }),
        });
    }

    function useDelete() {
        const queryClient = useQueryClient();
        return useMutation({
            mutationFn: (id: string) => service.delete(id),
            onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.all }),
        });
    }

    function useBulkDelete() {
        const queryClient = useQueryClient();
        return useMutation({
            mutationFn: (ids: string[]) => service.deleteBulk(ids),
            onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.all }),
        });
    }

    return { useList, usePaginatedList, useDetail, useCreate, useUpdate, useDelete, useBulkDelete };
}

File: frontend-crm/src/hooks/queries/queryKeys.ts

import type { PaginationParams } from '@/types/api.types';

/** Hierarchical keys (`all` → `lists`/`details` → one list/record) so invalidation can target any level. */
function createEntityKeys<E extends string>(entity: E) {
    const all = [entity] as const;
    return {
        all,
        lists: () => [...all, 'list'] as const,
        list: (params?: PaginationParams) => [...all, 'list', params ?? {}] as const,
        details: () => [...all, 'detail'] as const,
        detail: (id: string) => [...all, 'detail', id] as const,
    };
}

export type EntityQueryKeys = ReturnType<typeof createEntityKeys<string>>;

export const queryKeys = {
    organizations: createEntityKeys('organizations'),
    contacts: createEntityKeys('contacts'),
    tickets: createEntityKeys('tickets'),
    leads: createEntityKeys('leads'),
    opportunities: createEntityKeys('opportunities'),
    quotations: createEntityKeys('quotations'),
    products: createEntityKeys('products'),
    users: {
        all: ['users'] as const,
    },
} as const;

export type QueryEntity = keyof typeof queryKeys;

/**
 * Maps a `notifyCrmUpdate` entity (services pass their endpoint, e.g. `/api/tickets`) to its query-key
 * namespace, or undefined when no queries are cached under it.
 */
export function queryEntityFromSync(entity?: string): QueryEntity | undefined {
    const name = entity?.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop()?.toLowerCase();
    return name && name in queryKeys ? (name as QueryEntity) : undefined;
}

File: frontend-crm/src/hooks/queries/useAuditLogs.ts

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { AuditRevisionItem } from '@/components/common/Drawer/types';
import { apiClient } from '@/services/apiClient';
import type { ApiResponse } from '@/types/api.types';

/** `entityType` values accepted by GET /api/audit-logs/:entityType/:entityId. */
export type AuditEntityType = 'organizations' | 'contacts' | 'leads' | 'opportunities' | 'quotations' | 'products' | 'tickets';

interface EntityAuditLog {
    entityType: string;
    entityId: string;
    revisions: AuditRevisionItem[];
}

export const auditLogKeys = {
    all: ['auditLogs'] as const,
    entity: (entityType: AuditEntityType, entityId: string) => ['auditLogs', entityType, entityId] as const,
};

/** Revision trail of one record (newest first), shown in the detail drawer's Changes tab. */
export function useEntityAuditLogs(entityType: AuditEntityType, entityId: string | undefined) {
    return useQuery({
        queryKey: auditLogKeys.entity(entityType, entityId ?? ''),
        queryFn: async () => {
            const res = await apiClient.get<ApiResponse<EntityAuditLog>>(`/api/audit-logs/${entityType}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId!)}`);
            return res.data.revisions;
        },
        enabled: Boolean(entityId),
        staleTime: 15 * 1000,
    });
}

import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { emptySearchResults, searchCrm, type GlobalSearchResults } from '@/services/globalSearch.service';

/** Global search results for a (debounced) query; previous results stay visible while the next query loads. */
export function useGlobalSearch(query: string, limitPerCategory = 5): { results: GlobalSearchResults; isFetching: boolean } {
    const trimmed = query.trim();
    const remote = useQuery({
        queryKey: ['globalSearch', trimmed.toLowerCase(), limitPerCategory],
        queryFn: () => searchCrm(trimmed, limitPerCategory),
        enabled: trimmed.length > 0,
        placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
        staleTime: 30 * 1000,
    });

    if (!trimmed) return { results: emptySearchResults(), isFetching: false };
    return { results: remote.data ?? emptySearchResults(), isFetching: remote.isFetching };
}

File: frontend-crm/src/hooks/useFormDraftGuard.ts
================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

const SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;

export interface UseFormDraftGuardOptions<T> {
    /** Unique localStorage key for this form instance (e.g. per record id). */
    draftKey: string;
    isDirty: boolean;
    currentValues: T;
    /** Pristine values; a draft identical to these is never stored. */
    defaultValues: T;
    onRestoreDraft: (savedValues: T) => void;
    enabled?: boolean;
    /**
     * Called to perform an in-app navigation that was intercepted while dirty (e.g. `router.push`).
     * When provided, clicks on same-origin links are intercepted and routed through the discard modal.
     */
    navigate?: (href: string) => void;
    /** Called when the user confirms "Discard & Leave", before navigating, so the form can reset itself. */
    onDiscard?: () => void;
}

function readDraft<T>(key: string): T | null {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    try {
        const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
        if (!raw) return null;
        const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as T) : null;
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Persists in-progress form values to localStorage (debounced, in the background), restores them
 * on the next visit, warns on tab close/reload while dirty, and exposes a confirm-before-leave helper.
 */
export function useFormDraftGuard<T>({
    draftKey,
    isDirty,
    currentValues,
    defaultValues,
    onRestoreDraft,
    enabled = true,
    navigate,
    onDiscard,
}: UseFormDraftGuardOptions<T>) {
    const [discardModalOpen, setDiscardModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const pendingNavCallback = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
    const saveTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);
    const restoredFor = useRef<string | null>(null);

    // Keep the latest callback without making the restore effect re-run on every render.
    const restoreRef = useRef(onRestoreDraft);
    useEffect(() => {
        restoreRef.current = onRestoreDraft;
    });

    const cancelPendingSave = useCallback(() => {
        if (saveTimer.current !== null) {
            window.clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
            saveTimer.current = null;
        }
    }, []);

    const clearDraft = useCallback(() => {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
        cancelPendingSave();
        try {
            window.localStorage.removeItem(draftKey);
        } catch {
            // Storage unavailable: nothing to clear.
        }
    }, [draftKey, cancelPendingSave]);

    // 1. Restore a saved draft once per key when the guard becomes enabled.
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!enabled || restoredFor.current === draftKey) return;
        restoredFor.current = draftKey;
        const saved = readDraft<T>(draftKey);
        if (saved) restoreRef.current(saved);
    }, [draftKey, enabled]);

    // 2. Debounced background auto-save while the form is dirty.
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!enabled || !isDirty) return;
        saveTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
            saveTimer.current = null;
            try {
                if (JSON.stringify(currentValues) === JSON.stringify(defaultValues)) {
                    window.localStorage.removeItem(draftKey);
                } else {
                    window.localStorage.setItem(draftKey, JSON.stringify(currentValues));
                }
            } catch {
                // Quota exceeded / private browsing: drafts are best-effort.
            }
        }, SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS);
        return cancelPendingSave;
    }, [draftKey, isDirty, currentValues, defaultValues, enabled, cancelPendingSave]);

    // 3. Browser tab close / reload protection.
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!enabled || !isDirty) return;
        const handleBeforeUnload = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.returnValue = '';
        };
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    }, [enabled, isDirty]);

    // 4. Confirm before an in-app exit (e.g. Cancel button) when there are unsaved changes.
    const confirmDiscard = useCallback(
        (onProceed: () => void) => {
            if (!isDirty) {
                clearDraft();
                onProceed();
                return;
            }
            pendingNavCallback.current = onProceed;
            setDiscardModalOpen(true);
        },
        [isDirty, clearDraft]
    );

    // 5. Intercept clicks on in-app links (navbar, breadcrumbs, logo) while dirty.
    const navigateRef = useRef(navigate);
    const onDiscardRef = useRef(onDiscard);
    useEffect(() => {
        navigateRef.current = navigate;
        onDiscardRef.current = onDiscard;
    });
    const interceptLinks = Boolean(navigate);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!enabled || !isDirty || !interceptLinks) return;
        const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
            if (e.defaultPrevented || e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
            const anchor = (e.target as Element | null)?.closest?.('a[href]') as HTMLAnchorElement | null;
            if (!anchor || anchor.target === '_blank' || anchor.hasAttribute('download')) return;
            const url = new URL(anchor.href, window.location.href);
            if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
            // In-page anchors don't leave the form. A link to the same page (e.g. "New Organization" while on it) does reset it.
            if (url.hash && url.pathname === window.location.pathname && url.search === window.location.search) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const target = url.pathname + url.search + url.hash;
            pendingNavCallback.current = () => navigateRef.current?.(target);
            setDiscardModalOpen(true);
        };
        // Capture phase: runs before Next.js <Link> handles the click.
        document.addEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
    }, [enabled, isDirty, interceptLinks]);

    const handleKeepEditing = useCallback(() => {
        setDiscardModalOpen(false);
        pendingNavCallback.current = null;
    }, []);

    const handleDiscardAndLeave = useCallback(() => {
        clearDraft();
        onDiscardRef.current?.();
        setDiscardModalOpen(false);
        const proceed = pendingNavCallback.current;
        pendingNavCallback.current = null;
        proceed?.();
    }, [clearDraft]);

    return {
        clearDraft,
        confirmDiscard,
        discardModalOpen,
        handleKeepEditing,
        handleDiscardAndLeave,
    };
}

================
File: frontend-crm/src/services/apiClient.ts
================
import { ENV } from '../config/env';
import type { ApiError, PaginationParams } from '../types/api.types';

export interface RequestOptions extends RequestInit {
    params?: PaginationParams;
}

export type RequestInterceptor = (
    url: string,
    options: RequestInit
) => Promise<{ url: string; options: RequestInit }> | { url: string; options: RequestInit };

export type ResponseInterceptor = (response: Response) => Promise<Response> | Response;

export type ErrorInterceptor = (error: ApiClientError) => Promise<never> | never;

export class ApiClientError extends Error {
    public readonly status?: number;
    public readonly details?: ApiError;

    constructor(message: string, status?: number, details?: ApiError) {
        super(message);
        this.name = 'ApiClientError';
        this.status = status;
        this.details = details;
    }
}

export function normalizeApiError(error: unknown, fallbackStatus?: number): ApiClientError {
    if (error instanceof ApiClientError) {
        return error;
    }
    if (error instanceof Error) {
        return new ApiClientError(error.message || 'Network or client error occurred.', fallbackStatus, {
            message: error.message || 'Network or client error occurred.',
            status: fallbackStatus,
        });
    }
    return new ApiClientError('An unexpected error occurred.', fallbackStatus, {
        message: 'An unexpected error occurred.',
        status: fallbackStatus,
    });
}

const requestInterceptors: RequestInterceptor[] = [
    (url, options) => {
        const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
        if (!headers.has('Accept')) {
            headers.set('Accept', 'application/json');
        }
        if (!headers.has('Content-Type') && options.body && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) {
            headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        }
        return {
            url,
            options: {
                ...options,
                headers,
                credentials: options.credentials ?? 'include',
            },
        };
    },
];

const responseInterceptors: ResponseInterceptor[] = [];
const errorInterceptors: ErrorInterceptor[] = [];

function buildUrl(endpoint: string, params?: PaginationParams): string {
    const cleanEndpoint = endpoint.startsWith('/') ? endpoint : `/${endpoint}`;
    const base = `${ENV.API_URL}${cleanEndpoint}`;
    if (!params) return base;

    const qs = new URLSearchParams();
    Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
        if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') {
            qs.set(key, String(value));
        }
    });
    const queryString = qs.toString();
    if (!queryString) return base;
    return base.includes('?') ? `${base}&${queryString}` : `${base}?${queryString}`;
}

async function request<T>(endpoint: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    const { params, ...fetchInit } = options;
    let currentUrl = buildUrl(endpoint, params);
    let currentOptions: RequestInit = fetchInit;

    try {
        for (const interceptor of requestInterceptors) {
            const next = await interceptor(currentUrl, currentOptions);
            currentUrl = next.url;
            currentOptions = next.options;
        }

        if (!currentOptions.signal && typeof AbortSignal !== 'undefined' && typeof AbortSignal.timeout === 'function') {
            currentOptions = {
                ...currentOptions,
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
            };
        }

        let response = await fetch(currentUrl, currentOptions);

        for (const interceptor of responseInterceptors) {
            response = await interceptor(response);
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
            let errorData: ApiError;
            try {
                errorData = await response.json();
            } catch {
                errorData = {
                    message: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
                    status: response.status,
                };
            }
            throw new ApiClientError(
                errorData.message || 'An unexpected error occurred.',
                response.status,
                { ...errorData, status: response.status }
            );
        }

        if (response.status === 204) {
            return undefined as T;
        }

        return (await response.json()) as T;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
        const normalized = normalizeApiError(err);
        for (const onError of errorInterceptors) {
            await onError(normalized);
        }
        throw normalized;
    }
}

export const apiClient = {
    interceptors: {
        request: {
            use: (fn: RequestInterceptor) => {
                requestInterceptors.push(fn);
            },
        },
        response: {
            use: (onFulfilled: ResponseInterceptor, onRejected?: ErrorInterceptor) => {
                responseInterceptors.push(onFulfilled);
                if (onRejected) {
                    errorInterceptors.push(onRejected);
                }
            },
        },
    },

    get: <T>(endpoint: string, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, { ...options, method: 'GET' }),

    post: <T>(endpoint: string, body?: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, {
            ...options,
            method: 'POST',
            body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        }),

    put: <T>(endpoint: string, body?: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, {
            ...options,
            method: 'PUT',
            body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        }),

    patch: <T>(endpoint: string, body?: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, {
            ...options,
            method: 'PATCH',
            body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        }),

    delete: <T>(endpoint: string, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, { ...options, method: 'DELETE' }),
};

import type { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse, PaginationParams } from '../types/api.types';
import { ApiClientError, apiClient } from './apiClient';
import { notifyCrmUpdate } from './crmSync';

export interface CrudService<T, CreateDto = Partial<T>, UpdateDto = Partial<CreateDto>> {
    readonly endpoint: string;
    /** One page: `GET endpoint?page&limit&search&sortBy&sortOrder&<filters>`. */
    list: (params?: PaginationParams) => Promise<PaginatedResponse<T>>;
    /** Every record matching the filters (all pages). Prefer `list` for anything that can grow large. */
    getAll: (params?: PaginationParams) => Promise<T[]>;
    /** `undefined` when the record doesn't exist (or was deleted). */
    getById: (id: string) => Promise<T | undefined>;
    create: (data: CreateDto) => Promise<T>;
    update: (id: string, data: UpdateDto) => Promise<T>;
    delete: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
    deleteBulk: (ids: string[]) => Promise<void>;
}

/** The API caps a page at 100 records. */
const PAGE_SIZE = 100;
/** Safety cap for `getAll` (10,000 records). */
const MAX_PAGES = 100;

/**
 * CRUD client for a backend entity endpoint. Writes broadcast `notifyCrmUpdate(endpoint)`, which invalidates the
 * entity's React Query cache in this tab and in other open tabs.
 */
export function createCrudService<T, CreateDto = Partial<T>, UpdateDto = Partial<CreateDto>>(
    endpoint: string
): CrudService<T, CreateDto, UpdateDto> {
    const cleanEndpoint = endpoint.startsWith('/') ? endpoint : `/${endpoint}`;

    const list = (params?: PaginationParams) => apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<T>>(cleanEndpoint, { params });

    return {
        endpoint: cleanEndpoint,
        list,

        getAll: async (params?: PaginationParams): Promise<T[]> => {
            const all: T[] = [];
            for (let page = 1; page <= MAX_PAGES; page++) {
                const res = await list({ ...params, page, limit: PAGE_SIZE });
                all.push(...res.data);
                if (res.data.length < PAGE_SIZE || all.length >= res.total) return all;
            }
            console.warn(`${cleanEndpoint}: stopped after ${MAX_PAGES * PAGE_SIZE} records; use list() with server-side pagination instead.`);
            return all;
        },

        getById: async (id: string): Promise<T | undefined> => {
            try {
                const res = await apiClient.get<ApiResponse<T>>(`${cleanEndpoint}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
                return res.data;
            } catch (err) {
                // A missing record is "not found", not an error (callers render their empty state).
                if (err instanceof ApiClientError && err.status === 404) return undefined;
                throw err;
            }
        },

        create: async (data: CreateDto): Promise<T> => {
            const res = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<T>>(cleanEndpoint, data);
            notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
            return res.data;
        },

        update: async (id: string, data: UpdateDto): Promise<T> => {
            const res = await apiClient.put<ApiResponse<T>>(`${cleanEndpoint}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, data);
            notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
            return res.data;
        },

        delete: async (id: string): Promise<void> => {
            await apiClient.delete<ApiResponse<unknown>>(`${cleanEndpoint}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
            notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
        },

        deleteBulk: async (ids: string[]): Promise<void> => {
            await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<unknown>>(`${cleanEndpoint}/bulk-delete`, { ids });
            notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
        },
    };
}

File: frontend-crm/src/services/crmSync.ts

import { useEffect, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

/**
 * Global CRM Synchronization Service & Hooks
 *
 * Provides reactive event broadcasting and window/tab focus synchronization
 * across all master views, side drawers, and detail pages in the CRM.
 */

export const CRM_SYNC_EVENT = 'crm:data-updated';
export const CRM_SYNC_CHANNEL_NAME = 'crm_sync_channel';

export interface CrmSyncEventDetail {
    entity?: string;
    id?: string;
    timestamp: number;
}

// Global broadcast channel for immediate multi-tab synchronization
let syncChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BroadcastChannel' in window) {
    try {
        syncChannel = new BroadcastChannel(CRM_SYNC_CHANNEL_NAME);
    } catch {
        syncChannel = null;
    }
}

/**
 * Dispatches a global notification indicating that a CRM record was created,
 * updated, or deleted. Automatically alerts all open drawers, master views,
 * and background tabs.
 */
export function notifyCrmUpdate(entity?: string, id?: string): void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    const detail: CrmSyncEventDetail = {
        entity,
        id,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, { detail }));
    } catch {
        // Fallback for environments where CustomEvent might fail
    }

    try {
        syncChannel?.postMessage(detail);
    } catch {
        // Fallback if BroadcastChannel was closed or failed
    }
}

/**
 * Subscribes to window focus, document visibility change, cross-tab storage updates,
 * local CRM sync events, and BroadcastChannel messages.
 * Debounces calls to prevent rapid duplicate re-renders.
 */
export function subscribeCrmSync(onSync: () => void, debounceMs = 50): () => void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
        return () => {};
    }

    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const triggerSync = () => {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
            onSync();
        }, debounceMs);
    };

    const handleFocus = () => {
        triggerSync();
    };

    const handleVisibility = () => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            triggerSync();
        }
    };

    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
        // Check for any CRM-related key changes
        if (
            !e.key ||
            e.key.includes('crm') ||
            e.key.includes('org') ||
            e.key.includes('lead') ||
            e.key.includes('opp') ||
            e.key.includes('quote') ||
            e.key.includes('contact') ||
            e.key.includes('product')
        ) {
            triggerSync();
        }
    };

    const handleCustomEvent = () => {
        triggerSync();
    };

    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    window.addEventListener(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, handleCustomEvent);

    let channelListener: ((ev: MessageEvent) => void) | null = null;
    if (syncChannel) {
        channelListener = () => triggerSync();
        syncChannel.addEventListener('message', channelListener);
    }

    return () => {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
        window.removeEventListener(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, handleCustomEvent);
        if (syncChannel && channelListener) {
            syncChannel.removeEventListener('message', channelListener);
        }
    };
}

/**
 * Subscribes to CRM update notifications with their detail: local `notifyCrmUpdate` calls in this tab
 * and BroadcastChannel messages from other tabs (a channel never receives its own posts, so each
 * update arrives exactly once).
 */
export function subscribeCrmUpdates(onUpdate: (detail: CrmSyncEventDetail) => void): () => void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
        return () => {};
    }

    const handleLocal = (event: Event) => {
        onUpdate((event as CustomEvent<CrmSyncEventDetail>).detail ?? { timestamp: Date.now() });
    };
    const handleRemote = (event: MessageEvent<CrmSyncEventDetail>) => {
        onUpdate(event.data ?? { timestamp: Date.now() });
    };

    window.addEventListener(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, handleLocal);
    syncChannel?.addEventListener('message', handleRemote);

    return () => {
        window.removeEventListener(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, handleLocal);
        syncChannel?.removeEventListener('message', handleRemote);
    };
}

let crmDataVersion = 0;

const subscribeCrmDataVersion = (onChange: () => void) =>
    subscribeCrmUpdates(() => {
        crmDataVersion += 1;
        onChange();
    });

/**
 * Counter that changes whenever any CRM entity is updated (this tab or another). Use it as a memo
 * dependency for values derived from several entities at once, such as related-module counts.
 */
export function useCrmDataVersion(): number {
    return useSyncExternalStore(subscribeCrmDataVersion, () => crmDataVersion, () => 0);
}

/**
 * React hook that triggers a re-fetch or re-evaluation whenever the browser
 * gains focus, the tab becomes visible, or any CRM entity is updated.
 */
export function useCrmSync(callback: () => void, deps: React.DependencyList = []): void {
    const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    useEffect(() => {
        callbackRef.current = callback;
    });

    useEffect(() => {
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(() => {
            callbackRef.current();
        });
        return unsubscribe;
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, deps);
}

import type { ApiResponse } from '../types/api.types';
import { apiClient } from './apiClient';

export type GlobalSearchCategory = 'organizations' | 'contacts' | 'leads' | 'opportunities';

export interface GlobalSearchResult {
    id: string;
    category: GlobalSearchCategory;
    title: string;
    subtitle: string;
    /** Extra right-aligned tag (e.g. opportunity stage). */
    meta?: string;
    href: string;
}

export type GlobalSearchResults = Record<GlobalSearchCategory, GlobalSearchResult[]>;

export const GLOBAL_SEARCH_CATEGORIES: readonly GlobalSearchCategory[] = [
    'organizations',
    'contacts',
    'leads',
    'opportunities',
];

export const emptySearchResults = (): GlobalSearchResults => ({ organizations: [], contacts: [], leads: [], opportunities: [] });

/** GET /api/search: matches organizations, contacts, leads and opportunities (hrefs included). */
export async function searchCrm(rawQuery: string, limitPerCategory = 5): Promise<GlobalSearchResults> {
    const q = rawQuery.trim();
    if (!q) return emptySearchResults();
    const res = await apiClient.get<ApiResponse<GlobalSearchResults>>('/api/search', { params: { q, limit: limitPerCategory } });
    return res.data;
}

        return res.data;
    },

    async job(importId: string): Promise<ImportJob> {

import type { Lead } from '../types/lead.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '../types/organization.types';
import type { Contact } from '../types/contact.types';
import type { Opportunity } from '../types/opportunity.types';
import type { ConvertLeadFormValues } from '../validations/convertLead.schema';
import type { ApiResponse } from '../types/api.types';
import { leadService } from './lead.service';
import { notifyCrmUpdate } from './crmSync';
import { apiClient } from './apiClient';

export interface LeadConversionResult {
    organization: ExtendedOrganization;
    contact: Contact;
    opportunity: Opportunity;
    organizationCreated: boolean;
    contactCreated: boolean;
}

const normalize = (value?: string) => (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
const digits = (value?: string) => (value ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');

/** The organization conversion will reuse: by explicit id, else case-insensitive name (as the API matches). */
export function matchExistingOrganization(candidates: ExtendedOrganization[], name: string, id?: string): ExtendedOrganization | undefined {
    if (id) {
        const byId = candidates.find((o) => o.id === id);
        if (byId) return byId;
    }
    const target = normalize(name);
    return target ? candidates.find((o) => normalize(o.organizationName) === target) : undefined;
}

/** The contact conversion will reuse: by explicit id, else mobile number (as the API matches). */
export function matchExistingContact(candidates: Contact[], mobile: string, id?: string): Contact | undefined {
    if (id) {
        const byId = candidates.find((c) => c.id === id);
        if (byId) return byId;
    }
    const target = digits(mobile);
    return target ? candidates.find((c) => digits(c.mobile) === target) : undefined;
}

/** Maps a lead onto the initial values of the Convert Lead form. */
export function buildConvertLeadDefaults(lead: Lead): ConvertLeadFormValues {
    return {
        existingOrganizationId: '',
        organizationName: lead.organizationName ?? '',
        mailingName: lead.mailingName ?? '',
        natureOfBusiness: '',
        typeOfEntity: '',
        customerType: '',
        sourceOfLead: lead.leadSource ?? '',
        memberOf: '',
        organizationDescription: '',
        organizationAssignedTo: lead.assignedTo,

        existingContactId: '',
        contactName: lead.name,
        contactMobile: lead.mobile,
        contactPhone3: lead.otherPhone ?? '',
        contactEmails: lead.emailAddresses?.length
            ? lead.emailAddresses
            : [{ id: 'eml-1', email: '', isPrimary: true, isOptedOut: false, isInvalidBounce: false }],
        isPrimaryContact: true,
        designation: lead.designation ?? '',
        department: lead.department ?? '',
        communicationType: ['Call', 'Email'],
        doNotCall: false,
        contactDescription: '',
        contactAssignedTo: lead.assignedTo,

        productCategory: lead.productCategory ?? [],
        principalCompany: '',
        referredBy: lead.referredBy ?? '',
        opportunityType: 'New Business',
        nextFollowupDate: lead.nextFollowupDate,
        nextFollowupTime: lead.nextFollowupTime ?? '',
        followupType: lead.followupType ?? '',
        opportunityDescription: lead.addDescription ?? '',
        opportunityLeadSource: lead.leadSource ?? '',
        opportunityAssignedTo: lead.assignedTo,
        copyActivitiesTo: [],
    };
}

/**
 * POST /api/leads/:id/convert: reuses or creates the Organization and Contact, creates the Opportunity linked to
 * both and marks the lead Converted, all in one database transaction (nothing is left half-converted).
 */
export async function convertLead(leadId: string, values: ConvertLeadFormValues): Promise<LeadConversionResult> {
    const res = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<LeadConversionResult>>(`${leadService.endpoint}/${encodeURIComponent(leadId)}/convert`, values);
    // Up to four entities changed; 'leadConversion' has no query keys of its own, so every cache refreshes.
    notifyCrmUpdate('leadConversion', leadId);
    return res.data;
}

File: frontend-crm/src/services/masterData.service.ts
