import type { ApiResponse } from '../types/api.types';
import type { CrmUser } from '../types/user.types';
import type { NatureOfCallItem } from '../types/ticket.types';
import type { PartnerCompany, PartnerCompanyContact } from '../types/partner.types';
import { apiClient } from './apiClient';
import { setMasterData, type MasterData } from './masterData.store';

/**
 * Loads users, Nature of Call and partner masters from `/api/lookups/*` into the master-data store.
 * Components pick it up through `useMasterData()`. Deliberately no `notifyCrmUpdate`: QueryProvider would
 * invalidate every query (including this one) and loop.
 */
export async function loadMasterData(): Promise<MasterData> {
    const [users, natureOfCalls, partnerCompanies, partnerContacts] = await Promise.all([
        apiClient.get<ApiResponse<CrmUser[]>>('/api/lookups/users', { params: { includeInactive: true } }),
        apiClient.get<ApiResponse<NatureOfCallItem[]>>('/api/lookups/nature-of-calls'),
        apiClient.get<ApiResponse<PartnerCompany[]>>('/api/lookups/partner-companies'),
        apiClient.get<ApiResponse<PartnerCompanyContact[]>>('/api/lookups/partner-contacts'),
    ]);
    const data: MasterData = {
        users: users.data,
        natureOfCalls: natureOfCalls.data,
        partnerCompanies: partnerCompanies.data,
        partnerContacts: partnerContacts.data,
    };
    setMasterData(data);
    return data;
}

================
File: frontend-crm/src/services/masterData.store.ts
================
import type { CrmUser } from '../types/user.types';
import type { NatureOfCallItem } from '../types/ticket.types';
import type { PartnerCompany, PartnerCompanyContact } from '../types/partner.types';

/**
 * Master data loaded from `/api/lookups/*` after sign-in (`loadMasterData`, shared through `useMasterData`).
 * The synchronous getters below serve validation schemas and formatters that can't use hooks; components
 * call `useMasterData()` so they re-render when the data arrives. Dependency-free on purpose.
 */
export interface MasterData {
    users: CrmUser[];
    natureOfCalls: NatureOfCallItem[];
    partnerCompanies: PartnerCompany[];
    partnerContacts: PartnerCompanyContact[];
}

const EMPTY: MasterData = { users: [], natureOfCalls: [], partnerCompanies: [], partnerContacts: [] };

let masters: MasterData = EMPTY;

/** Empty lists until `loadMasterData()` has run. */
export const getMasterData = (): MasterData => masters;

export function setMasterData(data: MasterData): void {
    masters = data;
}

export function clearMasterData(): void {
    masters = EMPTY;
}

/** The user directory (`/api/lookups/users`, inactive users included so old assignments still resolve). */
export const getCrmUsers = (): CrmUser[] => masters.users;

/** Nature of Call master (`/api/lookups/nature-of-calls`). */
export const getNatureOfCalls = (): NatureOfCallItem[] => masters.natureOfCalls;

/** Partner companies (`/api/lookups/partner-companies`). */
export const getPartnerCompanies = (): PartnerCompany[] => masters.partnerCompanies;

/** Partner contacts (`/api/lookups/partner-contacts`). */
export const getPartnerContacts = (): PartnerCompanyContact[] => masters.partnerContacts;

/** Active, non-group usernames: autocomplete suggestions for assignee fields. */
export function getAssignableUsernames(): string[] {
    return masters.users.filter((x) => x.status === 'Active' && !x.isGroupUser).map((x) => x.username);
}

/** Finds a user by username or display name (tolerates legacy suffixes like "name (You)"). */
export function findCrmUser(value: string | undefined): CrmUser | undefined {
    const v = (value || '').replace(/\s*\(You\)\s*$/i, '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!v) return undefined;
    return masters.users.find((x) => x.username.toLowerCase() === v || x.name.toLowerCase() === v);
}

    Partial<ExtendedOrganization>
>('/api/organizations');

export const organizationService = {
    ...baseOrganizationService,
    /** Sets the account status of several organizations in one audited transaction (PATCH /bulk-status). */
    updateStatusBulk: async (
        ids: Iterable<string>,
        status: ExtendedOrganization['accountStatus'],
        inactivityReason?: string
    ): Promise<ExtendedOrganization[]> => {
        const res = await apiClient.patch<ApiResponse<ExtendedOrganization[]>>(`${baseOrganizationService.endpoint}/bulk-status`, {
            ids: [...new Set(ids)],
            status,
            inactivityReason,
        });
        notifyCrmUpdate(baseOrganizationService.endpoint);
        return res.data;
    },
};

import type { Opportunity } from '../types/opportunity.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '../types/organization.types';
import type { Contact } from '../types/contact.types';
import type { Quotation, QuotationFormData, QuotationLineItem } from '../types/quotation.types';
import { TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS, PAYMENT_TERMS_DESCRIPTIONS } from '../types/quotation.types';
import { createCrudService } from './base.service';
import { DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE, normalizeLegacyStateName } from '../data/addressMaster';
import { normalizeCountryValue } from '../utils/address';
import { notifyCrmUpdate } from './crmSync';

const baseQuotationService = createCrudService<Quotation, QuotationFormData, Partial<QuotationFormData>>('/api/quotations');

/** Billing / shipping address for a quote, taken from the opportunity's organization (loaded by the caller). */
export function resolveQuoteAddress(org?: ExtendedOrganization): {
    hasCompleteAddress: boolean;
    billingStreet: string;
    billingCity: string;
    billingState: string;
    billingPostalCode: string;
    billingCountry: string;
    shippingStreet: string;
    shippingCity: string;
    shippingState: string;
    shippingPostalCode: string;
    shippingCountry: string;
} {
    const billingStreet = (org?.billingStreet || '').trim();
    const billingCity = (org?.billingCity || '').trim();
    const billingCountry = normalizeCountryValue(org?.billingCountry);
    const billingState = normalizeLegacyStateName(org?.billingState, billingCountry);
    const billingPostalCode = (org?.billingPostalCode || '').trim();

    const shippingStreet = (org?.shippingStreet || billingStreet).trim();
    const shippingCity = (org?.shippingCity || billingCity).trim();
    const shippingCountry = normalizeCountryValue(org?.shippingCountry || billingCountry);
    const shippingState = normalizeLegacyStateName(org?.shippingState || billingState, shippingCountry);
    const shippingPostalCode = (org?.shippingPostalCode || billingPostalCode).trim();

    const hasCompleteAddress = Boolean(
        billingStreet && billingCity && billingState && billingPostalCode
    );

    return {
        hasCompleteAddress,
        billingStreet,
        billingCity,
        billingState,
        billingPostalCode,
        billingCountry,
        shippingStreet,
        shippingCity,
        shippingState,
        shippingPostalCode,
        shippingCountry,
    };
}

/**
 * Pre-populates Quotation form defaults from a source Opportunity and its linked Account/Contact.
 */
export function buildQuotationDefaultsFromOpportunity(
    opportunity: Opportunity,
    organization?: ExtendedOrganization,
    contact?: Contact
): QuotationFormData {
    const addr = resolveQuoteAddress(organization);
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const validityDate = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

    const mappedLineItems: QuotationLineItem[] =
        opportunity.lineItems && opportunity.lineItems.length > 0
            ? opportunity.lineItems.map((item) => ({
                  id: item.id || `line-${Date.now()}`,
                  productId: item.productId || '',
                  productName: item.productName || '',
                  quantity: item.quantity || 1,
                  amount: item.amount || 0,
                  discount: item.discount || 0,
                  discountType: item.discountType || 'percentage',
                  salePrice: item.salePrice || item.amount || 0,
                  taxRate: item.taxRate || 'GST 18%',
                  taxAmount: item.taxAmount || 0,
                  total: item.total || 0,
                  description: item.description || '',
                  note: item.note || '',
              }))
            : [
                  {
                      id: `item-${Date.now()}`,
                      productId: '',
                      productName: 'TallyPrime Gold (Multi-User Enterprise)',
                      quantity: 1,
                      amount: 54000,
                      discount: 0,
                      discountType: 'percentage',
                      salePrice: 54000,
                      taxRate: 'GST 18%',
                      taxAmount: 9720,
                      total: 63720,
                      description: 'Standard enterprise package license',
                      note: '',
                  },
              ];

    const quoteTitle = opportunity.opportunityName || opportunity.organizationName || 'B-Softwares';

    return {
        // Tab 1: Overview
        quotationTitle: quoteTitle,
        quoteStage: 'Draft',
        quotationDate: today,
        validUntil: validityDate,
        remarks: opportunity.addDescription || '',
        termsAndCondition: 'Standard Terms & Conditions',
        termsAndConditionDescription: TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS['Standard Terms & Conditions'],
        assignedTo: opportunity.assignedTo || '',

        opportunityName: quoteTitle,
        company: 'Nandini Infosystems',
        validationPeriod: '30 Days',
        otherRef: '',
        paymentTerms: '50% Advance & 50% on Delivery',
        paymentTermsDescription: PAYMENT_TERMS_DESCRIPTIONS['50% Advance & 50% on Delivery'],
        preparedFor: 'Customer',

        // Tab 2: Line Items
        currency: opportunity.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
        groupName: opportunity.groupName || 'Software Licenses & Add-ons',
        lineItems: mappedLineItems,
        lumpSumDiscount: opportunity.lumpSumDiscount || 0,
        totalAmount: opportunity.totalAmount || 0,
        totalDiscount: opportunity.totalDiscount || 0,
        subtotal: opportunity.subtotal || 0,
        totalTax: opportunity.totalTax || 0,
        grandTotal: opportunity.grandTotal || 0,

        // Tab 3: Address Information
        organizationName: opportunity.organizationName,
        organizationId: opportunity.organizationId || organization?.id,
        contactName: opportunity.contactName,
        contactId: opportunity.contactId || contact?.id,
        contactMobile: opportunity.contactNumber || contact?.mobile || '',
        mailingName: organization?.mailingName || opportunity.organizationName,
        gstNo: organization?.gstNumber || '',
        contactEmail: opportunity.emailAddress || contact?.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email || '',

        billingAddress: addr.billingStreet,
        billingCity: addr.billingCity,
        billingState: addr.billingState || 'Delhi',
        billingPostalCode: addr.billingPostalCode,
        billingCountry: addr.billingCountry || DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE,

        shippingAddress: addr.shippingStreet,
        shippingCity: addr.shippingCity,
        shippingState: addr.shippingState || 'Delhi',
        shippingPostalCode: addr.shippingPostalCode,
        shippingCountry: addr.shippingCountry || DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE,
        copyAddressFromBilling: true,

        // Aliases / Context
        opportunityId: opportunity.id,
        opportunityCode: opportunity.opportunityCode,
        status: 'Draft',
        quoteDate: today,
        quotationSubject: quoteTitle,
        contactNumber: opportunity.contactNumber || contact?.mobile || '',
        emailAddress: opportunity.emailAddress || contact?.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email || '',
        notes: opportunity.addDescription || '',
        termsAndConditions: TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS['Standard Terms & Conditions'],
    };
}

/**
 * Creates a quotation for an opportunity. The API advances the opportunity to "Proposal/Price Quote" in the same
 * transaction (unless it is already closed), so the opportunity's cache is refreshed too.
 */
export async function createQuotationFromOpportunity(opportunityId: string, values: QuotationFormData): Promise<Quotation> {
    const quotation = await baseQuotationService.create({ ...values, opportunityId });
    notifyCrmUpdate('/api/opportunities', opportunityId);
    return quotation;
}

export const quotationService = {
    ...baseQuotationService,
    buildQuotationDefaultsFromOpportunity,
    createQuotationFromOpportunity,
    resolveQuoteAddress,
};

import type React from 'react';
import type { CrmUser } from './user.types';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from './organization.types';
import type { Contact } from './contact.types';
import type { NatureOfCallItem } from './ticket.types';
import type { PartnerCompany, PartnerCompanyContact } from './partner.types';

// ─── Generic Lookup / Record Picker Types ─────────────────────────────────────

export interface LookupColumn<T> {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    minWidth?: number;
    width?: number;
    align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
    /** Custom cell renderer; falls back to `getValue` or `String(row[id])`. */
    render?: (row: T) => React.ReactNode;
    getValue?: (row: T) => string;
}

export interface LookupFilterOption {
    value: string;
    label: string;
}

export interface LookupFilterField {
    key: string;
    label: string;
    type: 'text' | 'select';
    options?: LookupFilterOption[];
    placeholder?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    /** Grid width in a 12-column row on desktop (default 3). */
    width?: number;
}

export type LookupFilterValues = Record<string, string>;

export type LookupSearchPredicate<T> = (item: T, filters: LookupFilterValues, query: string) => boolean;

/** Records each built-in lookup preset returns. */
export interface LookupRecordMap {
    user: CrmUser;
    organization: ExtendedOrganization;
    contact: Contact;
    natureOfCall: NatureOfCallItem;
    partnerCompany: PartnerCompany;
    partnerCompanyContact: PartnerCompanyContact;
}

export type LookupKind = keyof LookupRecordMap;

/** `custom` means the caller supplies its own `onLookupClick` handler. */
export type LookupType = LookupKind | 'custom';

/** Props shared by every entity-specific lookup modal (UserLookupModal, etc). */
export interface EntityLookupModalProps<T> {
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onSelect: (record: T) => void;
    /** Current field value; the matching record is highlighted. */
    selectedValue?: string;
}

import { DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE, getCountryNameByCode, normalizeLegacyStateName, resolveCountryIso2 } from '@/data/addressMaster';

/**
 * Stored country value → ISO2 code. Empty becomes India; legacy names ('India', 'United States') become codes;
 * values the master doesn't know (e.g. legacy 'Other') are kept as-is rather than silently changed.
 */
export function normalizeCountryValue(country?: string | null): string {
    const raw = (country ?? '').trim();
    if (!raw) return DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE;
    return resolveCountryIso2(raw) || raw;
}

/**
 * Returns a copy of `record` with each [countryField, stateField] pair normalised: country to ISO2
 * (see normalizeCountryValue) and state to the master's canonical name ('Haryana' → 'Haryāna'; manual entries kept).
 * Use when loading saved records into forms so legacy data prefills the address master fields.
 */
export function normalizeAddressFields<T extends object>(
    record: T,
    pairs: ReadonlyArray<readonly [country: keyof T, state: keyof T]>
): T {
    const next: Record<keyof T, unknown> = { ...record };
    for (const [countryKey, stateKey] of pairs) {
        const country = normalizeCountryValue(next[countryKey] as string | undefined);
        next[countryKey] = country;
        next[stateKey] = normalizeLegacyStateName(next[stateKey] as string | undefined, country);
    }
    return next as T;
}

/**
 * One-line postal-style address for read-only views: street, city, state, postal code, country name.
 * Empty parts are skipped.
 */
export function formatAddressLine(parts: {
    street?: string | null;
    city?: string | null;
    state?: string | null;
    postalCode?: string | null;
    country?: string | null;
}): string {
    return [
        parts.street,
        parts.city,
        parts.state,
        parts.postalCode,
        parts.country ? getCountryNameByCode(parts.country) : '',
    ]
        .map((p) => (p ?? '').toString().trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(', ');
}

/**
 * Builders for tel:, sms:, WhatsApp and mailto: links. Every value is sanitized so stored
 * formatting (spaces, dashes, brackets) never produces a broken or injectable link.
 */

/** Keeps digits and a single leading '+'; returns '' when no digits remain. */
export function sanitizePhone(phone?: string | null): string {
    if (!phone) return '';
    const trimmed = phone.trim();
    const digits = trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!digits) return '';
    return trimmed.startsWith('+') ? `+${digits}` : digits;
}

export function telHref(phone?: string | null): string {
    const clean = sanitizePhone(phone);
    return clean ? `tel:${clean}` : '';
}

export function smsHref(phone?: string | null): string {
    const clean = sanitizePhone(phone);
    return clean ? `sms:${clean}` : '';
}

/**
 * wa.me needs the full international number with digits only. A bare 10-digit number is
 * treated as Indian (+91), matching how mobiles are stored in this CRM.
 */
export function whatsappHref(phone?: string | null, defaultCountryCode = '91'): string {
    const digits = sanitizePhone(phone).replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!digits) return '';
    const international = digits.length === 10 ? `${defaultCountryCode}${digits}` : digits.replace(/^0+/, '');
    return `https://wa.me/${international}`;
}

export function mailtoHref(email?: string | null): string {
    const clean = (email ?? '').trim().replace(/[\s<>"'?&#]/g, '');
    return clean.includes('@') ? `mailto:${clean}` : '';
}

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

/** Formats an ISO timestamp as 'dd-MMM-yyyy, hh:mm a' (e.g. '24-Oct-2026, 01:07 PM'). Empty/invalid input → ''. */
export function formatDateTime(iso?: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return '';
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
    const hours = d.getHours() % 12 || 12;
    const meridiem = d.getHours() < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM';
    return `${pad(d.getDate())}-${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]}-${d.getFullYear()}, ${pad(hours)}:${pad(d.getMinutes())} ${meridiem}`;
}

const FOCUSABLE =
    'input:not([type="hidden"]):not([aria-hidden="true"]), textarea, select, [role="combobox"], [tabindex="0"]';

function findFieldElement(fieldName: string): HTMLElement | null {
    const key = CSS.escape(fieldName);
    // `data-field` wrappers (FormField) first, then native name/id/test-id hooks.
    const selectors = [
        `[data-field="${key}"]`,
        `input[name="${key}"]`,
        `textarea[name="${key}"]`,
        `select[name="${key}"]`,
        `[name="${key}"]`,
        `#${key}`,
        `[data-testid="${key}"]`,
    ];
    for (const selector of selectors) {
        const el = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
        if (el) return el;
    }
    return null;
}

function resolveFocusTarget(el: HTMLElement): HTMLElement {
    // MUI Select renders a hidden native input; the interactive element is the sibling combobox.
    if (el.classList.contains('MuiSelect-nativeInput')) {
        const combobox = el.parentElement?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="combobox"]');
        if (combobox) return combobox;
    }
    if (el.matches(FOCUSABLE)) return el;
    const phoneInput = el.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-phone-national]');
    if (phoneInput) return phoneInput;
    return el.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE) ?? el;
}

const BLUE = '37, 99, 235';
const activeGlows = new WeakMap<Element, Animation[]>();

/**
 * Plays a blue attention pulse on the field's visual container.
 * Uses the Web Animations API rather than a CSS class: React/MUI rewrite the element's className
 * when the field gains focus (Mui-focused), which would wipe a manually added class instantly.
 */
function glowField(target: HTMLElement): void {
    const visual =
        target.closest<HTMLElement>('.MuiOutlinedInput-root') ??
        target.closest<HTMLElement>('.MuiFormControl-root') ??
        target.parentElement ??
        target;
    if (typeof visual.animate !== 'function') return;

    activeGlows.get(visual)?.forEach((a) => a.cancel());

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const timing: KeyframeAnimationOptions = {
        duration: reduceMotion ? 1200 : 1800,
        delay: reduceMotion ? 0 : 250, // let the smooth scroll arrive first
        easing: 'ease-out',
        fill: 'backwards',
    };

    const ring: Keyframe[] = reduceMotion
        ? [{ boxShadow: `0 0 0 4px rgba(${BLUE}, 0.35)` }, { boxShadow: `0 0 0 0 rgba(${BLUE}, 0)` }]
        : [
              { boxShadow: `0 0 0 0 rgba(${BLUE}, 0.75), 0 0 0 rgba(${BLUE}, 0)`, backgroundColor: `rgba(${BLUE}, 0.10)`, transform: 'scale(1)', offset: 0 },
              { boxShadow: `0 0 0 7px rgba(${BLUE}, 0.30), 0 0 22px rgba(${BLUE}, 0.55)`, backgroundColor: `rgba(${BLUE}, 0.08)`, transform: 'scale(1.012)', offset: 0.18 },
              { boxShadow: `0 0 0 2px rgba(${BLUE}, 0.20), 0 0 8px rgba(${BLUE}, 0.20)`, backgroundColor: `rgba(${BLUE}, 0.05)`, transform: 'scale(1)', offset: 0.38 },
              { boxShadow: `0 0 0 9px rgba(${BLUE}, 0.26), 0 0 26px rgba(${BLUE}, 0.5)`, backgroundColor: `rgba(${BLUE}, 0.07)`, transform: 'scale(1.01)', offset: 0.58 },
              { boxShadow: `0 0 0 0 rgba(${BLUE}, 0), 0 0 0 rgba(${BLUE}, 0)`, backgroundColor: `rgba(${BLUE}, 0)`, transform: 'scale(1)', offset: 1 },
          ];

    const animations: Animation[] = [visual.animate(ring, timing)];

    // Keep the outline crisp blue while the glow is visible.
    const outline = visual.querySelector<HTMLElement>('fieldset');
    if (outline) {
        animations.push(
            outline.animate(
                [
                    { borderColor: '#2563eb', borderWidth: '2px', offset: 0 },
                    { borderColor: '#1d4ed8', borderWidth: '2px', offset: 0.6 },
                    { borderColor: '#2563eb', borderWidth: '1.5px', offset: 1 },
                ],
                timing
            )
        );
    }

    activeGlows.set(visual, animations);
}

/**
 * Smoothly scrolls to and focuses a form field by its field key (RHF `name`, `data-field`, id or test id).
 * Handles MUI text fields, selects and textareas. Returns false when the field isn't mounted.
 */
export function focusFormField(fieldName: string): boolean {
    if (!fieldName || typeof document === 'undefined') return false;

    const el = findFieldElement(fieldName);
    if (!el) return false;

    const target = resolveFocusTarget(el);
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    // preventScroll avoids a second jump fighting the smooth scroll above.
    target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    glowField(target);
    return true;
}

import { AsYouType, isValidPhoneNumber, parsePhoneNumberFromString, type CountryCode } from 'libphonenumber-js';
import { DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY_ISO2, PHONE_COUNTRIES, getPhoneCountry, type PhoneCountry } from '@/data/countryPhoneCodes';

/** ITU-T E.164: `+`, non-zero first digit, 7-15 digits total. */
export const E164_REGEX = /^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$/;

export const isValidE164 = (value: string): boolean => E164_REGEX.test(value) && isValidPhoneNumber(value);

export interface SplitPhone {
    country: PhoneCountry;
    /** Digits only, without the country code. */
    national: string;
}

const fallbackCountry = (): PhoneCountry => getPhoneCountry(DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY_ISO2) ?? PHONE_COUNTRIES[0];

/** Dial codes longest-first so '+1242' (Bahamas) wins over '+1'. */
const countriesByDialLength = [...PHONE_COUNTRIES].sort((a, b) => b.dialCode.length - a.dialCode.length);

/**
 * Splits a stored value into country + national digits. Legacy values without a '+' (10-digit Indian numbers,
 * "91..." or "0...") are treated as India. Empty or unparseable input yields `defaultIso2`.
 */
export function splitPhone(value: unknown, defaultIso2: string = DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY_ISO2): SplitPhone {
    const base = getPhoneCountry(defaultIso2) ?? fallbackCountry();
    const raw = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
    if (!raw) return { country: base, national: '' };

    if (raw.startsWith('+')) {
        const parsed = parsePhoneNumberFromString(raw);
        const iso2 = parsed?.country;
        const country =
            (iso2 && getPhoneCountry(iso2)) ||
            (parsed && countriesByDialLength.find((c) => c.dialCode === `+${parsed.countryCallingCode}`)) ||
            undefined;
        if (parsed && country) return { country, national: parsed.nationalNumber };
        // Incomplete while typing: match the longest known dial code prefix.
        const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '');
        const match = countriesByDialLength.find((c) => digits.startsWith(c.dialCode.slice(1)));
        if (match) return { country: match, national: digits.slice(match.dialCode.length - 1) };
        return { country: base, national: digits };
    }

    // Legacy national-only data -> India.
    const india = fallbackCountry();
    let digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('91')) digits = digits.slice(2);
    else if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('0')) digits = digits.slice(1);
    return { country: india, national: digits };
}

/** Combines country + national digits into E.164; '' when there are no digits. */
export function joinPhone(country: PhoneCountry, national: string): string {
    const digits = national.replace(/\D/g, '');
    return digits ? `${country.dialCode}${digits}` : '';
}

/** Max national digits that can still form a valid E.164 number (15 total minus the dial code). */
export const maxNationalDigits = (country: PhoneCountry): number => 15 - (country.dialCode.length - 1);

/** Human-readable international form, e.g. '+91 98112 34567'. Falls back to the raw value. */
export function formatPhoneDisplay(value: unknown): string {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) return '';
    const { country, national } = splitPhone(value);
    if (!national) return '';
    const formatter = new AsYouType(country.iso2 as CountryCode);
    formatter.input(`${country.dialCode}${national}`);
    return formatter.getNumber()?.formatInternational() ?? `${country.dialCode} ${national}`;
}
/**
 * Normalizes any phone input to E.164 for validation/submit: separators dropped, '+'/'00' kept as the
 * international prefix, legacy national numbers (10 digits, 91+10, 0+10) treated as India (+91).
 * Blank stays ''; unrecognised input is returned digits-only so validation rejects it.
 */
export function normalizeToE164(value: string): string {
    const trimmed = (value ?? '').trim();
    if (!trimmed) return '';
    const digits = trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!digits) return '';
    if (trimmed.startsWith('+')) return `+${digits}`;
    if (digits.startsWith('00')) return `+${digits.slice(2)}`;
    if (digits.length === 10) return `+91${digits}`;
    if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('91')) return `+${digits}`;
    if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('0')) return `+91${digits.slice(1)}`;
    return digits;
}
/**
 * Validation message for an E.164 candidate, or null when valid. Names the country so users can tell
 * "wrong length for this country" from "not a number at all".
 */
export function phoneIssue(e164: string): string | null {
    if (!e164) return 'Phone number is required.';
    if (isValidE164(e164)) return null;
    if (!E164_REGEX.test(e164)) return 'Enter a valid phone number (digits only, with country code).';
    const { country } = splitPhone(e164);
    return `Enter a valid ${country.name} (${country.dialCode}) phone number.`;
}

File: frontend-crm/src/utils/phoneCountryStore.ts

/**
 * Per-form "preferred phone country". When a user picks a country in one phone field, the other empty phone
 * fields of the same form default to it. Keyed by the react-hook-form `control` object, so forms never share state.
 */
const preferred = new WeakMap<object, string>();
const listeners = new WeakMap<object, Set<() => void>>();

export function getPreferredCountry(form: object | undefined): string | undefined {
    return form ? preferred.get(form) : undefined;
}

export function setPreferredCountry(form: object | undefined, iso2: string): void {
    if (!form || preferred.get(form) === iso2) return;
    preferred.set(form, iso2);
    listeners.get(form)?.forEach((notify) => notify());
}

export function subscribePreferredCountry(form: object | undefined, notify: () => void): () => void {
    if (!form) return () => undefined;
    let set = listeners.get(form);
    if (!set) listeners.set(form, (set = new Set()));
    set.add(notify);
    return () => {
        set.delete(notify);
    };
}

import { z } from 'zod';
import { E164_REGEX, normalizeToE164, phoneIssue } from '../utils/phone';
import { DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE, resolveCountryIso2 } from '../data/addressMaster';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH } from '../config/fieldLimits';

/**
 * Extracts the first human-readable validation error message from a ZodError
 * to display cleanly inside toast notifications.
 */
export function getZodErrorMessage(error: z.ZodError): string {
    if (error.issues && error.issues.length > 0) {
        return error.issues[0].message;
    }
    return 'Invalid form data. Please check required fields.';
}

/**
 * Walks a React Hook Form `FieldErrors` tree (including nested objects/arrays) and returns
 * the first human-readable message, for display in toast notifications.
 */
export function getFirstErrorMessage(errors: unknown): string | undefined {
    if (!errors || typeof errors !== 'object') return undefined;
    const node = errors as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof node.message === 'string' && node.message) return node.message;
    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
        if (key === 'ref' || key === 'type') continue;
        const found = getFirstErrorMessage(node[key]);
        if (found) return found;
    }
    return undefined;
}

export type ValidationResult<T> =
    | { success: true; data: T }
    | { success: false; error: string; /** Top-level key of the first invalid field. */ fieldName?: string };

/**
 * Safely validates form data using a Zod schema and extracts a single friendly
 * toast message if validation fails.
 */
export function validateWithToast<T>(
    schema: z.ZodType<T>,
    data: unknown
): ValidationResult<T> {
    const result = schema.safeParse(data);
    if (!result.success) {
        const firstKey = result.error.issues[0]?.path[0];
        return {
            success: false,
            error: getZodErrorMessage(result.error),
            fieldName: firstKey !== undefined ? String(firstKey) : undefined,
        };
    }
    return {
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
    };
}

// ── Reusable Regex Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** ITU-T E.164 (+919811234567). Kept under the old name so existing imports keep working. */
export const PHONE_REGEX = E164_REGEX;
/** Indian PIN code: exactly 6 digits. */
export const PIN_CODE_REGEX = /^\d{6}$/;
/** Non-Indian postal / ZIP codes: 2–12 letters, digits, spaces or hyphens (e.g. SW1A 1AA, K1A 0B1, 94105-1234). */
export const INTL_POSTAL_CODE_REGEX = /^[A-Za-z0-9\s-]{2,12}$/;
/** Characters a postal code may contain in any country (base shape before the country-specific check). */
const POSTAL_CODE_CHARS_REGEX = /^[A-Za-z0-9\s-]*$/;
export const PAN_REGEX = /^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}$/;
export const GST_REGEX = /^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}[1-9A-Z]{1}Z[0-9A-Z]{1}$/;
export const IFSC_REGEX = /^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$/;

// ── Reusable String Primitives ────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Non-empty trimmed string
export const requiredString = (fieldName: string) =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` });

// Optional trimmed string
export const optionalString = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

// ── Length-capped text (limits mirror each input's `maxLength`, see config/fieldLimits) ──

const maxLengthMessage = (fieldName: string, max: number) => ({
    message: `${fieldName} cannot exceed ${max} characters.`,
});

/** Required trimmed text capped at `max` characters. */
export const requiredText = (fieldName: string, max: number) =>
    requiredString(fieldName).max(max, maxLengthMessage(fieldName, max));

/** Optional trimmed text capped at `max` characters. */
export const optionalText = (fieldName: string, max: number) =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .max(max, maxLengthMessage(fieldName, max))
        .optional()
        .or(z.literal(''));

// ── Central DRY Zod Validation Dictionary ─────────────────────────────────────

/** International phone in E.164 (legacy 10-digit Indian numbers are upgraded to +91). */
export const zodPhone = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform(normalizeToE164)
    .superRefine((val, ctx) => {
        const message = phoneIssue(val);
        if (message) ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', message });
    });

export const zodPhoneOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform(normalizeToE164)
    .superRefine((val, ctx) => {
        const message = val ? phoneIssue(val) : null;
        if (message) ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', message });
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));
/** Exactly 6 digits Indian postal PIN code */
export const zodPinCode = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .regex(PIN_CODE_REGEX, { message: 'Must be exactly 6 digits.' });

export const zodPinCodeOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .refine((val) => !val || PIN_CODE_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be exactly 6 digits.',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

// ── Country-aware postal codes ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Address_Field_Design: postal codes are text (letters / leading zeros allowed) and their format depends on country.

const POSTAL_CODE_REQUIRED_MESSAGE = 'Postal / PIN Code is required.';
const INDIAN_PIN_MESSAGE = 'Must be a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code (e.g. 110001).';
const INTL_POSTAL_MESSAGE = 'Must be a valid postal / ZIP code (2–12 alphanumeric characters).';

/**
 * Validates a postal code against its country (ISO2 code or name).
 * An empty country means India; a non-empty country that isn't in the master (e.g. legacy 'Other')
 * gets the international rule rather than being forced into the Indian PIN format.
 */
export function validatePostalCodeByCountry(
    postalCode: string | undefined,
    country: string | undefined,
    isRequired: boolean
): { valid: boolean; message?: string } {
    const value = postalCode?.trim() ?? '';
    if (!value) {
        return { valid: !isRequired, message: isRequired ? POSTAL_CODE_REQUIRED_MESSAGE : undefined };
    }
    const iso2 = country?.trim() ? resolveCountryIso2(country) : DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE;
    if (iso2 === DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE) {
        return PIN_CODE_REGEX.test(value) ? { valid: true } : { valid: false, message: INDIAN_PIN_MESSAGE };
    }
    return INTL_POSTAL_CODE_REGEX.test(value) ? { valid: true } : { valid: false, message: INTL_POSTAL_MESSAGE };
}

/**
 * Adds a field issue to a schema's superRefine when the postal code doesn't fit its country.
 * Use with zodPostalCode / zodPostalCodeOptional, which only check the generic shape.
 */
export function refinePostalCodeForCountry(
    ctx: z.RefinementCtx,
    field: string,
    postalCode: string | undefined,
    country: string | undefined,
    isRequired = false
): void {
    const result = validatePostalCodeByCountry(postalCode, country, isRequired);
    if (!result.valid) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', message: result.message ?? INTL_POSTAL_MESSAGE, path: [field] });
    }
}

/** Required postal code: text, up to 12 letters/digits/spaces/hyphens. Country format is checked by refinePostalCodeForCountry. */
export const zodPostalCode = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { message: POSTAL_CODE_REQUIRED_MESSAGE })
    .max(12, { message: INTL_POSTAL_MESSAGE })
    .regex(POSTAL_CODE_CHARS_REGEX, { message: INTL_POSTAL_MESSAGE });

export const zodPostalCodeOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(12, { message: INTL_POSTAL_MESSAGE })
    .regex(POSTAL_CODE_CHARS_REGEX, { message: INTL_POSTAL_MESSAGE })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** 10-character Indian PAN format with auto toUpperCase */
export const zodPan = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
    .refine((val) => PAN_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 10-character Indian PAN (e.g. ABCDE1234F).',
    });

export const zodPanOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => (val ? val.toUpperCase() : ''))
    .refine((val) => !val || PAN_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 10-character Indian PAN (e.g. ABCDE1234F).',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** 15-character GST format with auto toUpperCase */
export const zodGst = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
    .refine((val) => GST_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 15-character GSTIN (e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5).',
    });

export const zodGstOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => (val ? val.toUpperCase() : ''))
    .refine((val) => !val || GST_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 15-character GSTIN (e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5).',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** 11-character Indian IFSC code with auto toUpperCase */
export const zodIfsc = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
    .refine((val) => IFSC_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 11-character IFSC code (e.g. SBIN0001234).',
    });

export const zodIfscOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => (val ? val.toUpperCase() : ''))
    .refine((val) => !val || IFSC_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 11-character IFSC code (e.g. SBIN0001234).',
    })
    .optional()

/** Standard email validation, trimmed, lowercased */
export const zodEmail = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.email, maxLengthMessage('Email', FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.email))
    .email({ message: 'Invalid email format.' })
    .toLowerCase();

export const zodEmailOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .max(FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.email, maxLengthMessage('Email', FIELD_MAX_LENGTH.email))
    .refine((val) => !val || z.string().email().safeParse(val).success, {
        message: 'Invalid email format.',
    })
    .default('');

/** Non-negative number coercion */
export const zodAmount = z.coerce
    .number()
    .min(0, { message: 'Amount cannot be negative.' });

/** Number coercion between 0 and 100 */
export const zodPercentage = z.coerce
    .number()
    .min(0, { message: 'Percentage cannot be less than 0.' })
    .max(100, { message: 'Percentage cannot exceed 100.' });

import { z } from 'zod';

    requiredString,
    optionalString,

    optionalText,

    zodEmailOptional,
} from './common';

export const corporateEmailSchema = z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    email: zodEmailOptional,
    isPrimary: z.boolean().default(false),
    isOptedOut: z.boolean().default(false),
    isInvalidBounce: z.boolean().default(false),
});

export const contactFormSchema = z.object({
    name: requiredText('Contact Name', L.personName),
    organizationName: requiredText('Organization Name', L.organizationName),
    mobile: zodPhone,
    officePhone: zodPhoneOptional,
    phone3: zodPhoneOptional,
    phone4: zodPhoneOptional,
    phone5: zodPhoneOptional,
    emailAddresses: z.array(corporateEmailSchema).superRefine((emails, ctx) => {
        // If emails are present, ensure at least one has a non-empty address
        if (emails.length > 0) {
            const hasValidEmail = emails.some((e) => (e.email || '').trim().length > 0);
            if (!hasValidEmail) {
                ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'Please provide at least one valid email address.',
                });
            }
        }
    }),
    assignedTo: requiredString('Assigned Representative'),
    isPrimaryContact: z.boolean().default(false),
    designation: optionalString,
    department: optionalString,
    leftJob: z.enum(['No', 'Yes']).default('No'),
    communicationType: z.array(z.string()).default(['Call', 'Email']),
    doNotCall: z.boolean().default(false),
    description: optionalText('Description', L.longText),
});

import { corporateEmailSchema } from './contact.schema';

export const partnerCompanySchema = z.object({

    relationshipType: optionalString,
    contactPerson: optionalString,
    contactEmail: zodEmailOptional,
    contactPhone: zodPhoneOptional,
    status: z.enum(['Active', 'Inactive']).default('Active'),

export const organizationFormSchema = z
    .object({
        // Basic Details
        organizationName: requiredText('Organization Name', L.organizationName),
        mailingName: optionalText('Mailing Name', L.organizationName),
        tradeName: optionalText('Trade Name', L.organizationName),
        natureOfBusiness: requiredString('Nature of Business'),
        accountStatus: z.enum(['Active', 'Inactive']).default('Active'),
        inactivityReason: optionalString,
        typeOfEntity: requiredString('Type of Entity'),
        customerType: requiredString('Customer Type'),
        sapCodeTallyId: optionalText('SAP Code / Tally ID', L.shortCode),
        showroomBranchCode: optionalText('Showroom / Branch Code', L.shortCode),
        sourceOfLead: optionalString,
        memberOfParentCorp: optionalText('Parent Corporation', L.organizationName),
        numberOfEmployees: optionalString,
        annualTurnover: optionalString,
        description: optionalText('Description', L.organizationDescription),
        accountVerified: z.boolean().default(false),
        verifiedAt: optionalString,
        verifiedBy: optionalString,
        activeAmc: z.boolean().default(false),
        activeCloud: z.boolean().default(false),
        provideSupport: z.enum(['Yes', 'No']).default('Yes'),
        // Emails live on Contacts now; accepted but not required for older records.
        corporateEmails: z.array(corporateEmailSchema).optional(),

        // Billing Address
        billingAddress: requiredText('Billing Address', L.address),
        billingStreet: optionalText('Billing Street', L.address),
        billingCity: requiredText('Billing City', L.shortText),
        billingState: requiredText('Billing State', L.shortText),
        billingPostalCode: zodPostalCode,
        billingCountry: optionalString.default('India'),
        billingLatitude: optionalString,

        // Shipping Address
        shippingAddress: optionalText('Shipping Address', L.address),
        shippingStreet: optionalText('Shipping Street', L.address),
        shippingCity: optionalText('Shipping City', L.shortText),
        shippingState: optionalText('Shipping State', L.shortText),
        shippingPostalCode: zodPostalCodeOptional,
        shippingCountry: optionalString.default('India'),
        shippingLongitude: optionalString,
        copyAddressFromBilling: z.boolean().default(false),

        // Tax & Bank Details
        registrationType: z.enum(['Registered', 'Unregistered']).default('Registered'),
        panNumber: zodPanOptional,
        msmeRegnNumber: optionalText('MSME Regn. Number', L.msme),
        accountName: optionalText('Account Name', L.organizationName),
        bankName: optionalText('Bank Name', L.personName),
        bankIfscCode: zodIfscOptional,
        gstNo: zodGstOptional,
        gstNumber: optionalString,
        cinNo: optionalText('CIN No', L.cin),
        tanNumber: optionalText('TAN Number', L.tan),
        accountNumber: optionalText('Account Number', L.bankAccount),
        typeOfAccount: optionalString,
        bankAddress: optionalText('Bank Address', L.address),

        if (data.registrationType === 'Registered') {
            const gst = (data.gstNo || data.gstNumber)?.trim();
            if (!gst || gst.length < 1) {
                ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'GST Number is required for registered organizations.',
                    path: ['gstNo'],
                });
            } else if (!GST_REGEX.test(gst.toUpperCase())) {
                ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'Please enter a valid 15-character GSTIN (e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5).',
                    path: ['gstNo'],
                });
            }
        }
    });

    discountType: z.enum(['percentage', 'direct']).default('percentage'),
    salePrice: zodAmount.default(0),
    taxRate: z.string().default('GST 18%'),
    taxAmount: zodAmount.default(0),
    total: zodAmount.default(0),
    description: optionalText('Line item description', L.longText),
    note: optionalText('Line item note', L.longText),
});

export const quotationFormSchema = z.object({
    // ── Tab 1: Overview ───────────────────────────────────────────
    quotationTitle: requiredText('Quotation Title', L.title),
    quoteStage: z.enum(QUOTE_STAGES as [string, ...string[]]).default('Draft'),
    quotationDate: requiredString('Quotation Date'),
    validUntil: requiredString('Valid Until Date'),
    remarks: optionalText('Remarks', L.longText),
    termsAndCondition: requiredString('Terms & Condition'),
    termsAndConditionDescription: optionalText('Terms & Condition Description', L.longText),
    assignedTo: requiredString('Assigned Representative'),

    opportunityName: requiredString('Opportunity Name'),
    company: requiredString('Company'),
    validationPeriod: requiredString('Validation Period'),
    otherRef: optionalText('Other Ref.', L.shortText),
    paymentTerms: requiredString('Payment Terms'),
    paymentTermsDescription: optionalText('Payment Terms Description', L.longText),
    preparedFor: requiredString('Prepared For'),

    // ── Tab 2: Line Items ─────────────────────────────────────────
    currency: optionalString.default('Indian Rupee: ₹'),
    groupName: optionalText('Group Name', L.shortText).default('Software Licenses & Add-ons'),
    lineItems: z
        .array(quotationLineItemSchema)
        .min(1, { message: 'At least one line item is required to create a quotation.' }),
    lumpSumDiscount: zodAmount.default(0),
    totalAmount: zodAmount.default(0),
    totalDiscount: zodAmount.default(0),
    subtotal: zodAmount.default(0),
    totalTax: zodAmount.default(0),
    grandTotal: zodAmount.default(0),

    // ── Tab 3: Address Information ────────────────────────────────
    organizationName: optionalText('Organization', L.organizationName),
    organizationId: optionalString,
    contactName: requiredText('Contact Name', L.personName),
    contactId: optionalString,
    contactMobile: zodPhoneOptional,
    mailingName: optionalText('Mailing Name', L.organizationName),
    gstNo: zodGstOptional,
    contactEmail: zodEmailOptional,

    billingAddress: requiredText('Street / Billing Address', L.address),
    billingCity: requiredText('City', L.shortText),
    billingState: requiredText('State / Region', L.shortText),
    billingPostalCode: zodPostalCode,
    billingCountry: requiredString('Country').default('India'),

    shippingAddress: optionalText('Shipping Street', L.address),
    shippingCity: optionalText('Shipping City', L.shortText),
    shippingState: optionalText('Shipping State', L.shortText),
    shippingPostalCode: zodPostalCodeOptional,
    shippingCountry: optionalString,
    copyAddressFromBilling: z.boolean().default(true),

    // ── Context & Compatibility Aliases ───────────────────────────
    opportunityId: optionalString,
    opportunityCode: optionalString,
    status: optionalString,
    quoteDate: optionalString,
    quotationSubject: optionalText('Quotation Subject', L.title),
    contactNumber: zodPhoneOptional,
    emailAddress: zodEmailOptional,
    notes: optionalText('Internal Notes', L.longText),
    termsAndConditions: optionalText('Terms and Conditions', L.longText),
}).superRefine((data, ctx) => {
    refinePostalCodeForCountry(ctx, 'billingPostalCode', data.billingPostalCode, data.billingCountry, true);
    // An empty shipping country falls back to the billing country.
    refinePostalCodeForCountry(ctx, 'shippingPostalCode', data.shippingPostalCode, data.shippingCountry || data.billingCountry);
});

export type QuotationFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof quotationFormSchema>;

File: frontend-crm/src/validations/ticket.schema.ts

import { z } from 'zod';
import { FIELD_MAX_LENGTH as L } from '../config/fieldLimits';
import {
    requiredString,
    optionalString,
    requiredText,
    optionalText,
    zodPhoneOptional,
    zodEmailOptional,
} from './common';
import { getNatureOfCalls } from '../services/masterData.store';
import {
    SUPPORT_MODES,
    SUPPORT_TYPES,
    TICKET_PRIORITIES,
    TICKET_SOURCES,
    TICKET_STATUSES,
} from '../types/ticket.types';

/** Enum whose empty/unknown value surfaces as "<Field> is required." instead of zod's generic enum message. */
const requiredEnum = <T extends string>(values: readonly [T, ...T[]], fieldName: string) =>
    z.enum(values, { error: () => `${fieldName} is required.` });

const asTuple = <T extends string>(values: T[]) => values as [T, ...T[]];

export const ticketFormSchema = z.object({
    // Overview — left column
    amcFlag: z.boolean().default(false),
    ticketSubject: optionalText('Ticket Subject', L.title),
    organizationName: requiredText('Organization Name', L.organizationName),
    contactPersonName: requiredText('Contact Person Name', L.personName),
    contactNumber: zodPhoneOptional,
    ticketPriority: requiredEnum(asTuple(TICKET_PRIORITIES), 'Ticket Priority'),
    source: z.enum(asTuple(TICKET_SOURCES)).default('Call'),
    supportType: z.enum(asTuple(SUPPORT_TYPES)).default('Free'),
    problemReported: requiredText('Problem Reported', L.longText),
    resolution: optionalText('Resolution', L.longText),
    reasonForEscalatedCalls: optionalText('Reason For Escalated Calls', L.longText),
    assignedTo: requiredString('Assigned to'),

    // Overview — right column
    cloudFlag: z.boolean().default(false),
    natureOfCall: requiredString('Nature Of Call').refine(
        (v) => getNatureOfCalls().some((n) => n.name.toLowerCase() === v.toLowerCase()),
        { message: 'Select a Nature Of Call from the list.' }
    ),
    accountAddress: optionalText('Account Address', L.address),
    contactEmail: zodEmailOptional,
    leftJob: z.enum(['No', 'Yes']).default('No'),
    ticketStatus: z.enum(asTuple(TICKET_STATUSES)).default('New'),
    dueDate: requiredString('Due Date').refine((v) => !Number.isNaN(new Date(v).getTime()), {
        message: 'Due Date must be a valid date and time.',
    }),
    supportMode: requiredEnum(asTuple(SUPPORT_MODES), 'Support Mode'),
    problemObserved: optionalText('Problem Observed', L.longText),
    rca: optionalText('RCA', L.longText),
    addDescription: optionalText('Add Description', L.longText),

    // Partner Company tab
    partnerCompany: optionalString,
    partnerCompanyContact: optionalString,
});

export type TicketFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof ticketFormSchema>;
